`crates/net-api/src/lockstep.rs`:

```rs
//! Lockstep mode: the server is the clock and the input relay. Every tick it bundles the
//! inputs that arrived for that tick and fans the bundle out to everyone; clients run the
//! deterministic simulation themselves (net-rollback) and report state hashes, which the
//! server compares to flag desyncs. The server keeps the canonical input journal (replays).
//!
//! Frames on the unreliable channel (first byte = kind):
//! ```text
//! 0x10 Input        client->server  u32 first_tick, u8 n, n x (u8 len, bytes)   (same as sync)
//! 0x20 InputBundle  server->client  u32 tick, u8 n, n x (u16 actor, u8 len, bytes)
//! 0x21 Hash         client->server  u32 tick, u64 hash
//! 0x25 InputStats   server->client  u32 tick, i8 min_margin, u8 late   every 30 ticks per actor:
//!                                   how early its inputs arrived (negative = late) -> clients
//!                                   tune their input delay instead of guessing from ping
//! 0x26 DumpReq      server->client  u32 tick            after a desync: "send your state at tick"
//! 0x27 Dump         client->server  u32 tick, u64 hash, bytes state (<= 60 KiB, reliable)
//! ```
//! Bundles for the last `BUNDLE_REDUNDANCY` ticks are re-sent each tick, so a lost datagram
//! costs nothing unless several in a row disappear.
//!
//! Late join / rejoin (reliable-ordered channel):
//! ```text
//! 0x23 CheckpointReq server->master  u32 tick            "upload your confirmed state"
//! 0x22 Checkpoint    master->server  u32 tick, u64 hash, bytes state (<= 60 KiB)
//! 0x24 Catchup       server->joiner  u32 tick, u64 hash, u32 len, bytes state
//! 0x20 InputBundle   server->joiner  (same layout as live bundles) ticks tick..now-1
//! ```
//! When a data link attaches to a room that is past tick 0 the server sends `Catchup`
//! (the newest master checkpoint, or tick 0 with an empty state = "start from the seed")
//! followed by every journal bundle up to the current tick, then the live stream continues.
//! The master is asked for a checkpoint every `CHECKPOINT_EVERY_SECS`, and immediately when
//! a joiner had to replay from a stale one, so catch-up stays bounded without any host
//! migration or peer-to-peer state transfer.

use crate::sync::GameLogic;
use bytes::{Buf, BufMut, Bytes, BytesMut};
use net_common::types::{ActorId, Tick};
use net_rollback::{hash_bytes, Journal, TickInputs};
use net_sim::{EntityId, Frame, FrameConfig};
use net_wire::Schema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet, HashMap, VecDeque};

/// Everything another node needs to continue this room: the newest master checkpoint and
/// the journal from that tick on. Stored in Redis every few seconds (see `ws::run_lockstep`).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct LockstepSnapshot {
    pub hz: u16,
    pub seed: u64,
    pub tick: u32,
    pub checkpoint: Option<(u32, u64, Vec<u8>)>,
    pub journal_from: u32,
    pub journal: Vec<TickInputs>,
}

pub const KIND_INPUT: u8 = crate::sync::KIND_INPUT;
pub const KIND_BUNDLE: u8 = 0x20;
pub const KIND_HASH: u8 = 0x21;
pub const KIND_CHECKPOINT: u8 = 0x22;
pub const KIND_CHECKPOINT_REQ: u8 = 0x23;
pub const KIND_CATCHUP: u8 = 0x24;
/// server->client  u32 tick, i8 min_margin (ticks the actor's inputs arrived before they were
/// needed over the last report window; negative = late), u8 late_count. Clients tune their
/// input delay from it.
pub const KIND_INPUT_STATS: u8 = 0x25;
/// server->client  u32 tick: "send me your state at this tick" (after a desync).
pub const KIND_DUMP_REQ: u8 = 0x26;
/// client->server  u32 tick, u64 hash, bytes state (<= MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES).
pub const KIND_DUMP: u8 = 0x27;
/// Ticks between input-margin reports (per actor).
pub const INPUT_REPORT_EVERY: u32 = 30;
const MAX_PENDING_DUMPS: usize = 16;

/// A client's state at the tick a desync was detected, for offline comparison.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Dump {
    pub tick: u32,
    pub actor: ActorId,
    pub hash: u64,
    pub state: Bytes,
}
pub const BUNDLE_REDUNDANCY: usize = 3;
pub const CHECKPOINT_EVERY_SECS: u32 = 5;
pub const MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES: usize = 60 * 1024;
/// Reliable catch-up frames are split at about this size.
const CATCHUP_CHUNK_BYTES: usize = 32 * 1024;

/// Deterministic state the master uploaded; `tick` is the tick the state is *entering*
/// (all inputs of earlier ticks applied), i.e. `Rollback::current_tick()` when captured.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Checkpoint {
    pub tick: u32,
    pub hash: u64,
    pub state: Bytes,
}
/// Inputs may arrive this many ticks ahead of the server clock.
pub const MAX_AHEAD: u32 = 16;

pub struct LockstepRoom {
    pub hz: u16,
    /// Next tick to be bundled.
    pub tick: Tick,
    pub actors: BTreeMap<ActorId, ()>,
    pending: BTreeMap<u32, TickInputs>,
    pub journal: Journal,
    recent: VecDeque<Bytes>,
    /// Hash reports per tick: actor -> hash.
    hashes: BTreeMap<u32, HashMap<ActorId, u64>>,
    pub desyncs: Vec<(u32, ActorId)>,
    /// Per actor since the last report: (min input margin in ticks, late inputs).
    margins: HashMap<ActorId, (i32, u16)>,
    pending_dumps: std::collections::HashSet<(u32, ActorId)>,
    dumps: Vec<Dump>,
    pub seed: u64,
    /// Current master (set by the host loop); only its checkpoints are accepted.
    pub master: Option<ActorId>,
    pub checkpoint: Option<Checkpoint>,
    last_checkpoint_req: Option<u32>,
    want_checkpoint: bool,
    /// Desyncs per actor this match; at `UNTRUSTED_AFTER` the actor is reported untrusted.
    strikes: HashMap<ActorId, u8>,
    /// Watch-only actors: get the input stream `spectator_delay` ticks late, send nothing.
    spectators: BTreeSet<ActorId>,
    past: VecDeque<Bytes>,
    pub spectator_delay: u32,
    /// Server-stepped simulation (room prop `logic`): its hash is the truth clients are
    /// compared against, and checkpoints come from it instead of the master.
    sim: Option<ServerSim>,
    server_hashes: BTreeMap<u32, u64>,
    /// Recent referee states at `SERVER_HASH_EVERY` ticks (bounded by `MAX_SERVER_STATES_BYTES`),
    /// so a desync can be answered with the node's own state instead of trusting the master.
    server_states: BTreeMap<u32, Bytes>,
    /// Actors that have appeared in a bundle (see `tick`).
    seen: BTreeSet<ActorId>,
}

/// Ticks between server state hashes; matches `RollbackConfig::default().hash_every`.
pub const SERVER_HASH_EVERY: u32 = 10;
/// Total bytes of recent referee states kept for desync dumps (the newest is always kept).
pub const MAX_SERVER_STATES_BYTES: usize = 512 * 1024;
/// Actor id under which the node's own (referee) state is stored among desync dumps.
pub const REFEREE_ACTOR: ActorId = ActorId(0);
/// Journal ticks kept in memory (4 h at 60 Hz). Beyond that the oldest ticks before the last
/// checkpoint are dropped: late join and failover still work (checkpoint + tail), the replay
/// of such a match starts at `from_tick`.
pub const MAX_JOURNAL_TICKS: usize = 4 * 3600 * 60;

/// The game logic stepped on the node over the canonical input journal. Rule shared with
/// clients: an actor's avatar is spawned (`on_join`) at the first tick it appears in a bundle;
/// the hash is `hash_bytes(frame.snapshot())` after the tick's inputs were applied.
pub struct ServerSim {
    pub frame: Frame,
    pub logic: Box<dyn GameLogic>,
    avatars: BTreeMap<ActorId, Option<EntityId>>,
}

impl ServerSim {
    pub fn new(frame: Frame, logic: Box<dyn GameLogic>) -> Self {
        Self {
            frame,
            logic,
            avatars: BTreeMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn step(&mut self, inputs: &TickInputs) {
        for a in inputs.keys() {
            if !self.avatars.contains_key(a) {
                // After a restore the avatar already exists in the frame: re-link, do not spawn.
                let existing = self
                    .frame
                    .entities()
                    .find(|e| e.owner == Some(*a))
                    .map(|e| e.id);
                let av = existing.or_else(|| self.logic.on_join(&mut self.frame, *a));
                self.avatars.insert(*a, av);
            }
        }
        let step: Vec<(ActorId, Option<EntityId>, Vec<u8>, bool)> = self
            .avatars
            .iter()
            .map(|(a, av)| {
                (
                    *a,
                    *av,
                    inputs.get(a).cloned().unwrap_or_default(),
                    inputs.contains_key(a),
                )
            })
            .collect();
        let logic = &mut self.logic;
        self.frame.advance(|f| logic.step(f, &step));
    }

    pub fn hash(&self) -> u64 {
        hash_bytes(&self.frame.snapshot())
    }
}

/// Desyncs after which an actor's results should not be trusted (its hash keeps disagreeing).
pub const UNTRUSTED_AFTER: u8 = 3;

impl LockstepRoom {
    pub fn new(hz: u16, seed: u64) -> Self {
        Self {
            hz: hz.clamp(8, 128),
            tick: Tick(0),
            actors: BTreeMap::new(),
            pending: BTreeMap::new(),
            journal: Journal::default(),
            recent: VecDeque::new(),
            hashes: BTreeMap::new(),
            desyncs: Vec::new(),
            margins: HashMap::new(),
            pending_dumps: Default::default(),
            dumps: Vec::new(),
            seed,
            master: None,
            checkpoint: None,
            last_checkpoint_req: None,
            want_checkpoint: false,
            strikes: HashMap::new(),
            spectators: BTreeSet::new(),
            past: VecDeque::new(),
            spectator_delay: hz.clamp(8, 128) as u32 * 3,
            sim: None,
            server_hashes: BTreeMap::new(),
            server_states: BTreeMap::new(),
            seen: BTreeSet::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Runs `logic` on the node from the last checkpoint (or tick 0) through the journal to the
    /// current tick; from here on hashes and checkpoints are the server's.
    pub fn attach_sim(&mut self, schema: Schema, logic: Box<dyn GameLogic>) -> Result<(), String> {
        let frame = Frame::new(
            schema,
            FrameConfig {
                tick_hz: self.hz,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            self.seed,
        );
        let mut sim = ServerSim::new(frame, logic);
        let start = match &self.checkpoint {
            Some(c) => {
                sim.frame.restore(&c.state).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                // Every owned entity is somebody's avatar: keep stepping them like before.
                let owned: Vec<(ActorId, EntityId)> = sim
                    .frame
                    .entities()
                    .filter_map(|e| e.owner.map(|o| (o, e.id)))
                    .collect();
                for (o, id) in owned {
                    sim.avatars.entry(o).or_insert(Some(id));
                }
                c.tick
            }
            None if self.journal.tick(Tick(0)).is_some() || self.tick.0 == 0 => 0,
            None => return Err("no checkpoint and journal does not start at 0".into()),
        };
        let empty = TickInputs::new();
        for t in start..self.tick.0 {
            sim.step(self.journal.tick(Tick(t)).unwrap_or(&empty));
        }
        self.sim = Some(sim);
        self.server_hashes.clear();
        self.server_states.clear();
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn has_sim(&self) -> bool {
        self.sim.is_some()
    }

    pub fn server_hash(&self, tick: u32) -> Option<u64> {
        self.server_hashes.get(&tick).copied()
    }

    /// Delay of the spectator stream in seconds (default 3, against stream sniping).
    pub fn with_spectator_delay(mut self, secs: u32) -> Self {
        self.spectator_delay = self.hz as u32 * secs;
        self
    }

    pub fn spectators(&self) -> Vec<ActorId> {
        self.spectators.iter().copied().collect()
    }

    /// The datagram spectators should get now: the one from `spectator_delay` ticks ago.
    pub fn spectator_datagram(&self) -> Option<Bytes> {
        (self.past.len() > self.spectator_delay as usize)
            .then(|| self.past.front().cloned())
            .flatten()
    }

    /// Records a desync for `actor`; returns its strike count so far.
    pub fn strike(&mut self, actor: ActorId) -> u8 {
        let n = self.strikes.entry(actor).or_default();
        *n = n.saturating_add(1);
        *n
    }

    pub fn is_untrusted(&self, actor: ActorId) -> bool {
        self.strikes
            .get(&actor)
            .is_some_and(|n| *n >= UNTRUSTED_AFTER)
    }

    /// The bundle produced by the last [`tick`]: one input-journal entry for Redis, so a node
    /// that adopts this room after a crash loses no inputs between checkpoints.
    pub fn last_bundle(&self) -> Option<Bytes> {
        self.recent.back().cloned()
    }

    /// Applies journal entries (from `last_bundle`) stored after the snapshot this room was
    /// restored from: inputs go into the journal and the clock moves past them. Entries at or
    /// before the current tick are already covered and skipped. Returns ticks applied.
    pub fn apply_journal(&mut self, entries: &[Vec<u8>]) -> u32 {
        let mut n = 0;
        for e in entries {
            let Some((t, inputs)) = Self::decode_bundle(e) else {
                continue;
            };
            if t.0.wrapping_sub(self.tick.0) >= 1 << 31 {
                continue;
            }
            if t != self.tick {
                // A gap means journal batches were lost; everything after it is unusable.
                tracing::warn!(
                    expected = self.tick.0,
                    got = t.0,
                    "journal gap, stopping replay"
                );
                break;
            }
            for (a, d) in inputs {
                self.journal.record(t, a, d);
            }
            self.tick = Tick(t.0.wrapping_add(1));
            n += 1;
        }
        n
    }

    /// Parses one bundle as produced by `encode_bundle`.
    pub fn decode_bundle(mut b: &[u8]) -> Option<(Tick, TickInputs)> {
        if b.len() < 6 || b.get_u8() != KIND_BUNDLE {
            return None;
        }
        let t = b.get_u32();
        let k = b.get_u8() as usize;
        let mut inputs = TickInputs::new();
        for _ in 0..k {
            if b.len() < 3 {
                return None;
            }
            let a = ActorId(b.get_u16());
            let l = b.get_u8() as usize;
            if b.len() < l {
                return None;
            }
            inputs.insert(a, b[..l].to_vec());
            b.advance(l);
        }
        Some((Tick(t), inputs))
    }

    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> LockstepSnapshot {
        let from = self.checkpoint.as_ref().map(|c| c.tick).unwrap_or(0);
        LockstepSnapshot {
            hz: self.hz,
            seed: self.seed,
            tick: self.tick.0,
            checkpoint: self
                .checkpoint
                .as_ref()
                .map(|c| (c.tick, c.hash, c.state.to_vec())),
            journal_from: from,
            journal: self.journal.tail(from),
        }
    }

    /// Re-hosts a room on this node: the clock continues from the snapshot tick, late
    /// joiners catch up from the stored checkpoint + journal tail as usual.
    pub fn restore(snap: LockstepSnapshot) -> Self {
        let mut r = Self::new(snap.hz, snap.seed);
        r.tick = Tick(snap.tick);
        r.checkpoint = snap.checkpoint.map(|(tick, hash, state)| Checkpoint {
            tick,
            hash,
            state: Bytes::from(state),
        });
        r.journal = Journal::from_parts(snap.journal_from, snap.journal);
        r.want_checkpoint = true;
        r
    }

    fn checkpoint_every(&self) -> u32 {
        (self.hz as u32 * CHECKPOINT_EVERY_SECS).max(1)
    }

    /// Called once per tick after [`tick`]: a `CheckpointReq` frame for the master, if due.
    pub fn checkpoint_request(&mut self) -> Option<Bytes> {
        if self.sim.is_some() {
            return None;
        }
        self.master?;
        let t = self.tick.0;
        let periodic = t > 0 && t.is_multiple_of(self.checkpoint_every());
        let urgent = self.want_checkpoint
            && self
                .last_checkpoint_req
                .is_none_or(|r| t.wrapping_sub(r) >= self.hz as u32);
        if !(periodic || urgent) {
            return None;
        }
        self.last_checkpoint_req = Some(t);
        let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(5);
        b.put_u8(KIND_CHECKPOINT_REQ);
        b.put_u32(t);
        Some(b.freeze())
    }

    /// A data link attached (join or rejoin) while the room is running: everything the
    /// client needs to reach the current tick, as reliable-ordered frames. Empty at tick 0.
    pub fn on_late_join(&mut self) -> Vec<Bytes> {
        self.catchup_until(self.tick.0)
    }

    /// Catch-up for a joining player, or for a spectator only up to the delayed tick.
    pub fn catchup_for(&mut self, spectator: bool) -> Vec<Bytes> {
        let end = if spectator {
            self.tick.0.saturating_sub(self.spectator_delay)
        } else {
            self.tick.0
        };
        self.catchup_until(end)
    }

    fn catchup_until(&mut self, end: u32) -> Vec<Bytes> {
        if end == 0 {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let (from, hash, state) = match &self.checkpoint {
            Some(c) => (c.tick, c.hash, c.state.clone()),
            None => (0, 0, Bytes::new()),
        };
        if self.tick.0.saturating_sub(from) > 2 * self.checkpoint_every() {
            self.want_checkpoint = true;
        }
        let mut frames = Vec::new();
        let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(17 + state.len());
        b.put_u8(KIND_CATCHUP);
        b.put_u32(from);
        b.put_u64(hash);
        b.put_u32(state.len() as u32);
        b.extend_from_slice(&state);
        frames.push(b.freeze());
        let empty = TickInputs::new();
        let mut chunk: Vec<Bytes> = Vec::new();
        let mut chunk_bytes = 0usize;
        let flush = |chunk: &mut Vec<Bytes>, frames: &mut Vec<Bytes>| {
            if chunk.is_empty() {
                return;
            }
            let mut out = BytesMut::new();
            out.put_u8(KIND_BUNDLE);
            out.put_u8(chunk.len() as u8);
            for r in chunk.drain(..) {
                out.put_u16(r.len() as u16);
                out.extend_from_slice(&r);
            }
            frames.push(out.freeze());
        };
        for t in from..end {
            let inputs = self.journal.tick(Tick(t)).unwrap_or(&empty);
            let bundle = Self::encode_bundle(t, inputs);
            if chunk.len() == 255 || chunk_bytes + bundle.len() + 2 > CATCHUP_CHUNK_BYTES {
                flush(&mut chunk, &mut frames);
                chunk_bytes = 0;
            }
            chunk_bytes += bundle.len() + 2;
            chunk.push(bundle);
        }
        flush(&mut chunk, &mut frames);
        frames
    }

    fn encode_bundle(t: u32, inputs: &TickInputs) -> Bytes {
        let mut b = BytesMut::new();
        b.put_u8(KIND_BUNDLE);
        b.put_u32(t);
        b.put_u8(inputs.len().min(255) as u8);
        for (a, d) in inputs.iter().take(255) {
            b.put_u16(a.0);
            b.put_u8(d.len().min(255) as u8);
            b.extend_from_slice(&d[..d.len().min(255)]);
        }
        b.freeze()
    }

    /// Client side: parses a `Catchup` frame.
    pub fn decode_catchup(mut d: Bytes) -> Option<Checkpoint> {
        if d.len() < 17 || d.get_u8() != KIND_CATCHUP {
            return None;
        }
        let tick = d.get_u32();
        let hash = d.get_u64();
        let len = d.get_u32() as usize;
        if d.len() < len {
            return None;
        }
        Some(Checkpoint {
            tick,
            hash,
            state: d.split_to(len),
        })
    }

    /// Client side: parses a `CheckpointReq` frame (the server's current tick).
    pub fn decode_checkpoint_request(mut d: Bytes) -> Option<u32> {
        if d.len() < 5 || d.get_u8() != KIND_CHECKPOINT_REQ {
            return None;
        }
        Some(d.get_u32())
    }

    /// Client (master) side: a `Checkpoint` upload frame.
    pub fn encode_checkpoint(tick: Tick, hash: u64, state: &[u8]) -> Bytes {
        let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(13 + state.len());
        b.put_u8(KIND_CHECKPOINT);
        b.put_u32(tick.0);
        b.put_u64(hash);
        b.extend_from_slice(state);
        b.freeze()
    }

    pub fn tick_period(&self) -> std::time::Duration {
        std::time::Duration::from_micros(1_000_000 / self.hz as u64)
    }

    pub fn on_join(&mut self, actor: ActorId) {
        self.on_join_as(actor, false)
    }

    pub fn on_join_as(&mut self, actor: ActorId, spectator: bool) {
        if spectator {
            self.spectators.insert(actor);
        } else {
            self.actors.insert(actor, ());
        }
    }

    pub fn on_leave(&mut self, actor: ActorId) {
        self.strikes.remove(&actor);
        self.spectators.remove(&actor);
        self.actors.remove(&actor);
    }

    /// Client data frame. Returns true when handled here.
    pub fn handle(&mut self, actor: ActorId, mut payload: Bytes) -> bool {
        let Some(&kind) = payload.first() else {
            return false;
        };
        if self.spectators.contains(&actor)
            && matches!(kind, KIND_INPUT | KIND_HASH | KIND_CHECKPOINT | KIND_DUMP)
        {
            return true;
        }
        match kind {
            KIND_INPUT => {
                payload.advance(1);
                if payload.len() < 5 {
                    return true;
                }
                let first = payload.get_u32();
                let n = payload.get_u8() as usize;
                for i in 0..n.min(8) {
                    if payload.is_empty() {
                        break;
                    }
                    let len = payload.get_u8() as usize;
                    if payload.len() < len {
                        break;
                    }
                    let data = payload.split_to(len).to_vec();
                    let t = first.wrapping_add(i as u32);
                    if i + 1 == n.min(8) {
                        // the newest input in the packet tells how much slack this actor has
                        let margin = (t as i64 - self.tick.0 as i64).clamp(-127, 127) as i32;
                        let e = self.margins.entry(actor).or_insert((i32::MAX, 0));
                        e.0 = e.0.min(margin);
                        if margin < 0 {
                            e.1 = e.1.saturating_add(1);
                        }
                    }
                    // Late inputs are stamped onto the next tick so the player keeps acting.
                    let t = t.max(self.tick.0);
                    if t > self.tick.0 + MAX_AHEAD {
                        continue;
                    }
                    self.pending
                        .entry(t)
                        .or_default()
                        .entry(actor)
                        .or_insert(data);
                }
                true
            }
            KIND_HASH => {
                payload.advance(1);
                if payload.len() < 12 {
                    return true;
                }
                let t = payload.get_u32();
                let h = payload.get_u64();
                if self.sim.is_some() {
                    if let Some(&sh) = self.server_hashes.get(&t) {
                        if h != sh {
                            self.desyncs.push((t, actor));
                            if let Some(d) = self.referee_dump(t) {
                                if !self
                                    .dumps
                                    .iter()
                                    .any(|x| x.tick == t && x.actor == REFEREE_ACTOR)
                                {
                                    self.dumps.push(d);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else if t < self.tick.0 && self.tick.0 - t <= 600 {
                    self.hashes.entry(t).or_default().insert(actor, h);
                    self.check_hashes(t);
                }
                true
            }
            KIND_DUMP => {
                payload.advance(1);
                if payload.len() < 12 || payload.len() - 12 > MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES {
                    return true;
                }
                let t = payload.get_u32();
                let h = payload.get_u64();
                if self.pending_dumps.remove(&(t, actor)) {
                    self.dumps.push(Dump {
                        tick: t,
                        actor,
                        hash: h,
                        state: payload,
                    });
                }
                true
            }
            KIND_CHECKPOINT => {
                payload.advance(1);
                if self.sim.is_some()
                    || Some(actor) != self.master
                    || payload.len() < 12
                    || payload.len() - 12 > MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES
                {
                    return true;
                }
                let t = payload.get_u32();
                let h = payload.get_u64();
                if t > self.tick.0 || self.checkpoint.as_ref().is_some_and(|c| c.tick >= t) {
                    return true;
                }
                self.checkpoint = Some(Checkpoint {
                    tick: t,
                    hash: h,
                    state: payload,
                });
                self.want_checkpoint = false;
                true
            }
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    /// Majority hash wins; anyone else is flagged once all current actors reported.
    fn check_hashes(&mut self, t: u32) {
        let Some(reports) = self.hashes.get(&t) else {
            return;
        };
        if reports.len() < self.actors.len().max(2) {
            return;
        }
        let mut counts: HashMap<u64, usize> = HashMap::new();
        for h in reports.values() {
            *counts.entry(*h).or_default() += 1;
        }
        let (majority, _) = counts.iter().max_by_key(|(_, n)| **n).unwrap();
        for (a, h) in reports {
            if h != majority {
                self.desyncs.push((t, *a));
            }
        }
        self.hashes.remove(&t);
        // forget very old partial reports
        let cutoff = self.tick.0.saturating_sub(600);
        self.hashes.retain(|k, _| *k >= cutoff);
    }

    /// The canonical replay so far (consumes the journal copy).
    pub fn replay(&self, schema_hash: &str) -> net_rollback::Replay {
        // Actors from the journal: by the time a room closes everyone has left.
        let actors = self.journal.actors();
        self.journal
            .clone()
            .into_replay(self.seed, schema_hash.to_string(), self.hz, actors, 10)
    }

    /// Instant replay: the confirmed inputs of a live room for ticks `from..to` (what the journal
    /// still holds; `from_tick` in the result says where it really starts).
    pub fn replay_window(&self, from: u32, to: Option<u32>) -> net_rollback::Replay {
        let mut r = self.replay("");
        window_replay(&mut r, from, to);
        r
    }

    pub fn take_desyncs(&mut self) -> Vec<(u32, ActorId)> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.desyncs)
    }

    /// Every `INPUT_REPORT_EVERY` ticks: one `KIND_INPUT_STATS` frame per actor that sent input
    /// since the last report. Call right after `tick()`.
    pub fn input_reports(&mut self) -> Vec<(ActorId, Bytes)> {
        if !self.tick.0.is_multiple_of(INPUT_REPORT_EVERY) || self.margins.is_empty() {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let t = self.tick.0;
        std::mem::take(&mut self.margins)
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(a, (min, late))| {
                let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(7);
                b.put_u8(KIND_INPUT_STATS);
                b.put_u32(t);
                b.put_i8(min.clamp(-127, 127) as i8);
                b.put_u8(late.min(255) as u8);
                (a, b.freeze())
            })
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn decode_input_stats(mut d: Bytes) -> Option<(u32, i8, u8)> {
        if d.len() < 7 || d.get_u8() != KIND_INPUT_STATS {
            return None;
        }
        Some((d.get_u32(), d.get_i8(), d.get_u8()))
    }

    /// Asks `actor` for its state at `tick` (after a desync); the answer lands in `take_dumps`.
    pub fn request_dump(&mut self, tick: u32, actor: ActorId) -> Option<Bytes> {
        if self.pending_dumps.len() >= MAX_PENDING_DUMPS
            || !self.pending_dumps.insert((tick, actor))
        {
            return None;
        }
        let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(5);
        b.put_u8(KIND_DUMP_REQ);
        b.put_u32(tick);
        Some(b.freeze())
    }

    /// The node's own state at `tick` (lockstep rooms with a `logic` module), stored among the
    /// desync dumps as actor `REFEREE_ACTOR` so operators diff clients against the truth.
    pub fn referee_dump(&self, tick: u32) -> Option<Dump> {
        let state = self.server_states.get(&tick)?.clone();
        let hash = self.server_hashes.get(&tick).copied()?;
        Some(Dump {
            tick,
            actor: REFEREE_ACTOR,
            hash,
            state,
        })
    }

    pub fn take_dumps(&mut self) -> Vec<Dump> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.dumps)
    }

    pub fn encode_dump(tick: u32, hash: u64, state: &[u8]) -> Bytes {
        let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(13 + state.len());
        b.put_u8(KIND_DUMP);
        b.put_u32(tick);
        b.put_u64(hash);
        b.extend_from_slice(state);
        b.freeze()
    }

    /// Closes the current tick: records inputs, builds the bundle, advances the clock.
    /// Returns the datagram to send to every actor (current + redundant bundles).
    pub fn tick(&mut self) -> Bytes {
        let t = self.tick.0;
        let mut inputs = self.pending.remove(&t).unwrap_or_default();
        // A new actor appears in its first bundle even without input, so every simulation
        // (server and clients) spawns the avatar at the same tick.
        for a in self.actors.keys() {
            if self.seen.insert(*a) {
                inputs.entry(*a).or_default();
            }
        }
        for (a, d) in inputs.iter().take(255) {
            self.journal.record(Tick(t), *a, d.clone());
        }
        if self.journal.live_len() > MAX_JOURNAL_TICKS {
            if let Some(c) = &self.checkpoint {
                let keep_from = c
                    .tick
                    .saturating_sub(self.hz as u32 * CHECKPOINT_EVERY_SECS);
                self.journal.trim_before(keep_from);
            }
        }
        if let Some(sim) = self.sim.as_mut() {
            sim.step(&inputs);
            let now = t.wrapping_add(1);
            let every = (self.hz as u32 * CHECKPOINT_EVERY_SECS).max(1);
            if now.is_multiple_of(SERVER_HASH_EVERY) || now.is_multiple_of(every) {
                let h = sim.hash();
                self.server_hashes.insert(now, h);
                let cutoff = now.saturating_sub(600);
                self.server_hashes.retain(|k, _| *k >= cutoff);
                let state = sim.frame.snapshot();
                if state.len() <= MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES {
                    self.server_states.insert(now, Bytes::from(state.clone()));
                    let mut total: usize = self.server_states.values().map(|b| b.len()).sum();
                    while total > MAX_SERVER_STATES_BYTES && self.server_states.len() > 1 {
                        if let Some((&oldest, _)) = self.server_states.iter().next() {
                            total -= self.server_states.remove(&oldest).map_or(0, |b| b.len());
                        }
                    }
                }
                if now.is_multiple_of(every) && state.len() <= MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES {
                    self.checkpoint = Some(Checkpoint {
                        tick: now,
                        hash: h,
                        state: Bytes::from(state),
                    });
                    self.want_checkpoint = false;
                }
            }
        }
        let b = Self::encode_bundle(t, &inputs);
        let bundle = b;
        self.recent.push_back(bundle);
        while self.recent.len() > BUNDLE_REDUNDANCY {
            self.recent.pop_front();
        }
        self.tick = Tick(t.wrapping_add(1));
        // One datagram: u8 count, then bundles each prefixed by u16 len.
        let mut out = BytesMut::new();
        out.put_u8(KIND_BUNDLE);
        out.put_u8(self.recent.len() as u8);
        for r in &self.recent {
            out.put_u16(r.len() as u16);
            out.extend_from_slice(r);
        }
        let out = out.freeze();
        self.past.push_back(out.clone());
        while self.past.len() > self.spectator_delay as usize + 1 {
            self.past.pop_front();
        }
        out
    }

    /// Client side: splits a server datagram into (tick, inputs) bundles.
    pub fn decode_bundles(mut d: Bytes) -> Vec<(Tick, TickInputs)> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        if d.len() < 2 || d.get_u8() != KIND_BUNDLE {
            return out;
        }
        let n = d.get_u8() as usize;
        for _ in 0..n {
            if d.len() < 2 {
                break;
            }
            let len = d.get_u16() as usize;
            if d.len() < len {
                break;
            }
            let mut b = d.split_to(len);
            if b.len() < 6 || b.get_u8() != KIND_BUNDLE {
                break;
            }
            let t = b.get_u32();
            let k = b.get_u8() as usize;
            let mut inputs = TickInputs::new();
            for _ in 0..k {
                if b.len() < 3 {
                    break;
                }
                let a = ActorId(b.get_u16());
                let l = b.get_u8() as usize;
                if b.len() < l {
                    break;
                }
                inputs.insert(a, b.split_to(l).to_vec());
            }
            out.push((Tick(t), inputs));
        }
        out
    }

    pub fn encode_hash(tick: Tick, hash: u64) -> Bytes {
        let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(13);
        b.put_u8(KIND_HASH);
        b.put_u32(tick.0);
        b.put_u64(hash);
        b.freeze()
    }
}

/// Cuts a replay down to ticks `from..to` (exclusive); keeps `from_tick`/`hashes` consistent.
pub fn window_replay(r: &mut net_rollback::Replay, from: u32, to: Option<u32>) {
    if from > r.from_tick {
        let drop = ((from - r.from_tick) as usize).min(r.inputs.len());
        r.inputs.drain(..drop);
        r.from_tick += drop as u32;
    }
    if let Some(to) = to {
        let keep = to.saturating_sub(r.from_tick) as usize;
        r.inputs.truncate(keep);
    }
    let end = r.from_tick + r.inputs.len() as u32;
    r.hashes.retain(|(t, _)| *t >= r.from_tick && *t < end);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn replay_window_cuts_inputs_and_hashes_consistently() {
        let mut r = net_rollback::Replay {
            seed: 1,
            schema_hash: String::new(),
            tick_hz: 30,
            actors: vec![],
            from_tick: 0,
            inputs: (0..10).map(|_| Default::default()).collect(),
            hash_every: 5,
            hashes: vec![(0, 1), (5, 2), (9, 3)],
        };
        window_replay(&mut r, 3, Some(7));
        assert_eq!((r.from_tick, r.inputs.len()), (3, 4));
        assert_eq!(r.hashes, vec![(5, 2)]);
        // a window that starts before what the journal still holds keeps the journal's start
        let mut r2 = r.clone();
        window_replay(&mut r2, 0, None);
        assert_eq!((r2.from_tick, r2.inputs.len()), (3, 4));
        window_replay(&mut r, 100, Some(200));
        assert_eq!((r.from_tick, r.inputs.len(), r.hashes.len()), (7, 0, 0));
    }

    use super::*;
    use crate::sync::SyncRoom;

    #[test]
    fn bundles_inputs_and_detects_desync() {
        let mut r = LockstepRoom::new(60, 1);
        let (a, b, c) = (ActorId(1), ActorId(2), ActorId(3));
        for x in [a, b, c] {
            r.on_join(x);
        }
        assert!(r.handle(a, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(0), &[vec![1], vec![2]])));
        assert!(r.handle(b, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(1), &[vec![9]])));
        let d0 = r.tick();
        let got = LockstepRoom::decode_bundles(d0);
        assert_eq!(got.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(got[0].0, Tick(0));
        assert_eq!(got[0].1.get(&a), Some(&vec![1]));
        assert_eq!(got[0].1.get(&b), Some(&vec![])); // first appearance, no input yet
        let d1 = r.tick();
        let got = LockstepRoom::decode_bundles(d1);
        assert_eq!(got.len(), 2); // redundancy: tick 0 again + tick 1
        assert_eq!(got[1].1.get(&a), Some(&vec![2]));
        assert_eq!(got[1].1.get(&b), Some(&vec![9]));
        assert_eq!(r.journal.len(), 2);
        // late input lands on the current tick, far-ahead input is dropped
        assert!(r.handle(c, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(0), &[vec![5]])));
        assert!(r.handle(c, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(500), &[vec![6]])));
        let got = LockstepRoom::decode_bundles(r.tick());
        assert_eq!(got.last().unwrap().1.get(&c), Some(&vec![5]));
        // hashes: a and b agree, c differs
        r.handle(a, LockstepRoom::encode_hash(Tick(1), 42));
        r.handle(b, LockstepRoom::encode_hash(Tick(1), 42));
        assert!(r.take_desyncs().is_empty());
        r.handle(c, LockstepRoom::encode_hash(Tick(1), 43));
        assert_eq!(r.take_desyncs(), vec![(1, c)]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn late_join_gets_checkpoint_and_journal_tail() {
        let mut r = LockstepRoom::new(60, 7);
        let (a, b) = (ActorId(1), ActorId(2));
        r.on_join(a);
        r.on_join(b);
        r.master = Some(a);
        for t in 0..400u32 {
            r.handle(a, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(t), &[vec![t as u8]]));
            r.handle(b, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(t), &[vec![1, t as u8]]));
            let _ = r.tick();
            let req = r.checkpoint_request();
            // Periodic request every 5s (300 ticks).
            assert_eq!(req.is_some(), t + 1 == 300, "tick {t}");
            if let Some(req) = req {
                assert_eq!(LockstepRoom::decode_checkpoint_request(req), Some(300));
                // Non-master uploads are ignored.
                assert!(r.handle(b, LockstepRoom::encode_checkpoint(Tick(300), 1, b"x")));
                assert!(r.checkpoint.is_none());
                assert!(r.handle(
                    a,
                    LockstepRoom::encode_checkpoint(Tick(300), 0xC0FFEE, b"state")
                ));
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(r.checkpoint.as_ref().map(|c| c.tick), Some(300));
        let frames = r.on_late_join();
        let ck = LockstepRoom::decode_catchup(frames[0].clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            (ck.tick, ck.hash, &ck.state[..]),
            (300, 0xC0FFEE, &b"state"[..])
        );
        let bundles: Vec<_> = frames[1..]
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|f| LockstepRoom::decode_bundles(f.clone()))
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(bundles.len(), 100);
        for (i, (t, inputs)) in bundles.iter().enumerate() {
            assert_eq!(t.0, 300 + i as u32);
            assert_eq!(inputs.get(&a), Some(&vec![(300 + i) as u8]));
            assert_eq!(inputs.get(&b).map(|v| v.len()), Some(2));
        }
        // Fresh checkpoint: no urgent request.
        assert!(r.checkpoint_request().is_none());

        // Without any checkpoint the joiner replays from tick 0 and a request becomes urgent.
        let mut r2 = LockstepRoom::new(60, 1);
        r2.on_join(a);
        r2.master = Some(a);
        for _ in 0..700 {
            let _ = r2.tick();
            let _ = r2.checkpoint_request();
        }
        let frames = r2.on_late_join();
        let ck = LockstepRoom::decode_catchup(frames[0].clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((ck.tick, ck.state.len()), (0, 0));
        let n: usize = frames[1..]
            .iter()
            .map(|f| LockstepRoom::decode_bundles(f.clone()).len())
            .sum();
        assert_eq!(n, 700);
        assert!(frames.iter().all(|f| f.len() <= 64 * 1024));
        for _ in 0..60 {
            let _ = r2.tick();
        }
        assert!(r2.checkpoint_request().is_some());

        // Snapshot -> restore on another node continues the clock and serves catch-up.
        let snap = r.snapshot();
        assert_eq!(
            (snap.tick, snap.journal_from, snap.journal.len()),
            (400, 300, 100)
        );
        let json = serde_json::to_vec(&snap).unwrap();
        let mut r3 = LockstepRoom::restore(serde_json::from_slice(&json).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(r3.tick, Tick(400));
        let _ = r3.tick();
        let frames = r3.on_late_join();
        let ck = LockstepRoom::decode_catchup(frames[0].clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(ck.tick, 300);
        let n: usize = frames[1..]
            .iter()
            .map(|f| LockstepRoom::decode_bundles(f.clone()).len())
            .sum();
        assert_eq!(n, 101);
        // The restored node only knows the journal from the checkpoint on; its replay says so.
        let (full, partial) = (r.replay(""), r3.replay(""));
        assert_eq!((full.from_tick, full.inputs.len()), (0, 400));
        assert_eq!((partial.from_tick, partial.inputs.len()), (300, 100));
    }

    #[test]
    fn catchup_is_contiguous_across_chunks_and_past_journal_end() {
        // Journal has inputs only up to tick 553, room is at 600, checkpoint at 300: the tail
        // must still cover 300..599 contiguously (empty bundles past the journal end), and the
        // 255-bundles-per-frame limit must not drop or duplicate anything.
        let mut r = LockstepRoom::new(60, 1);
        let a = ActorId(1);
        r.on_join(a);
        r.master = Some(a);
        for t in 0..600u32 {
            if t < 554 {
                r.handle(a, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(t), &[vec![t as u8, 1, 2]]));
            }
            let _ = r.tick();
            if t == 299 {
                assert!(r.handle(a, LockstepRoom::encode_checkpoint(Tick(300), 1, b"s")));
            }
        }
        let snap = r.snapshot();
        assert_eq!(
            (snap.tick, snap.journal_from, snap.journal.len()),
            (600, 300, 254)
        );
        let mut r2 = LockstepRoom::restore(snap);
        let frames = r2.on_late_join();
        assert_eq!(
            LockstepRoom::decode_catchup(frames[0].clone())
                .unwrap()
                .tick,
            300
        );
        let mut expect = 300u32;
        for f in &frames[1..] {
            let bundles = LockstepRoom::decode_bundles(f.clone());
            assert!(!bundles.is_empty());
            for (t, inputs) in bundles {
                assert_eq!(t.0, expect, "gap/dup at {expect}");
                assert_eq!(inputs.contains_key(&a), t.0 < 554);
                expect += 1;
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(expect, 600);
    }

    #[test]
    fn journal_entries_fill_the_gap_after_a_snapshot() {
        let mut r = LockstepRoom::new(60, 1);
        let a = ActorId(1);
        r.on_join(a);
        r.master = Some(a);
        let mut snap = None;
        let mut entries = Vec::new();
        for t in 0..100u32 {
            r.handle(a, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(t), &[vec![t as u8]]));
            let _ = r.tick();
            if t == 49 {
                snap = Some(r.snapshot());
            } else if t > 49 {
                entries.push(r.last_bundle().unwrap().to_vec());
            }
        }
        let mut r2 = LockstepRoom::restore(snap.unwrap());
        assert_eq!(r2.tick.0, 50);
        // stale and duplicate entries are ignored, the tail is applied once
        let mut with_noise = vec![entries[0].clone()];
        with_noise.extend(entries.iter().cloned());
        assert_eq!(r2.apply_journal(&with_noise), 50);
        assert_eq!(r2.tick.0, 100);
        assert_eq!(r2.journal.tail(0), r.journal.tail(0));
        assert_eq!(r2.apply_journal(&entries), 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn strikes_make_an_actor_untrusted() {
        let mut r = LockstepRoom::new(60, 1);
        let a = ActorId(1);
        assert_eq!(r.strike(a), 1);
        assert_eq!(r.strike(a), 2);
        assert!(!r.is_untrusted(a));
        assert_eq!(r.strike(a), 3);
        assert!(r.is_untrusted(a));
        r.on_leave(a);
        assert!(!r.is_untrusted(a));
    }

    #[test]
    fn spectators_get_the_stream_late_and_send_nothing() {
        let mut r = LockstepRoom::new(60, 1).with_spectator_delay(1);
        let (a, w) = (ActorId(1), ActorId(9));
        r.on_join(a);
        r.on_join_as(w, true);
        assert_eq!(r.actors.len(), 1);
        assert!(r.handle(w, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(0), &[vec![5]])));
        let mut live = Vec::new();
        for t in 0..70u32 {
            r.handle(a, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(t), &[vec![t as u8]]));
            live.push(r.tick());
            if t < 60 {
                assert!(r.spectator_datagram().is_none(), "t={t}");
            }
        }
        // 60 ticks of delay: at tick 69 the spectator gets the datagram of tick 9
        assert_eq!(r.spectator_datagram(), Some(live[9].clone()));
        assert!(r.journal.tick(Tick(0)).unwrap().get(&w).is_none());
        // catch-up for a spectator stops at the delayed tick
        let frames = r.catchup_for(true);
        let mut last = 0;
        for f in &frames[1..] {
            for (t, _) in LockstepRoom::decode_bundles(f.clone()) {
                last = t.0;
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(last, 9);
    }

    #[test]
    fn server_sim_is_the_truth_and_survives_restore() {
        use crate::sync::{ArenaLogic, ARENA_SCHEMA};
        let schema = Schema::parse(ARENA_SCHEMA).unwrap();
        let logic = || -> Box<dyn GameLogic> { Box::new(ArenaLogic { speed: 6.0 }) };
        let mut r = LockstepRoom::new(60, 7);
        r.attach_sim(schema.clone(), logic()).unwrap();
        let (a, b) = (ActorId(1), ActorId(2));
        r.on_join(a);
        r.on_join(b);
        // a client mirror steps the same bundles with the same rule
        let mut mirror = ServerSim::new(
            Frame::new(
                schema.clone(),
                FrameConfig {
                    tick_hz: 60,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                7,
            ),
            logic(),
        );
        let mut mirror_hashes = BTreeMap::new();
        for t in 0..320u32 {
            r.handle(a, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(t), &[vec![127, 0, 0]]));
            let dg = r.tick();
            for (tk, inputs) in LockstepRoom::decode_bundles(dg) {
                if tk.0 == t {
                    mirror.step(&inputs);
                    if (t + 1).is_multiple_of(SERVER_HASH_EVERY) {
                        mirror_hashes.insert(t + 1, mirror.hash());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(r.server_hash(320), Some(mirror_hashes[&320]));
        assert_eq!(r.server_hash(10), Some(mirror_hashes[&10]));
        assert!(r.checkpoint.as_ref().is_some_and(|c| c.tick == 300));
        assert!(r.checkpoint_request().is_none());
        // both clients agree on a wrong hash: a majority vote would pass, the server does not
        for x in [a, b] {
            r.handle(x, LockstepRoom::encode_hash(Tick(310), 12345));
        }
        assert_eq!(r.take_desyncs(), vec![(310, a), (310, b)]);
        // the referee's own state is the reference dump (once per tick, actor 0)
        let dumps = r.take_dumps();
        assert_eq!(dumps.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(dumps[0].actor, REFEREE_ACTOR);
        assert_eq!(dumps[0].tick, 310);
        assert_eq!(dumps[0].hash, mirror_hashes[&310]);
        assert_eq!(hash_bytes(&dumps[0].state), mirror_hashes[&310]);
        r.handle(a, LockstepRoom::encode_hash(Tick(310), mirror_hashes[&310]));
        assert!(r.take_desyncs().is_empty());
        // re-host: checkpoint at 300 + journal tail resimulated to 320 gives the same hash
        let snap = r.snapshot();
        let mut r2 = LockstepRoom::restore(snap);
        r2.attach_sim(schema, logic()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r2.sim.as_ref().unwrap().hash(), mirror_hashes[&320]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn input_margins_are_reported_and_dumps_only_when_requested() {
        let mut r = LockstepRoom::new(60, 1);
        let a = ActorId(1);
        r.on_join_as(a, false);
        for _ in 0..5 {
            r.tick();
        }
        // input stamped 3 ticks ahead, then one late (stamped at an old tick)
        let early =
            crate::sync::SyncRoom::encode_input(net_common::types::Tick(r.tick.0 + 3), &[vec![1]]);
        r.handle(a, early);
        let late = crate::sync::SyncRoom::encode_input(
            net_common::types::Tick(r.tick.0.saturating_sub(2)),
            &[vec![2]],
        );
        r.handle(a, late);
        let mut reports = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..(INPUT_REPORT_EVERY * 2) {
            r.tick();
            reports = r.input_reports();
            if !reports.is_empty() {
                break;
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(reports.len(), 1);
        let (_, min, late_n) = LockstepRoom::decode_input_stats(reports[0].1.clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(min, -2);
        assert_eq!(late_n, 1);
        assert!(r.input_reports().is_empty(), "report window reset");

        // an unsolicited dump is ignored; a requested one is kept once
        r.handle(a, LockstepRoom::encode_dump(7, 0xabc, b"state"));
        assert!(r.take_dumps().is_empty());
        let req = r.request_dump(7, a).expect("request frame");
        assert_eq!(req[0], KIND_DUMP_REQ);
        assert!(r.request_dump(7, a).is_none(), "no duplicate request");
        r.handle(a, LockstepRoom::encode_dump(7, 0xabc, b"state"));
        let d = r.take_dumps();
        assert_eq!(d.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(
            (d[0].tick, d[0].actor, d[0].hash, &d[0].state[..]),
            (7, a, 0xabc, &b"state"[..])
        );
        r.handle(a, LockstepRoom::encode_dump(7, 0xabc, b"again"));
        assert!(r.take_dumps().is_empty());
    }
}

```

`crates/net-api/src/matchmaking.rs`:

```rs
//! Matchmaking tickets: clients (or the game backend) file a ticket with the room shape they
//! want; the matcher groups compatible tickets and assigns them a room name. Clients then
//! `join_or_create` that name with the same mode. Tickets live in Redis, so a ticket filed on
//! any node of a region matches tickets filed on every other node; one node at a time runs the
//! matching pass (short leader lock, re-elected every cycle). 5 minute TTL while searching.

use net_common::{NetError, ProjectId, Result, RoomMode};
use net_control::{LiveRoom, RedisStore};
use redis::AsyncCommands;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use uuid::Uuid;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TicketReq {
    pub player_id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub mode: RoomMode,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub region: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default = "d_max")]
    pub max_players: u16,
    #[serde(default = "d_min")]
    pub min_players: u16,
    #[serde(default = "d_wait")]
    pub max_wait_secs: u64,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub props: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
    /// Player attributes other tickets may filter on (rank, language, ...); not part of the bucket.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub attrs: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
    /// SQL-like condition the *other* players' `attrs` must satisfy (`rank >= 10 AND lang = 'en'`).
    /// Two tickets only share a room when each one's filter accepts the other's attrs.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub filter: Option<String>,
    /// Prefer a seat in an already running open room (same mode, free slot, lobby props satisfy
    /// `filter`) over waiting for a fresh group; `match_type` picks among candidates:
    /// `fill` (fullest first, default), `serial` (emptiest first), `random`.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub fill_existing: bool,
    /// When `max_wait_secs` runs out with fewer than `max_players`, hand the group a room anyway
    /// and report the empty seats as `bots` so the game (master or WASM logic) fills them with AI —
    /// bot backfill; without it the group simply starts short-handed.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub bots: bool,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub match_type: Option<String>,
}
fn d_max() -> u16 {
    8
}
fn d_min() -> u16 {
    2
}
fn d_wait() -> u64 {
    15
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case", tag = "state")]
pub enum TicketState {
    Searching {
        waiting: usize,
    },
    Matched {
        room: String,
        mode: RoomMode,
        max_players: u16,
        players: Vec<String>,
        /// Seats the game should fill with bots (0 unless the ticket asked for `bots`).
        #[serde(default)]
        bots: u16,
    },
    Cancelled,
}

/// A group of tickets that became one room during a cycle (`match.found` webhook).
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct MatchFound {
    pub project: ProjectId,
    pub room: String,
    pub mode: RoomMode,
    pub players: Vec<String>,
    pub tickets: Vec<Uuid>,
    pub bots: u16,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Ticket {
    pub id: Uuid,
    pub project: ProjectId,
    pub req: TicketReq,
    /// Unix milliseconds.
    pub created_ms: u64,
    pub state: TicketState,
}

impl Ticket {
    fn bucket(&self) -> String {
        format!(
            "{:?}|{}|{}|{}",
            self.req.mode,
            self.req.region.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
            self.req.max_players,
            serde_json::Value::Object(self.req.props.clone())
        )
    }

    pub fn age_secs(&self, now_ms: u64) -> u64 {
        now_ms.saturating_sub(self.created_ms) / 1000
    }

    fn searching(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.state, TicketState::Searching { .. })
    }
}

pub const SEARCH_TTL_SECS: u64 = 300;
pub const RESULT_TTL_SECS: u64 = 120;
const LEADER_TTL_MS: u64 = 1500;

pub fn now_ms() -> u64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_millis() as u64)
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Pure matching pass over every searching ticket (all projects): groups per project+bucket,
/// starts full groups, or groups past the oldest ticket's wait with enough players. Mutates
/// states in place (waiting counts, matches) and returns the ids that changed plus the room
/// names started.
/// Picks one room out of `rooms` (already filtered to acceptable ones) by `match_type`.
pub fn pick_room<'a>(rooms: &[&'a LiveRoom], match_type: Option<&str>) -> Option<&'a LiveRoom> {
    match match_type.unwrap_or("fill") {
        "serial" => rooms
            .iter()
            .min_by_key(|r| (r.players, r.name.clone()))
            .copied(),
        "random" => {
            let n = rooms.len();
            (n > 0).then(|| rooms[(now_ms() as usize) % n])
        }
        _ => rooms
            .iter()
            .max_by_key(|r| (r.players, std::cmp::Reverse(r.name.clone())))
            .copied(),
    }
}

/// Seats `fill_existing` tickets into live rooms before grouping: open, visible, same mode, a free
/// slot, lobby props accepted by the ticket's filter. Seats taken in this pass are counted so one
/// free slot is not handed to two tickets.
pub fn fill_existing(
    tickets: &mut [Ticket],
    rooms: &HashMap<ProjectId, Vec<LiveRoom>>,
) -> Vec<Uuid> {
    let mut changed = Vec::new();
    let mut taken: HashMap<(ProjectId, String), u16> = HashMap::new();
    let mut order: Vec<usize> = (0..tickets.len()).collect();
    order.sort_by_key(|i| (tickets[*i].created_ms, tickets[*i].id));
    for i in order {
        let t = &tickets[i];
        if !t.searching() || !t.req.fill_existing {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(live) = rooms.get(&t.project) else {
            continue;
        };
        let filter = t
            .req
            .filter
            .as_deref()
            .and_then(|f| crate::mmfilter::Filter::parse(f).ok());
        let mode = format!("{:?}", t.req.mode).to_lowercase();
        let candidates: Vec<&LiveRoom> = live
            .iter()
            .filter(|r| {
                let extra = taken
                    .get(&(t.project, r.name.clone()))
                    .copied()
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                r.open
                    && r.visible
                    && r.mode == mode
                    && r.players + extra < r.max_players
                    && filter
                        .as_ref()
                        .is_none_or(|f| r.props.as_object().is_some_and(|p| f.matches(p)))
            })
            .collect();
        let Some(room) = pick_room(&candidates, t.req.match_type.as_deref()) else {
            continue;
        };
        let (name, max_players) = (room.name.clone(), room.max_players);
        *taken.entry((t.project, name.clone())).or_default() += 1;
        let t = &mut tickets[i];
        t.state = TicketState::Matched {
            room: name,
            mode: t.req.mode,
            max_players,
            players: vec![t.req.player_id.clone()],
            bots: 0,
        };
        changed.push(t.id);
    }
    changed
}

pub fn match_tickets(tickets: &mut [Ticket], now_ms: u64) -> (Vec<Uuid>, Vec<String>) {
    let mut groups: HashMap<(ProjectId, String), Vec<usize>> = HashMap::new();
    for (i, t) in tickets.iter().enumerate() {
        if t.searching() {
            groups.entry((t.project, t.bucket())).or_default().push(i);
        }
    }
    let mut changed = Vec::new();
    let mut rooms = Vec::new();
    for (_, mut idx) in groups {
        idx.sort_by_key(|i| (tickets[*i].created_ms, tickets[*i].id));
        let n = idx.len();
        for i in &idx {
            let new = TicketState::Searching { waiting: n };
            if tickets[*i].state != new {
                tickets[*i].state = new;
                changed.push(tickets[*i].id);
            }
        }
        let first = &tickets[idx[0]].req;
        let (max, min, wait) = (
            first.max_players as usize,
            first.min_players as usize,
            first.max_wait_secs,
        );
        let filters: Vec<Option<crate::mmfilter::Filter>> = idx
            .iter()
            .map(|i| {
                tickets[*i]
                    .req
                    .filter
                    .as_deref()
                    .and_then(|f| crate::mmfilter::Filter::parse(f).ok())
            })
            .collect();
        let attrs: Vec<serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>> =
            idx.iter().map(|i| tickets[*i].req.attrs.clone()).collect();
        let compatible = |a: usize, b: usize| -> bool {
            let ok = |f: &Option<crate::mmfilter::Filter>, other: usize| {
                f.as_ref().is_none_or(|f| f.matches(&attrs[other]))
            };
            ok(&filters[a], b) && ok(&filters[b], a)
        };
        // Greedy: the oldest unassigned ticket seeds a group, later tickets join when they are
        // mutually compatible with every member. A group fills a room when it reaches `max`, or
        // when its seed has waited `wait` seconds and the group has `min` players.
        let mut taken = vec![false; n];
        for seed in 0..n {
            if taken[seed] {
                continue;
            }
            let mut group = vec![seed];
            for cand in (seed + 1..n).filter(|c| !taken[*c]) {
                if group.len() >= max {
                    break;
                }
                if group.iter().all(|m| compatible(*m, cand)) {
                    group.push(cand);
                }
            }
            let seed_age = tickets[idx[seed]].age_secs(now_ms);
            let ready = group.len() >= max || (group.len() >= min.max(1) && seed_age >= wait);
            if !ready {
                continue;
            }
            let room = format!("mm-{}", &Uuid::new_v4().simple().to_string()[..12]);
            let players: Vec<String> = group
                .iter()
                .map(|g| tickets[idx[*g]].req.player_id.clone())
                .collect();
            // short-handed start: bot seats when every member agreed to play with bots
            let bots = if group.len() < max && group.iter().all(|g| tickets[idx[*g]].req.bots) {
                (max - group.len()) as u16
            } else {
                0
            };
            for g in &group {
                taken[*g] = true;
                let t = &mut tickets[idx[*g]];
                t.state = TicketState::Matched {
                    room: room.clone(),
                    mode: t.req.mode,
                    max_players: t.req.max_players,
                    players: players.clone(),
                    bots,
                };
                if !changed.contains(&t.id) {
                    changed.push(t.id);
                }
            }
            rooms.push(room);
        }
    }
    (changed, rooms)
}

fn ticket_key(id: Uuid) -> String {
    format!("net:mm:t:{id}")
}
const SEARCHING_SET: &str = "net:mm:searching";
const LEADER_KEY: &str = "net:mm:leader";

fn stats_key(project: ProjectId, hour: u64) -> String {
    format!("net:mm:stats:{}:{hour}", project.0)
}

fn rerr(e: redis::RedisError) -> NetError {
    NetError::Redis(e.to_string())
}

/// Redis-backed ticket store shared by every node.
#[derive(Default, Clone)]
pub struct Matchmaker;

impl Matchmaker {
    async fn put(&self, redis: &RedisStore, t: &Ticket) -> Result<()> {
        let mut c = redis.raw();
        let body = serde_json::to_vec(t).map_err(|e| NetError::Internal(e.to_string()))?;
        let ttl = if t.searching() {
            SEARCH_TTL_SECS
        } else {
            RESULT_TTL_SECS
        };
        let mut p = redis::pipe();
        p.atomic().set_ex(ticket_key(t.id), body, ttl).ignore();
        if t.searching() {
            p.sadd(SEARCHING_SET, t.id.to_string()).ignore();
        } else {
            p.srem(SEARCHING_SET, t.id.to_string()).ignore();
        }
        p.query_async::<()>(&mut c).await.map_err(rerr)
    }

    async fn load_many(&self, redis: &RedisStore, ids: &[String]) -> Result<Vec<Ticket>> {
        if ids.is_empty() {
            return Ok(Vec::new());
        }
        let mut c = redis.raw();
        let keys: Vec<String> = ids
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|s| s.parse::<Uuid>().ok())
            .map(ticket_key)
            .collect();
        let bodies: Vec<Option<Vec<u8>>> = c.mget(&keys).await.map_err(rerr)?;
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bodies.len());
        let mut stale = Vec::new();
        for (id, b) in ids.iter().zip(bodies) {
            match b.and_then(|b| serde_json::from_slice::<Ticket>(&b).ok()) {
                Some(t) => out.push(t),
                None => stale.push(id.clone()),
            }
        }
        if !stale.is_empty() {
            let _: () = c.srem(SEARCHING_SET, stale).await.map_err(rerr)?;
        }
        Ok(out)
    }

    async fn searching_ids(&self, redis: &RedisStore) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        let mut c = redis.raw();
        c.smembers(SEARCHING_SET).await.map_err(rerr)
    }

    /// Files a ticket; a player's earlier searching ticket in the same project is cancelled.
    pub async fn file(
        &self,
        redis: &RedisStore,
        project: ProjectId,
        req: TicketReq,
    ) -> Result<Ticket> {
        if let Some(f) = req.filter.as_deref() {
            crate::mmfilter::Filter::parse(f)
                .map_err(|e| NetError::Invalid(format!("filter: {e}")))?;
        }
        if serde_json::to_vec(&req.attrs)
            .map(|v| v.len())
            .unwrap_or(usize::MAX)
            > 1024
        {
            return Err(NetError::Invalid("attrs larger than 1 KiB".into()));
        }
        let ids = self.searching_ids(redis).await?;
        for mut t in self.load_many(redis, &ids).await? {
            if t.project == project && t.req.player_id == req.player_id && t.searching() {
                t.state = TicketState::Cancelled;
                self.put(redis, &t).await?;
            }
        }
        let ticket = Ticket {
            id: Uuid::now_v7(),
            project,
            req,
            created_ms: now_ms(),
            state: TicketState::Searching { waiting: 1 },
        };
        self.put(redis, &ticket).await?;
        Ok(ticket)
    }

    pub async fn get(
        &self,
        redis: &RedisStore,
        project: ProjectId,
        id: Uuid,
    ) -> Result<Option<Ticket>> {
        let mut c = redis.raw();
        let body: Option<Vec<u8>> = c.get(ticket_key(id)).await.map_err(rerr)?;
        Ok(body
            .and_then(|b| serde_json::from_slice::<Ticket>(&b).ok())
            .filter(|t| t.project == project))
    }

    pub async fn cancel(&self, redis: &RedisStore, project: ProjectId, id: Uuid) -> Result<bool> {
        match self.get(redis, project, id).await? {
            Some(mut t) if t.searching() => {
                t.state = TicketState::Cancelled;
                self.put(redis, &t).await?;
                Ok(true)
            }
            _ => Ok(false),
        }
    }

    /// One matching cycle; only the node holding the leader lock does work. Returns the matches
    /// formed (empty when not leader or nothing matched) so the caller can notify webhooks.
    pub async fn run_cycle(&self, redis: &RedisStore, node: &str) -> Result<Vec<MatchFound>> {
        let mut c = redis.raw();
        let got: Option<String> = redis::cmd("SET")
            .arg(LEADER_KEY)
            .arg(node)
            .arg("NX")
            .arg("PX")
            .arg(LEADER_TTL_MS)
            .query_async(&mut c)
            .await
            .map_err(rerr)?;
        if got.is_none() {
            // Somebody else leads; a dead leader's lock expires within LEADER_TTL_MS.
            let leader: Option<String> = c.get(LEADER_KEY).await.map_err(rerr)?;
            if leader.as_deref() != Some(node) {
                return Ok(Vec::new());
            }
        }
        let ids = self.searching_ids(redis).await?;
        let mut tickets = self.load_many(redis, &ids).await?;
        let now = now_ms();
        tickets.retain(|t| t.searching() && t.age_secs(now) < SEARCH_TTL_SECS);
        let mut live: HashMap<ProjectId, Vec<LiveRoom>> = HashMap::new();
        for p in tickets
            .iter()
            .filter(|t| t.req.fill_existing)
            .map(|t| t.project)
            .collect::<std::collections::HashSet<_>>()
        {
            live.insert(p, redis.list_rooms(p).await.unwrap_or_default());
        }
        let mut changed = fill_existing(&mut tickets, &live);
        let (grouped, _rooms) = match_tickets(&mut tickets, now);
        changed.extend(grouped);
        let mut found: Vec<MatchFound> = Vec::new();
        for t in tickets.iter().filter(|t| changed.contains(&t.id)) {
            self.put(redis, t).await?;
            if let TicketState::Matched {
                room,
                mode,
                players,
                bots,
                ..
            } = &t.state
            {
                match found
                    .iter_mut()
                    .find(|m| m.project == t.project && m.room == *room)
                {
                    Some(m) => m.tickets.push(t.id),
                    None => found.push(MatchFound {
                        project: t.project,
                        room: room.clone(),
                        mode: *mode,
                        players: players.clone(),
                        tickets: vec![t.id],
                        bots: *bots,
                    }),
                }
            }
        }
        let hour = now / 3_600_000;
        let mut per_project: std::collections::HashMap<ProjectId, i64> = Default::default();
        for m in &found {
            *per_project.entry(m.project).or_default() += 1;
        }
        for (project, n) in per_project {
            let key = stats_key(project, hour);
            let mut p = redis::pipe();
            p.atomic()
                .incr(&key, n)
                .ignore()
                .expire(&key, 26 * 3600)
                .ignore();
            p.query_async::<()>(&mut c).await.map_err(rerr)?;
        }
        Ok(found)
    }

    /// Tickets of one project still waiting, oldest first.
    pub async fn list_searching(
        &self,
        redis: &RedisStore,
        project: ProjectId,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Ticket>> {
        let ids = self.searching_ids(redis).await?;
        let now = now_ms();
        let mut out: Vec<Ticket> = self
            .load_many(redis, &ids)
            .await?
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|t| t.project == project && t.searching() && t.age_secs(now) < SEARCH_TTL_SECS)
            .collect();
        out.sort_by_key(|t| t.created_ms);
        Ok(out)
    }

    /// Matches formed for a project: (last hour, last 24 h).
    pub async fn matched_stats(
        &self,
        redis: &RedisStore,
        project: ProjectId,
    ) -> Result<(i64, i64)> {
        let hour = now_ms() / 3_600_000;
        let keys: Vec<String> = (0..24).map(|i| stats_key(project, hour - i)).collect();
        let mut c = redis.raw();
        let vals: Vec<Option<i64>> = c.mget(&keys).await.map_err(rerr)?;
        let last_hour = vals.first().copied().flatten().unwrap_or(0);
        let day: i64 = vals.iter().map(|v| v.unwrap_or(0)).sum();
        Ok((last_hour, day))
    }

    pub async fn searching(&self, redis: &RedisStore) -> Result<usize> {
        let mut c = redis.raw();
        c.scard(SEARCHING_SET).await.map_err(rerr)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn bot_backfill_reports_empty_seats_only_when_everyone_agreed() {
        let p = ProjectId::new();
        let with_bots = |id: &str| {
            let mut r = req(id, 4, 2, 15, serde_json::json!({}));
            r.bots = true;
            r
        };
        let mut ts = vec![
            ticket(p, with_bots("a"), 1000),
            ticket(p, with_bots("b"), 1100),
        ];
        // before max_wait nothing starts; after it the pair starts with 2 bot seats
        assert!(match_tickets(&mut ts, 5_000).1.is_empty());
        let (_, rooms) = match_tickets(&mut ts, 20_000);
        assert_eq!(rooms.len(), 1);
        for t in &ts {
            assert!(
                matches!(&t.state, TicketState::Matched { bots: 2, players, .. } if players.len() == 2)
            );
        }
        // one member without `bots`: the group starts short-handed, no bot seats
        let mut ts = vec![
            ticket(p, with_bots("c"), 1000),
            ticket(p, req("d", 4, 2, 15, serde_json::json!({})), 1100),
        ];
        match_tickets(&mut ts, 20_000);
        assert!(matches!(&ts[0].state, TicketState::Matched { bots: 0, .. }));
        // a full group never gets bots
        let mut ts: Vec<Ticket> = ["e", "f", "g", "h"]
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(i, id)| ticket(p, with_bots(id), 1000 + i as u64))
            .collect();
        match_tickets(&mut ts, 1_500);
        assert!(matches!(&ts[3].state, TicketState::Matched { bots: 0, .. }));
    }

    fn req(player: &str, max: u16, min: u16, wait: u64, props: serde_json::Value) -> TicketReq {
        TicketReq {
            player_id: player.into(),
            mode: RoomMode::Relay,
            region: None,
            max_players: max,
            min_players: min,
            max_wait_secs: wait,
            props: props.as_object().cloned().unwrap_or_default(),
            attrs: Default::default(),
            filter: None,
            fill_existing: false,
            bots: false,
            match_type: None,
        }
    }

    fn ticket(project: ProjectId, r: TicketReq, created_ms: u64) -> Ticket {
        Ticket {
            id: Uuid::now_v7(),
            project,
            req: r,
            created_ms,
            state: TicketState::Searching { waiting: 1 },
        }
    }

    fn room_of(t: &Ticket) -> Option<&str> {
        match &t.state {
            TicketState::Matched { room, .. } => Some(room),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn fills_existing_rooms_by_match_type() {
        let room = |name: &str, players: u16, map: &str| LiveRoom {
            room: net_common::RoomId(Uuid::new_v4()),
            node: "n".into(),
            name: name.into(),
            mode: "relay".into(),
            players,
            max_players: 4,
            open: true,
            visible: true,
            props: serde_json::json!({"map": map}),
        };
        let project = ProjectId::from_uuid(Uuid::nil());
        let mut rooms = HashMap::new();
        rooms.insert(
            project,
            vec![
                room("a", 3, "dust"),
                room("b", 1, "dust"),
                room("c", 1, "nuke"),
                room("full", 4, "dust"),
            ],
        );
        let t = |p: &str, mt: Option<&str>| {
            let mut r = req(p, 4, 2, 15, serde_json::json!({}));
            r.fill_existing = true;
            r.filter = Some("map = 'dust'".into());
            r.match_type = mt.map(str::to_string);
            Ticket {
                id: Uuid::now_v7(),
                project,
                req: r,
                created_ms: 0,
                state: TicketState::Searching { waiting: 0 },
            }
        };
        let mut tickets = vec![
            t("p1", None),
            t("p2", None),
            t("p3", Some("serial")),
            t("p4", Some("serial")),
        ];
        let changed = fill_existing(&mut tickets, &rooms);
        assert_eq!(changed.len(), 4);
        let room_of = |i: usize| match &tickets[i].state {
            TicketState::Matched { room, .. } => room.clone(),
            s => panic!("{s:?}"),
        };
        assert_eq!(room_of(0), "a"); // fullest with a seat
        assert_eq!(room_of(1), "b"); // "a" is now full after p1's seat
        assert_eq!(room_of(2), "b"); // emptiest dust room
        assert_eq!(room_of(3), "b");
        let mut none = vec![t("p5", None)];
        none[0].req.filter = Some("map = 'office'".into());
        assert!(fill_existing(&mut none, &rooms).is_empty());
        assert!(none[0].searching());
    }

    #[test]
    fn filters_split_a_bucket_by_attrs() {
        let t = |p: &str, rank: i64, filter: &str| {
            let mut r = req(p, 2, 2, 15, serde_json::json!({}));
            r.attrs = serde_json::json!({"rank": rank})
                .as_object()
                .cloned()
                .unwrap();
            r.filter = Some(filter.to_string());
            Ticket {
                id: Uuid::now_v7(),
                project: ProjectId::from_uuid(Uuid::nil()),
                req: r,
                created_ms: 0,
                state: TicketState::Searching { waiting: 0 },
            }
        };
        let mut tickets = vec![
            t("low", 5, "rank < 10"),
            t("high", 50, "rank >= 40"),
            t("low2", 7, "rank < 10"),
            t("high2", 45, "rank >= 40"),
        ];
        let (_, rooms) = match_tickets(&mut tickets, 1000);
        assert_eq!(rooms.len(), 2);
        let room_of = |p: &str| match &tickets.iter().find(|t| t.req.player_id == p).unwrap().state
        {
            TicketState::Matched { room, .. } => room.clone(),
            s => panic!("{p}: {s:?}"),
        };
        assert_eq!(room_of("low"), room_of("low2"));
        assert_eq!(room_of("high"), room_of("high2"));
        assert_ne!(room_of("low"), room_of("high"));
        // one-sided rejection keeps them apart even though the other side would accept
        let mut odd = vec![t("picky", 30, "rank > 100"), t("open", 30, "rank > 0")];
        let (_, rooms) = match_tickets(&mut odd, 1000);
        assert!(rooms.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn fills_groups_and_times_out() {
        let p = ProjectId::new();
        let q = ProjectId::new();
        let mut ts = vec![
            ticket(p, req("a", 2, 2, 15, serde_json::json!({})), 1000),
            ticket(p, req("b", 2, 2, 15, serde_json::json!({})), 1100),
            ticket(p, req("c", 2, 2, 15, serde_json::json!({})), 1200),
            // different props = different bucket
            ticket(p, req("d", 2, 2, 15, serde_json::json!({"map": "x"})), 1000),
            // other project never mixes
            ticket(q, req("e", 2, 2, 15, serde_json::json!({})), 1000),
            // solo with min 1 and zero wait starts immediately
            ticket(q, req("f", 4, 1, 0, serde_json::json!({"solo": 1})), 1000),
        ];
        let (changed, rooms) = match_tickets(&mut ts, 2000);
        assert_eq!(rooms.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(room_of(&ts[0]), room_of(&ts[1]));
        assert!(room_of(&ts[0]).is_some());
        assert_eq!(ts[2].state, TicketState::Searching { waiting: 3 });
        assert_eq!(ts[3].state, TicketState::Searching { waiting: 1 });
        assert_eq!(ts[4].state, TicketState::Searching { waiting: 1 });
        assert!(room_of(&ts[5]).is_some());
        assert!(changed.contains(&ts[2].id)); // waiting count changed 1 -> 3

        // "c" alone: no partner, min 2 -> keeps waiting even past max_wait.
        let (_, rooms) = match_tickets(&mut ts, 1000 + 20_000);
        assert!(rooms.is_empty());
        // c + e are different projects; add g to p: min reached and wait passed -> start.
        ts.push(ticket(p, req("g", 2, 2, 15, serde_json::json!({})), 30_000));
        let (_, rooms) = match_tickets(&mut ts, 31_000);
        assert_eq!(rooms.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(room_of(&ts[2]), room_of(&ts[6]));

        // Timeout with min < max: 3 of max 4 start after the oldest waited long enough.
        let r = ProjectId::new();
        let mut ts = vec![
            ticket(r, req("x", 4, 2, 5, serde_json::json!({})), 0),
            ticket(r, req("y", 4, 2, 5, serde_json::json!({})), 100),
            ticket(r, req("z", 4, 2, 5, serde_json::json!({})), 200),
        ];
        assert!(match_tickets(&mut ts, 4_000).1.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(match_tickets(&mut ts, 5_000).1.len(), 1);
        assert!(ts.iter().all(|t| room_of(t).is_some()));
    }
}
