`crates/net-api/src/metering.rs`:

```rs
//! Usage metering, the basis of node-hour billing (never CCU): every minute each node adds,
//! per project, `room_minutes`, `player_minutes`, `bytes_in` and `bytes_out` to `usage_hours`
//! (`GET /v1/usage`). Bytes are deltas of the per-session link counters, so a session that
//! leaves between two passes loses at most one minute of traffic accounting.

use crate::state::Shared;
use net_db::queries;
use std::time::Duration;

pub const METER_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);

pub async fn meter(st: Shared) {
    let mut iv = tokio::time::interval(METER_EVERY);
    iv.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Delay);
    iv.tick().await;
    loop {
        iv.tick().await;
        let hour = chrono::Utc::now()
            .date_naive()
            .and_hms_opt(
                chrono::Utc::now()
                    .format("%H")
                    .to_string()
                    .parse()
                    .unwrap_or(0),
                0,
                0,
            )
            .map(|t| t.and_utc())
            .unwrap_or_else(chrono::Utc::now);
        for (project, (rooms, players, bytes_in, bytes_out)) in st.host.usage() {
            let minutes = METER_EVERY.as_secs_f64() / 60.0;
            for (metric, qty) in [
                ("room_minutes", rooms as f64 * minutes),
                ("player_minutes", players as f64 * minutes),
                ("bytes_in", bytes_in as f64),
                ("bytes_out", bytes_out as f64),
            ] {
                if qty > 0.0 {
                    if let Err(e) = queries::add_usage(&st.pool, project.0, hour, metric, qty).await
                    {
                        tracing::warn!(error = %e, metric, "usage write failed");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
use prometheus::{
    Encoder, Histogram, HistogramOpts, IntCounter, IntCounterVec, IntGauge, Opts, Registry,
    TextEncoder,
};

pub struct Metrics {
    pub registry: Registry,
    pub rooms: IntGauge,
    pub players: IntGauge,
    pub control_sessions: IntGauge,
    pub datagrams_in: IntCounter,
    pub datagrams_out: IntCounter,
    pub bytes_in: IntCounter,
    pub bytes_out: IntCounter,
    pub events: IntCounterVec,
    pub errors: IntCounterVec,
    pub sync_tick: Histogram,
    pub sync_lost_deltas: IntCounter,
    pub sync_inputs_rate_limited: IntCounter,
    pub sync_invalid_inputs: IntCounter,
    pub sync_resyncs: IntCounter,
    pub sync_aoi_starved: IntCounter,
    pub tick_overruns: IntCounter,
    pub lockstep_desyncs: IntCounter,
    pub rooms_adopted: IntCounter,
}

impl Metrics {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let registry = Registry::new();
        let g = |n: &str, h: &str| {
            let g = IntGauge::new(n, h).unwrap();
            registry.register(Box::new(g.clone())).unwrap();
            g
        };
        let c = |n: &str, h: &str| {
            let c = IntCounter::new(n, h).unwrap();
            registry.register(Box::new(c.clone())).unwrap();
            c
        };
        let events = IntCounterVec::new(
            Opts::new("net_events_total", "relayed events by channel"),
            &["channel"],
        )
        .unwrap();
        registry.register(Box::new(events.clone())).unwrap();
        let errors = IntCounterVec::new(
            Opts::new("net_errors_total", "client-visible errors by code"),
            &["code"],
        )
        .unwrap();
        registry.register(Box::new(errors.clone())).unwrap();
        let sync_tick = Histogram::with_opts(
            HistogramOpts::new("net_sync_tick_seconds", "sync room tick duration").buckets(vec![
                0.0002, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.002, 0.004, 0.008, 0.016, 0.033,
            ]),
        )
        .unwrap();
        registry.register(Box::new(sync_tick.clone())).unwrap();
        let sync_lost_deltas = c(
            "net_sync_lost_deltas_total",
            "sync deltas clients reported lost (re-sent in full)",
        );
        let sync_inputs_rate_limited = c(
            "net_sync_inputs_rate_limited_total",
            "input frames dropped: client sent faster than tick rate + 10%",
        );
        let sync_invalid_inputs = c(
            "net_sync_invalid_inputs_total",
            "input frames dropped as malformed or too far ahead of the room tick",
        );
        let sync_resyncs = c(
            "net_sync_resyncs_total",
            "clients that asked for a full snapshot (baselines dropped)",
        );
        let sync_aoi_starved = c(
            "net_sync_aoi_starved_total",
            "client-ticks where the byte budget deferred relevant entities",
        );
        let tick_overruns = c(
            "net_tick_overruns_total",
            "sync/lockstep ticks that took longer than the tick period",
        );
        let lockstep_desyncs = c(
            "net_lockstep_desyncs_total",
            "lockstep hash reports that disagreed with the majority",
        );
        let rooms_adopted = c(
            "net_rooms_adopted_total",
            "rooms this node took over from a dead node (failover)",
        );
        Self {
            sync_tick,
            sync_lost_deltas,
            sync_resyncs,
            sync_aoi_starved,
            tick_overruns,
            lockstep_desyncs,
            rooms_adopted,
            sync_inputs_rate_limited,
            sync_invalid_inputs,
            rooms: g("net_rooms", "open rooms on this node"),
            players: g("net_players", "online players on this node"),
            control_sessions: g("net_control_sessions", "open control websockets"),
            datagrams_in: c("net_datagrams_in_total", "datagrams received"),
            datagrams_out: c("net_datagrams_out_total", "datagrams sent"),
            bytes_in: c("net_bytes_in_total", "data-path bytes received"),
            bytes_out: c("net_bytes_out_total", "data-path bytes sent"),
            events,
            errors,
            registry,
        }
    }

    pub fn render(&self) -> String {
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        TextEncoder::new()
            .encode(&self.registry.gather(), &mut buf)
            .ok();
        String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap_or_default()
    }
}

impl Default for Metrics {

        Self::new()
    }
}
```

`crates/net-api/src/mmfilter.rs`:

```rs
//! Matchmaking attribute filter: a tiny SQL-like boolean expression evaluated against a ticket's
//! `attrs` (`rank >= 10 AND rank <= 20 AND region != 'cn'`). Comparisons on numbers, strings and
//! booleans; `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, parentheses. Bounded: 256 chars, 16 comparisons.

use serde_json::{Map, Value};

pub const MAX_LEN: usize = 256;
pub const MAX_TERMS: usize = 16;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum Filter {
    Cmp(String, Op, Lit),
    And(Box<Filter>, Box<Filter>),
    Or(Box<Filter>, Box<Filter>),
    Not(Box<Filter>),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum Op {
    Eq,
    Ne,
    Lt,
    Le,
    Gt,
    Ge,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum Lit {
    Num(f64),
    Str(String),
    Bool(bool),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
enum Tok {
    Ident(String),
    Num(f64),
    Str(String),
    Op(Op),
    And,
    Or,
    Not,
    LParen,
    RParen,
}

fn lex(src: &str) -> Result<Vec<Tok>, String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let cs: Vec<char> = src.chars().collect();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < cs.len() {
        let c = cs[i];
        match c {
            ' ' | '\t' | '\n' | '\r' => i += 1,
            '(' => {
                out.push(Tok::LParen);
                i += 1;
            }
            ')' => {
                out.push(Tok::RParen);
                i += 1;
            }
            '=' => {
                out.push(Tok::Op(Op::Eq));
                i += 1;
                if i < cs.len() && cs[i] == '=' {
                    i += 1;
                }
            }
            '!' if i + 1 < cs.len() && cs[i + 1] == '=' => {
                out.push(Tok::Op(Op::Ne));
                i += 2;
            }
            '<' => {
                if i + 1 < cs.len() && cs[i + 1] == '>' {
                    out.push(Tok::Op(Op::Ne));
                    i += 2;
                } else if i + 1 < cs.len() && cs[i + 1] == '=' {
                    out.push(Tok::Op(Op::Le));
                    i += 2;
                } else {
                    out.push(Tok::Op(Op::Lt));
                    i += 1;
                }
            }
            '>' => {
                if i + 1 < cs.len() && cs[i + 1] == '=' {
                    out.push(Tok::Op(Op::Ge));
                    i += 2;
                } else {
                    out.push(Tok::Op(Op::Gt));
                    i += 1;
                }
            }
            '\'' | '"' => {
                let q = c;
                i += 1;
                let start = i;
                while i < cs.len() && cs[i] != q {
                    i += 1;
                }
                if i >= cs.len() {
                    return Err("unterminated string".into());
                }
                out.push(Tok::Str(cs[start..i].iter().collect()));
                i += 1;
            }
            c if c.is_ascii_digit() || c == '-' => {
                let start = i;
                i += 1;
                while i < cs.len() && (cs[i].is_ascii_digit() || cs[i] == '.') {
                    i += 1;
                }
                let s: String = cs[start..i].iter().collect();
                out.push(Tok::Num(
                    s.parse().map_err(|_| format!("bad number '{s}'"))?,
                ));
            }
            c if c.is_ascii_alphabetic() || c == '_' => {
                let start = i;
                while i < cs.len()
                    && (cs[i].is_ascii_alphanumeric() || cs[i] == '_' || cs[i] == '.')
                {
                    i += 1;
                }
                let s: String = cs[start..i].iter().collect();
                out.push(match s.to_ascii_uppercase().as_str() {
                    "AND" => Tok::And,
                    "OR" => Tok::Or,
                    "NOT" => Tok::Not,
                    "TRUE" => Tok::Ident("true".into()),
                    "FALSE" => Tok::Ident("false".into()),
                    _ => Tok::Ident(s),
                });
            }
            other => return Err(format!("unexpected character '{other}'")),
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}

struct Parser {
    toks: Vec<Tok>,
    pos: usize,
    terms: usize,
}

impl Parser {
    fn peek(&self) -> Option<&Tok> {
        self.toks.get(self.pos)
    }
    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Tok> {
        let t = self.toks.get(self.pos).cloned();
        self.pos += 1;
        t
    }
    fn or(&mut self) -> Result<Filter, String> {
        let mut left = self.and()?;
        while self.peek() == Some(&Tok::Or) {
            self.pos += 1;
            let right = self.and()?;
            left = Filter::Or(Box::new(left), Box::new(right));
        }
        Ok(left)
    }
    fn and(&mut self) -> Result<Filter, String> {
        let mut left = self.unary()?;
        while self.peek() == Some(&Tok::And) {
            self.pos += 1;
            let right = self.unary()?;
            left = Filter::And(Box::new(left), Box::new(right));
        }
        Ok(left)
    }
    fn unary(&mut self) -> Result<Filter, String> {
        match self.peek() {
            Some(Tok::Not) => {
                self.pos += 1;
                Ok(Filter::Not(Box::new(self.unary()?)))
            }
            Some(Tok::LParen) => {
                self.pos += 1;
                let inner = self.or()?;
                match self.next() {
                    Some(Tok::RParen) => Ok(inner),
                    _ => Err("expected ')'".into()),
                }
            }
            _ => self.cmp(),
        }
    }
    fn cmp(&mut self) -> Result<Filter, String> {
        let key = match self.next() {
            Some(Tok::Ident(k)) if k != "true" && k != "false" => k,
            other => return Err(format!("expected attribute name, got {other:?}")),
        };
        let op = match self.next() {
            Some(Tok::Op(op)) => op,
            other => return Err(format!("expected comparison after '{key}', got {other:?}")),
        };
        let lit = match self.next() {
            Some(Tok::Num(n)) => Lit::Num(n),
            Some(Tok::Str(s)) => Lit::Str(s),
            Some(Tok::Ident(b)) if b == "true" => Lit::Bool(true),
            Some(Tok::Ident(b)) if b == "false" => Lit::Bool(false),
            other => return Err(format!("expected value after '{key}', got {other:?}")),
        };
        self.terms += 1;
        if self.terms > MAX_TERMS {
            return Err(format!("more than {MAX_TERMS} comparisons"));
        }
        Ok(Filter::Cmp(key, op, lit))
    }
}

impl Filter {
    pub fn parse(src: &str) -> Result<Filter, String> {
        if src.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err("empty filter".into());
        }
        if src.len() > MAX_LEN {
            return Err(format!("filter longer than {MAX_LEN} chars"));
        }
        let toks = lex(src)?;
        let mut p = Parser {
            toks,
            pos: 0,
            terms: 0,
        };
        let f = p.or()?;
        if p.pos != p.toks.len() {
            return Err(format!("unexpected token {:?}", p.toks[p.pos]));
        }
        Ok(f)
    }

    /// A missing attribute fails every comparison (including `!=`), like SQL NULL.
    pub fn matches(&self, attrs: &Map<String, Value>) -> bool {
        match self {
            Filter::And(a, b) => a.matches(attrs) && b.matches(attrs),
            Filter::Or(a, b) => a.matches(attrs) || b.matches(attrs),
            Filter::Not(a) => !a.matches(attrs),
            Filter::Cmp(key, op, lit) => {
                let Some(v) = attrs.get(key) else {
                    return false;
                };
                let ord = match (v, lit) {
                    (Value::Number(n), Lit::Num(l)) => n.as_f64().map(|n| n.total_cmp(l)),
                    (Value::String(s), Lit::Str(l)) => Some(s.as_str().cmp(l.as_str())),
                    (Value::Bool(b), Lit::Bool(l)) => Some(b.cmp(l)),
                    _ => None,
                };
                let Some(ord) = ord else {
                    return false;
                };
                match op {
                    Op::Eq => ord.is_eq(),
                    Op::Ne => ord.is_ne(),
                    Op::Lt => ord.is_lt(),
                    Op::Le => ord.is_le(),
                    Op::Gt => ord.is_gt(),
                    Op::Ge => ord.is_ge(),
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;

    fn attrs(v: Value) -> Map<String, Value> {
        v.as_object().cloned().unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn ranges_strings_bools() {
        let f =
            Filter::parse("rank >= 10 AND rank <= 20 AND map = 'dust' AND ranked = true").unwrap();
        assert!(f.matches(&attrs(json!({"rank": 15, "map": "dust", "ranked": true}))));
        assert!(!f.matches(&attrs(json!({"rank": 25, "map": "dust", "ranked": true}))));
        assert!(!f.matches(&attrs(json!({"rank": 15, "map": "nuke", "ranked": true}))));
        assert!(!f.matches(&attrs(json!({"rank": 15, "map": "dust"}))));
    }

    #[test]
    fn precedence_parens_not() {
        let f = Filter::parse("a = 1 OR b = 2 AND c = 3").unwrap();
        assert!(f.matches(&attrs(json!({"a": 1}))));
        assert!(!f.matches(&attrs(json!({"b": 2}))));
        assert!(f.matches(&attrs(json!({"b": 2, "c": 3}))));
        let g = Filter::parse("(a = 1 OR b = 2) AND NOT c <> 3").unwrap();
        assert!(g.matches(&attrs(json!({"a": 1, "c": 3}))));
        assert!(!g.matches(&attrs(json!({"a": 1, "c": 4}))));
    }

    #[test]
    fn missing_attribute_never_matches() {
        let f = Filter::parse("lang != 'en'").unwrap();
        assert!(!f.matches(&attrs(json!({}))));
        assert!(f.matches(&attrs(json!({"lang": "de"}))));
    }

    #[test]
    fn type_mismatch_is_false() {
        let f = Filter::parse("rank > 5").unwrap();
        assert!(!f.matches(&attrs(json!({"rank": "high"}))));
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_garbage_and_limits() {
        for bad in [
            "",
            "rank >",
            "rank 5",
            "(rank = 1",
            "rank = 1 )",
            "rank = 'x",
            "x ~ 1",
            "1 = 1",
        ] {
            assert!(Filter::parse(bad).is_err(), "{bad}");
        }
        let long = "a".repeat(MAX_LEN + 1);
        assert!(Filter::parse(&long).is_err());
        let many = (0..MAX_TERMS + 1)
            .map(|i| format!("k{i} = {i}"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(" AND ");
        assert!(Filter::parse(&many).is_err());
        let ok = (0..MAX_TERMS)
            .map(|i| format!("k{i}={i}"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(" AND ");
        assert!(Filter::parse(&ok).is_ok());
    }
}
```

`crates/net-api/src/presence.rs`:

```rs
//! Lobby statistics and friend presence (lobby statistics / find friends):
//! rooms grouped by the room prop `lobby`, and "is this player online / in which room" across
//! every node of the fleet.
use crate::state::Shared;
use net_common::ProjectId;
use net_rooms::protocol::{FriendInfo, FriendRoom, LobbyStats, RoomSummary};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

/// Players per `find_friends` request.
pub const MAX_FRIENDS: usize = 64;
/// Room prop naming the lobby a room belongs to; rooms without it are in the default lobby `""`.
pub const LOBBY_PROP: &str = "lobby";

pub fn lobby_name(props: &serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>) -> String {
    props
        .get(LOBBY_PROP)
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
        .unwrap_or("")
        .to_string()
}

/// (rooms, players, per-lobby counts sorted by lobby name) over the given live rooms.
pub fn lobby_stats(rooms: &[RoomSummary]) -> (u32, u32, Vec<LobbyStats>) {
    let mut by: BTreeMap<String, (u32, u32)> = BTreeMap::new();
    for r in rooms {
        let e = by.entry(lobby_name(&r.props)).or_default();
        e.0 += 1;
        e.1 += u32::from(r.players);
    }
    let players = rooms.iter().map(|r| u32::from(r.players)).sum();
    let lobbies = by
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(lobby, (rooms, players))| LobbyStats {
            lobby,
            rooms,
            players,
        })
        .collect();
    (rooms.len() as u32, players, lobbies)
}

/// What this node knows about `players`: a control session here, or a slot in a room hosted here.
pub fn local_friends(st: &Shared, project: ProjectId, players: &[String]) -> Vec<FriendInfo> {
    players
        .iter()
        .map(|p| {
            let slots = st.host.find_player(project, p);
            let online = st.host.is_online(project, p) || slots.iter().any(|s| s.5);
            let room = slots
                .into_iter()
                .next()
                .map(|(id, name, mode, _, _, _)| FriendRoom {
                    id: id.to_string(),
                    name,
                    mode,
                    node: st.node_id.to_string(),
                });
            FriendInfo {
                player: p.clone(),
                online,
                room,
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

/// One answer per requested player (duplicates collapsed, request order kept): online if any node
/// says so, the first room reported wins.
pub fn merge_friends(
    order: &[String],
    parts: impl IntoIterator<Item = FriendInfo>,
) -> Vec<FriendInfo> {
    let mut map: BTreeMap<String, FriendInfo> = order
        .iter()
        .map(|p| {
            (
                p.clone(),
                FriendInfo {
                    player: p.clone(),
                    online: false,
                    room: None,
                },
            )
        })
        .collect();
    for f in parts {
        if let Some(e) = map.get_mut(&f.player) {
            e.online |= f.online;
            if e.room.is_none() {
                e.room = f.room;
            }
        }
    }
    order.iter().filter_map(|p| map.remove(p)).collect()
}

/// Fleet-wide presence: this node plus `GET /v1/internal/presence` on every other live node
/// (3 s budget each; an unreachable node is logged and skipped).
pub async fn find_friends(st: &Shared, project: ProjectId, players: &[String]) -> Vec<FriendInfo> {
    let mut parts = local_friends(st, project, players);
    let ids = players
        .iter()
        .map(|p| crate::rest::pct(p))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join("%0A");
    let path = format!("/v1/internal/presence?project={}&ids={ids}", project.0);
    let remote: Vec<_> = st
        .registry
        .snapshot()
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|n| n.id != st.node_id)
        .collect();
    let results = futures::future::join_all(
        remote
            .iter()
            .map(|n| crate::rest::internal_get(st, &n.http_url, &path)),
    )
    .await;
    for (n, r) in remote.iter().zip(results) {
        match r {
            Ok(v) => match serde_json::from_value::<Vec<FriendInfo>>(v["players"].clone()) {
                Ok(fs) => parts.extend(fs),
                Err(e) => {
                    tracing::warn!(node = %n.http_url, error = %e, "find_friends: bad answer")
                }
            },
            Err(e) => {
                tracing::warn!(node = %n.http_url, error = %e, "find_friends: node unreachable")
            }
        }
    }
    merge_friends(players, parts)
}
```

`crates/net-api/src/ratelimit.rs`:

```rs
//! Per-IP and per-key guards: token buckets for HTTP, WebSocket connects, auth failures and
//! API-key writes, plus concurrent session counts per IP. `X-Forwarded-For` is honoured only
//! from `server.trusted_proxies`.
use axum::body::Body;
use axum::extract::{ConnectInfo, State};
use axum::http::{HeaderMap, Request, StatusCode};
use axum::middleware::Next;
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};
use dashmap::DashMap;
use net_common::config::LimitsConfig;
use net_common::ipnet::IpNet;
use std::hash::Hash;
use std::net::{IpAddr, SocketAddr};
use std::time::Instant;

pub struct Buckets<K: Eq + Hash> {
    map: DashMap<K, (f64, Instant)>,
    per_sec: f64,
    burst: f64,
}

impl<K: Eq + Hash + Clone> Buckets<K> {
    pub fn new(per_sec: f64, burst: f64) -> Self {
        Self {
            map: DashMap::new(),
            per_sec,
            burst,
        }
    }

    /// Takes one token for `k`; false when the bucket is empty.
    pub fn allow(&self, k: K) -> bool {
        let now = Instant::now();
        let mut e = self.map.entry(k).or_insert((self.burst, now));
        let (tokens, last) = *e;
        let t = (tokens + last.elapsed().as_secs_f64() * self.per_sec).min(self.burst);
        if t >= 1.0 {
            *e = (t - 1.0, now);
            true
        } else {
            *e = (t, now);
            false
        }
    }

    /// Drops buckets idle long enough to be full again.
    pub fn sweep(&self) {
        let full_after = if self.per_sec > 0.0 {
            self.burst / self.per_sec
        } else {
            600.0
        };
        self.map
            .retain(|_, (_, last)| last.elapsed().as_secs_f64() < full_after + 1.0);
    }
}

pub struct Guards {
    pub http: Buckets<IpAddr>,
    pub ws_connects: Buckets<IpAddr>,
    pub auth_fail: Buckets<IpAddr>,
    pub key_writes: Buckets<uuid::Uuid>,
    pub key_grants: Buckets<uuid::Uuid>,
    sessions: DashMap<IpAddr, u32>,
    max_sessions_per_ip: u32,
    pub trusted_proxies: Vec<IpNet>,
}

impl Guards {
    pub fn new(l: &LimitsConfig, trusted: &[String]) -> Self {
        Self {
            http: Buckets::new(l.http_rps_per_ip as f64, 2.0 * l.http_rps_per_ip as f64),
            ws_connects: Buckets::new(
                l.ws_connects_per_min_per_ip as f64 / 60.0,
                l.ws_connects_per_min_per_ip as f64,
            ),
            auth_fail: Buckets::new(
                l.auth_failures_per_min_per_ip as f64 / 60.0,
                l.auth_failures_per_min_per_ip as f64,
            ),
            key_writes: Buckets::new(
                l.writes_per_sec_per_key as f64,
                2.0 * l.writes_per_sec_per_key as f64,
            ),
            key_grants: Buckets::new(
                l.grants_per_sec_per_key as f64,
                2.0 * l.grants_per_sec_per_key as f64,
            ),
            sessions: DashMap::new(),
            max_sessions_per_ip: l.max_sessions_per_ip.max(1),
            trusted_proxies: trusted.iter().filter_map(|p| IpNet::parse(p)).collect(),
        }
    }

    /// Counts a control session or data connection from `ip`; false when the IP is at cap.
    pub fn acquire_session(&self, ip: IpAddr) -> bool {
        let mut e = self.sessions.entry(ip).or_insert(0);
        if *e >= self.max_sessions_per_ip {
            return false;
        }
        *e += 1;
        true
    }

    pub fn release_session(&self, ip: IpAddr) {
        if let Some(mut e) = self.sessions.get_mut(&ip) {
            *e = e.saturating_sub(1);
            if *e == 0 {
                drop(e);
                self.sessions.remove_if(&ip, |_, n| *n == 0);
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn sweep(&self) {
        self.http.sweep();
        self.ws_connects.sweep();
        self.auth_fail.sweep();
        self.key_writes.sweep();
    }

    /// Peer address, or the first `X-Forwarded-For` hop when the peer is a trusted proxy.
    pub fn client_ip(&self, peer: IpAddr, headers: &HeaderMap) -> IpAddr {
        if self.trusted_proxies.iter().any(|n| n.contains(peer)) {
            if let Some(xff) = headers.get("x-forwarded-for").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()) {
                if let Some(ip) = xff.split(',').next().and_then(|s| s.trim().parse().ok()) {
                    return ip;
                }
            }
        }
        peer
    }
}

/// Request extension set by [`http_guard`].
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct ClientIp(pub IpAddr);

/// Resolved client address, written by the middleware (any client-supplied value is replaced)
/// so authentication helpers that only see headers can enforce per-key allowlists.
pub const CLIENT_IP_HEADER: &str = "x-aurix-client-ip";

/// Axum middleware: per-IP request budget, the `ClientIp` extension for handlers, and the
/// per-IP budget for failed authentications (401 → 429 once spent).
pub async fn http_guard(
    State(st): State<crate::state::Shared>,
    ConnectInfo(peer): ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>,
    mut req: Request<Body>,
    next: Next,
) -> Response {
    let ip = st.guards.client_ip(peer.ip(), req.headers());
    if !st.guards.http.allow(ip) {
        st.metrics.errors.with_label_values(&["rate_limited"]).inc();
        return (StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, "rate limited").into_response();
    }
    req.extensions_mut().insert(ClientIp(ip));
    if let Ok(v) = ip.to_string().parse() {
        req.headers_mut().insert(CLIENT_IP_HEADER, v);
    }
    let resp = next.run(req).await;
    // Failed REST auth (bad API key / operator token) shares the per-IP auth-failure budget
    // with WebSocket grant failures; once it is spent the caller sees 429 instead of 401,
    // so credential guessing cannot run at the general HTTP rate. Valid requests are untouched.
    if resp.status() == StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED && !st.guards.auth_fail.allow(ip) {
        st.metrics
            .errors
            .with_label_values(&["auth_rate_limited"])
            .inc();
        return (
            StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
            "too many failed authentications",
        )
            .into_response();
    }
    resp
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn bucket_refills() {
        let b = Buckets::new(1000.0, 2.0);
        assert!(b.allow(1u8));
        assert!(b.allow(1u8));
        assert!(!b.allow(1u8));
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(5));
        assert!(b.allow(1u8));
    }
    #[test]
    fn xff_only_from_trusted_proxy() {
        let l = LimitsConfig {
            max_players_per_room: 8,
            max_rooms_per_node: 1,
            max_events_per_sec_per_room: 1,
            max_events_per_sec_per_player: 1,
            max_event_bytes: 1,
            max_props_bytes: 1,
            max_player_props_bytes: 1,
            max_cached_events_per_room: 1,
            max_sessions_per_ip: 2,
            http_rps_per_ip: 1,
            ws_connects_per_min_per_ip: 1,
            auth_failures_per_min_per_ip: 1,
            writes_per_sec_per_key: 1,
            grants_per_sec_per_key: 1,
        };
        let g = Guards::new(&l, &["10.0.0.0/8".into()]);
        let mut h = HeaderMap::new();
        h.insert("x-forwarded-for", "203.0.113.9, 10.0.0.1".parse().unwrap());
        assert_eq!(
            g.client_ip("10.0.0.2".parse().unwrap(), &h),
            "203.0.113.9".parse::<IpAddr>().unwrap()
        );
        assert_eq!(
            g.client_ip("8.8.8.8".parse().unwrap(), &h),
            "8.8.8.8".parse::<IpAddr>().unwrap()
        );
        let ip: IpAddr = "1.1.1.1".parse().unwrap();
        assert!(g.acquire_session(ip) && g.acquire_session(ip) && !g.acquire_session(ip));
        g.release_session(ip);
        assert!(g.acquire_session(ip));
    }
}
```

```rs
            delete(op_kick_player),
        )
        .route("/v1/operator/nodes/{id}/drain", post(op_drain_node))
        .route("/v1/operator/rooms/{id}/replay", get(op_replay))
        .route("/v1/operator/rooms/{id}/desyncs", get(op_list_desyncs))
        .route(
            "/v1/operator/rooms/{id}/desyncs/{tick}/{actor}",
            get(op_get_desync),
        )
        .route(
            "/v1/operator/projects/{id}",
            get(op_project).delete(op_delete_project),
        )
        .route("/v1/operator/projects/{id}/usage", get(op_usage))
        .route("/v1/operator/billing", get(op_billing))
        .route("/v1/operator/projects/{id}/rooms", get(op_project_rooms))
        .with_state(st)
}

fn bearer(h: &HeaderMap) -> Option<&str> {
    h.get("authorization")?
        .to_str()
        .ok()?
        .strip_prefix("Bearer ")
        .map(str::trim)
}

async fn api_key(st: &Shared, h: &HeaderMap, scope: Scope) -> Result<ApiKeyRow> {
    let k = bearer(h).ok_or_else(|| NetError::Unauthorized("missing bearer api key".into()))?;
    if !looks_like_key(k) {
        return Err(NetError::Unauthorized("malformed api key".into()));
    }
    let auth = queries::find_api_key(&st.pool, &hash_key(k))
        .await?
        .ok_or_else(|| NetError::Unauthorized("unknown api key".into()))?;
    // A suspended project keeps read access so the team can see its state; everything that
    // creates load (grants, rooms, matchmaking, uploads) is refused.
    if auth.project_disabled_at.is_some() && scope != Scope::Read {
        reject(st, ProjectId::from_uuid(auth.key.project_id), "suspended");
        return Err(NetError::Forbidden("project suspended".into()));
    }
    let row = auth.key;
    let has = row
        .scopes
        .iter()
        .any(|s| s == scope.as_str() || s == "admin");
    if !has {
        return Err(NetError::Forbidden(format!(
            "key lacks scope {}",
            scope.as_str()
        )));
    }
    if !row.allowed_cidrs.is_empty() {
        let ip = h
            .get(crate::ratelimit::CLIENT_IP_HEADER)
            .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
            .and_then(|v| v.parse::<IpAddr>().ok());
        if !ip.is_some_and(|ip| cidr_allows(&row.allowed_cidrs, ip)) {
            reject(st, ProjectId::from_uuid(row.project_id), "ip_denied");
            return Err(NetError::Forbidden(
                "api key is not allowed from this address".into(),
            ));
        }
    }
    let _ = queries::touch_api_key(&st.pool, row.id).await;
    Ok(row)
}

/// Who the operator is: the bootstrap config token acts as `operator`, named tokens as `op:<name>`.
pub(crate) struct Operator {
    pub actor: String,
}

async fn operator(st: &Shared, h: &HeaderMap) -> Result<Operator> {
    let t = bearer(h).unwrap_or("");
    if net_auth::admin::admin_token_ok(&st.cfg.auth.admin_token, t) {
        return Ok(Operator {
            actor: "operator".into(),
        });
    }
    if looks_like_key(t) {
        let ip = h
            .get(crate::ratelimit::CLIENT_IP_HEADER)
            .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
            .map(str::to_string);
        if let Some(row) =
            queries::find_operator_token(&st.pool, &hash_key(t), ip.as_deref()).await?
        {
            if !row.allowed_cidrs.is_empty()
                && !ip
                    .as_deref()
                    .and_then(|v| v.parse::<IpAddr>().ok())
                    .is_some_and(|ip| cidr_allows(&row.allowed_cidrs, ip))
            {
                st.metrics.errors.with_label_values(&["ip_denied"]).inc();
                return Err(NetError::Forbidden(
                    "operator token is not allowed from this address".into(),
                ));
            }
            return Ok(Operator {
                actor: format!("op:{}", row.name),
            });
        }
    }
    Err(NetError::Unauthorized("operator token required".into()))
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct OperatorTokenReq {
    #[serde(default)]
    name: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    expires_in_secs: Option<u64>,
    /// Source networks allowed to use the token (CIDR or bare IP); empty = anywhere.
    #[serde(default)]
    allowed_cidrs: Vec<String>,
}

fn operator_token_json(r: &net_db::models::OperatorTokenRow) -> Value {
    json!({"id": r.id, "name": r.name, "prefix": r.prefix, "created_by": r.created_by, "created_at": r.created_at,
           "expires_at": r.expires_at, "revoked_at": r.revoked_at, "last_used_at": r.last_used_at,
           "allowed_cidrs": r.allowed_cidrs, "last_used_ip": r.last_used_ip})
}

async fn op_list_tokens(State(st): State<Shared>, h: HeaderMap) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    operator(&st, &h).await?;
    let rows = queries::list_operator_tokens(&st.pool).await?;
    Ok(Json(
        json!({"tokens": rows.iter().map(operator_token_json).collect::<Vec<_>>()}),
    ))
}

    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Json(req): Json<AlertWebhookReq>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    let op = operator(&st, &h).await?;
    crate::webhooks::validate_webhook_url(&req.url, st.cfg.server.environment == "development")?;
    crate::webhooks::validate_operator_events(&req.events)?;
    let secret = ApiKeyMaterial::generate().plaintext;
    let row = queries::insert_operator_webhook(&st.pool, &req.url, &secret, &req.events, &op.actor)
        .await?;
    audit_log(

        &op.actor,
        "operator_webhook.create",
        &row.id.to_string(),
        json!({"url": row.url, "events": row.events}),
    )
    .await;
    let mut out = serde_json::to_value(&row).unwrap_or_default();
    out["secret"] = Value::String(secret);
    Ok(Json(out))
}

}

#[derive(Deserialize, Default)]
struct BillingQuery {
    /// `YYYY-MM` (UTC); defaults to the current month.
    #[serde(default)]
    month: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    format: Option<String>,
}

fn month_bounds(spec: Option<&str>) -> Result<(chrono::DateTime<Utc>, chrono::DateTime<Utc>)> {
    use chrono::{Datelike, TimeZone};
    let (y, m) = match spec {
        None => {
            let n = Utc::now();
            (n.year(), n.month())
        }
        Some(s) => {
            let (y, m) = s
                .split_once('-')
                .ok_or_else(|| NetError::Invalid("month: YYYY-MM".into()))?;
            let y: i32 = y
                .parse()
                .map_err(|_| NetError::Invalid("month: YYYY-MM".into()))?;
            let m: u32 = m
                .parse()
                .map_err(|_| NetError::Invalid("month: YYYY-MM".into()))?;
            if !(1..=12).contains(&m) || !(2020..=2100).contains(&y) {
                return Err(NetError::Invalid("month: YYYY-MM".into()));
            }
            (y, m)
        }
    };
    let from = Utc
        .with_ymd_and_hms(y, m, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        .single()
        .ok_or_else(|| NetError::Invalid("month: YYYY-MM".into()))?;
    let (ny, nm) = if m == 12 { (y + 1, 1) } else { (y, m + 1) };
    let to = Utc
        .with_ymd_and_hms(ny, nm, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        .single()
        .ok_or_else(|| NetError::Invalid("month: YYYY-MM".into()))?;
    Ok((from, to))
}

/// Month report per project for invoicing: the metered units, rooms created and the caps that
/// applied. Soft-deleted projects are included (they used the service that month).
async fn op_billing(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Query(q): Query<BillingQuery>,
) -> ApiResult<axum::response::Response> {
    use axum::response::IntoResponse;
    operator(&st, &h).await?;
    let (from, to) = month_bounds(q.month.as_deref())?;
    let projects = queries::list_projects_all(&st.pool).await?;
    let usage = queries::usage_by_project_between(&st.pool, from, to).await?;
    let created: std::collections::HashMap<Uuid, i64> =
        queries::rooms_created_between(&st.pool, from, to)
            .await?
            .into_iter()
            .collect();
    let mut by: std::collections::HashMap<Uuid, std::collections::BTreeMap<String, f64>> =
        Default::default();
    for r in usage {
        *by.entry(r.project_id)
            .or_default()
            .entry(r.metric)
            .or_default() += r.quantity;
    }
    let get =
        |m: &std::collections::BTreeMap<String, f64>, k: &str| m.get(k).copied().unwrap_or(0.0);
    let mut rows: Vec<Value> = Vec::new();
    let mut total = std::collections::BTreeMap::<&str, f64>::new();
    for p in &projects {
        let m = by.remove(&p.id).unwrap_or_default();
        let rooms = created.get(&p.id).copied().unwrap_or(0);
        if m.is_empty() && rooms == 0 && p.deleted_at.is_some() {
            continue;
        }
        let l = net_control::ProjectLimits::from_json(&p.limits);
        for k in ["player_minutes", "room_minutes", "bytes_in", "bytes_out"] {
            *total.entry(k).or_default() += get(&m, k);
        }
        *total.entry("rooms_created").or_default() += rooms as f64;
        rows.push(json!({
            "project_id": p.id, "name": p.name, "plan": p.plan,
            "player_minutes": get(&m, "player_minutes"), "room_minutes": get(&m, "room_minutes"),
            "bytes_in": get(&m, "bytes_in"), "bytes_out": get(&m, "bytes_out"),
            "rooms_created": rooms,
            "cap_player_minutes": l.monthly_player_minutes, "cap_bytes": l.monthly_bytes,
            "deleted_at": p.deleted_at, "disabled_at": p.disabled_at,
        }));
    }
    rows.sort_by(|a, b| {
        b["player_minutes"]
            .as_f64()
            .partial_cmp(&a["player_minutes"].as_f64())
            .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
    });
    let month = from.format("%Y-%m").to_string();
    match q.format.as_deref() {
        None | Some("json") => Ok(Json(
            json!({"month": month, "from": from, "to": to, "projects": rows, "totals": total}),
        )
        .into_response()),
        Some("csv") => {
            let mut csv = String::from(
                "project_id,name,plan,player_minutes,room_minutes,bytes_in,bytes_out,rooms_created,cap_player_minutes,cap_bytes,deleted_at\n",
            );
            for r in &rows {
                let cell = |k: &str| match &r[k] {
                    Value::Null => String::new(),
                    Value::String(s) => csv_cell(s),
                    v => v.to_string(),
                };
                csv.push_str(&format!(
                    "{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}\n",
                    cell("project_id"),
                    cell("name"),
                    cell("plan"),
                    cell("player_minutes"),
                    cell("room_minutes"),
                    cell("bytes_in"),
                    cell("bytes_out"),
                    cell("rooms_created"),
                    cell("cap_player_minutes"),
                    cell("cap_bytes"),
                    cell("deleted_at"),
                ));
            }
            Ok((
                [
                    (
                        axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
                        "text/csv; charset=utf-8".to_string(),
                    ),
                    (
                        axum::http::header::CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
                        format!("attachment; filename=\"aurix-net-billing-{month}.csv\""),
                    ),
                ],
                csv,
            )
                .into_response())
        }
        _ => Err(NetError::Invalid("format: json or csv".into()).into()),
    }
}

async fn op_create_token(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Json(req): Json<OperatorTokenReq>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    let op = operator(&st, &h).await?;
    let name = req.name.trim();
    if name.is_empty() || name.len() > 64 || !name.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_graphic() || c == ' ')
    {
        return Err(NetError::Invalid("name: 1-64 printable ASCII characters".into()).into());
    }
    let cidrs = parse_cidrs(&req.allowed_cidrs)?;
    let m = ApiKeyMaterial::generate();
    let row = queries::insert_operator_token(
        &st.pool,
        name,
        &m.hash,
        &m.prefix,
        &op.actor,
        key_expiry(req.expires_in_secs),
        &cidrs,
    )
    .await?;
    audit_log(
        &st,
        None,
        &op.actor,
        "operator_token.create",
        &row.id.to_string(),
        json!({"name": row.name, "expires_at": row.expires_at, "allowed_cidrs": row.allowed_cidrs}),
    )
    .await;
    let mut out = operator_token_json(&row);
    out["token"] = Value::String(m.plaintext);
    Ok(Json(out))
}

async fn op_revoke_token(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
) -> ApiResult<StatusCode> {
    let op = operator(&st, &h).await?;
    let row = queries::revoke_operator_token(&st.pool, id)
        .await?
        .ok_or_else(|| NetError::NotFound("token not found or already revoked".into()))?;
    audit_log(
        &st,
        None,
        &op.actor,
        "operator_token.revoke",
        &id.to_string(),
        json!({"name": row.name}),
    )
    .await;
    Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
}

/// Audit row for an admin/operator mutation; a failed insert is logged, never fails the request.
async fn audit_log(
    st: &Shared,
    project: Option<Uuid>,
    actor: &str,
    action: &str,
    target: &str,
    details: Value,
) {
    if let Err(e) = queries::audit(&st.pool, project, actor, action, target, details).await {
        tracing::warn!(error = %e, action, "audit insert failed");
    }
}

/// Per-key write budget (`limits.writes_per_sec_per_key`).
fn key_write(st: &Shared, key: &ApiKeyRow) -> Result<()> {
    if st.guards.key_writes.allow(key.id) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        reject(st, ProjectId::from_uuid(key.project_id), "rate_limited");
        Err(NetError::RateLimited)
    }
}

/// Records why a project's player/key was turned away (hourly Redis buckets, see
/// `RedisStore::incr_rejection`). Off the request path; failures are only logged.
/// First instant of the current UTC calendar month.
pub(crate) fn month_start() -> chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc> {
    use chrono::{Datelike, TimeZone};
    let now = chrono::Utc::now();
    chrono::Utc
        .with_ymd_and_hms(now.year(), now.month(), 1, 0, 0, 0)
        .single()
        .unwrap_or(now)
}

/// Month-to-date (player_minutes, bytes) of a project, cached 30 s per node so the join path
/// does not add a SUM to every room creation.
pub(crate) async fn usage_month(st: &Shared, project: Uuid) -> Result<(f64, f64)> {
    use std::collections::HashMap;
    use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};
    use std::time::Instant;
    type UsageCache = Mutex<HashMap<Uuid, (Instant, (f64, f64))>>;
    static CACHE: OnceLock<UsageCache> = OnceLock::new();
    let cache = CACHE.get_or_init(Default::default);
    if let Some((at, v)) = cache.lock().unwrap().get(&project) {
        if at.elapsed() < std::time::Duration::from_secs(30) {
            return Ok(*v);
        }
    }
    let v = queries::usage_totals_since(&st.pool, project, month_start()).await?;
    let mut c = cache.lock().unwrap();
    if c.len() > 10_000 {
        c.clear();
    }
    c.insert(project, (Instant::now(), v));
    Ok(v)
}

/// Refuses a new room once a monthly cap is reached (counted as rejection `usage_cap`).
pub(crate) async fn check_usage_cap(
    st: &Shared,
    project: Uuid,
    limits: &net_control::quotas::EffectiveLimits,
) -> Result<()> {
    if limits.monthly_player_minutes.is_none() && limits.monthly_bytes.is_none() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let (minutes, bytes) = usage_month(st, project).await?;
    let hit = match (limits.monthly_player_minutes, limits.monthly_bytes) {
        (Some(cap), _) if minutes >= cap as f64 => {
            Some(format!("monthly cap of {cap} player-minutes reached"))
        }
        (_, Some(cap)) if bytes >= cap as f64 => {
            Some(format!("monthly cap of {cap} bytes reached"))
        }
        _ => None,
    };
    if let Some(msg) = hit {
        reject(st, ProjectId::from_uuid(project), "usage_cap");
        return Err(NetError::QuotaExceeded(msg));
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn reject(st: &Shared, project: ProjectId, reason: &'static str) {
    let redis = st.redis.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        if let Err(e) = redis.incr_rejection(project, reason).await {
            tracing::debug!(error = %e, reason, "rejection counter");
        }
    });
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct RejectionsQuery {
    #[serde(default)]
    hours: Option<u32>,
}

async fn rejections_json(st: &Shared, project: Uuid, hours: Option<u32>) -> Result<Value> {
    let hours = hours.unwrap_or(24).clamp(1, 26);
    let buckets = st
        .redis
        .get_rejections(ProjectId::from_uuid(project), hours)
        .await?;
    let mut total: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, i64> = Default::default();
    let series: Vec<Value> = buckets
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(t, counts)| {
            for (k, v) in &counts {
                *total.entry(k.clone()).or_default() += v;
            }
            let ts = chrono::DateTime::<chrono::Utc>::from_timestamp(t, 0)
                .map(|d| d.to_rfc3339())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            json!({"t": ts, "counts": counts})
        })
        .collect();
    Ok(json!({"hours": hours, "total": total, "series": series}))
}

async fn rejections(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Query(q): Query<RejectionsQuery>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    let key = api_key(&st, &h, Scope::Read).await?;
    Ok(Json(rejections_json(&st, key.project_id, q.hours).await?))
}

async fn op_rejections(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
    Query(q): Query<RejectionsQuery>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    operator(&st, &h).await?;
    Ok(Json(rejections_json(&st, id, q.hours).await?))
}

/// Per-key grant budget (`limits.grants_per_sec_per_key`): one grant per player login.
fn key_grant(st: &Shared, key: &ApiKeyRow) -> Result<()> {
    if st.guards.key_grants.allow(key.id) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        reject(st, ProjectId::from_uuid(key.project_id), "rate_limited");
        Err(NetError::RateLimited)
    }
}

async fn healthz(State(st): State<Shared>) -> Response {
    let draining = st.is_draining();
    let status = if draining {
        StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
    } else {
        StatusCode::OK
    };
    (
        status,
        Json(json!({
            "ok": !draining,
            "draining": draining,
            "version": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
            "node_id": st.node_id,
            "region": st.region,
            "rooms": st.host.len(),
            "players": st.host.players(),
            "uptime_secs": st.started.elapsed().as_secs(),
        })),
    )
        .into_response()
}

async fn metrics(State(st): State<Shared>, h: HeaderMap) -> Response {
    let want = &st.cfg.server.metrics_token;
    if !want.is_empty() && !net_auth::admin::admin_token_ok(want, bearer(&h).unwrap_or("")) {
        return (StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED, "metrics token required").into_response();
    }
    st.metrics.rooms.set(st.host.len() as i64);
    st.metrics.players.set(st.host.players() as i64);
    st.metrics.render().into_response()
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct RegionOut {
    id: String,
    display_name: String,
    nodes: usize,
    /// HTTP base URLs of live nodes in the region; clients pick one (lowest RTT) and use it
    /// for grants, rooms and the WebSocket control channel. Room lookups on the wrong node
    /// answer `room_elsewhere:<url>`.
    endpoints: Vec<String>,
}

async fn regions(State(st): State<Shared>) -> ApiResult<Json<Vec<RegionOut>>> {
    let rows = queries::list_regions(&st.pool, true).await?;
    let nodes = st.registry.snapshot();
    Ok(Json(
        rows.into_iter()
            .map(|r| RegionOut {
                nodes: nodes
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|n| n.region.as_str() == r.id && !n.draining)
                    .count(),
                endpoints: nodes
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|n| n.region.as_str() == r.id && !n.draining)
                    .map(|n| n.http_url.clone())
                    .collect(),
                id: r.id,
                display_name: r.display_name,
            })
            .filter(|r| r.nodes > 0 || r.id == st.region.as_str())
            .collect(),
    ))
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct NodesQuery {
    region: Option<String>,
}

async fn nodes(State(st): State<Shared>, Query(q): Query<NodesQuery>) -> Json<Vec<Value>> {
    Json(
        st.registry
            .snapshot()
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|n| !n.draining && q.region.as_deref().is_none_or(|r| r == n.region.as_str()))
            .map(|n| {
                json!({
                    "id": n.id, "region": n.region, "host": n.public_host, "quic_port": n.quic_port,
                    "http_url": n.http_url, "cert_sha256": n.cert_sha256, "load_factor": n.load_factor,
                })
            })
            .collect(),
    )
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct GrantReq {
    player_id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    name: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    room: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    scopes: Option<Vec<String>>,
    #[serde(default)]
    ttl_secs: Option<u64>,
    #[serde(default)]
    meta: Option<Value>,
}

async fn create_grant(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Json(req): Json<GrantReq>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    let key = api_key(&st, &h, Scope::Rooms).await?;
    key_grant(&st, &key)?;
    if !valid_player_id(&req.player_id) {
        return Err(NetError::Invalid("player_id: 1..=128 chars".into()).into());
    }
    if let Some(b) = queries::get_ban(&st.pool, key.project_id, &req.player_id).await? {
        reject(&st, ProjectId::from_uuid(key.project_id), "banned");
        return Err(NetError::Forbidden(ban_message(&b)).into());
    }
    let scopes: Vec<&str> = req
        .scopes
        .as_ref()
        .map(|v| v.iter().map(String::as_str).collect())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| vec!["join", "create"]);
    let (token, claims) = st.grants.issue(
        ProjectId::from_uuid(key.project_id),
        &req.player_id,
        &req.name,
        req.room.as_deref(),
        &scopes,
        req.meta,
        req.ttl_secs,
    )?;
    Ok(Json(
        json!({"grant": token, "expires_at": claims.exp, "player_id": claims.sub}),
    ))
}

/// Operator issues a short-lived test grant for a project (debugging a client without holding
/// the project's API key). Same checks as the key path (suspended, banned); the token is never
/// written to the audit log, only who/what/for how long.
async fn op_create_grant(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
    Json(req): Json<GrantReq>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    let op = operator(&st, &h).await?;
    let prow = queries::get_project(&st.pool, id).await?;
    if prow.disabled_at.is_some() {
        return Err(NetError::Forbidden("project is suspended".into()).into());
    }
    if !valid_player_id(&req.player_id) {
        return Err(NetError::Invalid("player_id: 1..=128 chars".into()).into());
    }
    if let Some(b) = queries::get_ban(&st.pool, id, &req.player_id).await? {
        return Err(NetError::Forbidden(ban_message(&b)).into());
    }
    let scopes: Vec<&str> = req
        .scopes
        .as_ref()
        .map(|v| v.iter().map(String::as_str).collect())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| vec!["join", "create"]);
    let ttl = req.ttl_secs.unwrap_or(300).min(3600);
    let (token, claims) = st.grants.issue(
        ProjectId::from_uuid(id),
        &req.player_id,
        &req.name,
        req.room.as_deref(),
        &scopes,
        req.meta,
        Some(ttl),
    )?;
    audit_log(
        &st,
        Some(id),
        &op.actor,
        "grant.issue",
        &req.player_id,
        json!({"scopes": scopes, "room": req.room, "ttl_secs": ttl}),
    )
    .await;
    Ok(Json(
        json!({"grant": token, "expires_at": claims.exp, "player_id": claims.sub}),
    ))
}

async fn list_rooms(State(st): State<Shared>, h: HeaderMap) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    let key = api_key(&st, &h, Scope::Read).await?;
    let project = ProjectId::from_uuid(key.project_id);
    let live = st.redis.list_rooms(project).await.unwrap_or_default();
    Ok(Json(json!({"rooms": live})))
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct CreateRoomReq {
    name: String,
    /// REST creates relay rooms only; sync/lockstep need the control-plane `create`.
    #[serde(default)]
    mode: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    max_players: Option<u16>,
    #[serde(default = "t")]
    visible: bool,
    #[serde(default = "t")]
    open: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    props: serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
    #[serde(default)]
    lobby_props: Vec<String>,
    /// Player ids whose slots are held for 60 s (party join); max 32.
    #[serde(default)]
    reserved: Vec<String>,
}
fn t() -> bool {
    true
}

/// Server-side room creation (no player joins). The room lives on this node.
async fn create_room(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Json(req): Json<CreateRoomReq>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    let key = api_key(&st, &h, Scope::Rooms).await?;
    key_write(&st, &key)?;
    if req.mode.as_deref().is_some_and(|m| m != "relay") {
        return Err(NetError::Invalid(
            "REST creates relay rooms only; create sync/lockstep rooms through the control plane"
                .into(),
        )
        .into());
    }
    validate_room_create(&req.name, &req.lobby_props)?;
    let project = ProjectId::from_uuid(key.project_id);
    if st.host.by_name(project, &req.name).is_some() {
        return Err(NetError::Conflict("room name already in use".into()).into());
    }
    let prow = queries::get_project(&st.pool, key.project_id).await?;
    let limits = net_control::ProjectLimits::from_json(&prow.limits).effective(&st.cfg.limits);
    let open_rooms = queries::count_open_rooms(&st.pool, key.project_id).await?;
    if open_rooms >= limits.max_rooms as i64 {
        reject(&st, project, "quota");
        return Err(NetError::QuotaExceeded(format!("max {} open rooms", limits.max_rooms)).into());
    }
    check_usage_cap(&st, key.project_id, &limits).await?;
    let max_players = req
        .max_players
        .unwrap_or(limits.max_players_per_room.min(16))
        .clamp(1, limits.max_players_per_room);
    let cfg = net_rooms::RoomConfig {
        id: RoomId::new(),
        project,
        name: req.name.clone(),
        mode: net_common::RoomMode::Relay,
        max_players,
        visible: req.visible,
        open: req.open,
        props: req.props.clone(),
        lobby_props: req.lobby_props.clone(),
        reserved: req.reserved.iter().take(32).cloned().collect(),
        reserved_until: (!req.reserved.is_empty())
            .then(|| std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(60)),
        cleanup_cache_on_leave: crate::ws::prop_bool(&req.props, "cleanup_cache_on_leave", true),
        max_events_per_sec: limits.max_events_per_sec_per_room,
        max_events_per_sec_per_player: limits.max_events_per_sec_per_player,
        max_event_bytes: limits.max_event_bytes,
        max_props_bytes: limits.max_props_bytes,
        max_player_props_bytes: limits.max_player_props_bytes,
        max_cached_events: limits.max_cached_events_per_room,
        offline_ttl: std::time::Duration::from_secs(crate::ws::prop_secs(
            &req.props,
            "player_ttl_secs",
            30,
        )),
        // Server-created rooms wait longer for their first player.
        empty_ttl: std::time::Duration::from_secs(crate::ws::prop_secs(
            &req.props,
            "empty_ttl_secs",
            300,
        )),
    };
    queries::insert_room(
        &st.pool,
        &queries::NewRoom {
            id: cfg.id.0,
            project_id: key.project_id,
            node_id: st.node_id.0,
            region: st.region.to_string(),
            name: req.name,
            mode: "relay".into(),
            max_players: max_players as i32,
            visible: req.visible,
            open: req.open,
            schema_hash: None,
            props: Value::Object(req.props),
            lobby_props: req.lobby_props,
        },
    )
    .await?;
    let id = cfg.id;
    let hr = st.host.insert(
        project,
        net_rooms::Room::new(cfg, std::time::Instant::now()),
    );
    crate::ws::publish_room(&st, &hr).await;
    st.webhooks.emit(
        project,
        "room.created",
        json!({"room": id.to_string(), "name": hr.lock().room.cfg.name, "mode": "relay", "region": st.region.to_string()}),
    );
    Ok(Json(
        json!({"id": id, "node": st.node_id, "region": st.region}),
    ))
}

async fn get_room(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    let key = api_key(&st, &h, Scope::Read).await?;
    let row = queries::get_room(&st.pool, id).await?;
    if row.project_id != key.project_id {
        return Err(NetError::NotFound("room".into()).into());
    }
    Ok(Json(room_detail(&st, row).await?))
}

/// Players of a room hosted on this node, or `None` when it is not hosted here.
fn local_players(st: &Shared, id: Uuid) -> Option<Vec<Value>> {
    st.host.get(RoomId::from_uuid(id)).map(|hr| {
        let g = hr.lock();
        let now = std::time::Instant::now();
        let stats: std::collections::HashMap<_, _> = g
            .room
            .player_stats(now)
            .into_iter()
            .map(|s| (s.actor, s))
            .collect();
        g.room
            .player_infos()
            .into_iter()
            .map(|p| {
                let s = stats.get(&p.actor);
                let rtt_ms = g
                    .sessions
                    .get(&p.actor)
                    .and_then(|s| s.data.as_ref())
                    .map(|d| d.link.lock().stats().rtt.as_secs_f64() * 1000.0)
                    .filter(|r| *r > 0.0);
                json!({
                    "actor": p.actor, "player_id": p.player_id, "name": p.name, "online": p.online,
                    "events": s.map(|s| s.events), "bytes_in": s.map(|s| s.bytes_in),
                    "eps": s.map(|s| s.eps), "idle_secs": s.and_then(|s| s.idle_secs),
                    "since_secs": s.map(|s| s.since_secs), "rtt_ms": rtt_ms,
                })
            })
            .collect()
    })
}

/// Live statistics of this process for the operator console: what the node is doing right now,
/// not what Postgres remembers about it.
fn local_stats(st: &Shared) -> Value {
    let mut by_mode: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, u32> = Default::default();
    let mut players = 0usize;
    let mut spectators = 0usize;
    for r in st.host.all() {
        let g = r.lock();
        *by_mode
            .entry(format!("{:?}", g.room.cfg.mode).to_lowercase())
            .or_default() += 1;
        players += g.room.online_count() as usize;
        spectators += g.room.player_infos().iter().filter(|p| p.spectator).count();
    }
    let m = &st.metrics;
    let tick = m.sync_tick.get_sample_count();
    let tick_avg_ms = if tick > 0 {
        m.sync_tick.get_sample_sum() / tick as f64 * 1000.0
    } else {
        0.0
    };
    let tick_p99_ms = {
        use prometheus::core::Metric as _;
        let proto = m.sync_tick.metric();
        let h = proto.get_histogram();
        let total = h.get_sample_count();
        let mut p99 = 0.0;
        if total > 0 {
            let target = (total as f64 * 0.99).ceil() as u64;
            for b in h.get_bucket() {
                if b.cumulative_count() >= target {
                    p99 = b.upper_bound() * 1000.0;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        p99
    };
    let rss_mb = std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/self/statm")
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| {
            s.split_whitespace()
                .nth(1)
                .and_then(|p| p.parse::<u64>().ok())
        })
        .map(|pages| pages * 4096 / 1_048_576);
    json!({
        "node_id": st.node_id,
        "version": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
        "region": st.region,
        "uptime_secs": st.started.elapsed().as_secs(),
        "draining": st.is_draining(),
        "rooms": st.host.len(),
        "rooms_by_mode": by_mode,
        "players": players,
        "spectators": spectators,
        "control_sessions": m.control_sessions.get(),
        "datagrams_in": m.datagrams_in.get(),
        "datagrams_out": m.datagrams_out.get(),
        "bytes_in": m.bytes_in.get(),
        "bytes_out": m.bytes_out.get(),
        "sync_ticks": tick,
        "sync_tick_avg_ms": tick_avg_ms,
        "sync_tick_p99_ms": tick_p99_ms,
        "tick_overruns": m.tick_overruns.get(),
        "sync_lost_deltas": m.sync_lost_deltas.get(),
        "sync_resyncs": m.sync_resyncs.get(),
        "lockstep_desyncs": m.lockstep_desyncs.get(),
        "rooms_adopted": m.rooms_adopted.get(),
        "rss_mb": rss_mb,
    })
}

async fn internal_stats(State(st): State<Shared>, h: HeaderMap) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    operator(&st, &h).await?;
    Ok(Json(local_stats(&st)))
}

/// Live stats of any node: answered locally for this node, fetched from the node otherwise.
async fn op_node_stats(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    operator(&st, &h).await?;
    if id == st.node_id.0 {
        return Ok(Json(local_stats(&st)));
    }
    let n = st
        .registry
        .get(net_common::NodeId::from_uuid(id))
        .ok_or_else(|| NetError::NotFound("node is not live".into()))?;
    Ok(Json(
        internal_get(&st, &n.http_url, "/v1/internal/stats").await?,
    ))
}

fn local_find_player(st: &Shared, project: ProjectId, player_id: &str) -> Vec<Value> {
    st.host
        .find_player(project, player_id)
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(room, name, mode, actor, pname, online)| {
            json!({"room_id": room, "name": name, "mode": mode, "node_id": st.node_id, "actor": actor, "player_name": pname, "online": online})
        })
        .collect()
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct ProjectQuery {
    project: Uuid,
}

/// Node-to-node: rooms hosted here where a player sits. Fleet-wide lookups fan out to every live node.
async fn internal_find_player(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Path(player_id): Path<String>,
    Query(q): Query<ProjectQuery>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    operator(&st, &h).await?;
    Ok(Json(
        json!({"rooms": local_find_player(&st, ProjectId::from_uuid(q.project), &player_id)}),
    ))
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct PresenceQuery {
    project: Uuid,
    /// Player ids separated by `\n` (never part of a valid id).
    #[serde(default)]
    ids: String,
}

/// Node-to-node: presence and room slots of players on this node (`find_friends` fans out to every node).
async fn internal_presence(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Query(q): Query<PresenceQuery>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    operator(&st, &h).await?;
    let ids: Vec<String> = q
        .ids
        .split('\n')
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .take(crate::presence::MAX_FRIENDS)
        .map(str::to_string)
        .collect();
    Ok(Json(json!({
        "players": crate::presence::local_friends(&st, ProjectId::from_uuid(q.project), &ids)
    })))
}

pub(crate) fn pct(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    for b in s.bytes() {
        match b {
            b'A'..=b'Z' | b'a'..=b'z' | b'0'..=b'9' | b'-' | b'_' | b'.' | b'~' => {
                out.push(b as char)
            }
            _ => out.push_str(&format!("%{b:02X}")),
        }
    }
    out
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone)]
struct NoticeReq {
    #[serde(default)]
    text: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    level: Option<String>,
}

fn notice_level(req: &NoticeReq) -> Result<(String, &str)> {
    let text = req.text.trim();
    if text.is_empty() || text.chars().count() > 512 || text.chars().any(|c| c.is_control()) {
        return Err(NetError::Invalid(
            "text: 1-512 characters, no control characters".into(),
        ));
    }
    let level = match req.level.as_deref() {
        None | Some("info") => "info",
        Some("warn") => "warn",
        _ => return Err(NetError::Invalid("level: info or warn".into())),
    };
    Ok((text.to_string(), level))
}

/// Notice to one room wherever it is hosted; returns players reached.
async fn notice_anywhere(
    st: &Shared,
    project: ProjectId,
    id: Uuid,
    req: &NoticeReq,
) -> Result<usize> {
    let (text, level) = notice_level(req)?;
    let room = RoomId::from_uuid(id);
    if st.host.get(room).is_some() {
        return crate::ws::notice_room(st, room, &text, level);
    }
    let live = st
        .redis
        .get_room(project, room)
        .await?
        .ok_or_else(|| NetError::NotFound("room is not live".into()))?;
    let node = Uuid::parse_str(&live.node)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|n| st.registry.get(net_common::NodeId::from_uuid(n)))
        .ok_or_else(|| NetError::NotFound("hosting node unknown".into()))?;
    let v = internal_post(
        st,
        &node.http_url,
        &format!("/v1/internal/rooms/{id}/notice"),
        json!({"text": text, "level": level}),
    )
    .await?;
    Ok(v["players"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as usize)
}

/// Notice to every live room of a project on every node; returns (rooms, players).
async fn notice_project_anywhere(
    st: &Shared,
    project: Uuid,
    req: &NoticeReq,
) -> Result<(usize, usize)> {
    let (text, level) = notice_level(req)?;
    let (mut rooms, mut players) =
        crate::ws::notice_project(st, ProjectId::from_uuid(project), &text, level);
    let body = json!({"text": text, "level": level});
    let path = format!("/v1/internal/notice?project={project}");
    let (path, body) = (path.as_str(), &body);
    let remote = st
        .registry
        .snapshot()
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|n| n.id != st.node_id);
    let results = futures::future::join_all(remote.map(|n| async move {
        let r = internal_post(st, &n.http_url, path, body.clone()).await;
        (n, r)
    }))
    .await;
    for (n, r) in results {
        match r {
            Ok(v) => {
                rooms += v["rooms"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as usize;
                players += v["players"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as usize;
            }
            Err(e) => tracing::warn!(node = %n.http_url, error = %e, "notice: node unreachable"),
        }
    }
    Ok((rooms, players))
}

async fn room_notice(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Path(id): Path<Uuid>,
    Json(req): Json<NoticeReq>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    let key = api_key(&st, &h, Scope::Rooms).await?;
    key_write(&st, &key)?;
    let row = queries::get_room(&st.pool, id).await?;
    if row.project_id != key.project_id {
        return Err(NetError::NotFound("room not found".into()).into());
    }
    let players = notice_anywhere(&st, ProjectId::from_uuid(row.project_id), id, &req).await?;
    audit_log(
        &st,
        Some(row.project_id),
        &format!("key:{}", key.id),
        "room.notice",
        &id.to_string(),
        json!({"text": req.text, "players": players}),
    )
    .await;
    Ok(Json(json!({"rooms": 1, "players": players})))
}

async fn project_notice(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    h: HeaderMap,
    Json(req): Json<NoticeReq>,
) -> ApiResult<Json<Value>> {
    let key = api_key(&st, &h, Scope::Rooms).await?;
    key_write(&st, &key)?;
    let (rooms, players) = notice_project_anywhere(&st, key.project_id, &req).await?;
    audit_log(
        &st,
        Some(key.project_id),
        &format!("key:{}", key.id),
        "project.notice",
        &key.project_id.to_string(),
        json!({"text": req.text, "rooms": rooms, "players": players}),
    )
    .await;
    Ok(Json(json!({"rooms": rooms, "players": players})))
}

async fn internal_room_notice(
    State(st): State<Shared>,
```
