`crates/net-api/src/sync.rs`:

```rs
//! Sync mode: the server runs the simulation at a fixed tick, clients send inputs, the
//! server replicates state deltas with interest management.
//!
//! Data frames on the unreliable channel (first byte = kind):
//! ```text
//! 0x10 Input    client->server  u32 first_tick, u8 n, n x (u8 len, bytes)   (redundant ticks)
//! 0x11 Delta    server->client  replication delta (see net-replication)
//! 0x12 Resync   client->server  drop baselines, next delta is a full snapshot
//! 0x13 Ack      client->server  u32 last delta tick, u32 history bits (see `AckTracker`)
//! ```

use bytes::{Buf, BufMut, Bytes, BytesMut};
use net_common::types::{ActorId, Tick};
use net_lagcomp::{History, Hitbox};
use net_replication::{ClientView, ReplicationConfig, Replicator};
use net_sim::{EntityId, Frame, FrameConfig, Input};
use net_wire::{BitReader, ComponentValue, Schema, Value};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

pub const KIND_INPUT: u8 = 0x10;
pub const KIND_DELTA: u8 = 0x11;
pub const KIND_RESYNC: u8 = 0x12;
pub const KIND_ACK: u8 = 0x13;

/// Redundant input ticks per packet (client resends the last K).
pub const INPUT_REDUNDANCY: usize = 3;

/// Built-in schema used when a room gives none: a moving avatar per actor.
pub const ARENA_SCHEMA: &str = "\
component Transform {\n    pos: vec3 @range(-512, 512, 0.01)\n    vel: vec3 @range(-64, 64, 0.01)\n}\n\
component Avatar {\n    actor: u16\n    hp: u8\n}\n";

/// Server-side game rules. The built-in ones below cover the two common cases; WASM-hosted
/// game logic plugs in here later.
pub trait GameLogic: Send {
    fn on_join(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, actor: ActorId) -> Option<EntityId>;
    fn on_leave(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, actor: ActorId, avatar: Option<EntityId>);
    /// `inputs`: (actor, avatar, input bytes, fresh) for every connected actor.
    fn step(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, inputs: &[(ActorId, Option<EntityId>, Vec<u8>, bool)]);
    fn hitboxes(&self, frame: &Frame) -> Vec<(EntityId, Hitbox)>;
    /// Called after the frame was restored from a checkpoint (node failover).
    fn reset(&mut self) {}
}

/// Project-supplied logic in the WebAssembly sandbox (`net-game`).
impl GameLogic for net_game::WasmLogic {
    fn on_join(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, actor: ActorId) -> Option<EntityId> {
        net_game::WasmLogic::on_join(self, frame, actor)
    }
    fn on_leave(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, actor: ActorId, avatar: Option<EntityId>) {
        net_game::WasmLogic::on_leave(self, frame, actor, avatar)
    }
    fn step(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, inputs: &[(ActorId, Option<EntityId>, Vec<u8>, bool)]) {
        net_game::WasmLogic::step(self, frame, inputs)
    }
    fn hitboxes(&self, _frame: &Frame) -> Vec<(EntityId, Hitbox)> {
        net_game::WasmLogic::hitboxes(self)
    }
    fn reset(&mut self) {
        net_game::WasmLogic::reset(self)
    }
}

/// Arena: input = i8 move_x, i8 move_z, u8 buttons; server integrates velocity.
/// Entities one client may force into view with `set_view`.
pub const MAX_INTEREST: usize = 64;

pub struct ArenaLogic {
    pub speed: f32,
}

impl GameLogic for ArenaLogic {
    fn on_join(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, actor: ActorId) -> Option<EntityId> {
        let e = frame.spawn(Some(actor)).ok()?;
        let x = (actor.0 % 16) as f32 * 4.0 - 32.0;
        let z = (actor.0 / 16) as f32 * 4.0 - 32.0;
        frame
            .set(
                e,
                "Transform",
                ComponentValue {
                    fields: vec![Value::Vec3([x, 0.0, z]), Value::Vec3([0.0; 3])],
                },
            )
            .ok()?;
        frame
            .set(
                e,
                "Avatar",
                ComponentValue {
                    fields: vec![Value::UInt(actor.0 as u64), Value::UInt(100)],
                },
            )
            .ok()?;
        Some(e)
    }

    fn on_leave(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, _actor: ActorId, avatar: Option<EntityId>) {
        if let Some(e) = avatar {
            let _ = frame.despawn(e);
        }
    }

    fn step(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, inputs: &[(ActorId, Option<EntityId>, Vec<u8>, bool)]) {
        let dt = frame.dt();
        for (_, avatar, data, _) in inputs {
            let Some(e) = avatar else { continue };
            let (mx, mz) = if data.len() >= 2 {
                (data[0] as i8 as f32 / 127.0, data[1] as i8 as f32 / 127.0)
            } else {
                (0.0, 0.0)
            };
            if let Some(t) = frame.get_mut(*e, "Transform") {
                let vel = [mx * self.speed, 0.0, mz * self.speed];
                if let Value::Vec3(p) = &mut t.fields[0] {
                    p[0] = (p[0] + vel[0] * dt).clamp(-512.0, 512.0);
                    p[2] = (p[2] + vel[2] * dt).clamp(-512.0, 512.0);
                }
                t.fields[1] = Value::Vec3(vel);
            }
        }
    }

    fn hitboxes(&self, frame: &Frame) -> Vec<(EntityId, Hitbox)> {
        frame
            .entities()
            .filter_map(|e| {
                let p = net_sim::vec3_of(e.components.get(&0)?, 0)?;
                Some((
                    e.id,
                    Hitbox {
                        center: [p[0], p[1] + 1.0, p[2]],
                        half: [0.5, 1.0, 0.5],
                    },
                ))
            })
            .collect()
    }
}

/// Owner-authoritative: every actor gets one entity (its avatar) and may spawn more. The input
/// body is either the plain form — `u8 n, n × (cid, encode_full)` applied to the avatar — or,
/// when the first byte is `OPS_MARKER`, a list of ops: `u8 n_ops`, each `u8 op` followed by
/// `OP_WRITE: u48 entity, u8 n, writes` · `OP_SPAWN: u8 n, writes` (new entity owned by the
/// actor, at most `MAX_OWNED` per actor) · `OP_DESPAWN: u48 entity` · `OP_TRANSFER: u48 entity,
/// u16 actor` (hand ownership to another joined actor). Only the owner may write, despawn or
/// transfer an entity; the first invalid op ends the input. A leaving actor's entities are
/// despawned. For games that bring their own schema but keep simulation on the clients.
pub struct OwnerLogic;
pub const OPS_MARKER: u8 = 0xFF;
pub const OP_WRITE: u8 = 0;
pub const OP_SPAWN: u8 = 1;
pub const OP_DESPAWN: u8 = 2;
pub const OP_TRANSFER: u8 = 3;
pub const MAX_OWNED: usize = 32;

fn owns(frame: &mut Frame, id: EntityId, actor: ActorId) -> bool {
    frame.entity_mut(id).is_some_and(|e| e.owner == Some(actor))
}

/// `u8 n, n × (cid, encode_full)` applied to `e`; false on a malformed list.
fn read_writes(frame: &mut Frame, e: EntityId, r: &mut BitReader) -> bool {
    let cid_bits = frame.schema.component_id_bits();
    let Ok(n) = r.read_bits(8) else {
        return false;
    };
    for _ in 0..n {
        let Ok(cid) = r.read_bits(cid_bits) else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(c) = frame.schema.by_id(cid as u16).cloned() else {
            return false;
        };
        let Ok(v) = ComponentValue::decode_full(&c, r) else {
            return false;
        };
        if let Some(ent) = frame.entity_mut(e) {
            ent.components.insert(c.id, v);
        }
    }
    true
}

impl GameLogic for OwnerLogic {
    fn on_join(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, actor: ActorId) -> Option<EntityId> {
        frame.spawn(Some(actor)).ok()
    }
    fn on_leave(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, actor: ActorId, _avatar: Option<EntityId>) {
        let owned: Vec<EntityId> = frame
            .entities()
            .filter(|e| e.owner == Some(actor))
            .map(|e| e.id)
            .collect();
        for e in owned {
            let _ = frame.despawn(e);
        }
    }
    fn step(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, inputs: &[(ActorId, Option<EntityId>, Vec<u8>, bool)]) {
        for (actor, avatar, data, fresh) in inputs {
            if !*fresh {
                continue;
            }
            let mut r = BitReader::new(data);
            if data.first() != Some(&OPS_MARKER) {
                if let Some(e) = avatar {
                    read_writes(frame, *e, &mut r);
                }
                continue;
            }
            let _ = r.read_bits(8);
            let Ok(n_ops) = r.read_bits(8) else {
                continue;
            };
            for _ in 0..n_ops {
                let Ok(op) = r.read_bits(8) else {
                    break;
                };
                let ok = match op as u8 {
                    OP_WRITE => {
                        let Ok(id) = r.read_bits(48) else {
                            break;
                        };
                        let id = EntityId::from_u64(id);
                        owns(frame, id, *actor) && read_writes(frame, id, &mut r)
                    }
                    OP_SPAWN => {
                        let owned = frame.entities().filter(|e| e.owner == Some(*actor)).count();
                        if owned >= MAX_OWNED {
                            break;
                        }
                        match frame.spawn(Some(*actor)) {
                            Ok(id) => read_writes(frame, id, &mut r),
                            Err(_) => break,
                        }
                    }
                    OP_DESPAWN => {
                        let Ok(id) = r.read_bits(48) else {
                            break;
                        };
                        let id = EntityId::from_u64(id);
                        owns(frame, id, *actor) && Some(id) != *avatar && frame.despawn(id).is_ok()
                    }
                    OP_TRANSFER => {
                        let (Ok(id), Ok(to)) = (r.read_bits(48), r.read_bits(16)) else {
                            break;
                        };
                        let (id, to) = (EntityId::from_u64(id), ActorId(to as _));
                        let joined = frame.entities().any(|e| e.owner == Some(to));
                        if owns(frame, id, *actor) && joined {
                            if let Some(e) = frame.entity_mut(id) {
                                e.owner = Some(to);
                            }
                            true
                        } else {
                            false
                        }
                    }
                    _ => false,
                };
                if !ok {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    fn hitboxes(&self, _frame: &Frame) -> Vec<(EntityId, Hitbox)> {
        Vec::new()
    }
}
pub struct SyncRoom {
    pub frame: Frame,
    pub rep: Replicator,
    pub history: History,
    pub logic: Box<dyn GameLogic>,
    pub views: HashMap<ActorId, ClientView>,
    pub avatars: HashMap<ActorId, Option<EntityId>>,
    pub hz: u16,
    pub schema_hash: String,
    /// Per-actor input-frame tokens: +1.1 per tick (tick rate + 10 %), burst `INPUT_BURST`.
    input_tokens: HashMap<ActorId, f32>,
    pub inputs_rate_limited: u64,
    pub invalid_inputs: u64,
    pub resyncs: u64,
    /// Watch-only actors: a view of the whole world, no avatar, inputs ignored.
    spectators: HashSet<ActorId>,
}

/// Input frames a client may send in a burst before the per-tick allowance applies.
pub const INPUT_BURST: f32 = 8.0;
/// Inputs further ahead of the room tick than this are dropped as invalid.
pub const INPUT_MAX_AHEAD: u32 = 64;

impl SyncRoom {
    /// `schema`: IDL text from room props, or None for the built-in arena.
    pub fn new(schema: Option<&str>, hz: u16, seed: u64) -> Result<Self, String> {
        Self::with_replication(schema, hz, seed, ReplicationConfig::default())
    }

    /// Replication settings from room props: `budget_bytes`, `aoi_cell`, `aoi_radius`,
    /// `position` ("Component.field_index"; empty string disables AOI).
    pub fn replication_from_props(
        props: &serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
    ) -> ReplicationConfig {
        let mut cfg = ReplicationConfig::default();
        if let Some(v) = props.get("budget_bytes").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()) {
            cfg.budget_bytes = (v as usize).clamp(200, 60_000);
        }
        if let Some(v) = props.get("aoi_cell").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()) {
            cfg.aoi_cell = v.max(0.0) as f32;
        }
        if let Some(v) = props.get("aoi_radius").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()) {
            cfg.aoi_radius = v.min(64) as u32;
        }
        if let Some(v) = props.get("stale_after").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()) {
            cfg.stale_after = v.clamp(1, 3600) as u32;
        }
        if let Some(v) = props.get("position").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
            cfg.position = v
                .split_once('.')
                .and_then(|(c, f)| f.parse().ok().map(|f| (c.to_string(), f)));
        }
        cfg
    }

    pub fn with_replication(
        schema: Option<&str>,
        hz: u16,
        seed: u64,
        rep: ReplicationConfig,
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        Self::with_logic(schema, hz, seed, rep, None)
    }

    /// `logic`: server-side game logic (WASM module); None = owner-authoritative writes for a
    /// custom schema, or the built-in arena when there is no schema either.
    pub fn with_logic(
        schema: Option<&str>,
        hz: u16,
        seed: u64,
        rep: ReplicationConfig,
        logic: Option<Box<dyn GameLogic>>,
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let (schema, logic): (Schema, Box<dyn GameLogic>) = match (schema, logic) {
            (Some(src), Some(l)) => (Schema::parse(src).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?, l),
            (None, Some(l)) => (Schema::parse(ARENA_SCHEMA).unwrap(), l),
            (Some(src), None) => (
                Schema::parse(src).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
                Box::new(OwnerLogic),
            ),
            (None, None) => (
                Schema::parse(ARENA_SCHEMA).unwrap(),
                Box::new(ArenaLogic { speed: 6.0 }),
            ),
        };
        let hz = hz.clamp(8, 128);
        let rep = Replicator::new(rep, &schema);
        let frame = Frame::new(
            schema.clone(),
            FrameConfig {
                tick_hz: hz,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            seed,
        );
        Ok(Self {
            schema_hash: schema.hash.clone(),
            frame,
            rep,
            history: History::new(hz as usize * 2),
            logic,
            views: HashMap::new(),
            avatars: HashMap::new(),
            hz,
            input_tokens: HashMap::new(),
            inputs_rate_limited: 0,
            invalid_inputs: 0,
            resyncs: 0,
            spectators: HashSet::new(),
        })
    }

    pub fn tick_period(&self) -> std::time::Duration {
        std::time::Duration::from_micros(1_000_000 / self.hz as u64)
    }

    pub fn on_join(&mut self, actor: ActorId) {
        self.on_join_as(actor, false)
    }

    pub fn on_join_as(&mut self, actor: ActorId, spectator: bool) {
        if spectator {
            self.spectators.insert(actor);
            self.views
                .entry(actor)
                .or_insert_with(|| ClientView::new(actor));
            return;
        }
        if self.avatars.contains_key(&actor) {
            return;
        }
        let existing = self
            .frame
            .entities()
            .find(|e| e.owner == Some(actor))
            .map(|e| e.id);
        let avatar = match existing {
            Some(e) => Some(e),
            None => self.logic.on_join(&mut self.frame, actor),
        };
        self.avatars.insert(actor, avatar);
        let mut v = ClientView::new(actor);
        v.viewpoint = avatar;
        self.views.insert(actor, v);
    }

    /// `set_view` control message: extra viewpoints (spectators get the first as their main
    /// viewpoint) and forced-interest entities; unknown entities are ignored. Returns what was
    /// applied.
    pub fn set_view(
        &mut self,
        actor: ActorId,
        viewpoints: &[u64],
        interest: &[u64],
    ) -> (usize, usize) {
        let Some(v) = self.views.get_mut(&actor) else {
            return (0, 0);
        };
        let live = |id: u64| {
            let e = net_sim::EntityId::from_u64(id);
            self.frame.entity(e).is_some().then_some(e)
        };
        let mut vps: Vec<net_sim::EntityId> =
            viewpoints.iter().filter_map(|&id| live(id)).collect();
        vps.dedup();
        if v.viewpoint.is_none() {
            v.viewpoint = (!vps.is_empty()).then(|| vps.remove(0));
        }
        vps.truncate(net_replication::MAX_VIEWPOINTS - 1);
        v.extra_viewpoints = vps;
        v.interest = interest
            .iter()
            .take(MAX_INTEREST)
            .filter_map(|&id| live(id))
            .collect();
        (
            v.extra_viewpoints.len() + v.viewpoint.is_some() as usize,
            v.interest.len(),
        )
    }

    pub fn on_leave(&mut self, actor: ActorId) {
        self.input_tokens.remove(&actor);
        self.spectators.remove(&actor);
        if let Some(avatar) = self.avatars.remove(&actor) {
            self.logic.on_leave(&mut self.frame, actor, avatar);
        }
        self.views.remove(&actor);
        self.frame.forget_actor(actor);
    }

    /// Client data frame. Returns true when it was a sync frame (handled here).
    pub fn handle(&mut self, actor: ActorId, mut payload: Bytes) -> bool {
        let Some(&kind) = payload.first() else {
            return false;
        };
        match kind {
            KIND_INPUT => {
                if self.spectators.contains(&actor) {
                    return true;
                }
                payload.advance(1);
                if payload.len() < 5 {
                    self.invalid_inputs += 1;
                    return true;
                }
                let tokens = self.input_tokens.entry(actor).or_insert(INPUT_BURST);
                if *tokens < 1.0 {
                    self.inputs_rate_limited += 1;
                    return true;
                }
                *tokens -= 1.0;
                let first = payload.get_u32();
                let n = payload.get_u8() as usize;
                if first.wrapping_sub(self.frame.tick.0) < 1 << 31
                    && first > self.frame.tick.0 + INPUT_MAX_AHEAD
                {
                    self.invalid_inputs += 1;
                    return true;
                }
                for i in 0..n.min(INPUT_REDUNDANCY + 1) {
                    if payload.is_empty() {
                        break;
                    }
                    let len = payload.get_u8() as usize;
                    if payload.len() < len {
                        break;
                    }
                    let data = payload.split_to(len).to_vec();
                    self.frame.push_input(Input {
                        actor,
                        tick: Tick(first.wrapping_add(i as u32)),
                        data,
                    });
                }
                true
            }
            KIND_RESYNC => {
                self.resyncs += 1;
                if let Some(v) = self.views.get_mut(&actor) {
                    v.reset();
                }
                true
            }
            KIND_ACK => {
                payload.advance(1);
                if payload.len() < 8 {
                    return true;
                }
                let last = payload.get_u32();
                let bits = payload.get_u32();
                if let Some(v) = self.views.get_mut(&actor) {
                    v.ack(last, bits);
                }
                true
            }
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    /// One simulation step. Returns the delta frame for each actor with a view.
    pub fn tick(&mut self) -> Vec<(ActorId, Bytes)> {
        for t in self.input_tokens.values_mut() {
            *t = (*t + 1.1).min(INPUT_BURST);
        }
        let actors: Vec<ActorId> = self.avatars.keys().copied().collect();
        let mut inputs = Vec::with_capacity(actors.len());
        for a in &actors {
            let (data, fresh) = self.frame.input_for(*a);
            inputs.push((*a, self.avatars[a], data, fresh));
        }
        let logic = &mut self.logic;
        self.frame.advance(|f| logic.step(f, &inputs));
        let boxes = self.logic.hitboxes(&self.frame);
        self.history.record(self.frame.tick, boxes);
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(self.views.len());
        for (a, v) in self.views.iter_mut() {
            let d = self.rep.build(&self.frame, v);
            let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(d.len() + 1);
            b.put_u8(KIND_DELTA);
            b.extend_from_slice(&d);
            out.push((*a, b.freeze()));
        }
        out
    }

    /// Simulation events raised during the last tick(s), as relay frames: `target` None means
    /// everyone in the room.
    pub fn take_events(&mut self) -> Vec<(Option<ActorId>, u8, Bytes)> {
        self.frame
            .drain_events()
            .into_iter()
            .map(|e| (e.target, e.code as u8, Bytes::from(e.data)))
            .collect()
    }

    /// Checkpoint body: frame snapshot (tick, rng, entities). Views are rebuilt on restore.
    pub fn checkpoint(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        self.frame.snapshot()
    }

    /// Re-host from a checkpoint: avatars are re-linked by owner on the next on_join.
    pub fn restore(&mut self, body: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.frame.restore(body).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        self.views.clear();
        self.avatars.clear();
        self.history = History::new(self.hz as usize * 2);
        self.logic.reset();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// (resync requests, starved client-ticks) since the last call.
    pub fn take_replication_stats(&mut self) -> (u64, u64) {
        let starved = self
            .views
            .values_mut()
            .map(|v| std::mem::take(&mut v.starved))
            .sum();
        (std::mem::take(&mut self.resyncs), starved)
    }

    /// (rate-limited, invalid) input frames since the last call.
    pub fn take_input_stats(&mut self) -> (u64, u64) {
        (
            std::mem::take(&mut self.inputs_rate_limited),
            std::mem::take(&mut self.invalid_inputs),
        )
    }

    /// Deltas clients lost since the last call (from their acks).
    pub fn take_lost_deltas(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.views
            .values_mut()
            .map(|v| std::mem::take(&mut v.lost_deltas))
            .sum()
    }

    /// Encodes a client ack frame from `AckTracker::ack()`.
    pub fn encode_ack(last: u32, bits: u32) -> Bytes {
        let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(9);
        b.put_u8(KIND_ACK);
        b.put_u32(last);
        b.put_u32(bits);
        b.freeze()
    }

    /// Encodes a client input packet (used by SDK/loadtest): the last K inputs ending at `tick`.
    pub fn encode_input(first_tick: Tick, inputs: &[Vec<u8>]) -> Bytes {
        let mut b = BytesMut::new();
        b.put_u8(KIND_INPUT);
        b.put_u32(first_tick.0);
        b.put_u8(inputs.len().min(255) as u8);
        for i in inputs.iter().take(255) {
            b.put_u8(i.len().min(255) as u8);
            b.extend_from_slice(&i[..i.len().min(255)]);
        }
        b.freeze()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn set_view_steers_viewpoints_and_interest() {
        let mut room = SyncRoom::new(None, 60, 7).unwrap();
        let (a, b, spec) = (ActorId(1), ActorId(2), ActorId(3));
        room.on_join(a);
        room.on_join(b);
        room.on_join_as(spec, true);
        let av_a = room.avatars[&a].unwrap().to_u64();
        let av_b = room.avatars[&b].unwrap().to_u64();
        // spectator: first viewpoint becomes the main one, unknown entities are ignored
        assert_eq!(
            room.set_view(spec, &[av_a, 0xdead_beef], &[av_b, 0xdead_beef]),
            (1, 1)
        );
        assert_eq!(room.views[&spec].viewpoint.map(|e| e.to_u64()), Some(av_a));
        assert!(room.views[&spec].extra_viewpoints.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(room.views[&spec].interest.len(), 1);
        // player keeps the avatar as main viewpoint; extras capped at MAX_VIEWPOINTS - 1
        let many: Vec<u64> = (0..10)
            .map(|i| if i % 2 == 0 { av_a } else { av_b })
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(
            room.set_view(a, &many, &[]),
            (net_replication::MAX_VIEWPOINTS, 0)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            room.views[&a].viewpoint.map(|e| e.to_u64()),
            Some(room.avatars[&a].unwrap().to_u64())
        );
        // clearing
        assert_eq!(room.set_view(a, &[], &[]), (1, 0));
        assert_eq!(room.set_view(ActorId(99), &[av_a], &[]), (0, 0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn arena_moves_avatars_and_replicates() {
        let mut room = SyncRoom::new(None, 60, 7).unwrap();
        let (a, b) = (ActorId(1), ActorId(2));
        room.on_join(a);
        room.on_join(b);
        let mut client_a = Frame::new(room.frame.schema.clone(), FrameConfig::default(), 0);
        // actor a pushes right for 60 ticks, b idle
        for t in 0..60u32 {
            let inp = SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(t), &[vec![127, 0, 0]]);
            assert!(room.handle(a, inp));
            let out = room.tick();
            assert_eq!(out.len(), 2);
            for (actor, d) in out {
                if actor == a {
                    assert_eq!(d[0], KIND_DELTA);
                    Replicator::apply(&mut client_a, &d[1..]).unwrap();
                }
            }
        }
        let ea = room.avatars[&a].unwrap();
        let p = net_sim::vec3_of(room.frame.get(ea, "Transform").unwrap(), 0).unwrap();
        assert!((p[0] - (-28.0 + 6.0)).abs() < 0.05, "{p:?}");
        let pc = net_sim::vec3_of(client_a.get(ea, "Transform").unwrap(), 0).unwrap();
        assert!((pc[0] - p[0]).abs() < 0.02);
        assert_eq!(client_a.entity_count(), 2);
        assert_eq!(client_a.tick, room.frame.tick);
        // leave removes the avatar on the next delta
        room.on_leave(b);
        for (actor, d) in room.tick() {
            if actor == a {
                Replicator::apply(&mut client_a, &d[1..]).unwrap();
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(client_a.entity_count(), 1);
        // resync -> full snapshot again
        room.handle(a, Bytes::from_static(&[KIND_RESYNC]));
        let out = room.tick();
        let full = &out.iter().find(|(x, _)| *x == a).unwrap().1;
        assert!(full.len() > 12);
        // lag comp sees the avatar where it was
        let hit = room
            .history
            .raycast_at(
                Tick(30),
                [p[0] - 20.0, 1.0, p[2]],
                [1.0, 0.0, 0.0],
                100.0,
                None,
            )
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(hit.entity, ea);
        assert!(hit.distance < 20.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn checkpoint_restore_keeps_avatars() {
        let mut room = SyncRoom::new(None, 60, 3).unwrap();
        room.on_join(ActorId(1));
        for t in 0..10u32 {
            room.handle(
                ActorId(1),
                SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(t), &[vec![127, 0, 0]]),
            );
            room.tick();
        }
        let ea = room.avatars[&ActorId(1)].unwrap();
        let p = net_sim::vec3_of(room.frame.get(ea, "Transform").unwrap(), 0).unwrap();
        let ck = room.checkpoint();
        let mut fresh = SyncRoom::new(None, 60, 0).unwrap();
        fresh.restore(&ck).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(fresh.frame.tick, Tick(10));
        fresh.on_join(ActorId(1));
        assert_eq!(fresh.avatars[&ActorId(1)], Some(ea));
        let p2 = net_sim::vec3_of(fresh.frame.get(ea, "Transform").unwrap(), 0).unwrap();
        assert!((p[0] - p2[0]).abs() < 0.02);
        room.frame.raise(7, Some(ActorId(1)), vec![1, 2]);
        room.frame.raise(8, None, vec![]);
        let ev = room.take_events();
        assert_eq!(ev.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(ev[0].1, 7);
        let mut props = serde_json::Map::new();
        props.insert("budget_bytes".into(), serde_json::json!(5000));
        props.insert("stale_after".into(), serde_json::json!(90));
        props.insert("position".into(), serde_json::json!("Transform.0"));
        let cfg = SyncRoom::replication_from_props(&props);
        assert_eq!(cfg.budget_bytes, 5000);
        assert_eq!(cfg.stale_after, 90);
        assert_eq!(cfg.position, Some(("Transform".into(), 0)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn owner_logic_applies_component_writes() {
        let src = "component Pose {\n x: f32 @range(-100, 100, 0.1)\n}";
        let mut room = SyncRoom::new(Some(src), 30, 1).unwrap();
        let a = ActorId(5);
        room.on_join(a);
        let ea = room.avatars[&a].unwrap();
        let c = room.frame.schema.component("Pose").unwrap().clone();
        let mut w = net_wire::BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bits(1, 8);
        w.write_bits(c.id as u64, room.frame.schema.component_id_bits());
        ComponentValue {
            fields: vec![Value::F32(42.0)],
        }
        .encode_full(&c, &mut w)
        .unwrap();
        room.handle(a, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(0), &[w.finish()]));
        room.tick();
        assert_eq!(
            room.frame.get(ea, "Pose"),
            Some(&ComponentValue {
                fields: vec![Value::F32(42.0)]
            })
        );
        assert!(SyncRoom::new(Some("component {"), 30, 1).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn owner_ops_spawn_write_transfer_despawn_and_leave() {
        let src = "component Pose {\n x: f32 @range(-100, 100, 0.1)\n}";
        let mut room = SyncRoom::new(Some(src), 30, 1).unwrap();
        let (a, b) = (ActorId(1), ActorId(2));
        room.on_join(a);
        room.on_join(b);
        let c = room.frame.schema.component("Pose").unwrap().clone();
        let cb = room.frame.schema.component_id_bits();
        let pose = |x: f32| ComponentValue {
            fields: vec![Value::F32(x)],
        };
        let send = |room: &mut SyncRoom, actor: ActorId, w: net_wire::BitWriter| {
            let t = room.frame.tick;
            room.handle(actor, SyncRoom::encode_input(t, &[w.finish()]));
            room.tick();
        };
        let mut w = net_wire::BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bits(OPS_MARKER as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(1, 8);
        w.write_bits(OP_SPAWN as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(1, 8);
        w.write_bits(c.id as u64, cb);
        pose(7.0).encode_full(&c, &mut w).unwrap();
        send(&mut room, a, w);
        let spawned = room
            .frame
            .entities()
            .find(|e| e.owner == Some(a) && Some(e.id) != room.avatars[&a])
            .unwrap()
            .id;
        assert_eq!(room.frame.get(spawned, "Pose"), Some(&pose(7.0)));

        // b does not own it: the write is ignored
        let mut w = net_wire::BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bits(OPS_MARKER as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(1, 8);
        w.write_bits(OP_WRITE as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(spawned.to_u64(), 48);
        w.write_bits(1, 8);
        w.write_bits(c.id as u64, cb);
        pose(9.0).encode_full(&c, &mut w).unwrap();
        send(&mut room, b, w);
        assert_eq!(room.frame.get(spawned, "Pose"), Some(&pose(7.0)));

        // a hands it to b; b writes and despawns it
        let mut w = net_wire::BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bits(OPS_MARKER as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(1, 8);
        w.write_bits(OP_TRANSFER as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(spawned.to_u64(), 48);
        w.write_bits(2, 16);
        send(&mut room, a, w);
        assert_eq!(room.frame.entity_mut(spawned).unwrap().owner, Some(b));
        let mut w = net_wire::BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bits(OPS_MARKER as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(2, 8);
        w.write_bits(OP_WRITE as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(spawned.to_u64(), 48);
        w.write_bits(1, 8);
        w.write_bits(c.id as u64, cb);
        pose(9.0).encode_full(&c, &mut w).unwrap();
        w.write_bits(OP_DESPAWN as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(spawned.to_u64(), 48);
        send(&mut room, b, w);
        assert!(room.frame.entity_mut(spawned).is_none());

        // transfer to an actor that is not in the room is refused; avatars cannot be despawned
        let av = room.avatars[&a].unwrap();
        let mut w = net_wire::BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bits(OPS_MARKER as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(2, 8);
        w.write_bits(OP_TRANSFER as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(av.to_u64(), 48);
        w.write_bits(77, 16);
        w.write_bits(OP_DESPAWN as u64, 8);
        w.write_bits(av.to_u64(), 48);
        send(&mut room, a, w);
        assert_eq!(room.frame.entity_mut(av).unwrap().owner, Some(a));

        // the cap holds and leaving despawns everything the actor owns
        for _ in 0..MAX_OWNED + 2 {
            let mut w = net_wire::BitWriter::new();
            w.write_bits(OPS_MARKER as u64, 8);
            w.write_bits(1, 8);
            w.write_bits(OP_SPAWN as u64, 8);
            w.write_bits(0, 8);
            send(&mut room, a, w);
        }
        let owned = room.frame.entities().filter(|e| e.owner == Some(a)).count();
        assert_eq!(owned, MAX_OWNED);
        room.on_leave(a);
        assert_eq!(
            room.frame.entities().filter(|e| e.owner == Some(a)).count(),
            0
        );
        assert_eq!(room.frame.entities().count(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn input_frames_are_rate_limited_per_actor() {
        let mut room = SyncRoom::new(None, 60, 1).unwrap();
        let a = ActorId(1);
        room.on_join(a);
        let frame = SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(1), &[vec![1, 0, 0]]);
        for _ in 0..20 {
            room.handle(a, frame.clone());
        }
        assert_eq!(room.take_input_stats(), (20 - INPUT_BURST as u64, 0));
        let _ = room.tick();
        assert!(room.handle(a, frame.clone()));
        assert!(room.handle(a, frame.clone()));
        assert_eq!(room.take_input_stats(), (1, 0));
        let far = SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(1000), &[vec![1, 0, 0]]);
        let _ = room.tick();
        room.handle(a, far);
        assert_eq!(room.take_input_stats(), (0, 1));
    }

    #[test]
    fn spectator_sees_everything_and_cannot_move() {
        let mut room = SyncRoom::new(None, 60, 3).unwrap();
        let (a, w) = (ActorId(1), ActorId(9));
        room.on_join(a);
        room.on_join_as(w, true);
        assert_eq!(room.avatars.len(), 1);
        room.handle(w, SyncRoom::encode_input(Tick(0), &[vec![127, 0, 0]]));
        let out = room.tick();
        let to_w = out
            .iter()
            .find(|(x, _)| *x == w)
            .map(|(_, d)| d.len())
            .unwrap();
        assert!(to_w > 12, "spectator got a delta with the avatar");
        assert_eq!(room.frame.entity_count(), 1);
    }
}

`crates/net-api/src/webhooks.rs`:

```rs
//! Webhook delivery: events are queued from the hot path and POSTed by one worker per node.
//! Body is JSON; `X-Aurix-Event` names the event, `X-Aurix-Signature: sha256=<hex>` is
//! HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the webhook secret. Three attempts with backoff.
//! After a secret rotation `X-Aurix-Signature-Previous` carries the old secret's signature
//! until the grace period ends, so receivers can switch without dropping events.

use hmac::{Hmac, KeyInit, Mac};
use net_common::ipnet::is_public_ip;
use net_common::NetError;
use net_common::ProjectId;
use net_db::{queries, DbPool};
use sha2::Sha256;
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use uuid::Uuid;

/// Every event a webhook can subscribe to (`events: []` means all). Kept in sync with docs/webhooks.md.
pub const EVENTS: &[&str] = &[
    "join.validate",
    "room.created",
    "room.closed",
    "room.rehosted",
    "player.joined",
    "player.left",
    "match.found",
    "rpc",
    "test",
];

/// Fleet-level alerts delivered to operator webhooks (`/v1/operator/webhooks`). Each fires at
/// most once per hour per subject while the condition persists.
pub const OPERATOR_EVENTS: &[&str] = &[
    "node.stale",
    "node.draining",
    "project.suspended",
    "project.usage_cap",
    "project.rejections",
    "webhook.failing",
    "test",
];

pub fn validate_operator_events(events: &[String]) -> Result<(), NetError> {
    for e in events {
        if !OPERATOR_EVENTS.contains(&e.as_str()) {
            return Err(NetError::Invalid(format!(
                "events: unknown event {e:?}; known: {}",
                OPERATOR_EVENTS.join(", ")
            )));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Registration-time check so a typo (`room.create`) does not silently subscribe to nothing.
pub fn validate_events(events: &[String]) -> Result<(), NetError> {
    if events.len() > EVENTS.len() {
        return Err(NetError::Invalid("events: too many entries".into()));
    }
    for e in events {
        if !EVENTS.contains(&e.as_str()) {
            return Err(NetError::Invalid(format!(
                "events: unknown event {e:?}; known: {}",
                EVENTS.join(", ")
            )));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct WebhookEvent {
    pub project: ProjectId,
    pub event: &'static str,
    pub payload: serde_json::Value,
    /// Set for test sends: deliver to this webhook only, ignoring its event filter.
    pub only: Option<Uuid>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Dispatcher {
    tx: mpsc::Sender<WebhookEvent>,
    /// Projects whose hook list changed (e.g. secret rotation): the worker drops its cache for them.
    dirty: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<HashSet<ProjectId>>>,
    /// Hooks subscribed to `join.validate`, per project (30 s cache, dropped on `invalidate`).
    validators: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<HashMap<ProjectId, Cached>>>,
    /// Hooks subscribed to `rpc`, per project (same caching).
    rpc_hooks: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<HashMap<ProjectId, Cached>>>,
    pool: Option<DbPool>,
    http: reqwest::Client,
    allow_private: bool,
}

/// Answer of a synchronous `join.validate` webhook.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum JoinVerdict {
    /// No validator configured, or the receiver allowed the join.
    Allow,
    /// The receiver answered `{"allow": false}`; `reason` goes back to the client.
    Deny(String),
    /// The receiver was unreachable or answered badly: the join is refused (fail closed).
    Unavailable(String),
}

const VALIDATE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);
/// `rpc` calls: the endpoint has 5 s and may answer at most 16 KiB of JSON.
pub const RPC_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
pub const RPC_MAX_RESPONSE: usize = 16 * 1024;

/// Answer of a client-initiated `rpc` call.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct RpcOutcome {
    pub ok: bool,
    pub status: Option<u16>,
    pub body: serde_json::Value,
    pub error: Option<String>,
}
impl RpcOutcome {
    fn failed(status: Option<u16>, error: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            ok: false,
            status,
            body: serde_json::Value::Null,
            error: Some(error.into()),
        }
    }
}

impl Dispatcher {
    /// Starts the worker; returns the handle used to enqueue events.
    /// `allow_private`: development only — lets webhooks target loopback/private addresses.
    pub fn start(pool: DbPool, allow_private: bool) -> Self {
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel(4096);
        let dirty = Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(HashSet::new()));
        tokio::spawn(worker(pool.clone(), rx, allow_private, dirty.clone()));
        Self {
            tx,
            dirty,
            validators: Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),
            rpc_hooks: Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),
            pool: Some(pool),
            http: validate_client(),
            allow_private,
        }
    }

    /// For tests and tools without a database: events are dropped.
    pub fn noop() -> Self {
        let (tx, _rx) = mpsc::channel(1);
        Self {
            tx,
            dirty: Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(HashSet::new())),
            validators: Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),
            rpc_hooks: Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),
            pool: None,
            http: validate_client(),
            allow_private: true,
        }
    }

    /// Call after a project's webhooks change so the next event reloads them from the database.
    pub fn invalidate(&self, project: ProjectId) {
        if let Ok(mut d) = self.dirty.lock() {
            d.insert(project);
        }
        if let Ok(mut v) = self.validators.lock() {
            v.remove(&project);
        }
        if let Ok(mut v) = self.rpc_hooks.lock() {
            v.remove(&project);
        }
    }

    /// Synchronous pre-join check (fine-grained validation): every webhook of the
    /// project subscribed to `join.validate` is POSTed `payload` and must answer 2xx with
    /// `{"allow": true}` (or an empty body) within 2 s; `{"allow": false, "reason": "..."}` refuses
    /// the join with that reason. Receiver down or non-2xx = refused (fail closed), so only
    /// subscribe a validator you can keep up. Each call lands in the delivery log.
    pub async fn validate_join(
        &self,
        project: ProjectId,
        payload: serde_json::Value,
    ) -> JoinVerdict {
        let Some(pool) = &self.pool else {
            return JoinVerdict::Allow;
        };
        let hooks = match self.validator_hooks(pool, project).await {
            Ok(h) => h,
            Err(e) => return JoinVerdict::Unavailable(format!("validator lookup failed: {e}")),
        };
        if hooks.is_empty() {
            return JoinVerdict::Allow;
        }
        let body = serde_json::json!({
            "event": "join.validate",
            "project": project.to_string(),
            "at": chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
            "data": payload,
        })
        .to_string();
        for h in hooks {
            let started = Instant::now();
            let (verdict, outcome) = self.ask(&h, &body).await;
            let latency_ms = started.elapsed().as_millis().min(i32::MAX as u128) as i32;
            let d = queries::NewDelivery {
                webhook_id: h.id,
                project_id: project.0,
                event: "join.validate",
                ok: outcome.ok,
                status: outcome.status,
                attempts: outcome.attempts,
                latency_ms,
                error: outcome.error.as_deref(),
            };
            if let Err(e) = queries::insert_webhook_delivery(pool, &d).await {
                tracing::warn!(error = %e, "webhook delivery log");
            }
            if verdict != JoinVerdict::Allow {
                return verdict;
            }
        }
        JoinVerdict::Allow
    }

    async fn validator_hooks(
        &self,
        pool: &DbPool,
        project: ProjectId,
    ) -> net_common::Result<Vec<Hook>> {
        self.hooks_for(pool, project, "join.validate", &self.validators)
            .await
    }
    /// Enabled hooks of `project` subscribed to `event`, cached 30 s (dropped on `invalidate`).
    async fn hooks_for(
        &self,
        pool: &DbPool,
        project: ProjectId,
        event: &str,
        cache: &std::sync::Mutex<HashMap<ProjectId, Cached>>,
    ) -> net_common::Result<Vec<Hook>> {
        if let Ok(v) = cache.lock() {
            if let Some(c) = v.get(&project) {
                if c.at.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(30) {
                    return Ok(c.hooks.clone());
                }
            }
        }
        let hooks: Vec<Hook> = queries::list_webhooks(pool, project.0)
            .await?
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|r| r.enabled && r.events.iter().any(|e| e == event))
            .map(|r| Hook {
                id: r.id,
                url: r.url,
                secret: r.secret,
                previous: r.previous_secret.filter(|_| {
                    r.previous_secret_expires_at
                        .is_some_and(|t| t > chrono::Utc::now())
                }),
                events: r.events,
            })
            .collect();
        if let Ok(mut v) = cache.lock() {
            v.insert(
                project,
                Cached {
                    at: Instant::now(),
                    hooks: hooks.clone(),
                },
            );
        }
        Ok(hooks)
    }
    /// Client-initiated call into the game's backend (WebRPC): the first webhook of the
    /// project subscribed to `rpc` is POSTed `payload`; its JSON answer (≤ 16 KiB, within 5 s)
    /// goes back to the caller. One attempt — RPCs are not assumed idempotent. Lands in the
    /// delivery log like every other webhook call.
    pub async fn rpc(&self, project: ProjectId, payload: serde_json::Value) -> RpcOutcome {
        let Some(pool) = &self.pool else {
            return RpcOutcome::failed(None, "rpc: no database");
        };
        let hooks = match self.hooks_for(pool, project, "rpc", &self.rpc_hooks).await {
            Ok(h) => h,
            Err(e) => return RpcOutcome::failed(None, format!("rpc endpoint lookup failed: {e}")),
        };
        let Some(h) = hooks.first() else {
            return RpcOutcome::failed(None, "no webhook subscribed to `rpc`");
        };
        let body = serde_json::json!({
            "event": "rpc",
            "project": project.to_string(),
            "at": chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
            "data": payload,
        })
        .to_string();
        let started = Instant::now();
        let out = self.call_rpc(h, &body).await;
        let d = queries::NewDelivery {
            webhook_id: h.id,
            project_id: project.0,
            event: "rpc",
            ok: out.ok,
            status: out.status.map(|s| s as i16),
            attempts: 1,
            latency_ms: started.elapsed().as_millis().min(i32::MAX as u128) as i32,
            error: out.error.as_deref(),
        };
        if let Err(e) = queries::insert_webhook_delivery(pool, &d).await {
            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "webhook delivery log");
        }
        out
    }
    async fn call_rpc(&self, h: &Hook, body: &str) -> RpcOutcome {
        if !self.allow_private
            && (validate_webhook_url(&h.url, false).is_err() || !resolves_public(&h.url).await)
        {
            return RpcOutcome::failed(None, "target is not a public host");
        }
        let mut req = self
            .http
            .post(&h.url)
            .timeout(RPC_TIMEOUT)
            .header("content-type", "application/json")
            .header("x-aurix-event", "rpc")
            .header("x-aurix-signature", sign(&h.secret, body.as_bytes()));
        if let Some(p) = &h.previous {
            req = req.header("x-aurix-signature-previous", sign(p, body.as_bytes()));
        }
        let mut resp = match req.body(body.to_string()).send().await {
            Ok(r) => r,
            Err(e) => return RpcOutcome::failed(None, format!("rpc endpoint: {e}")),
        };
        let status = resp.status().as_u16();
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        loop {
            match resp.chunk().await {
                Ok(Some(c)) => {
                    buf.extend_from_slice(&c);
                    if buf.len() > RPC_MAX_RESPONSE {
                        return RpcOutcome::failed(Some(status), "rpc answer too large");
                    }
                }
                Ok(None) => break,
                Err(e) => return RpcOutcome::failed(Some(status), format!("rpc endpoint: {e}")),
            }
        }
        let body = if buf.iter().all(u8::is_ascii_whitespace) {
            serde_json::Value::Null
        } else {
            match serde_json::from_slice(&buf) {
                Ok(v) => v,
                Err(_) => {
                    return RpcOutcome::failed(Some(status), "rpc endpoint answered non-JSON")
                }
            }
        };
        RpcOutcome {
            ok: (200..300).contains(&status),
            status: Some(status),
            body,
            error: None,
        }
    }
    async fn ask(&self, h: &Hook, body: &str) -> (JoinVerdict, Outcome) {
        if !self.allow_private
            && (validate_webhook_url(&h.url, false).is_err() || !resolves_public(&h.url).await)
        {
            let msg = "target is not a public host".to_string();
            return (
                JoinVerdict::Unavailable(msg.clone()),
                Outcome {
                    ok: false,
                    status: None,
                    attempts: 0,
                    error: Some(msg),
                },
            );
        }
        let mut req = self
            .http
            .post(&h.url)
            .header("content-type", "application/json")
            .header("x-aurix-event", "join.validate")
            .header("x-aurix-signature", sign(&h.secret, body.as_bytes()));
        if let Some(p) = &h.previous {
            req = req.header("x-aurix-signature-previous", sign(p, body.as_bytes()));
        }
        match req.body(body.to_string()).send().await {
            Ok(resp) => {
                let status = resp.status();
                let code = Some(status.as_u16() as i16);
                if !status.is_success() {
                    let msg = format!("validator answered {status}");
                    return (
                        JoinVerdict::Unavailable(msg.clone()),
                        Outcome {
                            ok: false,
                            status: code,
                            attempts: 1,
                            error: Some(msg),
                        },
                    );
                }
                let text = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
                let v: serde_json::Value = if text.trim().is_empty() {
                    serde_json::json!({"allow": true})
                } else {
                    match serde_json::from_str(&text) {
                        Ok(v) => v,
                        Err(_) => {
                            let msg = "validator answered non-JSON".to_string();
                            return (
                                JoinVerdict::Unavailable(msg.clone()),
                                Outcome {
                                    ok: false,
                                    status: code,
                                    attempts: 1,
                                    error: Some(msg),
                                },
                            );
                        }
                    }
                };
                let allow = v.get("allow").and_then(|a| a.as_bool()).unwrap_or(true);
                let ok = Outcome {
                    ok: true,
                    status: code,
                    attempts: 1,
                    error: None,
                };
                if allow {
                    (JoinVerdict::Allow, ok)
                } else {
                    let reason = v
                        .get("reason")
                        .and_then(|r| r.as_str())
                        .unwrap_or("rejected by validator")
                        .chars()
                        .take(200)
                        .collect::<String>();
                    (JoinVerdict::Deny(reason), ok)
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                let msg = describe_err(&e);
                (
                    JoinVerdict::Unavailable(msg.clone()),
                    Outcome {
                        ok: false,
                        status: None,
                        attempts: 1,
                        error: Some(msg),
                    },
                )
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn emit(&self, project: ProjectId, event: &'static str, payload: serde_json::Value) {
        let _ = self.tx.try_send(WebhookEvent {
            project,
            event,
            payload,
            only: None,
        });
    }

    /// Sends a `test` event to one webhook only (ignores its event filter); the outcome lands in
    /// the delivery log like any other emission.
    /// Fleet-level alert: delivered to operator webhooks, `project` is null in the body.
    pub fn emit_fleet(&self, event: &'static str, payload: serde_json::Value) {
        self.emit(ProjectId::from_uuid(Uuid::nil()), event, payload);
    }

    pub fn test_fleet(&self, webhook: Uuid) {
        self.test(ProjectId::from_uuid(Uuid::nil()), webhook);
    }

    pub fn test(&self, project: ProjectId, webhook: Uuid) {
        let _ = self.tx.try_send(WebhookEvent {
            project,
            event: "test",
            payload: serde_json::json!({"webhook": webhook}),
            only: Some(webhook),
        });
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Hook {
    id: Uuid,
    url: String,
    secret: String,
    /// Previous secret while its grace period lasts: deliveries carry a second signature.
    previous: Option<String>,
    events: Vec<String>,
}

struct Cached {
    at: Instant,
    hooks: Vec<Hook>,
}

/// Rejects URLs a tenant must not make the node call: non-http(s), credentials in the URL,
/// loopback/private/link-local hosts (literal or well-known names). Outside development
/// plain `http://` is refused too.
pub fn validate_webhook_url(url: &str, allow_private: bool) -> net_common::Result<()> {
    let u = reqwest::Url::parse(url).map_err(|e| NetError::Invalid(format!("url: {e}")))?;
    match u.scheme() {
        "https" => {}
        "http" if allow_private => {}
        "http" => return Err(NetError::Invalid("url must be https".into())),
        _ => return Err(NetError::Invalid("url must be http(s)".into())),
    }
    if !u.username().is_empty() || u.password().is_some() {
        return Err(NetError::Invalid("url must not carry credentials".into()));
    }
    let Some(host) = u.host_str() else {
        return Err(NetError::Invalid("url has no host".into()));
    };
    if allow_private {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let literal = host.trim_start_matches('[').trim_end_matches(']');
    let blocked = match literal.parse::<std::net::IpAddr>() {
        Ok(ip) => !is_public_ip(ip),
        Err(_) => {
            let d = host.trim_end_matches('.').to_ascii_lowercase();
            d == "localhost"
                || d.ends_with(".localhost")
                || d.ends_with(".local")
                || d.ends_with(".internal")
                || d.ends_with(".arpa")
                || !d.contains('.')
        }
    };
    if blocked {
        return Err(NetError::Invalid("url must point at a public host".into()));
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Resolves the host right before sending and refuses private answers (DNS rebinding).
async fn resolves_public(url: &str) -> bool {
    let Ok(u) = reqwest::Url::parse(url) else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some(host) = u
        .host_str()
        .map(|h| h.trim_start_matches('[').trim_end_matches(']').to_string())
    else {
        return false;
    };
    let port = u.port_or_known_default().unwrap_or(443);
    let target = format!("{host}:{port}");
    match tokio::net::lookup_host(target).await {
        Ok(addrs) => {
            let v: Vec<_> = addrs.collect();
            !v.is_empty() && v.iter().all(|a| is_public_ip(a.ip()))
        }
        Err(_) => false,
    }
}

async fn worker(
    pool: DbPool,
    mut rx: mpsc::Receiver<WebhookEvent>,
    allow_private: bool,
    dirty: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<HashSet<ProjectId>>>,
) {
    let http = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
        .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
        .build()
        .expect("reqwest");
    let mut cache: HashMap<ProjectId, Cached> = HashMap::new();
    while let Some(ev) = rx.recv().await {
        if dirty
            .lock()
            .map(|mut d| d.remove(&ev.project))
            .unwrap_or(false)
        {
            cache.remove(&ev.project);
        }
        let hooks = match cache.get(&ev.project) {
            Some(c) if c.at.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(30) && ev.only.is_none() => {
                c.hooks.clone()
            }
            _ => {
                let hooks: Vec<Hook> = if ev.project.0.is_nil() {
                    queries::list_operator_webhooks(&pool)
                        .await
                        .unwrap_or_default()
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|r| Hook {
                            id: r.id,
                            url: r.url,
                            secret: r.secret,
                            previous: None,
                            events: r.events,
                        })
                        .collect()
                } else {
                    queries::list_webhooks(&pool, ev.project.0)
                        .await
                        .unwrap_or_default()
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|r| Hook {
                            id: r.id,
                            url: r.url,
                            secret: r.secret,
                            previous: r.previous_secret.filter(|_| {
                                r.previous_secret_expires_at
                                    .is_some_and(|t| t > chrono::Utc::now())
                            }),
                            events: r.events,
                        })
                        .collect()
                };
                cache.insert(
                    ev.project,
                    Cached {
                        at: Instant::now(),
                        hooks: hooks.clone(),
                    },
                );
                hooks
            }
        };
        if hooks.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let project_field = if ev.project.0.is_nil() {
            serde_json::Value::Null
        } else {
            serde_json::Value::String(ev.project.to_string())
        };
        let body = serde_json::json!({
            "event": ev.event,
            "project": project_field,
            "at": chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
            "data": ev.payload,
        })
        .to_string();
        for Hook {
            id,
            url,
            secret,
            previous,
            events,
        } in hooks
        {
            match ev.only {
                Some(only) if only != id => continue,
                Some(_) => {}
                None if !events.is_empty() && !events.iter().any(|e| e == ev.event || e == "*") => {
                    continue
                }
                None => {}
            }
            let http = http.clone();
            let pool = pool.clone();
            let body = body.clone();
            let sig = sign(&secret, body.as_bytes());
            let sig_prev = previous.map(|p| sign(&p, body.as_bytes()));
            let event = ev.event;
            let project = ev.project.0;
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let started = Instant::now();
                let outcome = deliver(
                    &http,
                    &url,
                    event,
                    &sig,
                    sig_prev.as_deref(),
                    &body,
                    allow_private,
                )
                .await;
                let latency_ms = started.elapsed().as_millis().min(i32::MAX as u128) as i32;
                if project.is_nil() {
                    let d = queries::NewOperatorDelivery {
                        webhook_id: id,
                        event,
                        ok: outcome.ok,
                        status: outcome.status,
                        attempts: outcome.attempts,
                        latency_ms,
                        error: outcome.error.as_deref(),
                    };
                    if let Err(e) = queries::insert_operator_webhook_delivery(&pool, &d).await {
                        tracing::warn!(error = %e, "operator webhook delivery log");
                    }
                    return;
                }
                let d = queries::NewDelivery {
                    webhook_id: id,
                    project_id: project,
                    event,
                    ok: outcome.ok,
                    status: outcome.status,
                    attempts: outcome.attempts,
                    latency_ms,
                    error: outcome.error.as_deref(),
                };
                if let Err(e) = queries::insert_webhook_delivery(&pool, &d).await {
                    tracing::warn!(error = %e, "webhook delivery log");
                }
            });
        }
    }
}

fn validate_client() -> reqwest::Client {
    reqwest::Client::builder()
        .timeout(VALIDATE_TIMEOUT)
        .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
        .build()
        .expect("reqwest")
}

struct Outcome {
    ok: bool,
    status: Option<i16>,
    attempts: i16,
    error: Option<String>,
}

/// Up to three attempts with backoff; 4xx stops early (the receiver rejected it on purpose).
async fn deliver(
    http: &reqwest::Client,
    url: &str,
    event: &str,
    sig: &str,
    sig_prev: Option<&str>,
    body: &str,
    allow_private: bool,
) -> Outcome {
    if !allow_private && (validate_webhook_url(url, false).is_err() || !resolves_public(url).await)
    {
        tracing::warn!(%url, "webhook target is not a public host; skipped");
        return Outcome {
            ok: false,
            status: None,
            attempts: 0,
            error: Some("target is not a public host".into()),
        };
    }
    let mut last_err = None;
    let mut status = None;
    for attempt in 0..3u32 {
        let mut req = http
            .post(url)
            .header("content-type", "application/json")
            .header("x-aurix-event", event)
            .header("x-aurix-signature", sig);
        if let Some(p) = sig_prev {
            req = req.header("x-aurix-signature-previous", p);
        }
        let r = req.body(body.to_string()).send().await;
        match r {
            Ok(resp) if resp.status().is_success() => {
                return Outcome {
                    ok: true,
                    status: Some(resp.status().as_u16() as i16),
                    attempts: attempt as i16 + 1,
                    error: None,
                };
            }
            Ok(resp) if resp.status().is_client_error() => {
                tracing::debug!(%url, status = %resp.status(), "webhook rejected");
                return Outcome {
                    ok: false,
                    status: Some(resp.status().as_u16() as i16),
                    attempts: attempt as i16 + 1,
                    error: Some(format!("receiver answered {}", resp.status())),
                };
            }
            Ok(resp) => {
                status = Some(resp.status().as_u16() as i16);
                last_err = Some(format!("receiver answered {}", resp.status()));
            }
            Err(e) => {
                status = None;
                last_err = Some(describe_err(&e));
            }
        }
        if attempt < 2 {
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500 * (1 << attempt))).await;
        }
    }
    tracing::debug!(%url, event, "webhook gave up");
    Outcome {
        ok: false,
        status,
        attempts: 3,
        error: last_err,
    }
}

/// reqwest's top-level message is just "error sending request"; the useful part (connection
/// refused, timeout, TLS) is in the source chain. URLs are dropped so query strings never land
/// in the log.
fn describe_err(e: &reqwest::Error) -> String {
    let mut parts = Vec::new();
    let mut cur: Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> = Some(e);
    while let Some(err) = cur {
        let msg = err.to_string();
        let msg = msg
            .split(" for url ")
            .next()
            .unwrap_or(&msg)
            .trim()
            .to_string();
        if !msg.is_empty() && !parts.contains(&msg) {
            parts.push(msg);
        }
        cur = err.source();
    }
    let joined = if e.is_timeout() {
        "timeout".to_string()
    } else {
        parts.join(": ")
    };
    joined.chars().take(200).collect()
}

pub fn sign(secret: &str, body: &[u8]) -> String {
    let mut mac = Hmac::<Sha256>::new_from_slice(secret.as_bytes()).expect("hmac key");
    mac.update(body);
    format!("sha256={}", hex::encode(mac.finalize().into_bytes()))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// One-shot HTTP server on loopback answering `status` + `body`; returns its URL and the
    /// request it received.
    async fn one_shot(
        status: u16,
        body: Vec<u8>,
    ) -> (String, tokio::sync::oneshot::Receiver<String>) {
        use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
        let l = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let url = format!("http://{}/rpc", l.local_addr().unwrap());
        let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let (mut s, _) = l.accept().await.unwrap();
            let mut buf = vec![0u8; 64 * 1024];
            let mut got = Vec::new();
            loop {
                let n = s.read(&mut buf).await.unwrap();
                got.extend_from_slice(&buf[..n]);
                let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&got).to_string();
                if let Some(h) = text.find("\r\n\r\n") {
                    let len = text[..h]
                        .lines()
                        .find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("content-length: "))
                        .and_then(|v| v.trim().parse::<usize>().ok())
                        .unwrap_or(0);
                    if got.len() >= h + 4 + len || n == 0 {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if n == 0 {
                    break;
                }
            }
            let _ = tx.send(String::from_utf8_lossy(&got).to_string());
            let head = format!(
                "HTTP/1.1 {status} X\r\ncontent-type: application/json\r\ncontent-length: {}\r\nconnection: close\r\n\r\n",
                body.len()
            );
            let _ = s.write_all(head.as_bytes()).await;
            let _ = s.write_all(&body).await;
            let _ = s.shutdown().await;
        });
        (url, rx)
    }

    fn hook(url: String) -> Hook {
        Hook {
            id: Uuid::nil(),
            url,
            secret: "s3".into(),
            previous: None,
            events: vec!["rpc".into()],
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn rpc_call_is_signed_and_answer_comes_back() {
        let d = Dispatcher::noop();
        let (url, rx) = one_shot(200, br#"{"echo": 42}"#.to_vec()).await;
        let body = r#"{"event":"rpc","data":{"name":"echo"}}"#;
        let out = d.call_rpc(&hook(url), body).await;
        assert_eq!(out.status, Some(200));
        assert!(out.ok, "{out:?}");
        assert_eq!(out.body["echo"], 42);
        let req = rx.await.unwrap();
        assert!(req.starts_with("POST /rpc HTTP/1.1"));
        assert!(req.contains("x-aurix-event: rpc"));
        assert!(req.contains(&format!(
            "x-aurix-signature: {}",
            sign("s3", body.as_bytes())
        )));
        assert!(req.ends_with(body));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn rpc_non_2xx_non_json_and_oversize_are_reported() {
        let d = Dispatcher::noop();
        let (url, _rx) = one_shot(404, br#"{"error":"nope"}"#.to_vec()).await;
        let out = d.call_rpc(&hook(url), "{}").await;
        assert!(!out.ok && out.status == Some(404) && out.body["error"] == "nope");
        let (url, _rx) = one_shot(200, b"<html>".to_vec()).await;
        let out = d.call_rpc(&hook(url), "{}").await;
        assert!(!out.ok && out.error.as_deref() == Some("rpc endpoint answered non-JSON"));
        let (url, _rx) = one_shot(200, vec![b' '; RPC_MAX_RESPONSE + 1]).await;
        let out = d.call_rpc(&hook(url), "{}").await;
        assert!(!out.ok && out.error.as_deref() == Some("rpc answer too large"));
        let out = d
            .call_rpc(&hook("http://127.0.0.1:9/rpc".into()), "{}")
            .await;
        assert!(!out.ok && out.status.is_none());
        assert!(d
            .rpc(ProjectId(Uuid::nil()), serde_json::json!({}))
            .await
            .error
            .is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn signature_is_stable() {
        let s = super::sign("secret", b"{}");
        assert!(s.starts_with("sha256="));
        assert_eq!(s.len(), 7 + 64);
        assert_eq!(s, super::sign("secret", b"{}"));
        assert_ne!(s, super::sign("other", b"{}"));
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod ssrf_tests {
    use super::validate_webhook_url;
    #[test]
    fn ssrf_guard() {
        for bad in [
            "http://example.com/hook",
            "https://127.0.0.1/hook",
            "https://10.1.2.3/x",
            "https://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data",
            "https://[::1]/x",
            "https://[fd00::1]/x",
            "https://localhost/x",
            "https://db.internal/x",
            "https://router/x",
            "https://user:pw@example.com/x",
            "ftp://example.com/x",
        ] {
            assert!(validate_webhook_url(bad, false).is_err(), "{bad}");
        }
        assert!(validate_webhook_url("https://hooks.example.com/aurix", false).is_ok());
        assert!(validate_webhook_url("http://127.0.0.1:9000/dev", true).is_ok());
    }
}

```

`crates/net-api/src/ws.rs`:

```rs
//! Control channel: one WebSocket per client. Text frames are JSON [`ClientMsg`]/[`ServerMsg`],
//! binary frames are tunnelled data-path datagrams (first one is the data ticket).

use crate::host::{dispatch, handle_data_frame, Attached, DataSession, DataSink, HostedRoom};
use crate::state::Shared;
use axum::extract::ws::{Message, WebSocket, WebSocketUpgrade};
use axum::extract::State;
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};
use base64::Engine;
use bytes::Bytes;
use futures::{SinkExt, StreamExt};
use net_auth::Grant;
use net_common::{ActorId, NetError, ProjectId, Result, RoomId, RoomMode, SessionId};
use net_control::redis_store::LiveRoom;
use net_control::ProjectLimits;
use net_db::queries;
use net_rooms::protocol::{ClientMsg, DataEndpoint, RoomSummary, ServerMsg};
use net_rooms::{EventFrame, Room, RoomConfig, RoomError};
use parking_lot::Mutex;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{Map, Value};
use std::future::Future;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tokio::sync::mpsc;

const IDLE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(90);
/// A connection that has not authenticated within this window is dropped.
const AUTH_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
/// Largest text frame accepted before `auth` succeeded (a grant is ~1 KB).
const PRE_AUTH_MAX_TEXT: usize = 8 * 1024;
const B64: base64::engine::GeneralPurpose = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD;

pub async fn ws_handler(
    ws: WebSocketUpgrade,
    State(st): State<Shared>,
    ip: Option<axum::Extension<crate::ratelimit::ClientIp>>,
) -> Response {
    let ip = ip
        .map(|e| e.0 .0)
        .unwrap_or(std::net::IpAddr::V4(std::net::Ipv4Addr::UNSPECIFIED));
    if st.is_draining() {
        return (axum::http::StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "node draining").into_response();
    }
    if !st.guards.ws_connects.allow(ip) || !st.guards.acquire_session(ip) {
        st.metrics.errors.with_label_values(&["rate_limited"]).inc();
        return (
            axum::http::StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
            "too many connections",
        )
            .into_response();
    }
    ws.max_message_size(net_common::limits::MAX_MESSAGE + 4096)
        .on_upgrade(move |socket| async move {
            run(socket, st.clone(), ip).await;
            st.guards.release_session(ip);
        })
}

struct InRoom {
    id: RoomId,
    actor: ActorId,
    hosted: Arc<Mutex<HostedRoom>>,
}

struct Session {
    st: Shared,
    id: SessionId,
    ctl: mpsc::Sender<ServerMsg>,
    bin: mpsc::Sender<Bytes>,
    grant: Option<Grant>,
    room: Option<InRoom>,
    data: Option<Arc<DataSession>>,
    lobby: Option<ProjectId>,
    ip: std::net::IpAddr,
    /// Last `stats` / `find_friends` (fleet fan-out): at most one per second.
    last_lookup: Option<Instant>,
    /// `rpc` token bucket: `RPC_RATE` per second, burst `RPC_BURST`.
    rpc_tokens: f32,
    rpc_at: Instant,
}

const RPC_RATE: f32 = 5.0;
const RPC_BURST: f32 = 10.0;
const RPC_MAX_BODY: usize = 8 * 1024;

async fn run(socket: WebSocket, st: Shared, ip: std::net::IpAddr) {
    st.metrics.control_sessions.inc();
    let (mut sink, mut stream) = socket.split();
    let (ctl_tx, mut ctl_rx) = mpsc::channel::<ServerMsg>(512);
    let (bin_tx, mut bin_rx) = mpsc::channel::<Bytes>(2048);
    let writer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        loop {
            tokio::select! {
                m = ctl_rx.recv() => match m {
                    Some(m) => {
                        let txt = serde_json::to_string(&m).unwrap_or_default();
                        if sink.send(Message::Text(txt.into())).await.is_err() { break; }
                    }
                    None => break,
                },
                b = bin_rx.recv() => match b {
                    Some(b) => if sink.send(Message::Binary(b)).await.is_err() { break; },
                    None => break,
                },
            }
        }
        let _ = sink.close().await;
    });

    let mut sess = Session {
        st: st.clone(),
        id: SessionId::new(),
        ctl: ctl_tx,
        bin: bin_tx,
        grant: None,
        room: None,
        data: None,
        lobby: None,
        ip,
        last_lookup: None,
        rpc_tokens: RPC_BURST,
        rpc_at: Instant::now(),
    };
    let _ = sess.ctl.try_send(ServerMsg::Hello {
        session: sess.id.to_string(),
        version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
        region: st.region.to_string(),
    });

    loop {
        let limit = if sess.grant.is_some() {
            IDLE_TIMEOUT
        } else {
            AUTH_TIMEOUT
        };
        let next = tokio::time::timeout(limit, stream.next()).await;
        let msg = match next {
            Err(_) => break,
            Ok(None) => break,
            Ok(Some(Err(_))) => break,
            Ok(Some(Ok(m))) => m,
        };
        match msg {
            Message::Text(t) if sess.grant.is_none() && t.len() > PRE_AUTH_MAX_TEXT => {
                sess.error(NetError::Invalid("message too large before auth".into()));
                break;
            }
            Message::Text(t) => match serde_json::from_str::<ClientMsg>(&t) {
                Ok(m) => {
                    if let Err(e) = sess.handle(m).await {
                        let fatal = matches!(e, NetError::RateLimited);
                        sess.error(e);
                        if fatal {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => sess.error(NetError::Invalid(format!("bad message: {e}"))),
            },
            Message::Binary(b) => {
                if let Err(e) = sess.on_binary(b) {
                    sess.error(e);
                }
            }
            Message::Close(_) => break,
            Message::Ping(_) | Message::Pong(_) => {}
        }
    }
    sess.cleanup().await;
    writer.abort();
    st.metrics.control_sessions.dec();
}

impl Session {
    fn error(&self, e: NetError) {
        self.st.metrics.errors.with_label_values(&[e.code()]).inc();
        let _ = self.ctl.try_send(ServerMsg::Error {
            code: e.code().to_string(),
            message: e.to_string(),
        });
    }

    fn grant(&self) -> Result<&Grant> {
        self.grant
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| NetError::Unauthorized("send auth first".into()))
    }

    fn in_room(&self) -> Result<&InRoom> {
        self.room
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| NetError::Invalid("not in a room".into()))
    }

    /// False once another session of the same player took over this room slot.
    fn owns_slot(&self, h: &HostedRoom, actor: ActorId) -> bool {
        h.sessions.get(&actor).is_some_and(|a| a.session == self.id)
    }

    fn replaced(&mut self) -> NetError {
        self.room = None;
        self.data = None;
        NetError::Conflict("session_replaced".into())
    }

    async fn handle(&mut self, msg: ClientMsg) -> Result<()> {
        if let Some(r) = &self.room {
            let mine = self.owns_slot(&r.hosted.lock(), r.actor);
            if !mine {
                return Err(self.replaced());
            }
        }
        match msg {
            ClientMsg::Auth { grant } => {
                let g = match self.st.grants.verify(&grant) {
                    Ok(g) => g,
                    Err(e) => {
                        return Err(if self.st.guards.auth_fail.allow(self.ip) {
                            e
                        } else {
                            NetError::RateLimited
                        });
                    }
                };
                let _ = self.ctl.try_send(ServerMsg::Authed {
                    player_id: g.player_id.clone(),
                    name: g.name.clone(),
                });
                if let Some(old) = &self.grant {
                    self.st.host.presence_leave(old.project, &old.player_id);
                }
                self.st.host.presence_enter(g.project, &g.player_id);
                self.grant = Some(g);
                Ok(())
            }
            ClientMsg::GetRooms { expr, limit } => {
                let g = self.grant()?.clone();
                let filter = match expr.as_deref().map(str::trim) {
                    None | Some("") => None,
                    Some(e) => Some(
                        crate::mmfilter::Filter::parse(e)
                            .map_err(|e| NetError::Invalid(format!("expr: {e}")))?,
                    ),
                };
                self.lookup_budget()?;
                let limit = usize::from(limit.unwrap_or(100).clamp(1, 500));
                let rooms = self
                    .lobby_rooms(g.project)
                    .await
                    .into_iter()
                    .filter(|r| filter.as_ref().is_none_or(|f| f.matches(&r.props)))
                    .take(limit)
                    .collect();
                let _ = self.ctl.try_send(ServerMsg::Rooms { rooms });
                Ok(())
            }
            ClientMsg::Rpc { id, name, body } => {
                let g = self.grant()?.clone();
                let name_ok = !name.is_empty()
                    && name.len() <= 64
                    && name
                        .bytes()
                        .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(b, b'_' | b'.' | b'-'));
                if !name_ok {
                    return Err(NetError::Invalid(
                        "rpc: name is 1..=64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_.-]".into(),
                    ));
                }
                if serde_json::to_vec(&body).map_or(usize::MAX, |v| v.len()) > RPC_MAX_BODY {
                    return Err(NetError::Invalid(format!(
                        "rpc: body over {RPC_MAX_BODY} bytes"
                    )));
                }
                self.rpc_budget()?;
                let room = self.room.as_ref().map(|r| (r.id.to_string(), r.actor));
                let payload = serde_json::json!({
                    "name": name,
                    "player_id": g.player_id,
                    "actor": room.as_ref().map(|r| r.1),
                    "room": room.as_ref().map(|r| r.0.clone()),
