`crates/net-replication/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! Server -> client state replication for sync mode: per-client baselines, area-of-interest,
//! priority accumulation and a byte budget per tick. Output is a `Delta` packet the client
//! applies to its own `Frame`.
//!
//! Packet layout (bit-packed, after the 12-byte transport header):
//! ```text
//! u32 tick, u32 baseline_tick (0 = full), u16 n_despawn, n * u64 entity
//! u16 n_entities, for each: u64 entity, u1 owner?, [u16 owner], u8 n_components,
//!   for each: cid, u1 removed, [u1 full, body]
//! ```

use net_common::types::{ActorId, Tick};
use net_sim::{Entity, EntityId, Frame};
use net_wire::{BitReader, BitWriter, ComponentValue, Schema};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet, HashMap, HashSet, VecDeque};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ReplicationConfig {
    /// AOI grid cell size in world units; entities within `radius` cells of the viewer are
    /// relevant. 0 disables AOI (everything relevant).
    pub aoi_cell: f32,
    pub aoi_radius: u32,
    /// Component name and field index holding the vec3 position used for AOI.
    pub position: Option<(String, usize)>,
    /// Max payload bytes per client per tick.
    pub budget_bytes: usize,
    /// Entities not updated for this many ticks get top priority regardless of distance.
    pub stale_after: u32,
}

impl Default for ReplicationConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            aoi_cell: 32.0,
            aoi_radius: 2,
            position: Some(("Transform".into(), 0)),
            budget_bytes: 1100,
            stale_after: 30,
        }
    }
}

/// What one client believes about one entity.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
struct Known {
    components: BTreeMap<u16, ComponentValue>,
    owner: Option<ActorId>,
    last_sent: u32,
    priority: f32,
}

/// One delta we sent: whose baselines it advanced, so a lost delta can be undone once the
/// client's ack history shows it never arrived.
#[derive(Debug)]
struct Sent {
    tick: u32,
    entities: Vec<EntityId>,
    despawned: Vec<EntityId>,
}

/// Sent deltas remembered per client while waiting for acks.
const SENT_LOG: usize = 128;

/// Replication state for one connected client.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct ClientView {
    pub actor: ActorId,
    known: HashMap<EntityId, Known>,
    sent: VecDeque<Sent>,
    acked_any: bool,
    /// Despawns from lost deltas, repeated in the next delta.
    pending_despawn: BTreeSet<EntityId>,
    /// Deltas the client lost (reported or assumed); drained by the room for metrics.
    pub lost_deltas: u64,
    /// Ticks where the byte budget deferred relevant entities; drained for metrics.
    pub starved: u64,
    /// Entities the game forces into view (team mates, objectives) regardless of AOI.
    pub interest: BTreeSet<EntityId>,
    /// Entity whose position defines the viewpoint (the player's avatar).
    pub viewpoint: Option<EntityId>,
    /// Extra viewpoints (camera, scope target); at most `MAX_VIEWPOINTS` in total are used.
    pub extra_viewpoints: Vec<EntityId>,
    pub last_tick: Option<Tick>,
}

impl ClientView {
    pub fn new(actor: ActorId) -> Self {
        Self {
            actor,
            known: HashMap::new(),
            sent: VecDeque::new(),
            acked_any: false,
            pending_despawn: BTreeSet::new(),
            lost_deltas: 0,
            starved: 0,
            interest: BTreeSet::new(),
            viewpoint: None,
            extra_viewpoints: Vec::new(),
            last_tick: None,
        }
    }

    /// Forget everything so the next build is a full snapshot (client asked to resync).
    pub fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.known.clear();
        self.sent.clear();
        self.pending_despawn.clear();
        self.last_tick = None;
    }

    /// Client ack: `last` is the newest delta tick it received and bit `i` of `bits` says it
    /// also received tick `last - 1 - i`. Every remembered delta at or before `last` is
    /// resolved; a lost one has its entities forgotten (the next delta re-sends them in full,
    /// since later deltas were encoded against state the client never got) and its despawns
    /// queued again. Returns how many deltas were lost.
    pub fn ack(&mut self, last: u32, bits: u32) -> u32 {
        self.acked_any = true;
        let mut lost = 0;
        while let Some(s) = self.sent.front() {
            let d = last.wrapping_sub(s.tick);
            if d >= 1 << 31 {
                break;
            }
            let s = self.sent.pop_front().unwrap();
            let received = d == 0 || (d <= 32 && (bits >> (d - 1)) & 1 == 1);
            if !received {
                lost += 1;
                self.forget(s);
            }
        }
        self.lost_deltas += lost as u64;
        lost
    }

    fn forget(&mut self, s: Sent) {
        for id in s.entities {
            self.known.remove(&id);
        }
        self.pending_despawn.extend(s.despawned);
    }

    pub fn known_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.known.len()
    }
}

pub struct Replicator {
    pub cfg: ReplicationConfig,
    pos_cid: Option<(u16, usize)>,
    /// Component ids flagged `@owner_only` / `@global` in the schema.
    owner_only: HashSet<u16>,
    global: HashSet<u16>,
}

/// Viewpoints per client (`viewpoint` + `extra_viewpoints`).
pub const MAX_VIEWPOINTS: usize = 4;

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ApplyError {
    #[error("truncated delta")]
    Truncated,
    #[error("unknown component {0}")]
    Component(u16),
    #[error("codec: {0}")]
    Codec(String),
}

impl Replicator {
    pub fn new(cfg: ReplicationConfig, schema: &Schema) -> Self {
        let pos_cid = cfg
            .position
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|(name, idx)| schema.component(name).map(|c| (c.id, *idx)));
        Self {
            cfg,
            pos_cid,
            owner_only: schema
                .components
                .iter()
                .filter(|c| c.owner_only)
                .map(|c| c.id)
                .collect(),
            global: schema
                .components
                .iter()
                .filter(|c| c.global)
                .map(|c| c.id)
                .collect(),
        }
    }

    fn position(&self, e: &Entity) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
        let (cid, idx) = self.pos_cid?;
        net_sim::vec3_of(e.components.get(&cid)?, idx)
    }

    fn cell(&self, p: [f32; 3]) -> (i32, i32) {
        (
            (p[0] / self.cfg.aoi_cell).floor() as i32,
            (p[2] / self.cfg.aoi_cell).floor() as i32,
        )
    }

    /// Entities relevant to the viewer this tick: own entities, explicit interest, server
    /// entities without position, and everything within the AOI radius of the viewpoint.
    pub fn relevant(&self, frame: &Frame, view: &ClientView) -> Vec<EntityId> {
        let origins: Vec<(i32, i32)> = view
            .viewpoint
            .iter()
            .chain(view.extra_viewpoints.iter())
            .take(MAX_VIEWPOINTS)
            .filter_map(|v| frame.entity(*v))
            .filter_map(|e| self.position(e))
            .map(|p| self.cell(p))
            .collect();
        let r = self.cfg.aoi_radius as i32;
        frame
            .entities()
            .filter(|e| {
                if e.owner == Some(view.actor)
                    || view.interest.contains(&e.id)
                    || self.cfg.aoi_cell <= 0.0
                    || e.components.keys().any(|c| self.global.contains(c))
                {
                    return true;
                }
                match self.position(e) {
                    None => true,
                    Some(_) if origins.is_empty() => true,
                    Some(p) => {
                        // Hysteresis: something already in view stays until one cell further.
                        let r = if view.known.contains_key(&e.id) {
                            r + 1
                        } else {
                            r
                        };
                        let c = self.cell(p);
                        origins
                            .iter()
                            .any(|o| (c.0 - o.0).abs() <= r && (c.1 - o.1).abs() <= r)
                    }
                }
            })
            .map(|e| e.id)
            .collect()
    }

    /// Components of `e` this viewer may see (`@owner_only` hides from non-owners).
    fn visible<'a>(
        &self,
        e: &'a Entity,
        viewer: ActorId,
    ) -> std::borrow::Cow<'a, BTreeMap<u16, ComponentValue>> {
        if self.owner_only.is_empty() || e.owner == Some(viewer) {
            return std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(&e.components);
        }
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(
            e.components
                .iter()
                .filter(|(c, _)| !self.owner_only.contains(c))
                .map(|(c, v)| (*c, v.clone()))
                .collect(),
        )
    }

    /// Builds the delta for one client and advances its baseline for everything included.
    /// Entities that no longer exist or left the AOI are sent as despawns.
    pub fn build(&self, frame: &Frame, view: &mut ClientView) -> Vec<u8> {
        let tick = frame.tick.0;
        let relevant: Vec<EntityId> = self.relevant(frame, view);
        let rel_set: HashSet<EntityId> = relevant.iter().copied().collect();
        let origin = view
            .viewpoint
            .and_then(|v| frame.entity(v))
            .and_then(|e| self.position(e));

        let mut despawn: Vec<EntityId> = view
            .known
            .keys()
            .filter(|id| !rel_set.contains(id))
            .copied()
            .collect();
        for id in &despawn {
            view.known.remove(id);
        }
        for id in std::mem::take(&mut view.pending_despawn) {
            if !rel_set.contains(&id) && !despawn.contains(&id) {
                despawn.push(id);
            }
        }

        // Priority: distance-based accumulator plus staleness; new entities first.
        let mut order: Vec<(f32, EntityId)> = relevant
            .iter()
            .map(|id| {
                let e = frame.entity(*id).unwrap();
                let k = view.known.entry(*id).or_insert_with(|| Known {
                    last_sent: tick.wrapping_sub(u32::MAX / 2),
                    ..Default::default()
                });
                let dist = match (origin, self.position(e)) {
                    (Some(o), Some(p)) => {
                        ((p[0] - o[0]).powi(2) + (p[1] - o[1]).powi(2) + (p[2] - o[2]).powi(2))
                            .sqrt()
                    }
                    _ => 0.0,
                };
                let changed = e.owner != k.owner || *self.visible(e, view.actor) != k.components;
                let age = tick.wrapping_sub(k.last_sent);
                k.priority += if changed {
                    1.0 / (1.0 + dist / self.cfg.aoi_cell.max(1.0))
                } else {
                    0.0
                };
                let p = if k.components.is_empty() && !e.components.is_empty() {
                    f32::MAX
                } else if age >= self.cfg.stale_after && changed {
                    1e6 + k.priority
                } else {
                    k.priority
                };
                (p, *id)
            })
            .collect();
        order.sort_by(|a, b| b.0.partial_cmp(&a.0).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));

        let full = view.last_tick.is_none();
        let mut w = BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bits(tick as u64, 32);
        w.write_bits(view.last_tick.map(|t| t.0 as u64 + 1).unwrap_or(0), 32);
        w.write_bits(despawn.len().min(65535) as u64, 16);
        for id in despawn.iter().take(65535) {
            w.write_bits(id.to_u64(), 48);
        }
        let count_pos = w.bit_len();
        w.write_bits(0, 16);
        let cid_bits = frame.schema.component_id_bits();
        let mut sent = 0u16;
        let mut sent_ids = Vec::new();
        for (prio, id) in order {
            if prio <= 0.0 && !full {
                continue;
            }
            let e = frame.entity(id).unwrap();
            let vis = self.visible(e, view.actor);
            let k = view.known.get(&id).unwrap();
            let mut ew = BitWriter::new();
            ew.write_bits(id.to_u64(), 48);
            match e.owner {
                Some(a) => {
                    ew.write_bool(true);
                    ew.write_bits(a.0 as u64, 16);
                }
                None => ew.write_bool(false),
            }
            let mut comps: Vec<(u16, Option<&ComponentValue>)> = Vec::new();
            for (cid, v) in vis.iter() {
                if k.components.get(cid) != Some(v) {
                    comps.push((*cid, Some(v)));
                }
            }
            for cid in k.components.keys() {
                if !vis.contains_key(cid) {
                    comps.push((*cid, None));
                }
            }
            if comps.is_empty() && e.owner == k.owner && !k.components.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            ew.write_bits(comps.len().min(255) as u64, 8);
            for (cid, v) in comps.iter().take(255) {
                ew.write_bits(*cid as u64, cid_bits);
                match v {
                    None => ew.write_bool(true),
                    Some(v) => {
                        ew.write_bool(false);
                        let c = frame.schema.by_id(*cid).unwrap();
                        match k.components.get(cid) {
                            Some(base) => {
                                ew.write_bool(false);
                                let _ = v.encode_delta(base, c, &mut ew);
                            }
                            None => {
                                ew.write_bool(true);
                                let _ = v.encode_full(c, &mut ew);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (w.bit_len() + ew.bit_len()).div_ceil(8) > self.cfg.budget_bytes && sent > 0 {
                view.starved += 1;
                break;
            }
            let nbits = ew.bit_len();
            append_bits(&mut w, &ew.finish(), nbits);
            let vis = vis.into_owned();
            let k = view.known.get_mut(&id).unwrap();
            k.components = vis;
            k.owner = e.owner;
            k.last_sent = tick;
            k.priority = 0.0;
            sent_ids.push(id);
            sent += 1;
            if sent == u16::MAX {
                break;
            }
        }
        let mut out = w.finish();
        out[count_pos / 8..count_pos / 8 + 2].copy_from_slice(&sent.to_be_bytes());
        view.last_tick = Some(frame.tick);
        view.sent.push_back(Sent {
            tick,
            entities: sent_ids,
            despawned: despawn,
        });
        if view.sent.len() > SENT_LOG {
            let s = view.sent.pop_front().unwrap();
            // A client that acks never let a delta get this old: assume it was lost. Clients
            // that do not ack at all (older SDKs) just get the pre-ack behaviour.
            if view.acked_any {
                view.lost_deltas += 1;
                view.forget(s);
            }
        }
        out
    }

    /// Applies a delta to a client-side frame. Unknown entities are created; components are
    /// decoded against the client's current value (its baseline).
    pub fn apply(frame: &mut Frame, buf: &[u8]) -> Result<Tick, ApplyError> {
        Self::apply_report(frame, buf).map(|r| r.tick)
    }

    /// `apply` that also tells which entities the delta touched (for spawn/change/despawn callbacks).
    pub fn apply_report(frame: &mut Frame, buf: &[u8]) -> Result<ApplyReport, ApplyError> {
        let mut report = ApplyReport::default();
        let mut r = BitReader::new(buf);
        let rd = |r: &mut BitReader, n: u32| r.read_bits(n).map_err(|_| ApplyError::Truncated);
        let tick = Tick(rd(&mut r, 32)? as u32);
        report.tick = tick;
        report.baseline = rd(&mut r, 32)? as u32;
        let nd = rd(&mut r, 16)? as usize;
        for _ in 0..nd {
            let id = EntityId::from_u64(rd(&mut r, 48)?);
            if frame.despawn(id).is_ok() {
                report.despawned.push(id);
            }
        }
        let n = rd(&mut r, 16)? as usize;
        let cid_bits = frame.schema.component_id_bits();
        for _ in 0..n {
            let id = EntityId::from_u64(rd(&mut r, 48)?);
            let owner = if r.read_bool().map_err(|_| ApplyError::Truncated)? {
                Some(ActorId(rd(&mut r, 16)? as u16))
            } else {
                None
            };
            if frame.entity(id).is_none() {
                report.spawned.push(id);
            } else {
                report.changed.push(id);
            }
            frame
                .ensure_entity(id, owner)
                .map_err(|e| ApplyError::Codec(e.to_string()))?;
            let nc = rd(&mut r, 8)? as usize;
            for _ in 0..nc {
                let cid = rd(&mut r, cid_bits)? as u16;
                let removed = r.read_bool().map_err(|_| ApplyError::Truncated)?;
                let c = frame
                    .schema
                    .by_id(cid)
                    .ok_or(ApplyError::Component(cid))?
                    .clone();
                let e = frame.entity_mut(id).unwrap();
                if removed {
                    e.components.remove(&cid);
                    continue;
                }
                let is_full = r.read_bool().map_err(|_| ApplyError::Truncated)?;
                let v = if is_full {
                    ComponentValue::decode_full(&c, &mut r)
                } else {
                    let base = e
                        .components
                        .get(&cid)
                        .cloned()
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| ComponentValue::zero(&c));
                    ComponentValue::decode_delta(&base, &c, &mut r)
                }
                .map_err(|e| ApplyError::Codec(e.to_string()))?;
                e.components.insert(cid, v);
            }
        }
        frame.tick = tick;
        Ok(report)
    }
}

/// What a delta did to the client frame (`Replicator::apply_report`).
#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ApplyReport {
    pub tick: Tick,
    /// Server's `baseline_tick` header (0 = full state).
    pub baseline: u32,
    pub despawned: Vec<EntityId>,
    /// Entities the client had not seen before this delta.
    pub spawned: Vec<EntityId>,
    /// Entities the client already knew that this delta touched.
    pub changed: Vec<EntityId>,
}

/// Reads `(tick, baseline_tick)` from a delta payload (without the kind byte).
pub fn delta_header(buf: &[u8]) -> Option<(u32, u32)> {
    if buf.len() < 8 {
        return None;
    }
    Some((
        u32::from_be_bytes(buf[0..4].try_into().unwrap()),
        u32::from_be_bytes(buf[4..8].try_into().unwrap()),
    ))
}

/// Client side: which delta ticks arrived, in the shape the server's `ClientView::ack` wants.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct AckTracker {
    last: Option<u32>,
    bits: u32,
    /// Deltas the server sent (per its `baseline_tick` header) that never arrived.
    pub gaps: u64,
}

impl AckTracker {
    /// Records a received delta header. Returns true when the delta before it was missed.
    pub fn on_delta(&mut self, tick: u32, baseline_tick: u32) -> bool {
        let Some(l) = self.last else {
            self.last = Some(tick);
            return false;
        };
        let d = tick.wrapping_sub(l);
        if d == 0 || d >= 1 << 31 {
            // duplicate or late arrival: fill its slot in the history
            let back = l.wrapping_sub(tick);
            if (1..=32).contains(&back) {
                self.bits |= 1 << (back - 1);
            }
            return false;
        }
        let gap = baseline_tick != 0 && l != baseline_tick.wrapping_sub(1);
        if gap {
            self.gaps += 1;
        }
        self.bits = if d >= 32 {
            0
        } else {
            (self.bits << d) | (1 << (d - 1))
        };
        self.last = Some(tick);
        gap
    }

    /// `(last, bits)` for the ack frame; None before the first delta.
    pub fn ack(&self) -> Option<(u32, u32)> {
        self.last.map(|l| (l, self.bits))
    }
}

/// Concatenates a byte-padded sub-writer bit-exactly.
fn append_bits(w: &mut BitWriter, bytes: &[u8], nbits: usize) {
    let mut r = BitReader::new(bytes);
    let mut left = nbits;
    while left > 0 {
        let n = left.min(32) as u32;
        w.write_bits(r.read_bits(n).unwrap(), n);
        left -= n as usize;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use net_sim::FrameConfig;
    use net_wire::Value;

    fn schema() -> Schema {
        Schema::parse("component Transform {\n pos: vec3 @range(-1000, 1000, 0.01)\n}\ncomponent Health {\n hp: u8\n}").unwrap()
    }
    fn tf(x: f32, z: f32) -> ComponentValue {
        ComponentValue {
            fields: vec![Value::Vec3([x, 0.0, z])],
        }
    }
    fn hp(v: u64) -> ComponentValue {
        ComponentValue {
            fields: vec![Value::UInt(v)],
        }
    }
    fn pos(f: &Frame, id: EntityId) -> [f32; 3] {
        net_sim::vec3_of(f.get(id, "Transform").unwrap(), 0).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn full_then_delta_roundtrip() {
        let mut server = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let mut client = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let rep = Replicator::new(
            ReplicationConfig {
                aoi_cell: 0.0,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &server.schema,
        );
        let a = server.spawn(Some(ActorId(1))).unwrap();
        let b = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
        server.set(a, "Transform", tf(1.0, 2.0)).unwrap();
        server.set(a, "Health", hp(100)).unwrap();
        server.set(b, "Transform", tf(-5.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        let mut view = ClientView::new(ActorId(1));
        let d1 = rep.build(&server, &mut view);
        assert_eq!(Replicator::apply(&mut client, &d1).unwrap(), Tick(0));
        assert_eq!(client.entity_count(), 2);
        assert_eq!(client.entity(a).unwrap().owner, Some(ActorId(1)));
        assert_eq!(client.get(a, "Health"), Some(&hp(100)));

        // nothing changed -> header only
        server.advance(|_| {});
        let d2 = rep.build(&server, &mut view);
        assert_eq!(d2.len(), 12); // tick + baseline + two zero counts
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &d2).unwrap();

        // move a, drop Health, despawn b
        server.get_mut(a, "Transform").unwrap().fields[0] = Value::Vec3([1.5, 0.0, 2.0]);
        server.remove_component(a, "Health").unwrap();
        server.despawn(b).unwrap();
        server.advance(|_| {});
        let d3 = rep.build(&server, &mut view);
        assert!(d3.len() < 40, "{}", d3.len()); // 1 despawn + 1 entity (vec3 delta, Health removed)
        assert_eq!(Replicator::apply(&mut client, &d3).unwrap(), Tick(2));
        assert_eq!(client.entity_count(), 1);
        assert!(client.get(a, "Health").is_none());
        assert!((pos(&client, a)[0] - 1.5).abs() < 0.01);
        assert_eq!(view.known_count(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn aoi_filters_and_despawns_on_leave() {
        let mut server = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let mut client = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let rep = Replicator::new(
            ReplicationConfig {
                aoi_cell: 10.0,
                aoi_radius: 1,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &server.schema,
        );
        let me = server.spawn(Some(ActorId(7))).unwrap();
        server.set(me, "Transform", tf(0.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        let near = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
        server.set(near, "Transform", tf(15.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        let far = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
        server.set(far, "Transform", tf(100.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        let global = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
        server.set(global, "Health", hp(1)).unwrap();
        let mut view = ClientView::new(ActorId(7));
        view.viewpoint = Some(me);
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &rep.build(&server, &mut view)).unwrap();
        assert!(client.entity(near).is_some() && client.entity(global).is_some());
        assert!(client.entity(far).is_none());
        // near walks away
        server.get_mut(near, "Transform").unwrap().fields[0] = Value::Vec3([50.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        server.advance(|_| {});
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &rep.build(&server, &mut view)).unwrap();
        assert!(client.entity(near).is_none());
        // explicit interest overrides AOI
        view.interest.insert(far);
        server.advance(|_| {});
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &rep.build(&server, &mut view)).unwrap();
        assert!(client.entity(far).is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn budget_spreads_over_ticks() {
        let mut server = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let mut client = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let rep = Replicator::new(
            ReplicationConfig {
                aoi_cell: 0.0,
                budget_bytes: 200,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &server.schema,
        );
        for i in 0..100 {
            let e = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
            server.set(e, "Transform", tf(i as f32, 0.0)).unwrap();
        }
        let mut view = ClientView::new(ActorId(1));
        let mut ticks = 0;
        while client.entity_count() < 100 {
            let d = rep.build(&server, &mut view);
            assert!(d.len() <= 200 + 20, "{}", d.len());
            Replicator::apply(&mut client, &d).unwrap();
            server.advance(|_| {});
            ticks += 1;
            assert!(ticks < 50);
        }
        assert!(ticks > 3);
        for e in server.entities() {
            assert_eq!(pos(&client, e.id)[0], pos(&server, e.id)[0]);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn ack_tracker_bits() {
        let mut t = AckTracker::default();
        assert!(!t.on_delta(0, 0));
        assert!(!t.on_delta(1, 1));
        assert!(t.on_delta(3, 3)); // tick 2 missing
        assert_eq!(t.ack(), Some((3, 0b110)));
        assert!(!t.on_delta(2, 2)); // late arrival fills the hole
        assert_eq!(t.ack(), Some((3, 0b111)));
        assert_eq!(t.gaps, 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn lost_deltas_are_repaired_after_ack() {
        let mut server = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let mut client = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let rep = Replicator::new(
            ReplicationConfig {
                aoi_cell: 0.0,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &server.schema,
        );
        let a = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
        let b = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
        server.set(a, "Transform", tf(1.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        server.set(b, "Transform", tf(2.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        let mut view = ClientView::new(ActorId(1));
        let mut tracker = AckTracker::default();
        let d0 = rep.build(&server, &mut view);
        tracker.on_delta(0, 0);
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &d0).unwrap();
        // tick 1: a moves (lost); tick 2: b despawns (lost)
        server.get_mut(a, "Transform").unwrap().fields[0] = Value::Vec3([5.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        server.advance(|_| {});
        let _lost1 = rep.build(&server, &mut view);
        server.despawn(b).unwrap();
        server.advance(|_| {});
        let _lost2 = rep.build(&server, &mut view);
        // tick 3 arrives: nothing changed, but the client notices the hole
        server.advance(|_| {});
        let d3 = rep.build(&server, &mut view);
        let (t, base) = delta_header(&d3).unwrap();
        assert!(tracker.on_delta(t, base));
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &d3).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(client.entity_count(), 2);
        assert_eq!(pos(&client, a)[0], 1.0);
        let (last, bits) = tracker.ack().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(view.ack(last, bits), 2);
        assert_eq!(view.lost_deltas, 2);
        // next delta repairs both: a in full, b despawned again
        server.advance(|_| {});
        let d4 = rep.build(&server, &mut view);
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &d4).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(client.entity_count(), 1);
        assert_eq!(pos(&client, a)[0], 5.0);
        assert_eq!(view.known_count(), 1);
        // everything acked -> nothing more to repair
        tracker.on_delta(4, 4);
        let (last, bits) = tracker.ack().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(view.ack(last, bits), 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn owner_only_and_global_flags() {
        let sch = Schema::parse(
            "component Transform {\n pos: vec3 @range(-1000, 1000, 0.01)\n}\ncomponent Inv @owner_only {\n n: u8\n}\ncomponent Score @global {\n s: u8\n}",
        )
        .unwrap();
        let mut server = Frame::new(sch.clone(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let mut owner = Frame::new(sch.clone(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let mut other = Frame::new(sch.clone(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let rep = Replicator::new(
            ReplicationConfig {
                aoi_cell: 10.0,
                aoi_radius: 1,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &server.schema,
        );
        let me = server.spawn(Some(ActorId(1))).unwrap();
        server.set(me, "Transform", tf(0.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        server.set(me, "Inv", hp(7)).unwrap();
        let you = server.spawn(Some(ActorId(2))).unwrap();
        server.set(you, "Transform", tf(5.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        let score = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
        server.set(score, "Transform", tf(900.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        server.set(score, "Score", hp(3)).unwrap();
        let mut v1 = ClientView::new(ActorId(1));
        v1.viewpoint = Some(me);
        let mut v2 = ClientView::new(ActorId(2));
        v2.viewpoint = Some(you);
        Replicator::apply(&mut owner, &rep.build(&server, &mut v1)).unwrap();
        Replicator::apply(&mut other, &rep.build(&server, &mut v2)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(owner.get(me, "Inv"), Some(&hp(7)));
        assert!(other.entity(me).is_some() && other.get(me, "Inv").is_none());
        // far away, but @global
        assert_eq!(other.get(score, "Score"), Some(&hp(3)));
        // a change to the hidden component sends nothing to the non-owner
        server.get_mut(me, "Inv").unwrap().fields[0] = Value::UInt(8);
        server.advance(|_| {});
        let d = rep.build(&server, &mut v2);
        assert_eq!(d.len(), 12);
        let d = rep.build(&server, &mut v1);
        assert!(d.len() > 12);
        Replicator::apply(&mut owner, &d).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(owner.get(me, "Inv"), Some(&hp(8)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn aoi_hysteresis_and_extra_viewpoints() {
        let mut server = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let mut client = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let rep = Replicator::new(
            ReplicationConfig {
                aoi_cell: 10.0,
                aoi_radius: 1,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &server.schema,
        );
        let me = server.spawn(Some(ActorId(7))).unwrap();
        server.set(me, "Transform", tf(0.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        let edge = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
        server.set(edge, "Transform", tf(15.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        let scope = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
        server.set(scope, "Transform", tf(200.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        let near_scope = server.spawn(None).unwrap();
        server.set(near_scope, "Transform", tf(205.0, 0.0)).unwrap();
        let mut view = ClientView::new(ActorId(7));
        view.viewpoint = Some(me);
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &rep.build(&server, &mut view)).unwrap();
        assert!(client.entity(edge).is_some() && client.entity(near_scope).is_none());
        // one cell past the radius: still in view (hysteresis)
        server.get_mut(edge, "Transform").unwrap().fields[0] = Value::Vec3([25.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        server.advance(|_| {});
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &rep.build(&server, &mut view)).unwrap();
        assert!(client.entity(edge).is_some());
        // two cells past: gone
        server.get_mut(edge, "Transform").unwrap().fields[0] = Value::Vec3([35.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        server.advance(|_| {});
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &rep.build(&server, &mut view)).unwrap();
        assert!(client.entity(edge).is_none());
        // a second viewpoint pulls in what is around it
        view.extra_viewpoints.push(scope);
        server.advance(|_| {});
        Replicator::apply(&mut client, &rep.build(&server, &mut view)).unwrap();
        assert!(client.entity(near_scope).is_some());
    }
}

`crates/net-replication/tests/garbage.rs`:

```rs
//! Delta application never panics on random input; the frame stays usable.
use net_replication::Replicator;
use net_sim::{Frame, FrameConfig};
use net_wire::schema::Schema;
fn rng(seed: u64) -> impl FnMut() -> u64 {
    let mut s = seed | 1;
    move || {
        s ^= s << 13;
        s ^= s >> 7;
        s ^= s << 17;
        s
    }
}
fn garbage(r: &mut impl FnMut() -> u64, max: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
    let n = (r() as usize) % (max + 1);
    (0..n).map(|_| r() as u8).collect()
}
#[allow(dead_code)]
fn mutate(r: &mut impl FnMut() -> u64, v: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut m = v.to_vec();
    let k = 1 + (r() % 4) as usize;
    for _ in 0..k {
        if m.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        let i = (r() as usize) % m.len();
        match r() % 3 {
            0 => m[i] ^= 1 << (r() % 8),
            1 => {
                m.remove(i);
            }
            _ => m.insert(i, r() as u8),
        }
    }
    m
}
#[test]
fn apply_survives_garbage() {
    let s = Schema::parse(
        "component T {\n  pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)\n  hp: u8\n  name: string(8)\n}\n",
    )
    .unwrap();
    let mut f = Frame::new(s, FrameConfig::default(), 1);
    let mut r = rng(11);
    for _ in 0..20_000 {
        let _ = Replicator::apply(&mut f, &garbage(&mut r, 96));
    }
    let _ = f.snapshot();
}

`crates/net-rollback/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! Lockstep with prediction and rollback. The game supplies a deterministic `step` over a
//! cloneable state; this crate keeps the input journal, predicts missing inputs with each
//! actor's last known one, rewinds when a late input contradicts a prediction, and hashes
//! every confirmed tick so peers (and the server) can detect desyncs. The same journal is
//! the replay format.

use net_common::types::{ActorId, Tick};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, VecDeque};

pub trait Hashable {
    fn state_hash(&self) -> u64;
}

/// Everyone's inputs for one tick, in actor order. Missing actors mean "predicted".
pub type TickInputs = BTreeMap<ActorId, Vec<u8>>;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Replay {
    pub seed: u64,
    pub schema_hash: String,
    pub tick_hz: u16,
    pub actors: Vec<ActorId>,
    /// Tick of `inputs[0]` (0 unless the journal was trimmed on a very long match).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub from_tick: u32,
    /// Confirmed inputs per tick from `from_tick`; a missing actor keeps its previous input.
    pub inputs: Vec<TickInputs>,
    /// Hash after every `hash_every` ticks, for verification.
    pub hash_every: u32,
    pub hashes: Vec<(u32, u64)>,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum RollbackError {
    #[error("tick {0} is older than the rollback window")]
    TooOld(u32),
    #[error("tick {0} is too far ahead")]
    TooFar(u32),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct RollbackConfig {
    /// How many ticks back a late input can still be applied.
    pub window: usize,
    /// How far ahead of the last confirmed tick prediction may run.
    pub max_prediction: u32,
    pub hash_every: u32,
}

impl Default for RollbackConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            window: 32,
            max_prediction: 8,
            hash_every: 10,
        }
    }
}

/// `S` is the whole deterministic game state.
pub struct Rollback<S: Clone + Hashable> {
    pub cfg: RollbackConfig,
    actors: Vec<ActorId>,
    /// Inputs received, by tick (relative to `base_tick`).
    journal: VecDeque<TickInputs>,
    /// Which (tick, actor) pairs are confirmed (the rest were predicted).
    confirmed: VecDeque<Vec<bool>>,
    /// State before each tick in the window; `states[0]` is the state at `base_tick`.
    states: VecDeque<S>,
    base_tick: u32,
    /// Current (predicted) tick: states.len() - 1 + base_tick.
    last_input: BTreeMap<ActorId, Vec<u8>>,
    hashes: Vec<(u32, u64)>,
    pub rollbacks: u64,
    pub resimulated_ticks: u64,
}

impl<S: Clone + Hashable> Rollback<S> {
    pub fn new(cfg: RollbackConfig, actors: Vec<ActorId>, initial: S) -> Self {
        let mut actors = actors;
        actors.sort();
        actors.dedup();
        Self {
            cfg,
            actors,
            journal: VecDeque::new(),
            confirmed: VecDeque::new(),
            states: VecDeque::from([initial]),
            base_tick: 0,
            last_input: BTreeMap::new(),
            hashes: Vec::new(),
            rollbacks: 0,
            resimulated_ticks: 0,
        }
    }

    /// Starts from a checkpoint: `state` is the state entering `tick` (every earlier input
    /// applied), as uploaded by the master and relayed by the server to late joiners.
    pub fn from_checkpoint(
        cfg: RollbackConfig,
        actors: Vec<ActorId>,
        tick: Tick,
        state: S,
    ) -> Self {
        let mut r = Self::new(cfg, actors, state);
        r.base_tick = tick.0;
        r
    }

    /// Newest state whose every input is confirmed, with the tick it is entering. This is
    /// what a master uploads as a checkpoint.
    pub fn confirmed_state(&self) -> Option<(Tick, &S)> {
        let c = self.confirmed_tick()?;
        let i = (c.0 - self.base_tick) as usize + 1;
        self.states.get(i).map(|s| (Tick(c.0 + 1), s))
    }

    pub fn actors(&self) -> &[ActorId] {
        &self.actors
    }

    pub fn current_tick(&self) -> Tick {
        Tick(self.base_tick + (self.states.len() as u32 - 1))
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> &S {
        self.states.back().unwrap()
    }

    /// Highest tick for which every actor's input is confirmed (none = base_tick - 1).
    pub fn confirmed_tick(&self) -> Option<Tick> {
        let mut t = None;
        for (i, c) in self.confirmed.iter().enumerate() {
            if c.iter().all(|x| *x) {
                t = Some(Tick(self.base_tick + i as u32));
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        t
    }

    fn idx(&self, tick: u32) -> Option<usize> {
        if tick < self.base_tick {
            None
        } else {
            Some((tick - self.base_tick) as usize)
        }
    }

    /// Records a confirmed input. Returns true if a rollback happened (the input differed
    /// from what was predicted for an already simulated tick).
    pub fn add_input<F>(
        &mut self,
        actor: ActorId,
        tick: Tick,
        data: Vec<u8>,
        step: &mut F,
    ) -> Result<bool, RollbackError>
    where
        F: FnMut(&mut S, &TickInputs, Tick),
    {
        let Some(ai) = self.actors.iter().position(|a| *a == actor) else {
            return Ok(false);
        };
        let i = self.idx(tick.0).ok_or(RollbackError::TooOld(tick.0))?;
        let cur = self.current_tick().0;
        if tick.0 > cur + self.cfg.max_prediction {
            return Err(RollbackError::TooFar(tick.0));
        }
        while self.journal.len() <= i {
            self.journal.push_back(TickInputs::new());
            self.confirmed.push_back(vec![false; self.actors.len()]);
        }
        if self.confirmed[i][ai] {
            return Ok(false); // duplicate
        }
        let predicted = self.journal[i].get(&actor).cloned();
        self.journal[i].insert(actor, data.clone());
        self.confirmed[i][ai] = true;
        // Simulated already and prediction was wrong -> rewind.
        let simulated = i + 1 < self.states.len();
        if simulated && predicted.as_deref() != Some(data.as_slice()) {
            self.rollbacks += 1;
            self.resimulate_from(i, step);
            return Ok(true);
        }
        Ok(false)
    }

    fn resimulate_from<F>(&mut self, i: usize, step: &mut F)
    where
        F: FnMut(&mut S, &TickInputs, Tick),
    {
        let target = self.states.len() - 1;
        self.states.truncate(i + 1);
        // Rebuild last_input from confirmed history before i.
        self.last_input.clear();
        for t in 0..i {
            for (a, d) in &self.journal[t] {
                self.last_input.insert(*a, d.clone());
            }
        }
        for t in i..target {
            self.fill_predictions(t);
            let mut s = self.states[t].clone();
            step(&mut s, &self.journal[t], Tick(self.base_tick + t as u32));
            for (a, d) in &self.journal[t] {
                self.last_input.insert(*a, d.clone());
            }
            self.states.push_back(s);
            self.resimulated_ticks += 1;
        }
    }

    fn fill_predictions(&mut self, t: usize) {
        while self.journal.len() <= t {
            self.journal.push_back(TickInputs::new());
            self.confirmed.push_back(vec![false; self.actors.len()]);
        }
        for a in &self.actors {
            if !self.journal[t].contains_key(a) {
                let d = self.last_input.get(a).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
                self.journal[t].insert(*a, d);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Advances one tick, predicting any missing inputs. Fails when prediction would run too
    /// far ahead of confirmed inputs (the caller should wait instead).
    pub fn advance<F>(&mut self, step: &mut F) -> Result<Tick, RollbackError>
    where
        F: FnMut(&mut S, &TickInputs, Tick),
    {
        let t = self.states.len() - 1;
        let cur = self.base_tick + t as u32;
        let confirmed = self
            .confirmed_tick()
            .map(|t| t.0 + 1)
            .unwrap_or(self.base_tick);
        if cur >= confirmed + self.cfg.max_prediction {
            return Err(RollbackError::TooFar(cur));
        }
        self.fill_predictions(t);
        let mut s = self.states[t].clone();
        step(&mut s, &self.journal[t], Tick(cur));
        for (a, d) in &self.journal[t] {
            self.last_input.insert(*a, d.clone());
        }
        self.states.push_back(s);
        self.trim();
        let now = self.current_tick();
        if now.0.is_multiple_of(self.cfg.hash_every)
            && self.confirmed_tick().is_some_and(|c| c.0 + 1 >= now.0)
        {
            self.hashes.push((now.0, self.state().state_hash()));
        }
        Ok(now)
    }

    /// Drops confirmed history older than the window.
    fn trim(&mut self) {
        let confirmed = self
            .confirmed_tick()
            .map(|t| t.0 + 1)
            .unwrap_or(self.base_tick);
        while self.states.len() > self.cfg.window + 1 && self.base_tick < confirmed {
            self.states.pop_front();
            self.journal.pop_front();
            self.confirmed.pop_front();
            self.base_tick += 1;
        }
    }

    pub fn hashes(&self) -> &[(u32, u64)] {
        &self.hashes
    }

    pub fn take_hashes(&mut self) -> Vec<(u32, u64)> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.hashes)
    }
}

/// Replays a journal from scratch and returns the final state and hash checkpoints.
pub fn replay<S, F>(initial: S, replay: &Replay, mut step: F) -> (S, Vec<(u32, u64)>)
where
    S: Clone + Hashable,
    F: FnMut(&mut S, &TickInputs, Tick),
{
    let mut s = initial;
    let mut last: TickInputs = TickInputs::new();
    let mut hashes = Vec::new();
    for (t, inputs) in replay.inputs.iter().enumerate() {
        for (a, d) in inputs {
            last.insert(*a, d.clone());
        }
        let mut full = TickInputs::new();
        for a in &replay.actors {
            full.insert(*a, last.get(a).cloned().unwrap_or_default());
        }
        step(&mut s, &full, Tick(t as u32));
        let now = t as u32 + 1;
        if now.is_multiple_of(replay.hash_every) {
            hashes.push((now, s.state_hash()));
        }
    }
    (s, hashes)
}

/// Canonical input journal collector (server side): confirmed inputs per tick.
#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
pub struct Journal {
    /// Tick of `ticks[0]`; everything before it was trimmed (or never known after a restore).
    base: u32,
    ticks: std::collections::VecDeque<TickInputs>,
}

impl Journal {
    pub fn record(&mut self, tick: Tick, actor: ActorId, data: Vec<u8>) {
        if tick.0 < self.base {
            return;
        }
        let i = (tick.0 - self.base) as usize;
        while self.ticks.len() <= i {
            self.ticks.push_back(TickInputs::new());
        }
        self.ticks[i].entry(actor).or_insert(data);
    }

    /// Logical length: one past the last recorded tick (counts trimmed/unknown ticks too).
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.base as usize + self.ticks.len()
    }

    /// Ticks actually held in memory.
    pub fn live_len(&self) -> usize {
        self.ticks.len()
    }

    pub fn base(&self) -> u32 {
        self.base
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.ticks.is_empty()
    }

    /// Forgets ticks before `tick` (keeps memory bounded on long matches; the replay then
    /// starts at `from_tick`).
    pub fn trim_before(&mut self, tick: u32) {
        while self.base < tick && !self.ticks.is_empty() {
            self.ticks.pop_front();
            self.base += 1;
        }
    }

    /// Every actor that ever submitted an input.
    pub fn actors(&self) -> Vec<ActorId> {
        let mut v: Vec<ActorId> = self.ticks.iter().flat_map(|t| t.keys().copied()).collect();
        v.sort();
        v.dedup();
        v
    }

    pub fn tick(&self, t: Tick) -> Option<&TickInputs> {
        if t.0 < self.base {
            return None;
        }
        self.ticks.get((t.0 - self.base) as usize)
    }

    /// Inputs from tick `from` to the end (for re-hosting from a checkpoint). Ticks before the
    /// journal's base are unknown and come back empty.
    pub fn tail(&self, from: u32) -> Vec<TickInputs> {
        if from < self.base {
            let mut v = vec![TickInputs::new(); (self.base - from) as usize];
            v.extend(self.ticks.iter().cloned());
            return v;
        }
        self.ticks
            .iter()
            .skip((from - self.base) as usize)
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }

    /// Rebuilds a journal whose first `from` ticks are unknown and the rest is `tail`.
    pub fn from_parts(from: u32, tail: Vec<TickInputs>) -> Self {
        Self {
            base: from,
            ticks: tail.into(),
        }
    }

    pub fn into_replay(
        self,
        seed: u64,
        schema_hash: String,
        tick_hz: u16,
        actors: Vec<ActorId>,
        hash_every: u32,
    ) -> Replay {
        Replay {
            seed,
            schema_hash,
            tick_hz,
            actors,
            from_tick: self.base,
            inputs: self.ticks.into(),
            hash_every,
            hashes: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

/// Hash helper for plain byte-serialisable states.
pub fn hash_bytes(b: &[u8]) -> u64 {
    let h = blake3::hash(b);
    u64::from_le_bytes(h.as_bytes()[..8].try_into().unwrap())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
    struct World {
        pos: BTreeMap<ActorId, i64>,
    }
    impl Hashable for World {
        fn state_hash(&self) -> u64 {
            let mut b = Vec::new();
            for (a, p) in &self.pos {
                b.extend_from_slice(&a.0.to_le_bytes());
                b.extend_from_slice(&p.to_le_bytes());
            }
            hash_bytes(&b)
        }
    }
    fn step(w: &mut World, inputs: &TickInputs, _t: Tick) {
        for (a, d) in inputs {
            let dx = d.first().copied().unwrap_or(0) as i8 as i64;
            *w.pos.entry(*a).or_default() += dx;
        }
    }
    fn world() -> World {
        World {
            pos: BTreeMap::new(),
        }
    }
    const A: ActorId = ActorId(1);
    const B: ActorId = ActorId(2);

    #[test]
    fn predicts_then_rolls_back_on_late_input() {
        let mut rb = Rollback::new(RollbackConfig::default(), vec![A, B], world());
        // tick 0: both confirmed, A=+1, B=+1
        rb.add_input(A, Tick(0), vec![1], &mut step).unwrap();
        rb.add_input(B, Tick(0), vec![1], &mut step).unwrap();
        rb.advance(&mut step).unwrap();
        // ticks 1..3: only A arrives; B predicted as +1
        for t in 1..4 {
            rb.add_input(A, Tick(t), vec![1], &mut step).unwrap();
            rb.advance(&mut step).unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(rb.state().pos[&A], 4);
        assert_eq!(rb.state().pos[&B], 4); // predicted
        assert_eq!(rb.confirmed_tick(), Some(Tick(0)));
        // B's real inputs: tick1 = -1 (prediction wrong), tick2 = +1 (right), tick3 = +1
        assert!(rb.add_input(B, Tick(1), vec![255], &mut step).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(rb.state().pos[&B], 2); // 1 -1 +1 +1
        assert!(!rb.add_input(B, Tick(2), vec![1], &mut step).unwrap());
        assert!(!rb.add_input(B, Tick(3), vec![1], &mut step).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(rb.confirmed_tick(), Some(Tick(3)));
        assert_eq!(rb.rollbacks, 1);
        assert_eq!(rb.state().pos[&A], 4);
        // duplicate is ignored, too-old rejected after trim
        assert!(!rb.add_input(B, Tick(3), vec![9], &mut step).unwrap());
    }

    #[test]
    fn prediction_limit_and_window() {
        let cfg = RollbackConfig {
            window: 4,
            max_prediction: 3,
            hash_every: 2,
        };
        let mut rb = Rollback::new(cfg, vec![A], world());
        for _ in 0..3 {
            rb.advance(&mut step).unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(rb.advance(&mut step), Err(RollbackError::TooFar(3)));
        for t in 0..3 {
            rb.add_input(A, Tick(t), vec![2], &mut step).unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(rb.state().pos[&A], 6); // rolled back from predicted 0s
        for t in 3..20 {
            rb.add_input(A, Tick(t), vec![1], &mut step).unwrap();
            rb.advance(&mut step).unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(rb.current_tick(), Tick(20));
        assert_eq!(
            rb.add_input(A, Tick(2), vec![1], &mut step),
            Err(RollbackError::TooOld(2))
        );
        assert!(!rb.hashes().is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn replay_reproduces_hashes() {
        let mut rb = Rollback::new(
            RollbackConfig {
                hash_every: 5,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            vec![A, B],
            world(),
        );
        let mut journal = Journal::default();
        for t in 0..40u32 {
            let da = vec![(t % 3) as u8];
            let db = vec![if t % 7 == 0 { 255 } else { 1 }];
            rb.add_input(A, Tick(t), da.clone(), &mut step).unwrap();
            journal.record(Tick(t), A, da);
            if t % 2 == 0 {
                // B's input sometimes arrives one tick late
                rb.add_input(B, Tick(t), db.clone(), &mut step).unwrap();
            }
            journal.record(Tick(t), B, db.clone());
            rb.advance(&mut step).unwrap();
            if t % 2 == 1 {
                // B's odd-tick input arrives one tick late (after we already predicted it)
                rb.add_input(B, Tick(t), db, &mut step).unwrap();
            }
        }
        let live = rb.state().clone();
        let rep = journal.into_replay(1, "h".into(), 60, vec![A, B], 5);
        let (replayed, hashes) = replay(world(), &rep, step);
        assert_eq!(replayed, live);
        assert_eq!(hashes.last().unwrap().1, live.state_hash());
        let live_hashes = rb.hashes();
        for (t, h) in live_hashes {
            if let Some((_, rh)) = hashes.iter().find(|(rt, _)| rt == t) {
                assert_eq!(h, rh, "tick {t}");
            }
        }
        assert!(rb.rollbacks > 0);
    }
}

`crates/net-rooms/src/event.rs`:

```rs
//! Binary event frame carried on the data path (relay mode).
//!
//! ```text
//! u8   code          application event code (0..=255)
//! u8   flags         bit0..1 target kind, bit2 cache-add, bit3 cache-remove, bit4 has-group
//! u16  from          actor id (server fills in; clients send 0)
//! [u16 group]        when has-group
//! [u16 n, n x u16]   explicit actor list when target kind == 3
//! bytes payload
//! ```

use bytes::{Buf, BufMut, Bytes, BytesMut};
use net_common::ActorId;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case", tag = "kind", content = "actors")]
pub enum EventTarget {
    /// Everyone including the sender.
    All,
    /// Everyone except the sender.
    Others,
    /// The master client only.
    Master,
    /// Explicit list.
    Actors(Vec<ActorId>),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum CacheOp {
    #[default]
    None,
    /// Store so late joiners receive it.
    Add,
    /// Remove previously cached events with the same code from this sender.
    Remove,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct EventFrame {
    pub code: u8,
    pub target: EventTarget,
    pub cache: CacheOp,
    pub group: Option<u16>,
    pub from: ActorId,
    pub payload: Bytes,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FrameError {
    #[error("frame too short")]
    TooShort,
    #[error("bad target kind")]
    Target,
}

impl EventFrame {
    pub fn encode(&self) -> Bytes {
        let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(8 + self.payload.len());
        b.put_u8(self.code);
        let kind = match self.target {
            EventTarget::All => 0,
            EventTarget::Others => 1,
            EventTarget::Master => 2,
            EventTarget::Actors(_) => 3,
        };
        let mut flags = kind;
        match self.cache {
            CacheOp::None => {}
            CacheOp::Add => flags |= 0x04,
            CacheOp::Remove => flags |= 0x08,
        }
        if self.group.is_some() {
            flags |= 0x10;
        }
        b.put_u8(flags);
        b.put_u16(self.from.0);
        if let Some(g) = self.group {
            b.put_u16(g);
        }
        if let EventTarget::Actors(a) = &self.target {
            b.put_u16(a.len().min(u16::MAX as usize) as u16);
            for x in a.iter().take(u16::MAX as usize) {
                b.put_u16(x.0);
            }
        }
        b.extend_from_slice(&self.payload);
        b.freeze()
    }

    pub fn decode(mut data: Bytes) -> Result<Self, FrameError> {
        if data.len() < 4 {
            return Err(FrameError::TooShort);
        }
        let code = data.get_u8();
        let flags = data.get_u8();
        let from = ActorId(data.get_u16());
        let group = if flags & 0x10 != 0 {
            if data.len() < 2 {
                return Err(FrameError::TooShort);
            }
            Some(data.get_u16())
        } else {
            None
        };
        let target = match flags & 0x03 {
            0 => EventTarget::All,
            1 => EventTarget::Others,
            2 => EventTarget::Master,
            _ => {
                if data.len() < 2 {
                    return Err(FrameError::TooShort);
                }
                let n = data.get_u16() as usize;
                if data.len() < n * 2 {
                    return Err(FrameError::TooShort);
                }
                EventTarget::Actors((0..n).map(|_| ActorId(data.get_u16())).collect())
            }
        };
        let cache = if flags & 0x04 != 0 {
            CacheOp::Add
        } else if flags & 0x08 != 0 {
            CacheOp::Remove
        } else {
            CacheOp::None
        };
        if flags & 0x03 == 3 && matches!(target, EventTarget::Actors(_)) {
            // fine
        }
        Ok(Self {
            code,
            target,
            cache,
            group,
            from,
            payload: data,
        })
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn roundtrip_all_shapes() {
        for (t, g, c) in [
            (EventTarget::All, None, CacheOp::None),
            (EventTarget::Others, Some(3), CacheOp::Add),
            (EventTarget::Master, None, CacheOp::Remove),
            (
                EventTarget::Actors(vec![ActorId(1), ActorId(9)]),
                Some(0),
                CacheOp::None,
            ),
        ] {
            let f = EventFrame {
                code: 42,
                target: t,
                cache: c,
                group: g,
                from: ActorId(5),
                payload: Bytes::from_static(b"payload"),
            };
            assert_eq!(EventFrame::decode(f.encode()).unwrap(), f);
        }
    }
}

//! Control-channel messages (JSON over WebSocket). Field names are short on purpose.

use crate::event::{CacheOp, EventTarget};
use net_common::{ActorId, Channel, RoomMode};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(tag = "t", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ClientMsg {
    /// First message: the join grant issued by the developer's backend.
    Auth {
        grant: String,
    },
    Create {
        name: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        mode: RoomMode,
        #[serde(default)]
        max_players: Option<u16>,
        #[serde(default = "default_true")]
        visible: bool,
        #[serde(default = "default_true")]
        open: bool,
        #[serde(default)]
        props: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
        /// Property keys visible in lobby listings.
        #[serde(default)]
        lobby_props: Vec<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        region: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        player_props: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
    },
    Join {
        name: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        player_props: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
        /// Reconnect into the same actor slot.
        #[serde(default)]
        rejoin_actor: Option<ActorId>,
        /// Sync rooms: the client's compiled schema hash; mismatch is refused.
        #[serde(default)]
        schema_hash: Option<String>,
        /// Watch only: not counted against max_players, never master, cannot send events or
        /// inputs; sync sends the whole world, lockstep delays the input stream.
        #[serde(default)]
        spectator: bool,
    },
    /// Join by name, create with these settings if absent.
    JoinOrCreate {
        name: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        mode: RoomMode,
        #[serde(default)]
        max_players: Option<u16>,
        #[serde(default)]
        props: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
        #[serde(default)]
        lobby_props: Vec<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        region: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        player_props: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
        /// Player ids whose slots are held for 60 s when this call creates the room (party join).
        #[serde(default)]
        reserved: Vec<String>,
    },
    /// Any open, visible room with a free slot, optionally filtered by lobby props.
    JoinRandom {
        #[serde(default)]
        filter: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
        #[serde(default)]
        player_props: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
        /// SQL-like condition on the room's lobby props (`map = 'dust' AND rank_min <= 1400`).
        #[serde(default)]
        expr: Option<String>,
        /// `fill` (default: most players first), `serial` (fewest players first), `random`.
        #[serde(default)]
        match_type: Option<String>,
    },
    Leave,
    SetRoomProps {
        props: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
        /// Only apply if the current values match (compare-and-swap).
        #[serde(default)]
        expected: Option<serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>>,
        #[serde(default)]
        visible: Option<bool>,
        #[serde(default)]
        open: Option<bool>,
    },
    SetPlayerProps {
        props: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
        #[serde(default)]
        expected: Option<serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>>,
    },
    /// Event via the control channel (also available as a binary frame on the data path).
    Event {
        code: u8,
        /// base64 payload
        data: String,
        #[serde(default = "default_target")]
        target: EventTarget,
        #[serde(default = "default_channel")]
        channel: Channel,
        #[serde(default)]
        cache: CacheOp,
        #[serde(default)]
        group: Option<u16>,
    },
    SetGroups {
        #[serde(default)]
        join: Vec<u16>,
        #[serde(default)]
        leave: Vec<u16>,
    },
    /// Relay event cache slices (cache slice index): events cached from now on belong to the
    /// current slice; `increase` opens a new one, `set` picks `index`, `purge` drops the events of
    /// slice `index`, `purge_up_to` drops every slice <= `index`. Late joiners get all remaining
    /// slices in order.
    CacheSlice {
        op: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        index: Option<u16>,
    },
    /// Sync rooms: steer area-of-interest for this client — extra viewpoints (camera, scope
    /// target; the avatar stays the first one) and entities forced into view regardless of
    /// distance (team mates, objectives). Entity ids as in deltas (u64).
    SetView {
        #[serde(default)]
        viewpoints: Vec<u64>,
        #[serde(default)]
        interest: Vec<u64>,
    },
    SetMaster {
        actor: ActorId,
    },
    Kick {
        actor: ActorId,
        #[serde(default)]
        reason: String,
    },
    Lobby {
        subscribe: bool,
    },
    /// Project-wide live room/player counts grouped by the room prop `lobby`.
    Stats,
    /// Presence of up to 64 players of this project across the fleet (online, current room).
    FindFriends {
        players: Vec<String>,
    },
    /// Call into the game's backend through the node (WebRPC): the project's webhook
    /// subscribed to `rpc` is POSTed `{name, player_id, actor?, room?, body}` and its JSON
    /// answer comes back as `rpc_result{id}`. Body ≤ 8 KiB, 5 calls per second per session.
    /// One-shot room list (SQL-lobby style): open, visible rooms with a free
    /// slot, optionally filtered by a SQL-like condition on lobby props, newest first, ≤ `limit`
    /// (default 100). For a live view subscribe with `lobby`.
    GetRooms {
        #[serde(default)]
        expr: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        limit: Option<u16>,
    },
    Rpc {
        id: u32,
        name: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        body: serde_json::Value,
    },
    Ping {
        #[serde(default)]
        ts: u64,
    },
}

fn default_true() -> bool {
    true
}
fn default_target() -> EventTarget {
    EventTarget::Others
}
fn default_channel() -> Channel {
    Channel::ReliableOrdered
}
