```rs
//! One relay-mode room. Returns the messages to deliver instead of sending them.

use crate::event::{CacheOp, EventFrame, EventTarget};
use crate::protocol::{PlayerInfo, RoomSummary, ServerMsg};
use net_common::{ActorId, Channel, ProjectId, RoomId, RoomMode};
use serde_json::{Map, Value};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap, HashSet, VecDeque};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct RoomConfig {
    pub id: RoomId,
    pub project: ProjectId,
    pub name: String,
    pub mode: RoomMode,
    pub max_players: u16,
    pub visible: bool,
    pub open: bool,
    pub props: Map<String, Value>,
    pub lobby_props: Vec<String>,
    /// Player ids with a held slot (a party arriving together); others cannot take those slots
    /// until `reserved_until` passes.
    pub reserved: Vec<String>,
    pub reserved_until: Option<Instant>,
    /// Drop a player's cached events when they leave for good (room prop `cleanup_cache_on_leave`,
    /// default true); false keeps them for late joiners, the "keep the cache on leave" behaviour.
    pub cleanup_cache_on_leave: bool,
    pub max_events_per_sec: u32,
    /// Events one player may send per second (burst = 2 s worth).
    pub max_events_per_sec_per_player: u32,
    pub max_event_bytes: usize,
    pub max_props_bytes: usize,
    pub max_player_props_bytes: usize,
    pub max_cached_events: usize,
    /// How long an offline player keeps their slot before it is freed.
    pub offline_ttl: Duration,
    /// Close the room this long after the last player leaves.
    pub empty_ttl: Duration,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Player {
    pub actor: ActorId,
    pub player_id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub props: Map<String, Value>,
    pub online: bool,
    pub offline_since: Option<Instant>,
    pub groups: HashSet<u16>,
    pub spectator: bool,
    tokens: f64,
    last_refill: Instant,
    joined_at: Instant,
    events_in: u64,
    bytes_in: u64,
    last_event: Option<Instant>,
    /// One-second window for the live events/s figure shown in the console.
    win_start: Instant,
    win_count: u32,
    eps: f32,
}

/// Live per-player counters for the operator console (not persisted, reset on rehost).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]
pub struct PlayerStats {
    pub actor: ActorId,
    pub events: u64,
    pub bytes_in: u64,
    pub eps: f32,
    pub idle_secs: Option<f32>,
    pub since_secs: f32,
}

impl Player {
    fn count_event(&mut self, bytes: usize, now: Instant) {
        self.events_in += 1;
        self.bytes_in += bytes as u64;
        self.last_event = Some(now);
        let w = now.duration_since(self.win_start).as_secs_f32();
        if w >= 1.0 {
            self.eps = self.win_count as f32 / w;
            self.win_start = now;
            self.win_count = 0;
        }
        self.win_count += 1;
    }

    fn stats(&self, now: Instant) -> PlayerStats {
        let w = now.duration_since(self.win_start).as_secs_f32();
        // A window older than 2 s without a refresh means the player went quiet.
        let eps = if w > 2.0 { 0.0 } else { self.eps };
        PlayerStats {
            actor: self.actor,
            events: self.events_in,
            bytes_in: self.bytes_in,
            eps,
            idle_secs: self.last_event.map(|t| now.duration_since(t).as_secs_f32()),
            since_secs: now.duration_since(self.joined_at).as_secs_f32(),
        }
    }

    fn info(&self) -> PlayerInfo {
        PlayerInfo {
            actor: self.actor,
            player_id: self.player_id.clone(),
            name: self.name.clone(),
            props: self.props.clone(),
            online: self.online,
            spectator: self.spectator,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
#[allow(clippy::large_enum_variant)]
pub enum Outgoing {
    /// Control-channel message to one actor.
    Control(ActorId, ServerMsg),
    /// Data-path event frame to one actor on a channel.
    Data(ActorId, Channel, EventFrame),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum RoomError {
    #[error("room is full")]
    Full,
    #[error("room is closed")]
    Closed,
    #[error("not in room")]
    NotMember,
    #[error("only the master client may do this")]
    NotMaster,
    #[error("event too large")]
    EventTooLarge,
    #[error("too many events per second")]
    EventRate,
    #[error("you send too many events per second")]
    PlayerEventRate,
    #[error("spectators cannot send")]
    Spectator,
    #[error("properties too large")]
    PropsTooLarge,
    #[error("expected values did not match")]
    CasFailed,
    #[error("no such actor")]
    NoActor,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct CachedEvent {
    code: u8,
    from: ActorId,
    payload: bytes::Bytes,
    slice: u16,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum CacheSliceOp {
    Increase,
    Set(u16),
    Purge(u16),
    PurgeUpTo(u16),
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Room {
    pub cfg: RoomConfig,
    players: BTreeMap<ActorId, Player>,
    master: Option<ActorId>,
    next_actor: u16,
    cache: VecDeque<CachedEvent>,
    /// Slice newly cached events are stamped with (see `ClientMsg::CacheSlice`).
    cache_slice: u16,
    /// Token bucket for events.
    tokens: f64,
    last_refill: Instant,
    pub created: Instant,
    empty_since: Option<Instant>,
    /// Map player_id -> actor for rejoin.
    by_player: HashMap<String, ActorId>,
}

impl Room {
    pub fn new(cfg: RoomConfig, now: Instant) -> Self {
        let tokens = cfg.max_events_per_sec as f64;
        Self {
            cfg,
            players: BTreeMap::new(),
            master: None,
            next_actor: 1,
            cache: VecDeque::new(),
            cache_slice: 0,
            tokens,
            last_refill: now,
            created: now,
            empty_since: Some(now),
            by_player: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn id(&self) -> RoomId {
        self.cfg.id
    }
    pub fn master(&self) -> Option<ActorId> {
        self.master
    }
    pub fn players(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Player> {
        self.players.values()
    }
    pub fn player(&self, a: ActorId) -> Option<&Player> {
        self.players.get(&a)
    }
    /// Actor of `player_id` if that player is currently online in this room.
    pub fn online_actor(&self, player_id: &str) -> Option<ActorId> {
        self.by_player
            .get(player_id)
            .copied()
            .filter(|a| self.players.get(a).is_some_and(|p| p.online))
    }

    /// Players counted against `max_players` (spectators excluded).
    pub fn player_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.players.values().filter(|p| !p.spectator).count()
    }

    pub fn online_count(&self) -> u16 {
        self.players.values().filter(|p| p.online).count() as u16
    }
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.players.is_empty()
    }

    /// System notice to every online player; returns the frames and how many players get it.
    pub fn notice(&self, text: &str, level: &str) -> (Vec<Outgoing>, usize) {
        let out: Vec<Outgoing> = self
            .players
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, p)| p.online)
            .map(|(a, _)| {
                Outgoing::Control(
                    *a,
                    ServerMsg::Notice {
                        text: text.to_string(),
                        level: level.to_string(),
                    },
                )
            })
            .collect();
        let n = out.len();
        (out, n)
    }

    pub fn summary(&self) -> RoomSummary {
        let props = self
            .cfg
            .props
            .iter()
            .filter(|(k, _)| k.as_str() == "lobby" || self.cfg.lobby_props.iter().any(|l| l == *k))
            .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone()))
            .collect();
        RoomSummary {
            id: self.cfg.id.to_string(),
            name: self.cfg.name.clone(),
            mode: self.cfg.mode,
            players: self.players.len() as u16,
            max_players: self.cfg.max_players,
            open: self.cfg.open && self.player_count() < self.cfg.max_players as usize,
            props,
        }
    }

    /// Reserved slots whose player has not arrived yet (0 once the hold expired).
    pub fn pending_reserved(&self, now: Instant) -> usize {
        if !self.cfg.reserved_until.is_some_and(|u| now < u) {
            return 0;
        }
        self.cfg
            .reserved
            .iter()
            .filter(|r| !self.by_player.contains_key(r.as_str()))
            .count()
    }

    pub fn is_listed(&self) -> bool {
        self.cfg.visible && self.cfg.open && self.player_count() < self.cfg.max_players as usize
    }

    /// Admits a player. Returns the actor id, the player list to send them, cached events,
    /// and notifications for everyone else.
    pub fn join(
        &mut self,
        player_id: &str,
        name: &str,
        props: Map<String, Value>,
        rejoin: Option<ActorId>,
        spectator: bool,
        now: Instant,
    ) -> Result<(ActorId, Vec<Outgoing>), RoomError> {
        if props_len(&props) > self.cfg.max_player_props_bytes {
            return Err(RoomError::PropsTooLarge);
        }
        // Reconnect into the existing slot. If the player is still online from another
        // session, the new session takes the slot over (the caller tells the old one).
        if let Some(&a) = self.by_player.get(player_id) {
            if let Some(p) = self.players.get_mut(&a) {
                if rejoin.is_some_and(|r| r != a) {
                    return Err(RoomError::NoActor);
                }
                let was_online = p.online;
                let spec = p.spectator;
                p.online = true;
                p.offline_since = None;
                p.name = name.to_string();
                if !props.is_empty() {
                    p.props = props;
                }
                let info = p.info();
                self.empty_since = None;
                if self.master.is_none() && !spec {
                    self.master = Some(a);
                }
                let out = if was_online {
                    Vec::new()
                } else {
                    self.broadcast_except(a, ServerMsg::PlayerJoined { player: info })
                };
                return Ok((a, out));
            }
        }
        if !self.cfg.open {
            return Err(RoomError::Closed);
        }
        if !spectator {
            let held = if self.cfg.reserved.iter().any(|r| r == player_id) {
                0
            } else {
                self.pending_reserved(now)
            };
            if self.player_count() + held >= self.cfg.max_players as usize {
                return Err(RoomError::Full);
            }
        }
        let actor = ActorId(self.next_actor);
        self.next_actor = self.next_actor.wrapping_add(1).max(1);
        let p = Player {
            actor,
            player_id: player_id.to_string(),
            name: name.to_string(),
            props,
            online: true,
            offline_since: None,
            groups: HashSet::new(),
            spectator,
            tokens: 2.0 * self.cfg.max_events_per_sec_per_player as f64,
            last_refill: now,
            joined_at: now,
            events_in: 0,
            bytes_in: 0,
            last_event: None,
            win_start: now,
            win_count: 0,
            eps: 0.0,
        };
        let info = p.info();
        self.players.insert(actor, p);
        self.by_player.insert(player_id.to_string(), actor);
        self.empty_since = None;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        if self.master.is_none() && !spectator {
            self.master = Some(actor);
        }
        out.extend(self.broadcast_except(actor, ServerMsg::PlayerJoined { player: info }));
        Ok((actor, out))
    }

    /// Re-host: recreates the players of a checkpointed room as offline slots so they get
    /// their old actor ids back when they reconnect (`offline_ttl` applies from `now`).
    pub fn restore_offline(
        &mut self,
        players: Vec<(ActorId, String, String)>,
        master: Option<ActorId>,
        now: Instant,
    ) {
        for (actor, player_id, name) in players {
            if self.players.contains_key(&actor) || self.by_player.contains_key(&player_id) {
                continue;
            }
            self.players.insert(
                actor,
                Player {
                    actor,
                    player_id: player_id.clone(),
                    name,
                    props: Map::new(),
                    online: false,
                    offline_since: Some(now),
                    groups: HashSet::new(),
                    spectator: false,
                    tokens: 2.0 * self.cfg.max_events_per_sec_per_player as f64,
                    last_refill: now,
                    joined_at: now,
                    events_in: 0,
                    bytes_in: 0,
                    last_event: None,
                    win_start: now,
                    win_count: 0,
                    eps: 0.0,
                },
            );
            self.by_player.insert(player_id, actor);
            self.next_actor = self.next_actor.max(actor.0.wrapping_add(1).max(1));
        }
        if let Some(m) = master.filter(|m| self.players.contains_key(m)) {
            self.master = Some(m);
        }
        self.empty_since = Some(now);
    }

    pub fn player_infos(&self) -> Vec<PlayerInfo> {
        self.players.values().map(|p| p.info()).collect()
    }

    /// Counts a simulation input (sync/lockstep) that bypasses `raise_event`, so the live
    /// per-player figures cover every mode.
    pub fn count_input(&mut self, actor: ActorId, bytes: usize, now: Instant) {
        if let Some(p) = self.players.get_mut(&actor) {
            p.count_event(bytes, now);
        }
    }

    pub fn player_stats(&self, now: Instant) -> Vec<PlayerStats> {
        self.players.values().map(|p| p.stats(now)).collect()
    }

    /// Current cache slice index.
    pub fn cache_slice(&self) -> u16 {
        self.cache_slice
    }

    /// `increase` / `set` move the slice new cached events go to; `purge` drops one slice,
    /// `purge_up_to` every slice up to and including `index`. Returns cached events left.
    pub fn cache_slice_op(&mut self, op: CacheSliceOp) -> usize {
        match op {
            CacheSliceOp::Increase => self.cache_slice = self.cache_slice.wrapping_add(1),
            CacheSliceOp::Set(i) => self.cache_slice = i,
            CacheSliceOp::Purge(i) => self.cache.retain(|c| c.slice != i),
            CacheSliceOp::PurgeUpTo(i) => self.cache.retain(|c| c.slice > i),
        }
        self.cache.len()
    }

    pub fn cached_for_join(&self) -> Vec<(u8, ActorId, String)> {
        use base64::Engine;
        self.cache
            .iter()
            .map(|c| {
                (
                    c.code,
                    c.from,
                    base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&c.payload),
                )
            })
            .collect()
    }

    /// `offline = true` keeps the slot for `offline_ttl` so the player can rejoin.
    pub fn leave(&mut self, actor: ActorId, offline: bool, now: Instant) -> Vec<Outgoing> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        if offline {
            let Some(p) = self.players.get_mut(&actor) else {
                return out;
            };
            p.online = false;
            p.offline_since = Some(now);
            out.extend(self.broadcast_except(
                actor,
                ServerMsg::PlayerLeft {
                    actor,
                    offline: true,
                },
            ));
        } else {
            let Some(p) = self.players.remove(&actor) else {
                return out;
            };
            self.by_player.remove(&p.player_id);
            if self.cfg.cleanup_cache_on_leave {
                self.cache.retain(|c| c.from != actor);
            }
            out.extend(self.broadcast_except(
                actor,
                ServerMsg::PlayerLeft {
                    actor,
                    offline: false,
                },
            ));
        }
        if self.master == Some(actor) {
            // Oldest online (non-spectator) player becomes master.
            self.master = self
                .players
                .values()
                .filter(|p| p.online && !p.spectator)
                .map(|p| p.actor)
                .min()
                .or_else(|| {
                    self.players
                        .values()
                        .filter(|p| !p.spectator)
                        .map(|p| p.actor)
                        .min()
                });
            if let Some(m) = self.master {
                out.extend(self.broadcast_all(ServerMsg::MasterChanged { actor: m }));
            }
        }
        if self.players.is_empty() {
            self.empty_since = Some(now);
        }
        out
    }

    /// Frees slots of players offline longer than `offline_ttl`. Returns notifications.
    pub fn expire(&mut self, now: Instant) -> Vec<Outgoing> {
        let gone: Vec<ActorId> = self
            .players
            .values()
            .filter(|p| {
                !p.online
                    && p.offline_since
                        .is_some_and(|t| now.duration_since(t) >= self.cfg.offline_ttl)
            })
            .map(|p| p.actor)
            .collect();
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for a in gone {
            out.extend(self.leave(a, false, now));
        }
        out
    }

    pub fn should_close(&self, now: Instant) -> bool {
        self.players.is_empty()
            && self
                .empty_since
                .is_some_and(|t| now.duration_since(t) >= self.cfg.empty_ttl)
    }

    pub fn set_room_props(
        &mut self,
        by: ActorId,
        props: Map<String, Value>,
        expected: Option<&Map<String, Value>>,
        visible: Option<bool>,
        open: Option<bool>,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Outgoing>, RoomError> {
        if !self.players.contains_key(&by) {
            return Err(RoomError::NotMember);
        }
        if let Some(exp) = expected {
            for (k, v) in exp {
                if self.cfg.props.get(k).unwrap_or(&Value::Null) != v {
                    return Err(RoomError::CasFailed);
                }
            }
        }
        let mut merged = self.cfg.props.clone();
        merge_props(&mut merged, props);
        if props_len(&merged) > self.cfg.max_props_bytes {
            return Err(RoomError::PropsTooLarge);
        }
        self.cfg.props = merged;
        if let Some(v) = visible {
            self.cfg.visible = v;
        }
        if let Some(o) = open {
            self.cfg.open = o;
        }
        Ok(self.broadcast_all(ServerMsg::RoomProps {
            props: self.cfg.props.clone(),
            by: Some(by),
            visible: self.cfg.visible,
            open: self.cfg.open,
        }))
    }

    pub fn set_player_props(
        &mut self,
        actor: ActorId,
        props: Map<String, Value>,
        expected: Option<&Map<String, Value>>,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Outgoing>, RoomError> {
        let p = self.players.get_mut(&actor).ok_or(RoomError::NotMember)?;
        if let Some(exp) = expected {
            for (k, v) in exp {
                if p.props.get(k).unwrap_or(&Value::Null) != v {
                    return Err(RoomError::CasFailed);
                }
            }
        }
        let mut merged = p.props.clone();
        merge_props(&mut merged, props);
        if props_len(&merged) > self.cfg.max_player_props_bytes {
            return Err(RoomError::PropsTooLarge);
        }
        p.props = merged;
        let props = p.props.clone();
        Ok(self.broadcast_all(ServerMsg::PlayerProps { actor, props }))
    }

    pub fn set_groups(
        &mut self,
        actor: ActorId,
        join: &[u16],
        leave: &[u16],
    ) -> Result<(), RoomError> {
        let p = self.players.get_mut(&actor).ok_or(RoomError::NotMember)?;
        for g in leave {
            p.groups.remove(g);
        }
        for g in join {
            p.groups.insert(*g);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn set_master(&mut self, by: ActorId, target: ActorId) -> Result<Vec<Outgoing>, RoomError> {
        if self.master != Some(by) {
            return Err(RoomError::NotMaster);
        }
        if !self.players.contains_key(&target) {
            return Err(RoomError::NoActor);
        }
        self.master = Some(target);
        Ok(self.broadcast_all(ServerMsg::MasterChanged { actor: target }))
    }

    pub fn kick(
        &mut self,
        by: ActorId,
        target: ActorId,
        reason: &str,
        now: Instant,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Outgoing>, RoomError> {
        if self.master != Some(by) {
            return Err(RoomError::NotMaster);
        }
        self.admin_kick(target, reason, now)
    }

    /// Kick by the operator/project backend: no master check, same `left{reason}` to the target.
    pub fn admin_kick(
        &mut self,
        target: ActorId,
        reason: &str,
        now: Instant,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Outgoing>, RoomError> {
        if !self.players.contains_key(&target) {
            return Err(RoomError::NoActor);
        }
        let mut out = vec![Outgoing::Control(
            target,
            ServerMsg::Left {
                reason: if reason.is_empty() {
                    "kicked".into()
                } else {
                    reason.into()
                },
            },
        )];
        out.extend(self.leave(target, false, now));
        Ok(out)
    }

    fn refill(&mut self, now: Instant) {
        let dt = now.duration_since(self.last_refill).as_secs_f64();
        self.last_refill = now;
        let max = self.cfg.max_events_per_sec as f64;
        self.tokens = (self.tokens + dt * max).min(max);
    }

    /// Routes an event from `from`. `frame.from` is overwritten with the real sender.
    pub fn raise_event(
        &mut self,
        from: ActorId,
        mut frame: EventFrame,
        channel: Channel,
        now: Instant,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Outgoing>, RoomError> {
        if !self.players.get(&from).is_some_and(|p| p.online) {
            return Err(RoomError::NotMember);
        }
        if self.players[&from].spectator {
            return Err(RoomError::Spectator);
        }
        if frame.payload.len() > self.cfg.max_event_bytes {
            return Err(RoomError::EventTooLarge);
        }
        self.refill(now);
        if self.tokens < 1.0 {
            return Err(RoomError::EventRate);
        }
        {
            let rate = self.cfg.max_events_per_sec_per_player as f64;
            let p = self.players.get_mut(&from).unwrap();
            let dt = now.duration_since(p.last_refill).as_secs_f64();
            p.last_refill = now;
            p.tokens = (p.tokens + dt * rate).min(2.0 * rate);
            if p.tokens < 1.0 {
                return Err(RoomError::PlayerEventRate);
            }
            p.tokens -= 1.0;
            p.count_event(frame.payload.len(), now);
        }
        self.tokens -= 1.0;
        frame.from = from;

        match frame.cache {
            CacheOp::Add => {
                if self.cache.len() >= self.cfg.max_cached_events {
                    self.cache.pop_front();
                }
                self.cache.push_back(CachedEvent {
                    code: frame.code,
                    from,
                    payload: frame.payload.clone(),
                    slice: self.cache_slice,
                });
            }
            CacheOp::Remove => {
                self.cache
                    .retain(|c| !(c.from == from && c.code == frame.code));
            }
            CacheOp::None => {}
        }

        let targets: Vec<ActorId> = match &frame.target {
            EventTarget::All => self
                .players
                .values()
                .filter(|p| p.online)
                .map(|p| p.actor)
                .collect(),
            EventTarget::Others => self
                .players
                .values()
                .filter(|p| p.online && p.actor != from)
                .map(|p| p.actor)
                .collect(),
            EventTarget::Master => self.master.into_iter().collect(),
            EventTarget::Actors(list) => list
                .iter()
                .copied()
                .filter(|a| self.players.get(a).is_some_and(|p| p.online))
                .collect(),
        };
        let group = frame.group;
        let out = targets
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|a| match group {
                None => true,
                Some(g) => self.players.get(a).is_some_and(|p| p.groups.contains(&g)),
            })
            .map(|a| Outgoing::Data(a, channel, frame.clone()))
            .collect();
        Ok(out)
    }

    fn broadcast_all(&self, msg: ServerMsg) -> Vec<Outgoing> {
        self.players
            .values()
            .filter(|p| p.online)
            .map(|p| Outgoing::Control(p.actor, msg.clone()))
            .collect()
    }

    fn broadcast_except(&self, except: ActorId, msg: ServerMsg) -> Vec<Outgoing> {
        self.players
            .values()
            .filter(|p| p.online && p.actor != except)
            .map(|p| Outgoing::Control(p.actor, msg.clone()))
            .collect()
    }
}

/// `null` deletes a key, everything else overwrites.
pub fn merge_props(into: &mut Map<String, Value>, from: Map<String, Value>) {
    for (k, v) in from {
        if v.is_null() {
            into.remove(&k);
        } else {
            into.insert(k, v);
        }
    }
}

pub fn props_len(p: &Map<String, Value>) -> usize {
    serde_json::to_vec(p).map(|v| v.len()).unwrap_or(usize::MAX)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use bytes::Bytes;

    fn cfg() -> RoomConfig {
        RoomConfig {
            id: RoomId::new(),
            project: ProjectId::new(),
            name: "r".into(),
            mode: RoomMode::Relay,
            max_players: 2,
            visible: true,
            open: true,
            props: Map::new(),
            lobby_props: vec!["map".into()],
            reserved: Vec::new(),
            reserved_until: None,
            cleanup_cache_on_leave: true,
            max_events_per_sec: 4,
            max_events_per_sec_per_player: 3,
            max_event_bytes: 100,
            max_props_bytes: 200,
            max_player_props_bytes: 200,
            max_cached_events: 2,
            offline_ttl: Duration::from_secs(10),
            empty_ttl: Duration::from_secs(5),
        }
    }

    fn ev(code: u8, target: EventTarget, cache: CacheOp) -> EventFrame {
        EventFrame {
            code,
            target,
            cache,
            group: None,
            from: ActorId(0),
            payload: Bytes::from_static(b"x"),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn join_full_master_rotation() {
        let t = Instant::now();
        let mut r = Room::new(cfg(), t);
        let (a, out) = r.join("p1", "A", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        assert!(out.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(r.master(), Some(a));
        let (b, out) = r.join("p2", "B", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(
            r.join("p3", "C", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap_err(),
            RoomError::Full
        );
        // same player again: takes over the slot silently
        let (b2, out) = r.join("p2", "B", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((b2, out.len()), (b, 0));
        let out = r.leave(a, false, t);
        assert!(out.contains(&Outgoing::Control(b, ServerMsg::MasterChanged { actor: b })));
        assert_eq!(r.master(), Some(b));
    }

    #[test]
    fn offline_rejoin_keeps_actor_then_expires() {
        let t = Instant::now();
        let mut r = Room::new(cfg(), t);
        let (a, _) = r.join("p1", "A", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        r.leave(a, true, t);
        assert_eq!(r.online_count(), 0);
        let (a2, _) = r
            .join(
                "p1",
                "A",
                Map::new(),
                None,
                false,
                t + Duration::from_secs(1),
            )
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(a, a2);
        r.leave(a, true, t);
        assert!(r.expire(t + Duration::from_secs(5)).is_empty());
        r.expire(t + Duration::from_secs(11));
        assert!(r.is_empty());
        assert!(r.should_close(t + Duration::from_secs(17)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn events_targets_groups_cache_rate() {
        let t = Instant::now();
        let mut c = cfg();
        c.max_players = 3;
        let mut r = Room::new(c, t);
        let (a, _) = r.join("p1", "A", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        let (b, _) = r.join("p2", "B", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        let (cc, _) = r.join("p3", "C", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        let out = r
            .raise_event(
                a,
                ev(1, EventTarget::Others, CacheOp::Add),
                Channel::ReliableOrdered,
                t,
            )
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.len(), 2);
        assert!(
            matches!(&out[0], Outgoing::Data(x, Channel::ReliableOrdered, f) if *x == b && f.from == a)
        );
        let out = r
            .raise_event(
                b,
                ev(2, EventTarget::Master, CacheOp::None),
                Channel::UnreliableSequenced,
                t,
            )
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.len(), 1);
        assert!(matches!(&out[0], Outgoing::Data(x, _, _) if *x == a));
        r.set_groups(cc, &[7], &[]).unwrap();
        let mut g = ev(3, EventTarget::All, CacheOp::None);
        g.group = Some(7);
        let out = r.raise_event(a, g, Channel::ReliableOrdered, t).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.len(), 1);
        assert!(matches!(&out[0], Outgoing::Data(x, _, _) if *x == cc));
        // cache: Add kept, Remove drops, bounded at 2
        r.raise_event(
            a,
            ev(4, EventTarget::All, CacheOp::Add),
            Channel::ReliableOrdered,
            t,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.cached_for_join().len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(
            r.raise_event(
                a,
                ev(5, EventTarget::All, CacheOp::None),
                Channel::ReliableOrdered,
                t
            )
            .unwrap_err(),
            RoomError::EventRate
        );
        let t2 = t + Duration::from_secs(1);
        r.raise_event(
            a,
            ev(1, EventTarget::All, CacheOp::Remove),
            Channel::ReliableOrdered,
            t2,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.cached_for_join().len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(r.cached_for_join()[0].0, 4);
        r.leave(a, false, t2);
        assert!(r.cached_for_join().is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn props_cas_and_size() {
        let t = Instant::now();
        let mut r = Room::new(cfg(), t);
        let (a, _) = r.join("p1", "A", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        let mut p = Map::new();
        p.insert("map".into(), Value::from("dust"));
        r.set_room_props(a, p.clone(), None, None, None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.summary().props.get("map"), Some(&Value::from("dust")));
        let mut exp = Map::new();
        exp.insert("map".into(), Value::from("other"));
        assert_eq!(
            r.set_room_props(a, p.clone(), Some(&exp), None, None)
                .unwrap_err(),
            RoomError::CasFailed
        );
        let mut big = Map::new();
        big.insert("x".into(), Value::from("y".repeat(300)));
        assert_eq!(
            r.set_player_props(a, big, None).unwrap_err(),
            RoomError::PropsTooLarge
        );
        let mut del = Map::new();
        del.insert("map".into(), Value::Null);
        r.set_room_props(a, del, None, Some(false), None).unwrap();
        assert!(r.cfg.props.is_empty());
        assert!(!r.is_listed());
    }

    #[test]
    fn spectators_do_not_take_slots_or_master_and_cannot_send() {
        let t = Instant::now();
        let mut r = Room::new(cfg(), t);
        let (s, _) = r.join("watch", "W", Map::new(), None, true, t).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.master(), None);
        let (a, _) = r.join("p1", "A", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        let (_b, _) = r.join("p2", "B", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.master(), Some(a));
        assert_eq!(
            r.join("p3", "C", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap_err(),
            RoomError::Full
        );
        assert!(r.join("watch2", "W2", Map::new(), None, true, t).is_ok());
        assert_eq!(r.player_count(), 2);
        assert_eq!(
            r.raise_event(
                s,
                ev(1, EventTarget::All, CacheOp::None),
                Channel::ReliableOrdered,
                t
            )
            .unwrap_err(),
            RoomError::Spectator
        );
        r.leave(a, false, t);
        assert_ne!(r.master(), Some(s));
    }

    #[test]
    fn reserved_slots_hold_seats_for_the_party() {
        let mut c = cfg();
        c.max_players = 2;
        c.reserved = vec!["p2".into()];
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        c.reserved_until = Some(t0 + Duration::from_secs(60));
        let mut r = Room::new(c, t0);
        r.join("p1", "p1", Map::new(), None, false, t0).unwrap();
        // the only free seat is held for p2
        assert!(matches!(
            r.join("stranger", "s", Map::new(), None, false, t0),
            Err(RoomError::Full)
        ));
        assert_eq!(r.pending_reserved(t0), 1);
        r.join("p2", "p2", Map::new(), None, false, t0).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.pending_reserved(t0), 0);
        // hold lapsed: a stranger may take an unclaimed reserved seat
        let mut c = cfg();
        c.max_players = 2;
        c.reserved = vec!["late".into()];
        c.reserved_until = Some(t0 + Duration::from_secs(60));
        let mut r = Room::new(c, t0);
        r.join("p1", "p1", Map::new(), None, false, t0).unwrap();
        let later = t0 + Duration::from_secs(61);
        r.join("stranger", "s", Map::new(), None, false, later)
            .unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn cache_slices_group_and_purge_cached_events() {
        let mut c = cfg();
        c.max_cached_events = 8;
        let t = Instant::now();
        let mut r = Room::new(c, t);
        let (a, _) = r.join("a", "a", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
        let add = |r: &mut Room, code: u8| {
            r.raise_event(
                a,
                ev(code, EventTarget::All, CacheOp::Add),
                Channel::ReliableOrdered,
                t,
            )
            .unwrap();
        };
        add(&mut r, 1);
        assert_eq!(r.cache_slice_op(CacheSliceOp::Increase), 1);
        assert_eq!(r.cache_slice(), 1);
        add(&mut r, 2);
        add(&mut r, 3);
        r.cache_slice_op(CacheSliceOp::Set(5));
        add(&mut r, 4);
        let codes = |r: &Room| r.cached_for_join().iter().map(|c| c.0).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        assert_eq!(codes(&r), vec![1, 2, 3, 4]);
        assert_eq!(r.cache_slice_op(CacheSliceOp::Purge(1)), 2);
        assert_eq!(codes(&r), vec![1, 4]);
        assert_eq!(r.cache_slice_op(CacheSliceOp::PurgeUpTo(4)), 1);
        assert_eq!(codes(&r), vec![4]);
        assert_eq!(r.cache_slice_op(CacheSliceOp::Purge(9)), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn cached_events_survive_a_leave_when_cleanup_is_off() {
        for (cleanup, left) in [(true, 0usize), (false, 1usize)] {
            let mut c = cfg();
            c.cleanup_cache_on_leave = cleanup;
            let t = Instant::now();
            let mut r = Room::new(c, t);
            let (a, _) = r.join("a", "a", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
            r.join("b", "b", Map::new(), None, false, t).unwrap();
            r.raise_event(
                a,
                ev(4, EventTarget::All, CacheOp::Add),
                Channel::ReliableOrdered,
                t,
            )
            .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(r.cached_for_join().len(), 1);
            r.leave(a, false, t);
            assert_eq!(r.cached_for_join().len(), left, "cleanup={cleanup}");
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/net-rooms/tests/garbage.rs`:

```rs
//! Attacker-facing decoders never panic on random or mutated input.
use bytes::Bytes;
use net_common::ActorId;
use net_rooms::event::{CacheOp, EventFrame, EventTarget};
fn rng(seed: u64) -> impl FnMut() -> u64 {
    let mut s = seed | 1;
    move || {
        s ^= s << 13;
        s ^= s >> 7;
        s ^= s << 17;
        s
    }
}
fn garbage(r: &mut impl FnMut() -> u64, max: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
    let n = (r() as usize) % (max + 1);
    (0..n).map(|_| r() as u8).collect()
}
#[allow(dead_code)]
fn mutate(r: &mut impl FnMut() -> u64, v: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut m = v.to_vec();
    let k = 1 + (r() % 4) as usize;
    for _ in 0..k {
        if m.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        let i = (r() as usize) % m.len();
        match r() % 3 {
            0 => m[i] ^= 1 << (r() % 8),
            1 => {
                m.remove(i);
            }
            _ => m.insert(i, r() as u8),
        }
    }
    m
}
#[test]
fn event_frame_decode_survives_garbage() {
    let mut r = rng(7);
    for _ in 0..20_000 {
        let _ = EventFrame::decode(Bytes::from(garbage(&mut r, 64)));
    }
}
#[test]
fn event_frame_roundtrip_then_mutations() {
    let mut r = rng(9);
    for i in 0..2_000u32 {
        let f = EventFrame {
            code: i as u8,
            target: EventTarget::Others,
            cache: CacheOp::None,
            group: if i.is_multiple_of(3) {
                Some(i as u16)
            } else {
                None
            },
            from: ActorId((i % 7) as u16),
            payload: Bytes::from(garbage(&mut r, 40)),
        };
        let enc = f.encode();
        let back = EventFrame::decode(enc.clone()).expect("own encoding decodes");
        assert_eq!((back.code, back.from), (f.code, f.from));
        for _ in 0..5 {
            let _ = EventFrame::decode(Bytes::from(mutate(&mut r, &enc)));
        }
    }
}
```

```toml
futures = { workspace = true }
uuid = { workspace = true }
mimalloc = "0.1"
```

`crates/net-server/src/main.rs`:

```rs
use clap::Parser;
use net_api::rest;
use net_api::state::AppState;
use net_auth::GrantSigner;
use net_common::config::RedisConfig;
use net_common::{NetConfig, NodeId, RegionId};
use net_control::{NodeRegistry, RedisStore};
use net_db::queries::{self, NodeHeartbeat};
use net_rooms::protocol::ServerMsg;
use net_transport::quic;
use net_transport::TicketSigner;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;
use tracing::{error, info, warn};

/// glibc malloc keeps per-thread arenas at their high-water mark (RSS kept climbing by tens of MB
/// per batch of referee desyncs with nothing leaked); mimalloc returns freed pages to the OS.
#[global_allocator]
static GLOBAL: mimalloc::MiMalloc = mimalloc::MiMalloc;

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "aurix-net-server", version, about = "Aurix Net node")]
struct Cli {
    /// TOML config layered over built-in defaults; env NET__SECTION__KEY overrides both.
    #[arg(short, long)]
    config: Option<String>,
    #[arg(long)]
    migrate_only: bool,
    /// Probe this node's own `/healthz` and exit 0 on 200 — the container HEALTHCHECK for images
    /// without a shell or curl (distroless).
    #[arg(long)]
    healthcheck: bool,
}

fn healthcheck(cfg: &NetConfig) -> bool {
    use std::io::{Read, Write};
    let mut addr = cfg.server.http_addr;
    if addr.ip().is_unspecified() {
        addr.set_ip(std::net::IpAddr::V4(std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST));
    }
    let timeout = std::time::Duration::from_secs(2);
    let Ok(mut s) = std::net::TcpStream::connect_timeout(&addr, timeout) else {
        return false;
    };
    let _ = s.set_read_timeout(Some(timeout));
    let _ = s.set_write_timeout(Some(timeout));
    if s.write_all(b"GET /healthz HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n")
        .is_err()
    {
        return false;
    }
    let mut buf = [0u8; 64];
    let n = s.read(&mut buf).unwrap_or(0);
    buf[..n].starts_with(b"HTTP/1.1 200") || buf[..n].starts_with(b"HTTP/1.0 200")
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let cli = Cli::parse();
    let cfg = NetConfig::load(cli.config.as_deref())?;
    if cli.healthcheck {
        std::process::exit(if healthcheck(&cfg) { 0 } else { 1 });
    }
    let startup_warnings = cfg.production_warnings();
    let filter = tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::try_from_default_env()
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "info,quinn=warn,sqlx=warn".into());
    if cfg.server.log_format == "json" {
        tracing_subscriber::fmt()
            .json()
            .flatten_event(true)
            .with_env_filter(filter)
            .init();
    } else {
        tracing_subscriber::fmt().with_env_filter(filter).init();
    }
    let _ = rustls::crypto::ring::default_provider().install_default();
    for w in &startup_warnings {
        warn!("production check: {w}");
    }
    for k in NetConfig::unknown_env_keys() {
        warn!(var = %k, "unknown NET__ section in environment, ignored (sections: server, transport, database, redis, auth, limits, retention)");
    }
    info!(version = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"), region = %cfg.server.region, "starting aurix-net node");

    let pool = net_db::create_pool(&cfg.database).await?;
    if cli.migrate_only {
        info!("migrations applied");
        return Ok(());
    }
    let redis = RedisStore::connect(&cfg.redis.url, &cfg.redis.ca_cert).await?;

    let node_id = cfg
        .server
        .node_id
        .as_deref()
        .and_then(|s| s.parse::<NodeId>().ok())
        .unwrap_or_else(NodeId::new);
    let region = RegionId::new(cfg.server.region.clone());
    let regions = queries::list_regions(&pool, false).await?;
    if !regions.iter().any(|r| r.id == region.as_str()) {
        queries::upsert_region(
            &pool,
            &net_db::models::RegionRow {
                id: region.to_string(),
                display_name: region.to_string(),
                dns_label: region.to_string().replace('_', "-"),
                enabled: true,
            },
        )
        .await?;
    }

    let identity = quic::server_identity(
        cfg.transport.cert_pem.as_deref(),
        cfg.transport.key_pem.as_deref(),
        &[cfg.server.public_host.clone(), "localhost".into()],
    )?;
    let transport = quic::transport_config(
        Duration::from_millis(cfg.transport.idle_timeout_ms),
        Duration::from_millis(cfg.transport.keep_alive_ms),
    );
    let endpoint = quic::server_endpoint(cfg.transport.quic_addr, &identity, transport)?;
    let quic_port = endpoint.local_addr()?.port();
    let wt_endpoint = match cfg.transport.webtransport_addr {
        Some(addr) => Some(net_transport::webtransport::server_endpoint(
            addr,
            &identity,
            std::time::Duration::from_millis(cfg.transport.idle_timeout_ms),
            std::time::Duration::from_millis(cfg.transport.keep_alive_ms),
        )?),
        None => None,
    };
    let webtransport_port = wt_endpoint
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|e| e.local_addr().ok())
        .map(|a| a.port());
    info!(addr = %cfg.transport.quic_addr, fingerprint = %identity.fingerprint_sha256, "quic data plane listening");

    let registry = NodeRegistry::new(pool.clone());
    let http_url = format!(
        "http://{}:{}",
        cfg.server.public_host,
        cfg.server.http_addr.port()
    );
    let st = Arc::new(AppState {
        grants: GrantSigner::with_previous(
            &cfg.auth.grant_secret,
            cfg.auth
                .grant_secret_previous
                .as_deref()
                .filter(|p| !p.is_empty()),
            cfg.auth.grant_ttl_secs,
        ),
        tickets: TicketSigner::new(cfg.auth.grant_secret.as_bytes()),
        host: Default::default(),
        node_id,
        region: region.clone(),
        cert_sha256: identity.fingerprint_sha256.clone(),
        quic_port,
        webtransport_port,
        metrics: Arc::new(net_api::metrics::Metrics::new()),
        webhooks: net_api::webhooks::Dispatcher::start(
            pool.clone(),
            cfg.server.environment == "development",
        ),
        matchmaker: Default::default(),
        games: Arc::new(net_game::GameEngine::new()),
        started: std::time::Instant::now(),
        guards: net_api::ratelimit::Guards::new(&cfg.limits, &cfg.server.trusted_proxies),
        draining: std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false),
        adopting: Default::default(),
        pool: pool.clone(),
        redis: redis.clone(),
        registry: registry.clone(),
        cfg: cfg.clone(),
    });

    // First heartbeat before serving so the node is discoverable immediately.
    heartbeat(&st, &http_url, st.is_draining()).await?;
    registry.refresh().await?;
    registry.spawn_refresh(Duration::from_secs(cfg.server.heartbeat_secs));

    tokio::spawn(net_api::data::run_quic(st.clone(), endpoint));
    if let Some(wt) = wt_endpoint {
        info!(addr = ?cfg.transport.webtransport_addr, "webtransport data plane listening");
        tokio::spawn(net_api::data::run_webtransport(st.clone(), wt));
    }
    tokio::spawn(net_api::ws::reaper(st.clone()));
    tokio::spawn(net_api::ws::flusher(st.clone()));
    tokio::spawn(net_api::metering::meter(st.clone()));
    tokio::spawn(net_api::janitor::run(st.clone()));
    tokio::spawn({
        let st = st.clone();
        async move {
            let mut iv = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));
            loop {
                iv.tick().await;
                match st
                    .matchmaker
                    .run_cycle(&st.redis, &st.node_id.to_string())
                    .await
                {
                    Ok(found) => {
                        for m in found {
                            tracing::debug!(room = %m.room, players = m.players.len(), "match started");
                            st.webhooks.emit(
                                m.project,
                                "match.found",
                                serde_json::json!({
                                    "room": m.room,
                                    "mode": format!("{:?}", m.mode).to_lowercase(),
                                    "players": m.players,
                                    "tickets": m.tickets,
                                    "bots": m.bots,
                                }),
                            );
                        }
                    }
                    Err(e) => tracing::warn!(error = %e, "matchmaking cycle failed"),
                }
            }
        }
    });
    tokio::spawn(lobby_forwarder(st.clone(), cfg.redis.clone()));
    tokio::spawn(net_api::alerts::run(st.clone()));
    {
        let st = st.clone();
        let http_url = http_url.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut iv = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_secs(st.cfg.server.heartbeat_secs));
            iv.tick().await;
            loop {
                iv.tick().await;
                if let Err(e) = heartbeat(&st, &http_url, st.is_draining()).await {
                    warn!(error = %e, "heartbeat failed");
                }
            }
        });
    }

    tokio::spawn({
        let st = st.clone();
        async move {
            let mut iv = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_secs(60));
            loop {
                iv.tick().await;
                st.guards.sweep();
            }
        }
    });
    let app = axum::Router::new()
        .route("/ws", axum::routing::get(net_api::ws::ws_handler))
        .with_state(st.clone())
        .merge(rest::router(st.clone()))
        .layer(axum::extract::DefaultBodyLimit::max(64 * 1024))
        .layer(axum::middleware::from_fn_with_state(
            st.clone(),
            net_api::ratelimit::http_guard,
        ))
        .layer(tower_http::trace::TraceLayer::new_for_http())
        .layer(cors_layer(
            &cfg.server.allowed_origins,
            &cfg.server.environment,
        ));
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(cfg.server.http_addr).await?;
    info!(addr = %cfg.server.http_addr, node = %node_id, "control plane listening");
    let shutdown = {
        let st = st.clone();
        let http_url = http_url.clone();
        async move {
            wait_for_signal().await;
            info!("shutdown: draining");
            st.draining
                .store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
            if let Err(e) = heartbeat(&st, &http_url, true).await {
                warn!(error = %e, "drain heartbeat failed");
            }
            let n = net_api::ws::handoff_all(&st).await;
            info!(rooms = n, "shutdown: rooms handed off");
            if let Err(e) = queries::delete_node(&st.pool, st.node_id.0).await {
                error!(error = %e, "delete node row");
            }
        }
    };
    axum::serve(
        listener,
        app.into_make_service_with_connect_info::<std::net::SocketAddr>(),
    )
    .with_graceful_shutdown(shutdown)
    .await?;
    Ok(())
}

/// CORS for browser clients: an explicit origin list, or any origin when none is configured
/// (logged as a warning outside development).
fn cors_layer(origins: &[String], environment: &str) -> tower_http::cors::CorsLayer {
    use tower_http::cors::{AllowOrigin, CorsLayer};
    if origins.is_empty() {
        let _ = environment;
        return CorsLayer::permissive();
    }
    let list: Vec<axum::http::HeaderValue> =
        origins.iter().filter_map(|o| o.parse().ok()).collect();
    CorsLayer::new()
        .allow_origin(AllowOrigin::list(list))
        .allow_methods(tower_http::cors::Any)
        .allow_headers(tower_http::cors::Any)
}

/// Ctrl-C or SIGTERM (what Docker, systemd and Kubernetes send).
async fn wait_for_signal() {
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        let mut term = tokio::signal::unix::signal(tokio::signal::unix::SignalKind::terminate())
            .expect("install SIGTERM handler");
        tokio::select! {
            _ = tokio::signal::ctrl_c() => {}
            _ = term.recv() => {}
        }
    }
    #[cfg(not(unix))]
    {
        let _ = tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await;
    }
}

async fn heartbeat(st: &Arc<AppState>, http_url: &str, draining: bool) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let rooms = st.host.len() as i32;
    let players = st.host.players() as i32;
    let cap = st.cfg.limits.max_rooms_per_node.max(1) as f32;
    let load = (rooms as f32 / cap)
        .max(players as f32 / (cap * 8.0))
        .min(1.0);
    queries::upsert_node(
        &st.pool,
        &NodeHeartbeat {
            id: st.node_id.0,
            region: st.region.to_string(),
            public_host: st.cfg.server.public_host.clone(),
            quic_port: st.quic_port as i32,
            http_url: http_url.to_string(),
            cert_sha256: st.cert_sha256.clone(),
            version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
            rooms,
            players,
            load_factor: load,
            draining,
            heartbeat_secs: st.cfg.server.heartbeat_secs.clamp(1, i32::MAX as u64) as i32,
        },
    )
    .await?;
    Ok(())
}

/// Forwards Redis lobby publications (from every node) to local lobby subscribers.
async fn lobby_forwarder(st: Arc<AppState>, redis: RedisConfig) {
    loop {
        if let Err(e) = lobby_forward_once(&st, &redis).await {
            warn!(error = %e, "lobby forwarder stopped; retrying");
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2)).await;
    }
}

async fn lobby_forward_once(st: &Arc<AppState>, redis: &RedisConfig) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    use futures::StreamExt;
    let client = net_control::redis_store::redis_client(&redis.url, &redis.ca_cert)?;
    let mut ps = client.get_async_pubsub().await?;
    ps.psubscribe("net:p:*:lobby").await?;
    let mut stream = ps.on_message();
    while let Some(msg) = stream.next().await {
        let channel: String = msg.get_channel_name().to_string();
        let Some(pid) = channel
            .strip_prefix("net:p:")
            .and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix(":lobby"))
            .and_then(|s| s.parse::<net_common::ProjectId>().ok())
        else {
            continue;
        };
        let payload: String = match msg.get_payload() {
            Ok(p) => p,
            Err(_) => continue,
        };
        let v: serde_json::Value = match serde_json::from_str(&payload) {
            Ok(v) => v,
            Err(_) => continue,
        };
        if v.get("removed").and_then(|r| r.as_bool()) == Some(true) {
            let id = v
                .get("room")
                .and_then(|r| r.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("")
                .to_string();
            st.host.notify_lobby(
                pid,
                ServerMsg::LobbyUpdate {
                    room: net_rooms::protocol::RoomSummary {
                        id,
                        name: String::new(),
                        mode: net_common::RoomMode::Relay,
                        players: 0,
                        max_players: 0,
                        open: false,
                        props: Default::default(),
                    },
                    removed: true,
                },
            );
        } else if let Ok(live) = serde_json::from_value::<net_control::redis_store::LiveRoom>(v) {
            let listed = live.visible && live.open && live.players < live.max_players;
            st.host.notify_lobby(
                pid,
                ServerMsg::LobbyUpdate {
                    room: net_api::ws::live_to_summary(live),
                    removed: !listed,
                },
            );
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
```
