`crates/net-sim-bots/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! Deterministic bot kit: data-driven behavior trees and hierarchical state machines with an
//! integer blackboard, tick-counted timers (no wall clock), snapshot/restore/hash, and glue to
//! drive `net-sim-nav` crowd agents. Game-specific conditions and actions are integers resolved
//! by a `Brain` implementation, so trees/machines are plain data that can ship in a lockstep
//! room's WASM module or be authored in tools and serialized as JSON.
#![forbid(unsafe_code)]
#![deny(clippy::float_arithmetic)]

use net_fpmath::{Fx, FxVec2};
use net_sim_nav::{Crowd, NavMesh};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Status {
    Running,
    Success,
    Failure,
}

/// Integer-keyed state shared by a bot's tree/machine and the game; values are raw i64 so
/// positions (Q32.32), ids and counters all fit.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Blackboard {
    pub values: BTreeMap<u32, i64>,
}

impl Blackboard {
    pub fn get(&self, k: u32) -> i64 {
        self.values.get(&k).copied().unwrap_or(0)
    }
    pub fn set(&mut self, k: u32, v: i64) {
        self.values.insert(k, v);
    }
    pub fn get_fx(&self, k: u32) -> Fx {
        Fx(self.get(k))
    }
    pub fn set_fx(&mut self, k: u32, v: Fx) {
        self.set(k, v.0);
    }
    pub fn get_vec(&self, k: u32) -> FxVec2 {
        FxVec2::new(self.get_fx(k), self.get_fx(k + 1))
    }
    pub fn set_vec(&mut self, k: u32, v: FxVec2) {
        self.set_fx(k, v.x);
        self.set_fx(k + 1, v.y);
    }
    pub fn has(&self, k: u32) -> bool {
        self.values.contains_key(&k)
    }
    pub fn clear(&mut self, k: u32) {
        self.values.remove(&k);
    }
}

/// Game hooks: conditions and actions are referenced by id from trees and machines.
pub trait Brain {
    fn condition(&mut self, id: u32, bb: &Blackboard) -> bool;
    /// Called every tick while the action node is active; return `Running` to keep going.
    fn action(&mut self, id: u32, bb: &mut Blackboard) -> Status;
    /// Fired when an action node is interrupted while `Running` (higher-priority branch won).
    fn abort(&mut self, _id: u32, _bb: &mut Blackboard) {}
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Node {
    /// Runs children in order; fails on the first failure.
    Sequence(Vec<Node>),
    /// Runs children in order; succeeds on the first success.
    Selector(Vec<Node>),
    /// Runs all children each tick; succeeds when `need` succeed, fails when that becomes impossible.
    Parallel {
        need: u32,
        children: Vec<Node>,
    },
    /// Game condition; `Success`/`Failure` instantly.
    Condition(u32),
    /// Game action; may run across ticks.
    Action(u32),
    Inverter(Box<Node>),
    Succeeder(Box<Node>),
    /// Repeat `times` (0 = forever) while the child succeeds.
    Repeat {
        times: u32,
        child: Box<Node>,
    },
    /// Fails while on cooldown; after the child finishes, blocks for `ticks`.
    Cooldown {
        ticks: u32,
        child: Box<Node>,
    },
    /// Runs the child until it finishes or `ticks` elapse (then fails and aborts it).
    Timeout {
        ticks: u32,
        child: Box<Node>,
    },
    /// Succeeds after `ticks` of running.
    Wait(u32),
    /// Blackboard compare: value at `key` op `value` (op: 0 ==, 1 !=, 2 <, 3 <=, 4 >, 5 >=).
    Compare {
        key: u32,
        op: u8,
        value: i64,
    },
    /// Set `key` to `value`; always succeeds.
    Set {
        key: u32,
        value: i64,
    },
}

/// Per-node runtime state, indexed by preorder position so trees stay plain data.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct NodeState {
    /// Sequence/Selector cursor, Repeat count, Wait/Timeout/Cooldown elapsed.
    counter: u32,
    /// Cooldown remaining ticks.
    cooldown: u32,
    running: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct BehaviorTree {
    pub root: Node,
    states: Vec<NodeState>,
    pub tick: u32,
}

fn count(n: &Node) -> usize {
    1 + match n {
        Node::Sequence(c) | Node::Selector(c) => c.iter().map(count).sum(),
        Node::Parallel { children, .. } => children.iter().map(count).sum(),
        Node::Inverter(c) | Node::Succeeder(c) => count(c),
        Node::Repeat { child, .. } | Node::Cooldown { child, .. } | Node::Timeout { child, .. } => {
            count(child)
        }
        _ => 0,
    }
}

impl BehaviorTree {
    pub fn new(root: Node) -> BehaviorTree {
        let n = count(&root);
        BehaviorTree {
            root,
            states: vec![NodeState::default(); n],
            tick: 0,
        }
    }
    pub fn from_json(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<BehaviorTree> {
        serde_json::from_slice::<Node>(bytes)
            .ok()
            .map(BehaviorTree::new)
    }
    pub fn root_json(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        serde_json::to_vec(&self.root).unwrap_or_default()
    }
    /// Reset all runtime state (aborting running actions).
    pub fn reset<B: Brain>(&mut self, brain: &mut B, bb: &mut Blackboard) {
        let root = self.root.clone();
        self.abort(&root, 0, brain, bb);
        for s in &mut self.states {
            *s = NodeState::default();
        }
    }
    pub fn tick<B: Brain>(&mut self, brain: &mut B, bb: &mut Blackboard) -> Status {
        let root = self.root.clone();
        let (st, _) = self.run(&root, 0, brain, bb);
        for s in &mut self.states {
            if s.cooldown > 0 {
                s.cooldown -= 1;
            }
        }
        self.tick += 1;
        st
    }
    pub fn hash(&self) -> u64 {
        let mut h: u64 = 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325;
        let mut mix = |v: u64| {
            for b in v.to_le_bytes() {
                h ^= b as u64;
                h = h.wrapping_mul(0x0000_0100_0000_01b3);
            }
        };
        mix(self.tick as u64);
        for s in &self.states {
            mix(s.counter as u64 | (s.cooldown as u64) << 32 | (s.running as u64) << 63);
        }
        h
    }

    /// Returns (status, nodes consumed) so siblings can locate their state slots.
    fn run<B: Brain>(
        &mut self,
        node: &Node,
        idx: usize,
        brain: &mut B,
        bb: &mut Blackboard,
    ) -> (Status, usize) {
        let size = count(node);
        let st = match node {
            Node::Condition(id) => {
                if brain.condition(*id, bb) {
                    Status::Success
                } else {
                    Status::Failure
                }
            }
            Node::Action(id) => {
                let st = brain.action(*id, bb);
                self.states[idx].running = st == Status::Running;
                st
            }
            Node::Compare { key, op, value } => {
                let v = bb.get(*key);
                let ok = match op {
                    0 => v == *value,
                    1 => v != *value,
                    2 => v < *value,
                    3 => v <= *value,
                    4 => v > *value,
                    _ => v >= *value,
                };
                if ok {
                    Status::Success
                } else {
                    Status::Failure
                }
            }
            Node::Set { key, value } => {
                bb.set(*key, *value);
                Status::Success
            }
            Node::Wait(ticks) => {
                let s = &mut self.states[idx];
                s.counter += 1;
                if s.counter >= *ticks {
                    s.counter = 0;
                    s.running = false;
                    Status::Success
                } else {
                    s.running = true;
                    Status::Running
                }
            }
            Node::Sequence(children) | Node::Selector(children) => {
                let is_seq = matches!(node, Node::Sequence(_));
                let start = self.states[idx].counter as usize;
                let mut child_idx = idx + 1;
                let mut result = if is_seq {
                    Status::Success
                } else {
                    Status::Failure
                };
                let mut i = 0;
                // abort children before the cursor that may still be running (memory semantics
                // keep the cursor, so nothing before it runs; just advance indices)
                while i < children.len() {
                    let c = &children[i];
                    if i < start {
                        // guards before the cursor are re-evaluated every tick so a running
                        // branch reacts when its condition flips (reactive sequences/selectors)
                        if matches!(c, Node::Condition(_) | Node::Compare { .. }) {
                            let (st, _) = self.run(c, child_idx, brain, bb);
                            if (is_seq && st == Status::Failure)
                                || (!is_seq && st == Status::Success)
                            {
                                let mut rest = child_idx + count(c);
                                for later in &children[i + 1..] {
                                    self.abort(later, rest, brain, bb);
                                    rest += count(later);
                                }
                                self.states[idx].counter = 0;
                                self.states[idx].running = false;
                                return (st, size);
                            }
                        }
                        child_idx += count(c);
                        i += 1;
                        continue;
                    }
                    let (st, used) = self.run(c, child_idx, brain, bb);
                    child_idx += used;
                    match st {
                        Status::Running => {
                            self.states[idx].counter = i as u32;
                            self.states[idx].running = true;
                            // abort any later children that were left running by a prior tick
                            let mut rest = child_idx;
                            for later in &children[i + 1..] {
                                self.abort(later, rest, brain, bb);
                                rest += count(later);
                            }
                            return (Status::Running, size);
                        }
                        Status::Success if !is_seq => {
                            result = Status::Success;
                            break;
                        }
                        Status::Failure if is_seq => {
                            result = Status::Failure;
                            break;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    i += 1;
                }
                self.states[idx].counter = 0;
                self.states[idx].running = false;
                result
            }
            Node::Parallel { need, children } => {
                let mut child_idx = idx + 1;
                let (mut ok, mut failed) = (0u32, 0u32);
                for c in children {
                    let (st, used) = self.run(c, child_idx, brain, bb);
                    child_idx += used;
                    match st {
                        Status::Success => ok += 1,
                        Status::Failure => failed += 1,
                        Status::Running => {}
                    }
                }
                let total = children.len() as u32;
                if ok >= *need {
                    self.abort_children(node, idx, brain, bb);
                    Status::Success
                } else if total - failed < *need {
                    self.abort_children(node, idx, brain, bb);
                    Status::Failure
                } else {
                    Status::Running
                }
            }
            Node::Inverter(child) => match self.run(child, idx + 1, brain, bb).0 {
                Status::Success => Status::Failure,
                Status::Failure => Status::Success,
                Status::Running => Status::Running,
            },
            Node::Succeeder(child) => match self.run(child, idx + 1, brain, bb).0 {
                Status::Running => Status::Running,
                _ => Status::Success,
            },
            Node::Repeat { times, child } => match self.run(child, idx + 1, brain, bb).0 {
                Status::Running => Status::Running,
                Status::Failure => {
                    self.states[idx].counter = 0;
                    Status::Failure
                }
                Status::Success => {
                    let s = &mut self.states[idx];
                    s.counter += 1;
                    if *times > 0 && s.counter >= *times {
                        s.counter = 0;
                        Status::Success
                    } else {
                        Status::Running
                    }
                }
            },
            Node::Cooldown { ticks, child } => {
                if self.states[idx].cooldown > 0 && !self.states[idx].running {
                    Status::Failure
                } else {
                    let st = self.run(child, idx + 1, brain, bb).0;
                    let s = &mut self.states[idx];
                    s.running = st == Status::Running;
                    if st != Status::Running {
                        s.cooldown = *ticks + 1;
                    }
                    st
                }
            }
            Node::Timeout { ticks, child } => {
                let st = self.run(child, idx + 1, brain, bb).0;
                let s = &mut self.states[idx];
                if st == Status::Running {
                    s.counter += 1;
                    if s.counter >= *ticks {
                        s.counter = 0;
                        self.abort(child, idx + 1, brain, bb);
                        Status::Failure
                    } else {
                        Status::Running
                    }
                } else {
                    s.counter = 0;
                    st
                }
            }
        };
        (st, size)
    }

    fn abort_children<B: Brain>(
        &mut self,
        node: &Node,
        idx: usize,
        brain: &mut B,
        bb: &mut Blackboard,
    ) {
        if let Node::Parallel { children, .. } = node {
            let mut child_idx = idx + 1;
            for c in children {
                self.abort(c, child_idx, brain, bb);
                child_idx += count(c);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Stop anything running under `node` (cursor reset, running actions notified).
    fn abort<B: Brain>(&mut self, node: &Node, idx: usize, brain: &mut B, bb: &mut Blackboard) {
        match node {
            Node::Action(id) => {
                if self.states[idx].running {
                    brain.abort(*id, bb);
                }
            }
            Node::Sequence(children) | Node::Selector(children) => {
                let mut child_idx = idx + 1;
                for c in children {
                    self.abort(c, child_idx, brain, bb);
                    child_idx += count(c);
                }
            }
            Node::Parallel { children, .. } => {
                let mut child_idx = idx + 1;
                for c in children {
                    self.abort(c, child_idx, brain, bb);
                    child_idx += count(c);
                }
            }
            Node::Inverter(c) | Node::Succeeder(c) => self.abort(c, idx + 1, brain, bb),
            Node::Repeat { child, .. }
            | Node::Cooldown { child, .. }
            | Node::Timeout { child, .. } => self.abort(child, idx + 1, brain, bb),
            _ => {}
        }
        let s = &mut self.states[idx];
        s.counter = 0;
        s.running = false;
    }
}

// ---- hierarchical state machine --------------------------------------------------------------

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Transition {
    /// Game condition id; `None` = unconditional (taken when the state's action finishes).
    pub condition: Option<u32>,
    pub to: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct State {
    pub id: u32,
    /// Parent state (hierarchy): parent transitions are checked after the child's own.
    pub parent: Option<u32>,
    /// Initial child when this state is entered and has children.
    pub initial: Option<u32>,
    pub on_enter: Option<u32>,
    pub on_exit: Option<u32>,
    /// Action run every tick while active (leaf states).
    pub action: Option<u32>,
    pub transitions: Vec<Transition>,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct StateMachine {
    pub states: BTreeMap<u32, State>,
    pub current: u32,
    pub ticks_in_state: u32,
    pub tick: u32,
    last_action: Status,
}

impl StateMachine {
    pub fn new(states: Vec<State>, initial: u32) -> StateMachine {
        let states: BTreeMap<u32, State> = states.into_iter().map(|s| (s.id, s)).collect();
        StateMachine {
            states,
            current: initial,
            ticks_in_state: 0,
            tick: 0,
            last_action: Status::Running,
        }
    }
    pub fn from_json(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<StateMachine> {
        serde_json::from_slice(bytes).ok()
    }
    pub fn to_json(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        serde_json::to_vec(self).unwrap_or_default()
    }
    /// Enter `initial` (running on_enter hooks down the hierarchy); call once before ticking.
    pub fn start<B: Brain>(&mut self, brain: &mut B, bb: &mut Blackboard) {
        let mut cur = self.current;
        self.enter_chain(cur, brain, bb);
        while let Some(init) = self.states.get(&cur).and_then(|s| s.initial) {
            if let Some(a) = self.states[&init].on_enter {
                brain.action(a, bb);
            }
            cur = init;
        }
        self.current = cur;
        self.ticks_in_state = 0;
    }
    fn enter_chain<B: Brain>(&mut self, id: u32, brain: &mut B, bb: &mut Blackboard) {
        let mut chain = vec![id];
        let mut p = self.states.get(&id).and_then(|s| s.parent);
        while let Some(pp) = p {
            chain.push(pp);
            p = self.states.get(&pp).and_then(|s| s.parent);
        }
        for s in chain.iter().rev() {
            if let Some(a) = self.states[s].on_enter {
                brain.action(a, bb);
            }
        }
    }
    fn ancestors(&self, id: u32) -> Vec<u32> {
        let mut out = vec![id];
        let mut p = self.states.get(&id).and_then(|s| s.parent);
        while let Some(pp) = p {
            out.push(pp);
            p = self.states.get(&pp).and_then(|s| s.parent);
        }
        out
    }
    /// Is `id` the current state or one of its ancestors?
    pub fn is_in(&self, id: u32) -> bool {
        self.ancestors(self.current).contains(&id)
    }
    pub fn tick<B: Brain>(&mut self, brain: &mut B, bb: &mut Blackboard) {
        // transitions: own state first, then ancestors; first matching wins
        let chain = self.ancestors(self.current);
        let mut target = None;
        'outer: for s in &chain {
            for t in &self.states[s].transitions {
                let fire = match t.condition {
                    Some(c) => brain.condition(c, bb),
                    None => self.last_action != Status::Running && *s == self.current,
                };
                if fire {
                    target = Some(t.to);
                    break 'outer;
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(to) = target {
            self.transition(to, brain, bb);
        }
        if let Some(a) = self.states.get(&self.current).and_then(|s| s.action) {
            self.last_action = brain.action(a, bb);
        } else {
            self.last_action = Status::Success;
        }
        self.ticks_in_state += 1;
        self.tick += 1;
    }
    /// Exit up to the common ancestor, enter down to `to` (and its initial children).
    pub fn transition<B: Brain>(&mut self, to: u32, brain: &mut B, bb: &mut Blackboard) {
        let from_chain = self.ancestors(self.current);
        let to_chain = self.ancestors(to);
        for s in &from_chain {
            if to_chain.contains(s) {
                break;
            }
            if let Some(a) = self.states[s].on_exit {
                brain.action(a, bb);
            }
        }
        for s in to_chain.iter().rev() {
            if from_chain.contains(s) {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(a) = self.states[s].on_enter {
                brain.action(a, bb);
            }
        }
        let mut cur = to;
        while let Some(init) = self.states.get(&cur).and_then(|s| s.initial) {
            if let Some(a) = self.states[&init].on_enter {
                brain.action(a, bb);
            }
            cur = init;
        }
        self.current = cur;
        self.ticks_in_state = 0;
        self.last_action = Status::Running;
    }
    pub fn hash(&self) -> u64 {
        (self.current as u64)
            ^ (self.ticks_in_state as u64) << 32
            ^ (self.tick as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15)
    }
}

// ---- navmesh glue -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Blackboard keys the nav helpers read/write (games may use any other keys freely).
pub mod keys {
    /// Crowd agent id of this bot.
    pub const AGENT: u32 = 1;
    /// Current target point (x at TARGET, y at TARGET + 1).
    pub const TARGET: u32 = 2;
    /// 1 while the agent reports arrival.
    pub const ARRIVED: u32 = 4;
    /// Distance to target (Fx) refreshed by `sync_agent`.
    pub const DIST: u32 = 5;
    /// Agent position (x, y).
    pub const POS: u32 = 6;
}

/// Copy the agent's position/arrival into the blackboard; call before ticking brains.
pub fn sync_agent(crowd: &Crowd, bb: &mut Blackboard) {
    let id = bb.get(keys::AGENT) as u32;
    if let Some(a) = crowd.agents.get(&id) {
        bb.set_vec(keys::POS, a.pos);
        bb.set(keys::ARRIVED, a.arrived as i64);
        if bb.has(keys::TARGET) {
            bb.set_fx(keys::DIST, (bb.get_vec(keys::TARGET) - a.pos).length());
        }
    }
}

/// Steer the bot's agent to `target` (clamped onto the mesh); returns false when unreachable.
pub fn go_to(crowd: &mut Crowd, mesh: &NavMesh, bb: &mut Blackboard, target: FxVec2) -> bool {
    let id = bb.get(keys::AGENT) as u32;
    let Some((_, on_mesh)) = mesh.nearest(target) else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some(a) = crowd.agents.get_mut(&id) else {
        return false;
    };
    if mesh.find_path(a.pos, on_mesh, u32::MAX).is_none() {
        return false;
    }
    a.target = Some(on_mesh);
    a.field = None;
    a.arrived = false;
    bb.set_vec(keys::TARGET, on_mesh);
    bb.set(keys::ARRIVED, 0);
    true
}

/// Follow a shared flow field (e.g. "all zombies to the player").
pub fn follow_field(crowd: &mut Crowd, bb: &mut Blackboard, field: u32) {
    let id = bb.get(keys::AGENT) as u32;
    if let Some(a) = crowd.agents.get_mut(&id) {
        a.field = Some(field);
        a.target = None;
        a.arrived = false;
    }
    if let Some(f) = crowd.fields.get(field as usize) {
        bb.set_vec(keys::TARGET, f.goal);
    }
    bb.set(keys::ARRIVED, 0);
}

pub fn stop(crowd: &mut Crowd, bb: &mut Blackboard) {
    let id = bb.get(keys::AGENT) as u32;
    if let Some(a) = crowd.agents.get_mut(&id) {
        a.target = None;
        a.field = None;
        a.vel = FxVec2::ZERO;
    }
    bb.clear(keys::TARGET);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use net_sim_nav::{Agent, CrowdConfig};

    const C_SEE: u32 = 1;
    const A_PATROL: u32 = 10;
    const A_CHASE: u32 = 11;
    const A_LOG: u32 = 12;

    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Stub {
        see: bool,
        log: Vec<&'static str>,
        patrol_left: u32,
        aborted: u32,
    }
    impl Brain for Stub {
        fn condition(&mut self, id: u32, _bb: &Blackboard) -> bool {
            match id {
                C_SEE => self.see,
                _ => false,
            }
        }
        fn action(&mut self, id: u32, bb: &mut Blackboard) -> Status {
            match id {
                A_PATROL => {
                    self.log.push("patrol");
                    if self.patrol_left == 0 {
                        self.patrol_left = 3;
                        Status::Success
                    } else {
                        self.patrol_left -= 1;
                        Status::Running
                    }
                }
                A_CHASE => {
                    self.log.push("chase");
                    bb.set(100, bb.get(100) + 1);
                    Status::Running
                }
                A_LOG => {
                    self.log.push("log");
                    Status::Success
                }
                _ => Status::Failure,
            }
        }
        fn abort(&mut self, _id: u32, _bb: &mut Blackboard) {
            self.aborted += 1;
        }
    }

    fn guard_tree() -> Node {
        Node::Selector(vec![
            Node::Sequence(vec![Node::Condition(C_SEE), Node::Action(A_CHASE)]),
            Node::Sequence(vec![
                Node::Action(A_PATROL),
                Node::Wait(2),
                Node::Action(A_LOG),
            ]),
        ])
    }

    #[test]
    fn tree_prioritises_chase_and_aborts_patrol() {
        let mut t = BehaviorTree::new(guard_tree());
        let mut bb = Blackboard::default();
        let mut brain = Stub {
            patrol_left: 2,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Running); // patrol running
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Running);
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Running); // patrol done -> wait 1/2
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Success); // wait 2/2 -> log -> sequence done
        assert!(brain.log.contains(&"log"), "{:?}", brain.log);
        brain.see = true;
        brain.patrol_left = 5;
        t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb);
        t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb);
        assert_eq!(bb.get(100), 2, "chase ran twice");
        assert_eq!(brain.log.last(), Some(&"chase"));
        // memory: patrol restarted from scratch when chase stops
        brain.see = false;
        t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb);
        assert_eq!(brain.log.last(), Some(&"patrol"));
        let json = t.root_json();
        let t2 = BehaviorTree::from_json(&json).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(t2.root, t.root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn decorators_cooldown_timeout_repeat() {
        let mut bb = Blackboard::default();
        let mut brain = Stub::default();
        let mut t = BehaviorTree::new(Node::Sequence(vec![
            Node::Cooldown {
                ticks: 3,
                child: Box::new(Node::Action(A_LOG)),
            },
            Node::Set { key: 7, value: 1 },
        ]));
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Success);
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Failure);
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Failure);
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Failure);
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Success);
        let mut t = BehaviorTree::new(Node::Timeout {
            ticks: 3,
            child: Box::new(Node::Action(A_CHASE)),
        });
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Running);
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Running);
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Failure);
        assert_eq!(brain.aborted, 1);
        let mut t = BehaviorTree::new(Node::Repeat {
            times: 3,
            child: Box::new(Node::Action(A_LOG)),
        });
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Running);
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Running);
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Success);
        let mut t = BehaviorTree::new(Node::Parallel {
            need: 1,
            children: vec![Node::Action(A_CHASE), Node::Wait(2)],
        });
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Running);
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Success);
        assert_eq!(brain.aborted, 2, "chase aborted when the parallel finished");
        let mut t = BehaviorTree::new(Node::Compare {
            key: 100,
            op: 5,
            value: 1,
        });
        assert_eq!(t.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb), Status::Success);
    }

    #[test]
    fn hfsm_transitions_with_hierarchy_hooks() {
        // Alive { Idle -> Chase on see } ; any Alive -> Dead when key 50 == 1 (parent transition)
        #[derive(Default)]
        struct Fsm {
            see: bool,
            log: Vec<String>,
        }
        impl Brain for Fsm {
            fn condition(&mut self, id: u32, bb: &Blackboard) -> bool {
                match id {
                    1 => self.see,
                    2 => bb.get(50) == 1,
                    _ => false,
                }
            }
            fn action(&mut self, id: u32, _bb: &mut Blackboard) -> Status {
                self.log.push(format!("a{id}"));
                if id == 20 {
                    Status::Success
                } else {
                    Status::Running
                }
            }
        }
        let states = vec![
            State {
                id: 1,
                parent: None,
                initial: Some(2),
                on_enter: Some(100),
                on_exit: Some(101),
                action: None,
                transitions: vec![Transition {
                    condition: Some(2),
                    to: 4,
                }],
            },
            State {
                id: 2,
                parent: Some(1),
                initial: None,
                on_enter: None,
                on_exit: None,
                action: Some(20),
                transitions: vec![Transition {
                    condition: Some(1),
                    to: 3,
                }],
            },
            State {
                id: 3,
                parent: Some(1),
                initial: None,
                on_enter: Some(102),
                on_exit: None,
                action: Some(30),
                transitions: vec![Transition {
                    condition: None,
                    to: 2,
                }],
            },
            State {
                id: 4,
                parent: None,
                initial: None,
                on_enter: Some(103),
                on_exit: None,
                action: None,
                transitions: vec![],
            },
        ];
        let mut m = StateMachine::new(states.clone(), 1);
        let mut m2 = StateMachine::new(states, 1);
        let mut bb = Blackboard::default();
        let mut brain = Fsm::default();
        let mut brain2 = Fsm::default();
        m.start(&mut brain, &mut bb);
        m2.start(&mut brain2, &mut bb.clone());
        assert_eq!(m.current, 2);
        assert_eq!(brain.log, vec!["a100"]);
        m.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb);
        m2.tick(&mut brain2, &mut bb.clone());
        assert_eq!(brain.log.last().unwrap(), "a20");
        brain.see = true;
        brain2.see = true;
        m.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb);
        m2.tick(&mut brain2, &mut bb.clone());
        assert_eq!(m.current, 3);
        assert!(m.is_in(1));
        assert_eq!(&brain.log[brain.log.len() - 2..], &["a102", "a30"]);
        assert_eq!(m.hash(), m2.hash());
        bb.set(50, 1);
        m.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb);
        assert_eq!(m.current, 4);
        assert_eq!(
            &brain.log[brain.log.len() - 2..],
            &["a101", "a103"],
            "exit Alive then enter Dead"
        );
        let back = StateMachine::from_json(&m.to_json()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back, m);
    }

    #[test]
    fn nav_glue_moves_a_bot_to_its_target_deterministically() {
        let blocked: Vec<(u32, u32)> = (0..5).map(|r| (4, r)).collect();
        let mesh = NavMesh::grid(FxVec2::ZERO, Fx::ONE, 8, 6, &blocked);
        let run = || {
            let mut crowd = Crowd::new(CrowdConfig::default());
            let id = crowd.add(
                &mesh,
                Agent::new(
                    FxVec2::new(Fx::HALF, Fx::HALF),
                    Fx::from_ratio(1, 4),
                    Fx::from_int(3),
                ),
            );
            let mut bb = Blackboard::default();
            bb.set(keys::AGENT, id as i64);
            assert!(go_to(
                &mut crowd,
                &mesh,
                &mut bb,
                FxVec2::new(Fx::from_ratio(15, 2), Fx::HALF)
            ));
            let mut arrived_at = None;
            for t in 0..900 {
                crowd.step(&mesh);
                sync_agent(&crowd, &mut bb);
                if bb.get(keys::ARRIVED) == 1 && arrived_at.is_none() {
                    arrived_at = Some(t);
                    stop(&mut crowd, &mut bb);
                }
            }
            (arrived_at, crowd.hash(), bb.get_vec(keys::POS))
        };
        let (a1, h1, p1) = run();
        let (a2, h2, _) = run();
        assert!(a1.is_some(), "bot never arrived, last pos {p1:?}");
        assert_eq!(a1, a2);
        assert_eq!(h1, h2);
    }
    /// Cross-SDK vectors: a scripted brain drives the guard tree and the HFSM; per-tick status,
    /// tree hash and blackboard are recorded. `BOTS_WRITE_VECTORS=1` rewrites the fixture that
    /// the TS and C# ports replay.
    #[test]
    fn vectors_match_the_fixture() {
        struct Scripted {
            t: u32,
            patrol_left: u32,
        }
        impl Brain for Scripted {
            fn condition(&mut self, id: u32, bb: &Blackboard) -> bool {
                match id {
                    C_SEE => (8..=12).contains(&self.t) || (20..=22).contains(&self.t),
                    2 => bb.get(50) == 1,
                    _ => false,
                }
            }
            fn action(&mut self, id: u32, bb: &mut Blackboard) -> Status {
                match id {
                    A_PATROL => {
                        if self.patrol_left == 0 {
                            self.patrol_left = 3;
                            Status::Success
                        } else {
                            self.patrol_left -= 1;
                            Status::Running
                        }
                    }
                    A_CHASE => {
                        bb.set(100, bb.get(100) + 1);
                        Status::Running
                    }
                    A_LOG => {
                        bb.set(101, bb.get(101) + 1);
                        Status::Success
                    }
                    20 => Status::Success,
                    30 => Status::Running,
                    100..=103 => {
                        bb.set(id, bb.get(id) + 1);
                        Status::Success
                    }
                    _ => Status::Failure,
                }
            }
            fn abort(&mut self, _id: u32, bb: &mut Blackboard) {
                bb.set(102, bb.get(102) + 1);
            }
        }
        let tree_root = Node::Selector(vec![
            Node::Sequence(vec![
                Node::Condition(C_SEE),
                Node::Timeout {
                    ticks: 4,
                    child: Box::new(Node::Action(A_CHASE)),
                },
            ]),
            Node::Sequence(vec![
                Node::Cooldown {
                    ticks: 2,
                    child: Box::new(Node::Action(A_PATROL)),
                },
                Node::Wait(2),
                Node::Repeat {
                    times: 2,
                    child: Box::new(Node::Action(A_LOG)),
                },
                Node::Compare {
                    key: 101,
                    op: 5,
                    value: 4,
                },
                Node::Set { key: 7, value: 1 },
            ]),
        ]);
        let mut tree = BehaviorTree::new(tree_root.clone());
        let mut bb = Blackboard::default();
        let mut brain = Scripted {
            t: 0,
            patrol_left: 2,
        };
        let mut ticks = Vec::new();
        for t in 0..40u32 {
            brain.t = t;
            let st = tree.tick(&mut brain, &mut bb);
            ticks.push(serde_json::json!({
                "status": format!("{st:?}"), "hash": format!("{:#x}", tree.hash()),
                "bb": bb.values.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), *v)).collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>(),
            }));
        }
        let states = vec![
            State {
                id: 1,
                parent: None,
                initial: Some(2),
                on_enter: Some(100),
                on_exit: Some(101),
                action: None,
                transitions: vec![Transition {
                    condition: Some(2),
                    to: 4,
                }],
            },
            State {
                id: 2,
                parent: Some(1),
                initial: None,
                on_enter: None,
                on_exit: None,
                action: Some(20),
                transitions: vec![Transition {
                    condition: Some(C_SEE),
                    to: 3,
                }],
            },
            State {
                id: 3,
                parent: Some(1),
                initial: None,
                on_enter: Some(102),
                on_exit: None,
                action: Some(30),
                transitions: vec![
                    Transition {
                        condition: None,
                        to: 2,
                    },
                    Transition {
                        condition: Some(3),
                        to: 2,
                    },
                ],
            },
            State {
                id: 4,
                parent: None,
                initial: None,
                on_enter: Some(103),
                on_exit: None,
                action: None,
                transitions: vec![],
            },
        ];
        let mut fsm = StateMachine::new(states, 1);
        let mut fbb = Blackboard::default();
        let mut fbrain = Scripted {
            t: 0,
            patrol_left: 0,
        };
        fsm.start(&mut fbrain, &mut fbb);
        let mut fsm_ticks = Vec::new();
        for t in 0..30u32 {
            fbrain.t = t;
            if t == 25 {
                fbb.set(50, 1);
            }
            fsm.tick(&mut fbrain, &mut fbb);
            fsm_ticks.push(serde_json::json!({
                "current": fsm.current, "hash": format!("{:#x}", fsm.hash()),
                "bb": fbb.values.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), *v)).collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>(),
            }));
        }
        let doc = serde_json::json!({
            "tree": tree_root, "tree_ticks": ticks,
            "fsm": StateMachine::new(serde_json::from_slice::<StateMachine>(&fsm.to_json()).unwrap().states.into_values().collect(), 1),
            "fsm_ticks": fsm_ticks,
            "script": {"see_ticks": "8..=12, 20..=22", "dead_at": 25, "patrol_left_start": 2},
        });
        let path = concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/fixtures/vectors.json");
        let text = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&doc).unwrap();
        if std::env::var("BOTS_WRITE_VECTORS").is_ok() {
            std::fs::write(path, &text).unwrap();
        }
        let on_disk = std::fs::read_to_string(path)
            .expect("fixtures/vectors.json (run with BOTS_WRITE_VECTORS=1)");
        assert_eq!(
            on_disk.trim(),
            text.trim(),
            "bot vectors drifted from the fixture"
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/net-sim-guest/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! `physics-arena`: a room-logic module (see `net-game` for the host ABI) whose avatars are
//! deterministic fixed-point circles in a walled `net-sim-physics` world. Input = i8 move_x,
//! i8 move_z, u8 buttons; the module sets the avatar's velocity, steps the world and writes
//! `Transform.pos` (x, 0, z) for replication, so the node's frame hash — the lockstep referee's
//! truth — is driven by the same physics clients run through `net-sim-wasm`.
//!
//! Build: `cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p net-sim-guest`, upload with
//! `aurix-net module-put physics-arena target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/net_sim_guest.wasm`,
//! room props: `{"schema": "component Transform {\n pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)\n speed: f32\n}",
//! "logic": "physics-arena", "position": "Transform.0"}`.
//! Guest memory is not checkpointed across failover; the world is rebuilt from the frame's
//! `Transform.pos` on `aurix_init` with zero velocity (a documented approximation).
#![allow(clippy::missing_safety_doc)]

use net_fpmath::{Fx, FxVec2};
use net_sim_physics::{Body, BodyId, BodyKind, Shape, World, WorldConfig};
use std::cell::RefCell;

#[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
mod host {
    #[link(wasm_import_module = "aurix")]
    extern "C" {
        pub fn spawn(owner: i32) -> i64;
        pub fn despawn(id: i64) -> i32;
        pub fn component_id(ptr: *const u8, len: i32) -> i32;
        pub fn set_vec3(id: i64, comp: i32, field: i32, x: f32, y: f32, z: f32) -> i32;
        pub fn set_f32(id: i64, comp: i32, field: i32, v: f32) -> i32;
        pub fn input_count() -> i32;
        pub fn input_entity(i: i32) -> i64;
        pub fn input_read(i: i32, ptr: *mut u8, cap: i32) -> i32;
        pub fn hitbox(id: i64, cx: f32, cy: f32, cz: f32, hx: f32, hy: f32, hz: f32);
    }
}

/// Native stand-ins so the crate type-checks, lints and unit-tests on the host; only the wasm32
/// build is ever instantiated by a node.
#[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]
mod host {
    pub unsafe fn spawn(_owner: i32) -> i64 {
        1
    }
    pub unsafe fn despawn(_id: i64) -> i32 {
        1
    }
    pub unsafe fn component_id(_ptr: *const u8, _len: i32) -> i32 {
        0
    }
    pub unsafe fn set_vec3(_id: i64, _c: i32, _f: i32, _x: f32, _y: f32, _z: f32) -> i32 {
        1
    }
    pub unsafe fn set_f32(_id: i64, _c: i32, _f: i32, _v: f32) -> i32 {
        1
    }
    pub unsafe fn input_count() -> i32 {
        0
    }
    pub unsafe fn input_entity(_i: i32) -> i64 {
        0
    }
    pub unsafe fn input_read(_i: i32, _ptr: *mut u8, _cap: i32) -> i32 {
        0
    }
    pub unsafe fn hitbox(_id: i64, _cx: f32, _cy: f32, _cz: f32, _hx: f32, _hy: f32, _hz: f32) {}
}

pub const ARENA_HALF: i32 = 40;
pub const RADIUS_CENTI: i64 = 50;
pub const SPEED: i32 = 6;
pub const TICK_HZ: u32 = 30;

pub struct Arena {
    pub world: World,
    pub avatars: Vec<(i64, i32, BodyId)>,
    transform: i32,
}

impl Arena {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let mut world = World::new(WorldConfig {
            gravity: FxVec2::ZERO,
            dt: Fx::from_ratio(1, TICK_HZ as i64),
            ..WorldConfig::default()
        });
        let h = Fx::from_int(ARENA_HALF);
        let t = Fx::ONE;
        for (x, y, hw, hh) in [
            (Fx::ZERO, h + t, h + t + t, t),
            (Fx::ZERO, -(h + t), h + t + t, t),
            (h + t, Fx::ZERO, t, h),
            (-(h + t), Fx::ZERO, t, h),
        ] {
            world.add(Body::new(
                BodyKind::Static,
                Shape::rect(hw, hh),
                FxVec2::new(x, y),
            ));
        }
        Self {
            world,
            avatars: Vec::new(),
            transform: -1,
        }
    }

    /// Spawn position on the same grid the built-in arena uses.
    pub fn spawn_at(actor: i32) -> FxVec2 {
        let a = actor.rem_euclid(1 << 16);
        FxVec2::new(
            Fx::from_int((a % 16) * 4 - 32),
            Fx::from_int(((a / 16) % 16) * 4 - 32),
        )
    }

    pub fn join(&mut self, entity: i64, actor: i32) -> BodyId {
        let mut b = Body::new(
            BodyKind::Dynamic,
            Shape::Circle {
                radius: Fx::from_ratio(RADIUS_CENTI, 100),
            },
            Self::spawn_at(actor),
        )
        .with_density(Fx::ONE);
        b.linear_damping = Fx::from_ratio(1, 10);
        let id = self.world.add(b);
        self.avatars.push((entity, actor, id));
        id
    }

    pub fn leave(&mut self, entity: i64) {
        if let Some(i) = self.avatars.iter().position(|a| a.0 == entity) {
            let (_, _, id) = self.avatars.remove(i);
            self.world.remove(id);
        }
    }

    /// `(move_x, move_z)` in -127..=127 → velocity `SPEED * v / 127`.
    pub fn steer(&mut self, entity: i64, mx: i8, mz: i8) {
        if let Some(&(_, _, id)) = self.avatars.iter().find(|a| a.0 == entity) {
            let v = FxVec2::new(
                Fx::from_ratio(SPEED as i64 * mx as i64, 127),
                Fx::from_ratio(SPEED as i64 * mz as i64, 127),
            );
            if let Some(b) = self.world.body_mut(id) {
                b.velocity = v;
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn step(&mut self) {
        self.world.step();
    }

    pub fn position(&self, id: BodyId) -> FxVec2 {
        self.world
            .body(id)
            .map(|b| b.position)
            .unwrap_or(FxVec2::ZERO)
    }
}

impl Default for Arena {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

thread_local! {
    static ARENA: RefCell<Option<Arena>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
}

fn with<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Arena) -> R) -> R {
    ARENA.with(|a| {
        let mut a = a.borrow_mut();
        f(a.get_or_insert_with(Arena::new))
    })
}

fn f32_of(v: Fx) -> f32 {
    // exact for the arena's range: integer part + 32-bit fraction, rounded once
    (v.0 as f64 / 4294967296.0) as f32
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn aurix_init(_seed: i64) {
    with(|a| {
        *a = Arena::new();
        a.transform = unsafe { host::component_id(b"Transform".as_ptr(), 9) };
    });
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn aurix_join(actor: i32) -> i64 {
    with(|a| {
        let e = unsafe { host::spawn(actor) };
        if e == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        let id = a.join(e, actor);
        let p = a.position(id);
        unsafe {
            host::set_vec3(e, a.transform, 0, f32_of(p.x), 0.0, f32_of(p.y));
            host::set_f32(e, a.transform, 1, SPEED as f32);
        }
        e
    })
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn aurix_leave(_actor: i32, entity: i64) {
    with(|a| {
        a.leave(entity);
        unsafe { host::despawn(entity) };
    });
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn aurix_step() {
    with(|a| {
        let n = unsafe { host::input_count() };
        for i in 0..n {
            let e = unsafe { host::input_entity(i) };
            if e == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let mut buf = [0u8; 3];
            let got = unsafe { host::input_read(i, buf.as_mut_ptr(), 3) };
            if got >= 2 {
                a.steer(e, buf[0] as i8, buf[1] as i8);
            }
        }
        a.step();
        let r = RADIUS_CENTI as f32 / 100.0;
        for &(e, _, id) in &a.avatars {
            let p = a.position(id);
            let (x, z) = (f32_of(p.x), f32_of(p.y));
            unsafe {
                host::set_vec3(e, a.transform, 0, x, 0.0, z);
                host::hitbox(e, x, 1.0, z, r, 1.0, r);
            }
        }
    });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn two_arenas_agree_and_walls_hold() {
        let run = || {
            let mut a = Arena::new();
            let e1 = a.join(1, 0);
            let _e2 = a.join(2, 1);
            for t in 0..600 {
                a.steer(1, 127, 0);
                a.steer(2, if t % 2 == 0 { -127 } else { 127 }, 64);
                a.step();
            }
            (a.position(e1), a.world.hash())
        };
        let (p, h) = run();
        assert_eq!(h, run().1);
        assert!(
            p.x < Fx::from_int(ARENA_HALF) && p.x > Fx::from_int(30),
            "{p:?}"
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/net-sim-nav/src/crowd.rs`:

```rs
//! Deterministic agents on a navmesh: flow fields (one Dijkstra per goal, shared by any number
//! of agents) and a crowd stepper with arrive, separation and sampled velocity-obstacle
//! avoidance. Agents are kept on the mesh by sliding along boundary edges (mesh raycast), so no
//! physics world is required for units; use `net-sim-physics` only for things that need to collide.

use crate::{hash_points, NavMesh, PolyId};
use net_fpmath::{Fx, FxVec2};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

/// Per-polygon "next hop" towards a goal point; `None` = unreachable.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct FlowField {
    pub goal: FxVec2,
    pub goal_poly: PolyId,
    /// For every polygon: (next polygon, point to steer towards) — the goal itself in its polygon.
    pub next: Vec<Option<(PolyId, FxVec2)>>,
    pub dist: Vec<Fx>,
}

impl FlowField {
    /// Dijkstra from the goal over portal midpoints (`mask` filters polygon flags like `find_path`).
    pub fn build(mesh: &NavMesh, goal: FxVec2, mask: u32) -> Option<FlowField> {
        let (goal_poly, goal) = mesh.nearest(goal)?;
        let n = mesh.polys.len();
        let mut next: Vec<Option<(PolyId, FxVec2)>> = vec![None; n];
        let mut dist: Vec<Fx> = vec![Fx::MAX; n];
        let mut entry: Vec<FxVec2> = vec![FxVec2::ZERO; n];
        let pass = |p: PolyId| {
            let f = mesh.polys[p as usize].flags;
            f == 0 || f & mask != 0
        };
        if !pass(goal_poly) {
            return None;
        }
        dist[goal_poly as usize] = Fx::ZERO;
        entry[goal_poly as usize] = goal;
        next[goal_poly as usize] = Some((goal_poly, goal));
        let mut open: BTreeSet<(Fx, PolyId)> = BTreeSet::new();
        open.insert((Fx::ZERO, goal_poly));
        while let Some(&(d, cur)) = open.iter().next() {
            open.remove(&(d, cur));
            if d > dist[cur as usize] {
                continue;
            }
            let here = entry[cur as usize];
            let poly = &mesh.polys[cur as usize];
            for (e, &nb) in poly.neighbors.iter().enumerate() {
                if nb == u32::MAX || !pass(nb) {
                    continue;
                }
                let (a, b) = mesh.edge_pub(cur, e as u32);
                let mid = (a + b).scale(Fx::HALF);
                let nd = d + (mid - here).length() * mesh.polys[nb as usize].cost;
                if nd < dist[nb as usize] {
                    dist[nb as usize] = nd;
                    entry[nb as usize] = mid;
                    next[nb as usize] = Some((cur, mid));
                    open.insert((nd, nb));
                }
            }
        }
        Some(FlowField {
            goal,
            goal_poly,
            next,
            dist,
        })
    }

    /// Unit direction an agent standing in `poly` at `pos` should move in (zero at the goal).
    pub fn direction(&self, poly: PolyId, pos: FxVec2) -> FxVec2 {
        match self.next.get(poly as usize).copied().flatten() {
            Some((_, target)) => {
                let d = target - pos;
                if d.length_sq() == Fx::ZERO {
                    FxVec2::ZERO
                } else {
                    d.normalized()
                }
            }
            None => FxVec2::ZERO,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Agent {
    pub pos: FxVec2,
    pub vel: FxVec2,
    pub radius: Fx,
    pub max_speed: Fx,
    /// Acceleration limit per second.
    pub max_accel: Fx,
    /// Goal point; `None` = idle (still avoids others).
    pub target: Option<FxVec2>,
    /// Flow field index in `Crowd::fields` when following a shared field instead of a target.
    pub field: Option<u32>,
    pub poly: PolyId,
    pub user: u64,
    pub arrived: bool,
}

impl Agent {
    pub fn new(pos: FxVec2, radius: Fx, max_speed: Fx) -> Agent {
        Agent {
            pos,
            vel: FxVec2::ZERO,
            radius,
            max_speed,
            max_accel: max_speed * Fx::from_int(8),
            target: None,
            field: None,
            poly: u32::MAX,
            user: 0,
            arrived: false,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CrowdConfig {
    pub dt: Fx,
    /// Neighbours closer than `radius_a + radius_b + separation` push each other apart.
    pub separation: Fx,
    pub separation_weight: Fx,
    /// Look-ahead for velocity-obstacle avoidance (seconds).
    pub horizon: Fx,
    /// Distance at which arrive starts slowing down.
    pub slow_radius: Fx,
    pub arrive_radius: Fx,
}

impl Default for CrowdConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        CrowdConfig {
            dt: Fx::from_ratio(1, 60),
            separation: Fx::HALF,
            separation_weight: Fx::from_int(2),
            horizon: Fx::from_int(2),
            slow_radius: Fx::from_int(2),
            arrive_radius: Fx::from_ratio(1, 4),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Crowd {
    pub cfg: CrowdConfig,
    pub agents: BTreeMap<u32, Agent>,
    pub fields: Vec<FlowField>,
    next_id: u32,
    pub tick: u32,
}

impl Crowd {
    pub fn new(cfg: CrowdConfig) -> Crowd {
        Crowd {
            cfg,
            agents: BTreeMap::new(),
            fields: Vec::new(),
            next_id: 1,
            tick: 0,
        }
    }
    pub fn add(&mut self, mesh: &NavMesh, mut agent: Agent) -> u32 {
        if let Some((p, q)) = mesh.nearest(agent.pos) {
            agent.poly = p;
            agent.pos = q;
        }
        let id = self.next_id;
        self.next_id += 1;
        self.agents.insert(id, agent);
        id
    }
    pub fn remove(&mut self, id: u32) -> Option<Agent> {
        self.agents.remove(&id)
    }
    pub fn add_field(&mut self, field: FlowField) -> u32 {
        self.fields.push(field);
        (self.fields.len() - 1) as u32
    }

    /// Preferred velocity: flow field direction or arrive towards `target`, scaled by max speed.
    fn preferred(&self, mesh: &NavMesh, a: &Agent) -> FxVec2 {
        let (dir, remaining) = if let Some(f) = a.field.and_then(|i| self.fields.get(i as usize)) {
            let d = f.direction(a.poly, a.pos);
            let remaining = f.dist.get(a.poly as usize).copied().unwrap_or(Fx::ZERO)
                + (f.goal - a.pos).length();
            if a.poly == f.goal_poly {
                let to = f.goal - a.pos;
                (
                    if to.length_sq() == Fx::ZERO {
                        FxVec2::ZERO
                    } else {
                        to.normalized()
                    },
                    to.length(),
                )
            } else {
                (d, remaining)
            }
        } else if let Some(t) = a.target {
            if a.poly != u32::MAX && mesh.contains(a.poly, t) || mesh.raycast(a.pos, t).is_none() {
                let to = t - a.pos;
                (
                    if to.length_sq() == Fx::ZERO {
                        FxVec2::ZERO
                    } else {
                        to.normalized()
                    },
                    to.length(),
                )
            } else {
                match mesh.find_path(a.pos, t, u32::MAX) {
                    Some(path) if path.points.len() >= 2 => {
                        let to = path.points[1] - a.pos;
                        (
                            if to.length_sq() == Fx::ZERO {
                                FxVec2::ZERO
                            } else {
                                to.normalized()
                            },
                            path.cost,
                        )
                    }
                    _ => (FxVec2::ZERO, Fx::ZERO),
                }
            }
        } else {
            return FxVec2::ZERO;
        };
        let speed = if remaining < self.cfg.slow_radius {
            a.max_speed * remaining / self.cfg.slow_radius
        } else {
            a.max_speed
        };
        dir.scale(speed)
    }

    /// One tick: steer, avoid, move, slide along mesh borders, update polygons.
    pub fn step(&mut self, mesh: &NavMesh) {
        let dt = self.cfg.dt;
        let ids: Vec<u32> = self.agents.keys().copied().collect();
        let snapshot: Vec<(u32, FxVec2, FxVec2, Fx)> = ids
            .iter()
            .map(|&i| {
                (
                    i,
                    self.agents[&i].pos,
                    self.agents[&i].vel,
                    self.agents[&i].radius,
                )
            })
            .collect();
        let mut new_vel: Vec<(u32, FxVec2)> = Vec::with_capacity(ids.len());
        for &id in &ids {
            let a = &self.agents[&id];
            let mut desired = self.preferred(mesh, a);
            // separation
            let mut push = FxVec2::ZERO;
            for &(oid, opos, _, orad) in &snapshot {
                if oid == id {
                    continue;
                }
                let d = a.pos - opos;
                let min = a.radius + orad + self.cfg.separation;
                let len = d.length();
                if len < min && len > Fx::ZERO {
                    push = push + d.scale((min - len) / len);
                }
            }
            desired = desired + push.scale(self.cfg.separation_weight);
            if desired.length_sq() > a.max_speed * a.max_speed {
                desired = desired.normalized().scale(a.max_speed);
            }
            // sampled velocity-obstacle avoidance: pick the candidate closest to `desired` whose
            // earliest collision with a neighbour is beyond the horizon (or the latest one)
            let best = self.avoid(id, a, desired, &snapshot);
            // acceleration limit
            let dv = best - a.vel;
            let max_dv = a.max_accel * dt;
            let v = if dv.length_sq() > max_dv * max_dv {
                a.vel + dv.normalized().scale(max_dv)
            } else {
                best
            };
            new_vel.push((id, v));
        }
        for (id, v) in new_vel {
            let a = self.agents.get_mut(&id).unwrap();
            a.vel = v;
            let want = a.pos + v.scale(dt);
            // stay on the mesh: slide along the boundary edge that blocks the move
            let mut pos = want;
            if mesh.locate(want).is_none() {
                if let Some(hit) = mesh.raycast(a.pos, want) {
                    let (ea, eb) = mesh.edge_pub(hit.poly, hit.edge);
                    let edge = (eb - ea).normalized();
                    let slide = edge.scale((want - hit.point).dot(edge));
                    let cand = hit.point + slide;
                    pos = if mesh.locate(cand).is_some() {
                        cand
                    } else {
                        mesh.nearest(cand).map(|(_, q)| q).unwrap_or(hit.point)
                    };
                } else {
                    pos = mesh.nearest(want).map(|(_, q)| q).unwrap_or(a.pos);
                }
            }
            // nudge inside so border points do not fail `locate` on the next tick
            a.pos = pos;
            a.poly = mesh
                .locate(pos)
                .or_else(|| mesh.nearest(pos).map(|(p, _)| p))
                .unwrap_or(a.poly);
            if let Some(t) = a.target {
                if (t - a.pos).length() <= self.cfg.arrive_radius {
                    a.arrived = true;
                    a.vel = FxVec2::ZERO;
                }
            }
            if let Some(f) = a.field.and_then(|i| self.fields.get(i as usize)) {
                if (f.goal - a.pos).length() <= self.cfg.arrive_radius {
                    a.arrived = true;
                    a.vel = FxVec2::ZERO;
                }
            }
        }
        self.depenetrate(mesh);
        self.tick += 1;
    }

    /// Hard overlap resolution: one pass pushing each overlapping pair apart (id order), then
    /// re-snapping to the mesh, so crowding at a goal never stacks agents on top of each other.
    fn depenetrate(&mut self, mesh: &NavMesh) {
        let ids: Vec<u32> = self.agents.keys().copied().collect();
        for i in 0..ids.len() {
            for j in i + 1..ids.len() {
                let (a, b) = (&self.agents[&ids[i]], &self.agents[&ids[j]]);
                let d = b.pos - a.pos;
                let min = a.radius + b.radius;
                let len = d.length();
                if len >= min {
                    continue;
                }
                let push = if len == Fx::ZERO {
                    FxVec2::new(min * Fx::HALF, Fx::ZERO)
                } else {
                    d.scale((min - len) * Fx::HALF / len)
                };
                let (pa, pb) = (a.pos - push, b.pos + push);
                let snap = |p: FxVec2, fallback: FxVec2| {
                    if mesh.locate(p).is_some() {
                        p
                    } else {
                        mesh.nearest(p).map(|(_, q)| q).unwrap_or(fallback)
                    }
                };
                let (pa, pb) = (snap(pa, a.pos), snap(pb, b.pos));
                let (qa, qb) = (mesh.locate(pa), mesh.locate(pb));
                let a = self.agents.get_mut(&ids[i]).unwrap();
                a.pos = pa;
                if let Some(q) = qa {
                    a.poly = q;
                }
                let b = self.agents.get_mut(&ids[j]).unwrap();
                b.pos = pb;
                if let Some(q) = qb {
                    b.poly = q;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn avoid(
        &self,
        id: u32,
        a: &Agent,
        desired: FxVec2,
        others: &[(u32, FxVec2, FxVec2, Fx)],
    ) -> FxVec2 {
        if desired.length_sq() == Fx::ZERO {
            return desired;
        }
        let ttc = |v: FxVec2| -> Fx {
            let mut earliest = self.cfg.horizon;
            for &(oid, opos, ovel, orad) in others {
                if oid == id {
                    continue;
                }
                let rel_p = opos - a.pos;
                if rel_p.length_sq()
                    > (a.max_speed * self.cfg.horizon * Fx::from_int(2))
                        .saturating_mul(a.max_speed * self.cfg.horizon * Fx::from_int(2))
                {
                    continue;
                }
                let rel_v = v - ovel;
                let r = a.radius + orad;
                // solve |rel_p + rel_v t| = r
                let aa = rel_v.length_sq();
                if aa == Fx::ZERO {
                    continue;
                }
                let bb = rel_p.dot(rel_v);
                let cc = rel_p.length_sq() - r * r;
                if cc < Fx::ZERO {
                    earliest = Fx::ZERO;
                    continue;
                }
                let disc = bb * bb - aa * cc;
                if disc < Fx::ZERO || bb >= Fx::ZERO {
                    continue;
                }
                let t = (-bb - disc.sqrt()) / aa;
                if t < earliest {
                    earliest = t;
                }
            }
            earliest
        };
        if ttc(desired) >= self.cfg.horizon {
            return desired;
        }
        let speed = desired.length();
        let dir = desired.scale(Fx::ONE / speed);
        let perp = FxVec2::new(-dir.y, dir.x);
        let mut best = desired;
        let mut best_score = Fx::MIN;
        // candidates: rotate ±20°, ±45°, ±70° at full and half speed, plus stop
        let angles = [
            (Fx::from_ratio(94, 100), Fx::from_ratio(34, 100)),
            (Fx::from_ratio(71, 100), Fx::from_ratio(71, 100)),
            (Fx::from_ratio(34, 100), Fx::from_ratio(94, 100)),
        ];
        let consider = |v: FxVec2, best: &mut FxVec2, best_score: &mut Fx| {
            let t = ttc(v);
            let penalty = (v - desired).length();
            let score = t * Fx::from_int(4) - penalty;
            if score > *best_score {
                *best_score = score;
                *best = v;
            }
        };
        for &(c, s) in &angles {
            for sign in [Fx::ONE, -Fx::ONE] {
                let d = dir.scale(c) + perp.scale(s * sign);
                consider(d.scale(speed), &mut best, &mut best_score);
                consider(d.scale(speed * Fx::HALF), &mut best, &mut best_score);
            }
        }
        consider(desired.scale(Fx::HALF), &mut best, &mut best_score);
        consider(FxVec2::ZERO, &mut best, &mut best_score);
        best
    }

    /// FNV hash of positions and velocities in id order.
    pub fn hash(&self) -> u64 {
        let pts: Vec<FxVec2> = self.agents.values().flat_map(|a| [a.pos, a.vel]).collect();
        hash_points(&pts) ^ (self.tick as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15)
    }
    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        serde_json::to_vec(self).unwrap_or_default()
    }
    pub fn restore(b: &[u8]) -> Option<Crowd> {
        serde_json::from_slice(b).ok()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn fx(v: i32) -> Fx {
        Fx::from_int(v)
    }
    fn p(x: i32, y: i32) -> FxVec2 {
        FxVec2::new(fx(x), fx(y))
    }
    fn walled() -> NavMesh {
        let blocked: Vec<(u32, u32)> = (0..5).map(|r| (4, r)).collect();
        NavMesh::grid(p(0, 0), fx(1), 8, 6, &blocked)
    }

    #[test]
    fn flow_field_descends_to_goal() {
        let m = walled();
        let goal = FxVec2::new(Fx::from_ratio(15, 2), Fx::HALF);
        let f = FlowField::build(&m, goal, u32::MAX).unwrap();
        for (i, n) in f.next.iter().enumerate() {
            let (nb, _) = n.expect("every cell reachable");
            if i as PolyId != f.goal_poly {
                assert!(
                    f.dist[nb as usize] < f.dist[i],
                    "poly {i} -> {nb} does not descend"
                );
            }
        }
        let far = m.locate(FxVec2::new(Fx::HALF, Fx::HALF)).unwrap();
        assert!(
            f.dist[far as usize].to_f64() > 11.0,
            "wall not respected: {}",
            f.dist[far as usize]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn crowd_crosses_the_gap_without_leaving_the_mesh() {
        let m = walled();
        let build = || {
            let mut c = Crowd::new(CrowdConfig::default());
            let field = c.add_field(
                FlowField::build(&m, FxVec2::new(Fx::from_ratio(15, 2), Fx::HALF), u32::MAX)
                    .unwrap(),
            );
            for i in 0..6 {
                let mut a = Agent::new(
                    FxVec2::new(
                        Fx::HALF + Fx::from_ratio(i % 3, 2),
                        Fx::HALF + Fx::from_ratio(i / 3, 1),
                    ),
                    Fx::from_ratio(1, 4),
                    fx(3),
                );
                a.field = Some(field);
                c.add(&m, a);
            }
            // two agents walking head-on along the bottom-right corridor, by target
            let mut l = Agent::new(
                FxVec2::new(Fx::from_ratio(11, 2), Fx::HALF),
                Fx::from_ratio(1, 4),
                fx(2),
            );
            l.target = Some(FxVec2::new(Fx::from_ratio(15, 2), Fx::from_ratio(11, 2)));
            c.add(&m, l);
            let mut r = Agent::new(
                FxVec2::new(Fx::from_ratio(15, 2), Fx::from_ratio(11, 2)),
                Fx::from_ratio(1, 4),
                fx(2),
            );
            r.target = Some(FxVec2::new(Fx::from_ratio(11, 2), Fx::HALF));
            c.add(&m, r);
            c
        };
        let mut c = build();
        let mut c2 = build();
        let mut min_pair = Fx::MAX;
        for _ in 0..900 {
            c.step(&m);
            c2.step(&m);
            let v: Vec<&Agent> = c.agents.values().collect();
            for a in &v {
                assert!(
                    m.locate(a.pos).is_some()
                        || m.nearest(a.pos)
                            .map(|(_, q)| (q - a.pos).length() < Fx::from_ratio(1, 100))
                            .unwrap_or(false),
                    "agent left the mesh at {:?}",
                    a.pos
                );
            }
            for i in 0..v.len() {
                for j in i + 1..v.len() {
                    min_pair = min_pair.min((v[i].pos - v[j].pos).length());
                }
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(c.hash(), c2.hash());
        let goal = FxVec2::new(Fx::from_ratio(15, 2), Fx::HALF);
        let near_goal = c
            .agents
            .values()
            .filter(|a| a.field.is_some() && (a.pos - goal).length() < Fx::from_ratio(3, 2))
            .count();
        assert_eq!(
            near_goal,
            6,
            "flow-field agents not around the goal: {:?}",
            c.agents.values().map(|a| a.pos).collect::<Vec<_>>()
        );
        let arrived = c
            .agents
            .values()
            .filter(|a| a.target.is_some() && a.arrived)
            .count();
        assert_eq!(arrived, 2, "head-on agents did not swap places");
        assert!(
            min_pair.to_f64() > 0.2,
            "agents overlapped: min distance {min_pair}"
        );
        let snap = c.snapshot();
        let back = Crowd::restore(&snap).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back.hash(), c.hash());
    }
}
```
