                BodyId(b),
                v3(ax, ay, az),
                v3(bx, by, bz),
                JointKind::Distance {
                    length: Fx(len),
                    min_length: Fx(min_len),
                },
            ))
            .0
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_joint_remove(h: u32, id: u32) -> u32 {
    with3(h, |s| s.world.remove_joint(JointId(id)).is_some() as u32).unwrap_or(0)
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_joint_motor(h: u32, id: u32, speed: i64, max_torque: i64) {
    with3(h, |s| {
        if let Some(j) = s.world.joint_mut(JointId(id)) {
            if let JointKind::Hinge {
                motor_speed,
                max_motor_torque,
                ..
            } = &mut j.kind
            {
                *motor_speed = Fx(speed);
                *max_motor_torque = Fx(max_torque);
            }
        }
    });
}

/// Hinge angle in radians (raw Fx), 0 for other joints.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_hinge_angle(h: u32, id: u32) -> i64 {
    with3(h, |s| {
        s.world.hinge_angle(JointId(id)).map(|a| a.0).unwrap_or(0)
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Capsule character controller over a kinematic capsule body; returns its index.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_kcc_new(
    h: u32,
    body: u32,
    step_height: i64,
    min_ground_ny: i64,
    snap: i64,
) -> u32 {
    with3(h, |s| {
        let mut k = CharacterController::new(BodyId(body));
        k.step_height = Fx(step_height);
        k.min_ground_normal_y = Fx(min_ground_ny);
        k.snap_distance = Fx(snap);
        s.kcc.push(k);
        (s.kcc.len() - 1) as u32
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Move the controller by (dx, dy, dz) this tick; returns grounded (1/0). Read the body for position.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_kcc_move(h: u32, k: u32, dx: i64, dy: i64, dz: i64) -> u32 {
    with3(h, |s| {
        let Some(kcc) = s.kcc.get_mut(k as usize) else {
            return 0;
        };
        kcc.step(&mut s.world, v3(dx, dy, dz));
        kcc.grounded as u32
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Controller state: 0..=2 ground normal, 3..=5 velocity, 6 grounded, 7 ground body (+1, 0 = none).
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_kcc_get(h: u32, k: u32, field: u32) -> i64 {
    with3(h, |s| {
        s.kcc
            .get(k as usize)
            .map(|c| match field {
                0 => c.ground_normal.x.0,
                1 => c.ground_normal.y.0,
                2 => c.ground_normal.z.0,
                3 => c.velocity.x.0,
                4 => c.velocity.y.0,
                5 => c.velocity.z.0,
                6 => c.grounded as i64,
                _ => c.ground_body.map(|b| b.0 as i64 + 1).unwrap_or(0),
            })
            .unwrap_or(0)
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

// ---- convex hulls (staged per world: verts, then faces as index loops) and sweeps ----

/// Clear the staged hull.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_convex_reset(h: u32) {
    with3(h, |s| {
        s.hull_verts.clear();
        s.hull_faces.clear();
        s.hull_face.clear();
    });
}

/// Push a body-space vertex (raw Fx); at most 32.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_convex_vert(h: u32, x: i64, y: i64, z: i64) -> u32 {
    with3(h, |s| {
        if s.hull_verts.len() < 32 {
            s.hull_verts.push(v3(x, y, z));
        }
        s.hull_verts.len() as u32
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Push a vertex index onto the face being built.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_convex_index(h: u32, i: u32) {
    with3(h, |s| {
        if s.hull_face.len() < 32 {
            s.hull_face.push(i);
        }
    });
}

/// Close the current face (>= 3 indices, any winding); at most 32 faces.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_convex_face_end(h: u32) -> u32 {
    with3(h, |s| {
        let f = std::mem::take(&mut s.hull_face);
        if f.len() >= 3
            && s.hull_faces.len() < 32
            && f.iter().all(|i| (*i as usize) < s.hull_verts.len())
        {
            s.hull_faces.push(f);
        }
        s.hull_faces.len() as u32
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Add a convex body from the staged hull (which stays staged for reuse); returns the body id like
/// `sim3_add_box`, or `u32::MAX` if the hull is invalid (< 4 vertices or faces).
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_add_convex(h: u32, k: u32, x: i64, y: i64, z: i64, density: i64) -> u32 {
    with3(h, |s| {
        if s.hull_verts.len() < 4 || s.hull_faces.len() < 4 {
            return u32::MAX;
        }
        s.world
            .add(Body::with_density(
                kind3(k),
                Shape::Convex {
                    verts: s.hull_verts.clone(),
                    faces: s.hull_faces.clone(),
                },
                v3(x, y, z),
                Fx(density),
            ))
            .0
    })
    .unwrap_or(u32::MAX)
}

/// Sphere sweep; result fields as `sim3_ray_get`. Returns body id + 1 or 0.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_spherecast(
    h: u32,
    x: i64,
    y: i64,
    z: i64,
    dx: i64,
    dy: i64,
    dz: i64,
    radius: i64,
    mask: u32,
) -> u32 {
    with3(h, |s| {
        match s
            .world
            .sphere_cast(v3(x, y, z), v3(dx, dy, dz), Fx(radius), mask)
        {
            Some(hit) => {
                LAST_RAY3.with(|r| {
                    *r.borrow_mut() = [
                        hit.fraction.0,
                        hit.point.x.0,
                        hit.point.y.0,
                        hit.point.z.0,
                        hit.normal.x.0,
                        hit.normal.y.0,
                        hit.normal.z.0,
                    ];
                });
                hit.body.0 + 1
            }
            None => 0,
        }
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

fn store_ray3(hit: Option<net_sim_physics3d::RayHit>) -> u32 {
    match hit {
        Some(hit) => {
            LAST_RAY3.with(|r| {
                *r.borrow_mut() = [
                    hit.fraction.0,
                    hit.point.x.0,
                    hit.point.y.0,
                    hit.point.z.0,
                    hit.normal.x.0,
                    hit.normal.y.0,
                    hit.normal.z.0,
                ];
            });
            hit.body.0 + 1
        }
        None => 0,
    }
}

/// Capsule sweep (segment along the capsule's y axis rotated by the quaternion); result fields as
/// `sim3_ray_get`. Returns body id + 1 or 0.
#[no_mangle]
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_capsulecast(
    h: u32,
    x: i64,
    y: i64,
    z: i64,
    qx: i64,
    qy: i64,
    qz: i64,
    qw: i64,
    half_len: i64,
    radius: i64,
    dx: i64,
    dy: i64,
    dz: i64,
    mask: u32,
) -> u32 {
    with3(h, |s| {
        store_ray3(s.world.capsule_cast(
            v3(x, y, z),
            FxQuat::new(Fx(qx), Fx(qy), Fx(qz), Fx(qw)),
            Fx(half_len),
            Fx(radius),
            v3(dx, dy, dz),
            mask,
        ))
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Box sweep (half extents in body space, rotated by the quaternion); result fields as
/// `sim3_ray_get`. Returns body id + 1 or 0.
#[no_mangle]
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_boxcast(
    h: u32,
    x: i64,
    y: i64,
    z: i64,
    qx: i64,
    qy: i64,
    qz: i64,
    qw: i64,
    hx: i64,
    hy: i64,
    hz: i64,
    dx: i64,
    dy: i64,
    dz: i64,
    mask: u32,
) -> u32 {
    with3(h, |s| {
        store_ray3(s.world.box_cast(
            v3(x, y, z),
            FxQuat::new(Fx(qx), Fx(qy), Fx(qz), Fx(qw)),
            v3(hx, hy, hz),
            v3(dx, dy, dz),
            mask,
        ))
    })
    .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Convex reference scenario: three pyramids dropped in a column, a box sliding off a static
/// wedge, a sphere rolling onto a pyramid, plus sphere, capsule and box sweeps mixed into the hash;
/// 300 ticks.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_hull_golden_hash() -> u64 {
    let h = sim3_world_new(0, Fx::from_int(-10).0, 0, 60);
    let one = Fx::ONE.0;
    let half = Fx::HALF.0;
    let q = Fx::from_ratio(1, 4).0;
    sim3_add_box(
        h,
        0,
        0,
        -half,
        0,
        Fx::from_int(30).0,
        half,
        Fx::from_int(30).0,
        one,
    );
    sim3_convex_reset(h);
    for (x, z) in [(-half, -half), (half, -half), (half, half), (-half, half)] {
        sim3_convex_vert(h, x, -q, z);
    }
    sim3_convex_vert(h, 0, Fx::from_ratio(3, 4).0, 0);
    for f in [
        [0, 1, 2, 3],
        [0, 1, 4, u32::MAX],
        [1, 2, 4, u32::MAX],
        [2, 3, 4, u32::MAX],
        [3, 0, 4, u32::MAX],
    ] {
        for i in f {
            if i != u32::MAX {
                sim3_convex_index(h, i);
            }
        }
        sim3_convex_face_end(h);
    }
    for i in 0..3i32 {
        sim3_add_convex(
            h,
            2,
            Fx::from_ratio(i as i64, 20).0,
            Fx::from_int(1 + 2 * i).0,
            0,
            one,
        );
    }
    sim3_add_convex(h, 0, Fx::from_int(6).0, 0, 0, one);
    sim3_add_box(
        h,
        2,
        Fx::from_ratio(62, 10).0,
        Fx::from_int(2).0,
        0,
        q,
        q,
        q,
        one,
    );
    let ball = sim3_add_sphere(h, 2, Fx::from_int(-4).0, half, 0, half, one) - 1;
    sim3_set_velocity(h, ball, Fx::from_int(4).0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    for _ in 0..300 {
        sim3_step(h);
    }
    let mut x = sim3_hash(h);
    if sim3_spherecast(
        h,
        Fx::from_int(-8).0,
        half,
        0,
        Fx::from_int(30).0,
        0,
        0,
        q,
        u32::MAX,
    ) != 0
    {
        for i in 0..7 {
            x ^= (sim3_ray_get(i) as u64).rotate_left(i * 7);
        }
    }
    // capsule and box sweeps through the same scene (r40: were unimplemented)
    let tilt = FxQuat::from_axis_angle(
        FxVec3::new(Fx::ZERO, Fx::ZERO, Fx::ONE),
        Fx::HALF_PI * Fx::HALF,
    );
    if sim3_capsulecast(
        h,
        Fx::from_int(-8).0,
        Fx::from_int(2).0,
        0,
        tilt.x.0,
        tilt.y.0,
        tilt.z.0,
        tilt.w.0,
        one,
        q,
        Fx::from_int(30).0,
        0,
        0,
        u32::MAX,
    ) != 0
    {
        for i in 0..7 {
            x ^= (sim3_ray_get(i) as u64).rotate_left(i * 5 + 1);
        }
    }
    if sim3_boxcast(
        h,
        0,
        Fx::from_int(12).0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        one,
        half,
        half,
        half,
        0,
        Fx::from_int(-20).0,
        0,
        u32::MAX,
    ) != 0
    {
        for i in 0..7 {
            x ^= (sim3_ray_get(i) as u64).rotate_left(i * 3 + 2);
        }
    }
    sim3_world_free(h);
    x
}

/// 3D joint/character reference scenario: ball pendulum, rope, limited hinge door, motor wheel and
/// a capsule character walking over a step into a wall; 300 ticks. Equal on native and wasm32.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn sim3_joint_golden_hash() -> u64 {
    let one = Fx::ONE.0;
    let half = Fx::HALF.0;
    let f = |v: i32| Fx::from_int(v).0;
    let h = sim3_world_new(0, f(-10), 0, 60);
    sim3_add_box(h, 0, 0, -half, 0, f(20), half, f(20), one);
    let anchor = sim3_add_sphere(h, 0, 0, f(10), 0, Fx::from_ratio(1, 10).0, one);
    let bob = sim3_add_sphere(h, 2, f(3), f(10), 0, Fx::from_ratio(1, 4).0, one);
    sim3_joint_ball(h, anchor, bob, 0, 0, 0, f(-3), 0, 0);
    let anchor2 = sim3_add_sphere(h, 0, f(10), f(10), 0, Fx::from_ratio(1, 10).0, one);
    let rope_end = sim3_add_sphere(h, 2, f(10), f(9), 0, Fx::from_ratio(1, 4).0, one);
    sim3_joint_distance(h, anchor2, rope_end, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, f(3), 0);
    let post = sim3_add_box(
        h,
        0,
        f(-10),
        f(1),
        0,
        Fx::from_ratio(1, 10).0,
        f(1),
        Fx::from_ratio(1, 10).0,
        one,
    );
    let door = sim3_add_box(
        h,
        2,
        (Fx::from_int(-10) + Fx::from_ratio(6, 10)).0,
        f(1),
        0,
        half,
        f(1),
        Fx::from_ratio(1, 20).0,
        one,
    );
    sim3_joint_hinge(
        h,
        post,
        door,
        Fx::from_ratio(1, 10).0,
        0,
        0,
        -half,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        one,
        0,
        0,
        one,
        0,
        1,
        0,
        Fx::HALF_PI.0,
        0,
        0,
    );
    sim3_apply_impulse(
        h,
        door,
        0,
        0,
        f(8),
        1,
        (Fx::from_int(-10) + Fx::ONE).0,
        f(1),
        0,
    );
    let axle = sim3_add_sphere(h, 0, f(20), f(5), 0, Fx::from_ratio(1, 10).0, one);
    let wheel = sim3_add_sphere(h, 2, f(20), f(5), 0, one, one);
    sim3_joint_hinge(
        h,
        axle,
        wheel,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        one,
        0,
        0,
        one,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        f(4),
        f(50),
    );
    sim3_add_box(
        h,
        0,
        f(4),
        Fx::from_ratio(15, 100).0,
        f(10),
        one,
        Fx::from_ratio(15, 100).0,
        f(2),
        one,
    );
    sim3_add_box(
        h,
        0,
        f(8),
        f(1),
        f(10),
        Fx::from_ratio(1, 4).0,
        one,
        f(2),
        one,
    );
    let hero = sim3_add_capsule(
        h,
        1,
        0,
        Fx::from_ratio(8, 10).0,
        f(10),
        half,
        Fx::from_ratio(3, 10).0,
        one,
    );
    let k = sim3_kcc_new(
        h,
        hero,
        half,
        Fx::from_ratio(7, 10).0,
        Fx::from_ratio(1, 4).0,
    );
    let dt = Fx::from_ratio(1, 60);
    for _ in 0..300 {
        sim3_kcc_move(
            h,
            k,
            (Fx::from_int(3) * dt).0,
            (Fx::from_int(-10) * dt).0,
            0,
        );
        sim3_step(h);
    }
    let hash = sim3_hash(h) ^ (sim3_hinge_angle(h, 3) as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15);
    sim3_world_free(h);
    hash
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn joint3_golden_is_stable() {
        let a = sim3_joint_golden_hash();
        assert_eq!(a, sim3_joint_golden_hash());
        eprintln!("native 3d joint golden hash: {a:#x}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn golden3_is_stable_and_abi_round_trips() {
        let a = sim3_golden_hash();
        assert_eq!(a, sim3_golden_hash());
        eprintln!("native 3d golden hash: {a:#x}");
        let h = sim3_world_new(0, Fx::from_int(-10).0, 0, 60);
        sim3_add_box(
            h,
            0,
            0,
            -Fx::HALF.0,
            0,
            Fx::from_int(10).0,
            Fx::HALF.0,
            Fx::from_int(10).0,
            Fx::ONE.0,
        );
        let ball = sim3_add_sphere(h, 2, 0, Fx::from_int(3).0, 0, Fx::HALF.0, Fx::ONE.0);
        for _ in 0..240 {
            sim3_step(h);
        }
        assert!((Fx(sim3_body_get(h, ball, 1)) - Fx::HALF).abs() < Fx::from_ratio(3, 100));
        let n = sim3_snapshot(h);
        assert!(n > 0);
        let hash = sim3_hash(h);
        sim3_set_position(h, ball, 0, Fx::from_int(9).0, 0);
        assert_ne!(sim3_hash(h), hash);
        assert_eq!(sim3_restore(h), 1);
        assert_eq!(sim3_hash(h), hash);
        assert_eq!(
            sim3_raycast(
                h,
                0,
                Fx::from_int(5).0,
                0,
                0,
                Fx::from_int(-10).0,
                0,
                u32::MAX
            ),
            ball + 1
        );
        assert!(
            (Fx(sim3_ray_get(2)) - Fx::ONE).abs() < Fx::from_ratio(5, 100),
            "{}",
            Fx(sim3_ray_get(2))
        );
        sim3_world_free(h);
    }
}

`crates/net-sim/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! Simulation frame: entities with schema components, per-actor inputs, events, fixed tick.
//! The same `Frame` type drives the authoritative server (sync mode) and client prediction;
//! `snapshot`/`restore` and `hash` make it usable for checkpoints and lockstep verification.

use net_common::types::{ActorId, Tick};
use net_wire::{BitReader, BitWriter, ComponentValue, Schema, Value};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, VecDeque};

/// Entity handle: slot index + generation, so stale handles never alias a reused slot.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct EntityId {
    pub index: u32,
    pub generation: u16,
}

impl EntityId {
    pub fn to_u64(self) -> u64 {
        ((self.generation as u64) << 32) | self.index as u64
    }
    pub fn from_u64(v: u64) -> Self {
        Self {
            index: v as u32,
            generation: (v >> 32) as u16,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Entity {
    pub id: EntityId,
    /// Actor allowed to send inputs for this entity (None = server-owned).
    pub owner: Option<ActorId>,
    /// Components by schema component id.
    pub components: BTreeMap<u16, ComponentValue>,
    pub spawned_at: Tick,
}

/// One actor's input for one tick: an opaque schema-encoded blob chosen by the game.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Input {
    pub actor: ActorId,
    pub tick: Tick,
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
}

/// Game event raised by the simulation for clients (and the replay).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SimEvent {
    pub tick: Tick,
    pub code: u16,
    pub target: Option<ActorId>,
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SimError {
    #[error("unknown entity")]
    NoEntity,
    #[error("unknown component {0}")]
    NoComponent(u16),
    #[error("actor {0:?} does not own the entity")]
    NotOwner(ActorId),
    #[error("entity limit {0} reached")]
    Full(u32),
    #[error("codec: {0}")]
    Codec(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct FrameConfig {
    pub tick_hz: u16,
    pub max_entities: u32,
    /// Inputs kept per actor for late/duplicate arrivals.
    pub input_window: u32,
}

impl Default for FrameConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            tick_hz: 60,
            max_entities: 4096,
            input_window: 64,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Frame {
    pub cfg: FrameConfig,
    pub schema: Schema,
    pub tick: Tick,
    slots: Vec<Option<Entity>>,
    generations: Vec<u16>,
    free: Vec<u32>,
    inputs: BTreeMap<ActorId, BTreeMap<u32, Vec<u8>>>,
    /// Last input applied per actor; reused when a tick's input is missing.
    last_input: BTreeMap<ActorId, Vec<u8>>,
    events: VecDeque<SimEvent>,
    rng: u64,
}

impl Frame {
    pub fn new(schema: Schema, cfg: FrameConfig, seed: u64) -> Self {
        Self {
            cfg,
            schema,
            tick: Tick(0),
            slots: Vec::new(),
            generations: Vec::new(),
            free: Vec::new(),
            inputs: BTreeMap::new(),
            last_input: BTreeMap::new(),
            events: VecDeque::new(),
            rng: seed.max(1),
        }
    }

    pub fn dt(&self) -> f32 {
        1.0 / self.cfg.tick_hz as f32
    }

    // ---- entities -------------------------------------------------------------------

    pub fn spawn(&mut self, owner: Option<ActorId>) -> Result<EntityId, SimError> {
        let index = match self.free.pop() {
            Some(i) => i,
            None => {
                if self.slots.len() as u32 >= self.cfg.max_entities {
                    return Err(SimError::Full(self.cfg.max_entities));
                }
                self.slots.push(None);
                self.generations.push(0);
                (self.slots.len() - 1) as u32
            }
        };
        let id = EntityId {
            index,
            generation: self.generations[index as usize],
        };
        self.slots[index as usize] = Some(Entity {
            id,
            owner,
            components: BTreeMap::new(),
            spawned_at: self.tick,
        });
        Ok(id)
    }

    pub fn despawn(&mut self, id: EntityId) -> Result<(), SimError> {
        let slot = self
            .slots
            .get_mut(id.index as usize)
            .ok_or(SimError::NoEntity)?;
        match slot {
            Some(e) if e.id == id => {
                *slot = None;
                self.generations[id.index as usize] =
                    self.generations[id.index as usize].wrapping_add(1);
                self.free.push(id.index);
                Ok(())
            }
            _ => Err(SimError::NoEntity),
        }
    }

    /// Client side: makes sure `id` exists exactly as the server numbered it.
    /// Creates (or re-owns) an entity with a server-chosen id — delta/checkpoint application.
    /// Ids beyond `cfg.max_entities` are rejected instead of growing the slot table (a crafted
    /// id must not make a peer allocate gigabytes).
    pub fn ensure_entity(&mut self, id: EntityId, owner: Option<ActorId>) -> Result<(), SimError> {
        let i = id.index as usize;
        if id.index >= self.cfg.max_entities {
            return Err(SimError::Full(self.cfg.max_entities));
        }
        if i >= self.slots.len() {
            self.slots.resize(i + 1, None);
            self.generations.resize(i + 1, 0);
        }
        match &mut self.slots[i] {
            Some(e) if e.id == id => e.owner = owner,
            slot => {
                *slot = Some(Entity {
                    id,
                    owner,
                    components: BTreeMap::new(),
                    spawned_at: self.tick,
                });
                self.generations[i] = id.generation;
                self.free.retain(|f| *f != id.index);
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn entity(&self, id: EntityId) -> Option<&Entity> {
        self.slots
            .get(id.index as usize)
            .and_then(|s| s.as_ref())
            .filter(|e| e.id == id)
    }

    pub fn entity_mut(&mut self, id: EntityId) -> Option<&mut Entity> {
        self.slots
            .get_mut(id.index as usize)
            .and_then(|s| s.as_mut())
            .filter(|e| e.id == id)
    }

    pub fn entities(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Entity> {
        self.slots.iter().filter_map(|s| s.as_ref())
    }

    pub fn entity_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.slots.iter().filter(|s| s.is_some()).count()
    }

    /// Sets a component (validated against the schema type by encoding once).
    pub fn set(
        &mut self,
        id: EntityId,
        component: &str,
        value: ComponentValue,
    ) -> Result<(), SimError> {
        let c = self
            .schema
            .component(component)
            .ok_or(SimError::NoComponent(u16::MAX))?
            .clone();
        let mut w = BitWriter::new();
        value
            .encode_full(&c, &mut w)
            .map_err(|e| SimError::Codec(e.to_string()))?;
        let e = self.entity_mut(id).ok_or(SimError::NoEntity)?;
        e.components.insert(c.id, value);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: EntityId, component: &str) -> Option<&ComponentValue> {
        let c = self.schema.component(component)?;
        self.entity(id)?.components.get(&c.id)
    }

    pub fn get_mut(&mut self, id: EntityId, component: &str) -> Option<&mut ComponentValue> {
        let cid = self.schema.component(component)?.id;
        self.entity_mut(id)?.components.get_mut(&cid)
    }

    pub fn remove_component(&mut self, id: EntityId, component: &str) -> Result<(), SimError> {
        let cid = self
            .schema
            .component(component)
            .ok_or(SimError::NoComponent(u16::MAX))?
            .id;
        self.entity_mut(id)
            .ok_or(SimError::NoEntity)?
            .components
            .remove(&cid);
        Ok(())
    }

    // ---- inputs ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// Stores an input for a future (or current) tick. Inputs older than the window or for
    /// ticks already simulated are ignored and reported as `false`.
    pub fn push_input(&mut self, input: Input) -> bool {
        if input.tick.0 < self.tick.0 {
            return false;
        }
        let q = self.inputs.entry(input.actor).or_default();
        q.insert(input.tick.0, input.data);
        while q.len() > self.cfg.input_window as usize {
            let first = *q.keys().next().unwrap();
            q.remove(&first);
        }
        true
    }

    /// Input for `actor` at the current tick, or the last applied one (clients that lagged
    /// keep doing what they did). Returns the data and whether it was fresh.
    pub fn input_for(&mut self, actor: ActorId) -> (Vec<u8>, bool) {
        let fresh = self
            .inputs
            .get_mut(&actor)
            .and_then(|q| q.remove(&self.tick.0));
        match fresh {
            Some(d) => {
                self.last_input.insert(actor, d.clone());
                (d, true)
            }
            None => (
                self.last_input.get(&actor).cloned().unwrap_or_default(),
                false,
            ),
        }
    }

    pub fn has_input(&self, actor: ActorId, tick: Tick) -> bool {
        self.inputs
            .get(&actor)
            .is_some_and(|q| q.contains_key(&tick.0))
    }

    pub fn forget_actor(&mut self, actor: ActorId) {
        self.inputs.remove(&actor);
        self.last_input.remove(&actor);
    }

    // ---- events / rng / tick ----------------------------------------------------------

    pub fn raise(&mut self, code: u16, target: Option<ActorId>, data: Vec<u8>) {
        self.events.push_back(SimEvent {
            tick: self.tick,
            code,
            target,
            data,
        });
    }

    pub fn drain_events(&mut self) -> Vec<SimEvent> {
        self.events.drain(..).collect()
    }

    /// Deterministic xorshift64*; part of the frame state.
    pub fn rand_u32(&mut self) -> u32 {
        let mut x = self.rng;
        x ^= x >> 12;
        x ^= x << 25;
        x ^= x >> 27;
        self.rng = x;
        (x.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D) >> 32) as u32
    }

    /// Runs one tick: `step` sees the frame with inputs available, then the tick advances
    /// and stale input slots are dropped.
    pub fn advance<F: FnOnce(&mut Frame)>(&mut self, step: F) {
        step(self);
        self.tick = Tick(self.tick.0.wrapping_add(1));
        let t = self.tick.0;
        for q in self.inputs.values_mut() {
            q.retain(|k, _| *k >= t);
        }
    }

    // ---- snapshot / hash --------------------------------------------------------------

    /// Full state: tick, rng, every live entity with all components. Schema-encoded so it is
    /// compact and stable across builds.
    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut w = BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bits(self.tick.0 as u64, 32);
        w.write_bits(self.rng, 64);
        w.write_bits(self.slots.len() as u64, 32);
        w.write_bits(self.entity_count() as u64, 32);
        let cid_bits = self.schema.component_id_bits();
        for e in self.entities() {
            w.write_bits(e.id.index as u64, 32);
            w.write_bits(e.id.generation as u64, 16);
            w.write_bits(e.spawned_at.0 as u64, 32);
            match e.owner {
                Some(a) => {
                    w.write_bool(true);
                    w.write_bits(a.0 as u64, 16);
                }
                None => w.write_bool(false),
            }
            w.write_bits(e.components.len() as u64, 16);
            for (cid, v) in &e.components {
                w.write_bits(*cid as u64, cid_bits);
                if let Some(c) = self.schema.by_id(*cid) {
                    let _ = v.encode_full(c, &mut w);
                }
            }
        }
        for g in &self.generations {
            w.write_bits(*g as u64, 16);
        }
        w.finish()
    }

    pub fn restore(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> Result<(), SimError> {
        let err = |e: net_wire::bits::Eof| SimError::Codec(e.to_string());
        let mut r = BitReader::new(buf);
        let tick = Tick(r.read_bits(32).map_err(err)? as u32);
        let rng = r.read_bits(64).map_err(err)?;
        let nslots = r.read_bits(32).map_err(err)? as usize;
        let nents = r.read_bits(32).map_err(err)? as usize;
        if nslots > self.cfg.max_entities as usize || nents > nslots {
            return Err(SimError::Codec(format!(
                "snapshot claims {nslots} slots / {nents} entities (limit {})",
                self.cfg.max_entities
            )));
        }
        let cid_bits = self.schema.component_id_bits();
        let mut slots: Vec<Option<Entity>> = vec![None; nslots];
        for _ in 0..nents {
            let index = r.read_bits(32).map_err(err)? as u32;
            let generation = r.read_bits(16).map_err(err)? as u16;
            let spawned_at = Tick(r.read_bits(32).map_err(err)? as u32);
            let owner = if r.read_bool().map_err(err)? {
                Some(ActorId(r.read_bits(16).map_err(err)? as u16))
            } else {
                None
            };
            let n = r.read_bits(16).map_err(err)? as usize;
            let mut components = BTreeMap::new();
            for _ in 0..n {
                let cid = r.read_bits(cid_bits).map_err(err)? as u16;
                let c = self.schema.by_id(cid).ok_or(SimError::NoComponent(cid))?;
                let v = ComponentValue::decode_full(c, &mut r)
                    .map_err(|e| SimError::Codec(e.to_string()))?;
                components.insert(cid, v);
            }
            if index as usize >= nslots {
                return Err(SimError::Codec("entity index out of range".into()));
            }
            slots[index as usize] = Some(Entity {
                id: EntityId { index, generation },
                owner,
                components,
                spawned_at,
            });
        }
        let mut generations = Vec::with_capacity(nslots);
        for _ in 0..nslots {
            generations.push(r.read_bits(16).map_err(err)? as u16);
        }
        self.free = (0..nslots as u32)
            .filter(|i| slots[*i as usize].is_none())
            .rev()
            .collect();
        self.slots = slots;
        self.generations = generations;
        self.tick = tick;
        self.rng = rng;
        self.inputs.clear();
        self.events.clear();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Hash of the full state (what lockstep peers compare).
    pub fn hash(&self) -> [u8; 32] {
        *blake3::hash(&self.snapshot()).as_bytes()
    }
}

/// Convenience for games that keep a position vec3 in a component field.
pub fn vec3_of(v: &ComponentValue, field: usize) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
    match v.fields.get(field) {
        Some(Value::Vec3(p)) => Some(*p),
        _ => None,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn crafted_ids_and_snapshots_do_not_allocate() {
        let schema = net_wire::schema::Schema::parse("component T {\n  hp: u8\n}\n").unwrap();
        let mut f = super::Frame::new(schema, super::FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let huge = super::EntityId {
            index: u32::MAX - 1,
            generation: 0,
        };
        assert!(f.ensure_entity(huge, None).is_err());
        assert_eq!(f.entity_count(), 0);
        let mut w = net_wire::bits::BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bits(0, 32);
        w.write_bits(1, 64);
        w.write_bits(u64::from(u32::MAX), 32);
        w.write_bits(0, 32);
        assert!(f.restore(&w.finish()).is_err());
        assert_eq!(f.entity_count(), 0);
    }

    use super::*;

    fn schema() -> Schema {
        Schema::parse("component Transform {\n pos: vec3 @range(-1000, 1000, 0.01)\n rot: quat\n}\ncomponent Health {\n hp: u8\n}").unwrap()
    }

    fn transform(x: f32) -> ComponentValue {
        ComponentValue {
            fields: vec![
                Value::Vec3([x, 0.0, 0.0]),
                Value::Quat([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0]),
            ],
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn spawn_despawn_generations() {
        let mut f = Frame::new(
            schema(),
            FrameConfig {
                max_entities: 2,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            1,
        );
        let a = f.spawn(Some(ActorId(1))).unwrap();
        let b = f.spawn(None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(f.spawn(None), Err(SimError::Full(2)));
        f.despawn(a).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(f.despawn(a), Err(SimError::NoEntity));
        let c = f.spawn(None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.index, a.index);
        assert_ne!(c.generation, a.generation);
        assert!(f.entity(a).is_none());
        assert!(f.entity(b).is_some() && f.entity(c).is_some());
        assert_eq!(EntityId::from_u64(c.to_u64()), c);
    }

    #[test]
    fn components_validate_against_schema() {
        let mut f = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let e = f.spawn(None).unwrap();
        f.set(e, "Transform", transform(5.0)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            vec3_of(f.get(e, "Transform").unwrap(), 0),
            Some([5.0, 0.0, 0.0])
        );
        assert!(matches!(
            f.set(e, "Health", transform(1.0)),
            Err(SimError::Codec(_))
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            f.set(e, "Nope", transform(1.0)),
            Err(SimError::NoComponent(_))
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn inputs_fresh_then_repeat() {
        let mut f = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 1);
        let a = ActorId(3);
        assert!(f.push_input(Input {
            actor: a,
            tick: Tick(0),
            data: vec![1]
        }));
        assert!(f.push_input(Input {
            actor: a,
            tick: Tick(2),
            data: vec![3]
        }));
        let mut seen = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..4 {
            f.advance(|fr| {
                let (d, fresh) = fr.input_for(a);
                seen.push((d, fresh));
            });
        }
        assert_eq!(
            seen,
            vec![
                (vec![1], true),
                (vec![1], false),
                (vec![3], true),
                (vec![3], false)
            ]
        );
        assert!(!f.push_input(Input {
            actor: a,
            tick: Tick(1),
            data: vec![9]
        }));
        assert_eq!(f.tick, Tick(4));
    }

    #[test]
    fn snapshot_restore_hash() {
        let mut f = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 42);
        let e1 = f.spawn(Some(ActorId(1))).unwrap();
        let e2 = f.spawn(None).unwrap();
        f.despawn(e2).unwrap();
        let e3 = f.spawn(None).unwrap();
        f.set(e1, "Transform", transform(1.25)).unwrap();
        f.set(
            e3,
            "Health",
            ComponentValue {
                fields: vec![Value::UInt(77)],
            },
        )
        .unwrap();
        f.advance(|fr| {
            fr.rand_u32();
        });
        f.raise(1, None, vec![]);
        let snap = f.snapshot();
        let h = f.hash();

        let mut g = Frame::new(schema(), FrameConfig::default(), 0);
        g.restore(&snap).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(g.tick, Tick(1));
        assert_eq!(g.hash(), h);
        assert_eq!(g.entity_count(), 2);
        assert_eq!(g.entity(e3).unwrap().components.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(e3.index, e2.index); // e3 reused e2's slot
        assert_eq!(g.spawn(None).unwrap().index, 2); // no free slots after restore
        assert_eq!(g.rand_u32(), f.rand_u32());
        g.set(e1, "Transform", transform(2.0)).unwrap();
        assert_ne!(g.hash(), h);
    }
}

`crates/net-transport/src/channel.rs`:

```rs
//! Per-channel send/receive state. Reliability is our own (acks + retransmit) on top of
//! unreliable datagrams so that nothing blocks behind a lost packet.

use crate::packet::seq_newer;
use bytes::Bytes;
use net_common::limits::RELIABLE_WINDOW;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, VecDeque};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

/// Receive side of `UnreliableSequenced`: deliver only if newer than the last delivered.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct SequencedRx {
    last: Option<u16>,
}

impl SequencedRx {
    pub fn accept(&mut self, seq: u16) -> bool {
        match self.last {
            Some(l) if !seq_newer(seq, l) => false,
            _ => {
                self.last = Some(seq);
                true
            }
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct InFlight {
    pub seq: u16,
    pub payload: Bytes,
    pub sent_at: Instant,
    pub retries: u8,
}

/// Send side of a reliable channel: a sliding window of unacked packets.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct ReliableTx {
    next_seq: u16,
    in_flight: VecDeque<InFlight>,
    pending: VecDeque<Bytes>,
}

pub const MAX_RETRIES: u8 = 20;

/// A packet was retransmitted MAX_RETRIES times without an ack.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct LinkDead;

impl ReliableTx {
    /// Queues a payload; returns packets that may be sent now (window permitting).
    pub fn push(&mut self, payload: Bytes, now: Instant) -> Vec<(u16, Bytes)> {
        self.pending.push_back(payload);
        self.drain_window(now)
    }

    fn drain_window(&mut self, now: Instant) -> Vec<(u16, Bytes)> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        loop {
            // Bound the *span* of outstanding seqs, not just their count: the receiver can
            // only acknowledge 32 seqs behind the newest one it has seen.
            let oldest = self
                .in_flight
                .front()
                .map(|p| p.seq)
                .unwrap_or(self.next_seq);
            if self.next_seq.wrapping_sub(oldest) >= RELIABLE_WINDOW {
                break;
            }
            let Some(p) = self.pending.pop_front() else {
                break;
            };
            let seq = self.next_seq;
            self.next_seq = self.next_seq.wrapping_add(1);
            self.in_flight.push_back(InFlight {
                seq,
                payload: p.clone(),
                sent_at: now,
                retries: 0,
            });
            out.push((seq, p));
        }
        out
    }

    /// Processes a cumulative ack + bitfield. Returns RTT samples for acked packets.
    pub fn on_ack(&mut self, ack: u16, ack_bits: u32, now: Instant) -> Vec<Duration> {
        let mut rtts = Vec::new();
        self.in_flight.retain(|p| {
            let acked = if p.seq == ack {
                true
            } else if seq_newer(ack, p.seq) {
                let d = ack.wrapping_sub(p.seq);
                d <= 32 && (ack_bits >> (d - 1)) & 1 == 1
            } else {
                false
            };
            if acked && p.retries == 0 {
                rtts.push(now.duration_since(p.sent_at));
            }
            !acked
        });
        rtts
    }

    /// Returns packets to retransmit (older than `rto`) and newly windowed packets.
    /// `Err(LinkDead)` when a packet exceeded MAX_RETRIES.
    pub fn poll(&mut self, now: Instant, rto: Duration) -> Result<Vec<(u16, Bytes)>, LinkDead> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for p in self.in_flight.iter_mut() {
            if now.duration_since(p.sent_at) >= rto {
                if p.retries >= MAX_RETRIES {
                    return Err(LinkDead);
                }
                p.retries += 1;
                p.sent_at = now;
                out.push((p.seq, p.payload.clone()));
            }
        }
        out.extend(self.drain_window(now));
        Ok(out)
    }

    pub fn in_flight(&self) -> usize {
        self.in_flight.len()
    }
    pub fn pending(&self) -> usize {
        self.pending.len()
    }
}

/// Receive side of a reliable channel: dedupe, ack bookkeeping and (optionally) reordering.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct ReliableRx {
    ordered: bool,
    /// Highest seq seen (ack) and bitmask of 32 before it.
    ack: Option<u16>,
    ack_bits: u32,
    /// Next seq to deliver when ordered.
    next_deliver: u16,
    reorder: BTreeMap<u16, Bytes>,
    /// Recently delivered seqs for dedupe in unordered mode (relative to ack).
    seen: [u64; 4],
}

impl ReliableRx {
    pub fn new(ordered: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            ordered,
            ack: None,
            ack_bits: 0,
            next_deliver: 0,
            reorder: BTreeMap::new(),
            seen: [0; 4],
        }
    }

    /// `None` until the first packet arrives.
    pub fn ack_state(&self) -> Option<(u16, u32)> {
        self.ack.map(|a| (a, self.ack_bits))
    }

    fn mark(&mut self, seq: u16) -> bool {
        match self.ack {
            None => {
                self.ack = Some(seq);
                self.ack_bits = 0;
                true
            }
            Some(a) if seq == a => false,
            Some(a) if seq_newer(seq, a) => {
                let shift = seq.wrapping_sub(a) as u32;
                self.ack_bits = if shift >= 32 {
                    0
                } else {
                    (self.ack_bits << shift) | (1 << (shift - 1))
                };
                self.ack = Some(seq);
                true
            }
            Some(a) => {
                let d = a.wrapping_sub(seq) as u32;
                if d > 32 {
                    // Too old to track in the bitfield; treat as duplicate.
                    return false;
                }
                let bit = 1u32 << (d - 1);
                if self.ack_bits & bit != 0 {
                    false
                } else {
                    self.ack_bits |= bit;
                    true
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Feeds a packet; returns payloads ready for the application.
    pub fn accept(&mut self, seq: u16, payload: Bytes) -> Vec<Bytes> {
        if !self.mark(seq) {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        if !self.ordered {
            let idx = (seq as usize / 64) % 4;
            let bit = 1u64 << (seq % 64);
            if self.seen[idx] & bit != 0 {
                return Vec::new();
            }
            // Clear the bucket two ahead so old seqs can be reused after wraparound.
            self.seen[(idx + 2) % 4] = 0;
            self.seen[idx] |= bit;
            return vec![payload];
        }
        if seq == self.next_deliver {
            let mut out = vec![payload];
            self.next_deliver = self.next_deliver.wrapping_add(1);
            while let Some(p) = self.reorder.remove(&self.next_deliver) {
                out.push(p);
                self.next_deliver = self.next_deliver.wrapping_add(1);
            }
            out
        } else if seq_newer(seq, self.next_deliver) {
            if self.reorder.len() < RELIABLE_WINDOW as usize * 2 {
                self.reorder.insert(seq, payload);
            }
            Vec::new()
        } else {
            Vec::new()
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn sequenced_drops_old() {
        let mut r = SequencedRx::default();
        assert!(r.accept(5));
        assert!(!r.accept(4));
        assert!(r.accept(6));
        assert!(!r.accept(6));
    }

    #[test]
    fn ordered_reorders_and_dedupes() {
        let mut r = ReliableRx::new(true);
        assert!(r.accept(1, Bytes::from_static(b"b")).is_empty());
        let got = r.accept(0, Bytes::from_static(b"a"));
        assert_eq!(
            got,
            vec![Bytes::from_static(b"a"), Bytes::from_static(b"b")]
        );
        assert!(r.accept(0, Bytes::from_static(b"a")).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(r.ack_state(), Some((1, 0b1)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn unordered_delivers_immediately_once() {
        let mut r = ReliableRx::new(false);
        assert_eq!(r.accept(3, Bytes::from_static(b"d")).len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(r.accept(1, Bytes::from_static(b"b")).len(), 1);
        assert!(r.accept(3, Bytes::from_static(b"d")).is_empty());
        assert!(r.accept(1, Bytes::from_static(b"b")).is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn tx_acks_and_retransmits() {
        let now = Instant::now();
        let mut tx = ReliableTx::default();
        let sent = tx.push(Bytes::from_static(b"x"), now);
        assert_eq!(sent.len(), 1);
        let sent2 = tx.push(Bytes::from_static(b"y"), now);
        assert_eq!(sent2[0].0, 1);
        let r = tx.on_ack(1, 0b1, now + Duration::from_millis(40));
        assert_eq!(r.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(tx.in_flight(), 0);
        tx.push(Bytes::from_static(b"z"), now);
        let again = tx
            .poll(now + Duration::from_millis(500), Duration::from_millis(200))
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(again.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(again[0].0, 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn tx_window_limits_in_flight() {
        let now = Instant::now();
        let mut tx = ReliableTx::default();
        for _ in 0..300 {
            tx.push(Bytes::from_static(b"p"), now);
        }
        assert_eq!(tx.in_flight(), RELIABLE_WINDOW as usize);
        assert_eq!(tx.pending(), 300 - RELIABLE_WINDOW as usize);
    }
}

`crates/net-transport/src/fragment.rs`:

```rs
//! Messages larger than one datagram are split into fragments carried on the
//! `Fragment` kind over the reliable-unordered machinery and reassembled by message id.
//!
//! Fragment payload layout: `u16 msg_id, u8 channel, u8 index, u8 count, bytes…`

use bytes::{Buf, BufMut, Bytes, BytesMut};
use net_common::limits::{MAX_MESSAGE, MAX_UNFRAGMENTED};
use net_common::Channel;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

const FRAG_HDR: usize = 5;
pub const FRAG_PAYLOAD: usize = MAX_UNFRAGMENTED - FRAG_HDR;
const REASSEMBLY_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
const MAX_PARTIAL: usize = 64;

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Fragmenter {
    next_id: u16,
}

impl Fragmenter {
    /// Returns `None` if the message exceeds MAX_MESSAGE.
    pub fn split(&mut self, channel: Channel, msg: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<Bytes>> {
        if msg.len() > MAX_MESSAGE {
            return None;
        }
        let count = msg.len().div_ceil(FRAG_PAYLOAD).max(1);
        if count > u8::MAX as usize {
            return None;
        }
        let id = self.next_id;
        self.next_id = self.next_id.wrapping_add(1);
        Some(
            msg.chunks(FRAG_PAYLOAD)
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(i, c)| {
                    let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(FRAG_HDR + c.len());
                    b.put_u16(id);
                    b.put_u8(channel as u8);
                    b.put_u8(i as u8);
                    b.put_u8(count as u8);
                    b.extend_from_slice(c);
                    b.freeze()
                })
                .collect(),
        )
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct Partial {
    channel: Channel,
    parts: Vec<Option<Bytes>>,
    received: usize,
    started: Instant,
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Reassembler {
    partial: HashMap<u16, Partial>,
}

impl Reassembler {
    /// Feeds one fragment; returns the full message when complete.
    pub fn accept(&mut self, mut frag: Bytes, now: Instant) -> Option<(Channel, Bytes)> {
        if frag.len() < FRAG_HDR {
            return None;
        }
        let id = frag.get_u16();
        let channel = Channel::from_u8(frag.get_u8())?;
        let index = frag.get_u8() as usize;
        let count = frag.get_u8() as usize;
        if count == 0 || index >= count {
            return None;
        }
        self.partial
            .retain(|_, p| now.duration_since(p.started) < REASSEMBLY_TIMEOUT);
        if !self.partial.contains_key(&id) && self.partial.len() >= MAX_PARTIAL {
            return None;
        }
        let p = self.partial.entry(id).or_insert_with(|| Partial {
            channel,
            parts: vec![None; count],
            received: 0,
            started: now,
        });
        if p.parts.len() != count || p.channel != channel {
            self.partial.remove(&id);
            return None;
        }
        if p.parts[index].is_none() {
            p.parts[index] = Some(frag);
            p.received += 1;
        }
        if p.received == count {
            let p = self.partial.remove(&id).unwrap();
            let mut out = BytesMut::new();
            for part in p.parts {
                out.extend_from_slice(&part.unwrap());
            }
            Some((p.channel, out.freeze()))
        } else {
            None
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn split_and_reassemble_out_of_order() {
        let msg: Vec<u8> = (0..5000u32).map(|i| (i % 251) as u8).collect();
        let mut f = Fragmenter::default();
        let mut parts = f.split(Channel::ReliableOrdered, &msg).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(parts.len(), 5000usize.div_ceil(FRAG_PAYLOAD));
        parts.reverse();
        let mut r = Reassembler::default();
        let now = Instant::now();
        let mut got = None;
        for p in parts {
            got = r.accept(p, now).or(got);
        }
        let (ch, data) = got.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(ch, Channel::ReliableOrdered);
        assert_eq!(&data[..], &msg[..]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_oversize() {
        let mut f = Fragmenter::default();
        assert!(f
            .split(Channel::ReliableOrdered, &vec![0u8; MAX_MESSAGE + 1])
            .is_none());
    }
}

`crates/net-transport/src/link.rs`:

```rs
//! A [`Link`] multiplexes the three channels (plus fragments) onto a stream of datagrams.
//! It is sans-IO: the caller feeds incoming datagrams and drains outgoing ones, which keeps
//! it identical over QUIC, WebTransport and the WebSocket tunnel and trivially testable.

use crate::channel::{ReliableRx, ReliableTx, SequencedRx};
use crate::fragment::{Fragmenter, Reassembler};
use crate::packet::{Header, Kind, PacketError};
use bytes::{Buf, Bytes, BytesMut};
use net_common::limits::{HEADER_LEN, MAX_UNFRAGMENTED};
use net_common::Channel;
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct LinkStats {
    pub rtt: Duration,
    pub rtt_var: Duration,
    pub sent_datagrams: u64,
    pub recv_datagrams: u64,
    pub sent_bytes: u64,
    pub recv_bytes: u64,
    pub retransmits: u64,
    pub dropped_old: u64,
    pub decode_errors: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Received {
    pub channel: Channel,
    pub tick: u16,
    pub payload: Bytes,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum LinkError {
    #[error("message too large")]
    TooLarge,
    #[error("peer stopped acknowledging; link dead")]
    Dead,
}

const MIN_RTO: Duration = Duration::from_millis(60);
const MAX_RTO: Duration = Duration::from_millis(1500);
const ACK_DELAY: Duration = Duration::from_millis(20);

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Link {
    seq_tx: u16,
    seq_rx: SequencedRx,
    ordered_tx: ReliableTx,
    ordered_rx: ReliableRx,
    unordered_tx: ReliableTx,
    unordered_rx: ReliableRx,
    frag_tx: ReliableTx,
    frag_rx: ReliableRx,
    fragmenter: Fragmenter,
    reassembler: Reassembler,
    out: VecDeque<Bytes>,
    /// Small unreliable messages waiting to share one datagram (`u16 len` prefixed).
    batch: BytesMut,
    batch_n: usize,
    stats: LinkStats,
    srtt: Option<Duration>,
    rttvar: Duration,
    /// Local tick stamped into outgoing headers.
    pub tick: u16,
    ack_dirty: bool,
    last_ack_sent: Instant,
    last_recv: Instant,
    dead: bool,
}

impl Link {
    pub fn new(now: Instant) -> Self {
        Self {
            seq_tx: 0,
            seq_rx: SequencedRx::default(),
            ordered_tx: ReliableTx::default(),
            ordered_rx: ReliableRx::new(true),
            unordered_tx: ReliableTx::default(),
            unordered_rx: ReliableRx::new(false),
            frag_tx: ReliableTx::default(),
            frag_rx: ReliableRx::new(false),
            fragmenter: Fragmenter::default(),
            reassembler: Reassembler::default(),
            out: VecDeque::new(),
            batch: BytesMut::with_capacity(MAX_UNFRAGMENTED),
            batch_n: 0,
            stats: LinkStats::default(),
            srtt: None,
            rttvar: Duration::ZERO,
            tick: 0,
            ack_dirty: false,
            last_ack_sent: now,
            last_recv: now,
            dead: false,
        }
    }

    pub fn stats(&self) -> LinkStats {
        self.stats
    }

    pub fn rto(&self) -> Duration {
        match self.srtt {
            None => Duration::from_millis(250),
            Some(s) => (s + 4 * self.rttvar).clamp(MIN_RTO, MAX_RTO),
        }
    }

    pub fn last_recv(&self) -> Instant {
        self.last_recv
    }

    pub fn is_dead(&self) -> bool {
        self.dead
    }

    /// Acks are shared across reliable channels via a single (ack, bits) pair per kind;
    /// to keep the header small each channel carries its own ack in packets of that kind.
    fn ack_for(&self, kind: Kind) -> Option<(u16, u32)> {
        match kind {
            Kind::Channel(Channel::ReliableOrdered) => self.ordered_rx.ack_state(),
            Kind::Channel(Channel::ReliableUnordered) => self.unordered_rx.ack_state(),
            Kind::Fragment => self.frag_rx.ack_state(),
            Kind::Channel(Channel::UnreliableSequenced) => None,
        }
    }

    fn header(&self, kind: Kind, seq: u16, ack_only: bool) -> Header {
        let ack = self.ack_for(kind);
        Header {
            kind,
            ack_only,
            has_ack: ack.is_some(),
            batch: false,
            seq,
            ack: ack.map(|a| a.0).unwrap_or(0),
            ack_bits: ack.map(|a| a.1).unwrap_or(0),
            tick: self.tick,
        }
    }

    fn push_datagram(&mut self, h: Header, payload: &[u8]) {
        let mut b = BytesMut::with_capacity(HEADER_LEN + payload.len());
        h.encode(&mut b);
        b.extend_from_slice(payload);
        self.stats.sent_datagrams += 1;
        self.stats.sent_bytes += b.len() as u64;
        self.out.push_back(b.freeze());
    }

    fn emit(&mut self, kind: Kind, seq: u16, payload: &[u8], ack_only: bool) {
        let h = self.header(kind, seq, ack_only);
        self.push_datagram(h, payload);
    }

    /// Queues an application message on `channel`.
    pub fn send(&mut self, channel: Channel, msg: Bytes, now: Instant) -> Result<(), LinkError> {
        if msg.len() > MAX_UNFRAGMENTED {
            let parts = self
                .fragmenter
                .split(channel, &msg)
                .ok_or(LinkError::TooLarge)?;
            for p in parts {
                for (seq, payload) in self.frag_tx.push(p, now) {
                    self.emit(Kind::Fragment, seq, &payload, false);
                }
            }
            return Ok(());
        }
        match channel {
            Channel::UnreliableSequenced => {
                // Coalesce: several small messages share one datagram until flush_batch().
                if self.batch.len() + 2 + msg.len() > MAX_UNFRAGMENTED {
                    self.flush_batch();
                }
                self.batch
                    .extend_from_slice(&(msg.len() as u16).to_be_bytes());
                self.batch.extend_from_slice(&msg);
                self.batch_n += 1;
            }
            Channel::ReliableOrdered => {
                for (seq, payload) in self.ordered_tx.push(msg, now) {
                    self.emit(Kind::Channel(channel), seq, &payload, false);
                }
            }
            Channel::ReliableUnordered => {
                for (seq, payload) in self.unordered_tx.push(msg, now) {
                    self.emit(Kind::Channel(channel), seq, &payload, false);
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn sample_rtt(&mut self, samples: Vec<Duration>) {
        for r in samples {
            match self.srtt {
                None => {
                    self.srtt = Some(r);
                    self.rttvar = r / 2;
                }
                Some(s) => {
                    let diff = s.abs_diff(r);
                    self.rttvar = (self.rttvar * 3 + diff) / 4;
                    self.srtt = Some((s * 7 + r) / 8);
                }
            }
        }
        self.stats.rtt = self.srtt.unwrap_or_default();
        self.stats.rtt_var = self.rttvar;
    }

    /// Feeds one incoming datagram; returns messages ready for the application.
    pub fn receive(&mut self, datagram: Bytes, now: Instant) -> Vec<Received> {
        self.stats.recv_datagrams += 1;
        self.stats.recv_bytes += datagram.len() as u64;
        let (h, payload) = match Header::decode(datagram) {
            Ok(x) => x,
            Err(PacketError::TooShort)
            | Err(PacketError::Version(_))
            | Err(PacketError::Kind(_)) => {
                self.stats.decode_errors += 1;
                return Vec::new();
            }
        };
        self.last_recv = now;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        match h.kind {
            Kind::Channel(Channel::UnreliableSequenced) => {
                if h.ack_only {
                    return out;
                }
                if self.seq_rx.accept(h.seq) {
                    if h.batch {
                        let mut p = payload;
                        while p.len() >= 2 {
                            let n = u16::from_be_bytes([p[0], p[1]]) as usize;
                            p.advance(2);
                            if p.len() < n {
                                self.stats.decode_errors += 1;
                                break;
                            }
                            out.push(Received {
                                channel: Channel::UnreliableSequenced,
                                tick: h.tick,
                                payload: p.split_to(n),
                            });
                        }
                    } else {
                        out.push(Received {
                            channel: Channel::UnreliableSequenced,
                            tick: h.tick,
                            payload,
                        });
                    }
                } else {
                    self.stats.dropped_old += 1;
                }
            }
            Kind::Channel(Channel::ReliableOrdered) => {
                if h.has_ack {
                    let s = self.ordered_tx.on_ack(h.ack, h.ack_bits, now);
                    self.sample_rtt(s);
                }
                if !h.ack_only {
                    self.ack_dirty = true;
                    for p in self.ordered_rx.accept(h.seq, payload) {
                        out.push(Received {
                            channel: Channel::ReliableOrdered,
                            tick: h.tick,
                            payload: p,
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            Kind::Channel(Channel::ReliableUnordered) => {
                if h.has_ack {
                    let s = self.unordered_tx.on_ack(h.ack, h.ack_bits, now);
                    self.sample_rtt(s);
                }
                if !h.ack_only {
                    self.ack_dirty = true;
                    for p in self.unordered_rx.accept(h.seq, payload) {
                        out.push(Received {
                            channel: Channel::ReliableUnordered,
                            tick: h.tick,
                            payload: p,
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            Kind::Fragment => {
                if h.has_ack {
                    let s = self.frag_tx.on_ack(h.ack, h.ack_bits, now);
                    self.sample_rtt(s);
                }
                if !h.ack_only {
                    self.ack_dirty = true;
                    for frag in self.frag_rx.accept(h.seq, payload) {
                        if let Some((channel, msg)) = self.reassembler.accept(frag, now) {
                            out.push(Received {
                                channel,
                                tick: h.tick,
                                payload: msg,
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        out
    }

    /// Drives retransmits and delayed acks. Call every few milliseconds or after I/O.
    pub fn poll(&mut self, now: Instant) -> Result<(), LinkError> {
        self.flush_batch();
        let rto = self.rto();
        let mut dead = false;
        let mut retrans: Vec<(Kind, u16, Bytes)> = Vec::new();
        for (kind, tx) in [
            (
                Kind::Channel(Channel::ReliableOrdered),
                &mut self.ordered_tx,
            ),
            (
                Kind::Channel(Channel::ReliableUnordered),
                &mut self.unordered_tx,
            ),
            (Kind::Fragment, &mut self.frag_tx),
        ] {
            match tx.poll(now, rto) {
                Ok(pk) => {
                    for (seq, payload) in pk {
                        self.stats.retransmits += 1;
                        retrans.push((kind, seq, payload));
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => dead = true,
            }
        }
        if dead {
            self.dead = true;
            return Err(LinkError::Dead);
        }
        for (kind, seq, payload) in retrans {
            let h = self.header(kind, seq, false);
            self.push_datagram(h, &payload);
        }
        if self.ack_dirty && now.duration_since(self.last_ack_sent) >= ACK_DELAY {
            self.ack_dirty = false;
            self.last_ack_sent = now;
            for kind in [
                Kind::Channel(Channel::ReliableOrdered),
                Kind::Channel(Channel::ReliableUnordered),
                Kind::Fragment,
            ] {
                if self.ack_for(kind).is_some() {
                    self.emit(kind, 0, &[], true);
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Emits the pending unreliable batch as one datagram. Called by `poll()`; call it
    /// directly when a message must leave immediately.
    pub fn flush_batch(&mut self) {
        if self.batch_n == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let seq = self.seq_tx;
        self.seq_tx = self.seq_tx.wrapping_add(1);
        let mut h = self.header(Kind::Channel(Channel::UnreliableSequenced), seq, false);
        h.batch = true;
        let payload = self.batch.split().freeze();
        self.batch_n = 0;
        self.push_datagram(h, &payload);
    }

    /// Next datagram to put on the wire.
    pub fn next_outgoing(&mut self) -> Option<Bytes> {
        self.out.pop_front()
    }

    pub fn outgoing_len(&self) -> usize {
        self.out.len()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// Delivers a's outgoing datagrams to b, dropping roughly `drop_pct` percent with a
    /// deterministic LCG so the test is reproducible.
    fn pump(
        a: &mut Link,
        b: &mut Link,
        now: Instant,
        drop_pct: u32,
        rng: &mut u32,
    ) -> Vec<Received> {
        let mut got = Vec::new();
        while let Some(d) = a.next_outgoing() {
            *rng = rng.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
            if (*rng >> 16) % 100 < drop_pct {
                continue;
            }
            got.extend(b.receive(d, now));
        }
        got
    }

    #[test]
    fn reliable_ordered_survives_loss() {
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        let mut a = Link::new(t0);
        let mut b = Link::new(t0);
        for i in 0..100u32 {
            a.send(
                Channel::ReliableOrdered,
                Bytes::from(i.to_le_bytes().to_vec()),
                t0,
            )
            .unwrap();
        }
        let mut rng = 42u32;
        let mut received = pump(&mut a, &mut b, t0, 30, &mut rng);
        let mut now = t0;
        for _ in 0..200 {
            now += Duration::from_millis(300);
            b.poll(now).unwrap();
            pump(&mut b, &mut a, now, 30, &mut rng);
            a.poll(now).unwrap();
            received.extend(pump(&mut a, &mut b, now, 30, &mut rng));
            if received.len() == 100 {
                break;
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(received.len(), 100);
        for (i, r) in received.iter().enumerate() {
            assert_eq!(
                u32::from_le_bytes(r.payload[..].try_into().unwrap()),
                i as u32
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn large_message_is_fragmented_and_rebuilt() {
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        let mut a = Link::new(t0);
        let mut b = Link::new(t0);
        let msg = Bytes::from(vec![7u8; 20_000]);
        a.send(Channel::ReliableUnordered, msg.clone(), t0).unwrap();
        assert!(a.outgoing_len() > 10);
        let got = pump(&mut a, &mut b, t0, 0, &mut 1u32);
        assert_eq!(got.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(got[0].channel, Channel::ReliableUnordered);
        assert_eq!(got[0].payload, msg);
    }

    #[test]
    fn sequenced_drops_reordered_old() {
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        let mut a = Link::new(t0);
        let mut b = Link::new(t0);
        a.send(Channel::UnreliableSequenced, Bytes::from_static(b"1"), t0)
            .unwrap();
        a.flush_batch();
        a.send(Channel::UnreliableSequenced, Bytes::from_static(b"2"), t0)
            .unwrap();
        a.flush_batch();
        let d1 = a.next_outgoing().unwrap();
        let d2 = a.next_outgoing().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(b.receive(d2, t0).len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(b.receive(d1, t0).len(), 0);
        assert_eq!(b.stats().dropped_old, 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn unreliable_messages_coalesce() {
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        let mut a = Link::new(t0);
        let mut b = Link::new(t0);
        for i in 0..20u8 {
            a.send(Channel::UnreliableSequenced, Bytes::from(vec![i; 40]), t0)
                .unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(a.outgoing_len(), 0);
        a.flush_batch();
        assert_eq!(a.outgoing_len(), 1);
        let got = pump(&mut a, &mut b, t0, 0, &mut 1u32);
        assert_eq!(got.len(), 20);
        assert_eq!(got[7].payload, Bytes::from(vec![7u8; 40]));
        for _ in 0..40 {
            a.send(
                Channel::UnreliableSequenced,
                Bytes::from(vec![1u8; 100]),
                t0,
            )
            .unwrap();
        }
        a.flush_batch();
        assert!(a.outgoing_len() >= 4);
        assert_eq!(pump(&mut a, &mut b, t0, 0, &mut 1u32).len(), 40);
    }

    #[test]
    fn link_dies_without_acks() {
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        let mut a = Link::new(t0);
        a.send(Channel::ReliableOrdered, Bytes::from_static(b"x"), t0)
            .unwrap();
        let mut now = t0;
        let mut dead = false;
        for _ in 0..40 {
            now += Duration::from_secs(2);
            while a.next_outgoing().is_some() {}
            if a.poll(now).is_err() {
                dead = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        assert!(dead);
    }
}

`crates/net-transport/src/packet.rs`:

```rs
//! Fixed 12-byte header in front of every datagram.
//!
//! ```text
//! u8  version        PROTOCOL_VERSION
//! u8  kind           low 2 bits: channel (0..=2) or 3 = fragment; bit 7 = ack-only;
//!                    bit 6 = ack fields are valid (receiver has seen at least one packet)
//! u16 seq            per-channel sequence number
//! u16 ack            highest seq received on the peer's reliable stream (shared ack space)
//! u32 ack_bits       bitmask of the 32 seqs before `ack`
//! u16 tick           simulation tick hint (0 in relay mode)
//! ```

use bytes::{Buf, BufMut, Bytes, BytesMut};
use net_common::limits::HEADER_LEN;
use net_common::Channel;

pub const PROTOCOL_VERSION: u8 = 1;
pub const KIND_FRAGMENT: u8 = 3;
const FLAG_ACK_ONLY: u8 = 0x80;
const FLAG_HAS_ACK: u8 = 0x40;
/// Payload is a sequence of `u16 len, bytes` messages (unreliable channel only).
const FLAG_BATCH: u8 = 0x20;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Kind {
    Channel(Channel),
    Fragment,
}

impl Kind {
    fn to_u8(self) -> u8 {
        match self {
            Kind::Channel(c) => c as u8,
            Kind::Fragment => KIND_FRAGMENT,
        }
    }
    fn from_u8(v: u8) -> Option<Self> {
        if v == KIND_FRAGMENT {
            Some(Kind::Fragment)
        } else {
            Channel::from_u8(v).map(Kind::Channel)
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Header {
    pub kind: Kind,
    pub ack_only: bool,
    /// When false, `ack`/`ack_bits` carry nothing.
    pub has_ack: bool,
    pub batch: bool,
    pub seq: u16,
    pub ack: u16,
    pub ack_bits: u32,
    pub tick: u16,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PacketError {
    #[error("datagram shorter than header")]
    TooShort,
    #[error("unsupported protocol version {0}")]
    Version(u8),
    #[error("unknown packet kind {0}")]
    Kind(u8),
}

impl Header {
    pub fn encode(&self, out: &mut BytesMut) {
        out.put_u8(PROTOCOL_VERSION);
        let mut k = self.kind.to_u8();
        if self.ack_only {
            k |= FLAG_ACK_ONLY;
        }
        if self.has_ack {
            k |= FLAG_HAS_ACK;
        }
        if self.batch {
            k |= FLAG_BATCH;
        }
        out.put_u8(k);
        out.put_u16(self.seq);
        out.put_u16(self.ack);
        out.put_u32(self.ack_bits);
        out.put_u16(self.tick);
    }

    /// Splits a datagram into header and payload.
    pub fn decode(mut data: Bytes) -> Result<(Header, Bytes), PacketError> {
        if data.len() < HEADER_LEN {
            return Err(PacketError::TooShort);
        }
        let version = data.get_u8();
        if version != PROTOCOL_VERSION {
            return Err(PacketError::Version(version));
        }
        let k = data.get_u8();
        let kind = Kind::from_u8(k & 0x1f).ok_or(PacketError::Kind(k & 0x1f))?;
        let h = Header {
            kind,
            ack_only: k & FLAG_ACK_ONLY != 0,
            has_ack: k & FLAG_HAS_ACK != 0,
            batch: k & FLAG_BATCH != 0,
            seq: data.get_u16(),
            ack: data.get_u16(),
            ack_bits: data.get_u32(),
            tick: data.get_u16(),
        };
        Ok((h, data))
    }
}

/// `a` is newer than `b` with u16 wraparound.
#[inline]
pub fn seq_newer(a: u16, b: u16) -> bool {
    ((a > b) && (a - b <= 32768)) || ((a < b) && (b - a > 32768))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn roundtrip() {
        let h = Header {
            kind: Kind::Channel(Channel::ReliableOrdered),
            ack_only: false,
            has_ack: true,
            batch: false,
            seq: 65535,
            ack: 12,
            ack_bits: 0xdead_beef,
            tick: 777,
        };
        let mut b = BytesMut::new();
        h.encode(&mut b);
        b.extend_from_slice(b"xyz");
        assert_eq!(b.len(), HEADER_LEN + 3);
        let (d, p) = Header::decode(b.freeze()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(d, h);
        assert_eq!(&p[..], b"xyz");
    }

    #[test]
    fn wraparound() {
        assert!(seq_newer(1, 0));
        assert!(seq_newer(0, 65535));
        assert!(!seq_newer(65535, 0));
        assert!(!seq_newer(5, 5));
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_bad_version() {
        let mut b = BytesMut::zeroed(HEADER_LEN);
        b[0] = 9;
        assert_eq!(
            Header::decode(b.freeze()).unwrap_err(),
            PacketError::Version(9)
        );
    }
}
