`crates/net-transport/src/quic.rs`:

```rs
//! QUIC endpoints (quinn). Only DATAGRAM frames are used; streams are disabled.
//! Clients pin the server certificate by SHA-256 fingerprint advertised over the control
//! channel, so self-signed certificates work everywhere native.

use net_common::{NetError, Result};
use quinn::crypto::rustls::QuicServerConfig;
use rustls::pki_types::{CertificateDer, PrivateKeyDer, ServerName, UnixTime};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

pub const ALPN: &[u8] = b"aurix-net/1";

pub struct ServerIdentity {
    pub cert_chain: Vec<CertificateDer<'static>>,
    pub key: PrivateKeyDer<'static>,
    pub fingerprint_sha256: String,
}

pub fn fingerprint(der: &[u8]) -> String {
    hex::encode(Sha256::digest(der))
}

/// Loads PEM material or generates a self-signed certificate for `hosts`.
pub fn server_identity(
    cert_pem: Option<&str>,
    key_pem: Option<&str>,
    hosts: &[String],
) -> Result<ServerIdentity> {
    match (cert_pem, key_pem) {
        (Some(c), Some(k)) if !c.is_empty() && !k.is_empty() => {
            use rustls_pki_types::pem::PemObject;
            let chain: Vec<CertificateDer<'static>> = CertificateDer::pem_slice_iter(c.as_bytes())
                .collect::<std::result::Result<_, _>>()
                .map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("cert_pem: {e}")))?;
            let key = PrivateKeyDer::from_pem_slice(k.as_bytes())
                .map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("key_pem: {e}")))?;
            let fp = chain
                .first()
                .map(|c| fingerprint(c))
                .ok_or_else(|| NetError::Config("cert_pem has no certificate".into()))?;
            Ok(ServerIdentity {
                cert_chain: chain,
                key,
                fingerprint_sha256: fp,
            })
        }
        _ => {
            let names: Vec<String> = if hosts.is_empty() {
                vec!["localhost".into()]
            } else {
                hosts.to_vec()
            };
            // Browsers only accept `serverCertificateHashes` (WebTransport) for ECDSA certs
            // valid <= 14 days, so the dev certificate is short-lived and regenerated per start.
            let mut params = rcgen::CertificateParams::new(names)
                .map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("self-signed: {e}")))?;
            let now = chrono::Utc::now();
            let ymd = |d: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>| {
                use chrono::Datelike;
                rcgen::date_time_ymd(d.year(), d.month() as u8, d.day() as u8)
            };
            params.not_before = ymd(now - chrono::Duration::days(1));
            params.not_after = ymd(now + chrono::Duration::days(12));
            let key_pair = rcgen::KeyPair::generate()
                .map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("self-signed key: {e}")))?;
            let cert = params
                .self_signed(&key_pair)
                .map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("self-signed: {e}")))?;
            let der = CertificateDer::from(cert);
            let fp = fingerprint(&der);
            let key = PrivateKeyDer::try_from(key_pair.serialize_der())
                .map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("self-signed key: {e}")))?;
            Ok(ServerIdentity {
                cert_chain: vec![der],
                key,
                fingerprint_sha256: fp,
            })
        }
    }
}

pub fn transport_config(
    idle_timeout: Duration,
    keep_alive: Duration,
) -> Arc<quinn::TransportConfig> {
    let mut t = quinn::TransportConfig::default();
    t.max_concurrent_bidi_streams(0u32.into());
    t.max_concurrent_uni_streams(0u32.into());
    t.datagram_receive_buffer_size(Some(2 * 1024 * 1024));
    t.datagram_send_buffer_size(2 * 1024 * 1024);
    t.max_idle_timeout(Some(idle_timeout.try_into().unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        Duration::from_secs(15)
            .try_into()
            .expect("15s fits IdleTimeout")
    })));
    t.keep_alive_interval(Some(keep_alive));
    t.initial_mtu(1200);
    Arc::new(t)
}

pub fn server_endpoint(
    addr: SocketAddr,
    id: &ServerIdentity,
    transport: Arc<quinn::TransportConfig>,
) -> Result<quinn::Endpoint> {
    let mut tls = rustls::ServerConfig::builder()
        .with_no_client_auth()
        .with_single_cert(id.cert_chain.clone(), id.key.clone_key())
        .map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("tls: {e}")))?;
    tls.alpn_protocols = vec![ALPN.to_vec()];
    let qsc =
        QuicServerConfig::try_from(tls).map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("quic tls: {e}")))?;
    let mut sc = quinn::ServerConfig::with_crypto(Arc::new(qsc));
    sc.transport_config(transport);
    quinn::Endpoint::server(sc, addr).map_err(|e| NetError::Transport(format!("bind {addr}: {e}")))
}

/// Accepts exactly the certificate with the given fingerprint, nothing else.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct PinnedVerifier {
    fp: String,
}

impl rustls::client::danger::ServerCertVerifier for PinnedVerifier {
    fn verify_server_cert(
        &self,
        end_entity: &CertificateDer<'_>,
        _intermediates: &[CertificateDer<'_>],
        _server_name: &ServerName<'_>,
        _ocsp: &[u8],
        _now: UnixTime,
    ) -> std::result::Result<rustls::client::danger::ServerCertVerified, rustls::Error> {
        if fingerprint(end_entity) == self.fp {
            Ok(rustls::client::danger::ServerCertVerified::assertion())
        } else {
            Err(rustls::Error::General(
                "certificate fingerprint mismatch".into(),
            ))
        }
    }
    fn verify_tls12_signature(
        &self,
        message: &[u8],
        cert: &CertificateDer<'_>,
        dss: &rustls::DigitallySignedStruct,
    ) -> std::result::Result<rustls::client::danger::HandshakeSignatureValid, rustls::Error> {
        rustls::crypto::verify_tls12_signature(
            message,
            cert,
            dss,
            &rustls::crypto::ring::default_provider().signature_verification_algorithms,
        )
    }
    fn verify_tls13_signature(
        &self,
        message: &[u8],
        cert: &CertificateDer<'_>,
        dss: &rustls::DigitallySignedStruct,
    ) -> std::result::Result<rustls::client::danger::HandshakeSignatureValid, rustls::Error> {
        rustls::crypto::verify_tls13_signature(
            message,
            cert,
            dss,
            &rustls::crypto::ring::default_provider().signature_verification_algorithms,
        )
    }
    fn supported_verify_schemes(&self) -> Vec<rustls::SignatureScheme> {
        rustls::crypto::ring::default_provider()
            .signature_verification_algorithms
            .supported_schemes()
    }
}

pub fn client_endpoint(
    bind: SocketAddr,
    pinned_fp: &str,
    transport: Arc<quinn::TransportConfig>,
) -> Result<quinn::Endpoint> {
    let mut tls = rustls::ClientConfig::builder()
        .dangerous()
        .with_custom_certificate_verifier(Arc::new(PinnedVerifier {
            fp: pinned_fp.to_string(),
        }))
        .with_no_client_auth();
    tls.alpn_protocols = vec![ALPN.to_vec()];
    let qcc = quinn::crypto::rustls::QuicClientConfig::try_from(tls)
        .map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("quic client tls: {e}")))?;
    let mut cc = quinn::ClientConfig::new(Arc::new(qcc));
    cc.transport_config(transport);
    let mut ep = quinn::Endpoint::client(bind).map_err(|e| NetError::Transport(e.to_string()))?;
    ep.set_default_client_config(cc);
    Ok(ep)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use bytes::Bytes;

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn datagram_roundtrip_with_pinned_cert() {
        let _ = rustls::crypto::ring::default_provider().install_default();
        let id = server_identity(None, None, &["localhost".into()]).unwrap();
        let t = transport_config(Duration::from_secs(5), Duration::from_secs(1));
        let server = server_endpoint("127.0.0.1:0".parse().unwrap(), &id, t.clone()).unwrap();
        let addr = server.local_addr().unwrap();
        let fp = id.fingerprint_sha256.clone();
        let srv = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let conn = server.accept().await.unwrap().await.unwrap();
            let d = conn.read_datagram().await.unwrap();
            conn.send_datagram(Bytes::from(format!("echo:{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&d))))
                .unwrap();
            conn.read_datagram().await.ok();

        let conn = client.connect(addr, "localhost").unwrap().await.unwrap();

        let r = conn.read_datagram().await.unwrap();

        assert!(r.is_err());
    }

`crates/net-transport/src/ticket.rs`:

```rs
//! Data tickets: the first datagram on a fresh QUIC connection proves which session it
//! belongs to. 48 bytes: `u64 exp_unix, 16 session uuid, 16 room uuid(?)` is overkill;
//! we sign `session_id || room_id || actor || exp` with HMAC-SHA256 truncated to 16 bytes.

use hmac::{Hmac, KeyInit, Mac};
use net_common::limits::DATA_TICKET_TTL_SECS;
use net_common::{ActorId, RoomId, SessionId};
use sha2::Sha256;
use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
use subtle::ConstantTimeEq;

pub const TICKET_LEN: usize = 16 + 16 + 2 + 8 + 16;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct DataTicket {
    pub session: SessionId,
    pub room: RoomId,
    pub actor: ActorId,
    pub exp_unix: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct TicketSigner {
    key: Vec<u8>,
}

impl TicketSigner {
    pub fn new(secret: &[u8]) -> Self {
        Self {
            key: secret.to_vec(),
        }
    }

    fn mac(&self, body: &[u8]) -> [u8; 16] {
        let mut m = <Hmac<Sha256>>::new_from_slice(&self.key).expect("hmac accepts any key length");
        m.update(b"aurix-net-ticket-v1");
        m.update(body);
        let out = m.finalize().into_bytes();
        let mut t = [0u8; 16];
        t.copy_from_slice(&out[..16]);
        t
    }

    pub fn issue(&self, session: SessionId, room: RoomId, actor: ActorId) -> Vec<u8> {
        let exp = now_unix() + DATA_TICKET_TTL_SECS;
        let t = DataTicket {
            session,
            room,
            actor,
            exp_unix: exp,
        };
        self.encode(&t)
    }

    pub fn encode(&self, t: &DataTicket) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut body = Vec::with_capacity(TICKET_LEN);
        body.extend_from_slice(t.session.0.as_bytes());
        body.extend_from_slice(t.room.0.as_bytes());
        body.extend_from_slice(&t.actor.0.to_be_bytes());
        body.extend_from_slice(&t.exp_unix.to_be_bytes());
        let tag = self.mac(&body);
        body.extend_from_slice(&tag);
        body
    }

    /// Verifies signature and expiry.
    pub fn verify(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Option<DataTicket> {
        if data.len() != TICKET_LEN {
            return None;
        }
        let (body, tag) = data.split_at(TICKET_LEN - 16);
        let expect = self.mac(body);
        if expect.ct_eq(tag).unwrap_u8() != 1 {
            return None;
        }
        let session = SessionId(uuid::Uuid::from_slice(&body[0..16]).ok()?);
        let room = RoomId(uuid::Uuid::from_slice(&body[16..32]).ok()?);
        let actor = ActorId(u16::from_be_bytes([body[32], body[33]]));
        let exp_unix = u64::from_be_bytes(body[34..42].try_into().ok()?);
        if exp_unix < now_unix() {
            return None;
        }
        Some(DataTicket {
            session,
            room,
            actor,
            exp_unix,
        })
    }
}

fn now_unix() -> u64 {
    SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_secs())
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn roundtrip_and_tamper() {
        let s = TicketSigner::new(b"secret");
        let t = s.issue(SessionId::new(), RoomId::new(), ActorId(7));
        let v = s.verify(&t).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(v.actor, ActorId(7));
        let mut bad = t.clone();
        bad[33] ^= 1;
        assert!(s.verify(&bad).is_none());
        assert!(TicketSigner::new(b"other").verify(&t).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn expired_rejected() {
        let s = TicketSigner::new(b"k");
        let t = DataTicket {
            session: SessionId::new(),
            room: RoomId::new(),
            actor: ActorId(1),
            exp_unix: now_unix() - 1,
        };
        assert!(s.verify(&s.encode(&t)).is_none());
    }
}

`crates/net-transport/src/webtransport.rs`:

```rs
//! WebTransport (HTTP/3 over QUIC) endpoint for browsers. Same certificate, same tickets and
//! the same datagram-only data path as the raw QUIC endpoint; only the handshake differs
//! (browsers cannot open raw QUIC). Browsers pin the self-signed dev certificate through
//! `serverCertificateHashes`, production nodes use their real certificate.

use crate::quic::ServerIdentity;
use net_common::{NetError, Result};
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;
use wtransport::endpoint::endpoint_side::{Client, Server};
use wtransport::{ClientConfig, Endpoint, ServerConfig};

pub fn server_endpoint(
    addr: SocketAddr,
    id: &ServerIdentity,
    idle_timeout: Duration,
    keep_alive: Duration,
) -> Result<Endpoint<Server>> {
    let mut tls = rustls::ServerConfig::builder()
        .with_no_client_auth()
        .with_single_cert(id.cert_chain.clone(), id.key.clone_key())
        .map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("webtransport tls: {e}")))?;
    tls.alpn_protocols = vec![b"h3".to_vec()];
    let cfg = ServerConfig::builder()
        .with_bind_address(addr)
        .with_custom_tls(tls)
        .max_idle_timeout(Some(idle_timeout))
        .map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("webtransport idle: {e}")))?
        .keep_alive_interval(Some(keep_alive))
        .build();
    Endpoint::server(cfg).map_err(|e| NetError::Transport(format!("webtransport bind {addr}: {e}")))
}

/// Client that accepts exactly the server certificate with the given SHA-256 fingerprint
/// (hex), as a browser does with `serverCertificateHashes`. Used by tests and the load bot.
pub fn client_endpoint(cert_sha256_hex: &str) -> Result<Endpoint<Client>> {
    let bytes =
        hex::decode(cert_sha256_hex).map_err(|e| NetError::Config(format!("fingerprint: {e}")))?;
    let digest: [u8; 32] = bytes
        .try_into()
        .map_err(|_| NetError::Config("fingerprint must be 32 bytes".into()))?;
    let cfg = ClientConfig::builder()
        .with_bind_default()
        .with_server_certificate_hashes([wtransport::tls::Sha256Digest::new(digest)])
        .keep_alive_interval(Some(Duration::from_secs(5)))
        .build();
    Endpoint::client(cfg).map_err(|e| NetError::Transport(format!("webtransport client: {e}")))
}

pub type SharedConnection = Arc<wtransport::Connection>;

`crates/net-transport/tests/garbage.rs`:

```rs
//! Datagram headers, fragments, links and tickets never panic on garbage.
use bytes::Bytes;
use net_transport::fragment::Reassembler;
use net_transport::link::Link;
use net_transport::packet::Header;
use net_transport::TicketSigner;
use std::time::Instant;
fn rng(seed: u64) -> impl FnMut() -> u64 {
    let mut s = seed | 1;
    move || {
        s ^= s << 13;
        s ^= s >> 7;
        s ^= s << 17;
        s
    }
}
fn garbage(r: &mut impl FnMut() -> u64, max: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
    let n = (r() as usize) % (max + 1);
    (0..n).map(|_| r() as u8).collect()
}
#[allow(dead_code)]
fn mutate(r: &mut impl FnMut() -> u64, v: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut m = v.to_vec();
    let k = 1 + (r() % 4) as usize;
    for _ in 0..k {
        if m.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        let i = (r() as usize) % m.len();
        match r() % 3 {
            0 => m[i] ^= 1 << (r() % 8),
            1 => {
                m.remove(i);
            }
            _ => m.insert(i, r() as u8),
        }
    }
    m
}
#[test]
fn transport_decoders_survive_garbage() {
    let mut r = rng(29);
    let now = Instant::now();
    let mut link = Link::new(now);
    let mut re = Reassembler::default();
    let signer = TicketSigner::new(b"secret");
    for _ in 0..20_000 {
        let g = garbage(&mut r, 96);
        let _ = Header::decode(Bytes::from(g.clone()));
        let _ = re.accept(Bytes::from(g.clone()), now);
        let _ = link.receive(Bytes::from(g.clone()), now);
        let _ = signer.verify(&g);
        let _ = link.poll(now);
        while link.next_outgoing().is_some() {}
    }
}

```rs
//! MSB-first bit packing.

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
pub struct BitWriter {
    buf: Vec<u8>,
    /// Pending bits, MSB-aligned in the low `nscratch` bits.
    scratch: u64,
    nscratch: u32,
    bit: usize,
}

impl BitWriter {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn write_bits(&mut self, value: u64, nbits: u32) {
        debug_assert!(nbits <= 64);
        if nbits == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let value = if nbits == 64 {
            value
        } else {
            value & ((1u64 << nbits) - 1)
        };
        self.bit += nbits as usize;
        // Push in two halves when the scratch would overflow 64 bits.
        let mut remaining = nbits;
        let mut v = value;
        while remaining > 0 {
            let take = remaining.min(64 - self.nscratch);
            let part = v >> (remaining - take);
            let part = if take == 64 {
                part
            } else {
                part & ((1u64 << take) - 1)
            };
            self.scratch = if take == 64 {
                part
            } else {
                (self.scratch << take) | part
            };
            self.nscratch += take;
            remaining -= take;
            if remaining > 0 {
                v &= (1u64 << remaining) - 1;
            }
            while self.nscratch >= 8 {
                let byte = (self.scratch >> (self.nscratch - 8)) as u8;
                self.buf.push(byte);
                self.nscratch -= 8;
                if self.nscratch < 64 {
                    self.scratch &= (1u64 << self.nscratch) - 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn write_bool(&mut self, v: bool) {
        self.write_bits(v as u64, 1);
    }

    /// Unsigned integer in `[0, 2^nbits)`, clamped.
    pub fn write_uint(&mut self, v: u64, nbits: u32) {
        let max = if nbits >= 64 {
            u64::MAX
        } else {
            (1u64 << nbits) - 1
        };
        self.write_bits(v.min(max), nbits);
    }

    /// Signed integer via zigzag in `nbits`.
    pub fn write_int(&mut self, v: i64, nbits: u32) {
        let zz = ((v << 1) ^ (v >> 63)) as u64;
        self.write_uint(zz, nbits);
    }

    /// Quantizes `v` into `[min, max]` with step `res`.
    pub fn write_quantized(&mut self, v: f32, min: f32, max: f32, res: f32) {
        let (nbits, _) = quant_bits(min, max, res);
        let q = (((v.clamp(min, max) - min) / res) + 0.5) as u64;
        self.write_uint(q, nbits);
    }

    pub fn write_f32(&mut self, v: f32) {
        self.write_bits(v.to_bits() as u64, 32);
    }

    pub fn write_bytes(&mut self, b: &[u8]) {
        if self.nscratch == 0 {
            self.buf.extend_from_slice(b);
            self.bit += b.len() * 8;
            return;
        }
        for x in b {
            self.write_bits(*x as u64, 8);
        }
    }

    pub fn bit_len(&self) -> usize {
        self.bit
    }

    pub fn finish(mut self) -> Vec<u8> {
        if self.nscratch > 0 {
            let byte = (self.scratch << (8 - self.nscratch)) as u8;
            self.buf.push(byte);
            self.nscratch = 0;
        }
        self.buf
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[error("read past end of buffer")]
pub struct Eof;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct BitReader<'a> {
    buf: &'a [u8],
    bit: usize,
}

impl<'a> BitReader<'a> {
    pub fn new(buf: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
        Self { buf, bit: 0 }
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn read_bits(&mut self, nbits: u32) -> Result<u64, Eof> {
        if nbits == 0 {
            return Ok(0);
        }
        if self.bit + nbits as usize > self.buf.len() * 8 {
            return Err(Eof);
        }
        let mut v = 0u64;
        let mut remaining = nbits;
        while remaining > 0 {
            let byte = self.buf[self.bit / 8];
            let off = (self.bit % 8) as u32;
            let avail = 8 - off;
            let take = remaining.min(avail);
            let chunk = ((byte as u32) >> (avail - take)) & ((1u32 << take) - 1);
            v = (v << take) | chunk as u64;
            self.bit += take as usize;
            remaining -= take;
        }
        Ok(v)
    }

    pub fn read_bool(&mut self) -> Result<bool, Eof> {
        Ok(self.read_bits(1)? == 1)
    }

    pub fn read_uint(&mut self, nbits: u32) -> Result<u64, Eof> {
        self.read_bits(nbits)
    }

    pub fn read_int(&mut self, nbits: u32) -> Result<i64, Eof> {
        let zz = self.read_bits(nbits)?;
        Ok(((zz >> 1) as i64) ^ -((zz & 1) as i64))
    }

    pub fn read_quantized(&mut self, min: f32, max: f32, res: f32) -> Result<f32, Eof> {
        let (nbits, _) = quant_bits(min, max, res);
        let q = self.read_uint(nbits)?;
        Ok((min + q as f32 * res).min(max))
    }

    pub fn read_f32(&mut self) -> Result<f32, Eof> {
        Ok(f32::from_bits(self.read_bits(32)? as u32))
    }

    pub fn read_bytes(&mut self, n: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Eof> {
        if self.bit.is_multiple_of(8) {
            let start = self.bit / 8;
            if start + n > self.buf.len() {
                return Err(Eof);
            }
            self.bit += n * 8;
            return Ok(self.buf[start..start + n].to_vec());
        }
        (0..n).map(|_| self.read_bits(8).map(|b| b as u8)).collect()
    }

    pub fn bits_left(&self) -> usize {
        self.buf.len() * 8 - self.bit
    }
}

/// Bits needed to encode `(max-min)/res` steps, and the step count.
pub fn quant_bits(min: f32, max: f32, res: f32) -> (u32, u64) {
    let steps = (((max - min) / res).ceil() as u64).max(1);
    let bits = 64 - steps.leading_zeros();
    (bits.max(1), steps)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn roundtrip_mixed() {
        let mut w = BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bool(true);
        w.write_uint(5, 3);
        w.write_int(-1234, 20);
        w.write_quantized(12.345, -100.0, 100.0, 0.01);
        w.write_f32(1.5);
        w.write_bytes(b"ab");
        let bits = w.bit_len();
        let buf = w.finish();
        assert_eq!(buf.len(), bits.div_ceil(8));
        let mut r = BitReader::new(&buf);
        assert!(r.read_bool().unwrap());
        assert_eq!(r.read_uint(3).unwrap(), 5);
        assert_eq!(r.read_int(20).unwrap(), -1234);
        assert!((r.read_quantized(-100.0, 100.0, 0.01).unwrap() - 12.345).abs() < 0.006);
        assert_eq!(r.read_f32().unwrap(), 1.5);
        assert_eq!(r.read_bytes(2).unwrap(), b"ab");
        // Only padding bits remain in the last byte.
        let pad = buf.len() * 8 - bits;
        assert_eq!(r.read_bits(pad as u32).unwrap(), 0);
        assert_eq!(r.read_bits(1), Err(Eof));
    }

    #[test]
    fn word_boundaries() {
        let mut w = BitWriter::new();
        w.write_bits(0x1, 3);
        w.write_bits(u64::MAX, 64);
        w.write_bits(0xABCDEF, 24);
        w.write_bits(0, 61);
        w.write_bits(0x5, 3);
        let buf = w.finish();
        let mut r = BitReader::new(&buf);
        assert_eq!(r.read_bits(3).unwrap(), 1);
        assert_eq!(r.read_bits(64).unwrap(), u64::MAX);
        assert_eq!(r.read_bits(24).unwrap(), 0xABCDEF);
        assert_eq!(r.read_bits(61).unwrap(), 0);
        assert_eq!(r.read_bits(3).unwrap(), 5);
    }

    #[test]
    fn quant_bits_sizes() {
        assert_eq!(quant_bits(0.0, 1.0, 1.0).0, 1);
        assert_eq!(quant_bits(-1000.0, 1000.0, 0.01).0, 18);
    }
}

//! Schema-driven wire format: an IDL describes components, the codec bit-packs values with
//! quantization and encodes deltas against a baseline with a per-field change mask.
//! The schema hash travels in the handshake so client and server never disagree silently.

pub mod bits;
pub mod schema;
pub mod value;

pub use bits::{BitReader, BitWriter};
pub use schema::{Component, Field, FieldType, Schema, SchemaError};
pub use value::{ComponentValue, Value};

```

`crates/net-wire/src/schema.rs`:

```rs
//! IDL: text schema -> components with typed fields. Grammar (one statement per line,
//! `//` comments):
//!
//! ```text
//! component Transform {
//!     pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)
//!     rot: quat
//!     hp: u8
//!     name: string(24)
//!     flags: bits(5)
//!     speed: f32          // raw 32-bit
//!     team: i16
//! }
//! ```
//!
//! Components are numbered in declaration order; the hash covers the canonical text, so
//! renaming or reordering is a different schema.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum FieldType {
    Bool,
    /// Unsigned with `bits` width (u8=8, u16=16, u32=32, u64=64, bits(n)=n).
    UInt {
        bits: u32,
    },
    /// Signed zigzag with `bits` width.
    Int {
        bits: u32,
    },
    /// Raw f32.
    F32,
    /// Quantized float.
    Quant {
        min: f32,
        max: f32,
        res: f32,
    },
    /// Three quantized floats.
    Vec3 {
        min: f32,
        max: f32,
        res: f32,
    },
    /// Two quantized floats.
    Vec2 {
        min: f32,
        max: f32,
        res: f32,
    },
    /// Unit quaternion, smallest-three with 10 bits per component.
    Quat,
    /// UTF-8 up to `max` bytes.
    String {
        max: u32,
    },
    /// Opaque bytes up to `max`.
    Bytes {
        max: u32,
    },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Field {
    pub name: String,
    pub ty: FieldType,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Component {
    pub id: u16,
    pub name: String,
    pub fields: Vec<Field>,
    /// `@owner_only`: replicated only to the entity's owner (inventory, hand of cards).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub owner_only: bool,
    /// `@global`: an entity carrying this component is relevant to everyone regardless of AOI
    /// (score, match timer).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub global: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Schema {
    pub components: Vec<Component>,
    /// blake3 of the canonical text, hex.
    pub hash: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SchemaError {
    #[error("line {line}: {msg}")]
    Parse { line: usize, msg: String },
    #[error("duplicate component {0}")]
    DuplicateComponent(String),
    #[error("duplicate field {0}.{1}")]
    DuplicateField(String, String),
    #[error("too many components (max 4096)")]
    TooMany,
}

fn ident_ok(s: &str) -> bool {
    !s.is_empty()
        && s.chars()
            .next()
            .is_some_and(|c| c.is_ascii_alphabetic() || c == '_')
        && s.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_')
}

fn parse_type(spec: &str, line: usize) -> Result<FieldType, SchemaError> {
    let err = |msg: String| SchemaError::Parse { line, msg };
    let (base, attr) = match spec.find('@') {
        Some(i) => (spec[..i].trim(), Some(spec[i + 1..].trim())),
        None => (spec.trim(), None),
    };
    let range = |attr: Option<&str>| -> Result<(f32, f32, f32), SchemaError> {
        let a = attr.ok_or_else(|| err(format!("{base} needs @range(min, max, res)")))?;
        let inner = a
            .strip_prefix("range(")
            .and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix(')'))
            .ok_or_else(|| err(format!("bad attribute {a}")))?;
        let parts: Vec<f32> = inner
            .split(',')
            .map(|p| p.trim().parse::<f32>())
            .collect::<Result<_, _>>()
            .map_err(|_| err(format!("bad range numbers in {a}")))?;
        if parts.len() != 3 || parts[1] <= parts[0] || parts[2] <= 0.0 {
            return Err(err(format!(
                "range must be (min, max, res) with max>min, res>0: {a}"
            )));
        }
        Ok((parts[0], parts[1], parts[2]))
    };
    let paren = |name: &str| -> Result<Option<u32>, SchemaError> {
        if let Some(rest) = base.strip_prefix(name) {
            if rest.is_empty() {
                return Ok(None);
            }
            let n = rest
                .strip_prefix('(')
                .and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix(')'))
                .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<u32>().ok())
                .ok_or_else(|| err(format!("bad {name} size in {base}")))?;
            return Ok(Some(n));
        }
        Ok(None)
    };
    Ok(match base {
        "bool" => FieldType::Bool,
        "u8" => FieldType::UInt { bits: 8 },
        "u16" => FieldType::UInt { bits: 16 },
        "u32" => FieldType::UInt { bits: 32 },
        "u64" => FieldType::UInt { bits: 64 },
        "i8" => FieldType::Int { bits: 8 },
        "i16" => FieldType::Int { bits: 16 },
        "i32" => FieldType::Int { bits: 32 },
        "i64" => FieldType::Int { bits: 64 },
        "f32" if attr.is_none() => FieldType::F32,
        "f32" => {
            let (min, max, res) = range(attr)?;
            FieldType::Quant { min, max, res }
        }
        "vec3" => {
            let (min, max, res) = range(attr)?;
            FieldType::Vec3 { min, max, res }
        }
        "vec2" => {
            let (min, max, res) = range(attr)?;
            FieldType::Vec2 { min, max, res }
        }
        "quat" => FieldType::Quat,
        _ => {
            if let Some(n) = paren("bits")? {
                if n == 0 || n > 64 {
                    return Err(err("bits(n) needs 1..=64".into()));
                }
                return Ok(FieldType::UInt { bits: n });
            }
            if base.starts_with("bits") {
                return Err(err(format!("bad bits spec {base}")));
            }
            if let Some(n) = paren("string")? {
                return Ok(FieldType::String {
                    max: n.clamp(1, 65535),
                });
            }
            if let Some(n) = paren("bytes")? {
                return Ok(FieldType::Bytes {
                    max: n.clamp(1, 65535),
                });
            }
            return Err(err(format!("unknown type {base}")));
        }
    })
}

impl Schema {
    pub fn parse(text: &str) -> Result<Self, SchemaError> {
        let mut components: Vec<Component> = Vec::new();
        let mut cur: Option<Component> = None;
        let mut canonical = String::new();
        for (i, raw) in text.lines().enumerate() {
            let line = i + 1;
            let l = match raw.find("//") {
                Some(p) => &raw[..p],
                None => raw,
            }
            .trim();
            if l.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(rest) = l.strip_prefix("component ") {
                if cur.is_some() {
                    return Err(SchemaError::Parse {
                        line,
                        msg: "missing '}'".into(),
                    });
                }
                let header = rest.trim_end_matches('{').trim();
                let mut parts = header.split_whitespace();
                let name = parts.next().unwrap_or("");
                let (mut owner_only, mut global) = (false, false);
                for flag in parts {
                    match flag {
                        "@owner_only" => owner_only = true,
                        "@global" => global = true,
                        _ => {
                            return Err(SchemaError::Parse {
                                line,
                                msg: format!("unknown component flag {flag}"),
                            })
                        }
                    }
                }
                if !ident_ok(name) {
                    return Err(SchemaError::Parse {
                        line,
                        msg: format!("bad component name {name}"),
                    });
                }
                if components.iter().any(|c| c.name == name) {
                    return Err(SchemaError::DuplicateComponent(name.to_string()));
                }
                if components.len() >= 4096 {
                    return Err(SchemaError::TooMany);
                }
                canonical.push_str(&format!("component {name}"));
                if owner_only {
                    canonical.push_str(" @owner_only");
                }
                if global {
                    canonical.push_str(" @global");
                }
                canonical.push_str(" {\n");
                cur = Some(Component {
                    id: components.len() as u16,
                    name: name.to_string(),
                    fields: Vec::new(),
                    owner_only,
                    global,
                });
                continue;
            }
            if l == "}" {
                let c = cur.take().ok_or(SchemaError::Parse {
                    line,
                    msg: "unexpected '}'".into(),
                })?;
                canonical.push_str("}\n");
                components.push(c);
                continue;
            }
            let c = cur.as_mut().ok_or(SchemaError::Parse {
                line,
                msg: "field outside component".into(),
            })?;
            let (name, spec) = l.split_once(':').ok_or(SchemaError::Parse {
                line,
                msg: format!("expected 'name: type', got {l}"),
            })?;
            let name = name.trim();
            if !ident_ok(name) {
                return Err(SchemaError::Parse {
                    line,
                    msg: format!("bad field name {name}"),
                });
            }
            if c.fields.iter().any(|f| f.name == name) {
                return Err(SchemaError::DuplicateField(
                    c.name.clone(),
                    name.to_string(),
                ));
            }
            let ty = parse_type(spec.trim(), line)?;
            canonical.push_str(&format!("  {name}: {ty:?}\n"));
            c.fields.push(Field {
                name: name.to_string(),
                ty,
            });
        }
        if cur.is_some() {
            return Err(SchemaError::Parse {
                line: text.lines().count(),
                msg: "missing '}'".into(),
            });
        }
        let hash = blake3::hash(canonical.as_bytes()).to_hex().to_string();
        Ok(Schema { components, hash })
    }

    pub fn component(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&Component> {
        self.components.iter().find(|c| c.name == name)
    }

    pub fn by_id(&self, id: u16) -> Option<&Component> {
        self.components.get(id as usize)
    }

    /// Bits needed for a component id in this schema.
    pub fn component_id_bits(&self) -> u32 {
        (64 - (self.components.len().max(2) as u64 - 1).leading_zeros()).max(1)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const SRC: &str = r#"
// movement
component Transform {
    pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)
    rot: quat
    speed: f32
}
component Health {
    hp: u8
    team: i16
    name: string(24)
    flags: bits(5)
}
"#;

    #[test]
    fn parses_and_hashes() {
        let s = Schema::parse(SRC).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(s.components.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(s.component("Health").unwrap().id, 1);
        assert_eq!(
            s.component("Transform").unwrap().fields[0].ty,
            FieldType::Vec3 {
                min: -4096.0,
                max: 4096.0,
                res: 0.01
            }
        );
        assert_eq!(
            s.component("Health").unwrap().fields[3].ty,
            FieldType::UInt { bits: 5 }
        );
        let s2 = Schema::parse(&SRC.replace("hp: u8", "hp: u16")).unwrap();
        assert_ne!(s.hash, s2.hash);
        assert_eq!(
            Schema::parse(&format!("{SRC}\n// trailing comment"))
                .unwrap()
                .hash,
            s.hash
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_bad_input() {
        assert!(matches!(
            Schema::parse("component A {\n x: vec3\n}").unwrap_err(),
            SchemaError::Parse { .. }
        ));
        assert_eq!(
            Schema::parse("component A {\n}\ncomponent A {\n}").unwrap_err(),
            SchemaError::DuplicateComponent("A".into())
        );
        assert!(Schema::parse("component A {\n x: u8\n x: u8\n}").is_err());
        assert!(Schema::parse("component A {\n x: u8\n").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn component_flags() {
        let s = Schema::parse("component Inv @owner_only {\n n: u8\n}\ncomponent Score @global {\n s: u16\n}\ncomponent P {\n x: u8\n}").unwrap();
        assert!(s.component("Inv").unwrap().owner_only && !s.component("Inv").unwrap().global);
        assert!(s.component("Score").unwrap().global);
        assert!(!s.component("P").unwrap().owner_only && !s.component("P").unwrap().global);
        let plain = Schema::parse("component Inv {\n n: u8\n}").unwrap();
        let flagged = Schema::parse("component Inv @owner_only {\n n: u8\n}").unwrap();
        assert_ne!(plain.hash, flagged.hash);
        assert!(Schema::parse("component A @nope {\n x: u8\n}").is_err());
    }
}

`crates/net-wire/src/value.rs`:

```rs
//! Dynamic component values plus full and delta encoding against the schema.

use crate::bits::{BitReader, BitWriter, Eof};
use crate::schema::{Component, FieldType};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Value {
    Bool(bool),
    UInt(u64),
    Int(i64),
    F32(f32),
    Vec2([f32; 2]),
    Vec3([f32; 3]),
    /// x, y, z, w
    Quat([f32; 4]),
    String(String),
    Bytes(Vec<u8>),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ComponentValue {
    pub fields: Vec<Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum CodecError {
    #[error("value does not match field type at index {0}")]
    Type(usize),
    #[error("field count mismatch")]
    Arity,
    #[error(transparent)]
    Eof(#[from] Eof),
    #[error("invalid utf-8 in string field")]
    Utf8,
}

const QUAT_BITS: u32 = 10;

impl ComponentValue {
    /// Default (zero) value for a component.
    pub fn zero(c: &Component) -> Self {
        Self {
            fields: c
                .fields
                .iter()
                .map(|f| match &f.ty {
                    FieldType::Bool => Value::Bool(false),
                    FieldType::UInt { .. } => Value::UInt(0),
                    FieldType::Int { .. } => Value::Int(0),
                    FieldType::F32 | FieldType::Quant { .. } => Value::F32(0.0),
                    FieldType::Vec2 { .. } => Value::Vec2([0.0; 2]),
                    FieldType::Vec3 { .. } => Value::Vec3([0.0; 3]),
                    FieldType::Quat => Value::Quat([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0]),
                    FieldType::String { .. } => Value::String(String::new()),
                    FieldType::Bytes { .. } => Value::Bytes(Vec::new()),
                })
                .collect(),
        }
    }

    fn write_field(
        w: &mut BitWriter,
        ty: &FieldType,
        v: &Value,
        idx: usize,
    ) -> Result<(), CodecError> {
        match (ty, v) {
            (FieldType::Bool, Value::Bool(b)) => w.write_bool(*b),
            (FieldType::UInt { bits }, Value::UInt(x)) => w.write_uint(*x, *bits),
            (FieldType::Int { bits }, Value::Int(x)) => w.write_int(*x, *bits),
            (FieldType::F32, Value::F32(x)) => w.write_f32(*x),
            (FieldType::Quant { min, max, res }, Value::F32(x)) => {
                w.write_quantized(*x, *min, *max, *res)
            }
            (FieldType::Vec2 { min, max, res }, Value::Vec2(a)) => {
                for x in a {
                    w.write_quantized(*x, *min, *max, *res);
                }
            }
            (FieldType::Vec3 { min, max, res }, Value::Vec3(a)) => {
                for x in a {
                    w.write_quantized(*x, *min, *max, *res);
                }
            }
            (FieldType::Quat, Value::Quat(q)) => write_quat(w, *q),
            (FieldType::String { max }, Value::String(s)) => {
                let b = &s.as_bytes()[..s.len().min(*max as usize)];
                let b = truncate_utf8(b);
                w.write_uint(b.len() as u64, len_bits(*max));
                w.write_bytes(b);
            }
            (FieldType::Bytes { max }, Value::Bytes(b)) => {
                let b = &b[..b.len().min(*max as usize)];
                w.write_uint(b.len() as u64, len_bits(*max));
                w.write_bytes(b);
            }
            _ => return Err(CodecError::Type(idx)),
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn read_field(r: &mut BitReader, ty: &FieldType) -> Result<Value, CodecError> {
        Ok(match ty {
            FieldType::Bool => Value::Bool(r.read_bool()?),
            FieldType::UInt { bits } => Value::UInt(r.read_uint(*bits)?),
            FieldType::Int { bits } => Value::Int(r.read_int(*bits)?),
            FieldType::F32 => Value::F32(r.read_f32()?),
            FieldType::Quant { min, max, res } => Value::F32(r.read_quantized(*min, *max, *res)?),
            FieldType::Vec2 { min, max, res } => Value::Vec2([
                r.read_quantized(*min, *max, *res)?,
                r.read_quantized(*min, *max, *res)?,
            ]),
            FieldType::Vec3 { min, max, res } => Value::Vec3([
                r.read_quantized(*min, *max, *res)?,
                r.read_quantized(*min, *max, *res)?,
                r.read_quantized(*min, *max, *res)?,
            ]),
            FieldType::Quat => Value::Quat(read_quat(r)?),
            FieldType::String { max } => {
                let n = r.read_uint(len_bits(*max))? as usize;
                Value::String(String::from_utf8(r.read_bytes(n)?).map_err(|_| CodecError::Utf8)?)
            }
            FieldType::Bytes { max } => {
                let n = r.read_uint(len_bits(*max))? as usize;
                Value::Bytes(r.read_bytes(n)?)
            }
        })
    }

    /// All fields.
    pub fn encode_full(&self, c: &Component, w: &mut BitWriter) -> Result<(), CodecError> {
        if self.fields.len() != c.fields.len() {
            return Err(CodecError::Arity);
        }
        for (i, (f, v)) in c.fields.iter().zip(&self.fields).enumerate() {
            Self::write_field(w, &f.ty, v, i)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn decode_full(c: &Component, r: &mut BitReader) -> Result<Self, CodecError> {
        Ok(Self {
            fields: c
                .fields
                .iter()
                .map(|f| Self::read_field(r, &f.ty))
                .collect::<Result<_, _>>()?,
        })
    }

    /// Change mask (one bit per field) followed by changed fields only. Returns false when
    /// nothing changed (nothing written).
    pub fn encode_delta(
        &self,
        base: &Self,
        c: &Component,
        w: &mut BitWriter,
    ) -> Result<bool, CodecError> {
        if self.fields.len() != c.fields.len() || base.fields.len() != c.fields.len() {
            return Err(CodecError::Arity);
        }
        let changed: Vec<bool> = self
            .fields
            .iter()
            .zip(&base.fields)
            .map(|(a, b)| a != b)
            .collect();
        if !changed.iter().any(|c| *c) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        for ch in &changed {
            w.write_bool(*ch);
        }
        for (i, (f, v)) in c.fields.iter().zip(&self.fields).enumerate() {
            if changed[i] {
                Self::write_field(w, &f.ty, v, i)?;
            }
        }
        Ok(true)
    }

    pub fn decode_delta(base: &Self, c: &Component, r: &mut BitReader) -> Result<Self, CodecError> {
        let mut changed = Vec::with_capacity(c.fields.len());
        for _ in 0..c.fields.len() {
            changed.push(r.read_bool()?);
        }
        let mut out = base.clone();
        for (i, f) in c.fields.iter().enumerate() {
            if changed[i] {
                out.fields[i] = Self::read_field(r, &f.ty)?;
            }
        }
        Ok(out)
    }
}

fn len_bits(max: u32) -> u32 {
    (64 - (max as u64).leading_zeros()).max(1)
}

fn truncate_utf8(b: &[u8]) -> &[u8] {
    let mut n = b.len();
    while n > 0 && std::str::from_utf8(&b[..n]).is_err() {
        n -= 1;
    }
    &b[..n]
}

/// Smallest-three: drop the largest-magnitude component, send the other three in [-1/√2, 1/√2].
fn write_quat(w: &mut BitWriter, q: [f32; 4]) {
    let len = (q.iter().map(|x| x * x).sum::<f32>()).sqrt();
    let q = if len > 0.0 {
        q.map(|x| x / len)
    } else {
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    };
    let mut largest = 0;
    for (i, x) in q.iter().enumerate().skip(1) {
        if x.abs() > q[largest].abs() {
            largest = i;
        }
    }
    let sign = if q[largest] < 0.0 { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
    w.write_uint(largest as u64, 2);
    let lim = std::f32::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2;
    for (i, x) in q.iter().enumerate() {
        if i != largest {
            w.write_quantized(
                x * sign,
                -lim,
                lim,
                2.0 * lim / ((1u32 << QUAT_BITS) - 1) as f32,
            );
        }
    }
}

fn read_quat(r: &mut BitReader) -> Result<[f32; 4], Eof> {
    let largest = r.read_uint(2)? as usize;
    let lim = std::f32::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2;
    let mut q = [0.0f32; 4];
    let mut sum = 0.0;
    for (i, slot) in q.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        if i != largest {
            let v = r.read_quantized(-lim, lim, 2.0 * lim / ((1u32 << QUAT_BITS) - 1) as f32)?;
            *slot = v;
            sum += v * v;
        }
    }
    q[largest] = (1.0 - sum).max(0.0).sqrt();
    Ok(q)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::schema::Schema;

    fn schema() -> Schema {
        Schema::parse(
            "component T {\n pos: vec3 @range(-100, 100, 0.01)\n rot: quat\n hp: u8\n name: string(8)\n dir: i16\n raw: f32\n}",
        )
        .unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn full_roundtrip_and_sizes() {
        let s = schema();
        let c = s.component("T").unwrap();
        let v = ComponentValue {
            fields: vec![
                Value::Vec3([1.23, -45.67, 99.99]),
                Value::Quat([0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.927]),
                Value::UInt(200),
                Value::String("héllo wörld".into()),
                Value::Int(-300),
                Value::F32(3.5),
            ],
        };
        let mut w = BitWriter::new();
        v.encode_full(c, &mut w).unwrap();
        // 3*15 + (2+30) + 8 + (4+8*8) + 16 + 32 = 201 bits
        assert!(w.bit_len() <= 210, "{}", w.bit_len());
        let buf = w.finish();
        let d = ComponentValue::decode_full(c, &mut BitReader::new(&buf)).unwrap();
        match (&d.fields[0], &d.fields[1], &d.fields[3]) {
            (Value::Vec3(p), Value::Quat(q), Value::String(n)) => {
                assert!((p[1] + 45.67).abs() < 0.006);
                let dot: f32 = q
                    .iter()
                    .zip([0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.927])
                    .map(|(a, b)| a * b)
                    .sum();
                assert!(dot > 0.999, "{dot}");
                assert_eq!(n, "héllo w");
            }
            _ => panic!(),
        }
        assert_eq!(d.fields[2], Value::UInt(200));
        assert_eq!(d.fields[4], Value::Int(-300));
        assert_eq!(d.fields[5], Value::F32(3.5));
    }

    #[test]
    fn delta_only_changed_fields() {
        let s = schema();
        let c = s.component("T").unwrap();
        let base = ComponentValue::zero(c);
        let mut cur = base.clone();
        cur.fields[2] = Value::UInt(7);
        let mut w = BitWriter::new();
        assert!(cur.encode_delta(&base, c, &mut w).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(w.bit_len(), 6 + 8);
        let buf = w.finish();
        let d = ComponentValue::decode_delta(&base, c, &mut BitReader::new(&buf)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(d, cur);
        let mut w2 = BitWriter::new();
        assert!(!cur.encode_delta(&cur, c, &mut w2).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(w2.bit_len(), 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn type_mismatch_is_error() {
        let s = schema();
        let c = s.component("T").unwrap();
        let mut v = ComponentValue::zero(c);
        v.fields[2] = Value::Bool(true);
        assert_eq!(
            v.encode_full(c, &mut BitWriter::new()).unwrap_err(),
            CodecError::Type(2)
        );
    }
}

`crates/net-wire/tests/garbage.rs`:

```rs
//! Schema text and component codecs never panic on random input.
use net_wire::bits::BitReader;
use net_wire::schema::Schema;
use net_wire::value::ComponentValue;
fn rng(seed: u64) -> impl FnMut() -> u64 {
    let mut s = seed | 1;
    move || {
        s ^= s << 13;
        s ^= s >> 7;
        s ^= s << 17;
        s
    }
}
fn garbage(r: &mut impl FnMut() -> u64, max: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
    let n = (r() as usize) % (max + 1);
    (0..n).map(|_| r() as u8).collect()
}
#[allow(dead_code)]
fn mutate(r: &mut impl FnMut() -> u64, v: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut m = v.to_vec();
    let k = 1 + (r() % 4) as usize;
    for _ in 0..k {
        if m.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        let i = (r() as usize) % m.len();
        match r() % 3 {
            0 => m[i] ^= 1 << (r() % 8),
            1 => {
                m.remove(i);
            }
            _ => m.insert(i, r() as u8),
        }
    }
    m
}
const SCHEMA: &str = "component T {\n  pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)\n  rot: quat\n  name: string(16)\n  hp: u8\n  flags: bits(5)\n  blob: bytes(8)\n  f: f32\n  i: i32\n  b: bool\n  v2: vec2 @range(-10, 10, 0.1)\n}\n";
#[test]
fn schema_parse_survives_garbage_text() {
    let mut r = rng(3);
    let alphabet: &[u8] = b"component T{}:@range(),-.0123456789 \n\tabcxyz_vec3quatstringbitsbytesf32u8i16bool@owner_only@global";
    for _ in 0..20_000 {
        let n = (r() as usize) % 120;
        let t: String = (0..n)
            .map(|_| alphabet[(r() as usize) % alphabet.len()] as char)
            .collect();
        let _ = Schema::parse(&t);
        let _ = Schema::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&garbage(&mut r, 60)));
    }
}
#[test]
fn component_codecs_survive_garbage_bits() {
    let s = Schema::parse(SCHEMA).unwrap();
    let c = s.component("T").unwrap();
    let base = ComponentValue::zero(c);
    let mut r = rng(5);
    for _ in 0..20_000 {
        let g = garbage(&mut r, 48);
        let _ = ComponentValue::decode_full(c, &mut BitReader::new(&g));
        let _ = ComponentValue::decode_delta(&base, c, &mut BitReader::new(&g));
    }
}

`dashboard/Caddyfile`:

```
# Aurix Net console: static SPA + same-origin reverse proxy to one Aurix Net node.
#
# Environment:
#   NET_API_URL              node REST base URL the API prefixes are proxied to
#                              (default http://net:8090 - the docker-compose service)
#   CONSOLE_ADDRESS          Caddy site address (default :8080). A hostname such as
#                              dashboard.example.com turns on automatic HTTPS; then publish
#                              80/443 and keep /data persistent for the certificates.
#   CONSOLE_TRUSTED_PROXIES  proxies whose X-Forwarded-* is honoured and forwarded to the
#                              node (default private_ranges: Traefik/Caddy on the same network)
#
# The browser never talks to the node directly, so the console origin does not have to be
# listed in the node's `server.allowed_origins`. The node sees the console container as its client;
# list it in `server.trusted_proxies` so audit and rate limiting use the real player IP.
{
	admin off
	servers {
		trusted_proxies static {$CONSOLE_TRUSTED_PROXIES:private_ranges}
	}
}

{$CONSOLE_ADDRESS::8080} {
	encode zstd gzip
	log {
		output stdout
		format json
	}

	header {
		-Server
		X-Content-Type-Options nosniff
		X-Frame-Options DENY
		Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin
		Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
		Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'"
	}

	# Liveness of the console container itself; /healthz belongs to the node.
	handle /-/healthz {
		header Cache-Control no-store
		respond "ok" 200
	}

	@api path /v1/* /healthz
	handle @api {
		# flush_interval -1 streams GET /v1/events (none yet; kept for streaming endpoints) without buffering.
		reverse_proxy {$NET_API_URL:http://net:8090} {
			flush_interval -1
			header_up Host {upstream_hostport}
			transport http {
				dial_timeout 5s
			}
		}
	}

	# Hashed bundles: immutable when present, a plain 404 when not (never the SPA shell).
	handle /assets/* {
		root * /srv
		@exists file
		header @exists Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
		file_server
	}

	# SPA shell and the handful of public files: always revalidated.
	handle {
		root * /srv
		header Cache-Control "no-cache"
		try_files {path} /index.html
		file_server
	}
}

`dashboard/Dockerfile`:

```
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.6
# Build from the repository root:
#   docker build -f dashboard/Dockerfile -t aurix-net-console:local .
# ---------- build ----------
FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM node:22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /build
COPY dashboard/package.json dashboard/package-lock.json dashboard/
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm \
    cd dashboard && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
COPY dashboard dashboard
# Repository of the source this image is built from (shown in the sidebar; AGPL-3.0 §13).
ARG NET_SOURCE_URL=https://github.com/aurix-voice/aurix-net
RUN cd dashboard && NET_SOURCE_URL="$NET_SOURCE_URL" npm run build

# ---------- runtime ----------
FROM caddy:2.11-alpine AS runtime
# The stock binary carries cap_net_bind_service as a file capability; a container started with
# `cap_drop: [ALL]` then refuses to exec it. Strip it - port 8080 needs no capability.
RUN apk add --no-cache libcap \
    && setcap -r /usr/bin/caddy \
    && apk del libcap \
    && addgroup -S -g 10001 aurix \
    && adduser -S -u 10001 -G aurix -H -h /nonexistent -s /sbin/nologin aurix \
    && mkdir -p /data /config \
    && chown -R aurix:aurix /data /config
COPY dashboard/Caddyfile /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
COPY --from=builder /build/dashboard/dist /srv
RUN caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile

USER aurix:aurix
ENV NET_API_URL=http://net:8090 \
    CONSOLE_ADDRESS=:8080 \
    CONSOLE_TRUSTED_PROXIES=private_ranges \
    XDG_DATA_HOME=/data \
    XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/config
# /data keeps ACME certificates when CONSOLE_ADDRESS is a hostname (automatic HTTPS); binding
# 80/443 as uid 10001 then needs `--sysctl net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start=0` or a port mapping.
VOLUME ["/data"]
EXPOSE 8080/tcp
HEALTHCHECK --interval=15s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
    CMD ["sh", "-c", "wget -qO- \"${CONSOLE_HEALTHCHECK_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${CONSOLE_ADDRESS##*:}/-/healthz}\" >/dev/null || exit 1"]
CMD ["caddy", "run", "--config", "/etc/caddy/Caddyfile", "--adapter", "caddyfile"]

```

`dashboard/README.md`:

```md
# Aurix Net console

Operator console for an Aurix Net cluster: nodes, projects, live rooms, usage, API keys, webhooks,
WASM modules, matchmaking and the audit log. Single-page app (Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind)
shipped as its own image; the node never serves it. The SPA talks to the node only through a
same-origin proxy (`/v1/*`, `/healthz`), so the token never leaves the console's origin.

Sign in with the node's operator token (`auth.admin_token`, whole fleet) or a project API key
(`an_…`, that project only). Sessions live in the browser's local storage and are revalidated
against `/v1/me` on load.

```sh
npm ci            # Node >= 22.12 (package.json engines, enforced by .npmrc engine-strict): older Node
                  # skips rolldown's optional native binding and `npm run build` dies with "Cannot find native binding"
NET_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8090 npm run dev                  # http://127.0.0.1:5174
npm run check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
AURIX_NET_E2E_TOKEN=… npm run e2e                               # Playwright against a live node
```

Production: `docker build -f dashboard/Dockerfile .` from the repository root; run with
`NET_API_URL=http://net:8090` pointing at a node (see `Caddyfile`). The image is non-root and
serves on port 8080.

```

`dashboard/e2e/env.ts`:

```ts
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";

function required(name: string): string {
  const v = process.env[name];
  if (!v) throw new Error(`${name} is required for the console e2e suite`);
  return v;
}

export const operatorToken = (): string => required("AURIX_NET_E2E_TOKEN");

export const OPERATOR_STATE = "e2e/.auth/operator.json";

/** Short unique suffix so re-runs against the same node never collide on names. */
export function uniq(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
}

/** Pins the UI language so text selectors are stable regardless of the browser locale. */
export async function pinEnglish(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem("aurix.locale", "en");
      localStorage.setItem("aurix.theme", "light");
    } catch {
      /* storage disabled */
    }
  });
}

export async function signIn(page: Page, token: string): Promise<void> {
  await page.goto("/login");
  await page.getByLabel("Token").fill(token);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in" }).click();
  await page.waitForURL((u) => !u.pathname.startsWith("/login"));
}

const createdProjects: string[] = [];

/** Same-origin API call with the operator token, for fixtures the UI does not create itself.
 * Projects created through it are deleted again by `cleanupProjects` so the fleet stays tidy. */
export async function api<T>(page: Page, method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const res = await page.request.fetch(path, {
    method,
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${operatorToken()}`, "content-type": "application/json" },
    data: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!res.ok()) throw new Error(`${method} ${path} → ${res.status()} ${await res.text()}`);
  const out = res.status() === 204 ? (undefined as T) : ((await res.json()) as T);
  if (method === "POST" && path === "/v1/operator/projects") {
    const id = (out as { project?: { id?: string } }).project?.id;
    if (id) createdProjects.push(id);
  }
  return out;
}

/** Soft-deletes every project a test created (closes rooms, revokes keys). Safe to call twice. */
export async function cleanupProjects(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  const ids = createdProjects.splice(0);
  for (const id of ids) {
    await page.request.fetch(`/v1/operator/projects/${id}`, { method: "DELETE", headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${operatorToken()}` } }).catch(() => undefined);
  }
}

```

`dashboard/e2e/fleet.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

import { api, cleanupProjects, pinEnglish, uniq } from "./env";

test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => pinEnglish(page));
test.afterEach(async ({ page }) => cleanupProjects(page));

test("overview and nodes show the live fleet", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  await expect(page.getByText("This node", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("Ready")).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("navigation").getByRole("link", { name: "Nodes" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Nodes" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("row").filter({ hasText: "Live" }).first()).toBeVisible();
});

test("projects list opens project detail with keys and quotas", async ({ page }) => {
  const name = uniq("e2e");
  const created = await api<{ project: { id: string } }>(page, "POST", "/v1/operator/projects", { name, plan: "self_hosted" });
  await page.goto("/projects");
  await page.getByRole("row", { name: new RegExp(name) }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/projects/${created.project.id}`));
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("tab", { name: /API keys/ })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Quotas" })).toBeVisible();
});

test("rooms list shows a live room and its detail", async ({ page }) => {
  const project = await api<{ project: { id: string }; key: { key: string } }>(page, "POST", "/v1/operator/projects", { name: uniq("e2e-rooms") });
  const roomName = uniq("room");
  const res = await page.request.post("/v1/rooms", {
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${project.key.key}`, "content-type": "application/json" },
    data: { name: roomName, mode: "relay", max_players: 4 },
  });
  expect(res.ok()).toBeTruthy();
  const room = (await res.json()) as { id: string };
  await page.goto("/rooms");
  await expect(page.getByText(roomName)).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByText(roomName).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/rooms/${room.id}`));

  await page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Close room" }).click();

});

import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

import { api, cleanupProjects, pinEnglish, uniq } from "./env";

test.afterEach(async ({ page }) => cleanupProjects(page));

test("nodes page shows region cards and links a node to its rooms", async ({ page }) => {
  const project = await api<{ project: { id: string }; key: { key: string } }>(page, "POST", "/v1/operator/projects", { name: uniq("e2e-r2") });
  const roomName = uniq("r2room");
  const res = await page.request.post("/v1/rooms", {
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${project.key.key}`, "content-type": "application/json" },
    data: { name: roomName, mode: "relay", max_players: 4 },
  });
  expect(res.ok()).toBeTruthy();
  const room = (await res.json()) as { id: string; node: string };
  await page.goto("/nodes");
  await expect(page.getByText(/\d+ live/).first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto(`/rooms?node=${room.node}`);
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Node")).toHaveValue(room.node);
  await expect(page.getByText(roomName)).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByLabel("Mode").selectOption("relay");
  await expect(page.getByText(roomName)).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto("/rooms?node=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000");
  await expect(page.getByText("No live rooms")).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear filters" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(roomName)).toBeVisible();
  await api(page, "DELETE", `/v1/operator/rooms/${room.id}`);
});

test("operator can suspend and resume a project; suspended keys cannot issue grants", async ({ page }) => {
  const name = uniq("e2e-susp");
  const project = await api<{ project: { id: string }; key: { key: string } }>(page, "POST", "/v1/operator/projects", { name });
  const grant = () =>
    page.request.post("/v1/grants", {
      headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${project.key.key}`, "content-type": "application/json" },
      data: { player_id: "p1", name: "P" },
    });
  expect((await grant()).status()).toBe(200);
  await page.goto(`/projects/${project.project.id}`);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Suspend" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Suspend" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("Suspended", { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/This project is suspended since/)).toBeVisible();
  expect((await grant()).status()).toBe(403);
  await page.goto("/projects");
  await expect(page.getByRole("row", { name: new RegExp(name) }).getByText("Suspended")).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto(`/projects/${project.project.id}`);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Resume" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(/This project is suspended since/)).toHaveCount(0);
  expect((await grant()).status()).toBe(200);
  await page.goto("/audit");
  await page.getByPlaceholder(/^Action/).fill("project.suspend");
  await expect(page.getByRole("row").filter({ hasText: "project.suspend" }).first()).toBeVisible();
});

test("operator can drain another node from the console and put it back", async ({ page }) => {
  const me = await api<{ node_id: string }>(page, "GET", "/v1/me");
  const { nodes } = await api<{ nodes: { id: string; version: string; public_host: string; quic_port: number; draining: boolean; last_heartbeat: string }[] }>(page, "GET", "/v1/operator/nodes");
  const self = nodes.find((n) => n.id === me.node_id);
  const other = nodes.find((n) => n.id !== me.node_id && n.version === self?.version && !n.draining && Date.now() - Date.parse(n.last_heartbeat) < 30_000);
  test.skip(!other, "needs a second live node");
  const row = page.getByRole("row", { name: new RegExp(`${other!.public_host}:${other!.quic_port}`) });
  await page.goto("/nodes");
  await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Drain" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Drain" }).click();
  await expect(row.getByText("Draining")).toBeVisible();
  await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Back in rotation" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Back in rotation" }).click();
  await expect(row.getByText("Draining")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.goto("/audit");
  await page.getByPlaceholder(/^Action/).fill("node.");
  await expect(page.getByRole("row").filter({ hasText: "node.drain" }).first()).toBeVisible();
});

test("operator bans a player from the project page; grants for that id are refused until lifted", async ({ page }) => {
  const project = await api<{ project: { id: string }; key: { key: string } }>(page, "POST", "/v1/operator/projects", { name: uniq("e2e-ban") });
  const grant = () =>
    page.request.post("/v1/grants", {
      headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${project.key.key}`, "content-type": "application/json" },
      data: { player_id: "cheater-1", name: "C" },
    });
  expect((await grant()).status()).toBe(200);
  await page.goto(`/projects/${project.project.id}`);
  await page.getByRole("tab", { name: /Bans/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Ban player" }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  await dialog.getByRole("textbox").nth(0).fill("cheater-1");
  await dialog.getByRole("textbox").nth(1).fill("speedhack");
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Ban player" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("row").filter({ hasText: "cheater-1" })).toBeVisible();
  const refused = await grant();
  expect(refused.status()).toBe(403);
  expect(await refused.text()).toContain("speedhack");
  await page.getByRole("row").filter({ hasText: "cheater-1" }).getByRole("button", { name: "Lift" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Lift" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("row").filter({ hasText: "cheater-1" })).toHaveCount(0);
  expect((await grant()).status()).toBe(200);
});

test("operator issues a named token on Settings, it authenticates and is named in the audit log, then revokes it", async ({ page }) => {
  const name = uniq("ci-bot");
  await page.goto("/settings");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New token" }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  await dialog.getByLabel("Name").fill(name);
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Create" }).click();
  const token = (await page.getByRole("dialog").locator("pre, code").first().innerText()).trim();
  expect(token.length).toBeGreaterThan(20);
  await page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Close", exact: true }).last().click();
  const me = await page.request.get("/v1/me", { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
  expect(me.ok()).toBeTruthy();
  expect(((await me.json()) as { actor: string }).actor).toBe(`op:${name}`);
  const audit = await page.request.get("/v1/operator/audit?action=operator_token.create", { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
  expect(((await audit.json()) as { audit: { details: { name: string } }[] }).audit.some((a) => a.details.name === name)).toBeTruthy();
  const row = page.getByRole("row").filter({ hasText: name });
  await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Revoke" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Revoke" }).click();
  await expect(row.getByText("Revoked")).toBeVisible();
  const after = await page.request.get("/v1/me", { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
  expect(after.status()).toBe(401);
});

test("operator exports the audit log as CSV", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/audit");
  const [download] = await Promise.all([page.waitForEvent("download"), page.getByRole("button", { name: "Export CSV" }).first().click()]);

  const fs = await import("node:fs/promises");
  const text = await fs.readFile((await download.path()), "utf8");
  expect(text.split("\n")[0]).toBe("id,created_at,project_id,actor,action,target,details");
});

test("r20: lockstep room detail shows the desync dumps card; matchmaking queue shows filters", async ({ page }) => {
  const project = await api<{ project: { id: string }; key: { key: string } }>(page, "POST", "/v1/operator/projects", { name: uniq("e2e-r20") });
  const kh = { authorization: `Bearer ${project.key.key}`, "content-type": "application/json" };
  const gr = await page.request.post("/v1/grants", { headers: kh, data: { player_id: "ls-host", name: "ls-host", scopes: ["join", "create"] } });
  expect(gr.ok()).toBeTruthy();
  const { grant } = (await gr.json()) as { grant: string };
  const t = await page.request.post("/v1/matchmaking/tickets", {
    headers: kh,
    data: { player_id: "filtered", max_players: 8, min_players: 8, max_wait_secs: 300, attrs: { rank: 10 }, filter: "rank >= 5", fill_existing: true, match_type: "serial" },
  });
  expect(t.ok()).toBeTruthy();
  await page.goto("/rooms");
  // sync/lockstep rooms are created through the control plane, so open a WebSocket straight to the node
  const wsUrl = (process.env.NET_API_URL ?? "http://127.0.0.1:8098").replace(/^http/, "ws") + "/ws";
  const roomId = await page.evaluate(
    ({ url, grant, name }) =>
      new Promise<string>((res, rej) => {
        const ws = new WebSocket(url);
        const timer = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error("ws timeout")), 10000);
        ws.onopen = () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "auth", grant }));
        ws.onmessage = (ev) => {
          if (typeof ev.data !== "string") return;
          const m = JSON.parse(ev.data) as { t: string; room?: string; message?: string };
          if (m.t === "authed") ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "join_or_create", name, mode: "lockstep", max_players: 4, props: {} }));
          if (m.t === "joined") {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            res(m.room ?? "");
          }
          if (m.t === "error") rej(new Error(m.message));
        };
        ws.onerror = () => rej(new Error("ws error"));
      }),
    { url: wsUrl, grant, name: uniq("ls") },
  );
  expect(roomId).not.toBe("");
  await page.goto(`/rooms/${roomId}`);
  await expect(page.getByText("Desync dumps")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("desyncs-empty")).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto(`/projects/${project.project.id}`);
  await page.getByRole("tab", { name: /Matchmaking/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("rank >= 5")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/fill existing · serial/)).toBeVisible();
});

import { defineConfig, devices } from "@playwright/test";

// Live end-to-end suite: drives the real console (Caddy image or Vite dev server) against a
// real Aurix Net node. Nothing is mocked; every spec goes through the same-origin API proxy.
//
//   DASHBOARD_URL                console origin under test (default: Vite dev server started here)
//   NET_API_URL                  node the dev server proxies to (default http://127.0.0.1:8090)
//   AURIX_NET_E2E_TOKEN          operator token of that node (`auth.admin_token`)
const dashboardUrl = process.env.DASHBOARD_URL;
const baseURL = dashboardUrl ?? "http://127.0.0.1:5174";

export default defineConfig({
  testDir: "./e2e",
  outputDir: "./test-results",
  fullyParallel: false,
  workers: 1,
  forbidOnly: !!process.env.CI,
  retries: process.env.CI ? 1 : 0,
  timeout: 45_000,
  expect: { timeout: 10_000 },
  reporter: process.env.CI ? [["list"], ["html", { open: "never" }]] : [["list"]],
  use: {
    baseURL,
    locale: "en-US",
    timezoneId: "UTC",
    viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 },
    trace: "retain-on-failure",
    screenshot: "only-on-failure",
  },
  projects: [
    { name: "setup", testMatch: /auth\.setup\.ts/ },
    {
      name: "chromium",
      use: { ...devices["Desktop Chrome"], storageState: "e2e/.auth/operator.json" },
      dependencies: ["setup"],
    },
  ],
  webServer: dashboardUrl
    ? undefined
    : {
        command: "npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174 --strictPort",
        url: "http://127.0.0.1:5174/login",
        reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI,
        timeout: 60_000,
      },
});

`dashboard/public/theme-init.js`:

```js
// Applies the stored theme before the first paint so a dark-mode reload does not flash white.
// Kept as a separate file (not inline) so the Content-Security-Policy can stay `script-src 'self'`.
(function () {
  try {
    var t = localStorage.getItem("aurix.theme");
    var dark = t === "dark" || (t !== "light" && matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches);
    if (dark) document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
  } catch (e) {
    /* storage disabled */
  }
})();

```

`dashboard/src/__tests__/authStore.test.ts`:

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

const mem = new Map<string, string>();
vi.stubGlobal("localStorage", {
  getItem: (k: string) => mem.get(k) ?? null,
  setItem: (k: string, v: string) => void mem.set(k, v),
  removeItem: (k: string) => void mem.delete(k),
  clear: () => mem.clear(),
});

import type { Me } from "@/api/client";

const { authStore } = await import("@/auth/store");

const me: Me = { kind: "operator", region: "local", node_id: "n1" } as unknown as Me;

describe("authStore", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    authStore.clear();
    localStorage.clear();
  });

  it("persists a session to local storage and clears it on sign-out", () => {
    authStore.set({ token: "t0k", me });
    expect(authStore.get()?.token).toBe("t0k");
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("aurix-net.auth");
    expect(raw).not.toBeNull();
    expect(JSON.parse(raw!)).toMatchObject({ token: "t0k", me: { kind: "operator" } });
    authStore.clear();
    expect(authStore.get()).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem("aurix-net.auth")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("notifies subscribers once per change and stops after unsubscribe", () => {
    const l = vi.fn();
    const off = authStore.subscribe(l);
    authStore.set({ token: "a", me });
    authStore.clear();
    expect(l).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    off();
    authStore.set({ token: "b", me });
    expect(l).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });
});

```

`dashboard/src/__tests__/charts.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { compactTick } from "@/components/charts";

describe("compactTick", () => {
  it("keeps small values verbatim", () => {
    expect(compactTick(0)).toBe("0");
    expect(compactTick(42)).toBe("42");
    expect(compactTick(0.225)).toBe("0.23");
    expect(compactTick(0.1)).toBe("0.1");
    expect(compactTick(2.5)).toBe("2.5");
  });

  it("abbreviates thousands and beyond", () => {
    expect(compactTick(1200)).toBe("1.2k");
    expect(compactTick(6000)).toBe("6k");
    expect(compactTick(150_000)).toBe("150k");
    expect(compactTick(3_500_000)).toBe("3.5M");
    expect(compactTick(2_000_000_000)).toBe("2G");
    expect(compactTick(-1500)).toBe("-1.5k");
  });
});

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { NetClient, NetError, NetNetworkError, errorKind } from "@/api/client";

vi.stubGlobal("window", { location: { origin: "http://console.test" } });

function respond(status: number, body: unknown) {
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } });
}

describe("NetClient", () => {
  afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());

  it("sends the bearer token and drops empty query params", async () => {
    const fetchMock = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(respond(200, { ok: true }));
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
    vi.stubGlobal("window", { location: { origin: "http://console.test" } });
    const out = await new NetClient("s3cret").get<{ ok: boolean }>("/v1/operator/audit", { limit: 5, action: "", project: undefined });
    expect(out.ok).toBe(true);
    const [url, init] = fetchMock.mock.calls[0] as [URL, RequestInit];
    expect(url.toString()).toBe("http://console.test/v1/operator/audit?limit=5");
    expect((init.headers as Record<string, string>).authorization).toBe("Bearer s3cret");
  });

  it("maps API errors to NetError with the server code", async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(respond(401, { error: "unauthorized", message: "malformed api key" })));
    vi.stubGlobal("window", { location: { origin: "http://console.test" } });
    const err = await new NetClient(null).get("/v1/me").catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(NetError);
    expect((err as NetError).status).toBe(401);
    expect((err as NetError).code).toBe("unauthorized");
    expect(errorKind(err)).toBe("unauthorized");
  });

  it("returns undefined for 204 and wraps transport failures", async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(respond(204, null)));
    vi.stubGlobal("window", { location: { origin: "http://console.test" } });
    await expect(new NetClient("t").del("/v1/webhooks/x")).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new TypeError("Failed to fetch")));
    const err = await new NetClient("t").get("/healthz").catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(NetNetworkError);
    expect(errorKind(err)).toBe("network");
  });
});

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, isPageSize, PAGE_SIZES, parsePageSize } from "@/lib/usePageSize";

describe("page size preference", () => {
  it("offers sizes from 10 upwards with a 25-row default", () => {
    expect(PAGE_SIZES[0]).toBe(10);
    expect(PAGE_SIZES).toContain(DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE);
    expect(DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE).toBe(25);
  });
  it("accepts only the offered sizes", () => {
    for (const n of PAGE_SIZES) expect(isPageSize(n)).toBe(true);
    expect(isPageSize(0)).toBe(false);
    expect(isPageSize(15)).toBe(false);
    expect(isPageSize(1000)).toBe(false);
  });
  it("parses stored values and falls back on garbage", () => {
    expect(parsePageSize("50")).toBe(50);
    expect(parsePageSize("10")).toBe(10);
    expect(parsePageSize(null)).toBe(DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE);
    expect(parsePageSize("")).toBe(DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE);
    expect(parsePageSize("abc")).toBe(DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE);
    expect(parsePageSize("999")).toBe(DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE);
  });
});

    expect(shortId("01a0c523-9426-755b-bdca-e70cc44eae81")).toBe("01a0c523…ae81");
    expect(shortId("01a0c523-9426-755b-bdca-e70cc44e0f00")).toBe("01a0c523…0f00");
  });
  it("returns the id untouched when it fits", () => {
    expect(shortId("01a0c523-9426-755b-bdca-e70cc44eae81", 36)).toBe("01a0c523-9426-755b-bdca-e70cc44eae81");

  });
