```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { toPoints } from "@/pages/Usage";

describe("toPoints", () => {
  it("groups hourly metric rows into one point per hour", () => {
    const pts = toPoints({
      from: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      to: "2026-01-01T03:00:00Z",
      usage: [
        { hour: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", metric: "room_minutes", quantity: 10 },
        { hour: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", metric: "player_minutes", quantity: 40 },
        { hour: "2026-01-01T02:00:00Z", metric: "bytes_in", quantity: 1024 },
        { hour: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", metric: "bytes_in", quantity: 1 },
      ],
    });
    expect(pts).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(pts[0]!.t).toBe(Date.parse("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"));
    expect(pts[0]!.room_minutes).toBe(10);
    expect(pts[0]!.player_minutes).toBe(40);
    expect(pts[0]!.bytes_in).toBe(1);
    expect(pts[1]!.bytes_in).toBe(1024);
    expect(pts[0]!.t).toBeLessThan(pts[1]!.t);
  });

  it("returns an empty series when there is no data", () => {
    expect(toPoints(undefined)).toEqual([]);
    expect(toPoints({ from: "", to: "", usage: [] })).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

`dashboard/src/api/client.ts`:

```ts
import { translate, type Locale } from "@/i18n";

/** Same-origin: Caddy (image) or Vite (dev) proxies `/v1` and `/healthz` to one Aurix Net node. */
export function baseUrl(): string {
  return window.location.origin;
}

export class NetError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly status: number,
    public readonly code: string,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "NetError";
  }
}

export class NetNetworkError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "NetNetworkError";
  }
}

export type ErrorKind = "network" | "unauthorized" | "forbidden" | "notFound" | "conflict" | "rateLimited" | "validation" | "server" | "unknown";

export function errorKind(err: unknown): ErrorKind {
  if (err instanceof NetNetworkError) return "network";
  if (err instanceof NetError) {
    if (err.status === 401) return "unauthorized";
    if (err.status === 403) return "forbidden";
    if (err.status === 404) return "notFound";
    if (err.status === 409) return "conflict";
    if (err.status === 429) return "rateLimited";
    if (err.status === 400 || err.status === 422) return "validation";
    if (err.status >= 500) return "server";
  }
  return "unknown";
}

export function errorCode(err: unknown): string | null {
  return err instanceof NetError ? err.code : null;
}

export function isStatus(err: unknown, status: number): boolean {
  return err instanceof NetError && err.status === status;
}

export function errorMessage(err: unknown, locale: Locale = "en"): string {
  if (err instanceof NetNetworkError) return translate(locale, "error.network");
  if (err instanceof NetError) {
    const server = err.message.trim();
    if (server && server !== err.code) return server;
    return translate(locale, "error.withCode", { code: err.code || String(err.status) });
  }
  if (err instanceof Error) return err.message;
  return String(err);
}

export interface RequestOptions {
  method?: "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "DELETE";
  query?: Record<string, string | number | undefined | null>;
  body?: unknown;
  /** Raw body (module upload). */
  raw?: BodyInit;
  contentType?: string;
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

/** Thin fetch wrapper: bearer token, JSON in/out, typed errors from `{error, message}` bodies. */
export class NetClient {
  constructor(private readonly token: string | null) {}

  async request<T>(path: string, opts: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
    const url = new URL(path, baseUrl());
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(opts.query ?? {})) {
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") url.searchParams.set(k, String(v));
    }
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { accept: "application/json" };
    if (this.token) headers.authorization = `Bearer ${this.token}`;
    let body: BodyInit | undefined;
    if (opts.raw !== undefined) {
      body = opts.raw;
      headers["content-type"] = opts.contentType ?? "application/octet-stream";
    } else if (opts.body !== undefined) {
      body = JSON.stringify(opts.body);
      headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
    }
    const ctrl = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), opts.timeoutMs ?? 15_000);
    let res: Response;
    try {
      res = await fetch(url, { method: opts.method ?? "GET", headers, body, signal: ctrl.signal });
    } catch (e) {
      throw new NetNetworkError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "network error");
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    if (res.status === 204) return undefined as T;
    const text = await res.text();
    let json: unknown;
    try {
      json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
    } catch {
      json = null;
    }
    if (!res.ok) {
      const o = (json ?? {}) as { error?: string; message?: string };
      throw new NetError(res.status, o.error ?? `http_${res.status}`, o.message ?? text.slice(0, 200) ?? res.statusText);
    }
    return json as T;
  }

  get<T>(path: string, query?: RequestOptions["query"]) {
    return this.request<T>(path, { query });
  }
  post<T>(path: string, body?: unknown) {
    return this.request<T>(path, { method: "POST", body });
  }
  del<T = void>(path: string) {
    return this.request<T>(path, { method: "DELETE" });
  }
}
```

`dashboard/src/api/hooks.ts`:

```ts
import type { RoomDesyncs } from "./client";
import type { Billing, OperatorWebhook } from "@/api/client";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useMemo } from "react";

import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";

import { NetClient, type ApiKey, type AuditRow, type Health, type LiveRoom, type Module, type NewKey, type NodeRow, type Project, type PublicNode, type ProjectDetail, type Region, type RoomDetail, type Ticket, type Usage, type Attention, type Ban, type MatchmakingStats, type NewOperatorToken, type NodeStats, type OperatorToken, type PlayerLookup, type RotatedWebhook, type Rejections, type Webhook, type WebhookDelivery } from "./client";

export function useApi(): NetClient {
  const { token } = useAuth();
  return useMemo(() => new NetClient(token), [token]);
}

export const qk = {
  health: ["health"] as const,
  regions: ["regions"] as const,
  nodes: ["nodes"] as const,
  projects: ["projects"] as const,
  project: (id: string) => ["projects", id] as const,
  projectUsage: (id: string, from: string, to: string) => ["projects", id, "usage", from, to] as const,
  projectRooms: (id: string) => ["projects", id, "rooms"] as const,
  fleetRooms: ["fleet", "rooms"] as const,
  rooms: ["rooms"] as const,
  room: (id: string) => ["rooms", id] as const,
  usage: (from: string, to: string) => ["usage", from, to] as const,
  fleetUsage: (from: string, to: string) => ["fleet-usage", from, to] as const,
  keys: ["keys"] as const,
  webhooks: ["webhooks"] as const,
  modules: ["modules"] as const,
  audit: (project: string | null) => ["audit", project] as const,
  ticket: (id: string) => ["ticket", id] as const,
};

const LIVE = 5_000;

export function useHealth() {
  const api = useApi();
  return useQuery({ queryKey: qk.health, queryFn: () => api.get<Health>("/healthz"), refetchInterval: LIVE, retry: false });
}
export function useRegions() {
  const api = useApi();
  return useQuery({ queryKey: qk.regions, queryFn: () => api.get<Region[]>("/v1/regions"), refetchInterval: 15_000 });
}
/** Operator: every node row from the DB (including draining/stale). Project key: live nodes only. */
export function useNodes() {
  const api = useApi();
  const { operator } = useAuth();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [...qk.nodes, operator],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (operator) return (await api.get<{ nodes: NodeRow[] }>("/v1/operator/nodes")).nodes;
      const pub = await api.get<PublicNode[]>("/v1/nodes");
      return pub.map(
        (n): NodeRow => ({
          id: n.id,
          region: n.region,
          public_host: n.host,
          quic_port: n.quic_port,
          http_url: n.http_url,
          cert_sha256: n.cert_sha256,
          version: n.version ?? "",
          rooms: n.rooms ?? 0,
          players: n.players ?? 0,
          load_factor: n.load_factor,
          draining: false,
          started_at: n.started_at ?? "",
          last_heartbeat: n.last_heartbeat ?? "",
        }),
      );
    },
    refetchInterval: LIVE,
  });
}
export function useProjects() {
  const api = useApi();
  const { operator } = useAuth();
  return useQuery({ queryKey: qk.projects, queryFn: async () => (await api.get<{ projects: Project[] }>("/v1/operator/projects")).projects, enabled: operator });
}
export function useProject(id: string) {
  const api = useApi();
  return useQuery({ queryKey: qk.project(id), queryFn: () => api.get<ProjectDetail>(`/v1/operator/projects/${id}`), refetchInterval: 10_000 });
}
/** Live rooms in scope: the project's rooms (key or operator-selected project) or the whole fleet. */
export function useRooms() {
  const api = useApi();
  const { operator, projectId } = useAuth();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: operator ? (projectId ? qk.projectRooms(projectId) : qk.fleetRooms) : qk.rooms,
    queryFn: async () => {
      const path = operator ? (projectId ? `/v1/operator/projects/${projectId}/rooms` : "/v1/operator/rooms") : "/v1/rooms";
      return (await api.get<{ rooms: LiveRoom[] }>(path)).rooms;
    },
    refetchInterval: LIVE,
  });
}
export function useRoom(id: string) {
  const api = useApi();
  const { operator } = useAuth();
  const path = operator ? `/v1/operator/rooms/${id}` : `/v1/rooms/${id}`;
  return useQuery({ queryKey: qk.room(id), queryFn: () => api.get<RoomDetail>(path), refetchInterval: LIVE });
}
export function useRoomDesyncs(id: string, enabled: boolean) {
  const api = useApi();
  const { operator } = useAuth();
  const path = operator ? `/v1/operator/rooms/${id}/desyncs` : `/v1/rooms/${id}/desyncs`;
  return useQuery({ queryKey: ["room", id, "desyncs"], queryFn: () => api.get<RoomDesyncs>(path), refetchInterval: LIVE, enabled });
}
export function useKickPlayer(roomId: string) {
  const api = useApi();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { operator } = useAuth();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ actor, reason }: { actor: number; reason?: string }) =>
      api.request<void>(operator ? `/v1/operator/rooms/${roomId}/players/${actor}` : `/v1/rooms/${roomId}/players/${actor}`, { method: "DELETE", query: { reason } }),
    onSuccess: () => void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qk.room(roomId) }),
  });
}
export function useCloseRoom() {
  const api = useApi();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { operator } = useAuth();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => api.del(operator ? `/v1/operator/rooms/${id}` : `/v1/rooms/${id}`),
    onSuccess: () => void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["rooms"] }),
  });
}
export function useUsage(from: string, to: string) {
  const api = useApi();
  const { operator, projectId } = useAuth();
  const path = operator ? (projectId ? `/v1/operator/projects/${projectId}/usage` : "/v1/operator/usage") : "/v1/usage";

  return useQuery({ queryKey: key, queryFn: () => api.get<Usage>(path, { from, to }) });
}
```

`dashboard/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, type ReactNode, useState } from "react";

import { NetClient, NetError, type Me } from "@/api/client";

import { authStore, hasScope, useAuthSession, type AuthSession } from "./store";

export type AuthStatus = "anonymous" | "authenticated";

interface AuthCtx {
  status: AuthStatus;
  session: AuthSession | null;
  me: Me | null;
  token: string | null;
  /** True when signed in with the operator token. */
  operator: boolean;
  /** Project id in scope: the key's project, or the operator's selected project. */
  projectId: string | null;
  selectProject: (id: string | null) => void;
  signIn: (token: string) => Promise<Me>;
  signOut: (reason?: "expired" | "manual") => void;
  can: (scope: "rooms" | "read" | "admin") => boolean;
  lastSignOutReason: "expired" | "manual" | null;
}

const Ctx = createContext<AuthCtx | null>(null);
const PROJECT_KEY = "aurix-net.project";

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const session = useAuthSession();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [lastSignOutReason, setLastSignOutReason] = useState<"expired" | "manual" | null>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(PROJECT_KEY);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  });

  const signOut = useCallback(
    (reason: "expired" | "manual" = "manual") => {
      setLastSignOutReason(reason);
      authStore.clear();
      qc.clear();
    },
    [qc],
  );

  const signIn = useCallback(async (token: string) => {
    const me = await new NetClient(token).get<Me>("/v1/me");
    authStore.set({ token, me });
    setLastSignOutReason(null);
    return me;
  }, []);

  // Re-validate a restored token once per page load; a revoked key signs out.
  const validated = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session || validated.current === session.token) return;
    validated.current = session.token;
    new NetClient(session.token)
      .get<Me>("/v1/me")
      .then((me) => authStore.set({ token: session.token, me }))
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (err instanceof NetError && err.status === 401) signOut("expired");
      });
  }, [session, signOut]);

  const selectProject = useCallback((id: string | null) => {
    setSelected(id);
    try {
      if (id) localStorage.setItem(PROJECT_KEY, id);
      else localStorage.removeItem(PROJECT_KEY);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }, []);

  const me = session?.me ?? null;
  const operator = me?.kind === "operator";
  const value = useMemo<AuthCtx>(
    () => ({
      status: session ? "authenticated" : "anonymous",
      session,
      me,
      token: session?.token ?? null,
      operator,
      projectId: operator ? selected : (me?.project?.id ?? null),
      selectProject,
      signIn,
      signOut,
      can: (scope) => hasScope(me, scope),
      lastSignOutReason,
    }),
    [session, me, operator, selected, selectProject, signIn, signOut, lastSignOutReason],
  );
  return <Ctx.Provider value={value}>{children}</Ctx.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth(): AuthCtx {
  const ctx = useContext(Ctx);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useAuth outside AuthProvider");
  return ctx;
}
```

`dashboard/src/auth/LoginPage.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useNavigate, useSearch } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";

import { errorKind, errorMessage } from "@/api/client";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Callout, Card, Field } from "@/ui/Primitives";

export function LoginPage() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const { signIn, lastSignOutReason } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const search = useSearch({ from: "/auth/login" });
  const [token, setToken] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await signIn(token.trim());
      void navigate({ to: search.redirect ?? "/", replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorKind(err) === "unauthorized" ? t("auth.invalid") : errorMessage(err, locale));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card className="p-6">
      <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">{t("auth.title")}</h1>
      <p className="text-[13px] text-fg-muted mt-1">{t("auth.subtitle")}</p>
      {lastSignOutReason === "expired" ? (
        <Callout tone="warn" className="mt-4">
          {t("auth.sessionExpired")}
        </Callout>
      ) : null}
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="mt-5 space-y-3" noValidate>
        <Field label={t("auth.token")} htmlFor="login-token" hint={t("auth.token.hint")}>
          <Input id="login-token" type="password" name="token" autoComplete="off" required autoFocus value={token} onChange={(e) => setToken(e.target.value)} className="font-mono" />
        </Field>
        {error ? <Callout tone="danger">{error}</Callout> : null}
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full" loading={busy} disabled={!token.trim()}>
          {busy ? t("auth.signingIn") : t("auth.signIn")}
        </Button>
      </form>
      <p className="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-border text-[12px] text-fg-muted">{t("auth.note")}</p>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/auth/store.ts`:

```ts
import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

import type { Me } from "@/api/client";

/** Signed in with either the operator token (fleet) or a project API key (one project). */
export interface AuthSession {
  token: string;
  me: Me;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "aurix-net.auth";
let current: AuthSession | null = load();
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function load(): AuthSession | null {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<AuthSession>;
    if (typeof parsed.token !== "string" || !parsed.me || (parsed.me.kind !== "operator" && parsed.me.kind !== "project")) return null;
    return { token: parsed.token, me: parsed.me };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function persist(): void {
  try {
    if (current) localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(current));
    else localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

function emit(): void {
  for (const l of listeners) l();
}

export const authStore = {
  get: (): AuthSession | null => current,
  set: (s: AuthSession): void => {
    current = s;
    persist();
    emit();
  },
  clear: (): void => {
    current = null;
    persist();
    emit();
  },
  subscribe: (l: () => void): (() => void) => {
    listeners.add(l);
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(l);
    };
  },
};

export function useAuthSession(): AuthSession | null {
  return useSyncExternalStore(authStore.subscribe, authStore.get, authStore.get);
}

/** Scopes the session can use on `/v1`: the operator has every project scope through its own routes. */
export function hasScope(me: Me | null | undefined, scope: "rooms" | "read" | "admin"): boolean {
  if (!me) return false;
  if (me.kind === "operator") return scope !== "rooms";
  return me.key?.scopes.includes(scope) ?? false;
}
```

```tsx
import { Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import type { Ban } from "@/api/client";
import { useAddBan, useBans, useRemoveBan } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort } from "@/lib/format";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { ConfirmDialog, FormDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Input, NativeSelect } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Field, Mono } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable } from "@/ui/Table";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";

const DURATIONS = [0, 3600, 86_400, 7 * 86_400, 30 * 86_400] as const;

/** Deny-list of player ids for one project: banned players get 403 at grant issue and at join. */
export function BansPanel({ projectId }: { projectId?: string }) {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const toast = useToast();
  const bans = useBans(projectId);
  const add = useAddBan(projectId);
  const remove = useRemoveBan(projectId);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [playerId, setPlayerId] = useState("");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState<number>(0);
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<Ban | null>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <div className="flex justify-end px-3 py-2 border-b border-border">
        <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setAdding(true)}>
          <Plus className="size-3.5" /> {t("bans.add")}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <DataTable
        rows={bans.data}
        rowKey={(b) => b.player_id}
        dense
        loading={bans.isLoading}
        error={bans.error}
        empty={<span className="block px-3 py-6 text-center text-sm text-fg-muted">{t("bans.empty")}</span>}
        columns={[
          { key: "player", header: t("rooms.playerId"), cell: (b) => <Mono>{b.player_id}</Mono> },
          { key: "reason", header: t("bans.reason"), cell: (b) => b.reason || <span className="text-fg-muted">—</span> },
          { key: "by", header: t("audit.actor"), cell: (b) => <Mono className="text-xs">{b.created_by}</Mono> },
          { key: "until", header: t("bans.until"), cell: (b) => (b.expires_at ? fmtDateTimeShort(locale, b.expires_at) : <span className="text-fg-muted">{t("bans.permanent")}</span>) },
          { key: "created", header: t("common.created"), cell: (b) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{fmtDateTimeShort(locale, b.created_at)}</span> },
          {
            key: "actions",
            header: "",
            align: "right",
            cell: (b) => (
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setRemoving(b)}>
                {t("bans.remove")}
              </Button>
            ),
          },
        ]}
      />
      <FormDialog
        open={adding}
        onOpenChange={(o) => {
          setAdding(o);
          if (!o) {
            setPlayerId("");
            setReason("");
            setDuration(0);
          }
        }}
        title={t("bans.add")}
        description={t("bans.add.desc")}
        submitLabel={t("bans.add")}
        disabled={!playerId.trim()}
        onSubmit={async () => {
          await add.mutateAsync({ player_id: playerId.trim(), reason: reason.trim() || undefined, duration_secs: duration || undefined });
          toast.ok(t("bans.added", { id: playerId.trim() }));
        }}
      >
        <Field label={t("rooms.playerId")}>
          <Input value={playerId} onChange={(e) => setPlayerId(e.target.value)} maxLength={128} autoFocus />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t("bans.reason")}>
          <Input value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} maxLength={256} />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t("bans.duration")}>
          <NativeSelect value={String(duration)} onChange={(e) => setDuration(Number(e.target.value))}>
            {DURATIONS.map((d) => (
              <option key={d} value={d}>
                {d === 0 ? t("bans.permanent") : t("bans.duration.secs", { h: d / 3600 })}
              </option>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>
      </FormDialog>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={removing !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setRemoving(null)}
        title={t("bans.remove")}
        description={removing ? t("bans.remove.confirm", { id: removing.player_id }) : ""}
        confirmLabel={t("bans.remove")}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          if (!removing) return;
          await remove.mutateAsync(removing.player_id);
          toast.ok(t("bans.removed", { id: removing.player_id }));
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Download } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import { baseUrl, type BillingProject } from "@/api/client";
import { useBilling } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtBytes, fmtNumber } from "@/lib/format";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { NativeSelect } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Badge, Card, CardHeader, Mono } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable, type Column } from "@/ui/Table";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";

function lastMonths(n: number): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const d = new Date();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const y = d.getUTCFullYear();
    const m = d.getUTCMonth() + 1;
    out.push(`${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}`);
    d.setUTCMonth(d.getUTCMonth() - 1, 1);
  }
  return out;
}

/** Month report per project — the numbers an invoice is built from (operator, whole fleet). */
export function BillingCard() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const { token } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const months = lastMonths(12);
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(months[0] ?? "");
  const q = useBilling(month);
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  async function exportCsv() {
    const url = new URL("/v1/operator/billing", baseUrl());
    url.searchParams.set("month", month);
    url.searchParams.set("format", "csv");
    setExporting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { headers: token ? { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : undefined });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = `aurix-net-billing-${month}.csv`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
    } finally {
      setExporting(false);
    }
  }
  const cols: Column<BillingProject>[] = [
    {
      key: "name",
      header: t("common.name"),
      cell: (p) => (
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="font-medium">{p.name}</span>
          {p.deleted_at ? <Badge tone="neutral">{t("billing.deleted")}</Badge> : p.disabled_at ? <Badge tone="warn">{t("health.suspended")}</Badge> : null}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    { key: "plan", header: t("projects.plan"), cell: (p) => <Mono>{p.plan}</Mono> },
    { key: "pm", header: t("usage.player_minutes"), align: "right", cell: (p) => <span className="tabular">{fmtNumber(locale, Math.round(p.player_minutes))}{p.cap_player_minutes ? <span className="text-fg-muted"> / {fmtNumber(locale, p.cap_player_minutes)}</span> : null}</span> },
    { key: "rm", header: t("usage.room_minutes"), align: "right", cell: (p) => <span className="tabular">{fmtNumber(locale, Math.round(p.room_minutes))}</span> },
    { key: "bytes", header: t("billing.traffic"), align: "right", cell: (p) => <span className="tabular">{fmtBytes(locale, p.bytes_in + p.bytes_out)}{p.cap_bytes ? <span className="text-fg-muted"> / {fmtBytes(locale, p.cap_bytes)}</span> : null}</span> },
    { key: "rooms", header: t("billing.rooms"), align: "right", cell: (p) => <span className="tabular">{fmtNumber(locale, p.rooms_created)}</span> },
  ];
  const tot = q.data?.totals ?? {};
  return (
    <Card data-testid="billing">
      <CardHeader
        title={t("billing.title")}
        description={t("billing.desc")}
        actions={
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <NativeSelect value={month} onChange={(e) => setMonth(e.target.value)} aria-label={t("billing.month")}>
              {months.map((m) => (
                <option key={m} value={m}>
                  {m}
                </option>
              ))}
            </NativeSelect>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={exporting} onClick={() => void exportCsv()}>
              <Download className="size-4" /> {t("usage.export")}
            </Button>
          </span>
        }
      />
      <DataTable rows={q.data?.projects} columns={cols} rowKey={(p) => p.project_id} loading={q.isLoading} error={q.error} dense empty={<span className="block px-3 py-6 text-center text-sm text-fg-muted">{t("common.empty")}</span>} />
      {q.data ? (
        <p className="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-fg-muted border-t border-border">
          {t("billing.totals", { pm: fmtNumber(locale, Math.round(tot.player_minutes ?? 0)), rm: fmtNumber(locale, Math.round(tot.room_minutes ?? 0)), bytes: fmtBytes(locale, (tot.bytes_in ?? 0) + (tot.bytes_out ?? 0)), rooms: fmtNumber(locale, tot.rooms_created ?? 0) })}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/components/ConnectCard.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { Region } from "@/api/client";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { Card, CopyButton, Mono } from "@/ui/Primitives";

/** Everything a game team needs to point a client at this project: region endpoints and a
 * grant call. The API key is never rendered — the snippet reads it from the environment. */
export function ConnectCard({ regions, allowed }: { regions: Region[]; allowed?: string[] }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const shown = allowed?.length ? regions.filter((r) => allowed.includes(r.id)) : regions;
  const first = shown.find((r) => r.endpoints.length)?.endpoints[0] ?? "https://<node>";
  const grant = [
    `curl -s ${first}/v1/grants \\`,
    `  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AURIX_NET_API_KEY" \\`,
    `  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\`,
    `  -d '{"player_id":"p1","name":"Player","scopes":["join","create"],"ttl_secs":300}'`,
  ].join("\n");
  return (
    <Card className="p-4 space-y-4">
      <div>
        <div className="text-xs font-medium text-fg-muted mb-1.5">{t("projects.connect.endpoints")}</div>
        {shown.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-xs text-fg-faint">{t("projects.connect.noRegions")}</div>
        ) : (
          <ul className="space-y-1.5">
            {shown.map((r) => (
              <li key={r.id} className="text-xs">
                <div className="font-medium">{r.display_name || r.id}</div>
                {r.endpoints.map((e) => (
                  <div key={e} className="flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
                    <Mono className="truncate text-[11px]">{e}</Mono>
                    <CopyButton value={e} />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
          <div className="text-xs font-medium text-fg-muted">{t("projects.connect.grant")}</div>
          <CopyButton value={grant} />
        </div>
        <pre className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed bg-surface-2 border border-border rounded-md p-2.5 overflow-x-auto font-mono whitespace-pre">{grant}</pre>
        <div className="text-[11px] text-fg-faint mt-1.5">{t("projects.connect.hint")}</div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/components/NewKeyDialog.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from "react";

import type { NewKey } from "@/api/client";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { Dialog, FormDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Checkbox, Input, NativeSelect } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Callout, CodeBlock, Field } from "@/ui/Primitives";

const SCOPES = ["rooms", "read", "admin"] as const;
const EXPIRIES = [0, 30, 90, 365] as const;

/** Create form + one-time plaintext reveal; the key is never fetchable again. */
export function NewKeyDialog({ open, onOpenChange, create }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; create: (body: { name: string; scopes: string[]; expires_in_secs?: number; allowed_cidrs?: string[] }) => Promise<NewKey> }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [scopes, setScopes] = useState<string[]>(["rooms", "read"]);
  const [expiryDays, setExpiryDays] = useState<number>(0);
  const [cidrs, setCidrs] = useState("");
  const [created, setCreated] = useState<NewKey | null>(null);
  const keepOpen = useRef(false);
  const toggle = (s: string) => setScopes((cur) => (cur.includes(s) ? cur.filter((x) => x !== s) : [...cur, s]));
  const close = (o: boolean) => {
    if (!o && keepOpen.current) {
      keepOpen.current = false;
      return;
    }
    if (!o) {
      setCreated(null);
      setName("");
    }
    onOpenChange(o);
  };
  if (created) {
    return (
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={close} title={t("keys.new")} description={t("keys.created")} footer={<Button onClick={() => close(false)}>{t("common.close")}</Button>}>
        <Callout tone="warn">{t("keys.created")}</Callout>
        <CodeBlock value={created.key} className="mt-3" />
      </Dialog>
    );
  }
  return (
    <FormDialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={close}
      title={t("keys.new")}
      submitLabel={t("common.create")}
      disabled={!name.trim() || scopes.length === 0}
      onSubmit={async () => {
        const cidrList = cidrs
          .split(",")
          .map((c) => c.trim())
          .filter(Boolean);
        const k = await create({ name: name.trim(), scopes, expires_in_secs: expiryDays ? expiryDays * 86_400 : undefined, allowed_cidrs: cidrList.length ? cidrList : undefined });
        keepOpen.current = true;
        setCreated(k);
      }}
    >
      <Field label={t("common.name")} htmlFor="key-name" required>
        <Input id="key-name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} autoFocus />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t("keys.scopes")}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          {SCOPES.map((s) => (
            <Checkbox key={s} label={t(`keys.scope.${s}`)} checked={scopes.includes(s)} onChange={() => toggle(s)} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Field>
      <Field label={t("keys.cidrs")} htmlFor="key-cidrs" hint={t("keys.cidrs.hint")}>
        <Input id="key-cidrs" value={cidrs} onChange={(e) => setCidrs(e.target.value)} placeholder="203.0.113.0/24, 2001:db8::/32" />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t("keys.expires")} htmlFor="key-expiry">
        <NativeSelect id="key-expiry" value={String(expiryDays)} onChange={(e) => setExpiryDays(Number(e.target.value))}>
          {EXPIRIES.map((d) => (
            <option key={d} value={d}>
              {d === 0 ? t("keys.expires.never") : t("keys.expires.days", { d })}
            </option>
          ))}
        </NativeSelect>
      </Field>
    </FormDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";

import { useNotice } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { FormDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Input, NativeSelect } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Field } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";

/** Operator/system message pushed to connected players (a room, or every live room of a project). */
export function NoticeDialog({ open, onOpenChange, roomId, projectId }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; roomId?: string; projectId?: string }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const toast = useToast();
  const notice = useNotice();
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [level, setLevel] = useState<"info" | "warn">("info");
  return (
    <FormDialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(o) => {
        onOpenChange(o);
        if (!o) setText("");
      }}
      title={t("notice.title")}
      description={roomId ? t("notice.desc.room") : t("notice.desc.project")}
      submitLabel={t("notice.send")}
      disabled={!text.trim()}
      onSubmit={async () => {
        const r = await notice.mutateAsync({ roomId, projectId, text: text.trim(), level });
        toast.ok(t("notice.sent", { rooms: r.rooms, players: r.players }));
        onOpenChange(false);
        setText("");
      }}
    >
      <Field label={t("notice.text")} htmlFor="notice-text" required>
        <Input id="notice-text" value={text} maxLength={512} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} autoFocus placeholder={t("notice.placeholder")} />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t("notice.level")} htmlFor="notice-level">
        <NativeSelect id="notice-level" value={level} onChange={(e) => setLevel(e.target.value as "info" | "warn")}>
          <option value="info">{t("notice.level.info")}</option>
          <option value="warn">{t("notice.level.warn")}</option>
        </NativeSelect>
      </Field>
    </FormDialog>
  );
```

```tsx
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";

import { useAddBan, useApi, usePlayerLookup } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort } from "@/lib/format";
import { modeTone } from "@/lib/rooms";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Badge, Callout, IdChip, Mono } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable } from "@/ui/Table";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";

/** Moderation entry point: type a player id, see where they are on the whole fleet, kick or ban from here. */
export function PlayerLookup({ projectId }: { projectId?: string }) {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [playerId, setPlayerId] = useState("");
  const q = usePlayerLookup(playerId, projectId);
  const ban = useAddBan(projectId);
  const api = useApi();
  const { operator } = useAuth();
  const kick = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ room, actor }: { room: string; actor: number }) =>
      api.request<void>(operator ? `/v1/operator/rooms/${room}/players/${actor}` : `/v1/rooms/${room}/players/${actor}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
  });
  const d = q.data;
  return (
    <div className="p-3 space-y-3">
      <form
        className="flex gap-2"
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setPlayerId(draft.trim());
        }}
      >
        <Input aria-label={t("players.id")} placeholder={t("players.placeholder")} value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} className="max-w-md" />
        <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" disabled={!draft.trim()}>
          <Search className="size-4" />
          {t("players.find")}
        </Button>
      </form>
      {q.error ? <Callout tone="danger">{q.error instanceof Error ? q.error.message : String(q.error)}</Callout> : null}
      {d ? (
        <>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm" data-testid="player-lookup-status">
            <Mono>{d.player_id}</Mono>
            {d.ban ? (
              <Badge tone="danger">{d.ban.expires_at ? t("players.bannedUntil", { at: fmtDateTimeShort(locale, d.ban.expires_at) }) : t("players.banned")}</Badge>
            ) : (
              <Badge tone="ok">{t("players.notBanned")}</Badge>
            )}
            <span className="text-fg-muted">{t("players.inRooms", { n: d.rooms.length })}</span>
            {d.unreachable_nodes.length > 0 ? <Badge tone="warn">{t("players.unreachable", { n: d.unreachable_nodes.length })}</Badge> : null}
            {!d.ban ? (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="danger"
                className="ml-auto"
                disabled={ban.isPending}
                onClick={async () => {
                  try {
                    await ban.mutateAsync({ player_id: d.player_id, reason: undefined });
                    toast.ok(t("bans.added", { id: d.player_id }));
                    await q.refetch();
                  } catch (err) {
                    toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
                  }
                }}
              >
                {t("bans.add")}
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
          <DataTable
            rows={d.rooms}
            rowKey={(r) => `${r.room_id}-${r.actor}`}
            dense
            empty={<span className="block px-3 py-4 text-center text-sm text-fg-muted">{t("players.noRooms")}</span>}
            columns={[
              { key: "room", header: t("rooms.title"), cell: (r) => <Link to="/rooms/$roomId" params={{ roomId: r.room_id }} className="font-medium hover:underline">{r.name}</Link> },
              { key: "mode", header: t("rooms.mode"), cell: (r) => <Badge tone={modeTone(r.mode)}>{r.mode}</Badge> },
              { key: "node", header: t("rooms.node"), cell: (r) => <IdChip id={r.node_id} /> },
              { key: "actor", header: t("rooms.actor"), cell: (r) => <Mono>{r.actor}</Mono> },
              { key: "name", header: t("common.name"), cell: (r) => r.player_name || <span className="text-fg-muted">—</span> },
              { key: "online", header: t("rooms.state"), cell: (r) => (r.online ? <Badge tone="ok" dot>{t("rooms.online")}</Badge> : <Badge>{t("rooms.offline")}</Badge>) },
              {
                key: "actions",
                header: "",
                align: "right",
                cell: (r) => (
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                    disabled={kick.isPending}
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        await kick.mutateAsync({ room: r.room_id, actor: r.actor });
                        toast.ok(t("rooms.kick.done", { name: r.player_name || d.player_id }));
                        await q.refetch();
                      } catch (err) {
                        toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    {t("rooms.kick")}
                  </Button>
                ),
              },
            ]}
          />
          {d.audit.length > 0 ? (
            <div>
              <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-fg-muted mb-1">{t("players.history")}</div>
              <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">
                {d.audit.map((a) => (
                  <li key={a.id} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-fg-muted tabular">{fmtDateTimeShort(locale, a.created_at)}</span>
                    <Mono>{a.action}</Mono>
                    <span className="text-fg-muted truncate">{a.actor}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/components/ProjectHealthCard.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";

import type { ProjectDetail, Rejections } from "@/api/client";
import { type MessageKey, useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { Stat } from "@/ui/Primitives";

const WEEK_MS = 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000;

/** One-glance state of a project: suspension, live load vs the room quota, rejections,
 * webhook failures and keys about to expire. Everything comes from the detail payload plus the
 * rejections query, so there is no extra round trip. */
export function ProjectHealthCard({ detail, rejections }: { detail: ProjectDetail; rejections?: Rejections }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [now] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const p = detail.project;
  const liveRooms = detail.rooms.filter((r) => r.open).length;
  const players = detail.rooms.reduce((a, r) => a + r.players, 0);
  const maxRooms = typeof detail.effective_limits.max_rooms === "number" ? detail.effective_limits.max_rooms : undefined;
  const rejectedTotal = rejections ? Object.values(rejections.total).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) : 0;
  const top = rejections ? Object.entries(rejections.total).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0] : undefined;
  const openKeys = detail.keys.filter((k) => !k.revoked_at);
  const expiring = openKeys.filter((k) => k.expires_at && new Date(k.expires_at).getTime() - now < WEEK_MS).length;
  const wh = detail.webhooks_1h;
  const roomsTone = maxRooms !== undefined && liveRooms >= maxRooms ? "warn" : "neutral";
  const capMinutes = typeof detail.effective_limits.monthly_player_minutes === "number" ? detail.effective_limits.monthly_player_minutes : undefined;
  const capBytes = typeof detail.effective_limits.monthly_bytes === "number" ? detail.effective_limits.monthly_bytes : undefined;
  const usedMinutes = Math.round(detail.usage_month.player_minutes);
  const usedMb = Math.round(detail.usage_month.bytes / 1e6);
  const pct = (used: number, cap?: number) => (cap ? used / cap : 0);
  const capPct = Math.max(pct(detail.usage_month.player_minutes, capMinutes), pct(detail.usage_month.bytes, capBytes));
  const usageTone = capPct >= 1 ? "danger" : capPct >= 0.8 ? "warn" : "neutral";
  return (
    <div data-testid="project-health" className="grid gap-3 grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6">
      <Stat label={t("health.status")} value={p.disabled_at ? t("health.suspended") : t("health.active")} tone={p.disabled_at ? "danger" : "ok"} />
      <Stat label={t("health.rooms")} value={maxRooms !== undefined ? `${liveRooms} / ${maxRooms}` : String(liveRooms)} hint={t("health.players", { n: players })} tone={roomsTone} />
      <Stat
        label={t("health.rejections")}
        value={String(rejectedTotal)}
        hint={top && top[1] > 0 ? t("health.top", { reason: t(`rejections.${top[0]}` as MessageKey) }) : t("health.none")}
        tone={rejectedTotal > 0 ? "warn" : "neutral"}
      />
      <Stat
        label={t("health.webhooks")}
        value={detail.webhooks.length ? `${wh.failed} / ${wh.total}` : "—"}
        hint={detail.webhooks.length ? t("health.webhooks.hint") : t("health.webhooks.none")}
        tone={wh.failed > 0 ? "danger" : "neutral"}
      />
      <Stat
        label={t("health.usage")}
        value={capMinutes ? `${usedMinutes.toLocaleString()} / ${capMinutes.toLocaleString()}` : usedMinutes.toLocaleString()}
        hint={capBytes ? t("health.usage.bytes.cap", { mb: usedMb.toLocaleString(), cap: Math.round(capBytes / 1e6).toLocaleString() }) : t("health.usage.bytes", { mb: usedMb.toLocaleString() })}
        tone={usageTone}
      />
      <Stat label={t("health.keys")} value={String(openKeys.length)} hint={expiring ? t("health.keys.expiring", { n: expiring }) : t("health.none")} tone={expiring ? "warn" : "neutral"} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/components/RangePicker.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";

import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { isoDay, toIsoEnd, toIsoStart } from "@/lib/format";
import { Input } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Segmented } from "@/ui/Menu";

export type RangePreset = "24h" | "7d" | "30d" | "custom";

export interface Range {
  from: string;
  to: string;
  preset: RangePreset;
}

const PRESET_MS: Record<Exclude<RangePreset, "custom">, number> = {
  "24h": 86_400_000,
  "7d": 7 * 86_400_000,
  "30d": 30 * 86_400_000,
};

export function presetRange(preset: Exclude<RangePreset, "custom">, now = Date.now()): Range {
  return { from: new Date(now - PRESET_MS[preset]).toISOString(), to: new Date(now).toISOString(), preset };
}

/** Preset + custom day range. `to` is exclusive, matching the API. */
export function useRange(initial: Exclude<RangePreset, "custom"> = "7d"): [Range, (r: Range) => void] {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<Range>(() => presetRange(initial));
  return [range, setRange];
}

/** Step (seconds) keeping a series under ~400 points. */
export function stepFor(range: Range): number {
  const span = (Date.parse(range.to) - Date.parse(range.from)) / 1000;
  const candidates = [300, 900, 3600, 6 * 3600, 86_400];
  return candidates.find((s) => span / s <= 400) ?? 86_400;
}

export function RangePicker({ value, onChange }: { value: Range; onChange: (r: Range) => void }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const days = useMemo(
    () => ({ from: isoDay(new Date(value.from)), to: isoDay(new Date(Date.parse(value.to) - 1)) }),
    [value.from, value.to],
  );
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Segmented
        size="sm"
        value={value.preset}
        onChange={(p) => {
          if (p === "custom") onChange({ ...value, preset: "custom" });
          else onChange(presetRange(p));
        }}
        options={[
          { value: "24h", label: t("common.last24h") },
          { value: "7d", label: t("common.last7d") },
          { value: "30d", label: t("common.last30d") },
          { value: "custom", label: t("common.custom") },
        ]}
      />
      {value.preset === "custom" ? (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Input
            type="date"
            className="h-8 w-[9.5rem]"
            value={days.from}
            max={days.to}
            onChange={(e) => e.target.value && onChange({ ...value, from: toIsoStart(e.target.value), preset: "custom" })}
            aria-label={t("common.from")}
          />
          <span className="text-fg-faint">–</span>
          <Input
            type="date"
            className="h-8 w-[9.5rem]"
            value={days.to}
            min={days.from}
            onChange={(e) => e.target.value && onChange({ ...value, to: toIsoEnd(e.target.value), preset: "custom" })}
            aria-label={t("common.to")}
          />
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/components/RejectionsCard.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { Rejections } from "@/api/client";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtNumber } from "@/lib/format";
import { Badge, Card } from "@/ui/Primitives";

const REASONS = ["rate_limited", "quota", "usage_cap", "ip_denied", "capacity", "room_full", "suspended", "banned", "region", "grant"] as const;

/** Compact "who got turned away and why" panel for one project. */
export function RejectionsCard({ data, loading }: { data: Rejections | undefined; loading?: boolean }) {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const total = data ? Object.values(data.total).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) : 0;
  const peak = data ? Math.max(1, ...data.series.map((s) => Object.values(s.counts).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0))) : 1;
  return (
    <Card className="p-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="text-xs font-medium text-fg-muted">{t("rejections.title", { h: data?.hours ?? 24 })}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-2xl font-semibold tabular tracking-tight">{loading && !data ? "…" : fmtNumber(locale, total)}</div>
        </div>
        <Badge tone={total === 0 ? "ok" : "warn"} dot>
          {total === 0 ? t("rejections.none") : t("rejections.some")}
        </Badge>
      </div>
      {data ? (
        <div className="mt-3 flex h-8 items-end gap-px" aria-hidden>
          {data.series.map((s) => {
            const n = Object.values(s.counts).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
            return <div key={s.t} className={n ? "flex-1 rounded-sm bg-warn/70" : "flex-1 rounded-sm bg-border"} style={{ height: `${Math.max(8, Math.round((n / peak) * 100))}%` }} title={`${s.t}: ${n}`} />;
          })}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <dl className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs">
        {REASONS.map((r) => (
          <div key={r} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <dt className="text-fg-muted">{t(`rejections.${r}`)}</dt>
            <dd className="tabular font-medium">{fmtNumber(locale, data?.total[r] ?? 0)}</dd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>
      <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-fg-faint">{t("rejections.hint")}</div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/components/RotateWebhook.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";

import type { RotatedWebhook, Webhook } from "@/api/client";
import { useRotateWebhook } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort } from "@/lib/format";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { ConfirmDialog, Dialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { NativeSelect } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Callout, CodeBlock, Field } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";

const GRACE_HOURS = [1, 24, 72, 168] as const;

/** Confirm → rotate → show the new secret once, with the moment the old one stops signing. */
export function RotateWebhookDialog({ webhook, onClose, projectId }: { webhook: Webhook | null; onClose: () => void; projectId?: string }) {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const toast = useToast();
  const rotate = useRotateWebhook(projectId);
  const [grace, setGrace] = useState<number>(24);
  const [done, setDone] = useState<RotatedWebhook | null>(null);
  if (done) {
    return (
      <Dialog
        open
        onOpenChange={(o) => {
          if (!o) {
            setDone(null);
            onClose();
          }
        }}
        title={t("webhooks.rotate")}
        footer={
          <Button
            onClick={() => {
              setDone(null);
              onClose();
            }}
          >
            {t("common.close")}
          </Button>
        }
      >
        <Callout tone="warn">{t("webhooks.rotate.shownOnce", { until: fmtDateTimeShort(locale, done.previous_secret_expires_at) })}</Callout>
        <CodeBlock value={done.secret} className="mt-3" />
      </Dialog>
    );
  }
  return (
    <ConfirmDialog
      open={!!webhook}
      onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}
      title={t("webhooks.rotate")}
      description={t("webhooks.rotate.desc")}
      confirmLabel={t("webhooks.rotate")}
      onConfirm={async () => {
        if (!webhook) return;
        try {
          const r = await rotate.mutateAsync({ webhookId: webhook.id, graceSecs: grace * 3600 });
          setDone(r);
        } catch (err) {
          toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
          onClose();
        }
      }}
    >
      <Field label={t("webhooks.rotate.grace")} htmlFor="rotate-grace">
        <NativeSelect id="rotate-grace" value={String(grace)} onChange={(e) => setGrace(Number(e.target.value))}>
          {GRACE_HOURS.map((h) => (
            <option key={h} value={h}>
              {h < 24 ? t("webhooks.rotate.hours", { n: h }) : t("webhooks.rotate.days", { n: h / 24 })}
            </option>
          ))}
        </NativeSelect>
      </Field>
    </ConfirmDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";

import { useIssueTestGrant } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort } from "@/lib/format";
import { Checkbox } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Dialog, FormDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { CodeBlock } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { Input, NativeSelect } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Field } from "@/ui/Primitives";

const SCOPES = ["join", "create", "master", "spectate"] as const;

/** Issues a short-lived grant for a player of this project and shows it once, with the
 * control-plane auth message a client sends first. Lets an operator debug a connection without
 * holding the project's API key. */
export function TestGrantDialog({ open, onOpenChange, projectId, endpoint }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; projectId: string; endpoint?: string }) {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const issue = useIssueTestGrant(projectId);
  const [playerId, setPlayerId] = useState("debug-1");
  const [room, setRoom] = useState("");
  const [scopes, setScopes] = useState<string[]>(["join", "create"]);
  const [ttl, setTtl] = useState(300);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ grant: string; expires_at: number } | null>(null);
  const wsUrl = (endpoint ?? "https://<node>").replace(/^http/, "ws") + "/v1/ws";
  if (result) {
    return (
      <Dialog
        open
        onOpenChange={() => {
          setResult(null);
          onOpenChange(false);
        }}
        title={t("grant.title")}
        description={t("grant.expires", { at: fmtDateTimeShort(locale, new Date(result.expires_at * 1000).toISOString()) })}
        footer={
          <Button
            onClick={() => {
              setResult(null);
              onOpenChange(false);
            }}
          >
            {t("common.close")}
          </Button>
        }
      >
        <div data-testid="test-grant">
          <Field label={t("grant.token")}>
            <CodeBlock value={result.grant} />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <Field label={t("grant.snippet")} className="mt-3">
          <CodeBlock value={`${wsUrl}\n${JSON.stringify({ t: "auth", grant: result.grant })}`} />
        </Field>
      </Dialog>
    );
  }
  return (
    <FormDialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={onOpenChange}
      title={t("grant.title")}
      description={t("grant.desc")}
      submitLabel={t("grant.issue")}
      disabled={!playerId.trim() || scopes.length === 0}
      onSubmit={async () => {
        const r = await issue.mutateAsync({ player_id: playerId.trim(), name: playerId.trim(), room: room.trim() || undefined, scopes, ttl_secs: ttl });
        setResult(r);
      }}
    >
      <Field label={t("grant.player")} htmlFor="tg-player" required>
        <Input id="tg-player" value={playerId} maxLength={128} onChange={(e) => setPlayerId(e.target.value)} autoFocus />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t("grant.room")} htmlFor="tg-room" hint={t("grant.room.hint")}>
        <Input id="tg-room" value={room} onChange={(e) => setRoom(e.target.value)} placeholder="—" />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t("grant.scopes")}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          {SCOPES.map((s) => (
            <Checkbox key={s} label={s} checked={scopes.includes(s)} onChange={(e) => setScopes((cur) => (e.target.checked ? [...cur, s] : cur.filter((x) => x !== s)))} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Field>
      <Field label={t("grant.ttl")} htmlFor="tg-ttl">
        <NativeSelect id="tg-ttl" value={String(ttl)} onChange={(e) => setTtl(Number(e.target.value))}>
          <option value="300">5 min</option>
          <option value="900">15 min</option>
          <option value="3600">60 min</option>
        </NativeSelect>
      </Field>
    </FormDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Webhook } from "@/api/client";
import { useTestWebhook, useWebhookDeliveries } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort } from "@/lib/format";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { Dialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Badge, Mono } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable } from "@/ui/Table";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";

/** Recent deliveries of one webhook with a "send test" action. Operator sessions pass the
 * project id so the operator routes are used. */
export function WebhookDeliveriesDialog({ webhook, projectId, fleet, onClose }: { webhook: Pick<Webhook, "id" | "url"> | null; projectId?: string; fleet?: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const toast = useToast();
  const q = useWebhookDeliveries(webhook?.id ?? null, projectId, fleet);
  const test = useTestWebhook(projectId, fleet);
  return (
    <Dialog
      open={!!webhook}
      onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}
      title={t("webhooks.deliveries")}
      description={webhook ? <Mono className="break-all">{webhook.url}</Mono> : undefined}
      size="lg"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            disabled={!webhook || test.isPending}
            onClick={() => {
              if (!webhook) return;
              test.mutate(webhook.id, {
                onSuccess: () => toast.ok(t("webhooks.test.queued")),
                onError: (e) => toast.error(t("webhooks.test"), e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)),
              });
            }}
          >
            {t("webhooks.test")}
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>{t("common.close")}</Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <DataTable
        rows={q.data}
        rowKey={(d) => d.id}
        dense
        loading={q.isLoading}
        error={q.error}
        empty={<span className="block px-3 py-6 text-center text-sm text-fg-muted">{t("webhooks.deliveries.empty")}</span>}
        columns={[
          { key: "when", header: t("audit.when"), cell: (d) => <span className="text-fg-muted whitespace-nowrap">{fmtDateTimeShort(locale, d.created_at)}</span> },
          { key: "event", header: t("webhooks.events"), cell: (d) => <Mono>{d.event}</Mono> },
          {
            key: "result",
            header: t("webhooks.result"),
            cell: (d) => (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Badge tone={d.ok ? "ok" : "danger"} dot>
                  {d.status ?? (d.ok ? "OK" : t("webhooks.failed"))}
                </Badge>
                {d.error ? <span className="text-xs text-fg-muted truncate max-w-[280px]" title={d.error}>{d.error}</span> : null}
              </span>
            ),
          },
          { key: "attempts", header: t("webhooks.attempts"), align: "right", cell: (d) => d.attempts },
          { key: "latency", header: t("webhooks.latency"), align: "right", cell: (d) => `${d.latency_ms} ms` },
        ]}
      />
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/components/charts.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Area, AreaChart, CartesianGrid, Line, LineChart, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis, type TooltipContentProps } from "recharts";
import type { NameType, ValueType } from "recharts/types/component/DefaultTooltipContent";

import { useI18n, type Locale } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTime, fmtMinutes, fmtMos, fmtNumber, fmtTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { QueryError } from "@/ui/Page";
import { Badge, Card, CardHeader, Progress, Skeleton, type Tone } from "@/ui/Primitives";

/** Chart palette from the design tokens so charts follow the theme. */
export const chart = {
  fg: "var(--fg)",
  muted: "var(--fg-muted)",
  faint: "var(--fg-faint)",
  grid: "var(--border)",
  accent: "var(--accent)",
  ok: "var(--ok)",
  warn: "var(--warn)",
  danger: "var(--danger)",
} as const;

export interface SeriesDef {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  color: string;
  /** Right axis. */
  right?: boolean;
  format?: (v: number) => string;
  area?: boolean;
}

export type Point = { t: number } & Record<string, number | null>;

function tickFormatter(locale: Locale, spanMs: number) {
  return (v: number) => (spanMs > 2 * 86_400_000 ? fmtDateTime(locale, new Date(v).toISOString()).replace(/,? \d{2}:\d{2}.*$/, "") : fmtTime(locale, v));
}

/** Axis ticks must fit a 44px gutter: 1200 → "1.2k", 3_500_000 → "3.5M". */
export function compactTick(v: number): string {
  const abs = Math.abs(v);
  if (abs < 1000) return Number.isInteger(v) ? String(v) : v.toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "");
  const units = ["k", "M", "G", "T"];
  let n = abs;
  let i = -1;
  while (n >= 1000 && i < units.length - 1) {
    n /= 1000;
    i++;
  }
  const s = n >= 100 ? n.toFixed(0) : n.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "");
  return `${v < 0 ? "-" : ""}${s}${units[i]}`;
}

function ChartTooltip({ active, payload, label, series, locale }: Partial<TooltipContentProps<ValueType, NameType>> & { series: SeriesDef[]; locale: Locale }) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length || typeof label !== "number") return null;
  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-2.5 py-2 text-xs shadow-sm">
      <div className="text-fg-faint mb-1">{fmtDateTime(locale, new Date(label).toISOString())}</div>
      {payload.map((p) => {
        const def = series.find((s) => s.key === p.dataKey);
        if (!def) return null;
        const v = typeof p.value === "number" ? p.value : null;
        return (
          <div key={def.key} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="size-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: def.color }} />
            <span className="text-fg-muted">{def.label}</span>
            <span className="ml-auto tabular font-medium">{v === null ? "—" : def.format ? def.format(v) : v.toLocaleString(locale)}</span>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export function TimeSeriesChart({
  data,
  series,
  height = 220,
  leftDomain,
  rightDomain,
  empty,
}: {
  data: Point[];
  series: SeriesDef[];
  height?: number;
  leftDomain?: [number | "auto", number | "auto"];
  rightDomain?: [number | "auto", number | "auto"];
  empty?: ReactNode;
}) {
  const { locale } = useI18n();
  if (data.length === 0) {
    return <div className="flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-fg-faint" style={{ height }}>{empty ?? "—"}</div>;
  }
  const first = data[0]?.t ?? 0;
  const last = data[data.length - 1]?.t ?? first;
  const hasRight = series.some((s) => s.right);
  const anyArea = series.some((s) => s.area);
  const Chart = anyArea ? AreaChart : LineChart;
  return (
    <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={height}>
      <Chart data={data} margin={{ top: 8, right: hasRight ? 4 : 12, bottom: 0, left: 0 }}>
        <CartesianGrid stroke={chart.grid} vertical={false} />
        <XAxis
          dataKey="t"
          type="number"
          domain={["dataMin", "dataMax"]}
          scale="time"
          tickFormatter={tickFormatter(locale, last - first)}
          tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: chart.faint }}
          axisLine={false}
          tickLine={false}
          minTickGap={40}
        />
        <YAxis yAxisId="left" tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: chart.faint }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} width={44} domain={leftDomain} allowDecimals={false} tickFormatter={compactTick} />
        {hasRight ? (
          <YAxis yAxisId="right" orientation="right" tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: chart.faint }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} width={44} domain={rightDomain} tickFormatter={compactTick} />
        ) : null}
        <Tooltip content={(p) => <ChartTooltip {...p} series={series} locale={locale} />} cursor={{ stroke: chart.grid }} />
        {series.map((s) =>
          s.area ? (
            <Area
              key={s.key}
              yAxisId={s.right ? "right" : "left"}
              type="monotone"
              dataKey={s.key}
              stroke={s.color}
              fill={s.color}
              fillOpacity={0.08}
              strokeWidth={1.6}
              dot={false}
              isAnimationActive={false}
              connectNulls
            />
          ) : (
            <Line
              key={s.key}
              yAxisId={s.right ? "right" : "left"}
              type="monotone"
              dataKey={s.key}
              stroke={s.color}
              strokeWidth={1.6}
              dot={false}
              isAnimationActive={false}
              connectNulls
            />
          ),
        )}
      </Chart>
    </ResponsiveContainer>
  );
}

export function Legend({ series }: { series: SeriesDef[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-fg-muted">
      {series.map((s) => (
        <span key={s.key} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="size-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: s.color }} />
          {s.label}
        </span>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ChartCard({
  title,
  description,
  series,
  query,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  series: SeriesDef[];
  query: { isPending: boolean; isError: boolean; error: unknown; refetch: () => Promise<unknown> };
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader title={title} description={description} actions={<Legend series={series} />} />
      <div className="px-2 pb-3">
        {query.isError ? <QueryError error={query.error} onRetry={() => void query.refetch()} compact /> : query.isPending ? <Skeleton className="mx-2 h-[220px]" /> : children}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function mosTone(mos: number | null | undefined): Tone | undefined {
  if (mos === null || mos === undefined) return undefined;
  return mos >= 4 ? "ok" : mos >= 3.6 ? undefined : mos >= 3.1 ? "warn" : "danger";
}

export function MosBadge({ mos }: { mos: number | null | undefined }) {
  if (mos === null || mos === undefined) return <span className="text-fg-faint">—</span>;
  return <Badge tone={mosTone(mos) ?? "neutral"}>{fmtMos(mos)}</Badge>;
}

export function QuotaRow({ label, used, limit, minutes }: { label: string; used: number; limit: number; minutes?: boolean }) {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const fmt = (n: number) => (minutes ? fmtMinutes(locale, n) : fmtNumber(locale, n));
  const pct = limit > 0 ? (used / limit) * 100 : null;
  const tone: Tone | undefined = pct === null ? undefined : pct >= 100 ? "danger" : pct >= 80 ? "warn" : undefined;
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
        <span className="text-fg-muted">{label}</span>
        <span className="tabular">{limit > 0 ? t("overview.quota.of", { used: fmt(used), limit: fmt(limit) }) : `${fmt(used)} · ${t("common.unlimited")}`}</span>
      </div>
      <Progress value={used} max={limit > 0 ? limit : null} tone={tone} className="mt-1.5" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/i18n/index.tsx`:

```tsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";

import { en, type MessageKey, type Messages, type Vars } from "./en";
import { ru } from "./ru";

export type Locale = "en" | "ru";
export type { MessageKey };

const STORAGE_KEY = "aurix.locale";
const dictionaries: Record<Locale, Messages> = { en, ru };

interface I18n {
  locale: Locale;
  setLocale: (l: Locale) => void;
  t: (key: MessageKey, vars?: Vars) => string;
}

const I18nContext = createContext<I18n | null>(null);

function detectLocale(): Locale {
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (stored === "en" || stored === "ru") return stored;
  } catch {
    /* private mode */
  }
  return navigator.language.toLowerCase().startsWith("ru") ? "ru" : "en";
}

export function translate(locale: Locale, key: MessageKey, vars?: Vars): string {
  const msg = dictionaries[locale][key] ?? en[key];
  if (typeof msg === "function") return msg(vars ?? {});
  if (!vars) return msg;
  return msg.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k: string) => String(vars[k] ?? `{${k}}`));
}

export function I18nProvider({ children, initial }: { children: ReactNode; initial?: Locale }) {
  const [locale, setLocaleState] = useState<Locale>(() => initial ?? detectLocale());
  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.lang = locale;
  }, [locale]);
  const setLocale = useCallback((l: Locale) => {
    setLocaleState(l);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, l);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }, []);
  const t = useCallback((key: MessageKey, vars?: Vars) => translate(locale, key, vars), [locale]);
  const value = useMemo(() => ({ locale, setLocale, t }), [locale, setLocale, t]);
  return <I18nContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</I18nContext.Provider>;
}

export function useI18n(): I18n {
  const ctx = useContext(I18nContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useI18n outside I18nProvider");
  return ctx;
}

export function useT(): I18n["t"] {
  return useI18n().t;
}

/** Russian plural category → one/few/many; English → one/other. */
export function plural(locale: Locale, n: number, forms: { one: string; few?: string; many: string }): string {
  const cat = new Intl.PluralRules(locale === "ru" ? "ru-RU" : "en-US").select(n);
  if (cat === "one") return forms.one;
  if (cat === "few" && forms.few) return forms.few;
  return forms.many;
}

```

`dashboard/src/lib/format.ts`:

```ts
import type { Locale } from "@/i18n";

const bcp47: Record<Locale, string> = { en: "en-US", ru: "ru-RU" };

export function fmtNumber(locale: Locale, n: number | null | undefined, digits = 0): string {
  if (n === null || n === undefined || Number.isNaN(n)) return "—";
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(bcp47[locale], { maximumFractionDigits: digits }).format(n);
}

export function fmtCompact(locale: Locale, n: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (n === null || n === undefined || Number.isNaN(n)) return "—";
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(bcp47[locale], { notation: "compact", maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(n);
}

export function fmtPercent(locale: Locale, n: number | null | undefined, digits = 1): string {
  if (n === null || n === undefined || Number.isNaN(n)) return "—";
  return `${new Intl.NumberFormat(bcp47[locale], { maximumFractionDigits: digits }).format(n)} %`;
}

export function fmtBytes(locale: Locale, n: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (n === null || n === undefined || Number.isNaN(n)) return "—";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  let v = n;
  let i = 0;
  while (v >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
    v /= 1024;
    i++;
  }
  return `${new Intl.NumberFormat(bcp47[locale], { maximumFractionDigits: i === 0 ? 0 : 1 }).format(v)} ${units[i]}`;
}

export function fmtDateTime(locale: Locale, iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(bcp47[locale], {
    year: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    day: "2-digit",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
  }).format(d);
}

/** Compact "Sep 21, 18:43:51" for dense log tables; pair with the full `fmtDateTime` in a title. */
export function fmtDateTimeShort(locale: Locale, iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(bcp47[locale], {
    month: "short",
    day: "2-digit",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
    hourCycle: "h23",
  }).format(d);
}

export function fmtDate(locale: Locale, iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(bcp47[locale], { year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "2-digit" }).format(d);
}

export function fmtTime(locale: Locale, iso: string | number | null | undefined): string {
  if (iso === null || iso === undefined) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(iso);
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(bcp47[locale], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }).format(d);
}

/** "3 min ago" / "3 мин назад" style; `now` is injectable for tests. */
export function fmtRelative(locale: Locale, iso: string | null | undefined, now = Date.now()): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const t = new Date(iso).getTime();
  if (Number.isNaN(t)) return iso;
  const rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(bcp47[locale], { numeric: "auto", style: "narrow" });
  const diff = (t - now) / 1000;
  const abs = Math.abs(diff);
  if (abs < 45) return rtf.format(Math.round(diff), "second");
  if (abs < 3600) return rtf.format(Math.round(diff / 60), "minute");
  if (abs < 86400) return rtf.format(Math.round(diff / 3600), "hour");
  return rtf.format(Math.round(diff / 86400), "day");
}

export function fmtDuration(locale: Locale, secs: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (secs === null || secs === undefined || Number.isNaN(secs)) return "—";
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.round(secs));
  const h = Math.floor(s / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
  const r = s % 60;
  const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat(bcp47[locale]);
  if (h > 0) return `${nf.format(h)}:${pad(m)}:${pad(r)}`;
  return `${m}:${pad(r)}`;
}

export function fmtMinutes(locale: Locale, minutes: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (minutes === null || minutes === undefined || Number.isNaN(minutes)) return "—";
  if (minutes < 60) return `${fmtNumber(locale, minutes)} min`;
  return `${fmtNumber(locale, minutes / 60, 1)} h`;
}

export function fmtMos(n: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (n === null || n === undefined || Number.isNaN(n)) return "—";
  return n.toFixed(2);
}

export function shortId(id: string | null | undefined, n = 8): string {
  if (!id) return "—";
  return id.length > n ? id.slice(0, n) : id;
}

function pad(n: number): string {
  return n < 10 ? `0${n}` : String(n);
}

export function toIsoStart(date: string): string {
  return new Date(`${date}T00:00:00`).toISOString();
}

export function toIsoEnd(date: string): string {
  return new Date(`${date}T23:59:59.999`).toISOString();
}

export function isoDay(d: Date): string {
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = pad(d.getMonth() + 1);
  const day = pad(d.getDate());
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}
```

`dashboard/src/lib/rooms.ts`:

```ts
import type { Tone } from "@/ui/Primitives";

export function modeTone(mode: string): Tone {
  switch (mode) {
    case "relay":
      return "neutral";
    case "sync":
      return "accent";
    case "lockstep":
      return "ok";
    default:
      return "warn";
  }
}

/** Heartbeats are every few seconds; 30 s of silence means the node is gone or partitioned. */
export function nodeStale(lastHeartbeat: string, now = Date.now()): boolean {
  const t = Date.parse(lastHeartbeat);
  return !Number.isFinite(t) || now - t > 30_000;
}
```

`dashboard/src/lib/useNow.ts`:

```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

/** Current time, refreshed every `intervalMs`; keeps relative timestamps ticking without impure reads during render. */
export function useNow(intervalMs = 10_000): number {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), intervalMs);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [intervalMs]);
  return now;
}
```

`dashboard/src/lib/usePageSize.ts`:

```ts
import { useCallback, useState } from "react";

export const PAGE_SIZES = [10, 25, 50, 100] as const;
export type PageSize = (typeof PAGE_SIZES)[number];
export const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE: PageSize = 25;

const STORAGE_PREFIX = "aurix.dashboard.pageSize:";

export function isPageSize(n: number): n is PageSize {
  return (PAGE_SIZES as readonly number[]).includes(n);
}

/** Stored preference → valid page size (unknown or tampered values fall back to the default). */
export function parsePageSize(raw: string | null | undefined): PageSize {
  const n = Number(raw);
  return raw != null && raw !== "" && isPageSize(n) ? n : DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;
}

function read(table: string): PageSize {
  try {
    return parsePageSize(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_PREFIX + table));
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;
  }
}

/** Rows-per-page preference of one table, remembered per browser. */
export function usePageSize(table: string): [PageSize, (n: number) => void] {
  const [size, setSize] = useState<PageSize>(() => read(table));
  const update = useCallback(
    (n: number) => {
      if (!isPageSize(n)) return;
      setSize(n);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_PREFIX + table, String(n));
      } catch {
        /* private mode / quota: keep in-memory only */
      }
    },
    [table],
  );
  return [size, update];
}
```

`dashboard/src/main.tsx`:

```tsx
import "./styles.css";

import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { RouterProvider } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { StrictMode } from "react";
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";

import { NetError } from "@/api/client";
import { AuthProvider } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { I18nProvider } from "@/i18n";
import { router } from "@/router";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@/theme";
import { TooltipProvider } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { ToastProvider } from "@/ui/Toast";

const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      staleTime: 5_000,
      refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
      retry: (count, err) => {
        if (err instanceof NetError && err.status >= 400 && err.status < 500) return false;
        return count < 2;
      },
    },
    mutations: { retry: false },
  },
});

createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(
  <StrictMode>
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <ThemeProvider>
        <I18nProvider>
          <ToastProvider>
            <TooltipProvider delayDuration={250}>
              <AuthProvider>
                <RouterProvider router={router} />
              </AuthProvider>
            </TooltipProvider>
          </ToastProvider>
        </I18nProvider>
      </ThemeProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  </StrictMode>,
);
```
