`dashboard/src/pages/Audit.tsx`:

```tsx
import { baseUrl, type AuditRow } from "@/api/client";
import { Download } from "lucide-react";
import { useAudit } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort } from "@/lib/format";
import { RequireScope } from "@/shell/Guards";
import { useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { Input, NativeSelect } from "@/ui/Input";
import { PageHeader, Toolbar } from "@/ui/Page";
import { Badge, Card, IdChip, Mono } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";
import { DataTable, type Column } from "@/ui/Table";

const ACTIONS = ["key.create", "key.revoke", "webhook.create", "webhook.delete", "module.put", "module.delete", "project.create", "project.limits", "room.close"];

function AuditTable() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const { operator, projectId, token } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [action, setAction] = useState("");
  const [actor, setActor] = useState("");
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(200);
  async function exportCsv() {
    const url = new URL(operator ? "/v1/operator/audit" : "/v1/audit", baseUrl());
    if (action.trim()) url.searchParams.set("action", action.trim());
    if (actor.trim()) url.searchParams.set("actor", actor.trim());
    if (operator && projectId) url.searchParams.set("project", projectId);
    url.searchParams.set("limit", String(limit));
    url.searchParams.set("format", "csv");
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { headers: token ? { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : undefined });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const name = /filename="([^"]+)"/.exec(res.headers.get("content-disposition") ?? "")?.[1] ?? "audit.csv";
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = name;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
    }
  }
  const q = useAudit({ action: action.trim(), actor: actor.trim(), limit });
  const cols: Column<AuditRow>[] = [
    { key: "when", header: t("audit.when"), width: "160px", cell: (r) => <span className="text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{fmtDateTimeShort(locale, r.created_at)}</span> },
    { key: "actor", header: t("audit.actor"), cell: (r) => <Mono>{r.actor}</Mono> },
    { key: "action", header: t("audit.action"), cell: (r) => <Badge tone={r.action.endsWith(".revoke") || r.action.endsWith(".delete") ? "danger" : r.action.endsWith(".create") || r.action.endsWith(".put") ? "ok" : "neutral"}>{r.action}</Badge> },
    ...(operator && !projectId ? [{ key: "project", header: t("rooms.project"), cell: (r: AuditRow) => (r.project_id ? <IdChip id={r.project_id} /> : "—") } satisfies Column<AuditRow>] : []),
    { key: "target", header: t("audit.target"), cell: (r) => <IdChip id={r.target} short={12} /> },
    { key: "details", header: t("audit.details"), cell: (r) => <Mono className="text-[11px] text-fg-muted">{Object.keys(r.details).length ? JSON.stringify(r.details) : "—"}</Mono> },
  ];
  return (
    <Card>
      <Toolbar end={<span className="text-xs text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{t("common.total")}: {q.data?.length ?? 0}</span>}>
        <Input placeholder={t("audit.filter.action")} value={action} onChange={(e) => setAction(e.target.value)} className="w-44" list="audit-actions" />
        <datalist id="audit-actions">
          {ACTIONS.map((a) => (
            <option key={a} value={a} />
          ))}
        </datalist>
        <Input placeholder={t("audit.filter.actor")} value={actor} onChange={(e) => setActor(e.target.value)} className="w-44" />
        <NativeSelect aria-label={t("audit.filter.limit")} value={String(limit)} onChange={(e) => setLimit(Number(e.target.value))} className="w-28">
          {[50, 200, 500, 1000].map((n) => (
            <option key={n} value={n}>
              {n}
            </option>
          ))}
        </NativeSelect>
        {action || actor ? (
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => {
              setAction("");
              setActor("");
            }}
          >
            {t("rooms.filter.clear")}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => void exportCsv()}>
          <Download className="size-4" />
          {t("usage.export")}
        </Button>
      </Toolbar>
      <DataTable rows={q.data} columns={cols} rowKey={(r) => String(r.id)} loading={q.isLoading} error={q.error} dense />
    </Card>
  );
}

export function AuditPage() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  return (
    <RequireScope scope="read">
      <PageHeader title={t("audit.title")} description={t("audit.desc")} />
      <AuditTable />
    </RequireScope>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import type { ApiKey } from "@/api/client";
import { useCreateKey, useKeys, useRevokeKey } from "@/api/hooks";
import { NewKeyDialog } from "@/components/NewKeyDialog";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort, fmtRelative } from "@/lib/format";
import { RequireScope } from "@/shell/Guards";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { PageHeader } from "@/ui/Page";
import { Badge, Card, Mono } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable, type Column } from "@/ui/Table";

export function keyColumns(t: (k: never, v?: never) => string, locale: "en" | "ru", onRevoke?: (k: ApiKey) => void): Column<ApiKey>[] {
  const tt = t as unknown as (k: string, v?: Record<string, string | number>) => string;
  return [
    { key: "name", header: tt("common.name"), sort: (k) => k.name, cell: (k) => <span className="font-medium">{k.name}</span> },
    { key: "prefix", header: tt("keys.prefix"), cell: (k) => <Mono>an_{k.prefix}…</Mono> },
    { key: "scopes", header: tt("keys.scopes"), cell: (k) => <span className="flex gap-1 flex-wrap">{k.scopes.map((s) => <Badge key={s}>{s}</Badge>)}</span> },
    { key: "created", header: tt("common.created"), sort: (k) => k.created_at, cell: (k) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{fmtDateTimeShort(locale, k.created_at)}</span> },
    { key: "used", header: tt("keys.lastUsed"), sort: (k) => k.last_used_at ?? "", cell: (k) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{k.last_used_at ? fmtRelative(locale, k.last_used_at) : "—"}</span> },
    { key: "cidrs", header: tt("keys.cidrs"), cell: (k) => (k.allowed_cidrs?.length ? <span title={k.allowed_cidrs.join(", ")}><Badge>{tt("keys.cidrs.n", { n: k.allowed_cidrs.length })}</Badge></span> : <span className="text-fg-muted">{tt("keys.cidrs.any")}</span>) },
    { key: "expires", header: tt("keys.expires"), sort: (k) => k.expires_at ?? "", cell: (k) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{k.expires_at ? fmtDateTimeShort(locale, k.expires_at) : tt("keys.expires.never")}</span> },
    {
      key: "state",
      header: tt("rooms.state"),
      cell: (k) =>
        k.revoked_at ? <Badge tone="danger">{tt("keys.revoked")}</Badge> : k.expires_at && Date.parse(k.expires_at) < Date.now() ? <Badge tone="warn">{tt("keys.expired")}</Badge> : <Badge tone="ok" dot>{tt("rooms.open")}</Badge>,
    },
    ...(onRevoke
      ? [
          {
            key: "actions",
            header: "",
            align: "right",
            cell: (k: ApiKey) =>
              k.revoked_at ? null : (
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => onRevoke(k)}>
                  {tt("keys.revoke")}
                </Button>
              ),
          } satisfies Column<ApiKey>,
        ]
      : []),
  ];
}

function KeysBody() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const keys = useKeys();
  const create = useCreateKey();
  const revoke = useRevokeKey();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [revoking, setRevoking] = useState<ApiKey | null>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={t("keys.title")}
        description={t("keys.desc")}
        actions={
          <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
            <Plus className="size-3.5" /> {t("keys.new")}
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <Card>
        <DataTable rows={keys.data} columns={keyColumns(t, locale, setRevoking)} rowKey={(k) => k.id} loading={keys.isLoading} error={keys.error} />
      </Card>
      <NewKeyDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} create={(b) => create.mutateAsync(b)} />
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={!!revoking}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setRevoking(null)}
        title={t("keys.revoke")}
        description={revoking ? t("keys.revoke.confirm", { name: revoking.name }) : ""}
        confirmLabel={t("keys.revoke")}
        variant="danger"
        onConfirm={async () => {
          if (revoking) await revoke.mutateAsync(revoking.id);
          setRevoking(null);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

export function KeysPage() {
  return (
    <RequireScope scope="admin" projectKey>
      <KeysBody />
    </RequireScope>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/pages/Matchmaking.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";

import { useCancelTicket, useFileTicket, useTicket } from "@/api/hooks";
import { MatchmakingQueue } from "@/components/MatchmakingQueue";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { RequireScope } from "@/shell/Guards";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { Input, NativeSelect } from "@/ui/Input";
import { PageHeader } from "@/ui/Page";
import { Badge, Card, CardHeader, Field, IdChip, KV } from "@/ui/Primitives";

function MatchmakingBody() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const file = useFileTicket();
  const cancel = useCancelTicket();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState("relay");
  const [size, setSize] = useState(2);
  const [player, setPlayer] = useState("console-tester");
  const [ticketId, setTicketId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const ticket = useTicket(ticketId);
  const state = ticket.data?.state ?? (file.isPending ? "…" : null);
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={t("mm.title")} description={t("mm.desc")} />
      <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <Card className="p-4">
          <CardHeader title={t("mm.file")} className="px-0 pt-0" />
          <form
            className="space-y-3"
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              void file.mutateAsync({ mode, size, player_id: player, props: {} }).then((r) => setTicketId(r.ticket));
            }}
          >
            <Field label={t("mm.mode")} htmlFor="mm-mode">
              <NativeSelect id="mm-mode" value={mode} onChange={(e) => setMode(e.target.value)}>
                <option value="relay">relay</option>
                <option value="sync">sync</option>
                <option value="lockstep">lockstep</option>
              </NativeSelect>
            </Field>
            <Field label={t("mm.size")} htmlFor="mm-size">
              <Input id="mm-size" type="number" min={1} max={128} value={size} onChange={(e) => setSize(Number(e.target.value))} />
            </Field>
            <Field label={t("rooms.playerId")} htmlFor="mm-player">
              <Input id="mm-player" value={player} onChange={(e) => setPlayer(e.target.value)} />
            </Field>
            <Button type="submit" loading={file.isPending}>
              {t("mm.file")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </Card>
        <Card className="p-4">
          <CardHeader title={t("mm.ticket")} className="px-0 pt-0" />
          {ticketId ? (
            <>
              <KV
                cols={1}
                items={[
                  { k: t("mm.ticket"), v: <IdChip id={ticketId} short={36} /> },
                  { k: t("mm.state"), v: state ? <Badge tone={state === "matched" ? "ok" : state === "cancelled" ? "neutral" : "accent"} dot>{state}</Badge> : "—" },
                  { k: t("rooms.title"), v: ticket.data?.room ? <IdChip id={ticket.data.room} /> : "—", hidden: !ticket.data?.room },
                ]}
              />
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                size="sm"
                className="mt-4"
                onClick={() => void cancel.mutateAsync(ticketId).then(() => void ticket.refetch())}
                disabled={state === "matched" || state === "cancelled"}
              >
                {t("mm.cancel")}
              </Button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-[13px] text-fg-muted">{t("common.empty")}</p>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export function MatchmakingPage() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  return (
    <RequireScope scope="rooms" projectKey>
      <MatchmakingBody />
      <Card className="mt-5">
        <CardHeader title={t("mm.queue.title")} />
        <MatchmakingQueue />
      </Card>
    </RequireScope>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/pages/Modules.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Upload } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import type { Module } from "@/api/client";
import { useDeleteModule, useModules, usePutModule } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtBytes, fmtDateTimeShort } from "@/lib/format";
import { RequireScope } from "@/shell/Guards";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { ConfirmDialog, FormDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Input } from "@/ui/Input";
import { PageHeader } from "@/ui/Page";
import { Card, Field, Mono } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable, type Column } from "@/ui/Table";

function ModulesBody() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const list = useModules();
  const put = usePutModule();
  const del = useDeleteModule();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<Module | null>(null);
  const cols: Column<Module>[] = [
    { key: "name", header: t("common.name"), sort: (m) => m.name, cell: (m) => <span className="font-medium">{m.name}</span> },
    { key: "hash", header: t("modules.hash"), cell: (m) => <Mono title={m.hash}>{m.hash.slice(0, 16)}…</Mono> },
    { key: "size", header: t("modules.size"), align: "right", sort: (m) => m.size, cell: (m) => fmtBytes(locale, m.size) },
    { key: "updated", header: t("modules.updated"), sort: (m) => m.updated_at, cell: (m) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{fmtDateTimeShort(locale, m.updated_at)}</span> },
    {
      key: "actions",
      header: "",
      align: "right",
      cell: (m) => (
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setDeleting(m)}>
          {t("common.delete")}
        </Button>
      ),
    },
  ];
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={t("modules.title")}
        description={t("modules.desc")}
        actions={
          <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
            <Upload className="size-3.5" /> {t("modules.upload")}
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <Card>
        <DataTable rows={list.data} columns={cols} rowKey={(m) => m.name} loading={list.isLoading} error={list.error} />
      </Card>
      <FormDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        title={t("modules.upload")}
        submitLabel={t("modules.upload")}
        disabled={!name.trim() || !file}
        onSubmit={async () => {
          if (!file) return;
          await put.mutateAsync({ name: name.trim(), file });
          setOpen(false);
          setName("");
          setFile(null);
        }}
      >
        <Field label={t("common.name")} htmlFor="mod-name" required>
          <Input id="mod-name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="arena" autoFocus />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t("modules.file")} htmlFor="mod-file" required>
          <Input id="mod-file" type="file" accept=".wasm,application/wasm" onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)} />
        </Field>
      </FormDialog>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={!!deleting}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleting(null)}
        title={t("common.delete")}
        description={deleting ? t("modules.delete.confirm", { name: deleting.name }) : ""}
        confirmLabel={t("common.delete")}
        variant="danger"
        onConfirm={async () => {
          if (deleting) await del.mutateAsync(deleting.name);
          setDeleting(null);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

export function ModulesPage() {
  return (
    <RequireScope scope="admin" projectKey>
      <ModulesBody />
    </RequireScope>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/pages/Nodes.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useState } from "react";

import type { NodeRow } from "@/api/client";
import { useNodes, useRegions, useSetNodeDraining } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort, fmtNumber, fmtPercent, fmtRelative } from "@/lib/format";
import { nodeStale } from "@/lib/rooms";
import { PageHeader } from "@/ui/Page";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { NodeStatsDialog } from "@/components/NodeStatsDialog";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Badge, Card, IdChip, Mono, Progress, Tip } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";
import { DataTable, type Column } from "@/ui/Table";

export function NodesPage() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const nodes = useNodes();
  const regions = useRegions();
  const { selectProject } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const setDraining = useSetNodeDraining();
  const [draining, setDrainingNode] = useState<NodeRow | null>(null);
  const [inspecting, setInspecting] = useState<NodeRow | null>(null);
  const cols: Column<NodeRow>[] = [
    {
      key: "host",
      header: t("nodes.host"),
      sort: (n) => n.public_host,
      cell: (n) => (
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <Mono>
            {n.public_host}:{n.quic_port}
          </Mono>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-fg-faint truncate">{n.http_url}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    { key: "id", header: "ID", cell: (n) => <IdChip id={n.id} /> },
    { key: "region", header: t("nodes.region"), sort: (n) => n.region, cell: (n) => n.region },
    { key: "version", header: t("nodes.version"), cell: (n) => <Mono>{n.version || "—"}</Mono> },
    {
      key: "rooms",
      header: t("nodes.rooms"),
      align: "right",
      sort: (n) => n.rooms,
      cell: (n) =>
        n.rooms > 0 ? (
          <Link to="/rooms" search={{ node: n.id }} className="tabular-nums underline-offset-2 hover:underline"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              selectProject(null);
            }}
          >
            {fmtNumber(locale, n.rooms)}
          </Link>
        ) : (
          fmtNumber(locale, n.rooms)
        ),
    },
    { key: "players", header: t("nodes.players"), align: "right", sort: (n) => n.players, cell: (n) => fmtNumber(locale, n.players) },
    {
      key: "load",
      header: t("nodes.load"),
      sort: (n) => n.load_factor,
      width: "140px",
      cell: (n) => (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Progress value={n.load_factor} max={1} tone={n.load_factor > 0.85 ? "danger" : n.load_factor > 0.6 ? "warn" : "ok"} className="w-16" />
          <span className="tabular-nums text-fg-muted text-xs">{fmtPercent(locale, n.load_factor)}</span>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "status",
      header: t("nodes.status"),
      cell: (n) => (n.draining ? <Badge tone="warn" dot>{t("nodes.status.draining")}</Badge> : nodeStale(n.last_heartbeat) ? <Badge tone="danger" dot>{t("nodes.status.stale")}</Badge> : <Badge tone="ok" dot>{t("nodes.status.live")}</Badge>),
    },
    {
      key: "hb",
      header: t("nodes.heartbeat"),
      sort: (n) => n.last_heartbeat,
      cell: (n) => (
        <Tip content={fmtDateTimeShort(locale, n.last_heartbeat)}>
          <span className="text-fg-muted">{n.last_heartbeat ? fmtRelative(locale, n.last_heartbeat) : "—"}</span>
        </Tip>
      ),
    },
    { key: "cert", header: t("nodes.cert"), cell: (n) => <Mono title={n.cert_sha256}>{n.cert_sha256.slice(0, 12)}…</Mono> },
    {
      key: "actions",
      header: "",
      align: "right",
      cell: (n) => (
        <span className="flex justify-end gap-1">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={nodeStale(n.last_heartbeat)} onClick={() => setInspecting(n)}>
            {t("nodes.stats")}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={nodeStale(n.last_heartbeat)} onClick={() => setDrainingNode(n)}>
            {n.draining ? t("nodes.undrain") : t("nodes.drain")}
          </Button>
        </span>
      ),
    },
  ];
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={t("nodes.title")} description={t("nodes.desc")} />
      {regions.data && regions.data.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          {regions.data.map((r) => (
            <Card key={r.id} className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="font-medium truncate">{r.display_name || r.id}</div>
                <Badge tone={r.nodes > 0 ? "ok" : "neutral"} dot>
                  {t("nodes.region.live", { n: r.nodes })}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 space-y-0.5">
                {r.endpoints.map((e) => (
                  <div key={e} className="text-[11px] text-fg-faint truncate font-mono">
                    {e}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <Card>
        <DataTable rows={nodes.data} columns={cols} rowKey={(n) => n.id} loading={nodes.isLoading} error={nodes.error} />
      </Card>
      <NodeStatsDialog node={inspecting} onClose={() => setInspecting(null)} />
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={draining !== null}
        onOpenChange={(o) => {
          if (!o) setDrainingNode(null);
        }}
        title={draining?.draining ? t("nodes.undrain") : t("nodes.drain")}
        description={draining ? (draining.draining ? t("nodes.undrain.confirm", { host: `${draining.public_host}:${draining.quic_port}` }) : t("nodes.drain.confirm", { host: `${draining.public_host}:${draining.quic_port}`, n: draining.rooms })) : ""}
        confirmLabel={draining?.draining ? t("nodes.undrain") : t("nodes.drain")}
        variant={draining?.draining ? "primary" : "danger"}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          if (!draining) return;
          const r = await setDraining.mutateAsync({ nodeId: draining.id, draining: !draining.draining });
          toast.ok(r.draining ? t("nodes.drain.done", { n: r.rooms_handed_off }) : t("nodes.undrain.done"));
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/pages/Overview.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";

import type { NodeRow } from "@/api/client";
import { useAttention, useHealth, useNodes, useRooms, useUsage } from "@/api/hooks";
import { AttentionPanel } from "@/components/AttentionPanel";
import { ChartCard, TimeSeriesChart, type SeriesDef } from "@/components/charts";
import { presetRange } from "@/components/RangePicker";
import { toPoints } from "@/pages/Usage";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDuration, fmtNumber } from "@/lib/format";
import { modeTone, nodeStale } from "@/lib/rooms";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { PageHeader, QueryError, Section } from "@/ui/Page";
import { Badge, Card, CardHeader, EmptyState, IdChip, Mono, Skeleton, Stat } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable, type Column } from "@/ui/Table";

export function OverviewPage() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const { operator, projectId } = useAuth();
  const health = useHealth();
  const nodes = useNodes();
  const rooms = useRooms();
  const h = health.data;
  const attention = useAttention();
  const live = (nodes.data ?? []).filter((n) => !nodeStale(n.last_heartbeat) || !operator);
  const players = (rooms.data ?? []).reduce((a, r) => a + r.players, 0);
  const day = useMemo(() => presetRange("24h"), []);
  const usage = useUsage(day.from, day.to);
  const usagePoints = useMemo(() => toPoints(usage.data), [usage.data]);
  const usageSeries: SeriesDef[] = [
    { key: "player_minutes", label: t("usage.player_minutes"), color: "var(--fg)", area: true },
    { key: "room_minutes", label: t("usage.room_minutes"), color: "var(--accent)" },
  ];

  const nodeCols: Column<NodeRow>[] = [
    { key: "id", header: t("nodes.host"), cell: (n) => <Mono>{n.public_host}</Mono> },
    { key: "region", header: t("nodes.region"), cell: (n) => n.region },
    { key: "rooms", header: t("nodes.rooms"), align: "right", cell: (n) => fmtNumber(locale, n.rooms) },
    { key: "players", header: t("nodes.players"), align: "right", cell: (n) => fmtNumber(locale, n.players) },
    {
      key: "status",
      header: t("nodes.status"),
      cell: (n) => (n.draining ? <Badge tone="warn" dot>{t("nodes.status.draining")}</Badge> : nodeStale(n.last_heartbeat) ? <Badge tone="danger" dot>{t("nodes.status.stale")}</Badge> : <Badge tone="ok" dot>{t("nodes.status.live")}</Badge>),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={t("overview.title")} description={t("overview.desc")} />
      {operator ? <div className="mb-5"><AttentionPanel data={attention.data} loading={attention.isLoading} /></div> : null}
      {health.isError ? <QueryError error={health.error} onRetry={() => void health.refetch()} /> : null}
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 mb-6">
        <Stat label={t("overview.node")} value={h ? <span className="flex items-center gap-2">{h.draining ? <Badge tone="warn" dot>{t("overview.draining")}</Badge> : <Badge tone="ok" dot>{t("overview.ready")}</Badge>}</span> : <Skeleton className="h-6 w-20" />} hint={h ? <IdChip id={h.node_id} /> : null} />
        <Stat label={t("overview.region")} value={h ? <Mono>{h.region}</Mono> : <Skeleton className="h-6 w-16" />} hint={h ? `${t("overview.version")} ${h.version}` : null} />
        <Stat label={operator && !projectId ? t("overview.liveRooms") : t("overview.rooms")} value={rooms.data ? fmtNumber(locale, rooms.data.length) : <Skeleton className="h-6 w-10" />} hint={h ? `${t("overview.node")}: ${fmtNumber(locale, h.rooms)}` : null} />
        <Stat label={t("overview.players")} value={rooms.data ? fmtNumber(locale, players) : <Skeleton className="h-6 w-10" />} hint={h ? `${t("overview.uptime")} ${fmtDuration(locale, h.uptime_secs)}` : null} />
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,3fr)_minmax(0,2fr)]">
        <Section
          title={t("overview.nodes")}
          actions={
            <Link to="/nodes">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                {t("nav.nodes")} <ArrowRight className="size-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </Link>
          }
        >
          <Card>
            <DataTable rows={live} columns={nodeCols} rowKey={(n) => n.id} loading={nodes.isLoading} error={nodes.error} dense skeletonRows={3} />
          </Card>
        </Section>
        <Section
          title={t("overview.liveRooms")}
          actions={
            <Link to="/rooms">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                {t("nav.rooms")} <ArrowRight className="size-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </Link>
          }
        >
          <Card>
            <CardHeader title={t("rooms.title")} description={`${fmtNumber(locale, rooms.data?.length ?? 0)} · ${fmtNumber(locale, players)} ${t("overview.players").toLowerCase()}`} />
            {rooms.data && rooms.data.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState compact title={t("rooms.empty")} description={t("rooms.empty.desc")} />
            ) : (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
                {(rooms.data ?? []).slice(0, 8).map((r) => (
                  <li key={r.room} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-[13px]">
                    <Badge tone={modeTone(r.mode)}>{r.mode}</Badge>
                    <Link to="/rooms/$roomId" params={{ roomId: r.room }} className="font-medium truncate hover:underline">
                      {r.name || r.room}
                    </Link>
                    <span className="ml-auto text-fg-muted tabular-nums">
                      {r.players}/{r.max_players}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </Card>
        </Section>
        <ChartCard title={t("overview.usage24h")} description={t("usage.desc")} series={usageSeries} query={usage}>
          <TimeSeriesChart data={usagePoints} series={usageSeries} height={180} />
        </ChartCard>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
const LIMIT_KEYS = ["max_rooms", "max_players_per_room", "max_events_per_sec_per_room", "max_events_per_sec_per_player", "max_event_bytes", "max_concurrent_players", "monthly_player_minutes", "monthly_bytes"] as const;

function initialDraft(limits: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, string> {
  const next: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const k of LIMIT_KEYS) {
    const v = limits[k];
    next[k] = typeof v === "number" ? String(v) : "";
  }
  const regions = limits.allowed_regions;
  next.allowed_regions = Array.isArray(regions) ? regions.map(String).join(", ") : "";
  return next;
}

function LimitsForm({ projectId, limits, effective }: { projectId: string; limits: Record<string, unknown>; effective: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const toast = useToast();
  const setLimits = useSetLimits(projectId);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(() => initialDraft(limits ?? {}));
  async function save() {
    const body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const k of LIMIT_KEYS) {
      const v = draft[k]?.trim();
      if (v) body[k] = Number(v);
    }
    const regions = draft.allowed_regions
      ?.split(",")
      .map((s) => s.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
    if (regions?.length) body.allowed_regions = regions;
    await setLimits.mutateAsync(body);
    toast.ok(t("common.save"));
  }
  const fallback = (k: string) => {
    const v = effective[k];
    return typeof v === "number" || typeof v === "string" ? String(v) : "—";
  };
  return (
    <Card className="p-4 space-y-3">
      <p className="text-xs text-fg-muted">{t("projects.limits.desc")}</p>
      {LIMIT_KEYS.map((k) => (
        <Field key={k} label={t(`projects.limit.${k}`)} htmlFor={`lim-${k}`} hint={`${t("common.unlimited").toLowerCase()} → ${fallback(k)}`}>
          <Input id={`lim-${k}`} type="number" min={0} value={draft[k] ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setDraft((cur) => ({ ...cur, [k]: e.target.value }))} />
        </Field>
      ))}
      <Field label={t("projects.limit.allowed_regions")} htmlFor="lim-regions">
        <Input id="lim-regions" value={draft.allowed_regions ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setDraft((cur) => ({ ...cur, allowed_regions: e.target.value }))} placeholder="eu, us" />
      </Field>
      <Button onClick={() => void save()} loading={setLimits.isPending} className="w-full">
        {t("projects.limits.save")}
      </Button>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import type { NewKey, Project } from "@/api/client";
import { useCreateProject, useProjects } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort } from "@/lib/format";
import { RequireOperator } from "@/shell/Guards";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { Dialog, FormDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Input } from "@/ui/Input";

import { Badge, Callout, Card, CodeBlock, Field, IdChip } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable, type Column } from "@/ui/Table";

function ProjectsBody() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const list = useProjects();
  const create = useCreateProject();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState("self_hosted");
  const [created, setCreated] = useState<{ project: Project; key: NewKey } | null>(null);
  const cols: Column<Project>[] = [
    { key: "name", header: t("common.name"), sort: (p) => p.name, cell: (p) => <span className="font-medium">{p.name}</span> },
    { key: "id", header: "ID", cell: (p) => <IdChip id={p.id} /> },
    { key: "plan", header: t("projects.plan"), cell: (p) => <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Badge>{p.plan}</Badge>{p.disabled_at ? <Badge tone="warn">{t("projects.suspended")}</Badge> : null}</span> },
    { key: "limits", header: t("projects.limits"), cell: (p) => <span className="text-fg-muted text-xs">{Object.keys(p.limits ?? {}).length ? Object.entries(p.limits).map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${String(v)}`).join(" · ") : t("common.unlimited")}</span> },
    { key: "created", header: t("common.created"), sort: (p) => p.created_at, cell: (p) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{fmtDateTimeShort(locale, p.created_at)}</span> },
  ];
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={t("projects.title")}
        description={t("projects.desc")}
        actions={
          <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
            <Plus className="size-3.5" /> {t("projects.new")}
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <Card>
        <DataTable rows={list.data} columns={cols} rowKey={(p) => p.id} loading={list.isLoading} error={list.error} onRowClick={(p) => void navigate({ to: "/projects/$projectId", params: { projectId: p.id } })} />
      </Card>
      <FormDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        title={t("projects.new")}
        submitLabel={t("common.create")}
        disabled={!name.trim()}
        onSubmit={async () => {
          const r = await create.mutateAsync({ name: name.trim(), plan: plan.trim() || undefined });
          setOpen(false);
          setName("");
          setCreated(r);
        }}
      >
        <Field label={t("common.name")} htmlFor="pr-name" required>
          <Input id="pr-name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} autoFocus />
        </Field>

          <Input id="pr-plan" value={plan} onChange={(e) => setPlan(e.target.value)} />
        </Field>
      </FormDialog>
      <Dialog
        open={!!created}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setCreated(null)}
        title={created?.project.name ?? ""}
        description={t("projects.created")}
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setCreated(null)}>
              {t("common.close")}
            </Button>
            {created ? (
              <Button

                  setCreated(null);
                  void navigate({ to: "/projects/$projectId", params: { projectId: id } });
                }}
              >
                {t("projects.open")}
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </>
        }
      >
        <Callout tone="warn">{t("keys.created")}</Callout>
        {created ? <CodeBlock value={created.key.key} className="mt-3" /> : null}
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useRoomDesyncs } from "../api/hooks";
import { Link, useParams } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { ArrowLeft, Download, Megaphone } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import type { RoomDetail } from "@/api/client";
import { useAddBan, useKickPlayer, useRoom } from "@/api/hooks";
import { NoticeDialog } from "@/components/NoticeDialog";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort } from "@/lib/format";
import { modeTone } from "@/lib/rooms";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Input } from "@/ui/Input";
import { Loading, PageHeader, QueryError, Section, SplitLayout } from "@/ui/Page";
import { Badge, Callout, Card, CodeBlock, IdChip, KV, Mono } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable } from "@/ui/Table";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";

export function RoomDetailPage() {
  const { roomId } = useParams({ from: "/shell/rooms/$roomId" });
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const { token, operator } = useAuth();
  const q = useRoom(roomId);
  const toast = useToast();
  const kick = useKickPlayer(roomId);
  const [kicking, setKicking] = useState<RoomDetail["players"][number] | null>(null);
  const [kickReason, setKickReason] = useState("");
  const [alsoBan, setAlsoBan] = useState(false);
  const [noticing, setNoticing] = useState(false);
  const addBan = useAddBan(operator ? (q.data?.room.project_id ?? undefined) : undefined);
  const dz = useRoomDesyncs(roomId, q.data?.room.mode === "lockstep");
  if (q.isLoading) return <Loading />;
  if (q.isError) return <QueryError error={q.error} onRetry={() => void q.refetch()} />;
  const d = q.data!;
  const room = d.room;
  const live = d.live;

  async function downloadDump(tick: number, actor: number) {
    const res = await fetch(operator ? `/v1/operator/rooms/${roomId}/desyncs/${tick}/${actor}` : `/v1/rooms/${roomId}/desyncs/${tick}/${actor}`, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(await res.blob());
    a.download = `${room.name || room.id}.desync-${tick}-${actor}.bin`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }

  async function downloadReplay() {
    const res = await fetch(operator ? `/v1/operator/rooms/${roomId}/replay` : `/v1/rooms/${roomId}/replay`, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `${room.name || room.id}.replay.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={
          <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Link to="/rooms" className="text-fg-muted hover:text-fg">
              <ArrowLeft className="size-4" />
            </Link>
            {room.name || t("rooms.detail.title")}
            <Badge tone={modeTone(room.mode)}>{room.mode}</Badge>
            <Badge tone={room.state === "open" ? "ok" : room.state === "orphaned" ? "warn" : "neutral"}>{room.state}</Badge>
          </span>
        }
        description={<IdChip id={room.id} short={36} />}
        actions={
          <span className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => setNoticing(true)}>
              <Megaphone className="size-3.5" /> {t("notice.title")}
            </Button>
            {room.mode === "lockstep" ? (
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => void downloadReplay()}>
                <Download className="size-3.5" /> {t("rooms.detail.replay")}
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </span>
        }
      />
      <NoticeDialog open={noticing} onOpenChange={setNoticing} roomId={room.id} />
      <SplitLayout
        main={
          <>
            {!live ? <Callout tone="warn">{t("rooms.detail.noLive")}</Callout> : null}
            {d.players_source === "unavailable" ? <Callout tone="warn">{t("rooms.detail.playersUnavailable")}</Callout> : null}
            <Section title={t("rooms.detail.players")}>
              <Card>
                <DataTable
                  rows={d.players}
                  rowKey={(p) => String(p.actor)}
                  dense
                  columns={[
                    { key: "actor", header: t("rooms.actor"), cell: (p) => <Mono>{p.actor}</Mono>, width: "80px" },
                    { key: "name", header: t("common.name"), cell: (p) => p.name || "—" },
                    { key: "pid", header: t("rooms.playerId"), cell: (p) => <Mono>{p.player_id}</Mono> },
                    { key: "online", header: t("rooms.state"), cell: (p) => <Badge tone={p.online ? "ok" : "neutral"} dot>{p.online ? t("rooms.online") : t("rooms.offline")}</Badge> },
                    { key: "eps", header: t("rooms.eps"), cell: (p) => <span className="tabular">{p.eps === undefined ? "—" : p.eps.toFixed(1)}</span>, width: "90px" },
                    { key: "events", header: t("rooms.events"), cell: (p) => <span className="tabular text-fg-muted">{p.events === undefined ? "—" : `${p.events.toLocaleString()} · ${((p.bytes_in ?? 0) / 1024).toFixed(1)} KiB`}</span> },
                    { key: "idle", header: t("rooms.idle"), cell: (p) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{p.idle_secs === undefined ? "—" : p.idle_secs === null ? t("rooms.idle.never") : t("rooms.idle.secs", { s: Math.round(p.idle_secs) })}</span>, width: "100px" },
                    { key: "rtt", header: t("rooms.rtt"), cell: (p) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{p.rtt_ms == null ? "—" : `${p.rtt_ms < 10 ? p.rtt_ms.toFixed(1) : Math.round(p.rtt_ms)} ms`}</span>, width: "90px" },
                    {
                      key: "actions",
                      header: "",
                      align: "right",
                      cell: (p) => (
                        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={!live} onClick={() => setKicking(p)}>
                          {t("rooms.kick")}
                        </Button>
                      ),
                    },
                  ]}
                />
              </Card>
            </Section>
            {room.mode === "lockstep" ? (
              <Section title={t("rooms.detail.desyncs")}>
                <Card>
                  <p className="px-3 pt-2 text-xs text-fg-muted">{t("rooms.detail.desyncs.hint")}</p>
                  <DataTable
                    rows={dz.data?.desyncs}
                    rowKey={(x) => `${x.tick}:${x.actor}`}
                    dense
                    loading={dz.isLoading}
                    error={dz.error}
                    empty={<span className="block px-3 py-6 text-center text-sm text-fg-muted" data-testid="desyncs-empty">{t("rooms.detail.desyncs.empty")}</span>}
                    columns={[
                      { key: "tick", header: t("rooms.desync.tick"), cell: (x) => <Mono>{x.tick}</Mono>, width: "100px" },
                      { key: "actor", header: t("rooms.actor"), cell: (x) => <Mono>{x.actor}</Mono>, width: "80px" },
                      { key: "hash", header: t("rooms.desync.hash"), cell: (x) => <Mono>{x.hash}</Mono> },
                      { key: "bytes", header: t("rooms.desync.bytes"), align: "right", cell: (x) => <span className="tabular">{x.bytes}</span>, width: "90px" },
                      { key: "at", header: t("rooms.desync.at"), cell: (x) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{new Date(x.at).toLocaleTimeString()}</span> },
                      { key: "dl", header: "", align: "right", cell: (x) => <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => void downloadDump(x.tick, x.actor)}><Download className="size-3.5" /></Button> },
                    ]}
                  />
                </Card>
              </Section>
            ) : null}
            <ConfirmDialog
              open={kicking !== null}
              onOpenChange={(o) => {
                if (!o) {
                  setKicking(null);
                  setKickReason("");
                  setAlsoBan(false);
                }
              }}
              title={t("rooms.kick")}
              description={kicking ? t("rooms.kick.confirm", { name: kicking.name || kicking.player_id, actor: kicking.actor }) : ""}
              confirmLabel={t("rooms.kick")}
              variant="danger"
              onConfirm={async () => {
                if (!kicking) return;
                if (alsoBan) await addBan.mutateAsync({ player_id: kicking.player_id, reason: kickReason.trim() || undefined });
                await kick.mutateAsync({ actor: kicking.actor, reason: kickReason.trim() || undefined });
                toast.ok(t("rooms.kick.done", { name: kicking.name || kicking.player_id }));
              }}
            >
              <Input aria-label={t("rooms.kick.reason")} placeholder={t("rooms.kick.reason")} value={kickReason} maxLength={64} onChange={(e) => setKickReason(e.target.value)} />
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                <input type="checkbox" className="size-4 accent-fg" checked={alsoBan} onChange={(e) => setAlsoBan(e.target.checked)} />
                {t("rooms.kick.ban")}
              </label>
            </ConfirmDialog>
            <Section title={t("rooms.detail.props")}>
              <CodeBlock value={JSON.stringify(live?.props ?? room.props, null, 2)} />
            </Section>
          </>
        }
        side={
          <Card className="p-4">
            <KV
              cols={1}
              items={[
                { k: t("rooms.node"), v: room.node_id ? <IdChip id={room.node_id} /> : "—" },
                { k: t("overview.region"), v: room.region },
                { k: t("rooms.players"), v: live ? `${live.players} / ${live.max_players}` : `— / ${room.max_players}` },
                { k: t("rooms.visible"), v: room.visible ? t("common.yes") : t("common.no") },
                { k: t("rooms.schema"), v: room.schema_hash ? <Mono>{room.schema_hash.slice(0, 16)}</Mono> : "—" },
                { k: t("common.created"), v: fmtDateTimeShort(locale, room.created_at) },
                { k: t("rooms.closed"), v: room.closed_at ? fmtDateTimeShort(locale, room.closed_at) : "—" },
              ]}
            />
          </Card>
        }
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/pages/Rooms.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useNavigate, useSearch } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { DoorOpen } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import type { LiveRoom } from "@/api/client";
import { useCloseRoom, useNodes, useRooms } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtNumber } from "@/lib/format";
import { modeTone } from "@/lib/rooms";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Input, NativeSelect } from "@/ui/Input";
import { PageHeader, Toolbar } from "@/ui/Page";
import { Badge, Card, EmptyState, IdChip } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable, type Column } from "@/ui/Table";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";

export function RoomsPage() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const { operator, can, projectId } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const rooms = useRooms();
  const nodes = useNodes();
  const close = useCloseRoom();
  const search = useSearch({ strict: false });
  const setFilter = (patch: Partial<typeof search>) => void navigate({ to: "/rooms", search: { ...search, ...patch }, replace: true });
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [closing, setClosing] = useState<LiveRoom | null>(null);
  const canClose = operator || can("rooms");

  const all = rooms.data ?? [];
  const modes = [...new Set(all.map((r) => r.mode))].sort();
  const nodeIds = [...new Set(all.map((r) => r.node))].sort();
  const nodeLabel = (id: string) => {
    const n = (nodes.data ?? []).find((x) => x.id === id);
    return n ? `${n.public_host}:${n.quic_port} · ${n.region}` : `${id.slice(0, 8)}…`;
  };
  const rows = all.filter(
    (r) =>
      (!q || r.name.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()) || r.room.startsWith(q) || r.mode === q) &&
      (!search.node || r.node === search.node) &&
      (!search.mode || r.mode === search.mode) &&
      (!search.state || (search.state === "open" ? r.open : search.state === "closed" ? !r.open : search.state === "hidden" ? !r.visible : true)),
  );
  const filtered = !!(search.node || search.mode || search.state);
  const cols: Column<LiveRoom>[] = [
    {
      key: "name",
      header: t("common.name"),
      sort: (r) => r.name,
      cell: (r) => (
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="font-medium truncate">{r.name || "—"}</div>
          <IdChip id={r.room} />
        </div>
      ),
    },
    { key: "mode", header: t("rooms.mode"), sort: (r) => r.mode, cell: (r) => <Badge tone={modeTone(r.mode)}>{r.mode}</Badge> },
    {
      key: "players",
      header: t("rooms.players"),
      align: "right",
      sort: (r) => r.players,
      cell: (r) => (
        <span className="tabular-nums">
          {fmtNumber(locale, r.players)} / {fmtNumber(locale, r.max_players)}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    { key: "node", header: t("rooms.node"), cell: (r) => <IdChip id={r.node} /> },
    ...(operator && !projectId ? [{ key: "project", header: t("rooms.project"), cell: (r: LiveRoom) => (r.project_name ? r.project_name : r.project_id ? <IdChip id={r.project_id} /> : "—") } satisfies Column<LiveRoom>] : []),
    {
      key: "state",
      header: t("rooms.state"),
      cell: (r) => (
        <span className="flex gap-1">
          <Badge tone={r.open ? "ok" : "neutral"}>{r.open ? t("rooms.open") : t("rooms.closed")}</Badge>
          {!r.visible ? <Badge>{t("rooms.hidden")}</Badge> : null}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    ...(canClose
      ? [
          {
            key: "actions",
            header: "",
            align: "right",
            cell: (r: LiveRoom) => (
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  setClosing(r);
                }}
              >
                {t("rooms.close")}
              </Button>
            ),
          } satisfies Column<LiveRoom>,
        ]
      : []),
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={t("rooms.title")} description={t("rooms.desc")} />
      <Card>
        <Toolbar end={<span className="text-xs text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{t("common.total")}: {fmtNumber(locale, rows.length)}</span>}>
          <Input placeholder={t("common.search")} value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} className="w-56" />
          <NativeSelect aria-label={t("rooms.mode")} value={search.mode ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setFilter({ mode: e.target.value || undefined })} className="w-36">
            <option value="">{t("rooms.filter.anyMode")}</option>
            {modes.map((m) => (
              <option key={m} value={m}>
                {m}
              </option>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
          <NativeSelect aria-label={t("rooms.state")} value={search.state ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setFilter({ state: e.target.value || undefined })} className="w-36">
            <option value="">{t("rooms.filter.anyState")}</option>
            <option value="open">{t("rooms.open")}</option>
            <option value="closed">{t("rooms.closed")}</option>
            <option value="hidden">{t("rooms.hidden")}</option>
          </NativeSelect>
          <NativeSelect aria-label={t("rooms.node")} value={search.node ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setFilter({ node: e.target.value || undefined })} className="w-60">
            <option value="">{t("rooms.filter.anyNode")}</option>
            {[...new Set([...nodeIds, ...(search.node ? [search.node] : [])])].map((id) => (
              <option key={id} value={id}>
                {nodeLabel(id)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
          {filtered ? (
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => void navigate({ to: "/rooms", search: {}, replace: true })}>
              {t("rooms.filter.clear")}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </Toolbar>
        <DataTable
          rows={rows}
          columns={cols}
          rowKey={(r) => r.room}
          loading={rooms.isLoading}
          error={rooms.error}
          onRowClick={(r) => void navigate({ to: "/rooms/$roomId", params: { roomId: r.room } })}
          empty={<EmptyState compact icon={<DoorOpen className="size-5" />} title={t("rooms.empty")} description={t("rooms.empty.desc")} />}
        />
      </Card>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={!!closing}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setClosing(null)}
        title={t("rooms.close")}
        description={closing ? t("rooms.close.confirm", { name: closing.name || closing.room }) : ""}
        confirmLabel={t("rooms.close")}
        variant="danger"
        onConfirm={async () => {
          if (!closing) return;
          await close.mutateAsync(closing.room);
          toast.ok(t("rooms.closed.toast"));
          setClosing(null);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/pages/Settings.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import type { NewOperatorToken, OperatorToken, OperatorWebhook } from "@/api/client";
import { useAlertWebhooks, useCreateAlertWebhook, useCreateOperatorToken, useDeleteAlertWebhook, useOperatorTokens, useRevokeOperatorToken } from "@/api/hooks";
import { WebhookDeliveriesDialog } from "@/components/WebhookDeliveries";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtDateTimeShort, fmtRelative } from "@/lib/format";
import { RequireOperator } from "@/shell/Guards";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { ConfirmDialog, Dialog, FormDialog } from "@/ui/Dialog";
import { Checkbox, Input, NativeSelect } from "@/ui/Input";
import { PageHeader } from "@/ui/Page";
import { Badge, Callout, Card, CardHeader, CodeBlock, Field, Mono } from "@/ui/Primitives";
import { DataTable, type Column } from "@/ui/Table";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";

const EXPIRIES = [0, 30, 90, 365] as const;

function TokensCard() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const toast = useToast();
  const list = useOperatorTokens();
  const create = useCreateOperatorToken();
  const revoke = useRevokeOperatorToken();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [expiryDays, setExpiryDays] = useState(0);
  const [cidrs, setCidrs] = useState("");
  const [created, setCreated] = useState<NewOperatorToken | null>(null);
  const [revoking, setRevoking] = useState<OperatorToken | null>(null);
  const cols: Column<OperatorToken>[] = [
    { key: "name", header: t("common.name"), cell: (x) => <span className="font-medium">{x.name}</span> },
    { key: "prefix", header: t("keys.prefix"), cell: (x) => <Mono>an_{x.prefix}…</Mono> },
    { key: "by", header: t("audit.actor"), cell: (x) => <Mono>{x.created_by}</Mono> },
    { key: "created", header: t("common.created"), cell: (x) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{fmtDateTimeShort(locale, x.created_at)}</span> },
    { key: "used", header: t("keys.lastUsed"), cell: (x) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{x.last_used_at ? fmtRelative(locale, x.last_used_at) : "—"}{x.last_used_ip ? <Mono className="ml-1.5">{x.last_used_ip}</Mono> : null}</span> },
    { key: "cidrs", header: t("keys.cidrs"), cell: (x) => (x.allowed_cidrs?.length ? <span title={x.allowed_cidrs.join(", ")}><Badge>{t("keys.cidrs.n", { n: x.allowed_cidrs.length })}</Badge></span> : <span className="text-fg-muted">{t("keys.cidrs.any")}</span>) },
    { key: "expires", header: t("keys.expires"), cell: (x) => <span className="text-fg-muted">{x.expires_at ? fmtDateTimeShort(locale, x.expires_at) : t("keys.expires.never")}</span> },
    {
      key: "state",
      header: t("rooms.state"),
      cell: (x) =>
        x.revoked_at ? <Badge tone="danger">{t("keys.revoked")}</Badge> : x.expires_at && Date.parse(x.expires_at) < Date.now() ? <Badge tone="warn">{t("keys.expired")}</Badge> : <Badge tone="ok" dot>{t("rooms.open")}</Badge>,
    },
    {
      key: "actions",
      header: "",
      align: "right",
      cell: (x) =>
        x.revoked_at ? null : (
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setRevoking(x)}>
            {t("keys.revoke")}
          </Button>
        ),
    },
  ];
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={t("settings.tokens")}
        description={t("settings.tokens.desc")}
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
            <Plus className="size-3.5" /> {t("settings.tokens.new")}
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <DataTable rows={list.data} columns={cols} rowKey={(x) => x.id} loading={list.isLoading} error={list.error} dense empty={<span className="block px-3 py-6 text-center text-sm text-fg-muted">{t("settings.tokens.empty")}</span>} />
      <FormDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={(o) => {
          setOpen(o);
          if (!o) setName("");
        }}
        title={t("settings.tokens.new")}
        description={t("settings.tokens.new.desc")}
        submitLabel={t("common.create")}
        disabled={!name.trim()}
        onSubmit={async () => {
          const cidrList = cidrs
            .split(",")
            .map((c) => c.trim())
            .filter(Boolean);
          const r = await create.mutateAsync({ name: name.trim(), expires_in_secs: expiryDays ? expiryDays * 86_400 : undefined, allowed_cidrs: cidrList.length ? cidrList : undefined });
          setOpen(false);
          setName("");
          setCidrs("");
          setCreated(r);
        }}
      >
        <Field label={t("common.name")} htmlFor="op-token-name" required>
          <Input id="op-token-name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} autoFocus maxLength={64} />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t("keys.cidrs")} htmlFor="op-token-cidrs" hint={t("settings.tokens.cidrs.hint")}>
          <Input id="op-token-cidrs" value={cidrs} onChange={(e) => setCidrs(e.target.value)} placeholder="203.0.113.0/24, 2001:db8::/32" />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t("keys.expires")} htmlFor="op-token-expiry">
          <NativeSelect id="op-token-expiry" value={String(expiryDays)} onChange={(e) => setExpiryDays(Number(e.target.value))}>
            {EXPIRIES.map((d) => (
              <option key={d} value={d}>
                {d === 0 ? t("keys.expires.never") : t("keys.expires.days", { d })}
              </option>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>
      </FormDialog>
      <Dialog open={!!created} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setCreated(null)} title={t("settings.tokens.new")} footer={<Button onClick={() => setCreated(null)}>{t("common.close")}</Button>}>
        <Callout tone="warn">{t("settings.tokens.created")}</Callout>
        {created ? <CodeBlock value={created.token} className="mt-3" /> : null}
      </Dialog>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={!!revoking}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setRevoking(null)}
        title={t("keys.revoke")}
        description={revoking ? t("settings.tokens.revoke.confirm", { name: revoking.name }) : null}
        confirmLabel={t("keys.revoke")}
        variant="danger"
        onConfirm={async () => {
          if (!revoking) return;
          try {
            await revoke.mutateAsync(revoking.id);
            toast.ok(t("settings.tokens.revoked", { name: revoking.name }));
          } catch (err) {
            toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
          }
          setRevoking(null);
        }}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}

const ALERT_EVENTS = ["node.stale", "node.draining", "project.suspended", "project.usage_cap", "project.rejections", "webhook.failing"] as const;

          }
        }}
        title={t("settings.alerts.new")}
        description={t("settings.alerts.new.desc")}
        submitLabel={t("common.create")}
        disabled={!url.trim()}
        onSubmit={async () => {
          const w = await create.mutateAsync({ url: url.trim(), events });
          setCreated(w);
        }}
      >
        <Field label="URL" htmlFor="alert-url" required>
          <Input id="alert-url" value={url} onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)} placeholder="https://hooks.example.com/aurix" autoFocus />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t("webhooks.events")} hint={t("settings.alerts.events.hint")}>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            {ALERT_EVENTS.map((e) => (
              <Checkbox key={e} label={e} checked={events.includes(e)} onChange={(ev) => setEvents((cur) => (ev.target.checked ? [...cur, e] : cur.filter((x) => x !== e)))} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </Field>
      </FormDialog>
      <Dialog open={!!created} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setCreated(null)} title={t("settings.alerts.new")} footer={<Button onClick={() => setCreated(null)}>{t("common.close")}</Button>}>
        <Callout tone="warn">{t("webhooks.secret")}</Callout>
        {created?.secret && <CodeBlock value={created.secret} className="mt-3" />}
      </Dialog>
      <WebhookDeliveriesDialog webhook={inspecting} fleet onClose={() => setInspecting(null)} />
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={!!deleting}
        onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleting(null)}
        title={t("common.delete")}
        description={deleting ? t("settings.alerts.delete.confirm", { url: deleting.url }) : ""}
        confirmLabel={t("common.delete")}
        variant="danger"
        onConfirm={async () => {
          if (!deleting) return;
          await remove.mutateAsync(deleting.id);
          toast.ok(t("common.delete"));
        }}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}

export function SettingsPage() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  return (
    <RequireOperator>
      <PageHeader title={t("settings.title")} description={t("settings.desc")} />
      <TokensCard />
        <AlertsCard />
    </RequireOperator>
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/pages/Usage.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Download } from "lucide-react";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";

import { baseUrl, type Usage as UsageData } from "@/api/client";
import { useRejections, useUsage } from "@/api/hooks";
import { ChartCard, TimeSeriesChart, type Point, type SeriesDef } from "@/components/charts";
import { RangePicker, useRange } from "@/components/RangePicker";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { fmtBytes, fmtNumber } from "@/lib/format";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { RequireScope } from "@/shell/Guards";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { PageHeader } from "@/ui/Page";
import { useToast } from "@/ui/Toast";
import { BillingCard } from "@/components/BillingCard";
import { RejectionsCard } from "@/components/RejectionsCard";
import { Stat } from "@/ui/Primitives";

type Metric = "room_minutes" | "player_minutes" | "bytes_in" | "bytes_out";

export function toPoints(u: UsageData | undefined): Point[] {
  if (!u) return [];
  const byHour = new Map<number, Point>();
  for (const r of u.usage) {
    const t = Date.parse(r.hour);
    const p = byHour.get(t) ?? { t };
    p[r.metric] = (p[r.metric] ?? 0) + r.quantity;
    byHour.set(t, p);
  }
  return [...byHour.values()].sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
}

export function totals(u: UsageData | undefined): Record<Metric, number> {
  const out: Record<Metric, number> = { room_minutes: 0, player_minutes: 0, bytes_in: 0, bytes_out: 0 };
  for (const r of u?.usage ?? []) if (r.metric in out) out[r.metric as Metric] += r.quantity;
  return out;
}

function UsageBody() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const [range, setRange] = useRange("7d");
  const { operator, projectId, token } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  const q = useUsage(range.from, range.to);
  async function exportCsv() {
    const path = operator ? (projectId ? `/v1/operator/projects/${projectId}/usage` : "/v1/operator/usage") : "/v1/usage";
    const url = new URL(path, baseUrl());
    url.searchParams.set("from", range.from);
    url.searchParams.set("to", range.to);
    url.searchParams.set("format", "csv");
    setExporting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { headers: token ? { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : undefined });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const name = /filename="([^"]+)"/.exec(res.headers.get("content-disposition") ?? "")?.[1] ?? "usage.csv";
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = name;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
    } finally {
      setExporting(false);
    }
  }
  const rejections = useRejections(24);
  const points = useMemo(() => toPoints(q.data), [q.data]);
  const sum = useMemo(() => totals(q.data), [q.data]);
  const minutes: SeriesDef[] = [
    { key: "room_minutes", label: t("usage.room_minutes"), color: "var(--fg)", area: true },
    { key: "player_minutes", label: t("usage.player_minutes"), color: "var(--accent)" },
  ];
  const bytes: SeriesDef[] = [
    { key: "bytes_in", label: t("usage.bytes_in"), color: "var(--fg)", format: (v) => fmtBytes(locale, v) },
    { key: "bytes_out", label: t("usage.bytes_out"), color: "var(--accent)", format: (v) => fmtBytes(locale, v) },
  ];
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={operator && !projectId ? t("usage.fleetTitle") : t("usage.title")} description={t("usage.desc")} actions={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RangePicker value={range} onChange={setRange} />
            <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={exporting} onClick={() => void exportCsv()}>
              <Download className="size-4" />
              {t("usage.export")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      />
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 mb-5">
        <Stat label={t("usage.room_minutes")} value={fmtNumber(locale, Math.round(sum.room_minutes))} hint={t("usage.total")} />
        <Stat label={t("usage.player_minutes")} value={fmtNumber(locale, Math.round(sum.player_minutes))} hint={t("usage.total")} />
        <Stat label={t("usage.bytes_in")} value={fmtBytes(locale, sum.bytes_in)} hint={t("usage.total")} />
        <Stat label={t("usage.bytes_out")} value={fmtBytes(locale, sum.bytes_out)} hint={t("usage.total")} />
      </div>
      {!operator || projectId ? (
        <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_360px] mb-5">
          <div />
          <RejectionsCard data={rejections.data} loading={rejections.isLoading} />
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {operator && !projectId ? (
        <div className="mb-5">
          <BillingCard />
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <ChartCard title={`${t("usage.room_minutes")} · ${t("usage.player_minutes")}`} description={t("usage.desc")} series={minutes} query={q}>
          <TimeSeriesChart data={points} series={minutes} empty={t("common.empty")} />
        </ChartCard>
        <ChartCard title={`${t("usage.bytes_in")} · ${t("usage.bytes_out")}`} description={t("usage.desc")} series={bytes} query={q}>
          <TimeSeriesChart data={points} series={bytes} empty={t("common.empty")} />
        </ChartCard>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export function UsagePage() {
  return (
    <RequireScope scope="read">
      <UsageBody />
    </RequireScope>
  );
}
```

```tsx
function WebhooksBody() {

          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setRotating(w)}>
            {t("webhooks.rotate")}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setDeleting(w)}>
            {t("common.delete")}
          </Button>
```

```tsx
import { createRootRoute, createRoute, createRouter, Outlet, redirect } from "@tanstack/react-router";

import { AuthLayout } from "@/auth/AuthLayout";
import { LoginPage } from "@/auth/LoginPage";
import { authStore } from "@/auth/store";
import { AuditPage } from "@/pages/Audit";
import { BansPage } from "@/pages/Bans";
import { SettingsPage } from "@/pages/Settings";
import { KeysPage } from "@/pages/Keys";
import { MatchmakingPage } from "@/pages/Matchmaking";
import { ModulesPage } from "@/pages/Modules";
import { NodesPage } from "@/pages/Nodes";
import { OverviewPage } from "@/pages/Overview";
import { ProjectDetailPage } from "@/pages/ProjectDetail";
import { ProjectsPage } from "@/pages/Projects";
import { RoomDetailPage } from "@/pages/RoomDetail";
import { RoomsPage } from "@/pages/Rooms";
import { UsagePage } from "@/pages/Usage";
import { WebhooksPage } from "@/pages/Webhooks";
import { NotFound } from "@/shell/NotFound";
import { Shell } from "@/shell/Shell";


const rootRoute = createRootRoute({ component: Outlet, notFoundComponent: NotFound });

const authRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  id: "auth",
  component: AuthLayout,
  beforeLoad: () => {
    if (authStore.get()) throw redirect({ to: "/" });
  },
});
const loginRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => authRoute,
  path: "/login",
  validateSearch: (s: Record<string, unknown>): { redirect?: string } => ({ redirect: typeof s.redirect === "string" ? s.redirect : undefined }),
  component: LoginPage,
});

const shellRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => rootRoute, id: "shell", component: Shell });
export const overviewRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/", component: OverviewPage });
export const nodesRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/nodes", component: NodesPage });
export const projectsRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/projects", component: ProjectsPage });
export const projectDetailRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/projects/$projectId", component: ProjectDetailPage });
export const roomsRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => shellRoute,
  path: "/rooms",
  component: RoomsPage,
  validateSearch: (s: Record<string, unknown>): { node?: string; mode?: string; state?: string } => ({
    node: typeof s.node === "string" && s.node ? s.node : undefined,
    mode: typeof s.mode === "string" && s.mode ? s.mode : undefined,
    state: typeof s.state === "string" && s.state ? s.state : undefined,
  }),
});
export const roomDetailRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/rooms/$roomId", component: RoomDetailPage });
export const usageRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/usage", component: UsagePage });
export const keysRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/keys", component: KeysPage });
export const webhooksRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/webhooks", component: WebhooksPage });
export const bansRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/bans", component: BansPage });
export const settingsRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/settings", component: SettingsPage });
export const modulesRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/modules", component: ModulesPage });
export const matchmakingRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/matchmaking", component: MatchmakingPage });
export const auditRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => shellRoute, path: "/audit", component: AuditPage });

const routeTree = rootRoute.addChildren([
  authRoute.addChildren([loginRoute]),
  shellRoute.addChildren([overviewRoute, nodesRoute, projectsRoute, projectDetailRoute, roomsRoute, roomDetailRoute, usageRoute, keysRoute, webhooksRoute, bansRoute, settingsRoute, modulesRoute, matchmakingRoute, auditRoute]),
]);

export const router = createRouter({ routeTree, defaultPreload: "intent" });

declare module "@tanstack/react-router" {
  interface Register {
    router: typeof router;
  }
}
```

`dashboard/src/shell/Guards.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Boxes, Lock } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { EmptyState } from "@/ui/Primitives";

export function Forbidden({ scope }: { scope?: string }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  return (
    <EmptyState
      icon={<Lock className="size-5" />}
      title={t("common.forbidden")}
      description={
        <>
          {t("common.forbidden.desc")}
          {scope ? <div className="mt-1 font-mono text-[11px]">{t("common.forbidden.scope", { scope })}</div> : null}
        </>
      }
    />
  );
}

/** Operator-only pages (projects, fleet). */
export function RequireOperator({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { operator } = useAuth();
  if (!operator) return <Forbidden scope="operator" />;
  return <>{children}</>;
}

/** API-key scope gate for project pages. */
export function RequireScope({ scope, projectKey, children }: { scope: "rooms" | "read" | "admin"; projectKey?: boolean; children: ReactNode }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { can, operator } = useAuth();
  if (projectKey && operator) {
    return <EmptyState icon={<Lock className="size-5" />} title={t("common.forbidden")} description={t("common.forbidden.operator")} />;
  }
  if (!can(scope)) return <Forbidden scope={scope} />;
  return <>{children}</>;
}

/** Project pages need a project in scope; the operator picks one in the top bar. */
export function RequireProject({ children }: { children: (projectId: string) => ReactNode }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { projectId } = useAuth();
  if (!projectId) {
    return <EmptyState icon={<Boxes className="size-5" />} title={t("common.selectProject")} description={t("common.selectProject.desc")} />;
  }
  return <>{children(projectId)}</>;
}
```

```tsx
import { Languages, LogOut, Monitor, Moon, Sun, KeyRound, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";

import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { useTheme, type Theme } from "@/theme";
import { Menu, type MenuItem } from "@/ui/Menu";

export function ProfileMenu() {
  const { t, locale, setLocale } = useI18n();
  const { me, operator, signOut } = useAuth();
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  if (!me) return null;
  const themeItem = (value: Theme, icon: MenuItem["icon"], label: string): MenuItem => ({ label, icon, checked: theme === value, onSelect: () => setTheme(value) });
  const items: MenuItem[] = [
    {
      label: (
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="font-medium truncate">{operator ? t("nav.operator") : me.project?.name}</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-fg-muted truncate">{operator ? me.region : `${t("nav.project")} · ${me.key?.name} · ${me.key?.scopes.join(", ")}`}</div>
        </div>
      ),
      disabled: true,
    },
    { label: `${t("nav.language")}: ${locale === "ru" ? "Русский" : "English"}`, icon: <Languages className="size-3.5" />, onSelect: () => setLocale(locale === "ru" ? "en" : "ru"), separatorBefore: true },
    { ...themeItem("light", <Sun className="size-3.5" />, t("nav.theme.light")), separatorBefore: true },
    themeItem("dark", <Moon className="size-3.5" />, t("nav.theme.dark")),
    themeItem("system", <Monitor className="size-3.5" />, t("nav.theme.system")),
    { label: t("nav.signOut"), icon: <LogOut className="size-3.5" />, separatorBefore: true, danger: true, onSelect: () => signOut("manual") },
  ];
  return (
    <Menu
      label={t("nav.profile")}
      items={items}
      trigger={
        <button type="button" className="size-8 rounded-full bg-surface-2 border border-border grid place-items-center text-fg-muted hover:text-fg" aria-label={t("nav.profile")}>
          {operator ? <ShieldCheck className="size-4" /> : <KeyRound className="size-4" />}
        </button>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

`dashboard/src/shell/ProjectSwitcher.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Boxes, ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";

import { useProjects } from "@/api/hooks";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";
import { Menu } from "@/ui/Menu";

/** Operator sessions pick the project that project pages act on; key sessions are pinned. */
export function ProjectSwitcher() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { operator, me, projectId, selectProject } = useAuth();
  const projects = useProjects();
  if (!operator) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] min-w-0">
        <Boxes className="size-4 text-fg-muted shrink-0" />
        <span className="font-medium truncate">{me?.project?.name}</span>
        <span className="text-fg-faint hidden sm:inline">· {me?.key?.name}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const current = projects.data?.find((p) => p.id === projectId);
  const items = [
    { label: t("scope.all"), onSelect: () => selectProject(null) },
    ...(projects.data ?? []).map((p) => ({ label: p.name, onSelect: () => selectProject(p.id) })),
  ];
  return (
    <Menu
      label={t("scope.pick")}
      items={items}
      trigger={
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="max-w-[260px]">
          <Boxes className="size-4 text-fg-muted" />
          <span className="truncate">{current?.name ?? t("scope.all")}</span>
          <ChevronDown className="size-3.5 text-fg-faint" />
        </Button>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Outlet, useNavigate, useRouterState } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { Menu as MenuIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { useAuth } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { useI18n } from "@/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/ui/Button";

import { ProfileMenu } from "./ProfileMenu";
import { ProjectSwitcher } from "./ProjectSwitcher";
import { Sidebar } from "./Sidebar";

export function Shell() {
  const { status } = useAuth();
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const pathname = useRouterState({ select: (s) => s.location.pathname });
  const [drawer, setDrawer] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === "anonymous") {
      void navigate({ to: "/login", search: { redirect: pathname === "/" ? undefined : pathname }, replace: true });
    }
  }, [status, navigate, pathname]);

  if (status !== "authenticated") return null;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-dvh flex">
      <Sidebar className="hidden lg:flex" />
      {drawer ? (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 lg:hidden">
          <button type="button" className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/30" aria-label={t("common.close")} onClick={() => setDrawer(false)} />
          <Sidebar className="relative z-10 h-full shadow-xl" onNavigate={() => setDrawer(false)} />
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col">
        <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 h-14 shrink-0 border-b border-border bg-bg/85 backdrop-blur flex items-center gap-2 px-3 sm:px-5">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="lg:hidden" aria-label={t("nav.menu")} onClick={() => setDrawer(true)}>
            <MenuIcon className="size-4" />
          </Button>
          <ProjectSwitcher />
          <div className="flex-1" />
          <ProfileMenu />
        </header>
        <main className="flex-1 min-w-0 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 max-w-[1400px] w-full mx-auto animate-fade-in">
          <Outlet />
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export function Sidebar({ className, onNavigate }: { className?: string; onNavigate?: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { operator, can } = useAuth();
  const visible = (i: NavItem) => (i.operator ? operator : true) && (i.projectKey ? !operator : true) && (i.scope ? operator || can(i.scope) : true);
  return (
    <aside className={cn("w-60 shrink-0 border-r border-border bg-surface flex-col", className)}>
      <div className="h-14 flex items-center gap-2.5 px-5 border-b border-border">

      </div>

          const items = s.items.filter(visible);
          if (items.length === 0) return null;

            <div key={s.label}>
```
