`docs/webhooks.md`:

```md
# Webhooks

Aurix Net POSTs JSON events about rooms and players to the HTTPS endpoints registered for a project (`POST /v1/webhooks` with `admin` scope, or from the console). Every node has one delivery worker; events are queued off the hot path so a slow receiver never slows a match.

## Request

```http
POST /your/endpoint HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
X-Aurix-Event: player.joined
X-Aurix-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the webhook secret>
X-Aurix-Signature-Previous: sha256=<hex>   # only during a secret-rotation grace period

{"event":"player.joined","project":"<project-uuid>","at":"2026-11-07T16:20:00Z","data":{"room":"<uuid>","actor":3}}
```

The envelope is always `event`, `project`, `at` (RFC 3339, UTC) and `data`. Verify the signature over the **raw** body bytes before parsing.

## Events

| Event | `data` | When |
|---|---|---|
| `room.created` | `{"room":"<uuid>","name":"lobby-1","mode":"relay|sync|lockstep","region":"eu"}` | a room was opened (by a client join with `create`, or by `POST /v1/rooms`) |
| `join.validate` | `{"room":"<uuid>","name":"ranked-7","mode":"sync","room_props":{...},"player_id":"p1","player_name":"Ann","player_props":{...},"spectator":false}` | **synchronous**: sent before a player enters a room (not on rejoin); answer 2xx with `{"allow":true}` (or an empty body) within 2 s, or `{"allow":false,"reason":"season over"}` to refuse — the client gets `join rejected: <reason>`. Receiver down / non-2xx / non-JSON = refused (fail closed) and the rejection counter shows `validate_unavailable`. Subscribe explicitly (`*` does not include it) |
| `room.closed` | `{"room":"<uuid>","name":"ranked-7","mode":"sync","props":{...},"state":"<base64>"}` | `state` only with room prop `export_state_on_close: true`: the final checkpoint JSON (players, master, sync state or lockstep snapshot), ≤ 256 KiB (`state_too_large: <bytes>` otherwise) — persist matches on your side |
| `room.closed` (minimal) | `{"room":"<uuid>"}` | the room ended: last player left and `empty_ttl` passed, or it was closed by the game / an operator |
| `room.rehosted` | `{"room":"<uuid>","name":"lobby-1","mode":"sync","node":"<node-uuid>","restored":true}` | the room was adopted by another node after a drain or node loss; `restored` is false when no checkpoint was found and the room started fresh |
| `player.joined` | `{"room":"<uuid>","actor":3}` | a player finished auth + join; `actor` is the per-room id (0..N) |
| `player.left` | `{"room":"<uuid>","actor":3,"kicked":true}` | a player left or timed out (`player_ttl`); `kicked` is present only for kicks |
| `match.found` | `{"room":"lobby-7f3a","mode":"sync","players":["p1","p2"],"tickets":["<uuid>","<uuid>"],"bots":2}` | matchmaking grouped tickets; `room` is the room name the players will join with their grants (`tickets` lists the matched ticket ids) |
| `test` | `{"webhook":"<uuid>"}` | sent by `POST /v1/webhooks/:id/test` or the console; ignores the event filter |

A webhook with an empty `events` list receives every event. Unknown names are rejected at registration.

## Delivery semantics

- Up to 3 attempts per event with 0.5 s / 1 s / 2 s backoff; a 4xx answer stops retries (the receiver rejected it on purpose), 5xx and network errors retry. Request timeout 5 s.
- At-least-once: a receiver that answered slowly may see the same event twice — de-duplicate on (`event`, `data.room`, `data.actor`, `at`) if that matters.
- Ordering is per node, not global: `player.left` for a rehosted room can arrive from a different node than its `player.joined`.
- Outcomes are kept `retention.webhook_deliveries_days` (7) and visible under *Deliveries* in the console or `GET /v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries`: HTTP status, attempts, latency, error text.
- Receivers must be public HTTPS (plain HTTP only in `development`); loopback, private, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused at registration and re-checked at send time (DNS rebinding). Redirects are not followed.

## Secret rotation

`POST /v1/webhooks/:id/rotate` (`{"grace_secs": 86400}`) returns a new secret once. Until the grace period ends (max 7 days) every delivery also carries `X-Aurix-Signature-Previous` signed with the old secret, so switch the receiver whenever convenient and accept either header meanwhile.

## Verifying the signature

Node.js:

```js
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";

export function verify(rawBody, header, secret) {
  const expected = "sha256=" + createHmac("sha256", secret).update(rawBody).digest("hex");
  return header?.length === expected.length && timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(header), Buffer.from(expected));
}

// express: app.post('/hook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }), (req, res) => {
//   if (!verify(req.body, req.get('x-aurix-signature'), SECRET) && !verify(req.body, req.get('x-aurix-signature-previous'), OLD_SECRET)) return res.sendStatus(401);
//   const ev = JSON.parse(req.body); ... res.sendStatus(204); });
```

Python:

```python
import hmac, hashlib

def verify(raw_body: bytes, header: str | None, secret: str) -> bool:
    expected = "sha256=" + hmac.new(secret.encode(), raw_body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(header or "", expected)
```

Answer 2xx quickly (204 is fine) and do the work asynchronously; anything slower than 5 s counts as a failed attempt.

## Operator alerts (fleet level)

Operators can register their own receivers under **Settings → Alert webhooks** (`GET/POST/DELETE /v1/operator/webhooks[/:id]`, `GET …/:id/deliveries`, `POST …/:id/test`). Same envelope and signature; `project` is `null` and the subject lives in `data`.

| Event | `data` | Fires when |
|---|---|---|
| `node.stale` | node row (`id`, `region`, `last_heartbeat`, …) | a node missed heartbeats for 30 s |
| `node.draining` | node row + `rooms` | a node is draining for a rolling restart |
| `project.suspended` | `{id, name, since}` | a project is suspended |
| `project.usage_cap` | `{project_id, project_name, metric, used, cap, hard}` | ≥80 % of a monthly cap (`hard: false`) and again at 100 % (`hard: true`) |
| `project.rejections` | `{project_id, project_name, total, by}` | players were turned away in the last hour |
| `webhook.failing` | `{project_id, project_name, webhook_id, url, failed, total}` | a project webhook failed in the last hour |
| `test` | `{webhook}` | `POST /v1/operator/webhooks/:id/test` |

One node (Redis leader lock) evaluates the conditions every minute; each subject fires at most once per hour while the condition persists, so a stuck node produces one alert an hour, not sixty. Deliveries are logged like project webhooks (`retention.webhook_deliveries_days`).

CREATE TABLE projects (

);

    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    prefix TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    scopes TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_used_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE INDEX api_keys_project_idx ON api_keys(project_id);

    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    dns_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true
);

    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    public_host TEXT NOT NULL,
    quic_port INT NOT NULL,

);

);

`migrations/0007_webhook_secret_rotation.sql`:

`scripts/backup.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Consistent backup of a self-hosted Aurix Net deployment (Postgres + Redis) running under
# deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml. Postgres holds everything durable (projects, keys, rooms
# history, usage, audit, modules); Redis holds live state (room index, checkpoints of orphaned
# rooms, rate limits) — restoring it is optional but lets in-flight rooms survive a full restart.
#
#   scripts/backup.sh [out-dir]            # writes <out-dir>/aurix-net-<utc-stamp>/{postgres.sql.gz,redis.rdb,manifest}
#   set -a; . .env; set +a   # REDIS_PASSWORD for redis-cli
#   COMPOSE="docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env -p aurix" scripts/backup.sh
#
# Restore (stop the nodes first so they do not write while you load):
#   $COMPOSE stop node-a node-b
#   gunzip -c postgres.sql.gz | $COMPOSE exec -T postgres psql -U aurix -d aurix_net
#   $COMPOSE stop redis && docker cp redis.rdb <redis container>:/data/dump.rdb && $COMPOSE start redis
#   $COMPOSE start node-a node-b
set -euo pipefail
OUT=${1:-./backups}
COMPOSE=${COMPOSE:-"docker compose -f $(dirname "$0")/../deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml"}
STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
DIR="$OUT/aurix-net-$STAMP"
mkdir -p "$DIR"
chmod 700 "$DIR"

# Postgres: single transaction snapshot, schema + data, plain SQL so it restores into any 16.x.
$COMPOSE exec -T postgres pg_dump -U aurix -d aurix_net --no-owner --no-privileges \
  | gzip -9 > "$DIR/postgres.sql.gz"

# Redis: ask for a point-in-time RDB and wait for it to land, then copy it out. redis-server
# rewrites its argv, so the password cannot be read back from the container: pass REDIS_PASSWORD
# (e.g. `set -a; . .env; set +a` before running) — unset means an unauthenticated Redis.
rcli() { $COMPOSE exec -T -e REDIS_PASSWORD="${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}" redis sh -c "redis-cli --no-auth-warning \${REDIS_PASSWORD:+-a \"\$REDIS_PASSWORD\"} $*"; }
[ "$(rcli PING)" = "PONG" ] || { echo "redis: cannot authenticate (set REDIS_PASSWORD)" >&2; exit 1; }
LAST=$(rcli LASTSAVE)
rcli BGSAVE >/dev/null
for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
  [ "$(rcli LASTSAVE)" != "$LAST" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
$COMPOSE exec -T redis cat /data/dump.rdb > "$DIR/redis.rdb"

{
  echo "created_utc=$STAMP"
  echo "postgres_sha256=$(sha256sum "$DIR/postgres.sql.gz" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  echo "redis_sha256=$(sha256sum "$DIR/redis.rdb" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  echo "postgres_bytes=$(stat -c %s "$DIR/postgres.sql.gz")"
  echo "redis_bytes=$(stat -c %s "$DIR/redis.rdb")"
} > "$DIR/manifest"
echo "backup written to $DIR"
cat "$DIR/manifest"

```

`scripts/capacity.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Capacity steps against one node pinned to a few cores: for each "rooms x players @ rate" step run the
# loadtest for STEP_SECS, then print node CPU (cores busy, from /proc), RSS, sync tick p99/overruns and
# the bots' delivery/latency numbers as one CSV row. Bots run on the other cores.
#   NODE_PID=<pid> HTTP=http://127.0.0.1:8098 NET_OPERATOR_TOKEN=dev-admin MODE=relay \
#   STEPS="10x8@20 20x8@20 40x8@20" BOT_CPUS=2-7 scripts/capacity.sh
set -euo pipefail
HTTP="${HTTP:-http://127.0.0.1:8098}"; TOK="${NET_OPERATOR_TOKEN:-dev-admin}"; MODE="${MODE:-relay}"
STEP_SECS="${STEP_SECS:-30}"; RAW="${RAW:-}"; BOT_CPUS="${BOT_CPUS:-2-7}"; EXTRA="${EXTRA:-}"
LT="${LOADTEST:-$(dirname "$0")/../target/release/aurix-net-loadtest}"
CLI="${CLI:-$(dirname "$0")/../target/release/aurix-net}"
: "${NODE_PID:?NODE_PID=<node pid>}"
KEY="${NET_API_KEY:-$(NET_HTTP="$HTTP" NET_OPERATOR_TOKEN="$TOK" "$CLI" project-create "cap-$(date +%s)" | grep -oE 'an_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' | head -1)}"
TICK=$(getconf CLK_TCK)
cpu_ticks() { awk '{print $14+$15}' "/proc/$NODE_PID/stat"; }
rss_mb() { awk '/VmRSS/{printf "%.0f", $2/1024}' "/proc/$NODE_PID/status"; }
node_stat() { curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" "$HTTP/v1/operator/nodes" | python3 -c '
import json,sys; n=[x for x in json.load(sys.stdin)["nodes"] if x["http_url"].endswith(sys.argv[1])][0]; print(n["id"])' "${HTTP##*:}"; }
NODE_ID=$(node_stat)
stats() { curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" "$HTTP/v1/operator/nodes/$NODE_ID/stats" | python3 -c '
import json,sys; s=json.load(sys.stdin); print(s.get("sync_tick_p99_ms","") , s.get("tick_overruns",""), s.get("rooms",""), s.get("players",""))'; }
echo "mode,rooms,players,rate,joined,failed,loss_pct,p50_ms,p99_ms,node_cores,rss_mb,tick_p99_ms,overruns"
for st in $STEPS; do
  rooms=${st%%x*}; rest=${st#*x}; players=${rest%%@*}; rate=${rest#*@}
  t0=$(cpu_ticks); s0=$(date +%s.%N); ov0=$(stats | awk '{print $2}')
  out=$(taskset -c "$BOT_CPUS" "$LT" --http "$HTTP" --api-key "$KEY" --mode "$MODE" --rooms "$rooms" --players "$players" --rate "$rate" --duration-secs "$STEP_SECS" --run "$RANDOM" $EXTRA 2>&1 | tail -6)
  t1=$(cpu_ticks); s1=$(date +%s.%N)
  cores=$(python3 -c "print(round(($t1-$t0)/$TICK/($s1-$s0),2))")
  g() { echo "$out" | grep -oE "$1" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2 || true; }
  joined=$(g 'joined=[0-9]+'); failed=$(g 'failed=[0-9]+'); loss=$(g 'loss=[0-9.]+'); p50=$(g 'p50=[0-9]+'); p99=$(g 'p99=[0-9]+')
  [ -n "$RAW" ] && printf '%s\n--- %s %s\n' "$out" "$MODE" "$st" >> "$RAW" || true
  read -r tp99 ov _ < <(stats); sleep 3
  echo "$MODE,$rooms,$players,$rate,${joined:-},${failed:-},${loss:-},$(python3 -c "print(round(${p50:-0}/1000,2))"),$(python3 -c "print(round(${p99:-0}/1000,2))"),$cores,$(rss_mb),${tp99},$(( ${ov:-0} - ${ov0:-0} ))"
  sleep 5
done

```

`scripts/failover-test.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Chaos: a lockstep match runs on node A, A is killed mid-match, players reconnect to node B,
# which must adopt the room from the Redis checkpoint and serve catch-up. Expects two-nodes.sh
# started and NET_API_KEY (rooms scope) in the environment.
# KILL_SIGNAL=9 (default) simulates a crash: B waits for 3 missed heartbeats before the room is
# orphaned. KILL_SIGNAL=TERM is a rolling deploy: A checkpoints and orphans its rooms itself, so
# the handoff is immediate.
set -euo pipefail
LT="$(dirname "$0")/../target/release/aurix-net-loadtest"
RUN=$(date +%s)
"$LT" --api-key "$NET_API_KEY" --mode lockstep --rooms 1 --players 3 --duration-secs 40 --run "$RUN" >/tmp/failover-a.log 2>&1 &
sleep 14
SIG="${KILL_SIGNAL:-9}"
kill -"$SIG" "$(pgrep -f '^/tmp/aurix-net-A')"; echo "A killed (signal $SIG)"
if [ "$SIG" = "9" ]; then sleep 14; else sleep 2; fi   # crash: 3 missed heartbeats + reap; TERM: handoff is immediate
"$LT" --http http://127.0.0.1:8091 --api-key "$NET_API_KEY" --mode lockstep --rooms 1 --players 2 --duration-secs 14 --run "$RUN" --late-join-secs 1 2>&1 | grep -E "^joined=|late join|catch-up gap|still catching"
grep -c "adopted orphaned room" /tmp/aurix-net-B.log
echo "PASS criteria: joined=3 failed=0, caught-up=3/1, 'adopted orphaned room' >= 1"

```

`scripts/sdk-rehost-test.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Live: Web (sdk/web/test/rehost.mjs) and C# (sdk/unity/BuildCheck~/managed-rehost) clients sit in
# one relay room on node A; A gets SIGTERM; both must receive left{reason:"rehost"}, rejoin on B
# with the same grant/actor and still reach a client that joins on B afterwards.
# Needs: `cargo build --release`, `npm run build` in sdk/web, `dotnet build -c Release` in the
# managed-rehost project, NET_API_KEY in the environment. Expects two-nodes.sh layout (A :8090, B :8091).
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
DOTNET="${DOTNET:-dotnet}"
scripts/two-nodes.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 1; scripts/two-nodes.sh start
ROOM="sdk-rehost-$(date +%s)"
(cd sdk/web && node test/rehost.mjs "$ROOM" > /tmp/web-rehost.log 2>&1; echo "web exit $?" >> /tmp/web-rehost.log) &
(cd "sdk/unity/BuildCheck~/managed-rehost" && "$DOTNET" run --no-build -c Release -- "$ROOM" > /tmp/cs-rehost.log 2>&1; echo "cs exit $?" >> /tmp/cs-rehost.log) &
sleep 8
kill -TERM "$(pgrep -f '^/tmp/aurix-net-A')"; echo "A: SIGTERM sent"
wait
echo "=== web"; cat /tmp/web-rehost.log; echo "=== cs"; cat /tmp/cs-rehost.log
echo "=== 'adopted orphaned room' on B:"; grep -c "adopted orphaned room" /tmp/aurix-net-B.log
echo "PASS criteria: WEB_REHOST_OK, CS_REHOST_OK, same actor: true, adopted >= 1"

`scripts/soak-test.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Soak: relay + sync + lockstep bots against node B (WEB_KEY=<project api key> adds a forced desync per batch) for DURATION seconds while sampling both nodes' live
# stats (RSS, rooms, players, sync tick avg/p99, overruns) every 60 s into a CSV. The point is
# flat RSS and a flat tick after the first minutes: no leak per room/player churn.
#   DURATION=3600 ./scripts/soak-test.sh
#   LOCKSTEP_PROPS='{"schema":"component Transform {\n pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)\n speed: f32\n}","logic":"physics-arena","position":"Transform.0"}' adds a referee room per batch
set -euo pipefail
A="${HTTP_A:-http://127.0.0.1:8098}"; B="${HTTP_B:-http://127.0.0.1:8099}"
TOK="${NET_OPERATOR_TOKEN:-dev-admin}"; DURATION="${DURATION:-3600}"; BATCH="${BATCH:-300}"
BIN="${LOADTEST:-$(dirname "$0")/../target/release/aurix-net-loadtest}"
OUT="${OUT:-/tmp/soak-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).csv}"
auth=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK")
echo "t,node,rss_mb,rooms,players,tick_avg_ms,tick_p99_ms,tick_overruns" > "$OUT"
sample() {
  # re-list every time: nodes may (re)start during the run
  for id in $(curl -sf "${auth[@]}" "$A/v1/operator/nodes" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(" ".join(n["id"] for n in json.load(sys.stdin)["nodes"]))'); do
    curl -sf "${auth[@]}" "$A/v1/operator/nodes/$id/stats" | python3 -c '
import sys,json,time; s=json.load(sys.stdin)
print(",".join(str(x) for x in [int(time.time()),s["node_id"][-12:],s.get("rss_mb"),s.get("rooms"),s.get("players"),s.get("sync_tick_avg_ms"),s.get("sync_tick_p99_ms"),s.get("tick_overruns")]))' >> "$OUT" || true
  done
}
end=$(( $(date +%s) + DURATION ))
sample
(
  while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$end" ]; do
    "$BIN" --http "$B" --operator-token "$TOK" --rooms 2 --players 8 --rate 20 --duration-secs "$BATCH" --tunnel >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    "$BIN" --http "$B" --operator-token "$TOK" --rooms 1 --players 8 --rate 20 --mode sync --duration-secs "$BATCH" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    # lockstep room with a late joiner (catch-up) every batch; a web client lying about its hash forces a desync + dumps
    "$BIN" --http "$B" --operator-token "$TOK" --rooms 1 --players 4 --rate 30 --mode lockstep --tick-hz 30 --late-join-secs 30 --duration-secs "$BATCH" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    # referee: lockstep room whose `logic` module (LOCKSTEP_PROPS, e.g. physics-arena) the node simulates itself
    if [ -n "${LOCKSTEP_PROPS:-}" ]; then
        # the module lives in WEB_KEY's project, so the bots must join as that project (a throwaway project has no modules)
        "$BIN" --http "$B" --operator-token "$TOK" ${WEB_KEY:+--api-key "$WEB_KEY"} --rooms 1 --players 4 --rate 30 --mode lockstep --tick-hz 30 --late-join-secs 30 --props-json "$LOCKSTEP_PROPS" --duration-secs "$BATCH" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
        if [ -n "${WEB_KEY:-}" ]; then
            (cd "$(dirname "$0")/../sdk/web" && NET_HTTP="$B" NET_API_KEY="$WEB_KEY" NET_LOGIC="${NET_LOGIC:-physics-arena}" NET_LOGIC_PROPS="$LOCKSTEP_PROPS" node --test test/referee-live.test.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1) &
        fi
    fi
    if [ -n "${WEB_KEY:-}" ] && [ -f "$(dirname "$0")/../sdk/web/test/lockstep-live.test.mjs" ]; then
        (cd "$(dirname "$0")/../sdk/web" && NET_HTTP="$B" NET_API_KEY="$WEB_KEY" node --test test/lockstep-live.test.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1) &
    fi
    wait
    sleep 5
  done
) &
bots=$!
while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$end" ]; do sleep 60; sample; done
wait "$bots" || true
sleep 20; sample
echo "samples in $OUT"
python3 - "$OUT" <<'PY'
import sys,csv,collections
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open(sys.argv[1])))
by=collections.defaultdict(list)
for r in rows: by[r["node"]].append(r)
for n,rs in by.items():
    rss=[float(r["rss_mb"]) for r in rs if r["rss_mb"] not in ("","None")]
    p99=[float(r["tick_p99_ms"]) for r in rs if r["tick_p99_ms"] not in ("","None")]
    ov=[int(float(r["tick_overruns"])) for r in rs if r["tick_overruns"] not in ("","None")]
    print(f"node {n}: samples={len(rs)} rss first/last/max={rss[0]:.0f}/{rss[-1]:.0f}/{max(rss):.0f} MB  tick p99 max={max(p99) if p99 else 0:.2f} ms  overruns={ov[-1]-ov[0] if ov else 0}")
PY

```

`scripts/two-nodes.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Two local nodes sharing the dev Postgres/Redis (deploy/docker-compose.dev.yml):
#   A: http 8090, quic 7000, webtransport 7443     B: http 8091, quic 7001, webtransport 7444
# Usage: scripts/two-nodes.sh start|stop   (binaries from `cargo build --release`)
set -euo pipefail
BIN="$(dirname "$0")/../target/release/aurix-net-server"
export NET__AUTH__ADMIN_TOKEN="${NET__AUTH__ADMIN_TOKEN:-dev-admin}" NET__SERVER__HEARTBEAT_SECS="${HEARTBEAT:-3}" RUST_LOG="${RUST_LOG:-info}"
case "${1:-start}" in
  start)
    ln -sf "$(readlink -f "$BIN")" /tmp/aurix-net-A; ln -sf "$(readlink -f "$BIN")" /tmp/aurix-net-B
    /tmp/aurix-net-A >/tmp/aurix-net-A.log 2>&1 &
    NET__SERVER__HTTP_ADDR=127.0.0.1:8091 NET__TRANSPORT__QUIC_ADDR=0.0.0.0:7001 NET__TRANSPORT__WEBTRANSPORT_ADDR=0.0.0.0:7444 \
      /tmp/aurix-net-B >/tmp/aurix-net-B.log 2>&1 &
    for p in 8090 8091; do for _ in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf 127.0.0.1:$p/healthz >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done; done
    echo "A and B up (logs /tmp/aurix-net-{A,B}.log)";;
  stop) pkill -f '^/tmp/aurix-net-[AB]' || true;;
  kill-a) kill -9 "$(pgrep -f '^/tmp/aurix-net-A')";;
esac

```

`sdk/cpp/README.md`:

```md
# Aurix Net — C++ (header-only over the C ABI)

`aurix_net.hpp` wraps `libaurix_net` (crate `net-ffi`): relay rooms, `aurix::net::Sync` (replicated world),
`aurix::net::Lockstep`, plus aurix-sim (`aurix_sim.h`). Build the library once from the repo root:

```bash
cargo build --release -p net-ffi        # target/release/libaurix_net.{so,dylib} / aurix_net.dll
```

Live checks against a local node (README quickstart; `NET_HTTP` defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:8090`):

```bash
export NET_API_KEY=an_...
for t in echo_test sync_test; do
  g++ -std=c++17 -O1 sdk/cpp/$t.cpp -Isdk/cpp -Ltarget/release -laurix_net -lpthread \
      -Wl,-rpath,$PWD/target/release -o /tmp/$t && /tmp/$t
done
# plain C: crates/net-ffi/ctest/echo.c (relay) and ctest/sim.c (offline, six golden hashes)
gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror crates/net-ffi/ctest/sim.c -Ltarget/release -laurix_net -lm \
    -Wl,-rpath,$PWD/target/release -o /tmp/sim_ctest && /tmp/sim_ctest
```

API walk-through: [docs/sdk.md](../../docs/sdk.md) (sections "Lockstep rooms from Rust, C++ and Godot",
"Sync rooms from C++ and Godot", "aurix-sim from C / C++ / Godot").

```

`sdk/cpp/aurix_net.h`:

```h
/* Aurix Net C ABI. All calls are thread-safe; events are polled. Strings are UTF-8, NUL-terminated. */
#ifndef AURIX_NET_H
#define AURIX_NET_H
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct AurixNetClient AurixNetClient;

enum {
    AURIX_NET_EVENT_NONE = 0,
    AURIX_NET_EVENT_CONTROL = 1,    /* json = server control message */
    AURIX_NET_EVENT_DATA = 2,       /* data/data_len on channel */
    AURIX_NET_EVENT_DATA_READY = 3,
    AURIX_NET_EVENT_CLOSED = 4      /* json = reason */
};

enum { AURIX_NET_CH_UNRELIABLE = 0, AURIX_NET_CH_RELIABLE = 1, AURIX_NET_CH_RELIABLE_UNORDERED = 2 };
enum { AURIX_NET_TARGET_ALL = 0, AURIX_NET_TARGET_OTHERS = 1, AURIX_NET_TARGET_MASTER = 2, AURIX_NET_TARGET_ACTORS = 3 };

typedef struct AurixNetEvent {
    int32_t kind;
    uint8_t channel;
    uint16_t tick;
    uint8_t *data;
    size_t data_len;
    char *json;
} AurixNetEvent;

const char *aurix_net_version(void);
const char *aurix_net_last_error(void);

/* backend/tooling only */
char *aurix_net_issue_grant(const char *http, const char *api_key, const char *player_id, const char *name);
void aurix_net_string_free(char *s);

AurixNetClient *aurix_net_connect(const char *http, const char *grant, int32_t tunnel);
int32_t aurix_net_send_control(AurixNetClient *h, const char *json);
int32_t aurix_net_join(AurixNetClient *h, const char *json);          /* returns actor id or -1 */
char *aurix_net_joined_json(AurixNetClient *h);
int32_t aurix_net_send_data(AurixNetClient *h, uint8_t channel, const uint8_t *data, size_t len);
int32_t aurix_net_send_event(AurixNetClient *h, uint8_t code, int32_t target, const uint16_t *actors, size_t n_actors,
                             const uint8_t *data, size_t len, int32_t reliable);
void aurix_net_flush(AurixNetClient *h);
int32_t aurix_net_poll(AurixNetClient *h, AurixNetEvent *out);          /* 1 = event filled */
void aurix_net_event_free(AurixNetEvent *ev);
int32_t aurix_net_leave(AurixNetClient *h);
void aurix_net_destroy(AurixNetClient *h);

/* ---- lockstep rooms (pure-logic helper; feed it every data payload of a lockstep room) ---- */
typedef struct AurixNetLockstep AurixNetLockstep;
enum { AURIX_NET_LS_NONE = 0, AURIX_NET_LS_TICK = 1, AURIX_NET_LS_RESTORE = 2, AURIX_NET_LS_CHECKPOINT_REQ = 3, AURIX_NET_LS_DUMP_REQ = 4 };
enum { AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY = 0, AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY_MIN = 1, AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY_MAX = 2, AURIX_NET_LS_ADAPTIVE_DELAY = 3,
       AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_REDUNDANCY = 4, AURIX_NET_LS_LAST_MARGIN = 5, AURIX_NET_LS_LATE_INPUTS = 6, AURIX_NET_LS_CONFIRMED_TICK = 7,
       AURIX_NET_LS_SERVER_TICK = 8, AURIX_NET_LS_DELIVERED = 9, AURIX_NET_LS_CATCHUPS = 10, AURIX_NET_LS_DROPPED = 11 };
typedef struct AurixNetLsEvent {
  int32_t kind; uint32_t tick; uint64_t hash;
  uint16_t inputs;             /* TICK: actors with input, read with aurix_net_lockstep_input */
  const uint8_t *state; size_t state_len; /* RESTORE: checkpoint state, valid until the next poll */
} AurixNetLsEvent;
AurixNetLockstep *aurix_net_lockstep_new(void);
void aurix_net_lockstep_destroy(AurixNetLockstep *ls);
int32_t aurix_net_lockstep_receive(AurixNetLockstep *ls, const uint8_t *data, size_t len); /* 1 = lockstep frame */
int32_t aurix_net_lockstep_poll(AurixNetLockstep *ls, AurixNetLsEvent *out);               /* 1 = event filled */
int32_t aurix_net_lockstep_input(AurixNetLockstep *ls, uint16_t index, uint16_t *actor, const uint8_t **data, size_t *len);
int64_t aurix_net_lockstep_send_input(AurixNetLockstep *ls, AurixNetClient *h, const uint8_t *data, size_t len); /* stamped tick or -1 */
int32_t aurix_net_lockstep_report_hash(AurixNetClient *h, uint32_t tick, uint64_t hash);
int32_t aurix_net_lockstep_send_checkpoint(AurixNetClient *h, uint32_t tick, uint64_t hash, const uint8_t *state, size_t len);
int32_t aurix_net_lockstep_send_dump(AurixNetClient *h, uint32_t tick, uint64_t hash, const uint8_t *state, size_t len);
int64_t aurix_net_lockstep_get(AurixNetLockstep *ls, int32_t key);
int32_t aurix_net_lockstep_set(AurixNetLockstep *ls, int32_t key, int64_t value);
uint64_t aurix_net_lockstep_fnv1a(const uint8_t *data, size_t len);

/* ---- sync rooms (client-side replicated world; feed it every data payload of a sync room) ---- */
typedef struct AurixNetSync AurixNetSync;
enum { AURIX_NET_SYNC_NONE = 0, AURIX_NET_SYNC_SPAWN = 1, AURIX_NET_SYNC_CHANGE = 2, AURIX_NET_SYNC_DESPAWN = 3 };
typedef struct AurixNetSyncEvent { int32_t kind; uint64_t entity; int32_t owner; /* -1 = server-owned */ } AurixNetSyncEvent;
AurixNetSync *aurix_net_sync_new(const char *schema);                                   /* NULL + last_error on a bad schema */
void aurix_net_sync_destroy(AurixNetSync *s);
int32_t aurix_net_sync_receive(const AurixNetSync *s, const uint8_t *data, size_t len, uint8_t *ack9); /* 1 = delta applied, ack9 filled (send it unreliable); 0 = not a delta; -1 = error */
int32_t aurix_net_sync_poll(const AurixNetSync *s, AurixNetSyncEvent *out);           /* 1 = spawn/change/despawn filled */
uint32_t aurix_net_sync_server_tick(const AurixNetSync *s);
uint64_t aurix_net_sync_gaps(const AurixNetSync *s);

int32_t aurix_net_sync_get_vector(const AurixNetSync *s, uint64_t entity, int32_t component, int32_t field, float *out4); /* 2 vec2, 3 vec3, 4 quat xyzw, 1 scalar, 0 missing */
int32_t aurix_net_sync_get_bytes(const AurixNetSync *s, uint64_t entity, int32_t component, int32_t field, uint8_t *buf, size_t cap); /* string/bytes: full length (buf may be NULL), -1 missing */
int64_t aurix_net_sync_send_input(const AurixNetSync *s, AurixNetClient *h, const uint8_t *data, size_t len); /* raw input for server logic; stamped tick or -1 */
int32_t aurix_net_sync_write_begin(const AurixNetSync *s, int32_t component);           /* full component write, fields start at zero */
int32_t aurix_net_sync_write_number(const AurixNetSync *s, int32_t field, double v);
int32_t aurix_net_sync_write_vector(const AurixNetSync *s, int32_t field, const float *v, int32_t n); /* n = 2/3/4 */
int32_t aurix_net_sync_write_bytes(const AurixNetSync *s, int32_t field, const uint8_t *p, size_t n);
int32_t aurix_net_sync_write_end(const AurixNetSync *s);
int64_t aurix_net_sync_send_writes(const AurixNetSync *s, AurixNetClient *h);           /* queued writes as this tick's input (owner-authoritative rooms); stamped tick or -1 */
int64_t aurix_net_sync_send_op(const AurixNetSync *s, AurixNetClient *h, int32_t op, uint64_t entity, int32_t to); /* 0 write entity (queued writes), 1 spawn (queued writes = initial state), 2 despawn, 3 transfer to actor; own entities only */

#ifdef __cplusplus
}

#endif

`sdk/cpp/aurix_net.hpp`:

```hpp
// Header-only C++17 wrapper over libaurix_net (aurix_net.h). Used by the Godot SDK.
#pragma once
#include "aurix_net.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace aurix::net {

enum class Channel : uint8_t { Unreliable = 0, Reliable = 1, ReliableUnordered = 2 };
enum class Target : int32_t { All = 0, Others = 1, Master = 2, Actors = 3 };
enum class Mode { Relay, Sync, Lockstep };

struct Error : std::runtime_error { using std::runtime_error::runtime_error; };

inline std::string lastError() { const char* e = aurix_net_last_error(); return e ? e : "unknown error"; }

// Relay event frame: u8 code, u8 flags, u16 from (BE), [u16 group], [u16 n, n*u16], payload.
struct EventFrame {
    uint8_t code = 0; uint16_t from = 0; bool hasGroup = false; uint16_t group = 0;
    const uint8_t* payload = nullptr; size_t len = 0;
    static bool decode(const uint8_t* b, size_t n, EventFrame& f) {
        if (!b || n < 4) return false;
        f.code = b[0]; uint8_t flags = b[1]; f.from = uint16_t((b[2] << 8) | b[3]); size_t o = 4;
        if (flags & 0x10) { if (n < o + 2) return false; f.hasGroup = true; f.group = (uint16_t)((b[o] << 8) | b[o + 1]); o += 2; }
        if ((flags & 3) == 3) { if (n < o + 2) return false; size_t c = (b[o] << 8) | b[o + 1]; o += 2 + c * 2; if (n < o) return false; }
        f.payload = b + o; f.len = n - o; return true;
    }
};

class Client {
public:
    std::function<void(const std::string& json)> onControl;
    /// System notice from the operator or game backend: (text, level = "info" | "warn").
    std::function<void(const std::string& text, const std::string& level)> onNotice;
    /// The room moved to another node: rejoin with the same grant (see fallback URLs).
    std::function<void()> onRehost;
    // Minimal extraction of a top-level string field from a control message (no JSON dependency).
    static std::string jsonStr(const std::string& j, const char* key) {
        std::string k = std::string("\"") + key + "\":";
        size_t p = j.find(k);
        if (p == std::string::npos) return "";
        p += k.size();
        while (p < j.size() && j[p] == ' ') ++p;
        if (p >= j.size() || j[p] != '"') return "";
        std::string out;
        for (++p; p < j.size() && j[p] != '"'; ++p) {
            if (j[p] == '\\' && p + 1 < j.size()) { ++p; out += (j[p] == 'n' ? '\n' : j[p]); }
            else out += j[p];
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::function<void(Channel, uint16_t tick, const uint8_t*, size_t)> onData;
    std::function<void()> onDataReady;
    std::function<void(const std::string& reason)> onClosed;

    Client() = default;
    Client(const Client&) = delete; Client& operator=(const Client&) = delete;
    Client(Client&& o) noexcept : h_(o.h_), actor_(o.actor_) { o.h_ = nullptr; }
    ~Client() { destroy(); }

    static std::string version() { return aurix_net_version(); }
    /// Backend/tooling only.
    static std::string issueGrant(const std::string& http, const std::string& apiKey, const std::string& player, const std::string& name) {
        char* g = aurix_net_issue_grant(http.c_str(), apiKey.c_str(), player.c_str(), name.c_str());
        if (!g) throw Error(lastError());
        std::string s(g); aurix_net_string_free(g); return s;
    }

    void connect(const std::string& http, const std::string& grant, bool tunnel = false) {
        destroy();
        h_ = aurix_net_connect(http.c_str(), grant.c_str(), tunnel ? 1 : 0);
        if (!h_) throw Error(lastError());
    }
    bool connected() const { return h_ != nullptr; }
    AurixNetClient* handle() const { return h_; }
    int actor() const { return actor_; }

    /// Protocol JSON, e.g. {"t":"set_room_props","props":{...}}.
    void sendControl(const std::string& json) { if (aurix_net_send_control(h_, json.c_str()) != 0) throw Error(lastError()); }

    int joinOrCreate(const std::string& name, Mode mode = Mode::Relay, int maxPlayers = 8, const std::string& propsJson = "") {
        std::string j = "{\"t\":\"join_or_create\",\"name\":" + quote(name) + ",\"mode\":\"" + modeName(mode) + "\",\"max_players\":" + std::to_string(maxPlayers);
        if (!propsJson.empty()) j += ",\"props\":" + propsJson;
        return joinJson(j + "}");
    }
    int join(const std::string& name, const std::string& schemaHash = "") {
        std::string j = "{\"t\":\"join\",\"name\":" + quote(name);
        if (!schemaHash.empty()) j += ",\"schema_hash\":" + quote(schemaHash);
        return joinJson(j + "}");
    }
    int joinJson(const std::string& json) {
        int a = aurix_net_join(h_, json.c_str());
        if (a < 0) throw Error(lastError());
        actor_ = a; return a;
    }
    std::string joinedJson() const { char* s = aurix_net_joined_json(h_); if (!s) return ""; std::string r(s); aurix_net_string_free(s); return r; }

    void sendEvent(uint8_t code, const uint8_t* data, size_t len, Target target = Target::Others, bool reliable = false, const std::vector<uint16_t>& actors = {}) {
        if (aurix_net_send_event(h_, code, int32_t(target), actors.empty() ? nullptr : actors.data(), actors.size(), data, len, reliable ? 1 : 0) != 0) throw Error(lastError());
    }
    void sendData(Channel ch, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) { if (aurix_net_send_data(h_, uint8_t(ch), data, len) != 0) throw Error(lastError()); }
    /// Push queued unreliable messages; call once per frame.
    void flush() { aurix_net_flush(h_); }

    /// Dispatch pending events; call every frame on the game thread.
    int poll(int maxEvents = 256) {
        int n = 0; AurixNetEvent ev;
        while (n < maxEvents && aurix_net_poll(h_, &ev) == 1) {
            ++n;
            switch (ev.kind) {
                case AURIX_NET_EVENT_CONTROL: {
                    std::string j = ev.json ? ev.json : "";
                    if (onControl) onControl(j);
                    std::string t = jsonStr(j, "t");
                    if (t == "notice" && onNotice) onNotice(jsonStr(j, "text"), jsonStr(j, "level"));
                    if (t == "left" && onRehost && jsonStr(j, "reason") == "rehost") onRehost();
                    break;
                }
                case AURIX_NET_EVENT_DATA: if (onData) onData(Channel(ev.channel), ev.tick, ev.data, ev.data_len); break;
                case AURIX_NET_EVENT_DATA_READY: if (onDataReady) onDataReady(); break;
                case AURIX_NET_EVENT_CLOSED: if (onClosed) onClosed(ev.json ? ev.json : ""); break;
                default: break;
            }
            aurix_net_event_free(&ev);
        }
        return n;
    }

    void leave() { if (h_) aurix_net_leave(h_); }
    void destroy() { if (h_) { aurix_net_destroy(h_); h_ = nullptr; actor_ = -1; } }

    static std::string quote(const std::string& s) {
        std::string o = "\"";
        for (unsigned char c : s) {
            if (c == '"' || c == '\\') { o += '\\'; o += char(c); }
            else if (c < 0x20) { char b[8]; snprintf(b, sizeof b, "\\u%04x", c); o += b; }
            else o += char(c);
        }
        return o + "\"";
    }
    static const char* modeName(Mode m) { return m == Mode::Relay ? "relay" : m == Mode::Sync ? "sync" : "lockstep"; }

private:
    AurixNetClient* h_ = nullptr; int actor_ = -1;
};

/// Lockstep room helper: feed every Data payload to receive(), step your deterministic simulation
/// on each Tick, answer Restore/CheckpointReq/DumpReq. Input delay adapts to the node's margin reports.
class Lockstep {
public:
    enum class Kind { None = 0, Tick = 1, Restore = 2, CheckpointReq = 3, DumpReq = 4 };
    struct Input { uint16_t actor; const uint8_t* data; size_t len; };
    struct Event { Kind kind; uint32_t tick; uint64_t hash; std::vector<Input> inputs; const uint8_t* state; size_t stateLen; };

    Lockstep() : ls_(aurix_net_lockstep_new()) {}
    ~Lockstep() { aurix_net_lockstep_destroy(ls_); }
    Lockstep(const Lockstep&) = delete; Lockstep& operator=(const Lockstep&) = delete;

    /// True when the payload was a lockstep frame (events may now be pending in poll()).
    bool receive(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) { return aurix_net_lockstep_receive(ls_, data, len) == 1; }
    /// Next event; Event::kind == Kind::None when there is nothing. Pointers stay valid until the next poll().
    Event poll() {
        AurixNetLsEvent e{}; Event out{Kind::None, 0, 0, {}, nullptr, 0};
        if (aurix_net_lockstep_poll(ls_, &e) != 1) return out;
        out.kind = Kind(e.kind); out.tick = e.tick; out.hash = e.hash; out.state = e.state; out.stateLen = e.state_len;
        for (uint16_t i = 0; i < e.inputs; i++) { Input in{}; if (aurix_net_lockstep_input(ls_, i, &in.actor, &in.data, &in.len) == 1) out.inputs.push_back(in); }
        return out;
    }
    /// Sends this tick's local input through the client; returns the tick it was stamped with (or -1).
    int64_t sendInput(Client& c, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) { return aurix_net_lockstep_send_input(ls_, c.handle(), data, len); }
    static void reportHash(Client& c, uint32_t tick, uint64_t hash) { aurix_net_lockstep_report_hash(c.handle(), tick, hash); }
    static void sendCheckpoint(Client& c, uint32_t tick, uint64_t hash, const uint8_t* s, size_t n) { aurix_net_lockstep_send_checkpoint(c.handle(), tick, hash, s, n); }
    static void sendDump(Client& c, uint32_t tick, uint64_t hash, const uint8_t* s, size_t n) { aurix_net_lockstep_send_dump(c.handle(), tick, hash, s, n); }
    static uint64_t fnv1a(const uint8_t* s, size_t n) { return aurix_net_lockstep_fnv1a(s, n); }

    int64_t get(int32_t key) const { return aurix_net_lockstep_get(ls_, key); }
    void set(int32_t key, int64_t v) { aurix_net_lockstep_set(ls_, key, v); }
    uint32_t inputDelay() const { return uint32_t(get(AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY)); }
    void setInputDelay(uint32_t d, uint32_t min = 1, uint32_t max = 8, bool adaptive = true) {
        set(AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY, d); set(AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY_MIN, min); set(AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY_MAX, max); set(AURIX_NET_LS_ADAPTIVE_DELAY, adaptive ? 1 : 0);
    }
    void setInputRedundancy(uint32_t n) { set(AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_REDUNDANCY, n); }
    uint32_t confirmedTick() const { return uint32_t(get(AURIX_NET_LS_CONFIRMED_TICK)); }
    uint32_t serverTick() const { return uint32_t(get(AURIX_NET_LS_SERVER_TICK)); }
    int lastMargin() const { return int(get(AURIX_NET_LS_LAST_MARGIN)); }
    int64_t lateInputs() const { return get(AURIX_NET_LS_LATE_INPUTS); }

private:
    AurixNetLockstep* ls_;
};

/// Sync room helper (mirrors the Web `SyncSession`): feed every Data payload to receive() — it applies
/// the delta and sends the ack — then poll() spawn/change/despawn, read fields by name, and send raw
/// inputs (rooms with `logic`) or owner-authoritative component writes. renderTick() lags the server by
/// `interpolationTicks` for smoothing remote entities.
class Sync {
public:
    enum class Kind { None = 0, Spawn = 1, Change = 2, Despawn = 3 };
    struct Event { Kind kind; uint64_t entity; int owner; };

    explicit Sync(const std::string& schema, int tickHz = 60, int interpolationTicks = 2)
        : s_(aurix_net_sync_new(schema.c_str())), tickHz_(tickHz), interp_(interpolationTicks) {
        if (!s_) throw Error(lastError());
    }
    ~Sync() { aurix_net_sync_destroy(s_); }
    Sync(const Sync&) = delete; Sync& operator=(const Sync&) = delete;

    /// True when the payload was a delta: it is applied, the ack goes out through `c`, events wait in poll().
    bool receive(Client& c, const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
        uint8_t ack[9];
        int r = aurix_net_sync_receive(s_, d, n, ack);
        if (r < 0) throw Error(lastError());
        if (r != 1) return false;
        c.sendData(Channel::Unreliable, ack, sizeof ack);
        double lag = double(serverTick()) - interp_;
        if (lag > renderTick_) renderTick_ = lag;
        gotDelta_ = true;
        return true;
    }
    Event poll() {
        AurixNetSyncEvent e{}; Event out{Kind::None, 0, -1};
        if (aurix_net_sync_poll(s_, &e) == 1) { out.kind = Kind(e.kind); out.entity = e.entity; out.owner = e.owner; }
        return out;
    }
    uint32_t serverTick() const { return aurix_net_sync_server_tick(s_); }
    uint64_t gaps() const { return aurix_net_sync_gaps(s_); }
    /// Call once per frame; returns the render tick (fractional, `interpolationTicks` behind the server).
    double advance(double dtSeconds) { if (gotDelta_) renderTick_ += dtSeconds * tickHz_; return renderTick_; }
    double renderTick() const { return renderTick_; }

    int entityCount() const { return aurix_net_sync_entity_count(s_); }
    bool entityAt(int index, uint64_t& id, int& owner) const {
        int32_t o = -1; int r = aurix_net_sync_entity_at(s_, index, &id, &o); owner = o; return r == 1;
    }
    int component(const char* name) const { return aurix_net_sync_component(s_, name); }
    int field(int component, const char* name) const { return aurix_net_sync_field(s_, component, name); }
    bool has(uint64_t entity, int component) const { return aurix_net_sync_has(s_, entity, component) == 1; }
    bool number(uint64_t entity, int component, int field, double& out) const { return aurix_net_sync_get_number(s_, entity, component, field, &out) == 1; }
    /// Fills out[0..n) and returns n (2 vec2, 3 vec3, 4 quat x,y,z,w, 1 scalar), 0 when missing.
    int vector(uint64_t entity, int component, int field, float out[4]) const { return aurix_net_sync_get_vector(s_, entity, component, field, out); }
    std::string text(uint64_t entity, int component, int field) const {
        int n = aurix_net_sync_get_bytes(s_, entity, component, field, nullptr, 0);
        if (n <= 0) return {};
        std::string s(size_t(n), '\0');
        aurix_net_sync_get_bytes(s_, entity, component, field, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&s[0]), s.size());
        return s;
    }

    /// Raw input for server-side logic; returns the stamped tick (resent with the next two inputs).
    int64_t sendInput(Client& c, const uint8_t* d, size_t n) { return aurix_net_sync_send_input(s_, c.handle(), d, n); }
    /// Owner-authoritative writes: begin(component).write(field, …)….end(), then sendWrites().
    Sync& begin(int component) { check(aurix_net_sync_write_begin(s_, component)); return *this; }
    Sync& write(int field, double v) { check(aurix_net_sync_write_number(s_, field, v)); return *this; }
    Sync& write(int field, const float* v, int n) { check(aurix_net_sync_write_vector(s_, field, v, n)); return *this; }
    Sync& write(int field, const std::string& s) { check(aurix_net_sync_write_bytes(s_, field, reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(s.data()), s.size())); return *this; }
    Sync& write(int field, const uint8_t* p, size_t n) { check(aurix_net_sync_write_bytes(s_, field, p, n)); return *this; }
    Sync& end() { check(aurix_net_sync_write_end(s_)); return *this; }
    int64_t sendWrites(Client& c) { return aurix_net_sync_send_writes(s_, c.handle()); }
    /// Owner-authoritative ops on entities you own (queued writes feed write/spawn): Fusion-style Spawn/Despawn/authority hand-off.
    int64_t writeEntity(Client& c, uint64_t entity) { return aurix_net_sync_send_op(s_, c.handle(), 0, entity, 0); }
    int64_t spawn(Client& c) { return aurix_net_sync_send_op(s_, c.handle(), 1, 0, 0); }
    int64_t despawn(Client& c, uint64_t entity) { return aurix_net_sync_send_op(s_, c.handle(), 2, entity, 0); }
    int64_t transfer(Client& c, uint64_t entity, int toActor) { return aurix_net_sync_send_op(s_, c.handle(), 3, entity, toActor); }

private:
    static void check(int r) { if (r != 0) throw Error(lastError()); }
    AurixNetSync* s_; int tickHz_; double interp_; double renderTick_ = 0; bool gotDelta_ = false;
};

} // namespace aurix::net

```

`sdk/cpp/aurix_sim.h`:

```h
// aurix-sim C ABI: deterministic fixed-point (Q32.32, raw int64 values) physics 2D/3D, navmesh,
// flow fields, crowd and reference golden hashes. Exported by libaurix_net (crates/net-ffi) and by
// libnet_sim_wasm / net_sim_wasm.wasm (crates/net-sim-wasm). Generated from the Rust sources by
// tools/gen_sim_header.py - edit there. World handles are 1-based (0 = failure); body/joint/agent
// ids are returned as 1-based too where the Rust doc says so; positions and velocities are raw Fx
// (value * 2^32).
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define AURIX_FX_ONE ((int64_t)1 << 32)
static inline int64_t aurix_fx_from_double(double v) { return (int64_t)(v * 4294967296.0); }
static inline double aurix_fx_to_double(int64_t v) { return (double)v / 4294967296.0; }

/* Create a world: gravity (raw Fx), tick rate; returns a handle. */
uint32_t sim_world_new(int64_t gravity_x, int64_t gravity_y, uint32_t tick_hz);

void sim_world_free(uint32_t h);

void sim_step(uint32_t h);

uint32_t sim_tick(uint32_t h);

uint64_t sim_hash(uint32_t h);

/* Snapshot into an internal buffer; returns its length (read with `sim_snapshot_byte`). */
uint32_t sim_snapshot(uint32_t h);

uint32_t sim_snapshot_byte(uint32_t h, uint32_t i);

/* Restore from the internal buffer (fill it with `sim_snapshot_set_byte` first). */
void sim_snapshot_set_len(uint32_t h, uint32_t len);

void sim_snapshot_set_byte(uint32_t h, uint32_t i, uint32_t v);

uint32_t sim_restore(uint32_t h);

uint32_t sim_add_circle(uint32_t h, uint32_t k, int64_t x, int64_t y, int64_t radius, int64_t density);

uint32_t sim_add_box(uint32_t h, uint32_t k, int64_t x, int64_t y, int64_t half_w, int64_t half_h, int64_t density);

uint32_t sim_add_capsule(uint32_t h, uint32_t k, int64_t x, int64_t y, int64_t half_len, int64_t radius, int64_t density);

void sim_remove_body(uint32_t h, uint32_t id);

void sim_set_material(uint32_t h, uint32_t id, int64_t friction, int64_t restitution);

void sim_set_layers(uint32_t h, uint32_t id, uint32_t layer, uint32_t mask, uint32_t sensor);

void sim_apply_impulse(uint32_t h, uint32_t id, int64_t ix, int64_t iy);

/* Body state accessors: field 0..=4 = x, y, angle, vx, vy, 5 = angular velocity. */
int64_t sim_body_get(uint32_t h, uint32_t id, uint32_t field);

/* Character controller over a kinematic body; returns a controller index. */

uint32_t sim_kcc_move(uint32_t h, uint32_t k, int64_t dx, int64_t dy);

/* Reference scenario used to prove cross-target determinism: a box pyramid plus bouncing balls simulated for 240 ticks. Native tests and the wasm build must return the same value. */
uint64_t sim_golden_hash(void);

/* Distance/rope joint between local anchors; `min_len < len` makes it a rope (slack allowed). */

/* Revolute (pin) joint; `has_limits` != 0 enables the [lower, upper] angle range; the motor is active when `max_torque` > 0. */
uint32_t sim_joint_revolute(uint32_t h, uint32_t a, uint32_t b, int64_t ax, int64_t ay, int64_t bx, int64_t by, uint32_t has_limits, int64_t lower, int64_t upper, int64_t motor_speed, int64_t max_torque);

uint32_t sim_joint_weld(uint32_t h, uint32_t a, uint32_t b, int64_t ax, int64_t ay, int64_t bx, int64_t by, int64_t rel_angle);

uint32_t sim_joint_remove(uint32_t h, uint32_t id);

/* Retune a revolute motor at runtime (no-op for other joint kinds). */
void sim_joint_motor(uint32_t h, uint32_t id, int64_t speed, int64_t max_torque);

/* Number of contact begin/end events produced by the last `sim_step`. */
uint32_t sim_events_len(uint32_t h);

/* Event field: 0 = body a, 1 = body b, 2 = begin (1) / end (0). */

/* Grid navmesh: `cols × rows` cells of size `cell` from (ox, oy); blocked cells are given as (col, row) pairs in the snapshot buffer (u32 LE pairs: fill with `sim_snapshot_set_*`). */

`sdk/cpp/echo_test.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "aurix_net.hpp"
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <thread>
#include <unistd.h>
using namespace aurix::net;
int main() {
    const char* key = std::getenv("NET_API_KEY"); if (!key) { std::fprintf(stderr, "NET_API_KEY missing\n"); return 2; }
    const char* env = std::getenv("NET_HTTP"); std::string http = env ? env : "http://127.0.0.1:8090";
    Client a, b; a.connect(http, Client::issueGrant(http, key, "cpp-a", "A")); b.connect(http, Client::issueGrant(http, key, "cpp-b", "B"), true);
    std::string room = "cpp-echo-" + std::to_string(getpid());
    a.joinOrCreate(room, Mode::Relay, 4); b.joinOrCreate(room, Mode::Relay, 4);
    int hello = 0, ticks = 0;
    b.onData = [&](Channel, uint16_t, const uint8_t* d, size_t n) { EventFrame f; if (EventFrame::decode(d, n, f)) { if (f.code == 1) hello++; else if (f.code == 2) ticks++; } };
    const uint8_t hi[] = "hello"; a.sendEvent(1, hi, 5, Target::Others, true);
    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 10; i++) { a.sendEvent(2, &i, 1); a.flush(); std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(16)); }
    for (int s = 0; s < 300 && !(hello && ticks == 10); s++) { b.poll(); std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10)); }
    std::printf("cpp: hello=%d ticks=%d/10 joined=%s\n", hello, ticks, b.joinedJson().substr(0, 60).c_str());
    a.leave(); return (hello && ticks == 10) ? 0 : 1;
}

```

`sdk/cpp/sync_test.cpp`:

```cpp
// Live check of aurix::net::Sync: two clients in an owner-authoritative sync room, A writes its
// Transform every tick, B receives the replicated entity. NET_API_KEY (+ NET_HTTP) required.
#include "aurix_net.hpp"
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <thread>
#include <unistd.h>
using namespace aurix::net;
int main() {
    const char* key = std::getenv("NET_API_KEY"); if (!key) { std::fprintf(stderr, "NET_API_KEY missing\n"); return 2; }
    const char* env = std::getenv("NET_HTTP"); std::string http = env ? env : "http://127.0.0.1:8090";
    const std::string SCHEMA = "component Transform {\n  pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)\n  rot: quat\n}\n";
    Client a, b;
    a.connect(http, Client::issueGrant(http, key, "cpp-sync-a", "A"));
    b.connect(http, Client::issueGrant(http, key, "cpp-sync-b", "B"), true);
    std::string room = "cpp-sync-" + std::to_string(getpid());
    std::string props = "{\"schema\":" + Client::quote(SCHEMA) + "}";
    int actorA = a.joinOrCreate(room, Mode::Sync, 4, props); b.joinOrCreate(room, Mode::Sync, 4, props);
    Sync sa(SCHEMA), sb(SCHEMA);
    int tr = sa.component("Transform"), pos = sa.field(tr, "pos"), rot = sa.field(tr, "rot");
    a.onData = [&](Channel, uint16_t, const uint8_t* d, size_t n) { sa.receive(a, d, n); };
    b.onData = [&](Channel, uint16_t, const uint8_t* d, size_t n) { sb.receive(b, d, n); };
    float x = 0; int updates = 0; float last[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
        x += 0.5f; float p[3] = {x, 1, -2}, q[4] = {0, 0, 0, 1};
        sa.begin(tr).write(pos, p, 3).write(rot, q, 4).end().sendWrites(a); a.flush();
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(16));
        a.poll(); b.poll(); sb.advance(0.016);
        for (auto e = sb.poll(); e.kind != Sync::Kind::None; e = sb.poll())
            if (e.owner == actorA && e.kind != Sync::Kind::Despawn && sb.vector(e.entity, tr, pos, last) == 3) updates++;
    }
    // Let the last writes land (one server tick plus the WS hop) before judging `last`.
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(16));
        a.poll(); b.poll(); sb.advance(0.016);
        for (auto e = sb.poll(); e.kind != Sync::Kind::None; e = sb.poll())
            if (e.owner == actorA && e.kind != Sync::Kind::Despawn && sb.vector(e.entity, tr, pos, last) == 3) updates++;
    }
    int own = 0; uint64_t id; int owner;
    for (int i = 0; sa.entityAt(i, id, owner); i++) if (owner == actorA) own++;
    bool ok = sb.serverTick() > 30 && sb.gaps() == 0 && updates >= 20 && std::fabs(last[0] - x) < 3 && std::fabs(last[1] - 1) < 0.02 && std::fabs(last[2] + 2) < 0.02 && own == 1
              && sb.renderTick() > 0 && sb.renderTick() <= sb.serverTick();
    std::printf("cpp sync: serverTick=%u gaps=%llu updates=%d last=(%.2f %.2f %.2f) x=%.1f own=%d renderTick=%.1f -> %s\n", sb.serverTick(), (unsigned long long)sb.gaps(), updates, last[0], last[1], last[2], x, own, sb.renderTick(), ok ? "ok" : "FAIL");
    a.leave(); b.leave(); return ok ? 0 : 1;
}

```

`sdk/godot/README.md`:

```md
# Aurix Net for Godot 4 (GDExtension)

Build: `git clone -b 4.2 https://github.com/godotengine/godot-cpp` here, `cargo build --release -p net-ffi`
in the repo root, then `scons target=template_debug` (`SConstruct` builds godot-cpp with exceptions on:
`aurix_net.hpp` reports errors by throwing, the wrappers catch them). Copy `bin/` + `aurix_net.gdextension` to
`addons/aurix_net/` together with `libaurix_net.so` / `aurix_net.dll`.

Smoke test without the editor: `check~/` is a minimal project (classes load, sync schema parses, two relay
clients exchange an event, then two more replicate a `Transform` through `AurixNetSync` with 0 gaps).
`cp -r bin ../../target/release/libaurix_net.so check~/addons/aurix_net/bin/`, then
`GRANT_A=... GRANT_B=... GRANT_C=... GRANT_D=... godot --headless --path check~` (grants from
`POST /v1/grants`; without them only the offline part runs). Godot discovers `.gdextension` files when the
project is opened in the editor; headless, `check~/.godot/extension_list.cfg` lists it by hand.

```gdscript
var net := AurixNetClient.new(); add_child(net)   # polls in _process
net.event.connect(func(code, from, payload): print(code, from, payload))
net.connect_to("https://<node>", grant_from_backend)
net.join_or_create("lobby-1", AurixNetClient.MODE_RELAY, 8)
net.send_event(1, "hi".to_utf8_buffer()); net.flush()
```

## Signals added for operator messages

- `notice(text: String, level: String)` — system message pushed by the operator console or the game backend (`level` is `info` or `warn`). Show it in the HUD; it is not a chat message.
- `rehost()` — the room moved to another node during a rolling deploy. Call `rejoin()` with the same grant (the node list from `/v1/regions` works as fallback).

The C++ header exposes the same as `onNotice` / `onRehost` callbacks.

## aurix-sim

`libaurix_net` also carries the deterministic simulation (`src/aurix_sim.h`: 2D/3D physics, navmesh,
crowd, `sim3_*` convex hulls and casts). Call it from your GDExtension code the same way the client
header is used; values are raw Q32.32 (`aurix_fx_from_double`), handles/ids match the Web and Unity
wrappers, and `sim_golden_hash()` etc. let you assert the build is bit-identical to the other SDKs.

## Sync rooms

```gdscript
var client := AurixNetClient.new(); add_child(client)
var world := AurixNetSync.new()
world.setup(SCHEMA)                       # same IDL text as the room's `schema` prop
client.data.connect(func(_ch, _tick, payload): world.receive(client, payload))
world.spawn.connect(func(entity, owner): print("spawned ", entity, " of ", owner))
world.change.connect(func(entity, _owner): var p: Vector3 = world.get_field(entity, "Transform", "pos"))
func _process(dt):
    world.advance(dt)                     # render tick, 2 ticks behind the server
    world.begin_write("Transform"); world.write_field("pos", position); world.end_write(); world.send_writes(client)
    # more entities you own: queue writes, then world.spawn_entity(client); world.write_entity(client, id); world.despawn_entity(client, id); world.transfer_entity(client, id, other_actor)
```
`send_input(client, bytes)` is the raw input for rooms with server-side `logic`.

`sdk/godot/SConstruct`:

```
#!/usr/bin/env python
# Requires godot-cpp checked out next to this file: git clone -b 4.2 https://github.com/godotengine/godot-cpp
import os
# aurix_net.hpp reports failures with exceptions (caught in the wrappers), godot-cpp disables them by default.
ARGUMENTS.setdefault("disable_exceptions", "no")
env = SConscript("godot-cpp/SConstruct")
env.Append(CPPPATH=["src/"], LIBPATH=[os.environ.get("AURIX_NET_LIB", "../../target/release")], LIBS=["aurix_net"])
sources = Glob("src/*.cpp")
lib = env.SharedLibrary("bin/libaurixnet_godot{}{}".format(env["suffix"], env["SHLIBSUFFIX"]), source=sources)
Default(lib)

```

`sdk/godot/check~/main.gd`:

```gd
extends Node

var got := false
var t0 := 0
const SCHEMA := "component Transform {\n  pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)\n  rot: quat\n}\n"
var grant_c := ""; var grant_d := ""; var net_http := ""
var c: AurixNetClient; var d: AurixNetClient
var wc: AurixNetSync; var wd: AurixNetSync
var sync_on := false; var acc := 0.0; var writes := 0; var updates := 0; var x := 0.0; var last := Vector3.ZERO; var drain := 0

func fail(msg: String) -> void:
	printerr("GODOT FAIL: ", msg)
	get_tree().quit(1)

func _ready() -> void:
	for c in ["AurixNetClient", "AurixNetSync"]:
		if not ClassDB.class_exists(c):
			fail("class missing: " + c); return
	var http := OS.get_environment("NET_HTTP")
	if http == "": http = "http://127.0.0.1:8090"
	net_http = http
	var ga := OS.get_environment("GRANT_A"); var gb := OS.get_environment("GRANT_B")
	grant_c = OS.get_environment("GRANT_C"); grant_d = OS.get_environment("GRANT_D")
	var sync := AurixNetSync.new()
	if not sync.setup("component Transform {\n pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)\n}", 20, 2):
		fail("sync setup: " + sync.get_last_error()); return
	if ga == "" or gb == "":
		print("GODOT OK (classes load, sync schema parsed; no grants -> no live check)"); get_tree().quit(0); return
	var a := AurixNetClient.new(); var b := AurixNetClient.new(); add_child(a); add_child(b)
	if not a.connect_to(http, ga, true): fail("a connect: " + a.get_last_error()); return
	if not b.connect_to(http, gb, true): fail("b connect: " + b.get_last_error()); return
	var room := "godot-%d" % (Time.get_ticks_msec() % 100000)
	if a.join_or_create(room, AurixNetClient.MODE_RELAY, 8) < 0: fail("a join: " + a.get_last_error()); return
	if b.join_or_create(room, AurixNetClient.MODE_RELAY, 8) < 0: fail("b join: " + b.get_last_error()); return
	b.event.connect(func(code, from, payload): 
		print("b got event code=%d from=%d payload=%s" % [code, from, payload.get_string_from_utf8()])
		got = true)
	t0 = Time.get_ticks_msec()

func _process(dt: float) -> void:
	if sync_on: _sync_step(dt); return
	if t0 == 0: return
	var a := get_child(0) as AurixNetClient
	if (Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0) % 200 < 20:
		a.send_event(1, "hi".to_utf8_buffer()); a.flush()
	if got:
		print("relay ok: joined=", a.get_joined_json().substr(0, 60)); t0 = 0; _start_sync()
	elif Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0 > 10000:
		fail("no event within 10 s; a.err=" + a.get_last_error()); t0 = 0

func _start_sync() -> void:
	if grant_c == "" or grant_d == "":
		print("GODOT OK (relay only; set GRANT_C/GRANT_D for the sync check)"); get_tree().quit(0); return
	c = AurixNetClient.new(); d = AurixNetClient.new(); add_child(c); add_child(d)
	if not c.connect_to(net_http, grant_c, true): fail("c connect: " + c.get_last_error()); return
	if not d.connect_to(net_http, grant_d, true): fail("d connect: " + d.get_last_error()); return
	var props := JSON.stringify({"schema": SCHEMA})
	var room := "godot-sync-%d" % (Time.get_ticks_msec() % 100000)
	if c.join_or_create(room, AurixNetClient.MODE_SYNC, 4, props) < 0: fail("c join: " + c.get_last_error()); return
	if d.join_or_create(room, AurixNetClient.MODE_SYNC, 4, props) < 0: fail("d join: " + d.get_last_error()); return
	wc = AurixNetSync.new(); wd = AurixNetSync.new()
	if not wc.setup(SCHEMA, 20, 2) or not wd.setup(SCHEMA, 20, 2): fail("sync setup: " + wd.get_last_error()); return
	c.data.connect(func(_ch, _tick, payload): wc.receive(c, payload))
	d.data.connect(func(_ch, _tick, payload): wd.receive(d, payload))
	wd.change.connect(func(entity, owner):
		if owner == c.get_actor():
			updates += 1; last = wd.get_field(entity, "Transform", "pos"))
	sync_on = true

func _sync_step(dt: float) -> void:
	acc += dt
	if acc < 0.016: return
	acc = 0.0
	wd.advance(0.016)
	if writes < 90:
		writes += 1; x += 0.5
		if not wc.begin_write("Transform"): fail("begin_write: " + wc.get_last_error()); sync_on = false; return
		wc.write_field("pos", Vector3(x, 1, -2)); wc.write_field("rot", Quaternion.IDENTITY); wc.end_write()
		wc.send_writes(c); c.flush()
		return
	drain += 1
	if drain < 20: return
	sync_on = false
	var ok: bool = wd.get_server_tick() > 30 and wd.get_gaps() == 0 and updates >= 20 and abs(last.x - x) < 3 and abs(last.y - 1) < 0.02 and abs(last.z + 2) < 0.02 and wd.get_entities().size() >= 1
	print("godot sync: serverTick=%d gaps=%d updates=%d last=%s x=%.1f entities=%d renderTick=%.1f -> %s" % [wd.get_server_tick(), wd.get_gaps(), updates, last, x, wd.get_entities().size(), wd.get_render_tick(), "ok" if ok else "FAIL"])
	if ok: print("GODOT OK"); get_tree().quit(0)
	else: fail("sync replication")

    AURIX_NET_EVENT_NONE = 0,
    AURIX_NET_EVENT_CONTROL = 1,    /* json = server control message */
    AURIX_NET_EVENT_DATA = 2,       /* data/data_len on channel */
    AURIX_NET_EVENT_DATA_READY = 3,

};

`sdk/godot/src/aurix_net.hpp`:

```hpp
// Header-only C++17 wrapper over libaurix_net (aurix_net.h). Used by the Godot SDK.
#pragma once
#include "aurix_net.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace aurix::net {

enum class Channel : uint8_t { Unreliable = 0, Reliable = 1, ReliableUnordered = 2 };
enum class Target : int32_t { All = 0, Others = 1, Master = 2, Actors = 3 };
enum class Mode { Relay, Sync, Lockstep };

struct Error : std::runtime_error { using std::runtime_error::runtime_error; };

inline std::string lastError() { const char* e = aurix_net_last_error(); return e ? e : "unknown error"; }

// Relay event frame: u8 code, u8 flags, u16 from (BE), [u16 group], [u16 n, n*u16], payload.
struct EventFrame {
    uint8_t code = 0; uint16_t from = 0; bool hasGroup = false; uint16_t group = 0;
    const uint8_t* payload = nullptr; size_t len = 0;
    static bool decode(const uint8_t* b, size_t n, EventFrame& f) {
        if (!b || n < 4) return false;
        f.code = b[0]; uint8_t flags = b[1]; f.from = uint16_t((b[2] << 8) | b[3]); size_t o = 4;
        if (flags & 0x10) { if (n < o + 2) return false; f.hasGroup = true; f.group = (uint16_t)((b[o] << 8) | b[o + 1]); o += 2; }
        if ((flags & 3) == 3) { if (n < o + 2) return false; size_t c = (b[o] << 8) | b[o + 1]; o += 2 + c * 2; if (n < o) return false; }
        f.payload = b + o; f.len = n - o; return true;
    }
};

class Client {
public:
    std::function<void(const std::string& json)> onControl;
    /// System notice from the operator or game backend: (text, level = "info" | "warn").
    std::function<void(const std::string& text, const std::string& level)> onNotice;
    /// The room moved to another node: rejoin with the same grant (see fallback URLs).
    std::function<void()> onRehost;
    // Minimal extraction of a top-level string field from a control message (no JSON dependency).
    static std::string jsonStr(const std::string& j, const char* key) {
        std::string k = std::string("\"") + key + "\":";
        size_t p = j.find(k);
        if (p == std::string::npos) return "";
        p += k.size();
        while (p < j.size() && j[p] == ' ') ++p;
        if (p >= j.size() || j[p] != '"') return "";
        std::string out;
        for (++p; p < j.size() && j[p] != '"'; ++p) {
            if (j[p] == '\\' && p + 1 < j.size()) { ++p; out += (j[p] == 'n' ? '\n' : j[p]); }
            else out += j[p];
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::function<void(Channel, uint16_t tick, const uint8_t*, size_t)> onData;
    std::function<void()> onDataReady;
    std::function<void(const std::string& reason)> onClosed;

    Client() = default;
    Client(const Client&) = delete; Client& operator=(const Client&) = delete;
    Client(Client&& o) noexcept : h_(o.h_), actor_(o.actor_) { o.h_ = nullptr; }
    ~Client() { destroy(); }

    static std::string version() { return aurix_net_version(); }
    /// Backend/tooling only.
    static std::string issueGrant(const std::string& http, const std::string& apiKey, const std::string& player, const std::string& name) {
        char* g = aurix_net_issue_grant(http.c_str(), apiKey.c_str(), player.c_str(), name.c_str());
        if (!g) throw Error(lastError());
        std::string s(g); aurix_net_string_free(g); return s;
    }

    void connect(const std::string& http, const std::string& grant, bool tunnel = false) {
        destroy();
        h_ = aurix_net_connect(http.c_str(), grant.c_str(), tunnel ? 1 : 0);
        if (!h_) throw Error(lastError());
    }
    bool connected() const { return h_ != nullptr; }
    AurixNetClient* handle() const { return h_; }
    int actor() const { return actor_; }

    /// Protocol JSON, e.g. {"t":"set_room_props","props":{...}}.
    void sendControl(const std::string& json) { if (aurix_net_send_control(h_, json.c_str()) != 0) throw Error(lastError()); }

    int joinOrCreate(const std::string& name, Mode mode = Mode::Relay, int maxPlayers = 8, const std::string& propsJson = "") {
        std::string j = "{\"t\":\"join_or_create\",\"name\":" + quote(name) + ",\"mode\":\"" + modeName(mode) + "\",\"max_players\":" + std::to_string(maxPlayers);
        if (!propsJson.empty()) j += ",\"props\":" + propsJson;
        return joinJson(j + "}");
    }
    int join(const std::string& name, const std::string& schemaHash = "") {
        std::string j = "{\"t\":\"join\",\"name\":" + quote(name);
        if (!schemaHash.empty()) j += ",\"schema_hash\":" + quote(schemaHash);
        return joinJson(j + "}");
    }
    int joinJson(const std::string& json) {
        int a = aurix_net_join(h_, json.c_str());
        if (a < 0) throw Error(lastError());
        actor_ = a; return a;
    }
    std::string joinedJson() const { char* s = aurix_net_joined_json(h_); if (!s) return ""; std::string r(s); aurix_net_string_free(s); return r; }

    void sendEvent(uint8_t code, const uint8_t* data, size_t len, Target target = Target::Others, bool reliable = false, const std::vector<uint16_t>& actors = {}) {
        if (aurix_net_send_event(h_, code, int32_t(target), actors.empty() ? nullptr : actors.data(), actors.size(), data, len, reliable ? 1 : 0) != 0) throw Error(lastError());
    }
    void sendData(Channel ch, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) { if (aurix_net_send_data(h_, uint8_t(ch), data, len) != 0) throw Error(lastError()); }
    /// Push queued unreliable messages; call once per frame.
    void flush() { aurix_net_flush(h_); }

    /// Dispatch pending events; call every frame on the game thread.
    int poll(int maxEvents = 256) {
        int n = 0; AurixNetEvent ev;
        while (n < maxEvents && aurix_net_poll(h_, &ev) == 1) {
            ++n;
            switch (ev.kind) {
                case AURIX_NET_EVENT_CONTROL: {
                    std::string j = ev.json ? ev.json : "";
                    if (onControl) onControl(j);
                    std::string t = jsonStr(j, "t");
                    if (t == "notice" && onNotice) onNotice(jsonStr(j, "text"), jsonStr(j, "level"));
                    if (t == "left" && onRehost && jsonStr(j, "reason") == "rehost") onRehost();
                    break;
                }
                case AURIX_NET_EVENT_DATA: if (onData) onData(Channel(ev.channel), ev.tick, ev.data, ev.data_len); break;
                case AURIX_NET_EVENT_DATA_READY: if (onDataReady) onDataReady(); break;
                case AURIX_NET_EVENT_CLOSED: if (onClosed) onClosed(ev.json ? ev.json : ""); break;
                default: break;
            }
            aurix_net_event_free(&ev);
        }
        return n;
    }

    void leave() { if (h_) aurix_net_leave(h_); }
    void destroy() { if (h_) { aurix_net_destroy(h_); h_ = nullptr; actor_ = -1; } }

    static std::string quote(const std::string& s) {
        std::string o = "\"";
        for (unsigned char c : s) {
            if (c == '"' || c == '\\') { o += '\\'; o += char(c); }
            else if (c < 0x20) { char b[8]; snprintf(b, sizeof b, "\\u%04x", c); o += b; }
            else o += char(c);
        }
        return o + "\"";
    }
    static const char* modeName(Mode m) { return m == Mode::Relay ? "relay" : m == Mode::Sync ? "sync" : "lockstep"; }

private:
    AurixNetClient* h_ = nullptr; int actor_ = -1;
};

/// Lockstep room helper: feed every Data payload to receive(), step your deterministic simulation
/// on each Tick, answer Restore/CheckpointReq/DumpReq. Input delay adapts to the node's margin reports.
class Lockstep {
public:
    enum class Kind { None = 0, Tick = 1, Restore = 2, CheckpointReq = 3, DumpReq = 4 };
    struct Input { uint16_t actor; const uint8_t* data; size_t len; };
    struct Event { Kind kind; uint32_t tick; uint64_t hash; std::vector<Input> inputs; const uint8_t* state; size_t stateLen; };

    Lockstep() : ls_(aurix_net_lockstep_new()) {}
    ~Lockstep() { aurix_net_lockstep_destroy(ls_); }
    Lockstep(const Lockstep&) = delete; Lockstep& operator=(const Lockstep&) = delete;

    /// True when the payload was a lockstep frame (events may now be pending in poll()).
    bool receive(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) { return aurix_net_lockstep_receive(ls_, data, len) == 1; }
    /// Next event; Event::kind == Kind::None when there is nothing. Pointers stay valid until the next poll().
    Event poll() {
        AurixNetLsEvent e{}; Event out{Kind::None, 0, 0, {}, nullptr, 0};
        if (aurix_net_lockstep_poll(ls_, &e) != 1) return out;
        out.kind = Kind(e.kind); out.tick = e.tick; out.hash = e.hash; out.state = e.state; out.stateLen = e.state_len;
        for (uint16_t i = 0; i < e.inputs; i++) { Input in{}; if (aurix_net_lockstep_input(ls_, i, &in.actor, &in.data, &in.len) == 1) out.inputs.push_back(in); }
        return out;
    }
    /// Sends this tick's local input through the client; returns the tick it was stamped with (or -1).
    int64_t sendInput(Client& c, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) { return aurix_net_lockstep_send_input(ls_, c.handle(), data, len); }
    static void reportHash(Client& c, uint32_t tick, uint64_t hash) { aurix_net_lockstep_report_hash(c.handle(), tick, hash); }
    static void sendCheckpoint(Client& c, uint32_t tick, uint64_t hash, const uint8_t* s, size_t n) { aurix_net_lockstep_send_checkpoint(c.handle(), tick, hash, s, n); }
    static void sendDump(Client& c, uint32_t tick, uint64_t hash, const uint8_t* s, size_t n) { aurix_net_lockstep_send_dump(c.handle(), tick, hash, s, n); }
    static uint64_t fnv1a(const uint8_t* s, size_t n) { return aurix_net_lockstep_fnv1a(s, n); }

    int64_t get(int32_t key) const { return aurix_net_lockstep_get(ls_, key); }
    void set(int32_t key, int64_t v) { aurix_net_lockstep_set(ls_, key, v); }
    uint32_t inputDelay() const { return uint32_t(get(AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY)); }
    void setInputDelay(uint32_t d, uint32_t min = 1, uint32_t max = 8, bool adaptive = true) {
        set(AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY, d); set(AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY_MIN, min); set(AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_DELAY_MAX, max); set(AURIX_NET_LS_ADAPTIVE_DELAY, adaptive ? 1 : 0);
    }
    void setInputRedundancy(uint32_t n) { set(AURIX_NET_LS_INPUT_REDUNDANCY, n); }
    uint32_t confirmedTick() const { return uint32_t(get(AURIX_NET_LS_CONFIRMED_TICK)); }
    uint32_t serverTick() const { return uint32_t(get(AURIX_NET_LS_SERVER_TICK)); }
    int lastMargin() const { return int(get(AURIX_NET_LS_LAST_MARGIN)); }
    int64_t lateInputs() const { return get(AURIX_NET_LS_LATE_INPUTS); }

private:
    AurixNetLockstep* ls_;
};

/// Sync room helper (mirrors the Web `SyncSession`): feed every Data payload to receive() — it applies
/// the delta and sends the ack — then poll() spawn/change/despawn, read fields by name, and send raw
/// inputs (rooms with `logic`) or owner-authoritative component writes. renderTick() lags the server by
/// `interpolationTicks` for smoothing remote entities.
class Sync {
public:
    enum class Kind { None = 0, Spawn = 1, Change = 2, Despawn = 3 };
    struct Event { Kind kind; uint64_t entity; int owner; };

    explicit Sync(const std::string& schema, int tickHz = 60, int interpolationTicks = 2)
        : s_(aurix_net_sync_new(schema.c_str())), tickHz_(tickHz), interp_(interpolationTicks) {
        if (!s_) throw Error(lastError());
    }
    ~Sync() { aurix_net_sync_destroy(s_); }
    Sync(const Sync&) = delete; Sync& operator=(const Sync&) = delete;

    /// True when the payload was a delta: it is applied, the ack goes out through `c`, events wait in poll().
    bool receive(Client& c, const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
        uint8_t ack[9];
        int r = aurix_net_sync_receive(s_, d, n, ack);
        if (r < 0) throw Error(lastError());
        if (r != 1) return false;
        c.sendData(Channel::Unreliable, ack, sizeof ack);
        double lag = double(serverTick()) - interp_;
        if (lag > renderTick_) renderTick_ = lag;
        gotDelta_ = true;
        return true;
    }
    Event poll() {
        AurixNetSyncEvent e{}; Event out{Kind::None, 0, -1};
        if (aurix_net_sync_poll(s_, &e) == 1) { out.kind = Kind(e.kind); out.entity = e.entity; out.owner = e.owner; }
        return out;
    }
    uint32_t serverTick() const { return aurix_net_sync_server_tick(s_); }
    uint64_t gaps() const { return aurix_net_sync_gaps(s_); }
    /// Call once per frame; returns the render tick (fractional, `interpolationTicks` behind the server).
    double advance(double dtSeconds) { if (gotDelta_) renderTick_ += dtSeconds * tickHz_; return renderTick_; }
    double renderTick() const { return renderTick_; }

    int entityCount() const { return aurix_net_sync_entity_count(s_); }
    bool entityAt(int index, uint64_t& id, int& owner) const {
        int32_t o = -1; int r = aurix_net_sync_entity_at(s_, index, &id, &o); owner = o; return r == 1;
    }
    int component(const char* name) const { return aurix_net_sync_component(s_, name); }
    int field(int component, const char* name) const { return aurix_net_sync_field(s_, component, name); }
    bool has(uint64_t entity, int component) const { return aurix_net_sync_has(s_, entity, component) == 1; }
    bool number(uint64_t entity, int component, int field, double& out) const { return aurix_net_sync_get_number(s_, entity, component, field, &out) == 1; }
    /// Fills out[0..n) and returns n (2 vec2, 3 vec3, 4 quat x,y,z,w, 1 scalar), 0 when missing.
    int vector(uint64_t entity, int component, int field, float out[4]) const { return aurix_net_sync_get_vector(s_, entity, component, field, out); }
    std::string text(uint64_t entity, int component, int field) const {
        int n = aurix_net_sync_get_bytes(s_, entity, component, field, nullptr, 0);
        if (n <= 0) return {};
        std::string s(size_t(n), '\0');
        aurix_net_sync_get_bytes(s_, entity, component, field, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&s[0]), s.size());
        return s;
    }

    /// Raw input for server-side logic; returns the stamped tick (resent with the next two inputs).
    int64_t sendInput(Client& c, const uint8_t* d, size_t n) { return aurix_net_sync_send_input(s_, c.handle(), d, n); }
    /// Owner-authoritative writes: begin(component).write(field, …)….end(), then sendWrites().
    Sync& begin(int component) { check(aurix_net_sync_write_begin(s_, component)); return *this; }
    Sync& write(int field, double v) { check(aurix_net_sync_write_number(s_, field, v)); return *this; }
    Sync& write(int field, const float* v, int n) { check(aurix_net_sync_write_vector(s_, field, v, n)); return *this; }
    Sync& write(int field, const std::string& s) { check(aurix_net_sync_write_bytes(s_, field, reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(s.data()), s.size())); return *this; }
    Sync& write(int field, const uint8_t* p, size_t n) { check(aurix_net_sync_write_bytes(s_, field, p, n)); return *this; }
    Sync& end() { check(aurix_net_sync_write_end(s_)); return *this; }
    int64_t sendWrites(Client& c) { return aurix_net_sync_send_writes(s_, c.handle()); }
    /// Owner-authoritative ops on entities you own (queued writes feed write/spawn): Fusion-style Spawn/Despawn/authority hand-off.
    int64_t writeEntity(Client& c, uint64_t entity) { return aurix_net_sync_send_op(s_, c.handle(), 0, entity, 0); }
    int64_t spawn(Client& c) { return aurix_net_sync_send_op(s_, c.handle(), 1, 0, 0); }
    int64_t despawn(Client& c, uint64_t entity) { return aurix_net_sync_send_op(s_, c.handle(), 2, entity, 0); }
    int64_t transfer(Client& c, uint64_t entity, int toActor) { return aurix_net_sync_send_op(s_, c.handle(), 3, entity, toActor); }

private:
    static void check(int r) { if (r != 0) throw Error(lastError()); }
    AurixNetSync* s_; int tickHz_; double interp_; double renderTick_ = 0; bool gotDelta_ = false;
};

} // namespace aurix::net
