```cpp
#include "aurix_net_client.h"
#include <godot_cpp/core/class_db.hpp>

namespace godot {

static std::string to_std(const String &s) { return std::string(s.utf8().get_data()); }
static PackedByteArray to_pba(const uint8_t *d, size_t n) { PackedByteArray p; p.resize(n); if (n) memcpy(p.ptrw(), d, n); return p; }

void AurixNetClient::_bind_methods() {
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("connect_to", "http_url", "grant", "force_tunnel"), &AurixNetClient::connect_to, DEFVAL(false));
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("join_or_create", "room", "mode", "max_players", "props_json"), &AurixNetClient::join_or_create, DEFVAL(MODE_RELAY), DEFVAL(8), DEFVAL(""));
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("join", "room", "schema_hash"), &AurixNetClient::join, DEFVAL(""));
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("send_control", "json"), &AurixNetClient::send_control);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("send_event", "code", "payload", "target", "reliable"), &AurixNetClient::send_event, DEFVAL(TARGET_OTHERS), DEFVAL(false));
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("send_data", "channel", "payload"), &AurixNetClient::send_data);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("flush"), &AurixNetClient::flush);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("poll", "max_events"), &AurixNetClient::poll, DEFVAL(256));
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("leave"), &AurixNetClient::leave);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("disconnect_from"), &AurixNetClient::disconnect_from);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_actor"), &AurixNetClient::get_actor);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("is_connected_to"), &AurixNetClient::is_connected_to);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_joined_json"), &AurixNetClient::get_joined_json);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_last_error"), &AurixNetClient::get_last_error);
    ADD_SIGNAL(MethodInfo("control", PropertyInfo(Variant::STRING, "json")));
    ADD_SIGNAL(MethodInfo("event", PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "code"), PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "from_actor"), PropertyInfo(Variant::PACKED_BYTE_ARRAY, "payload")));
    ADD_SIGNAL(MethodInfo("data", PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "channel"), PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "tick"), PropertyInfo(Variant::PACKED_BYTE_ARRAY, "payload")));
    ADD_SIGNAL(MethodInfo("closed", PropertyInfo(Variant::STRING, "reason")));
    ADD_SIGNAL(MethodInfo("notice", PropertyInfo(Variant::STRING, "text"), PropertyInfo(Variant::STRING, "level")));
    ADD_SIGNAL(MethodInfo("rehost"));
    BIND_ENUM_CONSTANT(MODE_RELAY); BIND_ENUM_CONSTANT(MODE_SYNC); BIND_ENUM_CONSTANT(MODE_LOCKSTEP);
    BIND_ENUM_CONSTANT(TARGET_ALL); BIND_ENUM_CONSTANT(TARGET_OTHERS); BIND_ENUM_CONSTANT(TARGET_MASTER);
}

void AurixNetClient::hook() {
    if (hooked_) return;
    hooked_ = true;
    client_.onControl = [this](const std::string &j) { emit_signal("control", String::utf8(j.c_str())); };
    client_.onClosed = [this](const std::string &r) { emit_signal("closed", String::utf8(r.c_str())); };
    client_.onNotice = [this](const std::string &text, const std::string &level) { emit_signal("notice", String::utf8(text.c_str()), String::utf8(level.c_str())); };
    client_.onRehost = [this]() { emit_signal("rehost"); };
    client_.onData = [this](aurix::net::Channel ch, uint16_t tick, const uint8_t *d, size_t n) {
        emit_signal("data", (int)ch, (int)tick, to_pba(d, n));
        aurix::net::EventFrame f;
        if (aurix::net::EventFrame::decode(d, n, f)) emit_signal("event", (int)f.code, (int)f.from, to_pba(f.payload, f.len));
    };
}

#define AURIX_TRY(expr, fail) try { expr; } catch (const std::exception &e) { last_error_ = e.what(); return fail; }

bool AurixNetClient::connect_to(const String &http_url, const String &grant, bool force_tunnel) {
    AURIX_TRY(client_.connect(to_std(http_url), to_std(grant), force_tunnel); hook(); return true, false);
}
int AurixNetClient::join_or_create(const String &room, int mode, int max_players, const String &props_json) {
    AURIX_TRY(return client_.joinOrCreate(to_std(room), (aurix::net::Mode)mode, max_players, to_std(props_json)), -1);
}
int AurixNetClient::join(const String &room, const String &schema_hash) {
    AURIX_TRY(return client_.join(to_std(room), to_std(schema_hash)), -1);
}
bool AurixNetClient::send_control(const String &json) { AURIX_TRY(client_.sendControl(to_std(json)); return true, false); }
bool AurixNetClient::send_event(int code, const PackedByteArray &payload, int target, bool reliable) {
    AURIX_TRY(client_.sendEvent((uint8_t)code, payload.ptr(), payload.size(), (aurix::net::Target)target, reliable); return true, false);
}
bool AurixNetClient::send_data(int channel, const PackedByteArray &payload) {
    AURIX_TRY(client_.sendData((aurix::net::Channel)channel, payload.ptr(), payload.size()); return true, false);
}
void AurixNetClient::flush() { if (client_.connected()) client_.flush(); }
int AurixNetClient::poll(int max_events) { return client_.connected() ? client_.poll(max_events) : 0; }
void AurixNetClient::leave() { client_.leave(); }
void AurixNetClient::disconnect_from() { client_.destroy(); }
void AurixNetClient::_process(double) { poll(); }

} // namespace godot
```

```h
class AurixNetClient : public Node {
```

`sdk/godot/src/aurix_net_sync.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "aurix_net_sync.h"
#include <godot_cpp/core/class_db.hpp>

namespace godot {

static std::string to_std(const String &s) { return std::string(s.utf8().get_data()); }

void AurixNetSync::_bind_methods() {
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("setup", "schema", "tick_hz", "interpolation_ticks"), &AurixNetSync::setup, DEFVAL(60), DEFVAL(2));
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("receive", "client", "payload"), &AurixNetSync::receive);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_server_tick"), &AurixNetSync::get_server_tick);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_gaps"), &AurixNetSync::get_gaps);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("advance", "dt"), &AurixNetSync::advance);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_render_tick"), &AurixNetSync::get_render_tick);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_entities"), &AurixNetSync::get_entities);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_owner", "entity"), &AurixNetSync::get_owner);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("has", "entity", "component"), &AurixNetSync::has);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_field", "entity", "component", "field"), &AurixNetSync::get_field);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("send_input", "client", "body"), &AurixNetSync::send_input);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("begin_write", "component"), &AurixNetSync::begin_write);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("write_field", "field", "value"), &AurixNetSync::write_field);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("end_write"), &AurixNetSync::end_write);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("send_writes", "client"), &AurixNetSync::send_writes);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("write_entity", "client", "entity"), &AurixNetSync::write_entity);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("spawn_entity", "client"), &AurixNetSync::spawn_entity);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("despawn_entity", "client", "entity"), &AurixNetSync::despawn_entity);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("transfer_entity", "client", "entity", "to_actor"), &AurixNetSync::transfer_entity);
    ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_last_error"), &AurixNetSync::get_last_error);
    ADD_SIGNAL(MethodInfo("spawn", PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "entity"), PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "owner")));
    ADD_SIGNAL(MethodInfo("change", PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "entity"), PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "owner")));
    ADD_SIGNAL(MethodInfo("despawn", PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "entity")));
}

#define AURIX_TRY(fail, ...) try { __VA_ARGS__; } catch (const std::exception &e) { last_error_ = e.what(); return fail; }

bool AurixNetSync::setup(const String &schema, int tick_hz, int interpolation_ticks) {
    AURIX_TRY(false, sync_ = std::make_unique<aurix::net::Sync>(to_std(schema), tick_hz, interpolation_ticks); return true);
}

bool AurixNetSync::receive(AurixNetClient *client, const PackedByteArray &payload) {
    if (!sync_ || !client) return false;
    bool delta = false;
    AURIX_TRY(false, delta = sync_->receive(client->raw(), payload.ptr(), payload.size()));
    if (!delta) return false;
    for (auto e = sync_->poll(); e.kind != aurix::net::Sync::Kind::None; e = sync_->poll()) {
        switch (e.kind) {
            case aurix::net::Sync::Kind::Spawn: emit_signal("spawn", (int64_t)e.entity, e.owner); break;
            case aurix::net::Sync::Kind::Change: emit_signal("change", (int64_t)e.entity, e.owner); break;
            case aurix::net::Sync::Kind::Despawn: emit_signal("despawn", (int64_t)e.entity); break;
            default: break;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

PackedInt64Array AurixNetSync::get_entities() const {
    PackedInt64Array out;
    if (!sync_) return out;
    uint64_t id; int owner;
    for (int i = 0; sync_->entityAt(i, id, owner); i++) out.push_back((int64_t)id);
    return out;
}

int AurixNetSync::get_owner(int64_t entity) const {
    if (!sync_) return -1;
    uint64_t id; int owner;
    for (int i = 0; sync_->entityAt(i, id, owner); i++) if (id == (uint64_t)entity) return owner;
    return -1;
}

bool AurixNetSync::has(int64_t entity, const String &component) const {
    if (!sync_) return false;
    int c = sync_->component(to_std(component).c_str());
    return c >= 0 && sync_->has((uint64_t)entity, c);
}

Variant AurixNetSync::get_field(int64_t entity, const String &component, const String &field) const {
    if (!sync_) return Variant();
    int c = sync_->component(to_std(component).c_str());
    int f = c >= 0 ? sync_->field(c, to_std(field).c_str()) : -1;
    if (f < 0) return Variant();
    float v[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    switch (sync_->vector((uint64_t)entity, c, f, v)) {
        case 2: return Vector2(v[0], v[1]);
        case 3: return Vector3(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
        case 4: return Quaternion(v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3]);
        case 1: { double d; if (sync_->number((uint64_t)entity, c, f, d)) return d; return (double)v[0]; }
        default: break;
    }
    std::string t = sync_->text((uint64_t)entity, c, f);
    return t.empty() && !sync_->has((uint64_t)entity, c) ? Variant() : Variant(String::utf8(t.c_str(), (int)t.size()));
}

int AurixNetSync::send_input(AurixNetClient *client, const PackedByteArray &body) {
    if (!sync_ || !client) return -1;
    return (int)sync_->sendInput(client->raw(), body.ptr(), body.size());
}

bool AurixNetSync::begin_write(const String &component) {
    if (!sync_) return false;
    int c = sync_->component(to_std(component).c_str());
    if (c < 0) { last_error_ = "unknown component " + component; return false; }
    AURIX_TRY(false, sync_->begin(c); current_ = c; return true);
}

bool AurixNetSync::write_field(const String &field, const Variant &value) {
    if (!sync_) return false;
    // the component under construction is the last begin(); resolve the field through it
    AURIX_TRY(false, {
        int c = current_;
        int f = sync_->field(c, to_std(field).c_str());
        if (f < 0) { last_error_ = "unknown field " + field; return false; }
        switch (value.get_type()) {
            case Variant::VECTOR2: { Vector2 a = value; float v[2] = {(float)a.x, (float)a.y}; sync_->write(f, v, 2); break; }
            case Variant::VECTOR3: { Vector3 a = value; float v[3] = {(float)a.x, (float)a.y, (float)a.z}; sync_->write(f, v, 3); break; }
            case Variant::QUATERNION: { Quaternion q = value; float v[4] = {(float)q.x, (float)q.y, (float)q.z, (float)q.w}; sync_->write(f, v, 4); break; }
            case Variant::STRING: { std::string s = to_std(value); sync_->write(f, s); break; }
            case Variant::PACKED_BYTE_ARRAY: { PackedByteArray b = value; sync_->write(f, b.ptr(), b.size()); break; }
            default: sync_->write(f, (double)value); break;
        }
        return true;
    });
    return false;
}

bool AurixNetSync::end_write() {
    if (!sync_) return false;
    AURIX_TRY(false, sync_->end(); return true);
}

int AurixNetSync::send_writes(AurixNetClient *client) {
    if (!sync_ || !client) return -1;
    return (int)sync_->sendWrites(client->raw());
}

// Owner-authoritative ops on entities this actor owns (queued begin_write/end_write feed write/spawn).
int AurixNetSync::write_entity(AurixNetClient *client, int64_t entity) {
    if (!sync_ || !client) return -1;
    return (int)sync_->writeEntity(client->raw(), (uint64_t)entity);
}
int AurixNetSync::spawn_entity(AurixNetClient *client) {
    if (!sync_ || !client) return -1;
    return (int)sync_->spawn(client->raw());
}
int AurixNetSync::despawn_entity(AurixNetClient *client, int64_t entity) {
    if (!sync_ || !client) return -1;
    return (int)sync_->despawn(client->raw(), (uint64_t)entity);
}
int AurixNetSync::transfer_entity(AurixNetClient *client, int64_t entity, int to_actor) {
    if (!sync_ || !client) return -1;
    return (int)sync_->transfer(client->raw(), (uint64_t)entity, to_actor);
}

} // namespace godot

```

```h
#pragma once
#include <godot_cpp/classes/ref_counted.hpp>
#include <godot_cpp/variant/packed_byte_array.hpp>
#include <godot_cpp/variant/packed_int64_array.hpp>
#include <godot_cpp/variant/variant.hpp>
#include <memory>
#include "aurix_net.hpp"
#include "aurix_net_client.h"

namespace godot {

/// Client-side replicated world of a sync room: feed every `data` payload of an AurixNetClient to
/// receive(); it applies the delta, acks it and emits spawn/change/despawn. Fields are read by
/// component/field name as Godot values (Vector2/Vector3/Quaternion/float/String/PackedByteArray).
class AurixNetSync : public RefCounted {
    GDCLASS(AurixNetSync, RefCounted)
    std::unique_ptr<aurix::net::Sync> sync_;
    String last_error_;
    int current_ = -1;

protected:
    static void _bind_methods();

public:
    bool setup(const String &schema, int tick_hz = 60, int interpolation_ticks = 2);
    bool receive(AurixNetClient *client, const PackedByteArray &payload);
    int get_server_tick() const { return sync_ ? (int)sync_->serverTick() : 0; }
    int get_gaps() const { return sync_ ? (int)sync_->gaps() : 0; }
    double advance(double dt) { return sync_ ? sync_->advance(dt) : 0.0; }
    double get_render_tick() const { return sync_ ? sync_->renderTick() : 0.0; }
    PackedInt64Array get_entities() const;
    int get_owner(int64_t entity) const;
    bool has(int64_t entity, const String &component) const;
    Variant get_field(int64_t entity, const String &component, const String &field) const;
    int send_input(AurixNetClient *client, const PackedByteArray &body);
    bool begin_write(const String &component);
    bool write_field(const String &field, const Variant &value);
    bool end_write();
    int send_writes(AurixNetClient *client);
    int write_entity(AurixNetClient *client, int64_t entity);
    int spawn_entity(AurixNetClient *client);
    int despawn_entity(AurixNetClient *client, int64_t entity);
    int transfer_entity(AurixNetClient *client, int64_t entity, int to_actor);
    String get_last_error() const { return last_error_; }
};

} // namespace godot
```

```h
// aurix-sim C ABI: deterministic fixed-point (Q32.32, raw int64 values) physics 2D/3D, navmesh,
// flow fields, crowd and reference golden hashes. Exported by libaurix_net (crates/net-ffi) and by
// libnet_sim_wasm / net_sim_wasm.wasm (crates/net-sim-wasm). Generated from the Rust sources by
// tools/gen_sim_header.py - edit there. World handles are 1-based (0 = failure); body/joint/agent
// ids are returned as 1-based too where the Rust doc says so; positions and velocities are raw Fx
// (value * 2^32).
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define AURIX_FX_ONE ((int64_t)1 << 32)
static inline int64_t aurix_fx_from_double(double v) { return (int64_t)(v * 4294967296.0); }
static inline double aurix_fx_to_double(int64_t v) { return (double)v / 4294967296.0; }

/* Create a world: gravity (raw Fx), tick rate; returns a handle. */
uint32_t sim_world_new(int64_t gravity_x, int64_t gravity_y, uint32_t tick_hz);

uint32_t sim_snapshot_byte(uint32_t h, uint32_t i);

/* Restore from the internal buffer (fill it with `sim_snapshot_set_byte` first). */
void sim_snapshot_set_len(uint32_t h, uint32_t len);

void sim_snapshot_set_byte(uint32_t h, uint32_t i, uint32_t v);

uint32_t sim_restore(uint32_t h);

uint32_t sim_add_circle(uint32_t h, uint32_t k, int64_t x, int64_t y, int64_t radius, int64_t density);

uint32_t sim_add_box(uint32_t h, uint32_t k, int64_t x, int64_t y, int64_t half_w, int64_t half_h, int64_t density);

uint64_t sim_golden_hash(void);
```

`sdk/godot/src/register_types.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "aurix_net_client.h"
#include "aurix_net_sync.h"
#include <gdextension_interface.h>
#include <godot_cpp/core/defs.hpp>
#include <godot_cpp/godot.hpp>

namespace godot {

static void init(ModuleInitializationLevel level) {
    if (level != MODULE_INITIALIZATION_LEVEL_SCENE) return;
    ClassDB::register_class<AurixNetClient>();
    ClassDB::register_class<AurixNetSync>();
}
static void uninit(ModuleInitializationLevel) {}

extern "C" GDExtensionBool GDE_EXPORT aurix_net_library_init(GDExtensionInterfaceGetProcAddress p_get_proc_address, GDExtensionClassLibraryPtr p_library, GDExtensionInitialization *r_initialization) {
    GDExtensionBinding::InitObject init_obj(p_get_proc_address, p_library, r_initialization);
    init_obj.register_initializer(init);
    init_obj.register_terminator(uninit);
    init_obj.set_minimum_library_initialization_level(MODULE_INITIALIZATION_LEVEL_SCENE);
    return init_obj.init();
}

} // namespace godot
```

`sdk/unity/BuildCheck~/framework-check/Program.cs`:

```cs
// Compile check + live test of the gameplay framework (NetworkManager / NetworkIdentity /
// NetworkBehaviour / SyncVar / SyncList / SyncDictionary / RPCs) over a local node. Skips the live
// part without NET_API_KEY. Scenario: host + two clients; the host spawns a player object per
// client (owner = that client) and one server object; SyncVars, an owner-auth SyncList, a
// SyncDictionary, ServerRpc / ObserversRpc (bufferLast) / TargetRpc, ownership transfer, late join,
// despawn on owner leave.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework;
using UnityEngine;

struct Loadout : INetSerializable
{
    public int weapon; public string skin;
    public void Write(Aurix.Net.Managed.BitWriter w) { NetSerializer.Write(w, weapon); NetSerializer.Write(w, skin); }
    public void Read(Aurix.Net.Managed.BitReader r) { weapon = NetSerializer.Read<int>(r); skin = NetSerializer.Read<string>(r); }
}

class Player : NetworkBehaviour
{
    public SyncHashSet<string> tags = new SyncHashSet<string>();
    public SyncQueue<int> queue = new SyncQueue<int>();
    public SyncArray<int> slots = new SyncArray<int>(4);
    public SyncEvent<int> boom = new SyncEvent<int>();
    public SyncTimer timer = new SyncTimer();
    public int boomsSeen;
    public SyncVar<int> health = new SyncVar<int>(100);
    public SyncVar<string> nick = new SyncVar<string>("");
    public SyncVar<Vector3> pos = new SyncVar<Vector3>(default, 0f, ownerAuth: true);
    public SyncList<int> inventory = new SyncList<int>(ownerAuth: true);
    public SyncDictionary<string, int> stats = new SyncDictionary<string, int>();
    public SyncVar<Loadout> loadout = new SyncVar<Loadout>();
    public SyncVar<NetworkIdentity> target = new SyncVar<NetworkIdentity>();
    public readonly List<string> log = new List<string>();
    public string tag;

    [ServerRpc] void CmdHit(int dmg, RpcInfo info = default) { log.Add($"CmdHit({dmg}) from {info.sender}"); health.value -= dmg; }
    [ObserversRpc(bufferLast: true)] void RpcShout(string text, RpcInfo info = default) { log.Add($"Shout:{text}"); }
    [TargetRpc] void RpcWhisper(PlayerID to, string text) { log.Add($"Whisper:{text}"); }
    [ServerRpc(requireOwnership: false)] void CmdAny(byte b) { log.Add($"CmdAny({b})"); }

    public void Hit(int d) => CmdHit(d);                       // woven: direct call
    public void Shout(string s) => Rpc(nameof(RpcShout), s);   // reflection mode still works on woven code
    public void Whisper(PlayerID to, string s) => RpcWhisper(to, s);
    public void Any(byte b) => CmdAny(b);
    public static bool Woven => typeof(Player).GetMethod("CmdHit" + ImplSuffix, System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic) != null;
    protected override void OnSpawned(bool asServer) { log.Add($"spawned server={asServer} owner={owner} mine={isOwner}"); }
    protected override void OnOwnerChanged(PlayerID? o, PlayerID? n) { log.Add($"owner {o}->{n}"); }
}

struct MoveInput : INetSerializable { public float dx; public void Write(Aurix.Net.Managed.BitWriter w) => w.WriteF32(dx); public void Read(Aurix.Net.Managed.BitReader r) => dx = r.ReadF32(); }
struct MoveState : INetSerializable, IEquatable<MoveState>
{
    public float x; public int steps;
    public void Write(Aurix.Net.Managed.BitWriter w) { w.WriteF32(x); w.WriteBits((uint)steps, 32); }
    public void Read(Aurix.Net.Managed.BitReader r) { x = r.ReadF32(); steps = (int)(uint)r.ReadBits(32); }
    public bool Equals(MoveState o) => Math.Abs(x - o.x) < 1e-4f && steps == o.steps;
    public override bool Equals(object o) => o is MoveState m && Equals(m);
    public override int GetHashCode() => steps;
}
class Pawn : PredictedBehaviour<MoveInput, MoveState>
{
    public float dx; public float impulse; public int impulsesApplied; public float viewX;
    protected override void GetInput(ref MoveInput i) => i.dx = dx;
    protected override void Simulate(MoveInput i, ref MoveState s, float dt) { s.x += i.dx * 10f * dt; s.steps++; }
    protected override void ServerModifyState(ref MoveState s) { if (impulse != 0) { s.x += impulse; impulse = 0; impulsesApplied++; } }
    protected override MoveState Interpolate(MoveState a, MoveState b, float t) => new MoveState { x = a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, steps = b.steps };
    protected override void UpdateView(MoveState v, MoveState? ver) => viewX = v.x;
}
class PawnIdentity : NetworkIdentity { public Pawn pawn = new Pawn(); public PawnIdentity() { behaviours.Add(pawn); } }
class TestIdentity : NetworkIdentity { public Player player = new Player(); public TestIdentity() { behaviours.Add(player); } }

    [ObserversRpc] public static void Announce(string text) { clientLog.Add(text); }

class DelayedFactory : IAsyncNetworkObjectFactory
{
    public INetworkObjectFactory inner; public int delayPumps = 20; readonly List<(int left, int pid, Action<NetworkIdentity> ready)> _pending = new List<(int, int, Action<NetworkIdentity>)>();
    public NetworkIdentity Instantiate(NetworkManager m, int prefabId) => inner.Instantiate(m, prefabId);
    public void Destroy(NetworkIdentity id) => inner.Destroy(id);
    public void InstantiateAsync(NetworkManager m, int prefabId, Action<NetworkIdentity> ready) => _pending.Add((delayPumps, prefabId, ready));
    public void Pump(NetworkManager m) { for (int i = _pending.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) { var p = _pending[i]; if (--p.left <= 0) { _pending.RemoveAt(i); p.ready(inner.Instantiate(m, p.pid)); } else _pending[i] = p; } }
}

class TestFactory : INetworkObjectFactory
{
    public readonly List<TestIdentity> alive = new List<TestIdentity>();
    public readonly List<NetworkIdentity> all = new List<NetworkIdentity>();
    public NetworkIdentity Instantiate(NetworkManager m, int prefabId) { if (prefabId == 13) { var gl = new Glider(); all.Add(gl); return gl; } if (prefabId == 12) { var ii = new InputsIdentity(); all.Add(ii); return ii; } if (prefabId == 11) { var gi = new GenericIdentity(); all.Add(gi); return gi; } if (prefabId == 10) { var pk = new PackerIdentity(); all.Add(pk); return pk; } if (prefabId == 9) { var rc = new RacerIdentity(); all.Add(rc); return rc; } if (prefabId == 7) { var rg = new Rig(); all.Add(rg); return rg; } if (prefabId == 8) { var sp = new Speaker(); all.Add(sp); return sp; } if (prefabId == 6) { var rf = new Reflected(); all.Add(rf); return rf; } if (prefabId == 4) { var ph = new Phases(); all.Add(ph); return ph; } if (prefabId == 5) { var lb = new LodBox(); all.Add(lb); return lb; } if (prefabId == 3) { var tg = new Target(); all.Add(tg); return tg; } if (prefabId == 2) { var pw = new PawnIdentity(); all.Add(pw); return pw; } if (prefabId == 1) { var mv = new Mover(); all.Add(mv); return mv; } var t = new TestIdentity(); alive.Add(t); all.Add(t); return t; }
    public void Destroy(NetworkIdentity id) { all.Remove(id); if (id is TestIdentity t) alive.Remove(t); }
}

static class Program
{
    const int PH = 4, LB = 5, RF = 6, RG = 7, SP = 8, RC = 9, PK = 10, GI = 11, II = 12, GL = 13;
    static async Task<string> Grant(HttpClient h, string key, string pid)
    {
        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/grants");
        req.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", key);
        req.Content = new StringContent("{\"player_id\":\"" + pid + "\",\"name\":\"" + pid + "\"}", Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
        var r = await h.SendAsync(req); var body = await r.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        if (!r.IsSuccessStatusCode) throw new Exception(body);
        int i = body.IndexOf("\"grant\":\"") + 9; return body.Substring(i, body.IndexOf('"', i) - i);
    }

    static async Task Pump(int ms, params NetworkManager[] ms_) { var until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(ms); while (DateTime.UtcNow < until) { foreach (var m in ms_) m.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); await Task.Delay(10); } }

    static async Task Until(Func<bool> cond, int timeoutMs, params NetworkManager[] ms_) { var until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(timeoutMs); while (DateTime.UtcNow < until && !cond()) { foreach (var m in ms_) m.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); await Task.Delay(10); } await Pump(150, ms_); }

    static int fails;
    static void Check(bool ok, string what) { Console.WriteLine((ok ? "  ok   " : "  FAIL ") + what); if (!ok) fails++; }
    static Player P(NetworkManager m, uint oid) => m.TryGetIdentity(oid, out var id) ? ((TestIdentity)id).player : null;

    static async Task<int> Main()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("RPC methods woven: " + Player.Woven);
        Console.WriteLine("FRAMEWORK COMPILE OK: " + string.Join(", ", new[] { typeof(NetworkManager), typeof(NetworkIdentity), typeof(NetworkBehaviour), typeof(SyncVar<>), typeof(SyncList<>), typeof(SyncDictionary<,>) }.Select(t => t.Name)));
        var key = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("NET_API_KEY");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key)) { Console.WriteLine("NET_API_KEY unset: live test skipped"); return 0; }
        var h = new HttpClient(); var room = "fw-" + DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks;
        NetworkManager Make(string pid) { var m = new NetworkManager { roomName = room, GrantProvider = () => Grant(h, key, "fw-" + pid), factory = new TestFactory(), tickRate = 30 }; return m; }
        var host = Make("host"); var c1 = Make("c1"); var c2 = Make("c2");
        host.onError += e => Console.WriteLine("host error: " + e); c1.onError += e => Console.WriteLine("c1 error: " + e); c2.onError += e => Console.WriteLine("c2 error: " + e);

        host.StartHost(); await Until(() => host.isServer, 8000, host);
        Check(host.isServer && host.isHost && host.localPlayer.HasValue, $"host started as {host.localPlayer}");
        Check(Player.Woven, "test assembly was woven (CmdHit__Impl present)");

        // a server object exists before anyone joins (late-join path for c1)
        var srvObj = (TestIdentity)host.Spawn(0);
        srvObj.player.nick.value = "server-bot"; srvObj.player.stats["kills"] = 3; srvObj.player.loadout.value = new Loadout { weapon = 7, skin = "gold" };
        srvObj.player.Shout("welcome");   // bufferLast: late joiners must get it
        await Pump(300, host);

        c1.StartClient(); await Until(() => c1.players.Count == 2 && c1.identities.Any(), 8000, host, c1);
        Check(c1.isClient && !c1.isServer && c1.players.Count == 2, $"c1 joined: players={c1.players.Count} local={c1.localPlayer}");
        var s1 = P(c1, srvObj.objectId);
        Check(s1 != null && s1.nick.value == "server-bot" && s1.stats["kills"] == 3 && s1.loadout.value.weapon == 7 && s1.loadout.value.skin == "gold", "late join: full state of server object");
        Check(s1 != null && s1.log.Contains("Shout:welcome"), "late join: buffered ObserversRpc delivered");

        // host spawns a player object owned by c1
        var p1h = (TestIdentity)host.Spawn(0, c1.localPlayer); p1h.player.nick.value = "alice"; p1h.player.target.value = srvObj;
        await Pump(400, host, c1);
        var p1c = P(c1, p1h.objectId);
        Check(p1c != null && p1c.isOwner && p1c.nick.value == "alice", "spawn with owner replicated, isOwner on c1");
        Check(p1c != null && p1c.target.value != null && p1c.target.value.objectId == srvObj.objectId, "NetworkIdentity reference resolved on client");

        // owner-auth: c1 writes pos + inventory → host sees it
        p1c.pos.value = new Vector3(1, 2, 3); p1c.inventory.Add(42); p1c.inventory.Add(43); p1c.inventory.RemoveAt(0);
        await Pump(400, host, c1);
        Check(p1h.player.pos.value.x == 1 && p1h.player.pos.value.z == 3, "ownerAuth SyncVar<Vector3> client→host");
        Check(p1h.player.inventory.Count == 1 && p1h.player.inventory[0] == 43, $"ownerAuth SyncList ops client→host ({string.Join(",", p1h.player.inventory)})");

        // non-owner-auth write on client is refused
        p1c.health.value = 1; await Pump(200, host, c1);
        Check(p1h.player.health.value == 100 && p1c.health.value == 100, "server-auth SyncVar not writable by client");

        // ServerRpc from owner, ObserversRpc back, TargetRpc
        p1c.Hit(30); await Pump(400, host, c1);
        Check(p1h.player.log.Any(l => l.StartsWith("CmdHit(30) from " + c1.localPlayer)) && p1h.player.health.value == 70 && p1c.health.value == 70, "ServerRpc with RpcInfo, state back to client");
        p1h.player.Shout("hello"); p1h.player.Whisper(c1.localPlayer.Value, "psst"); await Pump(400, host, c1);
        Check(p1c.log.Contains("Shout:hello") && p1h.player.log.Contains("Shout:hello"), "ObserversRpc on client and host");
        Check(p1c.log.Contains("Whisper:psst") && !p1h.player.log.Contains("Whisper:psst"), "TargetRpc only on target");

        // second client joins late: sees both objects, both buffered shouts, player list of 3
        c2.StartClient(); await Until(() => c2.players.Count == 3 && c2.identities.Count() == 2 && c1.players.Count == 3, 8000, host, c1, c2);
        var p1c2 = P(c2, p1h.objectId);
        Console.WriteLine($"  dbg c2 state={c2.clientState} err={c2.lastError} isClient={c2.isClient} local={c2.localPlayer} server={c2.serverPlayer} hostPlayers={host.players.Count} c2ids={c2.identities.Count()}");
        if (p1c2 == null) { Console.WriteLine("FRAMEWORK LIVE FAIL (c2 did not join)"); return 1; }
        Check(c2.players.Count == 3 && c1.players.Count == 3, $"player lists after c2 join: c1={c1.players.Count} c2={c2.players.Count}");
        Check(p1c2 != null && !p1c2.isOwner && p1c2.health.value == 70 && p1c2.pos.value.y == 2 && p1c2.inventory.Count == 1, "late joiner gets live state incl. ownerAuth modules");
        Check(p1c2 != null && p1c2.log.Contains("Shout:hello") && P(c2, srvObj.objectId).log.Contains("Shout:welcome"), "late joiner gets last buffered ObserversRpc per object");

        // non-owner ServerRpc refused on host, requireOwnership:false allowed
        p1c2.Hit(5); p1c2.Any(9); await Pump(400, host, c1, c2);
        Check(p1h.player.health.value == 70 && p1h.player.log.Contains("CmdAny(9)"), "ServerRpc ownership enforced on host; requireOwnership:false passes");

        // ownership transfer to c2
        host.SetOwnership(p1h, c2.localPlayer); await Pump(400, host, c1, c2);
        Check(p1c2.isOwner && !p1c.isOwner && p1c.log.Any(l => l.StartsWith("owner")) , "ownership transferred, OnOwnerChanged fired");
        p1c2.pos.value = new Vector3(9, 9, 9); await Pump(400, host, c1, c2);
        Check(p1h.player.pos.value.x == 9 && p1c.pos.value.x == 9, "new owner writes ownerAuth state, relayed to the old owner");

        // c2 leaves → its object is despawned everywhere
        c2.Stop(); await Until(() => host.players.Count == 2 && !c1.TryGetIdentity(p1h.objectId, out _), 8000, host, c1);
        Check(!host.TryGetIdentity(p1h.objectId, out _) && !c1.TryGetIdentity(p1h.objectId, out _) && host.players.Count == 2, "despawnOnOwnerDisconnect + player list shrink");

        // explicit despawn
        host.Despawn(srvObj); await Pump(300, host, c1);
        Check(!c1.TryGetIdentity(srvObj.objectId, out _) && ((TestFactory)c1.factory).alive.Count == 0, "explicit despawn reaches clients and destroys instances");

        // NetworkTransform: owner moves 1 unit per tick along x; remote interpolates behind and follows
        var mvH = (Mover)host.Spawn(1, c1.localPlayer); await Until(() => c1.TryGetIdentity(mvH.objectId, out _), 5000, host, c1);
        var mvC = (Mover)(c1.TryGetIdentity(mvH.objectId, out var mvId) ? mvId : null);
        Check(mvC != null && mvC.nt.isOwner, "NetworkTransform object spawned, owner = c1");
        async Task PumpMover(int ms) { var until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(ms); while (DateTime.UtcNow < until) { host.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); c1.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); mvH.nt.RenderUpdate(0.01f); mvC.nt.RenderUpdate(0.01f); await Task.Delay(10); } }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++) { mvC.nt.transform.position = new Vector3(i, 0, 0); mvC.nt.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0, i * 9, 0); await PumpMover(34); }
        await PumpMover(400);
        float hx = mvH.nt.transform.position.x; float ang = Quaternion.Angle(mvH.nt.transform.rotation, Quaternion.Euler(0, hx * 9, 0)); // rotation must match the interpolated position
        Check(hx >= 15 && hx <= 20.01f && ang < 2f, $"remote follows owner motion with interpolation (host x={hx:0.##}, rot err={ang:0.##}°)");
        Check(mvH.nt.sync.buffer.Count >= 2 && mvH.nt.sync.buffer[mvH.nt.sync.buffer.Count - 1].tick > mvH.nt.sync.buffer[0].tick, "samples stamped with increasing server ticks");
        mvC.nt.Teleport(new Vector3(100, 0, 0), Quaternion.identity); await PumpMover(400);
        Check(Math.Abs(mvH.nt.transform.position.x - 100) < 0.01f, $"teleport snaps on remote (x={mvH.nt.transform.position.x:0.##})");

        // extra sync modules: hash set, queue, array, event, timer (server → client, plus late join)
        {
            var hostX = Make("hostX"); var cX = Make("cX"); var roomX = room + "-mods"; hostX.roomName = cX.roomName = roomX;
            hostX.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostX.isServer, 8000, hostX);
            var px = (TestIdentity)hostX.Spawn(0);
            px.player.tags.Add("vip"); px.player.tags.Add("beta"); px.player.queue.Enqueue(1); px.player.queue.Enqueue(2); px.player.queue.Enqueue(3); px.player.slots[2] = 42; px.player.timer.Start(1.2f);
            cX.StartClient(); await Until(() => cX.TryGetIdentity(px.objectId, out _), 8000, hostX, cX);
            var pc = ((TestIdentity)(cX.TryGetIdentity(px.objectId, out var pxi) ? pxi : null)).player;
            pc.boom.onInvoked += v => pc.boomsSeen += v;
            await Pump(300, hostX, cX);
            Check(pc.tags.Contains("vip") && pc.tags.Count == 2 && pc.queue.Count == 3 && pc.queue.Peek() == 1 && pc.slots[2] == 42 && pc.timer.isRunning, $"late joiner gets full hash set/queue/array/timer state (timer remaining {pc.timer.remaining:0.00}s)");
            px.player.tags.Remove("beta"); px.player.queue.Dequeue(); px.player.slots[0] = 7; px.player.boom.Invoke(5); px.player.boom.Invoke(6);
            await Pump(400, hostX, cX);
            Check(!pc.tags.Contains("beta") && pc.tags.Count == 1 && pc.queue.Count == 2 && pc.queue.Peek() == 2 && pc.slots[0] == 7 && pc.slots[2] == 42 && pc.boomsSeen == 11, $"deltas: remove/dequeue/slot/event replicated (booms {pc.boomsSeen})");
            Check(!pc.timer.finished && pc.timer.remaining > 0.2f, $"SyncTimer still running on the client ({pc.timer.remaining:0.00}s left)");
            await Until(() => pc.timer.finished && px.player.timer.finished, 3000, hostX, cX);
            Check(pc.timer.finished && px.player.timer.finished, "SyncTimer finished on both sides from the server tick");
            hostX.Stop(); cX.Stop(); await Pump(300, hostX, cX);
        }

        // NetworkTransform parent sync: child attached to a networked parent replicates the parent + local pose
        {
            var hostP = Make("hostP"); var cP = Make("cP"); hostP.roomName = cP.roomName = room + "-parent";
            hostP.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostP.isServer, 8000, hostP);
            var pa = (Mover)hostP.Spawn(1); var ch = (Mover)hostP.Spawn(1);
            pa.nt.transform.position = new Vector3(10, 0, 0);
            ch.nt.SetParent(pa); ch.nt.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(1, 2, 3);
            cP.StartClient(); await Until(() => cP.TryGetIdentity(ch.objectId, out _) && cP.TryGetIdentity(pa.objectId, out _), 8000, hostP, cP);
            await Pump(400, hostP, cP);
            cP.TryGetIdentity(pa.objectId, out var cpa); cP.TryGetIdentity(ch.objectId, out var cch);
            var cnt = ((Mover)cch).nt;
            Check(cnt.transform.parent == cpa.transform && cnt.parentIdentity == cpa && Vector3.Distance(cnt.transform.localPosition, new Vector3(1, 2, 3)) < 0.01f, $"late joiner re-parents the child under the networked parent with the local pose ({cnt.transform.localPosition.x},{cnt.transform.localPosition.y},{cnt.transform.localPosition.z})");
            ch.nt.SetParent(null); ch.nt.transform.position = new Vector3(5, 5, 5);
            for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) { hostP.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); cP.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); cnt.RenderUpdate(0.01f); await Task.Delay(10); }
            Check(cnt.transform.parent == null && cnt.parentIdentity == null && Vector3.Distance(cnt.transform.position, new Vector3(5, 5, 5)) < 0.01f, "detach replicates: parent cleared, world pose follows");
            hostP.Stop(); cP.Stop(); await Pump(300, hostP, cP);
        }

        // replicated StateMachine: controller switches states (with payload), peers run Enter/Exit, late joiner enters the current state
        {
            var hostM = Make("hostM"); var cM = Make("cM"); var cM2 = Make("cM2"); hostM.roomName = cM.roomName = cM2.roomName = room + "-sm";
            hostM.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostM.isServer, 8000, hostM);
            var ph = (Phases)hostM.Spawn(PH);
            cM.StartClient(); await Until(() => cM.TryGetIdentity(ph.objectId, out _), 8000, hostM, cM);
            Check(ph.sm.SetState(ph.idle) && ph.idle.enters == 1, "server enters Idle locally");
            await Until(() => cM.TryGetIdentity(ph.objectId, out var x) && ((Phases)x).idle.enters == 1, 3000, hostM, cM);
            cM.TryGetIdentity(ph.objectId, out var phC1); var phC = (Phases)phC1;
            Check(phC.idle.enters == 1 && phC.sm.IsCurrentState<Idle>(), "client entered Idle");
            Check(ph.sm.SetState(ph.round, 7), "server switches to Round(7)");
            await Until(() => phC.round.enters == 1, 3000, hostM, cM);
            Check(phC.round.last == 7 && phC.idle.exits == 1 && phC.sm.currentStateNode == phC.round && phC.sm.previousStateNode == phC.idle, $"client exited Idle and entered Round with payload {phC.round.last}");
            cM2.StartClient(); await Until(() => cM2.TryGetIdentity(ph.objectId, out _), 8000, hostM, cM, cM2); await Pump(200, hostM, cM, cM2);
            cM2.TryGetIdentity(ph.objectId, out var phC2); var late = (Phases)phC2;
            Check(late.round.enters == 1 && late.round.last == 7 && late.idle.enters == 0, "late joiner enters only the current state Round(7)");
            Check(ph.sm.Next() && ph.sm.IsCurrentState<Idle>(), "Next() wraps to Idle");
            await Until(() => phC.idle.enters == 2 && late.idle.enters == 1, 3000, hostM, cM, cM2);
            Check(phC.round.exits == 1 && late.round.exits == 1, "Round exited on both clients");
            hostM.Stop(); cM.Stop(); cM2.Stop(); await Pump(300, hostM, cM, cM2);
        }

        // NetworkLOD: far player is culled from deltas (still an observer), near player gets them; moving closer restores
        {
            var hostL = Make("hostL"); var cN = Make("cN"); var cF = Make("cF"); hostL.roomName = cN.roomName = cF.roomName = room + "-lod";
            hostL.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostL.isServer, 8000, hostL);
            var box = (LodBox)hostL.Spawn(LB);
            cN.StartClient(); cF.StartClient(); await Until(() => hostL.players.Count == 3, 8000, hostL, cN, cF);
            var avN = (Mover)hostL.Spawn(1, cN.localPlayer); var avF = (Mover)hostL.Spawn(1, cF.localPlayer);

        }

        // ValidatedSyncVar (server vetoes owner writes) + SyncBigData (chunked 40 KB payload, late joiner gets it whole)
        {
            var hostX = Make("hostX"); var cX = Make("cX"); var cX2 = Make("cX2"); hostX.roomName = cX.roomName = cX2.roomName = room + "-val";
            hostX.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostX.isServer, 8000, hostX);
            cX.StartClient(); await Until(() => hostX.players.Count == 2, 8000, hostX, cX);

            await Until(() => cX.TryGetIdentity(rc.objectId, out _), 5000, hostX, cX);
            cX.TryGetIdentity(rc.objectId, out var rcC1); var rcC = (RacerIdentity)rcC1;
            int rejected = 0; rcC.racer.speed.onRejected += _ => rejected++;
            rcC.racer.speed.value = 5; await Until(() => rc.racer.speed.value == 5, 3000, hostX, cX);
            Check(rc.racer.speed.value == 5 && rejected == 0, "owner proposal within limits accepted by the server");
            rcC.racer.speed.value = 50; await Until(() => rejected == 1, 3000, hostX, cX); await Pump(200, hostX, cX);
            Check(rc.racer.speed.value == 5 && rcC.racer.speed.value == 5 && rejected == 1, $"out-of-range proposal rejected and owner reverted (owner sees {rcC.racer.speed.value})");
            var payload = new byte[40_000]; new Random(7).NextBytes(payload);
            byte[] got = null; var progress = new List<float>(); rcC.racer.blob.onCompleted += d => got = d; rcC.racer.blob.onProgress += pr => progress.Add(pr);
            rc.racer.blob.Set(payload);
            await Until(() => got != null, 5000, hostX, cX);
            Check(got != null && got.Length == payload.Length && got.AsSpan().SequenceEqual(payload) && progress.Count >= 3 && progress[0] < 1f, $"40 KB streamed in chunks ({progress.Count} progress events), bytes identical");
            cX2.StartClient(); await Until(() => cX2.TryGetIdentity(rc.objectId, out _), 8000, hostX, cX, cX2); await Pump(300, hostX, cX, cX2);
            cX2.TryGetIdentity(rc.objectId, out var rcC2x); var rcC2 = (RacerIdentity)rcC2x;
            Check(rcC2.racer.blob.data.Length == payload.Length && rcC2.racer.blob.data.AsSpan().SequenceEqual(payload) && rcC2.racer.speed.value == 5, "late joiner receives the whole payload and the validated value");
            hostX.Stop(); cX.Stop(); cX2.Stop(); await Pump(300, hostX, cX, cX2);
        }

        // RPC packing: compression shrinks a 4 KB string, delta packing shrinks repeated state calls; payloads arrive intact
        {

            await Until(() => pkC.packer.bigs.Count == 1, 3000, hostK, cK); long used = hostK.statistics.totalBytesOut - before;
            Check(pkC.packer.bigs[0] == big && used < 1000, $"compressed ObserversRpc: {big.Length} chars arrived intact using {used} bytes on the wire");

            pk.packer.State(new Vector3(1, 2, 3), 100, longName); await Until(() => pkC.packer.states.Count == 1, 3000, hostK, cK);
            before = hostK.statistics.totalBytesOut; pk.packer.State(new Vector3(1, 2, 3.5f), 99, longName);
            await Until(() => pkC.packer.states.Count == 2, 3000, hostK, cK); used = hostK.statistics.totalBytesOut - before;
            Check(pkC.packer.states[1].Item1.z == 3.5f && pkC.packer.states[1].Item2 == 99 && pkC.packer.states[1].Item3 == longName && used < 300, $"delta-packed ObserversRpc: second call (600-char name unchanged) used {used} bytes, values intact");
            hostK.Stop(); cK.Stop(); await Pump(300, hostK, cK);
        }

        // async factory (Addressables-style): spawn + messages for a not-yet-loaded prefab stay pending, then apply in order
        {

        // SyncInput (owner → server only) + SyncTexture / SyncFile over SyncBigData

        // adaptive transform sync: constant-velocity motion skips most sends, receiver reconstructs within tolerance
        {
            var hostD = Make("hostD"); var cD = Make("cD"); hostD.roomName = cD.roomName = room + "-adapt";
            hostD.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostD.isServer, 8000, hostD);
            var gl = (Glider)hostD.Spawn(GL);
            cD.StartClient(); await Until(() => cD.TryGetIdentity(gl.objectId, out _), 8000, hostD, cD); await Pump(200, hostD, cD);
            cD.TryGetIdentity(gl.objectId, out var glC1); var glC = (Glider)glC1;
            float worst = 0; int made0 = gl.nt.sync.sendsMade, skipped0 = gl.nt.sync.sendsSkipped;
            for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++)
            {
                gl.nt.transform.position = new Vector3(i * 0.1f, 0, 0);
                hostD.NetworkUpdate(1f / 30); cD.NetworkUpdate(1f / 30); glC.nt.RenderUpdate(1f / 30);   // exactly one tick per iteration
                if (i > 20) worst = Math.Max(worst, Math.Abs(glC.nt.transform.position.x - gl.nt.transform.position.x));   // includes render delay (interpolationTicks + transit)
                await Task.Delay(33);
            }
            int made = gl.nt.sync.sendsMade - made0, skipped = gl.nt.sync.sendsSkipped - skipped0;
            Check(skipped > made && made >= 3, $"adaptive sync skipped {skipped} sends, made {made} over 90 ticks of linear motion");
            Check(worst < 1.0f, $"receiver stays within 10 ticks of the controller while sends are skipped (worst {worst:0.00} units at 0.1/tick)");
            gl.nt.transform.position = new Vector3(100, 5, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) { hostD.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); cD.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); glC.nt.RenderUpdate(0.033f); await Task.Delay(10); }
            Check(Vector3.Distance(glC.nt.transform.position, new Vector3(100, 5, 0)) < 0.1f, "a jump breaks the skip streak and is sent");
            hostD.Stop(); cD.Stop(); await Pump(300, hostD, cD);
        }

        // static RPCs: no NetworkIdentity, routed via NetworkManager.main (host) / the client manager

            Check(Chat.clientLog.Contains("motd:welcome"), "late joiner gets bufferLast static ObserversRpc");

            await Until(() => Chat.serverLog.Count > 0, 3000, hostS, cS);
            Check(Chat.serverLog.Count == 1 && Chat.serverLog[0] == cS.localPlayer + ":hi from client", $"static ServerRpc reached the host with the sender ({string.Join(",", Chat.serverLog)})");
            NetworkManager.SetMain(hostS);
            Chat.Announce("round 2"); Chat.Whisper(cS.localPlayer.Value, "psst"); Chat.Whisper(hostS.localPlayer.Value, "self");
            await Until(() => Chat.clientLog.Contains("round 2") && Chat.whispers.Count >= 2, 3000, hostS, cS);
            Check(Chat.clientLog.Count(x => x == "round 2") == 2 && Chat.whispers.Contains(cS.localPlayer + "<psst") && Chat.whispers.Contains(hostS.localPlayer + "<self") && Chat.whispers.Count == 2,
                $"static ObserversRpc ran on host+client, static TargetRpc on the target only (whispers {string.Join(",", Chat.whispers)})");

        // Lag compensation: server rewinds ColliderRollback poses to the shooter's view tick
        {
            var hostL = Make("hostL"); var cL = Make("cL"); hostL.roomName = cL.roomName = room + "-lag";
            hostL.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostL.isServer, 8000, hostL);
            var tg = (Target)hostL.Spawn(3);
            cL.StartClient(); await Until(() => cL.TryGetIdentity(tg.objectId, out _), 8000, hostL, cL);
            // the server moves the target one unit per tick (x = server tick)
            var mover = new Func<Task>(async () => { var until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(600); while (DateTime.UtcNow < until) { tg.cr.transform.position = new Vector3(hostL.serverTick, 0, 0); hostL.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); cL.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); await Task.Delay(5); } });
            await mover();
            uint view = hostL.ViewTickOf(cL.localPlayer.Value); float seenX = -1, liveX = tg.cr.transform.position.x;
            hostL.Rollback(cL.localPlayer.Value, () => seenX = tg.cr.transform.position.x);
            tg.cr.TryGetPose(view, out var hp);
            Check(view > 0 && view < hostL.serverTick && view >= hostL.serverTick - 6 && Math.Abs(seenX - hp.pos.x) < 0.001f && seenX < liveX - 1 && Math.Abs(tg.cr.transform.position.x - liveX) < 0.001f,
                $"Rollback(shooter) sees the recorded pose at the shooter's view tick (view {view}, server {hostL.serverTick}, seen x={seenX:0.##}, live x={liveX:0.##}) and restores");
            Check(tg.cr.history.Count > 10 && !tg.cr.isRolledBack, $"server keeps a pose history ({tg.cr.history.Count} ticks)");
            hostL.Stop(); cL.Stop(); await Pump(300, hostL, cL);
        }

        // Quick match: StartAuto hosts when nothing matches, the next StartAuto joins that room as a client
        {

            qa.StartAuto(); await Until(() => qa.isServer, 8000, qa);

            Check(qa.isHost && !qb.isServer && qb.serverPlayer == qa.localPlayer, $"StartAuto: first became host, second joined as client (server player {qb.serverPlayer})");
            var q = (TestIdentity)qa.Spawn(0, qb.localPlayer); await Until(() => qb.identities.Any(i => i.isOwner), 5000, qa, qb);
            Check(qb.identities.Any(i => i.isOwner), "quick-matched client receives spawns");
            qa.Stop(); qb.Stop(); await Pump(300, qa, qb);
        }

        // Host migration: host leaves → the node promotes a client; it becomes server with the world it holds, the other client re-attaches
        {
            var hostM = Make("hostM"); var a = Make("aM"); var b = Make("bM"); var roomM = room + "-mig"; hostM.roomName = a.roomName = b.roomName = roomM;
            hostM.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostM.isServer, 8000, hostM);
            a.StartClient(); b.StartClient(); await Until(() => a.players.Count == 3 && b.players.Count == 3, 8000, hostM, a, b);
            var objA = (TestIdentity)hostM.Spawn(0, a.localPlayer); objA.player.nick.value = "A"; var objS = (TestIdentity)hostM.Spawn(0); objS.player.nick.value = "S";
            await Until(() => a.identities.Count() == 2 && b.identities.Count() == 2, 5000, hostM, a, b);
            hostM.Stop(); await Until(() => a.isServer || b.isServer, 10000, a, b);
            var srv = a.isServer ? a : b; var cli = a.isServer ? b : a;
            await Until(() => cli.serverPlayer == srv.localPlayer && cli.players.Count == 2 && srv.players.Count == 2, 8000, a, b);
            Check(srv.isServer && !cli.isServer && cli.serverPlayer == srv.localPlayer, $"new master promoted to server ({srv.localPlayer}); other client re-attached");
            Check(srv.identities.Count() == 2 && cli.identities.Count() == 2 && ((TestIdentity)(srv.TryGetIdentity(objS.objectId, out var ss) ? ss : null))?.player.nick.value == "S", "world survived the migration with the same object ids");
            var fresh = (TestIdentity)srv.Spawn(0); fresh.player.nick.value = "after"; await Until(() => cli.TryGetIdentity(fresh.objectId, out _), 5000, a, b); await Pump(300, a, b);
            Check(fresh.objectId > objS.objectId && ((TestIdentity)(cli.TryGetIdentity(fresh.objectId, out var fc) ? fc : null))?.player.nick.value == "after", "new host spawns and replicates after migration");
            a.Stop(); b.Stop(); await Pump(300, a, b);
        }

        // Prediction: owner predicts, server verifies, observer interpolates; a server impulse forces a reconciliation
        {
            var hostP = Make("hostP"); var cP = Make("cP"); var oP = Make("oP"); var roomP = room + "-pred"; hostP.roomName = cP.roomName = oP.roomName = roomP;
            hostP.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostP.isServer, 8000, hostP);
            cP.StartClient(); oP.StartClient(); await Until(() => cP.players.Count == 3 && oP.players.Count == 3, 8000, hostP, cP, oP);
            var pawnH = (PawnIdentity)hostP.Spawn(2, cP.localPlayer);
            await Until(() => cP.TryGetIdentity(pawnH.objectId, out _) && oP.TryGetIdentity(pawnH.objectId, out _), 5000, hostP, cP, oP);
            var pawnC = (PawnIdentity)(cP.TryGetIdentity(pawnH.objectId, out var pi) ? pi : null); var pawnO = (PawnIdentity)(oP.TryGetIdentity(pawnH.objectId, out var po) ? po : null);
            async Task PumpP(int ms) { var until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(ms); while (DateTime.UtcNow < until) { hostP.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); cP.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); oP.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); pawnO.pawn.RenderUpdate(0.01f); await Task.Delay(10); } }
            await PumpP(300);
            pawnC.pawn.dx = 1f; await PumpP(120); float early = pawnC.pawn.state.x;
            Check(early > 0.2f, $"owner predicts immediately (x={early:0.##} after 120 ms)");
            await PumpP(900); pawnC.pawn.dx = 0f; await PumpP(600);
            float sx = pawnH.pawn.state.x, cx = pawnC.pawn.state.x;
            Check(sx > 5f && Math.Abs(sx - cx) < 0.05f, $"server and owner converge after input stops (server x={sx:0.##}, owner x={cx:0.##}, missed inputs={pawnH.pawn.missedInputs}, reconciliations={pawnC.pawn.reconciliations})");
            Check(Math.Abs(pawnO.pawn.viewX - sx) < 0.05f, $"observer view follows verified state (view x={pawnO.pawn.viewX:0.##})");
            int before = pawnC.pawn.reconciliations; pawnH.pawn.impulse = 10f; await PumpP(600);
            Check(pawnH.pawn.impulsesApplied == 1 && pawnC.pawn.reconciliations > before && Math.Abs(pawnC.pawn.state.x - pawnH.pawn.state.x) < 0.05f, $"server impulse → owner reconciles to x={pawnC.pawn.state.x:0.##} (server {pawnH.pawn.state.x:0.##}, reconciliations {pawnC.pawn.reconciliations})");
            hostP.Stop(); cP.Stop(); oP.Stop(); await Pump(300, hostP, cP, oP);
        }

        // PlayerSpawner: one Mover per player (host included), owned by that player, gone when they leave
        {
            var hostS = Make("hostS"); var cS = Make("cS"); var roomS = room + "-spawner"; hostS.roomName = roomS; cS.roomName = roomS;
            var spawner = new PlayerSpawner { manager = hostS, prefabId = 1 }; spawner.Attach(hostS);
            hostS.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostS.isServer && spawner.spawned.Count == 1, 8000, hostS);
            cS.StartClient(); await Until(() => cS.identities.Count() == 2, 8000, hostS, cS);
            var mine = cS.identities.FirstOrDefault(i => i.isOwner);
            Check(spawner.spawned.Count == 2 && mine != null && spawner.spawned[cS.localPlayer.Value].objectId == mine.objectId, "PlayerSpawner spawned one owned object per player (host + client)");
            cS.Stop(); await Until(() => hostS.identities.Count() == 1, 8000, hostS);
            Check(spawner.spawned.Count == 1 && hostS.identities.Count() == 1, "PlayerSpawner: object despawned and forgotten when the player left");
            hostS.Stop(); await Pump(300, hostS);
        }

        // interest management: DistanceRule — c1's avatar at x=100 sees a server object at x=110 but not one at x=500
        {
            var hostV = Make("hostV"); var cV = Make("cV"); var roomV = room + "-vis"; hostV.roomName = roomV; cV.roomName = roomV;
            hostV.visibilityRules.Add(new DistanceRule(hostV, 50f)); hostV.visibilityIntervalTicks = 2;
            hostV.StartHost(); await Until(() => hostV.isServer, 8000, hostV);
            var near = (Mover)hostV.Spawn(1); near.nt.transform.position = new Vector3(110, 0, 0); near.nt.RenderUpdate(0);
            var far = (Mover)hostV.Spawn(1); far.nt.transform.position = new Vector3(500, 0, 0); far.nt.RenderUpdate(0);
            cV.StartClient(); await Until(() => cV.players.Count == 2, 8000, hostV, cV);
            var avatar = (Mover)hostV.Spawn(1, cV.localPlayer);
            await Until(() => cV.TryGetIdentity(avatar.objectId, out _), 5000, hostV, cV);
            var avC = (Mover)(cV.TryGetIdentity(avatar.objectId, out var avId) ? avId : null);
            avC.nt.transform.position = new Vector3(100, 0, 0);
            async Task PumpV(int ms) { var until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(ms); while (DateTime.UtcNow < until) { hostV.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); cV.NetworkUpdate(0.01f); avC.nt.RenderUpdate(0.01f); avatar.nt.RenderUpdate(0.01f); await Task.Delay(10); } }
            await PumpV(600);
            Check(cV.TryGetIdentity(near.objectId, out _) && !cV.TryGetIdentity(far.objectId, out _) && near.IsObserver(cV.localPlayer.Value) && !far.IsObserver(cV.localPlayer.Value), $"DistanceRule: near visible, far hidden (client has {cV.identities.Count()} objects)");
            avC.nt.transform.position = new Vector3(480, 0, 0); await PumpV(600);
            Check(cV.TryGetIdentity(far.objectId, out _) && !cV.TryGetIdentity(near.objectId, out _), "moving the avatar flips visibility: far spawned, near despawned on the client");
            hostV.Stop(); cV.Stop(); await Pump(300, hostV, cV);
        }

        // scene object: same sceneId registered on every peer, bound (not instantiated) and replicated
        host.Stop(); c1.Stop(); await Pump(300, host, c1);
        var room2 = room + "-scene";
        var host2 = Make("host2"); var c3 = Make("c3"); host2.roomName = room2; c3.roomName = room2;
        var soH = new TestIdentity { sceneId = 77 }; var soC = new TestIdentity { sceneId = 77 };
        host2.RegisterSceneObject(soH); c3.RegisterSceneObject(soC);
        host2.StartHost(); await Until(() => host2.isServer && soH.isSpawned, 8000, host2);
        soH.player.nick.value = "door"; soH.player.stats["open"] = 1;
        c3.StartClient(); await Until(() => soC.isSpawned, 8000, host2, c3);
        await Pump(300, host2, c3);
        Check(soC.isSpawned && soC.objectId == soH.objectId && soC.player.nick.value == "door" && soC.player.stats["open"] == 1 && ((TestFactory)c3.factory).all.Count == 0, "scene object bound by sceneId with state, nothing instantiated");
        host2.Stop(); c3.Stop(); await Pump(300, host2, c3);
        Check(!soC.isSpawned && !soH.isSpawned, "scene objects survive despawn (not destroyed)");
        Console.WriteLine(fails == 0 ? "FRAMEWORK LIVE OK" : $"FRAMEWORK LIVE FAIL ({fails})");
        return fails == 0 ? 0 : 1;
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/BuildCheck~/managed-live/Program.cs`:

```cs
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Aurix.Net;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;

class P
{
    static async Task<string> Grant(HttpClient h, string key, string pid)
    {
        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/grants");
        req.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", key);
        req.Content = new StringContent("{\"player_id\":\"" + pid + "\",\"name\":\"" + pid + "\"}", Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
        var r = await h.SendAsync(req); var body = await r.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        if (!r.IsSuccessStatusCode) throw new Exception(body);
        int i = body.IndexOf("\"grant\":\"") + 9; return body.Substring(i, body.IndexOf('"', i) - i);
    }
    static async Task<int> Main()
    {
        var key = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("NET_API_KEY");
        var h = new HttpClient();
        var room = "cs-" + DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks;
        var a = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync("http://127.0.0.1:8090", await Grant(h, key, "cs-a"));
        var b = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync("http://127.0.0.1:8090", await Grant(h, key, "cs-b"));
        int rel = 0, unrel = 0, big = 0, bigLen = 0; string ctl = "";
        b.OnEvent += f => { if (f.Code == 1) rel++; else if (f.Code == 2) unrel++; else if (f.Code == 3) { big++; bigLen = f.Payload.Count; } };
        b.OnControl += j => { if (j.Contains("player_joined")) ctl += "J"; };
        int aa = await a.JoinOrCreateAsync(room, "relay", 8);
        int ab = await b.JoinAsync(room);
        Console.WriteLine($"joined actors a={aa} b={ab} mode={a.RoomMode}");
        a.SendEvent(1, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("hello"), Target.Others, reliable: true);
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) a.SendEvent(2, new byte[] { (byte)i }, Target.Others, reliable: false);
        a.SendEvent(3, new byte[5000], Target.Others, reliable: true);
        a.Flush();
        var until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(2);
        while (DateTime.UtcNow < until) { a.Poll(); b.Poll(); await Task.Delay(5); }
        Console.WriteLine($"relay: reliable={rel}/1 unreliable={unrel}/10 fragmented={big}/1 ({bigLen} bytes) control={ctl}");
        await a.LeaveAsync(); await b.LeaveAsync(); a.Dispose(); b.Dispose();

        var s = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync("http://127.0.0.1:8090", await Grant(h, key, "cs-s"));
        int deltas = 0; s.OnData += (ch, tick, p) => { if ((p[0] & 0xf0) == 0x10) deltas++; };
        await s.JoinOrCreateAsync("cs-sync-" + room, "sync", 8, "{\"tick_hz\":60}");
        until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(2); int sent = 0;
        while (DateTime.UtcNow < until) { s.SendData(Channel.Unreliable, new byte[] { 0x10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 3, 127, 0, 0 }); sent++; s.Flush(); s.Poll(); await Task.Delay(16); }
        Console.WriteLine($"sync: inputs sent={sent} deltas received={deltas} (expect ~120 in 2 s)");
        await s.LeaveAsync(); s.Dispose();
        // owner-authoritative sync room with a custom schema: A moves its avatar, B decodes deltas
        var idl = "component Transform {\\n  pos: vec3 @range(-100, 100, 0.01)\\n  rot: quat\\n}\\ncomponent Tag {\\n  name: string(16)\\n  hp: u8\\n}\\n";
        var schema = Schema.Parse(idl.Replace("\\n", "\n"));
        var wa = new SyncWorld(schema); var wb = new SyncWorld(schema);
        var oa = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync("http://127.0.0.1:8090", await Grant(h, key, "cs-oa"));
        var ob = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync("http://127.0.0.1:8090", await Grant(h, key, "cs-ob"));
        oa.OnData += (ch, t, p) => { var ack = wa.Receive(p); if (ack != null) oa.SendData(Channel.Unreliable, ack); };
        ob.OnData += (ch, t, p) => { var ack = wb.Receive(p); if (ack != null) ob.SendData(Channel.Unreliable, ack); };
        int spawns = 0, changes = 0; wb.OnSpawn += e => spawns++; wb.OnChange += e => changes++;
        int actA = await oa.JoinOrCreateAsync("cs-owner-" + room, "sync", 8, "{\"schema\":\"" + idl + "\",\"tick_hz\":60}");
        var hash = Aurix.Net.Managed.ManagedClientTestHooks.Str(oa.JoinedJson, "schema_hash");
        await ob.JoinAsync("cs-owner-" + room, hash);
        var tr = schema.ByName("Transform"); var tag = schema.ByName("Tag");
        until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(2); float x = 0;
        while (DateTime.UtcNow < until)
        {
            x = Math.Min(5f, x + 0.1f);
            var pos = ComponentValue.Zero(tr); pos.Fields[0] = new Value { X = x, Y = 1.5f, Z = -2 }; pos.Fields[1] = new Value { X = 0, Y = 0.7071f, Z = 0, W = 0.7071f };
            var tg = ComponentValue.Zero(tag); tg.Fields[0] = new Value { S = "alice" }; tg.Fields[1] = new Value { U = 77 };
            var body = wa.EncodeWrites(new List<(ComponentDef, ComponentValue)> { (tr, pos), (tag, tg) });
            oa.SendData(Channel.Unreliable, SyncWorld.EncodeInput(wa.ServerTick + 2, new[] { body }));
            oa.Flush(); ob.Flush(); oa.Poll(); ob.Poll(); await Task.Delay(16);
        }
        NetEntity seen = null; foreach (var e in wb.Entities.Values) if (e.Owner == actA) seen = e;
        var sp = seen?.Get(tr)?.Fields[0]; var sq = seen?.Get(tr)?.Fields[1]; var st = seen?.Get(tag);
        Console.WriteLine($"schema sync: entities on B={wb.Entities.Count} spawns={spawns} changes={changes} gaps={wb.Gaps} A.pos=({sp?.X:F2},{sp?.Y:F2},{sp?.Z:F2}) rot.y={sq?.Y:F3} tag={st?.Fields[0].S}/{st?.Fields[1].U}");
        bool schemaOk = seen != null && wb.Entities.Count == 2 && Math.Abs((sp?.X ?? 0) - 5f) < 0.02 && Math.Abs((sp?.Z ?? 0) + 2f) < 0.02 && Math.Abs((sq?.Y ?? 0) - 0.7071f) < 0.01 && st?.Fields[0].S == "alice" && st?.Fields[1].U == 77;
        await oa.LeaveAsync(); await ob.LeaveAsync(); oa.Dispose(); ob.Dispose();
        // lockstep: A (master) and B confirm identical input streams, C joins late and catches up contiguously
        var lsRoom = "cs-ls-" + room; var clients = new List<ManagedClient>(); var ls = new List<LockstepClient>(); var journals = new List<List<string>>(); var seenTicks = new List<HashSet<uint>>();
        int ckReqs = 0, restores = 0; uint cStart = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        {
            var c = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync("http://127.0.0.1:8090", await Grant(h, key, "cs-ls-" + i));
            var cl = c; var l = new LockstepClient((ch, b) => cl.SendData(ch, b)); var j = new List<string>(); var sn = new HashSet<uint>(); int idx = i;
            l.OnTick += (t, inputs) => { if (!sn.Add(t)) j.Add("DUP" + t); var sb = new StringBuilder(); sb.Append(t).Append(':'); foreach (var kv in inputs) sb.Append(kv.Key).Append('=').Append(kv.Value.Length > 0 ? kv.Value[0] : -1).Append(','); j.Add(sb.ToString()); if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0) l.ReportHash(t + 1, 1234); };
            l.OnRestore += (t, hh, st) => { restores++; if (idx == 2) cStart = t; };
            l.OnCheckpointRequested += t => { ckReqs++; l.SendCheckpoint(Math.Min(t, l.ConfirmedTick), 0xA0, new byte[64]); };
            c.OnData += (ch, t, p) => l.Receive(p);
            clients.Add(c); ls.Add(l); journals.Add(j); seenTicks.Add(sn);
        }
        await clients[0].JoinOrCreateAsync(lsRoom, "lockstep", 8, "{\"tick_hz\":60}");
        await clients[1].JoinAsync(lsRoom);
        until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(8.5); bool cJoined = false; int frame = 0;
        while (DateTime.UtcNow < until)
        {
            frame++;
            if (!cJoined && DateTime.UtcNow > until.AddSeconds(-2)) { cJoined = true; await clients[2].JoinAsync(lsRoom); }
            for (int i = 0; i < (cJoined ? 3 : 2); i++) { ls[i].SendInput(new[] { (byte)(i * 16 + frame % 7) }); clients[i].Flush(); clients[i].Poll(); }
            await Task.Delay(16);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) clients[i].Poll();
        // compare A vs B on the common range, and C vs A from C's catch-up start
        int cmpAB = 0, cmpAC = 0; bool sameAB = true, sameAC = true;
        var mapA = new Dictionary<uint, string>(); foreach (var e in journals[0]) { var k = uint.Parse(e.Substring(0, e.IndexOf(':'))); mapA[k] = e; }
        foreach (var e in journals[1]) { var k = uint.Parse(e.Substring(0, e.IndexOf(':'))); if (mapA.TryGetValue(k, out var ea)) { cmpAB++; if (ea != e) sameAB = false; } }
        foreach (var e in journals[2]) { var k = uint.Parse(e.Substring(0, e.IndexOf(':'))); if (mapA.TryGetValue(k, out var ea)) { cmpAC++; if (ea != e) sameAC = false; } }
        bool contiguousC = true; uint exp = cStart; foreach (var e in journals[2]) { var k = uint.Parse(e.Substring(0, e.IndexOf(':'))); if (k != exp) { contiguousC = false; break; } exp++; }
        Console.WriteLine($"lockstep: A ticks={journals[0].Count} B ticks={journals[1].Count} C ticks={journals[2].Count} from {cStart} (restores={restores}, checkpoint reqs answered={ckReqs}) A==B on {cmpAB}: {sameAB}, A==C on {cmpAC}: {sameAC}, C contiguous: {contiguousC}, dropped={ls[0].Dropped + ls[1].Dropped + ls[2].Dropped}");
        bool lsOk = journals[0].Count > 150 && sameAB && sameAC && contiguousC && cmpAC > 60 && restores >= 1;
        foreach (var c in clients) { await c.LeaveAsync(); c.Dispose(); }
        bool ok = lsOk && schemaOk && rel == 1 && unrel == 10 && big == 1 && bigLen == 5000 && deltas > 60;
        Console.WriteLine(ok ? "MANAGED OK" : "MANAGED FAIL");
        return ok ? 0 : 1;
    }
}
```

```cs
// Minimal UnityEngine stand-ins so the Unity layer compiles under plain dotnet (no behaviour).
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
namespace UnityEngine
{
    public class Object { public string name; public static T Instantiate<T>(T o) where T : Object => o; public static void Destroy(Object o) { } }
    public class GameObject : Object { public T GetComponent<T>() where T : class => null; }
    public class Component : Object { Transform _t; public Transform transform => _t ??= new Transform(); public GameObject gameObject = new GameObject(); public T[] GetComponentsInChildren<T>() => new T[0]; public void GetComponentsInChildren<T>(bool inc, List<T> r) { } public T GetComponent<T>() where T : class => null; }
    public class Rigidbody : Component { public Vector3 position, velocity, angularVelocity; public Quaternion rotation; public bool isKinematic; public void MovePosition(Vector3 p) { position = p; } public void MoveRotation(Quaternion q) { rotation = q; } }
    public enum AnimatorControllerParameterType { Float = 1, Int = 3, Bool = 4, Trigger = 9 }
    public class Texture2D : Object { public int width, height; public byte[] raw = new byte[0]; public Texture2D(int w, int h) { width = w; height = h; } }
    public static class ImageConversion { public static byte[] EncodeToPNG(this Texture2D t) => t.raw; public static bool LoadImage(this Texture2D t, byte[] b) { t.raw = b; return true; } }
    public class AudioClip : Object { public string name; public float length = 1f; }
    public class AudioSource : Component { public AudioClip clip; public float volume = 1f, pitch = 1f, spatialBlend, minDistance = 1f, maxDistance = 500f, time; public bool loop, mute, isPlaying; public AudioClip lastOneShot; public float lastOneShotScale; public void Play() { isPlaying = true; } public void Stop() { isPlaying = false; time = 0; } public void Pause() { isPlaying = false; } public void UnPause() { isPlaying = true; } public void PlayOneShot(AudioClip c, float scale = 1f) { lastOneShot = c; lastOneShotScale = scale; } }
    public class SkinnedMeshRenderer : Component { public Transform[] bones = new Transform[0]; }
    public class AnimatorControllerParameter { public string name; public AnimatorControllerParameterType type; }
    public class Animator : Component { public AnimatorControllerParameter[] parameters = new AnimatorControllerParameter[0]; public float GetFloat(string n) => 0; public void SetFloat(string n, float v) { } public void SetFloat(string n, float v, float damp, float dt) { } public int GetInteger(string n) => 0; public void SetInteger(string n, int v) { } public bool GetBool(string n) => false; public void SetBool(string n, bool v) { } public void SetTrigger(string n) { } }
    public class RequireComponentAttribute : Attribute { public RequireComponentAttribute(Type t) { } }
    public class Behaviour : Component { }
    public class MonoBehaviour : Behaviour { }
    public class ScriptableObject : Object { }
    public class Transform : Component { public Transform parent; public void SetParent(Transform p, bool worldPositionStays = true) { parent = p; } public Vector3 position, localPosition, localScale = new Vector3(1, 1, 1); public Quaternion rotation = Quaternion.identity, localRotation = Quaternion.identity; }
    public struct Vector2 { public float x, y; public Vector2(float a, float b) { x = a; y = b; } }
    public struct Vector3 { public float x, y, z; public Vector3(float a, float b, float c) { x = a; y = b; z = c; } public static Vector3 zero => default; public static Vector3 one => new Vector3(1, 1, 1); public float magnitude => (float)Math.Sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z); public static Vector3 operator +(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z); public static Vector3 operator -(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z); public static Vector3 operator *(Vector3 a, float k) => new Vector3(a.x * k, a.y * k, a.z * k); public static bool operator ==(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => a.x == b.x && a.y == b.y && a.z == b.z; public static bool operator !=(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => !(a == b); public override bool Equals(object o) => o is Vector3 v && v == this; public override int GetHashCode() => x.GetHashCode() ^ y.GetHashCode() ^ z.GetHashCode(); public static float Distance(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => (a - b).magnitude; public static Vector3 Lerp(Vector3 a, Vector3 b, float t) => a + (b - a) * Mathf.Clamp01(t); public override string ToString() => $"({x:0.##}, {y:0.##}, {z:0.##})"; }
    public struct Quaternion { public float x, y, z, w; public Quaternion(float a, float b, float c, float d) { x = a; y = b; z = c; w = d; } public static Quaternion identity => new Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 1); public static Quaternion Slerp(Quaternion a, Quaternion b, float t) { t = Mathf.Clamp01(t); float d = a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z + a.w * b.w; if (d < 0) { b = new Quaternion(-b.x, -b.y, -b.z, -b.w); } var q = new Quaternion(a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t, a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t, a.w + (b.w - a.w) * t); float n = (float)Math.Sqrt(q.x * q.x + q.y * q.y + q.z * q.z + q.w * q.w); return n > 0 ? new Quaternion(q.x / n, q.y / n, q.z / n, q.w / n) : identity; } public static float Angle(Quaternion a, Quaternion b) { float d = Math.Abs(a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z + a.w * b.w); return d >= 1f ? 0f : (float)(Math.Acos(Math.Min(1, d)) * 2 * 57.29578); } public static Quaternion Euler(float x, float y, float z) { double cy = Math.Cos(z * 0.00872665), sy = Math.Sin(z * 0.00872665), cp = Math.Cos(y * 0.00872665), sp = Math.Sin(y * 0.00872665), cr = Math.Cos(x * 0.00872665), sr = Math.Sin(x * 0.00872665); return new Quaternion((float)(sr * cp * cy - cr * sp * sy), (float)(cr * sp * cy + sr * cp * sy), (float)(cr * cp * sy - sr * sp * cy), (float)(cr * cp * cy + sr * sp * sy)); } }
    public static class Mathf { public static float Min(float a, float b) => a < b ? a : b; public static float Clamp01(float v) => v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v; public static float Max(float a, float b) => a > b ? a : b; public static float Abs(float v) => Math.Abs(v); public static float Sqrt(float v) => (float)Math.Sqrt(v); public static float Lerp(float a, float b, float t) => a + (b - a) * Clamp01(t); }
    public static class SystemInfo { public static Rendering.GraphicsDeviceType graphicsDeviceType => Rendering.GraphicsDeviceType.Null; }
    namespace Rendering { public enum GraphicsDeviceType { Null = 4 } }
    public static class Time { public static float unscaledDeltaTime => 0.016f; public static float deltaTime => 0.016f; public static float unscaledTime => 0; }
    public static class Debug { public static void Log(object o) { Console.WriteLine(o); } public static void LogWarning(object o) { Console.WriteLine(o); } public static void LogError(object o) { Console.WriteLine(o); } }
    public class TooltipAttribute : Attribute { public TooltipAttribute(string s) { } }
```

`sdk/unity/BuildCheck~/managed-rehost/Program.cs`:

```cs
// Live rehost check: joins a relay room on node A, waits for OnRehost (A got SIGTERM), RejoinAsync
// via node B with the same grant, then a second client on B must still reach it.
using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Aurix.Net;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;

class P
{
    const string A = "http://127.0.0.1:8090", B = "http://127.0.0.1:8091";
    static async Task<string> Grant(HttpClient h, string http, string key, string pid)
    {
        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, http + "/v1/grants");
        req.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", key);
        req.Content = new StringContent("{\"player_id\":\"" + pid + "\",\"name\":\"" + pid + "\"}", Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
        var r = await h.SendAsync(req); var body = await r.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        if (!r.IsSuccessStatusCode) throw new Exception(body);
        int i = body.IndexOf("\"grant\":\"") + 9; return body.Substring(i, body.IndexOf('"', i) - i);
    }
    static async Task<int> Main(string[] args)
    {
        var key = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("NET_API_KEY");
        var room = args.Length > 0 ? args[0] : "cs-rehost-" + DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks;
        var h = new HttpClient();
        var a = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync(A, await Grant(h, A, key, "cs-rehost-a"));
        int actor1 = await a.JoinOrCreateAsync(room, "relay", 8);
        Console.WriteLine($"cs: joined {room} actor={actor1} on A");
        bool rehost = false; int frames = 0;
        a.OnRehost += () => rehost = true;
        a.OnData += (ch, t, p) => frames++;
        var deadline = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(60);
        while (!rehost && DateTime.UtcNow < deadline)
        {
            a.SendEvent(1, new byte[] { 1 }, Target.Others, reliable: false); a.Flush(); a.Poll();
            await Task.Delay(50);
        }
        if (!rehost) { Console.WriteLine("CS_REHOST_FAIL no rehost within 60 s"); return 1; }
        Console.WriteLine($"cs: got rehost after {frames} data frames");
        var a2 = await a.RejoinAsync(B);
        Console.WriteLine($"cs: rejoined actor={a2.Actor} (same actor: {a2.Actor == actor1})");
        string got = null;
        a2.OnEvent += f => { if (f.Code == 7) got = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(f.Payload.Array, f.Payload.Offset, f.Payload.Count); };
        var b = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync(B, await Grant(h, B, key, "cs-rehost-b"));
        await b.JoinAsync(room);
        b.SendEvent(7, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("after-rehost"), Target.Others, reliable: true); b.Flush();
        deadline = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(3);
        while (got == null && DateTime.UtcNow < deadline) { a2.Poll(); b.Poll(); await Task.Delay(5); }
        bool ok = got == "after-rehost" && a2.Actor == actor1;
        Console.WriteLine(ok ? "CS_REHOST_OK" : $"CS_REHOST_FAIL got={got}");
        a2.Dispose(); b.Dispose();
        return ok ? 0 : 1;
    }
}
```
