`sdk/unity/BuildCheck~/managed-tests/Program.cs`:

```cs
// Offline unit checks for the managed core (no node needed): `dotnet run`.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Aurix.Net;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using Aurix.Net.Sim;
using Aurix.Net.Sim.Bots;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.IO;

static class Program
{
    static int _fails;
    static void Check(bool ok, string what) { if (!ok) { _fails++; Console.WriteLine("FAIL " + what); } else Console.WriteLine("ok   " + what); }

    // 1-D mover: input byte = signed velocity, world is a wall at x = 10.
    static int Step(int x, byte[] input) { int v = input != null && input.Length > 0 ? (sbyte)input[0] : 0; return Math.Min(10, x + v); }
    static byte[] In(int v) => new[] { (byte)(sbyte)v };

    static void TickTimerTests()
    {
        var t = TickTimer.CreateFromSeconds(100, 0.5f, 60);
        Check(t.IsRunning && t.End == 130 && !t.Expired(100) && t.IsActive(129) && t.RemainingTicks(110) == 20, "0.5 s at 60 Hz = 30 ticks");
        Check(t.Expired(130) && t.Expired(500) && !t.IsActive(130) && t.RemainingTicks(130) == 0, "expired at End and stays expired");
        Check(System.Math.Abs(t.Normalized(115) - 0.5f) < 1e-6 && t.Normalized(999) == 1f, "normalized progress");
        Check(!TickTimer.None.IsRunning && !TickTimer.None.Expired(10) && TickTimer.None.Normalized(10) == 1f, "None never runs or expires");
        Check(TickTimer.CreateFromTicks(5, 0).End == 6, "zero ticks still expires one tick later");
        Check(System.Math.Abs(t.RemainingSeconds(100, 60) - 0.5f) < 1e-6, "remaining seconds");
    }

    static void PredictorTests()
    {
        var p = new Predictor<int>(0, Step);
        // Perfect prediction: server agrees tick by tick, nothing is replayed.
        p.Record(1, In(2)); p.Record(2, In(2)); p.Record(3, In(2));
        Check(p.Predicted == 6 && p.Pending == 3, "predicted 3 inputs ahead");
        Check(!p.Reconcile(1, 2) && p.Pending == 2 && p.Predicted == 6, "confirming tick 1 keeps the prediction");
        Check(!p.Reconcile(3, 6) && p.Pending == 0 && p.Mispredictions == 0, "all confirmed, no misprediction");

        // Server disagrees (we were pushed back to 1 at tick 4): later inputs replay on top of it.
        int correctedFrom = -1, correctedTo = -1;
        p.OnCorrected += (was, now) => { correctedFrom = was; correctedTo = now; };
        p.Record(4, In(2)); p.Record(5, In(2)); p.Record(6, In(2)); // predicts 8, 10(wall), 10
        Check(p.Reconcile(4, 1) && p.Predicted == 5 && p.Pending == 2, "replayed 2 pending inputs on the server state (1 + 2 + 2)");
        Check(p.Mispredictions == 1 && correctedFrom == 8 && correctedTo == 1, "correction reported with predicted vs authoritative");

        // Stale / reordered state is ignored.
        Check(!p.Reconcile(3, 99) && p.Predicted == 5, "stale tick ignored");

        // Custom divergence threshold: small drift tolerated.
        var q = new Predictor<int>(0, Step, (a, b) => Math.Abs(a - b) > 1);
        q.Record(1, In(3)); q.Record(2, In(3));
        Check(!q.Reconcile(1, 2) && q.Predicted == 6, "within threshold: no replay");
        Check(q.Reconcile(2, 0) && q.Predicted == 0, "beyond threshold: replay");

        // Capacity: oldest in-flight inputs are dropped.
        var r = new Predictor<int>(0, Step, null, 4);
        for (uint t = 1; t <= 10; t++) r.Record(t, In(1));
        Check(r.Pending == 4 && r.Predicted == 10, "ring keeps the last 4 inputs");
        r.Reset(0); Check(r.Pending == 0 && r.Predicted == 0, "reset");
    }

    static string Hex(byte[] b) { var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(); foreach (var x in b) sb.Append(x.ToString("x2")); return sb.ToString(); }

    // Golden vectors shared with the Web SDK tests (sdk/web/test/sync.test.mjs): the same schema + values
    // must encode to the same bytes in C# and TypeScript.
    static void CodecVectors()
    {
        var schema = Schema.Parse("component Transform {\n  pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)\n  rot: quat\n}\ncomponent Stats {\n  hp: u16\n  name: string(16)\n  speed: f32\n  team: i8\n  flags: bits(5)\n  seed: u64\n}\n");
        var tr = schema.ByName("Transform"); var st = schema.ByName("Stats");
        var world = new SyncWorld(schema);
        var pos = new ComponentValue { Fields = new[] { new Value { X = 1.25f, Y = -2.5f, Z = 300.75f }, new Value { X = 0.1f, Y = 0.2f, Z = 0.3f, W = 0.9f } } };
        var stats = new ComponentValue { Fields = new[] { new Value { U = 4242 }, new Value { S = "zé" }, new Value { F = 3.5f }, new Value { I = -3 }, new Value { U = 21 }, new Value { U = 0x0123456789abcdefUL } } };
        Console.WriteLine("VECTOR writes " + Hex(world.EncodeWrites(new List<(ComponentDef, ComponentValue)> { (tr, pos), (st, stats) })));
        var w = new BitWriter(); w.WriteBits(0x1ff, 9); w.WriteInt(-77, 12); w.WriteQuantized(12.345f, -100, 100, 0.001f); w.WriteF32(1.5f); w.WriteBits(ulong.MaxValue, 64); w.WriteBool(true);
        Console.WriteLine("VECTOR bits " + Hex(w.Finish()));
        Console.WriteLine("VECTOR input " + Hex(SyncWorld.EncodeInput(0x01020304, new List<byte[]> { new byte[] { 1, 2 }, new byte[0], new byte[] { 9 } })));
        Console.WriteLine("VECTOR ack " + Hex(SyncWorld.EncodeAck(0xdeadbeef, 0x80000001)));
    }

    static void LockstepTests()
    {
        var sent = new List<(Channel, byte[])>();
        var ls = new LockstepClient((ch, b) => sent.Add((ch, b)));
        // adaptive delay: late inputs raise it at once, steady slack lowers it slowly
        ls.OnInputStats(-2, 2);
        Check(ls.InputDelay == 4 && ls.LateInputs == 2, "late by 2 -> delay 2 -> 4");
        ls.OnInputStats(3, 0); ls.OnInputStats(3, 0);
        Check(ls.InputDelay == 4, "two slack reports: unchanged");
        ls.OnInputStats(3, 0);
        Check(ls.InputDelay == 3, "third slack report: -1");
        ls.OnInputStats(1, 0); ls.OnInputStats(3, 0); ls.OnInputStats(3, 0); ls.OnInputStats(3, 0);
        Check(ls.InputDelay == 2, "streak resets on a tight report");
        ls.InputDelay = ls.InputDelayMax; ls.OnInputStats(-9, 1);
        Check(ls.InputDelay == ls.InputDelayMax, "capped at max");
        // the same frame through Receive
        Check(ls.Receive(new byte[] { 0x25, 0, 0, 0, 10, unchecked((byte)(sbyte)-1), 1 }) && ls.LastMargin == -1, "0x25 parsed");
        // dump request -> event -> SendDump frame on the reliable channel
        uint asked = 0; ls.OnDumpRequested += t => asked = t;
        ls.Receive(new byte[] { 0x26, 0, 0, 1, 0 });
        Check(asked == 256, "dump requested for tick 256");
        ls.SendDump(256, 0x1122334455667788UL, new byte[] { 7, 7 });
        var d = sent[sent.Count - 1];
        Check(d.Item1 == Channel.Reliable && Hex(d.Item2) == "27000001001122334455667788" + "0707", "dump frame layout");
        // input redundancy window
        ls.InputRedundancy = 2; ls.SendInput(new byte[] { 1 }); ls.SendInput(new byte[] { 2 }); ls.SendInput(new byte[] { 3 });
        Check(sent[sent.Count - 1].Item2[5] == 2, "two inputs per datagram");
    }


    sealed class Toy : ISimulation<(ulong state, int steps)>
    {
        public ulong State; public int Steps;
        public void Step(uint tick, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> inputs)
        {
            foreach (var kv in inputs.OrderBy(k => k.Key)) { ulong b = kv.Value.Length > 0 ? kv.Value[0] : 0UL; unchecked { State = State * 31 + tick * 1000UL + kv.Key * 10UL + b; } }
            unchecked { State = State * 7 + tick; } Steps++;
        }
        public (ulong state, int steps) Snapshot() => (State, Steps);
        public void Restore((ulong state, int steps) s) { State = s.state; Steps = s.steps; }
    }
    static Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> Inputs(params (ushort, byte)[] v) { var d = new Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>(); foreach (var (a, b) in v) d[a] = new[] { b }; return d; }
    static ulong Reference(List<Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>> script) { var s = new Toy(); for (int t = 0; t < script.Count; t++) s.Step((uint)t, script[t]); return s.State; }

    static void RollbackTests()
    {
        var sim = new Toy(); var rb = new LockstepRollback<(ulong, int)>(sim, 1, 0, 8);
        var script = new List<Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>>(); for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) script.Add(Inputs((1, 5), (2, 9)));
        rb.Confirm(0, script[0]); bool rolled = false;
        for (uint t = 1; t < 10; t++) { rb.LocalInput(t, new byte[] { 5 }); rb.Predict(t + 3); rolled |= rb.Confirm(t, script[(int)t]); }
        Check(!rolled && rb.Rollbacks == 0 && rb.ConfirmedTick == 10 && rb.HeadTick > rb.ConfirmedTick, "rollback: correct predictions never roll back");

        sim = new Toy(); rb = new LockstepRollback<(ulong, int)>(sim, 1, 0, 8);
        script.Clear(); for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) script.Add(Inputs((1, 1), (2, 2)));
        script[4] = Inputs((1, 1), (2, 7)); script[5] = Inputs((2, 7));
        for (uint t = 0; t < 8; t++) { rb.LocalInput(t, new byte[] { 1 }); rb.Predict(t + 4); rb.Confirm(t, script[(int)t]); }
        Check(rb.Rollbacks == 4 && rb.ResimulatedTicks > 0 && rb.HeadTick == 11, "rollback: mispredictions roll back and re-predict (" + rb.Rollbacks + ")");
        var pure = new Toy(); var rb2 = new LockstepRollback<(ulong, int)>(pure, 1, 0, 8);
        for (uint t = 0; t < 8; t++) rb2.Confirm(t, script[(int)t]);
        Check(pure.State == Reference(script), "rollback: confirmed-only run equals pure lockstep");

        sim = new Toy(); rb = new LockstepRollback<(ulong, int)>(sim, 1, 0, 3);
        rb.Predict(100);
        Check(rb.HeadTick == 3 && rb.PredictedTicks == 3 && !rb.Confirm(7, Inputs()), "rollback: prediction bounded, out-of-order confirm ignored");
        rb.Reset(50); rb.Predict(52);
        Check(rb.ConfirmedTick == 50 && rb.HeadTick == 52, "rollback: reset forgets history");

        var ring = new ReplayRing<uint>(50, 10);
        for (uint t = 0; t < 100; t++) ring.Record(t, Inputs((1, (byte)t)), () => t * 100);
        var w = ring.Window(73).Value;
        Check(w.Start == 70 && w.Snapshot == 7000 && w.Inputs.Count == 30 && w.Inputs[0][1][0] == 70, "replay ring: window from nearest snapshot");
        w = ring.Window(5).Value;
        Check(w.Start == 50 && w.Inputs.Count == 50 && ring.Oldest == 50, "replay ring: clamps to the oldest kept snapshot");
        ring.Record(200, Inputs(), () => 1);
        Check(ring.Oldest == 200 && ring.Window(0).Value.Inputs.Count == 1, "replay ring: gap resets");

    }


    sealed class Scripted : IBrain
    {
        public uint T; public uint PatrolLeft;
        public bool Condition(uint id, Blackboard bb) => id == 1 ? (T >= 8 && T <= 12) || (T >= 20 && T <= 22) : id == 2 && bb.Get(50) == 1;
        public Status Action(uint id, Blackboard bb)
        {
            switch (id)
            {
                case 10: if (PatrolLeft == 0) { PatrolLeft = 3; return Status.Success; } PatrolLeft--; return Status.Running;
                case 11: bb.Set(100, bb.Get(100) + 1); return Status.Running;
                case 12: bb.Set(101, bb.Get(101) + 1); return Status.Success;
                case 20: return Status.Success;
                case 30: return Status.Running;
                default: if (id >= 100 && id <= 103) { bb.Set(id, bb.Get(id) + 1); return Status.Success; } return Status.Failure;
            }
        }
        public void Abort(uint id, Blackboard bb) => bb.Set(102, bb.Get(102) + 1);
    }

    static string BbJson(Blackboard bb) => "{" + string.Join(",", bb.Values.Select(kv => "\"" + kv.Key + "\":" + kv.Value)) + "}";
    static string BbJson(JsonElement e) => "{" + string.Join(",", e.EnumerateObject().OrderBy(p => uint.Parse(p.Name)).Select(p => "\"" + p.Name + "\":" + p.Value.GetInt64())) + "}";

    static void BotsTests()
    {
        var dir = AppContext.BaseDirectory;
        while (dir != null && !Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(dir, "crates"))) dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(dir.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
        var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(dir, "crates/net-sim-bots/fixtures/vectors.json"))).RootElement;
        var tree = new BehaviorTree(BtNode.Parse(doc.GetProperty("tree")));
        var bb = new Blackboard(); var brain = new Scripted { PatrolLeft = 2 };
        bool ok = true; uint t = 0;
        foreach (var exp in doc.GetProperty("tree_ticks").EnumerateArray())
        {
            brain.T = t; var st = tree.Step(brain, bb);
            ok &= st.ToString() == exp.GetProperty("status").GetString() && "0x" + tree.Hash().ToString("x") == exp.GetProperty("hash").GetString() && BbJson(bb) == BbJson(exp.GetProperty("bb"));
            t++;
        }
        Check(ok, "bots: behavior tree replays the Rust vectors (" + t + " ticks)");
        var fsm = StateMachine.FromJson(doc.GetProperty("fsm").GetRawText());
        var fbb = new Blackboard(); var fbrain = new Scripted();
        fsm.Start(fbrain, fbb);
        bool fok = true; t = 0;
        foreach (var exp in doc.GetProperty("fsm_ticks").EnumerateArray())
        {
            fbrain.T = t; if (t == 25) fbb.Set(50, 1);
            fsm.Step(fbrain, fbb);
            fok &= fsm.Current == exp.GetProperty("current").GetUInt32() && "0x" + fsm.Hash().ToString("x") == exp.GetProperty("hash").GetString() && BbJson(fbb) == BbJson(exp.GetProperty("bb"));
            t++;
        }
        Check(fok, "bots: state machine replays the Rust vectors (" + t + " ticks)");
    }

    static void SimTests()
    {
        Check(SimWorld.GoldenHash() == 0x58d9870ba45952b5UL, "sim: golden hash equals the Rust/wasm value");
        using var a = new SimWorld();
        using var b = new SimWorld();
        uint ballA = 0, ballB = 0;
        foreach (var (w, isA) in new[] { (a, true), (b, false) })
        {
            w.AddBox(BodyKind.Static, 0, -1, 50, 1);
            uint ball = w.AddCircle(BodyKind.Dynamic, 0, 5, 1);
            w.SetMaterial(ball, 0.3, 0.2);
            if (isA) ballA = ball; else ballB = ball;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++) { a.Step(); b.Step(); }
        Check(a.Hash() == b.Hash() && ballA == ballB, "sim: two worlds agree");
        double y = a.Body(ballA).Y;
        Check(y > 0.9 && y < 1.1, "sim: ball rests on the floor (" + y.ToString("F3") + ")");
        var snap = a.Snapshot(); ulong h = a.Hash(); a.Step();
        Check(a.Restore(snap) && a.Hash() == h, "sim: snapshot round-trip");
        Check(a.Raycast(0, 5, 0, -10, out var hit) && hit.Body == ballA && Math.Abs(hit.Ny - 1) < 1e-6, "sim: raycast hits the ball from above");
        Check(SimWorld.NavGoldenHash() == 0x746c5a608abe2f26UL, "nav: golden hash equals the Rust/wasm value");
        Check(SimWorld.JointGoldenHash() == 0x4bcc781a484ceeedUL, "joints: golden hash equals the Rust/wasm value");
        Check(Sim3World.GoldenHash() == 0x0a9c7e6fc4fa43bfUL, "sim3: golden hash equals the Rust/wasm value");
        using (var w3 = new Sim3World())
        {
            w3.AddBox(BodyKind.Static, new Vec3(0, -0.5, 0), new Vec3(10, 0.5, 10));
            uint ball3 = w3.AddSphere(BodyKind.Dynamic, new Vec3(0, 3, 0), 0.5);
            for (int i = 0; i < 240; i++) w3.Step();
            Check(Math.Abs(w3.Body(ball3).Position.Y - 0.5) < 0.03, "sim3: sphere rests on the floor");
            var snap3 = w3.Snapshot(); ulong h3 = w3.Hash();
            w3.SetPosition(ball3, new Vec3(0, 9, 0));
            Check(w3.Hash() != h3 && w3.Restore(snap3) && w3.Hash() == h3, "sim3: snapshot round-trip");
            Check(w3.Raycast(new Vec3(0, 5, 0), new Vec3(0, -10, 0), out var h3hit) && h3hit.Body == ball3 && Math.Abs(h3hit.Point.Y - 1) < 0.05, "sim3: raycast hits the sphere");
        }
        Check(Sim3World.JointGoldenHash() == 0x5db56af63cceee85UL, "sim3: joint golden hash equals the Rust/wasm value");
        Check(Sim3World.HullGoldenHash() == 0xd656fc8f55999cf8UL, "sim3: hull golden hash equals the Rust/wasm value");
        using (var c3 = new Sim3World())
        {
            c3.AddBox(BodyKind.Static, new Vec3(0, -0.5, 0), new Vec3(20, 0.5, 20));
            var verts = new[] { new Vec3(-0.5, -0.25, -0.5), new Vec3(0.5, -0.25, -0.5), new Vec3(0.5, -0.25, 0.5), new Vec3(-0.5, -0.25, 0.5), new Vec3(0, 0.75, 0) };
            var faces = new[] { new uint[] { 0, 1, 2, 3 }, new uint[] { 0, 1, 4 }, new uint[] { 1, 2, 4 }, new uint[] { 2, 3, 4 }, new uint[] { 3, 0, 4 } };
            uint pyr = c3.AddConvex(BodyKind.Dynamic, new Vec3(0, 2, 0), verts, faces);
            for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++) c3.Step();
            var pp = c3.Body(pyr).Position;
            Check(Math.Abs(pp.Y - 0.25) < 0.06, "sim3: convex pyramid rests on the floor (" + pp.Y.ToString("F3") + ")");
            Check(c3.SphereCast(new Vec3(0, 5, 0), new Vec3(0, -10, 0), 0.5, out var sh) && sh.Body == pyr && Math.Abs(sh.Point.Y - 1.0) < 0.05 && sh.Normal.Y > 0.5, "sim3: sphere cast hits the pyramid apex");
            var q0 = new Quat(0, 0, 0, 1);
            Check(c3.BoxCast(new Vec3(0, 5, 0), q0, new Vec3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), new Vec3(0, -10, 0), out var bh) && bh.Body == pyr && Math.Abs(bh.Point.Y - 1.0) < 0.05 && Math.Abs(bh.Fraction - 0.35) < 0.01, "sim3: box cast stops on the pyramid apex (y=" + bh.Point.Y.ToString("F3") + ")");
            Check(c3.CapsuleCast(new Vec3(0, 5, 0), q0, 0.5, 0.25, new Vec3(0, -10, 0), out var ch) && ch.Body == pyr && Math.Abs(ch.Point.Y - 1.0) < 0.05 && Math.Abs(ch.Fraction - 0.325) < 0.01, "sim3: capsule cast stops on the pyramid apex (y=" + ch.Point.Y.ToString("F3") + ")");
            Check(!c3.BoxCast(new Vec3(0, 5, 0), q0, new Vec3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), new Vec3(10, 0, 0), out _), "sim3: box cast misses sideways");
        }
        using (var j3 = new Sim3World())
        {
            j3.AddBox(BodyKind.Static, new Vec3(0, -0.5, 0), new Vec3(20, 0.5, 20));
            uint post = j3.AddBox(BodyKind.Static, new Vec3(-10, 1, 0), new Vec3(0.1, 1, 0.1));
            uint door = j3.AddBox(BodyKind.Dynamic, new Vec3(-9.4, 1, 0), new Vec3(0.5, 1, 0.05));
            uint hinge = j3.JointHinge(post, door, new Vec3(0.1, 0, 0), new Vec3(-0.5, 0, 0), new Vec3(0, 1, 0), new Vec3(0, 1, 0), 0, Math.PI / 2);
            j3.ApplyImpulse(door, new Vec3(0, 0, 8), new Vec3(-9, 1, 0));
            j3.AddBox(BodyKind.Static, new Vec3(4, 0.15, 10), new Vec3(1, 0.15, 2));
            uint hero = j3.AddCapsule(BodyKind.Kinematic, new Vec3(0, 0.8, 10), 0.5, 0.3);
            uint k = j3.Character(hero);
            for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++) { j3.MoveCharacter(k, new Vec3(3.0 / 60, -10.0 / 60, 0)); j3.Step(); }
            double angle = j3.HingeAngle(hinge);
            Check(angle > 0.3 && angle < Math.PI / 2 + 0.1, "sim3: hinged door opened within its limits (" + angle.ToString("F2") + ")");
            var hp = j3.Body(hero).Position;
            Check(hp.X > 5 && Math.Abs(hp.Y - 0.8) < 0.05 && j3.CharacterState(k).Grounded, "sim3: character stepped over the ledge and stands (" + hp.X.ToString("F2") + "," + hp.Y.ToString("F2") + ")");
        }
        using (var j = new SimWorld(0, -10))
        {
            uint floor = j.AddBox(BodyKind.Static, 0, -0.5, 10, 0.5);
            uint ball = j.AddCircle(BodyKind.Dynamic, 0, 2, 0.5);
            int begins = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++) { j.Step(); foreach (var e in j.Events()) if (e.Begin && ((e.A == ball && e.B == floor) || (e.A == floor && e.B == ball))) begins++; }
            Check(begins >= 1, "joints: ball/floor contact begin reported");
            Check(j.CircleCast(-5, 0.5, 10, 0, 0.4, out var ch) && ch.Body == ball && Math.Abs(ch.X + 0.9) < 0.01, "joints: circle cast stops one radius short of the ball");
        }
        using var n = new SimWorld(0, 0);
        n.NavGrid(0, 0, 1, 8, 6, new (uint, uint)[] { (4, 0), (4, 1), (4, 2), (4, 3), (4, 4) });
        var path = n.NavPath(0.5, 0.5, 7.5, 0.5);
        Check(path != null && Array.Exists(path, p => p.x == 4 && p.y == 5), "nav: path rounds the wall");
        Check(n.NavRaycast(0.5, 0.5, 7.5, 0.5, out _, out _), "nav: wall blocks line of sight");
        uint field = n.NavField(7.5, 0.5);
        uint ag = n.AddAgent(0.5, 0.5, 0.25, 3);
        n.AgentFollow(ag, field);
        for (int i = 0; i < 600; i++) n.CrowdStep();
        var st = n.Agent(ag);
        Check(Math.Sqrt((st.X - 7.5) * (st.X - 7.5) + (st.Y - 0.5) * (st.Y - 0.5)) < 0.5, "nav: agent reached the goal (" + st.X.ToString("F2") + "," + st.Y.ToString("F2") + ")");
    }

    static int Main()
    {
        try { SimTests(); }
        catch (DllNotFoundException)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("skip sim/nav checks: libnet_sim_wasm not built (cargo build --release -p net-sim-wasm)");
        }
        BotsTests();
        PredictorTests();
        TickTimerTests();
        LockstepTests();
        RollbackTests();
        CodecVectors();
        Console.WriteLine(_fails == 0 ? "all managed checks passed" : _fails + " check(s) failed");
        return _fails == 0 ? 0 : 1;
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/BuildCheck~/transports-check/Program.cs`:

```cs
// Compile check + live test of the PurrNet / Mirror / FishNet transports over a local node
// (the live part skips without NET_API_KEY). The same scenario runs through each adapter:
// host + two clients, ping/pong both ways, a 4000-byte reliable frame, a kick, host stop.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

interface IDriver
{
    string Name { get; }
    void Listen(); void StopListening(); bool Listening { get; } int Peers { get; }
    void Connect(); bool Connected { get; }
    void SendToServer(byte[] data, bool reliable); void SendToClient(int conn, byte[] data, bool reliable); void Kick(int conn); int FirstPeer { get; } int LastPeer { get; }
    void Pump();
    Action<string> Log { get; set; }
}

sealed class PurrDriver : IDriver
{
    readonly Aurix.Net.PurrNet.AurixNetTransport t = new Aurix.Net.PurrNet.AurixNetTransport();
    public string Name => "PurrNet";
    public Action<string> Log { get; set; }
    public PurrDriver(string room, Func<Task<string>> grant, string tag)
    {
        t.roomName = room; t.GrantProvider = grant;
        t.onConnected += (c, s) => Log?.Invoke(s ? $"H+{c.connectionId}" : $"{tag}+");
        t.onDisconnected += (c, r, s) => Log?.Invoke(s ? $"H-{c.connectionId}:{r}" : $"{tag}-:{r}");
        t.onDataReceived += (c, d, s) => Log?.Invoke((s ? $"Hrx{c.connectionId}:" : $"{tag}rx:") + Program.Show(d.data, d.offset, d.length));
    }
    public void Listen() => t.Listen(0); public void StopListening() => t.StopListening();
    public bool Listening => t.listenerState == PurrNet.Transports.ConnectionState.Connected; public int Peers => t.connections.Count;
    public void Connect() => t.Connect(null, 0); public bool Connected => t.clientState == PurrNet.Transports.ConnectionState.Connected;
    public void SendToServer(byte[] d, bool r) => t.SendToServer(new PurrNet.Transports.ByteData(d, 0, d.Length), r ? PurrNet.Transports.Channel.ReliableOrdered : PurrNet.Transports.Channel.Unreliable);
    public void SendToClient(int c, byte[] d, bool r) => t.SendToClient(new PurrNet.Transports.Connection(c), new PurrNet.Transports.ByteData(d, 0, d.Length), r ? PurrNet.Transports.Channel.ReliableOrdered : PurrNet.Transports.Channel.Unreliable);
    public void Kick(int c) => t.CloseConnection(new PurrNet.Transports.Connection(c));
    public int FirstPeer => t.connections[0].connectionId; public int LastPeer => t.connections[t.connections.Count - 1].connectionId;
    public void Pump() { t.ReceiveMessages(0); t.SendMessages(0); }
}

sealed class MirrorDriver : IDriver
{
    readonly Aurix.Net.MirrorTransport.AurixNetMirrorTransport t = new Aurix.Net.MirrorTransport.AurixNetMirrorTransport();
    readonly List<int> peers = new List<int>();
    public string Name => "Mirror";
    public Action<string> Log { get; set; }
    public MirrorDriver(string room, Func<Task<string>> grant, string tag)
    {
        t.roomName = room; t.GrantProvider = grant;
        t.OnServerConnected = c => { peers.Add(c); Log?.Invoke($"H+{c}"); };
        t.OnServerDisconnected = c => { peers.Remove(c); Log?.Invoke($"H-{c}:ServerRequest"); };
        t.OnServerDataReceived = (c, d, ch) => Log?.Invoke($"Hrx{c}:" + Program.Show(d.Array, d.Offset, d.Count));
        t.OnClientConnected = () => Log?.Invoke($"{tag}+");
        t.OnClientDisconnected = () => Log?.Invoke($"{tag}-:{last}");
        t.OnClientError = (e, m) => last = e.ToString();
        t.OnClientDataReceived = (d, ch) => Log?.Invoke($"{tag}rx:" + Program.Show(d.Array, d.Offset, d.Count));
    }
    string last = "ClientRequest";
    public void Listen() => t.ServerStart(); public void StopListening() => t.ServerStop();
    public bool Listening => t.ServerActive(); public int Peers => peers.Count;
    public void Connect() => t.ClientConnect(""); public bool Connected => t.ClientConnected();
    public void SendToServer(byte[] d, bool r) => t.ClientSend(new ArraySegment<byte>(d), r ? 0 : 1);
    public void SendToClient(int c, byte[] d, bool r) => t.ServerSend(c, new ArraySegment<byte>(d), r ? 0 : 1);
    public void Kick(int c) => t.ServerDisconnect(c);
    public int FirstPeer => peers[0]; public int LastPeer => peers[peers.Count - 1];
    public void Pump() { t.ServerEarlyUpdate(); t.ClientEarlyUpdate(); t.ServerLateUpdate(); t.ClientLateUpdate(); }
}

sealed class FishDriver : IDriver
{
    readonly Aurix.Net.FishNetTransport.AurixNetFishNetTransport t = new Aurix.Net.FishNetTransport.AurixNetFishNetTransport();
    readonly List<int> peers = new List<int>();
    public string Name => "FishNet";
    public Action<string> Log { get; set; }
    public FishDriver(string room, Func<Task<string>> grant, string tag)
    {
        t.roomName = room; t.GrantProvider = grant; t.Initialize(null, 0);
        t.OnRemoteConnectionState += a => { if (a.ConnectionState == FishNet.Transporting.RemoteConnectionState.Started) { peers.Add(a.ConnectionId); Log?.Invoke($"H+{a.ConnectionId}"); } else { peers.Remove(a.ConnectionId); Log?.Invoke($"H-{a.ConnectionId}:ServerRequest"); } };
        t.OnServerReceivedData += a => Log?.Invoke($"Hrx{a.ConnectionId}:" + Program.Show(a.Data.Array, a.Data.Offset, a.Data.Count));
        t.OnClientConnectionState += a => { if (a.ConnectionState == FishNet.Transporting.LocalConnectionState.Started) Log?.Invoke($"{tag}+"); else if (a.ConnectionState == FishNet.Transporting.LocalConnectionState.Stopped) Log?.Invoke($"{tag}-:Stopped"); };
        t.OnClientReceivedData += a => Log?.Invoke($"{tag}rx:" + Program.Show(a.Data.Array, a.Data.Offset, a.Data.Count));
    }
    public void Listen() => t.StartConnection(true); public void StopListening() => t.StopConnection(true);
    public bool Listening => t.GetConnectionState(true) == FishNet.Transporting.LocalConnectionState.Started; public int Peers => peers.Count;
    public void Connect() => t.StartConnection(false); public bool Connected => t.GetConnectionState(false) == FishNet.Transporting.LocalConnectionState.Started;
    public void SendToServer(byte[] d, bool r) => t.SendToServer(r ? (byte)0 : (byte)1, new ArraySegment<byte>(d));
    public void SendToClient(int c, byte[] d, bool r) => t.SendToClient(r ? (byte)0 : (byte)1, new ArraySegment<byte>(d), c);
    public void Kick(int c) => t.StopConnection(c, true);
    public int FirstPeer => peers[0]; public int LastPeer => peers[peers.Count - 1];
    public void Pump() { t.IterateIncoming(true); t.IterateIncoming(false); t.IterateOutgoing(true); t.IterateOutgoing(false); }
}

static class Program
{
    public static string Show(byte[] b, int o, int n) => n > 64 ? $"{n}B" : Encoding.UTF8.GetString(b, o, n);

    static async Task<string> Grant(HttpClient h, string key, string pid)
    {
        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/grants");
        req.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", key);
        req.Content = new StringContent("{\"player_id\":\"" + pid + "\",\"name\":\"" + pid + "\"}", Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
        var r = await h.SendAsync(req); var body = await r.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        if (!r.IsSuccessStatusCode) throw new Exception(body);
        int i = body.IndexOf("\"grant\":\"") + 9; return body.Substring(i, body.IndexOf('"', i) - i);
    }

    static async Task Pump(params IDriver[] ds) { var until = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(1500); while (DateTime.UtcNow < until) { foreach (var d in ds) d.Pump(); await Task.Delay(5); } }

    static async Task<bool> Scenario(Func<string, string, IDriver> make)
    {
        var host = make("host", "H"); var c1 = make("c1", "C1"); var c2 = make("c2", "C2");
        var log = new StringBuilder();
        Action<string> L = s => log.Append(s).Append(' ');
        host.Log = L; c1.Log = L; c2.Log = L;
        host.Log = s => { L(s); if (s.StartsWith("Hrx")) { int conn = int.Parse(s.Substring(3, s.IndexOf(':') - 3)); host.SendToClient(conn, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("pong"), false); } };

        host.Listen(); await Pump(host);
        if (!host.Listening) { Console.WriteLine($"[{host.Name}] FAIL host not listening"); return false; }
        c1.Connect(); c2.Connect(); await Pump(host, c1, c2);
        Console.WriteLine($"[{host.Name}] connections on host: {host.Peers}/2  c1={c1.Connected} c2={c2.Connected}");
        c1.SendToServer(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("ping1"), true); c2.SendToServer(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("ping2"), true); await Pump(host, c1, c2);
        host.SendToClient(host.FirstPeer, new byte[4000], true); await Pump(host, c1, c2);
        host.Kick(host.LastPeer); await Pump(host, c1, c2);
        host.StopListening(); await Pump(host, c1, c2);
        var s = log.ToString();
        Console.WriteLine($"[{host.Name}] log: {s}");
        bool ok = s.Contains("H+") && s.Contains("C1+") && s.Contains("C2+") && s.Contains("ping1") && s.Contains("ping2") && s.Contains("C1rx:pong") && s.Contains("C2rx:pong")
                  && s.Contains("rx:4000B") && s.Contains("ServerRequest") && s.Contains("C1-") && s.Contains("C2-") && host.Peers == 0 && !c1.Connected && !c2.Connected;
        Console.WriteLine($"[{host.Name}] {(ok ? "LIVE OK" : "LIVE FAIL")}");
        return ok;
    }

    static async Task<int> Main()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("TRANSPORT ADAPTERS COMPILE OK: " + typeof(Aurix.Net.PurrNet.AurixNetTransport).Name + ", " + typeof(Aurix.Net.MirrorTransport.AurixNetMirrorTransport).Name + ", " + typeof(Aurix.Net.FishNetTransport.AurixNetFishNetTransport).Name);
        var key = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("NET_API_KEY");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key)) { Console.WriteLine("NET_API_KEY unset: live test skipped"); return 0; }
        var h = new HttpClient();
        bool all = true;
        foreach (var kind in new[] { "purr", "mirror", "fish" })
        {
            var room = kind + "-" + DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks;
            Func<string, string, IDriver> make = (pid, tag) =>
            {
                Func<Task<string>> g = () => Grant(h, key, kind + "-" + pid);
                return kind == "purr" ? new PurrDriver(room, g, tag) : kind == "mirror" ? new MirrorDriver(room, g, tag) : (IDriver)new FishDriver(room, g, tag);
            };
            all &= await Scenario(make);
        }
        return all ? 0 : 1;
    }
}
```

```cs
// Minimal mirror of FishNet.Transporting (Assets/FishNet/Runtime/Transporting, MIT) for compile checks only.
using System;
namespace FishNet.Managing { public class NetworkManager : UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour { } }
namespace FishNet.Transporting
{
    public enum Channel : byte { Reliable = 0, Unreliable = 1 }
    public enum LocalConnectionState : int { Stopped = 1, Stopping = 2, Starting = 4, Started = 8 }
    public enum RemoteConnectionState : byte { Stopped = 0, Started = 2 }
    public enum IPAddressType { IPv4, IPv6 }
    public struct ServerReceivedDataArgs { public ArraySegment<byte> Data; public Channel Channel; public int ConnectionId; public int TransportIndex; public ServerReceivedDataArgs(ArraySegment<byte> d, Channel c, int id, int t) { Data = d; Channel = c; ConnectionId = id; TransportIndex = t; } }
    public struct ClientReceivedDataArgs { public ArraySegment<byte> Data; public Channel Channel; public int TransportIndex; public ClientReceivedDataArgs(ArraySegment<byte> d, Channel c, int t) { Data = d; Channel = c; TransportIndex = t; } }
    public struct RemoteConnectionStateArgs { public int TransportIndex; public RemoteConnectionState ConnectionState; public int ConnectionId; public RemoteConnectionStateArgs(RemoteConnectionState s, int id, int t) { ConnectionState = s; ConnectionId = id; TransportIndex = t; } }
    public struct ServerConnectionStateArgs { public int TransportIndex; public LocalConnectionState ConnectionState; public ServerConnectionStateArgs(LocalConnectionState s, int t) { ConnectionState = s; TransportIndex = t; } }
    public struct ClientConnectionStateArgs { public LocalConnectionState ConnectionState; public int TransportIndex; public ClientConnectionStateArgs(LocalConnectionState s, int t) { ConnectionState = s; TransportIndex = t; } }
    public abstract class Transport : UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour
    {
        public int Index { get; private set; }
        public virtual void Initialize(FishNet.Managing.NetworkManager nm, int transportIndex) { Index = transportIndex; }
        public abstract string GetConnectionAddress(int connectionId);
        public abstract event Action<ClientConnectionStateArgs> OnClientConnectionState;
        public abstract event Action<ServerConnectionStateArgs> OnServerConnectionState;
        public abstract event Action<RemoteConnectionStateArgs> OnRemoteConnectionState;
        public abstract void HandleClientConnectionState(ClientConnectionStateArgs a);
        public abstract void HandleServerConnectionState(ServerConnectionStateArgs a);
        public abstract void HandleRemoteConnectionState(RemoteConnectionStateArgs a);
        public abstract LocalConnectionState GetConnectionState(bool server);
        public abstract RemoteConnectionState GetConnectionState(int connectionId);
        public abstract void SendToServer(byte channelId, ArraySegment<byte> segment);
        public abstract void SendToClient(byte channelId, ArraySegment<byte> segment, int connectionId);
        public abstract event Action<ClientReceivedDataArgs> OnClientReceivedData;
        public abstract void HandleClientReceivedDataArgs(ClientReceivedDataArgs a);
        public abstract event Action<ServerReceivedDataArgs> OnServerReceivedData;
        public abstract void HandleServerReceivedDataArgs(ServerReceivedDataArgs a);
        public abstract void IterateIncoming(bool asServer);
        public abstract void IterateOutgoing(bool asServer);
        public virtual int GetMaximumClients() => 0;
        public virtual void SetMaximumClients(int value) { }
        public virtual void SetClientAddress(string address) { }
        public virtual string GetClientAddress() => string.Empty;
        public abstract bool StartConnection(bool server);
        public abstract bool StopConnection(bool server);
        public abstract bool StopConnection(int connectionId, bool immediately);
        public abstract void Shutdown();
        public abstract int GetMTU(byte channel);
    }
}
```

```cs
// Minimal mirror of Mirror's Transport base (Assets/Mirror/Core/Transport.cs, MIT) for compile checks only.
using System;
namespace Mirror
{
    public static class Channels { public const int Reliable = 0; public const int Unreliable = 1; }
    public enum TransportError : byte { DnsResolve, Refused, Timeout, Congestion, InvalidReceive, InvalidSend, ConnectionClosed, Unexpected }
    public abstract class Transport : UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour
    {
        public abstract bool Available();
        public Action OnClientConnected;
        public Action<ArraySegment<byte>, int> OnClientDataReceived;
        public Action<ArraySegment<byte>, int> OnClientDataSent;
        public Action<TransportError, string> OnClientError;
        public Action OnClientDisconnected;
        public Action<int> OnServerConnected;
        public Action<int, string> OnServerConnectedWithAddress;
        public Action<int, ArraySegment<byte>, int> OnServerDataReceived;
        public Action<int, ArraySegment<byte>, int> OnServerDataSent;
        public Action<int, TransportError, string> OnServerError;
        public Action<int> OnServerDisconnected;
        public abstract bool ClientConnected();
        public abstract void ClientConnect(string address);
        public abstract void ClientSend(ArraySegment<byte> segment, int channelId = Channels.Reliable);
        public abstract void ClientDisconnect();
        public abstract Uri ServerUri();
        public abstract bool ServerActive();
        public abstract void ServerStart();
        public abstract void ServerSend(int connectionId, ArraySegment<byte> segment, int channelId = Channels.Reliable);
        public abstract void ServerDisconnect(int connectionId);
        public abstract string ServerGetClientAddress(int connectionId);
        public abstract void ServerStop();
        public abstract int GetMaxPacketSize(int channelId = Channels.Reliable);
        public virtual int GetBatchThreshold(int channelId = Channels.Reliable) => GetMaxPacketSize(channelId);
        public virtual void ClientEarlyUpdate() { }
        public virtual void ServerEarlyUpdate() { }
        public virtual void ClientLateUpdate() { }
        public virtual void ServerLateUpdate() { }
        public abstract void Shutdown();
    }
}
```

```cs
// Minimal mirror of PurrNet.Transports (Assets/PurrNet/Runtime/Transports/Interface, MIT) for compile checks only.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
namespace PurrNet.Transports
{
    public delegate void OnConnectionState(ConnectionState state, bool asServer);
    public delegate void OnDataReceived(Connection conn, ByteData data, bool asServer);
    public delegate void OnDataSent(Connection conn, ByteData data, bool asServer);
    public delegate void OnConnected(Connection conn, bool asServer);
    public delegate void OnDisconnected(Connection conn, DisconnectReason reason, bool asServer);
    public enum ConnectionState { Connecting, Connected, Disconnected, Disconnecting }
    public enum DisconnectReason { Timeout, ClientRequest, ServerRequest, ConnectionFailed }
    public enum Channel : byte { ReliableUnordered, UnreliableSequenced, ReliableOrdered, Unreliable }
    public readonly struct ByteData
    {
        public readonly byte[] data; public readonly int length; public readonly int offset;
        public ArraySegment<byte> segment => new ArraySegment<byte>(data, offset, length);
        public ByteData(byte[] data, int offset, int length) { this.data = data; this.offset = offset; this.length = length; }
    }
    public struct Connection : IEquatable<Connection>
    {
        public int connectionId { get; private set; }
        public bool isValid { get; private set; }
        public Connection(int connectionId) { this.connectionId = connectionId; isValid = true; }
        public bool Equals(Connection o) => connectionId == o.connectionId && isValid == o.isValid;
        public override bool Equals(object o) => o is Connection c && Equals(c);
        public override int GetHashCode() => connectionId;
    }
    public interface IConnectable { ConnectionState clientState { get; } void Connect(string ip, ushort port); void Disconnect(); }
    public interface IListener { ConnectionState listenerState { get; } void Listen(ushort port); void StopListening(); }
    public interface ITransport : IListener, IConnectable
    {
        event OnConnected onConnected; event OnDisconnected onDisconnected; event OnDataReceived onDataReceived; event OnDataSent onDataSent; event OnConnectionState onConnectionState;
        IReadOnlyList<Connection> connections { get; }
        int GetMTU(Connection target, Channel channel, bool asServer);
        void RaiseDataReceived(Connection conn, ByteData data, bool asServer);
        void RaiseDataSent(Connection conn, ByteData data, bool asServer);
        void SendToClient(Connection target, ByteData data, Channel method = Channel.ReliableOrdered);
        void SendToServer(ByteData data, Channel method = Channel.ReliableOrdered);
        void CloseConnection(Connection conn);
        void ReceiveMessages(float delta);
        void SendMessages(float delta);
    }
    public abstract class GenericTransport : UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour
    {
        public abstract bool isSupported { get; }
        public abstract ITransport transport { get; }
        protected abstract void StartClientInternal();
        protected abstract void StartServerInternal();
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Editor/CodeGen/AurixILPostProcessor.cs`:

```cs
// Unity ILPostProcessor glue: runs RpcWeaver on every player/editor assembly that references
// Aurix.Net, right after the C# compiler, so [ServerRpc]/[ObserversRpc]/[TargetRpc] methods become
// direct call sites. Mirrors the structure of Netcode for GameObjects' codegen assembly: editor-only,
// no engine references, Mono.Cecil from Unity's own precompiled copy. NOT yet verified in a Unity
// editor (no licence on the build machines); the weaver core is verified on plain .NET builds.
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using Mono.Cecil;
using Mono.Cecil.Cil;
using Unity.CompilationPipeline.Common.Diagnostics;
using Unity.CompilationPipeline.Common.ILPostProcessing;

namespace Aurix.Net.CodeGen
{
    internal sealed class AurixILPostProcessor : ILPostProcessor
    {
        const string Runtime = "Aurix.Net";

        public override ILPostProcessor GetInstance() => this;

        public override bool WillProcess(ICompiledAssembly a) =>
            a.Name == Runtime || a.References.Any(r => Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(r) == Runtime);

        public override ILPostProcessResult Process(ICompiledAssembly a)
        {
            if (!WillProcess(a)) return null;
            var diagnostics = new System.Collections.Generic.List<DiagnosticMessage>();
            var resolver = new DefaultAssemblyResolver();
            foreach (var dir in a.References.Select(Path.GetDirectoryName).Distinct()) resolver.AddSearchDirectory(dir);
            var rp = new ReaderParameters
            {
                AssemblyResolver = resolver, ReadingMode = ReadingMode.Immediate, ReadWrite = false, InMemory = true,
                SymbolStream = new MemoryStream(a.InMemoryAssembly.PdbData), SymbolReaderProvider = new PortablePdbReaderProvider(), ReadSymbols = true
            };
            using var asm = AssemblyDefinition.ReadAssembly(new MemoryStream(a.InMemoryAssembly.PeData), rp);
            var res = Weaver.RpcWeaver.Process(asm.MainModule);
            foreach (var d in res.Diagnostics) diagnostics.Add(new DiagnosticMessage { DiagnosticType = DiagnosticType.Warning, MessageData = "Aurix.Net weaver: " + d });
            if (!res.Changed) return new ILPostProcessResult(a.InMemoryAssembly, diagnostics);
            var pe = new MemoryStream(); var pdb = new MemoryStream();
            asm.Write(pe, new WriterParameters { SymbolWriterProvider = new PortablePdbWriterProvider(), SymbolStream = pdb, WriteSymbols = true });
            return new ILPostProcessResult(new InMemoryAssembly(pe.ToArray(), pdb.ToArray()), diagnostics);
        }
    }
}

```

`sdk/unity/Editor/CodeGen/RpcWeaver.cs`:

```cs
// IL weaver for the gameplay framework: turns a method marked [ServerRpc] / [ObserversRpc] /
// [TargetRpc] into a direct call site. For `void CmdHit(int dmg, RpcInfo info = default)` it emits
//
//   void CmdHit(int dmg, RpcInfo info) { if (__RpcSend(IDX, new object[] { dmg })) return; CmdHit__Impl(dmg, __LocalInfo()); }
//   void CmdHit__Impl(int dmg, RpcInfo info) { /* original body */ }
//
// IDX is the index the runtime assigns in NetworkBehaviour.Reflect (declaring type full name, method
// name, parameter count) — both sides must agree, so the ordering here mirrors it exactly. Runs inside
// Unity through the ILPostProcessor in Editor/CodeGen, or from the CLI for plain .NET builds.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Mono.Cecil;
using Mono.Cecil.Cil;
using Mono.Cecil.Rocks;

namespace Aurix.Net.Weaver
{
    public static class RpcWeaver
    {
        public const string BehaviourType = "Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework.NetworkBehaviour";
        public const string RpcAttributeType = "Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework.RpcAttribute";
        public const string RpcInfoType = "Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework.RpcInfo";
        public const string ImplSuffix = "__Impl";
        public const string MarkerType = "AurixNetWoven";
        public const string ManagerType = "Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework.NetworkManager";

        public sealed class Result { public int Methods; public List<string> Diagnostics = new List<string>(); public bool Changed => Methods > 0; internal readonly Dictionary<MethodDefinition, MethodDefinition> Redirect = new Dictionary<MethodDefinition, MethodDefinition>(); }

        /// <summary>Weaves every NetworkBehaviour subclass in the module. Idempotent (marker attribute).</summary>
        public static Result Process(ModuleDefinition module)
        {
            var res = new Result();
            if (module.Types.Any(t => t.Name == MarkerType)) { res.Diagnostics.Add("already woven"); return res; }
            var behaviours = module.GetTypes().Where(t => t.IsClass && !t.IsAbstract || t.IsClass).Where(t => DerivesFrom(t, BehaviourType)).ToList();
            var statics = module.GetTypes().SelectMany(t => t.Methods).Where(m => m.IsStatic && !m.IsConstructor && HasRpcAttribute(m) && !m.Name.EndsWith(ImplSuffix)).ToList();
            foreach (var m in statics)
            {
                if (m.Body == null) { res.Diagnostics.Add($"{m.DeclaringType.FullName}.{m.Name}: no body"); continue; }
                if (m.ReturnType.MetadataType != MetadataType.Void) { res.Diagnostics.Add($"{m.DeclaringType.FullName}.{m.Name}: RPC methods must return void"); continue; }
                bool info = m.Parameters.Count > 0 && m.Parameters[m.Parameters.Count - 1].ParameterType.FullName == RpcInfoType;
                int argc = info ? m.Parameters.Count - 1 : m.Parameters.Count;
                WeaveStatic(m, StaticHash(m.DeclaringType.FullName, m.Name, argc), info, res);
                res.Methods++;
            }
            if (behaviours.Count == 0 && res.Methods == 0) return res;
            foreach (var t in behaviours)
            {
                foreach (var entry in RpcIndex(t))
                {
                    if (entry.method.Module != module) continue; // inherited from another assembly: woven there
                    if (entry.method.Body == null) { res.Diagnostics.Add($"{t.FullName}.{entry.method.Name}: no body"); continue; }
                    if (entry.method.ReturnType.MetadataType != MetadataType.Void) { res.Diagnostics.Add($"{t.FullName}.{entry.method.Name}: RPC methods must return void"); continue; }
                    if (entry.method.DeclaringType != t) continue; // base-class method: woven when its own type is processed
                    Weave(entry.method, entry.index, entry.wantsInfo, res);
                    res.Methods++;
                }
            }
            if (res.Methods > 0)
            {
                // call sites inside this module still point at the renamed original (same MethodDefinition
                // object); route them to the new public method so direct calls go through the prologue
                foreach (var t in module.GetTypes())
                    foreach (var m in t.Methods)
                    {
                        if (!m.HasBody || res.Redirect.ContainsValue(m)) continue;
                        foreach (var ins in m.Body.Instructions)
                            if (ins.Operand is MethodDefinition md && res.Redirect.TryGetValue(md, out var fresh)) ins.Operand = fresh;
                    }
                var marker = new TypeDefinition("", MarkerType, TypeAttributes.NotPublic | TypeAttributes.Sealed | TypeAttributes.Abstract | TypeAttributes.Class, module.ImportReference(typeof(object)));
                module.Types.Add(marker);
            }
            return res;
        }

        public struct Entry { public MethodDefinition method; public int index; public bool wantsInfo; }

        /// <summary>Same ordering as NetworkBehaviour.Reflect: walk the hierarchy up to NetworkBehaviour, collect
        /// attributed methods, order by (declaring type full name, name, parameter count without RpcInfo).</summary>
        public static List<Entry> RpcIndex(TypeDefinition t)
        {
            var all = new List<Entry>();
            for (var cur = t; cur != null && cur.FullName != BehaviourType; cur = Resolve(cur.BaseType))
            {
                foreach (var m in cur.Methods)
                {
                    if (m.IsStatic || m.IsConstructor || !HasRpcAttribute(m)) continue;
                    bool info = m.Parameters.Count > 0 && m.Parameters[m.Parameters.Count - 1].ParameterType.FullName == RpcInfoType;
                    all.Add(new Entry { method = m, wantsInfo = info, index = info ? m.Parameters.Count - 1 : m.Parameters.Count });
                }
            }
            var ordered = all.OrderBy(e => e.method.DeclaringType.FullName, StringComparer.Ordinal).ThenBy(e => e.method.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal).ThenBy(e => e.index).ToList();
            for (int i = 0; i < ordered.Count; i++) { var e = ordered[i]; e.index = i; ordered[i] = e; }
            return ordered;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generic RPC methods keep their body; a prologue is inserted instead:
        /// <c>if (__RpcSendGeneric(index, new[] { typeof(T)... }, args)) return; info = __LocalInfo();</c>.
        /// On receive the runtime invokes the closed method with a re-entrancy guard so the prologue falls through.
        /// </summary>
        static void WeaveGenericInPlace(MethodDefinition m, int index, bool wantsInfo)
        {
            var type = m.DeclaringType; var module = m.Module;
            var body = m.Body; var il = body.GetILProcessor(); var first = body.Instructions[0];
            var send = module.ImportReference(FindMethod(type, "__RpcSendGeneric"));
            var localInfo = module.ImportReference(FindMethod(type, "__LocalInfoOr"));
            var getType = module.ImportReference(typeof(Type).GetMethod("GetTypeFromHandle"));
            var objType = module.TypeSystem.Object; var typeType = module.ImportReference(typeof(Type));
            int n = wantsInfo ? m.Parameters.Count - 1 : m.Parameters.Count;
            var ins = new List<Instruction>();
            ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Ldarg_0));
            ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, index));
            ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, m.GenericParameters.Count));
            ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Newarr, typeType));
            for (int i = 0; i < m.GenericParameters.Count; i++)
            {
                ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Dup)); ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, i));
                ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Ldtoken, m.GenericParameters[i])); ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Call, getType));
                ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Stelem_Ref));
            }
            ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, n));
            ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Newarr, objType));
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Dup)); ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, i)); ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Ldarg, m.Parameters[i]));
                var pt = m.Parameters[i].ParameterType;
                if (pt.IsValueType || pt.IsGenericParameter) ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Box, pt));
                ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Stelem_Ref));
            }
            ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Callvirt, send));
            var br = il.Create(OpCodes.Brfalse, first); ins.Add(br);
            ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Ret));
            if (wantsInfo)
            {
                // fall-through path: info = __LocalInfo(); then the original body
                var infoParam = m.Parameters[m.Parameters.Count - 1];
                var ld = il.Create(OpCodes.Ldarg_0); ins.Add(ld); ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Ldarg, infoParam)); ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Call, localInfo)); ins.Add(il.Create(OpCodes.Starg, infoParam));
                br.Operand = ld;
            }
            foreach (var x in ins) il.InsertBefore(first, x);
            body.InitLocals = true;
            body.OptimizeMacros();
        }

        static void Weave(MethodDefinition m, int index, bool wantsInfo, Result res)
        {
            var type = m.DeclaringType; var module = m.Module;
            if (m.HasGenericParameters) { WeaveGenericInPlace(m, index, wantsInfo); return; }
            if (type.Methods.Any(x => x.Name == m.Name + ImplSuffix && x.Parameters.Count == m.Parameters.Count)) return;

            // 1. the original method becomes Method__Impl (private, attributes moved off it); a fresh method
            //    with the original name, signature and attributes takes its place
            var impl = m;
            var fresh = new MethodDefinition(m.Name, m.Attributes, m.ReturnType);
            foreach (var p in m.Parameters) fresh.Parameters.Add(new ParameterDefinition(p.Name, p.Attributes, p.ParameterType) { Constant = p.HasConstant ? p.Constant : null });
            foreach (var a in m.CustomAttributes) fresh.CustomAttributes.Add(a);
            m.CustomAttributes.Clear();
            foreach (var o in m.Overrides) fresh.Overrides.Add(o);
            m.Overrides.Clear();
            m.Name = m.Name + ImplSuffix;
            m.Attributes = (m.Attributes & ~MethodAttributes.MemberAccessMask & ~MethodAttributes.Virtual & ~MethodAttributes.NewSlot & ~MethodAttributes.Abstract & ~MethodAttributes.Final) | MethodAttributes.Private | MethodAttributes.HideBySig;
            type.Methods.Add(fresh);
            res.Redirect[impl] = fresh;
            m = fresh;

            // 2. new body for Method: if (__RpcSend(index, args)) return; Method__Impl(args..., __LocalInfo());
            var body = m.Body = new MethodBody(m);
            var il = body.GetILProcessor();
            var send = module.ImportReference(FindMethod(type, "__RpcSend"));
            var localInfo = module.ImportReference(FindMethod(type, "__LocalInfo"));
            var objType = module.TypeSystem.Object;
            int n = wantsInfo ? m.Parameters.Count - 1 : m.Parameters.Count;

            il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, index);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, n);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Newarr, objType);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                il.Emit(OpCodes.Dup);
                il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, i);
                il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg, m.Parameters[i]);
                var pt = m.Parameters[i].ParameterType;
                if (pt.IsValueType || pt.IsGenericParameter) il.Emit(OpCodes.Box, pt);
                il.Emit(OpCodes.Stelem_Ref);
            }
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Callvirt, send);
            var runBody = il.Create(OpCodes.Nop);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Brfalse, runBody);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
            il.Append(runBody);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg, m.Parameters[i]);
            if (wantsInfo) { il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0); il.Emit(OpCodes.Call, localInfo); }
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Call, impl);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
            body.InitLocals = true;
            body.OptimizeMacros();
        }

        /// <summary>Same as StaticRpcs.Hash: FNV-1a over "Type.FullName::Method/argCount".</summary>
        public static uint StaticHash(string typeFullName, string method, int argCount)
        {
            uint h = 2166136261;
            foreach (char c in typeFullName + "::" + method + "/" + argCount) { h ^= c; h *= 16777619; }
            return h;
        }

        static void WeaveStatic(MethodDefinition m, uint hash, bool wantsInfo, Result res)
        {
            var type = m.DeclaringType; var module = m.Module;
            if (type.Methods.Any(x => x.Name == m.Name + ImplSuffix && x.Parameters.Count == m.Parameters.Count)) return;
            var manager = FindManager(module);
            if (manager == null) { res.Diagnostics.Add($"{type.FullName}.{m.Name}: NetworkManager type not found"); return; }

            var impl = m;
            var fresh = new MethodDefinition(m.Name, m.Attributes, m.ReturnType);
            foreach (var p in m.Parameters) fresh.Parameters.Add(new ParameterDefinition(p.Name, p.Attributes, p.ParameterType) { Constant = p.HasConstant ? p.Constant : null });
            foreach (var a in m.CustomAttributes) fresh.CustomAttributes.Add(a);
            m.CustomAttributes.Clear();
            m.Name = m.Name + ImplSuffix;
            m.Attributes = (m.Attributes & ~MethodAttributes.MemberAccessMask) | MethodAttributes.Private;
            type.Methods.Add(fresh);
            res.Redirect[impl] = fresh;
            m = fresh;

            var body = m.Body = new MethodBody(m);
            var il = body.GetILProcessor();
            var send = module.ImportReference(manager.Methods.First(x => x.Name == "__StaticRpcSend"));
            var localInfo = module.ImportReference(manager.Methods.First(x => x.Name == "__StaticLocalInfo"));
            var objType = module.TypeSystem.Object;
            int n = wantsInfo ? m.Parameters.Count - 1 : m.Parameters.Count;

            il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, unchecked((int)hash));
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, n);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Newarr, objType);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                il.Emit(OpCodes.Dup);
                il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, i);
                il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg, m.Parameters[i]);
                var pt = m.Parameters[i].ParameterType;
                if (pt.IsValueType || pt.IsGenericParameter) il.Emit(OpCodes.Box, pt);
                il.Emit(OpCodes.Stelem_Ref);
            }
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Call, send);
            var runBody = il.Create(OpCodes.Nop);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Brfalse, runBody);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
            il.Append(runBody);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg, m.Parameters[i]);
            if (wantsInfo) il.Emit(OpCodes.Call, localInfo);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Call, impl);
            il.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
            body.InitLocals = true;
            body.OptimizeMacros();
        }

        static TypeDefinition FindManager(ModuleDefinition module)
        {
            var own = module.GetType(ManagerType); if (own != null) return own;
            foreach (var ar in module.AssemblyReferences)
            {
                try { var t = module.AssemblyResolver.Resolve(ar).MainModule.GetType(ManagerType); if (t != null) return t; } catch { }
            }
            return null;
        }

        static MethodReference FindMethod(TypeDefinition t, string name)
        {
            for (var cur = t; cur != null; cur = Resolve(cur.BaseType))
            {
                var m = cur.Methods.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Name == name);
                if (m != null) return m;
            }
            throw new InvalidOperationException("NetworkBehaviour." + name + " not found — framework version mismatch");
        }

        static bool HasRpcAttribute(MethodDefinition m)
        {
            foreach (var a in m.CustomAttributes)
            {
                var at = Resolve(a.AttributeType);
                for (var cur = at; cur != null; cur = Resolve(cur.BaseType)) if (cur.FullName == RpcAttributeType) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        static bool DerivesFrom(TypeDefinition t, string baseName)
        {
            for (var cur = Resolve(t.BaseType); cur != null; cur = Resolve(cur.BaseType)) if (cur.FullName == baseName) return true;
            return false;
        }

        static TypeDefinition Resolve(TypeReference r)
        {
            if (r == null) return null;
            try { return r.Resolve(); } catch { return null; }
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Editor/Framework/NetworkIdentityEditor.cs`:

```cs
// Inspector for NetworkIdentity: scene objects get a stable sceneId (hash of scene + hierarchy path),
// play mode shows object id, owner and observers. Not yet exercised in a Unity Editor.
using System.Linq;
using Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Editor
{
    [CustomEditor(typeof(NetworkIdentity), true)]
    public class NetworkIdentityEditor : UnityEditor.Editor
    {
        public override void OnInspectorGUI()
        {
            var id = (NetworkIdentity)target;
            if (!Application.isPlaying && SceneIds.IsSceneObject(id))
            {
                uint want = SceneIds.Compute(id);
                if (id.sceneId != want)
                {
                    Undo.RecordObject(id, "Assign scene id"); id.sceneId = want; EditorUtility.SetDirty(id);
                    if (!Application.isPlaying) EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(id.gameObject.scene);
                }
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Scene id", id.sceneId.ToString());
            }
            DrawDefaultInspector();
            if (!Application.isPlaying) return;
            EditorGUILayout.Space();
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Runtime", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Object id", id.isSpawned ? id.objectId.ToString() : "not spawned");
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Owner", id.owner?.ToString() ?? "server");
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Is owner / server / client", $"{id.isOwner} / {id.isServer} / {id.isClient}");
            if (id.isServer) EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Observers", string.Join(", ", id.observers.Select(p => p.ToString())));
            Repaint();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Stable per-scene ids for objects that live in the scene (not prefabs): FNV-1a of "scenePath|hierarchyPath", never 0.</summary>
    public static class SceneIds
    {
        public static bool IsSceneObject(NetworkIdentity id) =>
            id != null && id.gameObject.scene.IsValid() && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(id.gameObject.scene.path) && !PrefabUtility.IsPartOfPrefabAsset(id.gameObject);

        public static uint Compute(NetworkIdentity id)
        {
            var path = id.gameObject.scene.path + "|" + HierarchyPath(id.transform);
            uint h = 2166136261;
            foreach (char c in path) { h ^= c; h *= 16777619; }
            return h == 0 ? 1u : h;
        }

        static string HierarchyPath(Transform t)
        {
            var s = t.name;
            while (t.parent != null) { t = t.parent; s = t.name + "/" + s; }
            return s;
        }

        [MenuItem("Aurix Net/Assign scene ids in open scenes")]
        public static void AssignAll()
        {
            int n = 0;
            foreach (var id in Object.FindObjectsByType<NetworkIdentity>(FindObjectsInactive.Include, FindObjectsSortMode.None))
                if (IsSceneObject(id)) { uint want = Compute(id); if (id.sceneId != want) { Undo.RecordObject(id, "Assign scene id"); id.sceneId = want; EditorUtility.SetDirty(id); n++; } }
            Debug.Log($"[AurixNet] scene ids assigned: {n}");
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
// Inspector for NetworkManager: settings when editing, live role/players/objects and Start/Stop buttons in play mode.
// Not yet exercised in a Unity Editor (no licence on the build machine); kept to plain IMGUI APIs.
using System.Linq;
using Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Editor
{
    [CustomEditor(typeof(NetworkManager))]
    public class NetworkManagerEditor : UnityEditor.Editor
    {
        bool _objects = true;

        public override void OnInspectorGUI()
        {
            DrawDefaultInspector();
            var m = (NetworkManager)target;
            if (!Application.isPlaying) { EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Enter play mode to start a host, server or client from here.", MessageType.None); return; }

            EditorGUILayout.Space();
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Runtime", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            string role = m.isHost ? "Host" : m.isServer ? "Server" : m.isClient ? "Client" : "Offline";
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Role", role);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Local player", m.localPlayer?.ToString() ?? "-");
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Server player", m.serverPlayer?.ToString() ?? "-");
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Tick / server tick", $"{m.tick} / {m.serverTick}");
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Players", string.Join(", ", m.players.Select(p => p.ToString())));

            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(m.isServer || m.isClient))
                {
                    if (GUILayout.Button("Start Host")) m.StartHost();
                    if (GUILayout.Button("Start Server")) m.StartServer();
                    if (GUILayout.Button("Start Client")) m.StartClient();
                }
                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!(m.isServer || m.isClient)))
                    if (GUILayout.Button("Stop")) m.Stop();
            }

            var ids = m.identities.ToList();
            _objects = EditorGUILayout.Foldout(_objects, $"Objects ({ids.Count})", true);
            if (_objects)
                foreach (var id in ids.OrderBy(i => i.objectId))
                {
                    using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
                    {
                        EditorGUILayout.ObjectField(id, typeof(NetworkIdentity), true, GUILayout.MinWidth(120));
                        EditorGUILayout.LabelField($"#{id.objectId}  owner {(id.owner?.ToString() ?? "server")}  observers {id.observers.Count}", GUILayout.MinWidth(200));
                    }
                }
            Repaint();
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
// Aurix Net Unity SDK — editor window showing live NetworkStatistics of the running NetworkManager.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Editor
{
    public sealed class NetworkStatisticsWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        [MenuItem("Window/Aurix Net/Network Statistics")]

        void OnGUI()
        {

            if (m == null || (!m.isServer && !m.isClient)) { EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("No running NetworkManager (enter play mode and start host/server/client).", MessageType.Info); return; }

            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Upload", $"{s.upload / 1024f:0.0} KB/s, {s.messagesOutPerSecond} msg/s");
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Download", $"{s.download / 1024f:0.0} KB/s, {s.messagesInPerSecond} msg/s");
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Total", $"{s.totalBytesOut / 1024f:0.0} KB out, {s.totalBytesIn / 1024f:0.0} KB in");
            if (m.isServer && s.playerPings.Count > 0)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.Space(); EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Player pings", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                foreach (var kv in s.playerPings) EditorGUILayout.LabelField(kv.Key.ToString(), kv.Value + " ms");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
// Window > Aurix Net: finds or creates the NetSettings asset and edits it in place.
using System.Net.Http;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Editor
{
    public sealed class NetSettingsWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        NetSettings _settings; UnityEditor.Editor _editor; string _status = "";

        [MenuItem("Window/Aurix Net")]
        public static void Open() => GetWindow<NetSettingsWindow>("Aurix Net");

        void OnEnable() { _settings = Find(); if (_settings != null) _editor = UnityEditor.Editor.CreateEditor(_settings); }

        static NetSettings Find()
        {
            foreach (var g in AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:NetSettings")) return AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<NetSettings>(AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(g));
            return null;
        }

        void OnGUI()
        {
            if (_settings == null)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("No NetSettings asset yet.", MessageType.Info);
                if (GUILayout.Button("Create Assets/AurixNetSettings.asset"))
                {
                    _settings = CreateInstance<NetSettings>();
                    AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(_settings, "Assets/AurixNetSettings.asset"); AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
                    _editor = UnityEditor.Editor.CreateEditor(_settings);
                }
                return;
            }
            _editor.OnInspectorGUI();
            GUILayout.Space(8);
            if (GUILayout.Button("Test connection")) _ = Test();
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_status)) EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(_status, MessageType.None);
            GUILayout.Space(8);
            EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Scene: add a NetRunner, assign this asset, set AutoJoinRoom. Prefab: NetView + NetTransform (+ your SyncBehaviours), add it to Prefabs. Production grants come from your backend (POST /v1/grants); DevApiKey is for the editor only.", MessageType.Info);
        }

        async System.Threading.Tasks.Task Test()
        {
            try
            {
                using (var c = new HttpClient()) { var r = await c.GetAsync(_settings.ServerUrl.TrimEnd('/') + "/healthz"); _status = r.IsSuccessStatusCode ? "Node reachable: " + _settings.ServerUrl : "HTTP " + (int)r.StatusCode; }
            }
            catch (System.Exception e) { _status = "Unreachable: " + e.Message; }
            Repaint();
        }
    }
}
```
