`sdk/unity/README.md`:

```md
# Aurix Net for Unity

Pure C#, no native library, every Unity platform including WebGL. Install as a UPM package
(`Packages/manifest.json` → `"com.aurix.net": "file:../../sdk/unity"` or a git URL).

## Quick start (sync mode, ~10 minutes)

1. **Window > Aurix Net** → *Create settings*. Fill `ServerUrl` and, for the editor only,
   `DevApiKey` (production builds get grants from your backend via `POST /v1/grants`).
2. Add a **NetRunner** to the scene, assign the settings, set `AutoJoinRoom` (e.g. `arena-1`).
3. Make a player prefab: **NetView** + **NetTransform** (+ mesh). Drop it into `Settings.Prefabs`.
4. Press Play in two editors / builds: each client gets its own avatar, moves it, the other sees
   it interpolated.

Replicate your own state with `[Sync]` fields on a `SyncBehaviour`; they map onto a component
of the schema in the settings (component name = `[SyncComponent("Name")]` or the class name):

```text
component Transform { pos: vec3 @range(-1024, 1024, 0.01)  rot: quat }   // used by NetTransform
component Player    { name: string(16)  hp: u8 }
```

```csharp
[SyncComponent("Player")]
public class PlayerController : SyncBehaviour
{
    [Sync("name")] public string PlayerName;
    [Sync] public byte hp = 100;                        // field name = schema field name

    void Update()
    {
        if (!IsMine) return;                            // only the owner moves its avatar
        transform.position += Speed * Time.deltaTime * new Vector3(Input.GetAxis("Horizontal"), 0, Input.GetAxis("Vertical"));
        if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space)) View.Rpc(nameof(Wave), transform.position);
    }

    [Rpc] void Wave(Vector3 at) => Debug.Log($"{PlayerName} waves at {at}");
    protected override void OnSynced(uint tick) { /* remote copy updated from a server delta */ }
}
```

The owner's `[Sync]` values go to the server as its input every tick; the server (owner-authoritative
by default, or your WASM logic with `props.logic`) replicates deltas to everyone in range (AOI),
`NetTransform` interpolates `InterpolationTicks` behind the server. `[Rpc]` methods travel as
reliable relay events (`bool, int, long, float, string, byte[], Vector3, Quaternion` args).

Prediction (server-authoritative movement with `props.logic`): keep the local player responsive without
waiting a round trip. Send raw inputs with `Runner.SendInput(bytes)` (returns the tick), apply the same
step locally through `Predictor<TState>` (`Aurix.Net.Managed`), and reconcile when your own entity's
server state arrives:

```csharp
var pred = new Predictor<Vector3>(transform.position, (pos, input) => Move(pos, input), (a, b) => (a - b).sqrMagnitude > 0.0001f);
pred.OnCorrected += (was, now) => _visualError += was - now;   // decay _visualError over a few frames
Runner.OnOwnEntityUpdated += (view, entity, tick) => { if (view == View) pred.Reconcile(tick, ReadPos(entity)); };
void Tick(byte[] input) { uint t = Runner.SendInput(input); transform.position = pred.Record(t, input) + _visualError; }
```

`Move` must be the rule your WASM logic applies for one tick of that input (same fixed-point/float math); a
mismatch is corrected by replaying the unconfirmed inputs on the server state (`Mispredictions` counts them).
Owner-authoritative rooms (no `logic`) do not need prediction: the owner's `[Sync]` values are the truth.

Relay rooms (no simulation): `Runner.SendEvent(code, bytes, Target.All, reliable: true)` and
`Runner.OnEvent`. Event codes `0x10–0x13` and `0x20–0x24` are reserved for sync/lockstep frames.

Lockstep rooms (deterministic, every client simulates): `Runner.Lockstep` delivers confirmed inputs
per tick in order (`OnTick`), restores state on late join / rehost (`OnRestore`), uploads the master's
checkpoint when the node asks (`OnCheckpointRequested` → `SendCheckpoint`); you send `SendInput(bytes)`
every tick and `ReportHash(tick, hash)` so the node can flag desyncs. Keep the simulation integer or
fixed-point; see `Samples~/LockstepDuel/DuelSim.cs`.

Samples (`Samples~`): `SyncArena/PlayerController.cs`, `RelayChat/ChatSample.cs`, `LockstepDuel/DuelSim.cs`.

## Layers

| Layer | Namespace | What |
|---|---|---|
| Unity | `Aurix.Net.Unity` | `NetSettings`, `NetRunner`, `NetView`, `NetTransform`, `SyncBehaviour` + `[Sync]`/`[Rpc]`, editor window |
| Managed core | `Aurix.Net.Managed` | `ManagedClient` (WebSocket control + tunnel data, same packets/channels/fragmentation as QUIC), `Schema` (IDL parser), `SyncWorld` (delta decode, acks, owner inputs), bit codec |
| Native (optional) | `Aurix.Net.Client` | P/Invoke into `libaurix_net` for QUIC datagrams; needs the binary per platform, not WebGL |

Lower level, no scene objects:

```csharp
var c = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync("https://net.example.com", grant);
c.OnEvent += f => Debug.Log($"event {f.Code} from {f.From}");
await c.JoinOrCreateAsync("lobby-1", "relay", 8);
c.SendEvent(1, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("hi"), Target.Others, reliable: true);
void Update() { c.Poll(); }  void LateUpdate() { c.Flush(); }
```

## Gameplay framework (host-authoritative, PurrNet-style)

`Runtime/Framework/` is a complete netcode layer for games that want a Unity host (or a headless
Unity server) to own the simulation, with Aurix Net as the relay, lobby and hosting underneath —
the model PurrNet, Mirror and FishNet users know:

```csharp
using Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework;

public class Player : NetworkBehaviour
{
    public SyncVar<int> health = new SyncVar<int>(100);                        // server writes
    public SyncVar<Vector3> aim = new SyncVar<Vector3>(default, 0.05f, ownerAuth: true); // owner writes, 20/s
    public SyncList<int> inventory = new SyncList<int>(ownerAuth: true);
    public SyncDictionary<string, int> stats = new SyncDictionary<string, int>();

    [ServerRpc] void CmdHit(int dmg, RpcInfo info) { health.value -= dmg; }   // owner → server
    [ObserversRpc(bufferLast: true)] void RpcShout(string s) { ... }         // server → everyone (late joiners get the last one)
    [TargetRpc] void RpcWhisper(string s) { ... }                            // server → one player

    void Update() { if (isOwner && Input.GetMouseButtonDown(0)) CmdHit(10); }        // woven: a plain call
    protected override void OnSpawned(bool asServer) { health.onChanged += h => bar.value = h; }
}
```

`NetworkManager` (one per scene): `httpUrl`, `grant`/`GrantProvider`, `roomName`, `maxPlayers`,
`tickRate`, `networkPrefabs`; `StartHost()` (server + local player), `StartServer()` (headless),
`StartClient()`, `Stop()`; `Spawn(prefab, owner?)`, `Despawn(id)`, `SetOwnership(id, player?)`;
`players`, `localPlayer`, `identities`, `onPlayerJoined/Left`, `onSpawned/Despawned`. Put a
`NetworkIdentity` on each prefab root; its `behaviours` list (auto-filled from children) fixes the
replication order; objects placed in the scene get a non-zero `sceneId` and are bound, not instantiated. Drop-in components: `NetworkTransform`, `NetworkRigidbody`, `NetworkAnimator`, `PlayerSpawner` (`Runtime/Framework/Components/`). `PlayerID` is the Aurix actor id. Modules and RPC methods are bound by reflection
in declaration order, so host and clients must run the same build. RPC methods are rewritten after
compilation by the weaver in `Editor/CodeGen` (an `ILPostProcessor`, like Mirror/PurrNet/NGO): calling
`CmdHit(10)` sends the RPC and the body runs where it should; without the weaver (or from code you do
not own) use `Rpc(nameof(CmdHit), 10)` / `RpcTo(player, …)`. Interest management: add `INetworkVisibilityRule`s to `NetworkManager.visibilityRules` (e.g. `new DistanceRule(manager, 50f)`) or set `NetworkIdentity.visibilityRule`; clients only hold objects they can see. Client-side prediction: derive from `PredictedBehaviour<INPUT, STATE>`, implement `GetInput`, a deterministic `Simulate(input, ref state, dt)` and `SetUnityState`; the owner predicts and reconciles, the server verifies, observers interpolate. Static RPCs work too: put `[ServerRpc]`/`[ObserversRpc]`/`[TargetRpc]` on a static method of any class (no NetworkIdentity needed); they route through `NetworkManager.main`. Lag compensation: add `ColliderRollback` to hittable objects and wrap server-side hit checks in `networkManager.Rollback(info.sender, () => Physics.Raycast(...))`. `StartAuto()` is quick match: join a random open room (`matchFilterJson`, `matchExpr`) or host a new one with `roomPropsJson`. Host migration is on by default: if the host leaves, the new room master becomes the server with the world it can see and the others re-attach.

Check without Unity: `cd BuildCheck~/framework-check && NET_API_KEY=an_… dotnet run -c Release`.

More of the framework, all covered by `BuildCheck~/framework-check` against a live node: generic RPCs (`Show<T>(T v)`),
static RPCs on any class, `compression:`/`deltaPack:` RPC options, `StateMachine`/`StateNode<T>`, `NetworkLOD`
(distance send-rate tiers), `NetworkReflection` (sync members / call methods of any component by name), `NetworkBones`,
`NetworkAudioSource`, `NetworkTransform.adaptiveSync` + `syncParent`, `ValidatedSyncVar<T>` (server vetoes owner
writes), `SyncInput<T>`, `SyncBigData`/`SyncTexture`/`SyncFile`, `NetworkManager.statistics` (ping, jitter, throughput,
stall events; Window ▸ Aurix Net ▸ Network Statistics in the Editor) and `IAsyncNetworkObjectFactory` /
`AddressablesPrefabFactory` for prefabs that load on demand.

## PurrNet, Mirror and FishNet transports

Already on [PurrNet](https://github.com/PurrNet/PurrNet), [Mirror](https://github.com/MirrorNetworking/Mirror)
or [FishNet](https://github.com/FirstGearGames/FishNet)? Keep the framework (its `NetworkManager`,
SyncVars, RPCs, prediction) and move the wire to Aurix Net: `Runtime/Transports/RelayBridge.cs` runs
a host and its clients over one relay room, and a thin adapter per framework compiles when that
framework is in the project:

| Framework | Component | Compiles when |
|---|---|---|
| PurrNet | `AurixNetTransport` (`GenericTransport`/`ITransport`), `Runtime/PurrNet/` | package `dev.purrnet.purrnet` present → asmdef version define `AURIX_PURRNET` |
| Mirror | `AurixNetMirrorTransport` (`Transport`), `Runtime/Mirror/` | Mirror's own `MIRROR` define |
| FishNet | `AurixNetFishNetTransport` (`Transport`), `Runtime/FishNet/` | FishNet's own `FISHNET` define |

Add the component next to the framework's `NetworkManager`, point the manager's transport at it, and set:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `httpUrl` | node control-plane URL (`https://…`, or `http://127.0.0.1:8090` locally) |
| `grant` / `GrantProvider` | grant from your backend (`POST /v1/grants`); `GrantProvider` is an async callback that wins over the field |
| `roomName`, `maxPlayers` | relay room shared by host and clients (Mirror `ClientConnect(address)` / FishNet `SetClientAddress` override the room name when non-empty) |
| `eventCode` | relay event code reserved for transport frames (default 200; keep other events off it) |

Topology: the framework's server joins or creates the relay room and must be its master; clients
join the same room and talk only to the master. The framework's connection id equals the Aurix
actor id. Reliable channels ride the reliable relay channel (fragmented above the datagram size,
MTU 8192), unreliable ones the unreliable channel (MTU = datagram payload). Disconnecting a client
from the server kicks the actor; the kicked client sees the framework's server-side disconnect.
Not yet: host migration (on `master_changed` the host stops and clients disconnect; reconnect from
the framework's side), lobby/matchmaking from inside the framework (use the Aurix REST/WS API or
`join_random` through a small wrapper).

Check without Unity: `cd BuildCheck~/transports-check && NET_API_KEY=an_… dotnet run -c Release`
runs host + two clients through each adapter against a local node (compile-only without the key).

## Checks

`BuildCheck~/managed-tests` (`dotnet run`): offline checks of the managed core; the sim/nav checks load
`target/release/libnet_sim_wasm.so` (`cargo build --release -p net-sim-wasm`) and are skipped when it is absent.

`BuildCheck~/managed-live`: .NET console test of the managed core against a local node
(`NET_API_KEY=… dotnet run -c Release`): relay reliable/unreliable/fragmented events, sync deltas,
a custom-schema owner room (vec3/quat/string/u8 decode, acks with 0 gaps) and a lockstep room
(identical confirmed input streams on 3 clients, late join catch-up from the master's checkpoint). The Unity layer is
compiled there against `Stubs/UnityEngine.cs`; the real editor build is a separate step.

Lockstep tuning: `Runner.Lockstep.InputDelay` adapts between `InputDelayMin`/`InputDelayMax` from the node's
input-margin reports (late inputs raise it at once, steady slack lowers it slowly; `AdaptiveDelay = false`
to pin it), `InputRedundancy` (1–8) sets how many past inputs ride in each datagram. After a desync the
node asks for your state at the flagged tick: handle `OnDumpRequested(tick)` with `SendDump(tick, hash, state)`
from your rollback history; the dumps are downloadable via the REST API next to the master's.

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Client.cs`:

```cs
// Aurix Net client for Unity/.NET. Poll() once per frame from the main thread.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;

namespace Aurix.Net
{
    public enum Channel : byte { Unreliable = 0, Reliable = 1, ReliableUnordered = 2 }
    public enum Target { All = 0, Others = 1, Master = 2, Actors = 3 }
    public enum RoomMode { Relay, Sync, Lockstep }

    public sealed class NetException : Exception { public NetException(string m) : base(m) { } }

    /// <summary>A relay event frame decoded from the data path.</summary>
    public struct EventFrame
    {
        public byte Code;
        public ushort From;
        public ushort? Group;
        public ArraySegment<byte> Payload;

        /// <summary>Wire: u8 code, u8 flags, u16 from (BE), [u16 group if flags&0x10], [u16 n + n*u16 if target==3], payload.</summary>
        public static bool TryDecode(byte[] buf, out EventFrame f)
        {
            f = default;
            if (buf == null || buf.Length < 4) return false;
            f.Code = buf[0];
            byte flags = buf[1];
            f.From = (ushort)((buf[2] << 8) | buf[3]);
            int off = 4;
            if ((flags & 0x10) != 0) { if (buf.Length < off + 2) return false; f.Group = (ushort)((buf[off] << 8) | buf[off + 1]); off += 2; }
            if ((flags & 0x03) == 3)
            {
                if (buf.Length < off + 2) return false;
                int n = (buf[off] << 8) | buf[off + 1];
                off += 2 + n * 2;
                if (buf.Length < off) return false;
            }
            f.Payload = new ArraySegment<byte>(buf, off, buf.Length - off);
            return true;
        }
    }

    public sealed class Client : IDisposable
    {
        IntPtr _h;
        public bool IsConnected => _h != IntPtr.Zero;
        public int Actor { get; private set; } = -1;
        public string JoinedJson { get; private set; }

        /// <summary>Server control message as JSON (joined, player_joined, player_left, desync, ...).</summary>
        public event Action<string> OnControl;
        /// <summary>Data-path message: channel, tick, raw bytes (relay event frame / sync delta / lockstep bundle).</summary>
        public event Action<Channel, ushort, byte[]> OnData;
        public event Action OnDataReady;
        public event Action<string> OnClosed;

        public static string Version => Native.Utf8(Native.aurix_net_version());

        /// <summary>Backend/tooling only; never ship an API key in a game build.</summary>
        public static string IssueGrant(string http, string apiKey, string playerId, string name)
        {
            var p = Native.aurix_net_issue_grant(http, apiKey, playerId, name);
            if (p == IntPtr.Zero) throw new NetException(Native.LastError());
            var s = Native.Utf8(p); Native.aurix_net_string_free(p); return s;
        }

        /// <summary>Opens the control channel and authenticates. Blocks briefly (network round trip).</summary>
        public static Client Connect(string http, string grant, bool tunnel = false)
        {
            var h = Native.aurix_net_connect(http, grant, tunnel ? 1 : 0);
            if (h == IntPtr.Zero) throw new NetException(Native.LastError());
            return new Client { _h = h };
        }

        public void SendControl(string json)
        {
            if (Native.aurix_net_send_control(_h, json) != 0) throw new NetException(Native.LastError());
        }

        /// <summary>Joins or creates a room and opens the data path. Returns the actor id.</summary>
        public int JoinOrCreate(string name, RoomMode mode = RoomMode.Relay, int maxPlayers = 8, string propsJson = null, string[] reserved = null)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("{\"t\":\"join_or_create\",\"name\":").Append(Json(name))
                .Append(",\"mode\":\"").Append(mode.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()).Append("\",\"max_players\":").Append(maxPlayers);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propsJson)) sb.Append(",\"props\":").Append(propsJson);
            if (reserved != null && reserved.Length > 0)
            {
                sb.Append(",\"reserved\":[");
                for (int i = 0; i < reserved.Length; i++) { if (i > 0) sb.Append(','); sb.Append(Json(reserved[i])); }
                sb.Append(']');
            }
            return Join(sb.Append('}').ToString());
        }

        /// <summary>Joins a random open room. <paramref name="filterJson"/> must equal room props exactly,
        /// <paramref name="expr"/> is a SQL-like condition on lobby props ("map = 'dust' AND skill <= 1500"),
        /// <paramref name="matchType"/> is "fill" (default), "serial" or "random".</summary>
        public int JoinRandom(string filterJson = null, string expr = null, string matchType = null)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("{\"t\":\"join_random\"");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filterJson)) sb.Append(",\"filter\":").Append(filterJson);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(expr)) sb.Append(",\"expr\":").Append(Json(expr));
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(matchType)) sb.Append(",\"match_type\":").Append(Json(matchType));
            return Join(sb.Append('}').ToString());
        }

        public int Join(string name, string schemaHash = null)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("{\"t\":\"join\",\"name\":").Append(Json(name));
            if (schemaHash != null) sb.Append(",\"schema_hash\":").Append(Json(schemaHash));
            return Join(sb.Append('}').ToString());
        }

        int Join(string json)
        {
            var a = Native.aurix_net_join(_h, json);
            if (a < 0) throw new NetException(Native.LastError());
            Actor = a;
            var p = Native.aurix_net_joined_json(_h);
            JoinedJson = Native.Utf8(p); Native.aurix_net_string_free(p);
            return a;
        }

        public void SendEvent(byte code, byte[] data, Target target = Target.Others, bool reliable = false, ushort[] actors = null)
        {
            var r = Native.aurix_net_send_event(_h, code, (int)target, actors, (UIntPtr)(actors?.Length ?? 0), data, (UIntPtr)(data?.Length ?? 0), reliable ? 1 : 0);
            if (r != 0) throw new NetException(Native.LastError());
        }

        public void SendData(Channel channel, byte[] data)
        {
            if (Native.aurix_net_send_data(_h, (byte)channel, data, (UIntPtr)(data?.Length ?? 0)) != 0) throw new NetException(Native.LastError());
        }

        /// <summary>Pushes queued unreliable messages onto the wire; call at the end of the frame.</summary>
        public void Flush() => Native.aurix_net_flush(_h);

        /// <summary>Dispatches pending events (up to maxEvents). Call every frame.</summary>
        public int Poll(int maxEvents = 256)
        {
            int n = 0;
            while (n < maxEvents && Native.aurix_net_poll(_h, out var ev) == 1)
            {
                n++;
                try
                {
                    switch (ev.kind)
                    {
                        case Native.EventControl: OnControl?.Invoke(Native.Utf8(ev.json)); break;
                        case Native.EventData:
                            var len = (int)ev.dataLen;
                            var buf = new byte[len];
                            if (len > 0) Marshal.Copy(ev.data, buf, 0, len);
                            OnData?.Invoke((Channel)ev.channel, ev.tick, buf);
                            break;
                        case Native.EventDataReady: OnDataReady?.Invoke(); break;
                        case Native.EventClosed: OnClosed?.Invoke(Native.Utf8(ev.json)); break;
                    }
                }
                finally { Native.aurix_net_event_free(ref ev); }
            }
            return n;
        }

        public void Leave() { if (_h != IntPtr.Zero) Native.aurix_net_leave(_h); }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_h != IntPtr.Zero) { Native.aurix_net_destroy(_h); _h = IntPtr.Zero; }
        }

        static string Json(string s)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("\"");
            foreach (var c in s)
            {
                if (c == '"' || c == '\\') sb.Append('\\').Append(c);
                else if (c < 0x20) sb.Append("\\u").Append(((int)c).ToString("x4"));
                else sb.Append(c);
            }
            return sb.Append('"').ToString();
        }
    }
}

// FishNet transport over an Aurix Net relay room (see Transports/RelayBridge.cs for the topology).
// Compiled only when FishNet is in the project (FishNet defines FISHNET).
#if FISHNET
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Aurix.Net.Transports;
using FishNet.Managing;
using FishNet.Transporting;
using UnityEngine;
using FChannel = FishNet.Transporting.Channel;

namespace Aurix.Net.FishNetTransport
{
    public sealed class AurixNetFishNetTransport : Transport
    {
        [Header("Aurix Net")]
        [Tooltip("Node control-plane URL, e.g. https://node.example.com")]
        public string httpUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:8090";
        [Tooltip("Grant issued by your backend (POST /v1/grants). Leave empty and set GrantProvider from code.")]
        public string grant = "";
        [Tooltip("Relay room name shared by host and clients. SetClientAddress overrides it when non-empty.")]
        public string roomName = "fishnet";
        public int maxPlayers = 16;
        [Tooltip("Relay event code reserved for FishNet frames.")]
        public byte eventCode = 200;

        /// <summary>Async grant source; wins over the inspector field.</summary>
        public Func<Task<string>> GrantProvider;

        public override event Action<ClientConnectionStateArgs> OnClientConnectionState;
        public override event Action<ServerConnectionStateArgs> OnServerConnectionState;
        public override event Action<RemoteConnectionStateArgs> OnRemoteConnectionState;
        public override event Action<ClientReceivedDataArgs> OnClientReceivedData;
        public override event Action<ServerReceivedDataArgs> OnServerReceivedData;

        RelayBridge _server, _client;
        string _clientRoom;

        RelayBridge NewBridge(string room) => new RelayBridge(new RelayBridgeSettings
        {
            HttpUrl = httpUrl, Grant = grant, GrantProvider = GrantProvider, RoomName = room, MaxPlayers = maxPlayers, EventCode = eventCode
        });

        public override string GetConnectionAddress(int connectionId) => "actor:" + connectionId;

        public override void HandleClientConnectionState(ClientConnectionStateArgs a) => OnClientConnectionState?.Invoke(a);
        public override void HandleServerConnectionState(ServerConnectionStateArgs a) => OnServerConnectionState?.Invoke(a);
        public override void HandleRemoteConnectionState(RemoteConnectionStateArgs a) => OnRemoteConnectionState?.Invoke(a);
        public override void HandleClientReceivedDataArgs(ClientReceivedDataArgs a) => OnClientReceivedData?.Invoke(a);
        public override void HandleServerReceivedDataArgs(ServerReceivedDataArgs a) => OnServerReceivedData?.Invoke(a);

        public override LocalConnectionState GetConnectionState(bool server)
        {
            var b = server ? _server : _client;
            return b == null ? LocalConnectionState.Stopped : Map(b.State);
        }

        public override RemoteConnectionState GetConnectionState(int connectionId) =>
            _server != null && _server.HasPeer(connectionId) ? RemoteConnectionState.Started : RemoteConnectionState.Stopped;

        public override void SendToServer(byte channelId, ArraySegment<byte> segment) => _client?.SendToHost(segment, channelId == (byte)FChannel.Reliable);
        public override void SendToClient(byte channelId, ArraySegment<byte> segment, int connectionId) => _server?.SendTo(connectionId, segment, channelId == (byte)FChannel.Reliable);

        public override void IterateIncoming(bool asServer) { if (asServer) _server?.Pump(); else _client?.Pump(); }
        public override void IterateOutgoing(bool asServer) { if (asServer) _server?.Flush(); else _client?.Flush(); }

        public override void SetClientAddress(string address) => _clientRoom = address;
        public override string GetClientAddress() => string.IsNullOrEmpty(_clientRoom) ? roomName : _clientRoom;
        public override int GetMaximumClients() => maxPlayers - 1;
        public override void SetMaximumClients(int value) => maxPlayers = value + 1;

        public override bool StartConnection(bool server) => server ? StartServer() : StartClient();

        bool StartServer()
        {
            if (_server != null) return false;
            var b = _server = NewBridge(roomName);
            b.OnState += s => HandleServerConnectionState(new ServerConnectionStateArgs(Map(s), Index));
            b.OnPeerJoined += a => HandleRemoteConnectionState(new RemoteConnectionStateArgs(RemoteConnectionState.Started, a, Index));
            b.OnPeerLeft += (a, why) => HandleRemoteConnectionState(new RemoteConnectionStateArgs(RemoteConnectionState.Stopped, a, Index));
            b.OnData += (from, d, _) => HandleServerReceivedDataArgs(new ServerReceivedDataArgs(d, FChannel.Reliable, from, Index));
            b.OnDisconnected += why => { if (_server == b) _server = null; if (why != BridgeLeave.Local) Debug.LogWarning("[AurixNet] server stopped: " + b.LastError); };
            b.StartHost();
            return true;
        }

        bool StartClient()
        {
            if (_client != null) return false;
            var b = _client = NewBridge(GetClientAddress());
            b.OnState += s => HandleClientConnectionState(new ClientConnectionStateArgs(Map(s), Index));
            b.OnData += (from, d, _) => HandleClientReceivedDataArgs(new ClientReceivedDataArgs(d, FChannel.Reliable, Index));
            b.OnDisconnected += why => { if (_client == b) _client = null; if (why == BridgeLeave.Failed) Debug.LogError("[AurixNet] connect failed: " + b.LastError); };
            b.StartClient();
            return true;
        }

        public override bool StopConnection(bool server)
        {
            var b = server ? _server : _client;
            if (b == null) return false;
            if (server) _server = null; else _client = null;
            b.Stop();
            return true;
        }

        public override bool StopConnection(int connectionId, bool immediately)
        {
            if (_server == null || !_server.HasPeer(connectionId)) return false;
            _server.Kick(connectionId);
            return true;
        }

        public override void Shutdown() { StopConnection(false); StopConnection(true); }

        public override int GetMTU(byte channel) => RelayBridge.Mtu(channel == (byte)FChannel.Reliable);

        static LocalConnectionState Map(BridgeState s) => s switch
        {
            BridgeState.Starting => LocalConnectionState.Starting,
            BridgeState.Started => LocalConnectionState.Started,
            BridgeState.Stopping => LocalConnectionState.Stopping,
            _ => LocalConnectionState.Stopped
        };
    }
}
#endif

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/AddressablesPrefabFactory.cs`:

```cs
// Aurix Net Unity SDK — network prefabs loaded through Addressables (compiled only when com.unity.addressables is present).
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#if AURIX_ADDRESSABLES
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.AddressableAssets;
using UnityEngine.ResourceManagement.AsyncOperations;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Prefab ids map to <see cref="AssetReferenceGameObject"/>s; spawns for not-yet-loaded prefabs stay pending on the
    /// client until the asset arrives. Assign to <c>NetworkManager.factory</c> and register the same list on every peer.
    /// </summary>
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class AddressablesPrefabFactory : IAsyncNetworkObjectFactory
    {
        public List<AssetReferenceGameObject> prefabs = new List<AssetReferenceGameObject>();
        readonly Dictionary<int, GameObject> _loaded = new Dictionary<int, GameObject>();
        readonly Dictionary<int, AsyncOperationHandle<GameObject>> _handles = new Dictionary<int, AsyncOperationHandle<GameObject>>();
        readonly Dictionary<int, List<Action<GameObject>>> _waiting = new Dictionary<int, List<Action<GameObject>>>();

        /// <summary>Preload a prefab (e.g. during a loading screen) so later spawns are synchronous.</summary>
        public void Preload(int prefabId) => Load(prefabId, null);

        public NetworkIdentity Instantiate(NetworkManager m, int prefabId)
        {
            if (!_loaded.TryGetValue(prefabId, out var prefab)) throw new NetException($"prefab {prefabId} is not loaded yet; use InstantiateAsync");
            return Make(prefab, prefabId);
        }

        public void InstantiateAsync(NetworkManager m, int prefabId, Action<NetworkIdentity> ready)
        {
            if (_loaded.TryGetValue(prefabId, out var prefab)) { ready(Make(prefab, prefabId)); return; }
            Load(prefabId, go => ready(go != null ? Make(go, prefabId) : null));
        }

        public void Destroy(NetworkIdentity id) { if (id != null) UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(id.gameObject); }

        /// <summary>Release every loaded prefab (call when leaving the game).</summary>
        public void ReleaseAll() { foreach (var h in _handles.Values) if (h.IsValid()) Addressables.Release(h); _handles.Clear(); _loaded.Clear(); }

        void Load(int prefabId, Action<GameObject> done)
        {
            if (prefabId < 0 || prefabId >= prefabs.Count || prefabs[prefabId] == null) { Debug.LogError($"AddressablesPrefabFactory: unknown prefab id {prefabId}"); done?.Invoke(null); return; }
            if (_waiting.TryGetValue(prefabId, out var list)) { if (done != null) list.Add(done); return; }
            list = new List<Action<GameObject>>(); if (done != null) list.Add(done); _waiting[prefabId] = list;
            var h = prefabs[prefabId].LoadAssetAsync<GameObject>(); _handles[prefabId] = h;
            h.Completed += op =>
            {
                _waiting.Remove(prefabId);
                if (op.Status == AsyncOperationStatus.Succeeded) _loaded[prefabId] = op.Result; else Debug.LogError($"AddressablesPrefabFactory: failed to load prefab {prefabId}: {op.OperationException?.Message}");
                foreach (var cb in list) cb(op.Status == AsyncOperationStatus.Succeeded ? op.Result : null);
            };
        }

        static NetworkIdentity Make(GameObject prefab, int prefabId)
        {
            var go = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(prefab);
            var id = go.GetComponent<NetworkIdentity>();
            if (id == null) throw new NetException(prefab.name + " has no NetworkIdentity");
            return id;
        }
    }
}
#endif

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/Components/ColliderRollback.cs`:

```cs
// Lag compensation (PurrNet ColliderRollback-style): the server keeps a per-tick history of this object's
// pose; NetworkManager.Rollback(shooter, body) rewinds every ColliderRollback to the tick the shooter was
// looking at (its reported view tick), runs body (raycasts, overlaps…), then restores the live pose.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public class ColliderRollback : NetworkBehaviour
    {
        public struct Pose { public uint tick; public Vector3 pos; public Quaternion rot; }

        [Tooltip("How many seconds of poses the server keeps.")] public float historySeconds = 1f;
        readonly List<Pose> _history = new List<Pose>(64);
        Pose _live; bool _rolledBack;

        public IReadOnlyList<Pose> history => _history;
        public bool isRolledBack => _rolledBack;

        public override void OnTick(uint tick)
        {
            if (!isServer || _rolledBack) return;
            int cap = Math.Max(2, (int)(historySeconds * Math.Max(1, networkManager.tickRate)));
            if (_history.Count >= cap) _history.RemoveAt(0);
            _history.Add(new Pose { tick = tick, pos = transform.position, rot = transform.rotation });
        }

        /// <summary>Pose at the given server tick, interpolated between the two nearest samples; clamped to the history range.</summary>
        public bool TryGetPose(uint tick, out Pose pose)
        {
            pose = default;
            if (_history.Count == 0) return false;
            if (tick <= _history[0].tick) { pose = _history[0]; pose.tick = tick; return true; }
            var last = _history[_history.Count - 1];
            if (tick >= last.tick) { pose = last; pose.tick = tick; return true; }
            for (int i = 1; i < _history.Count; i++)
            {
                if (_history[i].tick < tick) continue;
                var a = _history[i - 1]; var b = _history[i];
                float t = (tick - a.tick) / (float)Math.Max(1, b.tick - a.tick);
                pose = new Pose { tick = tick, pos = Vector3.Lerp(a.pos, b.pos, t), rot = Quaternion.Slerp(a.rot, b.rot, t) };
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        internal void Rollback(uint tick)
        {
            if (!TryGetPose(tick, out var p)) return;
            if (!_rolledBack) { _live = new Pose { pos = transform.position, rot = transform.rotation }; _rolledBack = true; }
            transform.position = p.pos; transform.rotation = p.rot;
        }

        internal void Restore()
        {
            if (!_rolledBack) return;
            transform.position = _live.pos; transform.rotation = _live.rot; _rolledBack = false;
        }
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/Components/NetworkAnimator.cs`:

```cs
// Replicates Animator parameters (float / int / bool) from the controller and forwards triggers
// as RPCs. Remote copies blend floats towards the replicated value.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public sealed class AnimatorSync : NetworkModule
    {
        public readonly List<float> floats = new List<float>();
        public readonly List<int> ints = new List<int>();
        public readonly List<bool> bools = new List<bool>();
        readonly List<bool> _dirtyF = new List<bool>(), _dirtyI = new List<bool>(), _dirtyB = new List<bool>();

        public AnimatorSync(bool ownerAuth = true) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; }

        public void Resize(int f, int i, int b)
        {
            while (floats.Count < f) { floats.Add(0); _dirtyF.Add(true); } while (ints.Count < i) { ints.Add(0); _dirtyI.Add(true); } while (bools.Count < b) { bools.Add(false); _dirtyB.Add(true); }
        }
        public void SetFloat(int i, float v) { if (floats[i] != v) { floats[i] = v; _dirtyF[i] = true; isDirty = true; } }
        public void SetInt(int i, int v) { if (ints[i] != v) { ints[i] = v; _dirtyI[i] = true; isDirty = true; } }
        public void SetBool(int i, bool v) { if (bools[i] != v) { bools[i] = v; _dirtyB[i] = true; isDirty = true; } }

        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w)
        {
            w.WriteUInt((ulong)floats.Count, 8); foreach (var f in floats) w.WriteF32(f);
            w.WriteUInt((ulong)ints.Count, 8); foreach (var i in ints) w.WriteBits((uint)i, 32);
            w.WriteUInt((ulong)bools.Count, 8); foreach (var b in bools) w.WriteBool(b);
        }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r)
        {
            int nf = (int)r.ReadUInt(8), ni, nb; Resize(nf, 0, 0); for (int i = 0; i < nf; i++) floats[i] = r.ReadF32();
            ni = (int)r.ReadUInt(8); Resize(nf, ni, 0); for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) ints[i] = (int)(uint)r.ReadBits(32);
            nb = (int)r.ReadUInt(8); Resize(nf, ni, nb); for (int i = 0; i < nb; i++) bools[i] = r.ReadBool();
        }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < floats.Count; i++) { w.WriteBool(_dirtyF[i]); if (_dirtyF[i]) { w.WriteF32(floats[i]); _dirtyF[i] = false; } }
            for (int i = 0; i < ints.Count; i++) { w.WriteBool(_dirtyI[i]); if (_dirtyI[i]) { w.WriteBits((uint)ints[i], 32); _dirtyI[i] = false; } }
            for (int i = 0; i < bools.Count; i++) { w.WriteBool(_dirtyB[i]); if (_dirtyB[i]) { w.WriteBool(bools[i]); _dirtyB[i] = false; } }
        }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < floats.Count; i++) if (r.ReadBool()) floats[i] = r.ReadF32();
            for (int i = 0; i < ints.Count; i++) if (r.ReadBool()) ints[i] = (int)(uint)r.ReadBits(32);
            for (int i = 0; i < bools.Count; i++) if (r.ReadBool()) bools[i] = r.ReadBool();
        }
    }

    [RequireComponent(typeof(Animator))]
    public class NetworkAnimator : NetworkBehaviour
    {
        [Tooltip("Who drives the animator: the owner (true) or the server (false).")] public bool ownerAuth = true;
        [Tooltip("Remote copies blend float parameters towards the replicated value with this rate (0 = snap).")] public float floatDamping = 10f;

        public AnimatorSync sync;
        Animator _anim;
        readonly List<string> _floatNames = new List<string>(), _intNames = new List<string>(), _boolNames = new List<string>();

        void Awake() => EnsureSync();
        protected override void OnBeforeBind() => EnsureSync();

        void EnsureSync()
        {
            if (sync != null) return;
            sync = new AnimatorSync(ownerAuth);
            _anim = GetComponent<Animator>();
            if (_anim == null) return;
            foreach (var p in _anim.parameters)
            {
                switch (p.type)
                {
                    case AnimatorControllerParameterType.Float: _floatNames.Add(p.name); break;
                    case AnimatorControllerParameterType.Int: _intNames.Add(p.name); break;
                    case AnimatorControllerParameterType.Bool: _boolNames.Add(p.name); break;
                }
            }
            sync.Resize(_floatNames.Count, _intNames.Count, _boolNames.Count);
            Sample();
        }

        public override void OnTick(uint tick) { if (isController) Sample(); }

        void Sample()
        {
            if (_anim == null) return;
            for (int i = 0; i < _floatNames.Count; i++) sync.SetFloat(i, _anim.GetFloat(_floatNames[i]));
            for (int i = 0; i < _intNames.Count; i++) sync.SetInt(i, _anim.GetInteger(_intNames[i]));
            for (int i = 0; i < _boolNames.Count; i++) sync.SetBool(i, _anim.GetBool(_boolNames[i]));
        }

        void Update()
        {
            if (!isSpawned || isController || _anim == null) return;
            for (int i = 0; i < _floatNames.Count && i < sync.floats.Count; i++)
                _anim.SetFloat(_floatNames[i], floatDamping > 0 ? Mathf.Lerp(_anim.GetFloat(_floatNames[i]), sync.floats[i], Mathf.Clamp01(floatDamping * Time.deltaTime)) : sync.floats[i]);
            for (int i = 0; i < _intNames.Count && i < sync.ints.Count; i++) _anim.SetInteger(_intNames[i], sync.ints[i]);
            for (int i = 0; i < _boolNames.Count && i < sync.bools.Count; i++) _anim.SetBool(_boolNames[i], sync.bools[i]);
        }

        /// <summary>Controller: fire a trigger here and on every remote copy.</summary>
        public void SetTrigger(string name)
        {
            if (!isSpawned || !isController) return;
            if (_anim != null) _anim.SetTrigger(name);
            if (isServer) Rpc(nameof(RpcTrigger), name); else Rpc(nameof(CmdTrigger), name);
        }

        [ServerRpc(requireOwnership: true)] void CmdTrigger(string name) { if (_anim != null && !isController) _anim.SetTrigger(name); Rpc(nameof(RpcTrigger), name); }
        [ObserversRpc(runLocally: false, excludeOwner: true)] void RpcTrigger(string name) { if (_anim != null && !isController) _anim.SetTrigger(name); }
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/Components/NetworkAudioSource.cs`:

```cs
// Aurix Net Unity SDK — replicated AudioSource (settings + playback commands).
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Networks an <see cref="AudioSource"/>: volume/pitch/loop/mute/spatial settings replicate as sync vars, Play/Stop/
    /// Pause/UnPause/PlayOneShot are RPCs. Clips travel as indices into <see cref="clips"/> (same list on every peer).
    /// Controller is the owner (<see cref="ownerAuth"/>) or the server.
    /// </summary>
    public class NetworkAudioSource : NetworkBehaviour
    {
        public AudioSource audioSource;
        [Tooltip("Owner controls playback (otherwise the server).")] public bool ownerAuth = true;
        [Tooltip("Clips that may be played over the network, same order on every peer.")] public List<AudioClip> clips = new List<AudioClip>();

        public readonly SyncVar<float> volume = new SyncVar<float>(1f), pitch = new SyncVar<float>(1f), spatialBlend = new SyncVar<float>(0f), minDistance = new SyncVar<float>(1f), maxDistance = new SyncVar<float>(500f);
        public readonly SyncVar<bool> loop = new SyncVar<bool>(false), mute = new SyncVar<bool>(false);
        public readonly SyncVar<int> clipIndex = new SyncVar<int>(-1);
        public readonly SyncVar<bool> playing = new SyncVar<bool>(false);

        public bool isPlaying => playing.value;
        public AudioClip clip => clipIndex.value >= 0 && clipIndex.value < clips.Count ? clips[clipIndex.value] : null;

        protected override void OnBeforeBind()
        {
            foreach (var v in new NetworkModule[] { volume, pitch, spatialBlend, minDistance, maxDistance, loop, mute, clipIndex, playing }) v.SetAuthority(ownerAuth);
            volume.onChanged += v => { if (audioSource != null) audioSource.volume = v; };
            pitch.onChanged += v => { if (audioSource != null) audioSource.pitch = v; };
            spatialBlend.onChanged += v => { if (audioSource != null) audioSource.spatialBlend = v; };
            minDistance.onChanged += v => { if (audioSource != null) audioSource.minDistance = v; };
            maxDistance.onChanged += v => { if (audioSource != null) audioSource.maxDistance = v; };
            loop.onChanged += v => { if (audioSource != null) audioSource.loop = v; };
            mute.onChanged += v => { if (audioSource != null) audioSource.mute = v; };
            clipIndex.onChanged += _ => { if (audioSource != null) audioSource.clip = clip; };
            playing.onChanged += v => { if (audioSource == null || isController) return; if (v && !audioSource.isPlaying) audioSource.Play(); else if (!v && audioSource.isPlaying) audioSource.Stop(); };
        }

        protected override void OnSpawned(bool asServer)
        {
            if (audioSource == null) return;
            audioSource.volume = volume.value; audioSource.pitch = pitch.value; audioSource.spatialBlend = spatialBlend.value; audioSource.minDistance = minDistance.value; audioSource.maxDistance = maxDistance.value;
            audioSource.loop = loop.value; audioSource.mute = mute.value; audioSource.clip = clip;
            if (!isController) { if (playing.value && !audioSource.isPlaying) audioSource.Play(); else if (!playing.value && audioSource.isPlaying) audioSource.Stop(); }
        }

        /// <summary>Controller: mirror the AudioSource's current settings into the sync vars (call after editing it directly).</summary>
        public void PushSettings()
        {
            if (!isController || audioSource == null) return;
            volume.value = audioSource.volume; pitch.value = audioSource.pitch; spatialBlend.value = audioSource.spatialBlend; minDistance.value = audioSource.minDistance; maxDistance.value = audioSource.maxDistance;
            loop.value = audioSource.loop; mute.value = audioSource.mute;
        }

        public void Play() { if (!isController) return; if (audioSource != null) audioSource.Play(); playing.value = true; }
        public void Play(int clipId) { if (!isController) return; clipIndex.value = clipId; if (audioSource != null) audioSource.clip = clip; Play(); }
        public void Play(AudioClip c) { int i = clips.IndexOf(c); if (i < 0) { Debug.LogError("NetworkAudioSource: clip is not in the clips list"); return; } Play(i); }
        public void Stop() { if (!isController) return; if (audioSource != null) audioSource.Stop(); playing.value = false; }
        public void Pause() { if (!isController) return; if (audioSource != null) audioSource.Pause(); Rpc(nameof(RpcPause)); }
        public void UnPause() { if (!isController) return; if (audioSource != null) audioSource.UnPause(); Rpc(nameof(RpcUnPause)); }
        /// <summary>Controller: play a one-shot on every peer (fire-and-forget, not replayed to late joiners).</summary>
        public void PlayOneShot(int clipId, float volumeScale = 1f) { if (!isController) return; if (isServer) Rpc(nameof(RpcOneShot), clipId, volumeScale); else Rpc(nameof(CmdOneShot), clipId, volumeScale); }
        public void PlayOneShot(AudioClip c, float volumeScale = 1f) { int i = clips.IndexOf(c); if (i >= 0) PlayOneShot(i, volumeScale); }

        void DoOneShot(int clipId, float scale) { if (audioSource != null && clipId >= 0 && clipId < clips.Count) audioSource.PlayOneShot(clips[clipId], scale); }
        [ServerRpc(requireOwnership: true)] void CmdOneShot(int clipId, float scale) { Rpc(nameof(RpcOneShot), clipId, scale); }
        [ObserversRpc(runLocally: true)] void RpcOneShot(int clipId, float scale) => DoOneShot(clipId, scale);
        [ObserversRpc] void RpcPause() { if (!isController && audioSource != null) audioSource.Pause(); }
        [ObserversRpc] void RpcUnPause() { if (!isController && audioSource != null) audioSource.UnPause(); }
    }
}

// Aurix Net Unity SDK — replicate skeleton bones (local pose) for ragdolls / procedural animation.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Replicates the local position/rotation/scale of every bone gathered from the SkinnedMeshRenderers under this
    /// object plus <see cref="extraBones"/>. Only bones that moved beyond the accuracy thresholds are sent; remotes
    /// smooth toward the latest pose. Set bones before spawn.
    /// </summary>
    public class NetworkBones : NetworkBehaviour
    {
        [Tooltip("Owner samples and sends (otherwise the server).")] public bool ownerAuth = true;
        [Tooltip("Max sends per second.")] public float sendRate = 10f;
        [Tooltip("Extra bones to sync on top of the ones gathered from SkinnedMeshRenderers.")] public Transform[] extraBones = Array.Empty<Transform>();
        public bool syncPosition = true, syncRotation = true, syncScale;
        public float positionAccuracy = 0.01f, angleAccuracy = 0.5f, scaleAccuracy = 0.05f, positionRange = 64f;
        [Tooltip("Remote smoothing speed (1/s); 0 snaps.")] public float smoothing = 20f;

        BonesSync _sync;
        public int boneCount => _sync?.bones.Count ?? 0;
        public IReadOnlyList<Transform> bones => _sync?.bones;

        protected override void OnBeforeBind()
        {
            _sync = new BonesSync(ownerAuth, sendRate > 0 ? 1f / sendRate : 0f) { owner = this };
            var list = new List<Transform>();
            foreach (var smr in GetComponentsInChildren<SkinnedMeshRenderer>()) if (smr.bones != null) foreach (var b in smr.bones) if (b != null && !list.Contains(b)) list.Add(b);
            foreach (var b in extraBones) if (b != null && !list.Contains(b)) list.Add(b);
            _sync.Configure(list);
        }

        public override void OnTick(uint tick) { if (isController) _sync.Sample(); }
        protected virtual void LateUpdate() => RenderUpdate(Time.deltaTime);
        /// <summary>Remote side: ease bones toward the last received pose.</summary>
        public void RenderUpdate(float dt) { if (isSpawned && !isController) _sync.Apply(smoothing > 0 ? Math.Min(1f, dt * smoothing) : 1f); }
    }

    public sealed class BonesSync : NetworkModule
    {
        internal NetworkBones owner;
        public readonly List<Transform> bones = new List<Transform>();
        Vector3[] _pos = Array.Empty<Vector3>(), _scale = Array.Empty<Vector3>(), _tPos = Array.Empty<Vector3>(), _tScale = Array.Empty<Vector3>();
        Quaternion[] _rot = Array.Empty<Quaternion>(), _tRot = Array.Empty<Quaternion>();
        bool[] _dirty = Array.Empty<bool>();

        public BonesSync(bool ownerAuth, float sendInterval) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; sendIntervalInSeconds = sendInterval; }

        public void Configure(List<Transform> list)
        {
            bones.Clear(); bones.AddRange(list); int n = bones.Count;
            _pos = new Vector3[n]; _scale = new Vector3[n]; _rot = new Quaternion[n]; _tPos = new Vector3[n]; _tScale = new Vector3[n]; _tRot = new Quaternion[n]; _dirty = new bool[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { _pos[i] = _tPos[i] = bones[i].localPosition; _rot[i] = _tRot[i] = bones[i].localRotation; _scale[i] = _tScale[i] = bones[i].localScale; }
        }

        public void Sample()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < bones.Count; i++)
            {
                var b = bones[i]; bool moved = false;
                if (owner.syncPosition && Vector3.Distance(b.localPosition, _pos[i]) > owner.positionAccuracy) { _pos[i] = b.localPosition; moved = true; }
                if (owner.syncRotation && Quaternion.Angle(b.localRotation, _rot[i]) > owner.angleAccuracy) { _rot[i] = b.localRotation; moved = true; }
                if (owner.syncScale && Vector3.Distance(b.localScale, _scale[i]) > owner.scaleAccuracy) { _scale[i] = b.localScale; moved = true; }
                if (moved) { _dirty[i] = true; isDirty = true; }
            }
        }

        public void Apply(float t)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < bones.Count; i++)
            {
                var b = bones[i];
                if (owner.syncPosition) b.localPosition = Vector3.Lerp(b.localPosition, _tPos[i], t);
                if (owner.syncRotation) b.localRotation = Quaternion.Slerp(b.localRotation, _tRot[i], t);
                if (owner.syncScale) b.localScale = Vector3.Lerp(b.localScale, _tScale[i], t);
            }
        }

        void WriteBone(BitWriter w, int i)
        {
            if (owner.syncPosition) { float r = owner.positionRange, q = owner.positionAccuracy; w.WriteQuantized(_pos[i].x, -r, r, q); w.WriteQuantized(_pos[i].y, -r, r, q); w.WriteQuantized(_pos[i].z, -r, r, q); }
            if (owner.syncRotation) TransformSync.WriteQuat(w, _rot[i]);
            if (owner.syncScale) { w.WriteF32(_scale[i].x); w.WriteF32(_scale[i].y); w.WriteF32(_scale[i].z); }
        }
        void ReadBone(BitReader r, int i)
        {
            if (owner.syncPosition) { float rg = owner.positionRange, q = owner.positionAccuracy; _tPos[i] = new Vector3(r.ReadQuantized(-rg, rg, q), r.ReadQuantized(-rg, rg, q), r.ReadQuantized(-rg, rg, q)); }
            if (owner.syncRotation) _tRot[i] = TransformSync.ReadQuat(r);
            if (owner.syncScale) _tScale[i] = new Vector3(r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32());
        }

        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) { w.WriteUInt((ulong)bones.Count, 16); for (int i = 0; i < bones.Count; i++) WriteBone(w, i); }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r)
        {
            int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(16);
            if (n != bones.Count) { Debug.LogError($"NetworkBones: {n} bones received, {bones.Count} local; skipping"); return; }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ReadBone(r, i);
            Apply(1f);
        }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) { for (int i = 0; i < bones.Count; i++) { w.WriteBool(_dirty[i]); if (_dirty[i]) { WriteBone(w, i); _dirty[i] = false; } } }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r) { for (int i = 0; i < bones.Count; i++) if (r.ReadBool()) ReadBone(r, i); if (owner.smoothing <= 0) Apply(1f); }
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/Components/NetworkLOD.cs`:

```cs
// Aurix Net Unity SDK — per-player level-of-detail for replication traffic.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    [Serializable]
    public struct NetworkLODTier
    {
        [Tooltip("Players whose closest owned object is within this distance get this tier (or a closer one).")] public float maxDistance;
        [Tooltip("Extra distance a player must move before dropping back to a closer tier (avoids flapping).")] public float hysteresis;
        [Tooltip("Send dirty deltas to players in this tier every N server ticks.")] public int sendIntervalTicks;
        public NetworkLODTier(float maxDistance, int sendIntervalTicks, float hysteresis = 0f) { this.maxDistance = maxDistance; this.sendIntervalTicks = Math.Max(1, sendIntervalTicks); this.hysteresis = hysteresis; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Server-side send-rate tiers by distance: far players get this object's deltas less often (or not at all when
    /// culled beyond the last tier). Does not change visibility: culled players stay observers and still get spawn,
    /// despawn, ownership and RPCs; only module deltas are gated.
    /// </summary>
    public class NetworkLOD : NetworkBehaviour
    {
        public const byte CulledTier = byte.MaxValue;

        public NetworkLODTier[] tiers = { new NetworkLODTier(25f, 1), new NetworkLODTier(75f, 3, 5f), new NetworkLODTier(200f, 10, 10f) };
        [Tooltip("Players farther than the last tier get no deltas at all.")] public bool cullBeyondLastTier = true;
        [Tooltip("Re-evaluate tiers every N server ticks.")] public int evaluateIntervalTicks = 10;

        readonly Dictionary<PlayerID, byte> _tiers = new Dictionary<PlayerID, byte>();
        public event Action<PlayerID, byte, byte> onTierChanged;

        /// <summary>Tier of a player (0 = closest / full rate; owner is always 0).</summary>
        public byte GetTier(PlayerID p) { if (identity != null && identity.owner == p) return 0; return _tiers.TryGetValue(p, out var t) ? t : (byte)0; }
        public bool IsCulled(PlayerID p) => GetTier(p) == CulledTier;

        /// <summary>Whether a dirty delta of this object should go to the player on this server tick.</summary>
        public bool ShouldSendToPlayer(PlayerID p, uint tick)
        {
            byte t = GetTier(p);
            if (t == CulledTier) return false;
            if (tiers == null || t >= tiers.Length) return true;
            int every = Math.Max(1, tiers[t].sendIntervalTicks);
            if (every == 1) return true;
            uint stagger = identity != null ? identity.objectId : 0;
            return (tick + stagger) % (uint)every == 0;
        }

        protected override void OnBeforeBind() { if (identity != null) identity.lod = this; }
        protected override void OnSpawned(bool asServer) { if (identity != null) identity.lod = this; }
        protected override void OnDespawned() { _tiers.Clear(); }

        public override void OnTick(uint tick)
        {
            if (!isServer || networkManager == null || tiers == null || tiers.Length == 0) return;
            if (evaluateIntervalTicks > 1 && tick % (uint)evaluateIntervalTicks != 0) return;
            var me = transform.position;
            foreach (var p in identity.observers)
            {
                if (identity.owner == p) continue;
                float best = float.MaxValue;
                foreach (var id in networkManager.identities) if (id.owner == p) { float d = Vector3.Distance(id.transform.position, me); if (d < best) best = d; }
                if (best == float.MaxValue) continue;  // no avatar: keep the current tier
                byte prev = _tiers.TryGetValue(p, out var pt) ? pt : (byte)0, next = Resolve(best, prev);
                if (next == prev) { _tiers[p] = next; continue; }
                _tiers[p] = next; onTierChanged?.Invoke(p, prev, next);
            }
        }

        byte Resolve(float dist, byte current)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < tiers.Length; i++)
            {
                float limit = tiers[i].maxDistance;
                if (current != CulledTier && i < current) limit += tiers[i].hysteresis;  // moving closer needs margin
                if (dist <= limit) return (byte)i;
            }
            return cullBeyondLastTier ? CulledTier : (byte)(tiers.Length - 1);
        }

        internal void RemovePlayer(PlayerID p) => _tiers.Remove(p);
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/Components/NetworkReflection.cs`:

```cs
// Aurix Net Unity SDK — replicate fields/properties and call methods of any plain component by name (PurrNet-style NetworkReflection).
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using UnityEngine;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public enum ReflectionRpcType : byte { Server, Observers, Target }

    [Serializable]
    public struct ReflectedMethod
    {
        public string name; public ReflectionRpcType rpcType;
        public ReflectedMethod(string name, ReflectionRpcType rpcType) { this.name = name; this.rpcType = rpcType; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Networks a component you cannot (or do not want to) edit: listed fields/properties of <see cref="trackedBehaviour"/>
    /// are replicated when they change (full state to late joiners), listed methods can be called over the network with
    /// <see cref="Invoke"/>. Values must be types <see cref="NetSerializer"/> understands.
    /// </summary>
    public class NetworkReflection : NetworkBehaviour
    {
        [Tooltip("The object whose members are tracked (any component or plain object).")] public object trackedBehaviour;
        public List<string> trackedFields = new List<string>();
        public List<ReflectedMethod> trackedMethods = new List<ReflectedMethod>();
        [Tooltip("Owner samples and sends (otherwise the server).")] public bool ownerAuth;
        [Tooltip("Max sends per second (0 = every tick).")] public float sendRate;

        ReflectionSync _sync;
        /// <summary>Fired on receivers after a tracked member was updated (member index).</summary>
        public event Action<int> onMemberChanged;

        protected override void OnBeforeBind()
        {
            _sync = new ReflectionSync(ownerAuth, sendRate > 0 ? 1f / sendRate : 0f);
            _sync.Configure(trackedBehaviour, trackedFields);
            _sync.onChanged += i => onMemberChanged?.Invoke(i);
        }

        public override void OnTick(uint tick) { if (isController) _sync.Sample(); }

        /// <summary>Re-read the tracked members now (e.g. after changing many at once) instead of waiting for the tick.</summary>
        public void MarkDirty() { if (isController) _sync.Sample(); }

        /// <summary>Call a tracked method over the network according to its configured RPC type (Target type: first arg is the PlayerID).</summary>
        public bool Invoke(string method, params object[] args)
        {
            var (rm, mi) = Find(method); if (mi == null) return false;
            if (rm.rpcType == ReflectionRpcType.Target)
            {
                if (args.Length == 0 || !(args[0] is PlayerID to)) { Debug.LogError($"NetworkReflection: Target method {method} needs a PlayerID first argument"); return false; }
                var rest = new object[args.Length - 1]; Array.Copy(args, 1, rest, 0, rest.Length);
                var bytes = Pack(mi, rest);
                if (isServer) { if (to == localPlayer) Dispatch(mi, bytes); else Rpc(nameof(ReflTarget), to, method, bytes); }
                else Rpc(nameof(ReflTargetViaServer), to, method, bytes);
                return true;
            }
            var payload = Pack(mi, args);
            switch (rm.rpcType)
            {
                case ReflectionRpcType.Server:
                    if (isServer) Dispatch(mi, payload); else Rpc(nameof(ReflServer), method, payload);
                    return true;
                default:
                    if (isServer) Rpc(nameof(ReflObservers), method, payload); else Rpc(nameof(ReflForward), method, payload);
                    return true;
            }
        }

        PlayerID? localPlayer => networkManager?.localPlayer;

        (ReflectedMethod, MethodInfo) Find(string name)
        {
            if (trackedBehaviour == null) return (default, null);
            foreach (var rm in trackedMethods) if (rm.name == name)
            {
                var mi = trackedBehaviour.GetType().GetMethod(name, BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (mi == null) Debug.LogError($"NetworkReflection: method {name} not found on {trackedBehaviour.GetType().Name}");
                return (rm, mi);
            }
            Debug.LogError($"NetworkReflection: method {name} is not in trackedMethods"); return (default, null);
        }

        static byte[] Pack(MethodInfo mi, object[] args)
        {
            var ps = mi.GetParameters(); var w = new BitWriter();
            for (int i = 0; i < ps.Length; i++) NetSerializer.Write(w, i < args.Length ? args[i] : null, ps[i].ParameterType);
            return w.Finish();
        }

        void Dispatch(MethodInfo mi, byte[] payload)
        {
            var ps = mi.GetParameters(); var r = new BitReader(payload); var args = new object[ps.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < ps.Length; i++) args[i] = NetSerializer.Read(r, ps[i].ParameterType);
            mi.Invoke(trackedBehaviour, args);
        }

        void DispatchNamed(string name, byte[] payload) { var (_, mi) = Find(name); if (mi != null) Dispatch(mi, payload); }

        [ServerRpc(requireOwnership: false)] void ReflServer(string name, byte[] payload) => DispatchNamed(name, payload);
        [ServerRpc(requireOwnership: false)] void ReflForward(string name, byte[] payload) => Rpc(nameof(ReflObservers), name, payload);
        [ObserversRpc(runLocally: true)] void ReflObservers(string name, byte[] payload) => DispatchNamed(name, payload);
        [ServerRpc(requireOwnership: false)] void ReflTargetViaServer(PlayerID to, string name, byte[] payload) { if (to == localPlayer) DispatchNamed(name, payload); else Rpc(nameof(ReflTarget), to, name, payload); }
        [TargetRpc] void ReflTarget(PlayerID to, string name, byte[] payload) => DispatchNamed(name, payload);
    }

    /// <summary>Module behind <see cref="NetworkReflection"/>: snapshot of the tracked members, change mask deltas.</summary>
    public sealed class ReflectionSync : NetworkModule
    {
        object _target; MemberInfo[] _members = Array.Empty<MemberInfo>(); Type[] _types = Array.Empty<Type>();
        object[] _last = Array.Empty<object>(); bool[] _changed = Array.Empty<bool>();
        public event Action<int> onChanged;
        public int memberCount => _members.Length;

        public ReflectionSync(bool ownerAuth, float sendInterval) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; sendIntervalInSeconds = sendInterval; }

        public void Configure(object target, List<string> names)
        {
            _target = target; var ms = new List<MemberInfo>(); var ts = new List<Type>();
            if (target != null) foreach (var n in names)
            {
                var t = target.GetType();
                var f = t.GetField(n, BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (f != null) { ms.Add(f); ts.Add(f.FieldType); continue; }
                var p = t.GetProperty(n, BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (p != null && p.CanRead && p.CanWrite) { ms.Add(p); ts.Add(p.PropertyType); continue; }
                Debug.LogError($"NetworkReflection: {t.Name} has no field/property {n}");
            }
            _members = ms.ToArray(); _types = ts.ToArray(); _last = new object[_members.Length]; _changed = new bool[_members.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < _members.Length; i++) _last[i] = Get(i);
        }

        object Get(int i) => _members[i] is FieldInfo f ? f.GetValue(_target) : ((PropertyInfo)_members[i]).GetValue(_target);
        void Set(int i, object v) { if (_members[i] is FieldInfo f) f.SetValue(_target, v); else ((PropertyInfo)_members[i]).SetValue(_target, v); }

        /// <summary>Controller: compare the live members with the last sent values.</summary>
        public void Sample()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _members.Length; i++)
            {
                var v = Get(i);
                if (!Equals(v, _last[i])) { _last[i] = v; _changed[i] = true; isDirty = true; }
            }
        }

        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) { for (int i = 0; i < _members.Length; i++) NetSerializer.Write(w, Get(i), _types[i]); }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) { for (int i = 0; i < _members.Length; i++) { var v = NetSerializer.Read(r, _types[i]); _last[i] = v; Set(i, v); onChanged?.Invoke(i); } }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _members.Length; i++) { w.WriteBool(_changed[i]); if (_changed[i]) { NetSerializer.Write(w, _last[i], _types[i]); _changed[i] = false; } }
        }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _members.Length; i++) if (r.ReadBool()) { var v = NetSerializer.Read(r, _types[i]); _last[i] = v; Set(i, v); onChanged?.Invoke(i); }
        }
    }
}

// NetworkTransform for a Rigidbody: the controller simulates and also sends velocities; remote
// copies are kinematic, interpolate like NetworkTransform and extrapolate with the last velocity
// while the next sample has not arrived.
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    [RequireComponent(typeof(Rigidbody))]
    public class NetworkRigidbody : NetworkTransform
    {
        public SyncVar<Vector3> velocity = new SyncVar<Vector3>(default, 0f, ownerAuth: true);
        public SyncVar<Vector3> angularVelocity = new SyncVar<Vector3>(default, 0f, ownerAuth: true);
        [Tooltip("Remote copies extrapolate with the last velocity for at most this many ticks.")] public float maxExtrapolationTicks = 3f;

        Rigidbody _rb;

        protected override void Awake() { base.Awake(); _rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody>(); }
        protected override void OnBeforeBind() { base.OnBeforeBind(); if (_rb == null) _rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody>(); }

        protected override void OnSpawned(bool asServer)
        {
            if (_rb == null) _rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
            base.OnSpawned(asServer);
            if (!isController && _rb != null) _rb.isKinematic = true;
        }

        protected override void OnOwnerChanged(PlayerID? o, PlayerID? n)
        {
            if (_rb != null && isSpawned) _rb.isKinematic = !isController;
        }

        public override void OnTick(uint tick)
        {
            base.OnTick(tick);
            if (isController && _rb != null) { velocity.value = _rb.velocity; angularVelocity.value = _rb.angularVelocity; }
        }

        protected override void Apply(Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot, Vector3 scale)
        {
            if (_rb == null) { base.Apply(pos, rot, scale); return; }
            var buf = sync.buffer;
            if (buf.Count > 0 && networkManager != null)
            {
                var last = buf[buf.Count - 1];
                float behind = (networkManager.serverTick - interpolationTicks) - last.tick;
                if (behind > 0) pos = last.pos + velocity.value * (Mathf.Min(behind, maxExtrapolationTicks) / Mathf.Max(1, networkManager.tickRate));
            }
            _rb.MovePosition(pos); _rb.MoveRotation(rot);
        }
    }
}
