`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/Components/NetworkTransform.cs`:

```cs
// Replicates position / rotation / scale of a networked object. The controller (owner when
// ownerAuth, else the server) samples the Transform every network tick and sends what changed
// (quantized); remote copies buffer the samples and interpolate `interpolationTicks` behind the
// newest one, snapping when the object teleported farther than `teleportDistance`.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public enum SyncMode : byte { No, Local, World }

    /// <summary>Module carrying one transform sample per tick; interpolation lives in <see cref="NetworkTransform"/>.</summary>
    public enum AdaptiveSyncLevel : byte { Off, Conservative, Balanced, Aggressive }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adaptive sync: the controller skips a send while receivers can reconstruct the motion from the last two samples
    /// (default: linear extrapolation) within the level's tolerance; <see cref="maxSendInterval"/> bounds how long a
    /// skip streak may last. Receivers use the same reconstruction when their buffer runs dry. Subclass and override
    /// <see cref="TryReconstruct"/> for other motion models; see <see cref="CompositeTransformSyncStrategy"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public class TransformSyncStrategy
    {
        public float maxSendInterval = 0.3f;
        public float positionTolerance = 0.02f, angleTolerance = 1f, scaleTolerance = 0.01f;

        public static TransformSyncStrategy For(AdaptiveSyncLevel level)
        {
            switch (level)
            {
                case AdaptiveSyncLevel.Conservative: return new TransformSyncStrategy { positionTolerance = 0.01f, angleTolerance = 0.5f, maxSendInterval = 0.2f };
                case AdaptiveSyncLevel.Balanced: return new TransformSyncStrategy();
                case AdaptiveSyncLevel.Aggressive: return new TransformSyncStrategy { positionTolerance = 0.08f, angleTolerance = 3f, maxSendInterval = 0.5f };
                default: return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Predict the sample at <paramref name="tick"/> given the two last known samples; false = cannot reconstruct.</summary>
        public virtual bool TryReconstruct(in TransformSync.Sample prev, in TransformSync.Sample from, float tick, out TransformSync.Sample result)
        {
            result = from;
            if (from.tick <= prev.tick) return false;
            float t = (tick - from.tick) / (from.tick - prev.tick);
            result.pos = from.pos + (from.pos - prev.pos) * t;
            result.rot = Quaternion.Slerp(prev.rot, from.rot, 1f + t);
            result.scale = from.scale + (from.scale - prev.scale) * t;
            result.tick = (uint)Math.Max(0, Math.Round(tick));
            return true;
        }

        public bool Within(in TransformSync.Sample predicted, in TransformSync.Sample actual, bool pos, bool rot, bool scale)
            => (!pos || Vector3.Distance(predicted.pos, actual.pos) <= positionTolerance) && (!rot || Quaternion.Angle(predicted.rot, actual.rot) <= angleTolerance) && (!scale || Vector3.Distance(predicted.scale, actual.scale) <= scaleTolerance);
    }

    /// <summary>Tries each strategy in order; the first that reconstructs wins.</summary>
    public class CompositeTransformSyncStrategy : TransformSyncStrategy
    {
        public TransformSyncStrategy[] strategies;
        public CompositeTransformSyncStrategy(params TransformSyncStrategy[] strategies) { this.strategies = strategies; }
        public override bool TryReconstruct(in TransformSync.Sample prev, in TransformSync.Sample from, float tick, out TransformSync.Sample result)
        {
            if (strategies != null) foreach (var st in strategies) if (st != null && st.TryReconstruct(prev, from, tick, out result)) return true;
            return base.TryReconstruct(prev, from, tick, out result);
        }
    }

    public sealed class TransformSync : NetworkModule
    {
        /// <summary>Adaptive sync strategy (null = send every change).</summary>
        public TransformSyncStrategy strategy;
        public float tickRate = 30f;
        public int sendsMade { get; private set; }
        public int sendsSkipped { get; private set; }
        Sample _prevSent; int _sentCount;
        public struct Sample { public uint tick; public Vector3 pos; public Quaternion rot; public Vector3 scale; public uint parent; }
        public Sample current;
        public bool syncPosition = true, syncRotation = true, syncScale, syncParent;
        public float positionResolution = 0.001f, positionRange = 8192f;
        public readonly List<Sample> buffer = new List<Sample>(16);
        public event System.Action<Sample> onSample;
        Sample _lastSent; bool _sentOnce;

        public TransformSync(bool ownerAuth = true, float sendInterval = 0f) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; sendIntervalInSeconds = sendInterval; }

        /// <summary>Controller side: record the current transform; marks dirty when something moved.</summary>
        public void Set(Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot, Vector3 scale, uint parent = 0)
        {
            current.pos = pos; current.rot = rot; current.scale = scale; current.parent = parent;
            bool changed = !_sentOnce || (syncPosition && pos != _lastSent.pos) || (syncRotation && Quaternion.Angle(rot, _lastSent.rot) > 0.01f) || (syncScale && scale != _lastSent.scale) || (syncParent && parent != _lastSent.parent);
            if (!changed) return;
            if (strategy != null && _sentCount >= 2 && parent == _lastSent.parent && current.tick > _lastSent.tick && (current.tick - _lastSent.tick) / Math.Max(1f, tickRate) < strategy.maxSendInterval
                && strategy.TryReconstruct(_prevSent, _lastSent, current.tick, out var predicted) && strategy.Within(predicted, current, syncPosition, syncRotation, syncScale))
            { sendsSkipped++; isDirty = false; return; }
            isDirty = true;
        }

        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) => WriteSample(w, current, true);
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) { ReadSample(r, ref current, true); buffer.Clear(); Push(current); }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) { WriteSample(w, current, false); _prevSent = _lastSent; _lastSent = current; _sentOnce = true; _sentCount++; sendsMade++; }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r) { ReadSample(r, ref current, false); current.tick = lastReceivedTick; Push(current); }

        void Push(Sample s)
        {
            if (buffer.Count > 0 && buffer[buffer.Count - 1].tick >= s.tick) buffer.RemoveAt(buffer.Count - 1);
            buffer.Add(s); while (buffer.Count > 16) buffer.RemoveAt(0);
            onSample?.Invoke(s);
        }

        void WriteSample(BitWriter w, in Sample s, bool full)
        {
            bool p = syncPosition && (full || s.pos != _lastSent.pos), q = syncRotation && (full || Quaternion.Angle(s.rot, _lastSent.rot) > 0.01f), sc = syncScale && (full || s.scale != _lastSent.scale);
            bool pa = syncParent && (full || s.parent != _lastSent.parent);
            w.WriteBool(p); w.WriteBool(q); w.WriteBool(sc); w.WriteBool(pa);
            if (pa) w.WriteBits(s.parent, 32);
            if (p) { w.WriteQuantized(s.pos.x, -positionRange, positionRange, positionResolution); w.WriteQuantized(s.pos.y, -positionRange, positionRange, positionResolution); w.WriteQuantized(s.pos.z, -positionRange, positionRange, positionResolution); }
            if (q) WriteQuat(w, s.rot);
            if (sc) { w.WriteF32(s.scale.x); w.WriteF32(s.scale.y); w.WriteF32(s.scale.z); }
        }

        void ReadSample(BitReader r, ref Sample s, bool full)
        {
            bool p = r.ReadBool(), q = r.ReadBool(), sc = r.ReadBool(), pa = r.ReadBool();
            if (pa) s.parent = (uint)r.ReadBits(32);
            if (p) s.pos = new Vector3(r.ReadQuantized(-positionRange, positionRange, positionResolution), r.ReadQuantized(-positionRange, positionRange, positionResolution), r.ReadQuantized(-positionRange, positionRange, positionResolution));
            if (q) s.rot = ReadQuat(r);
            if (sc) s.scale = new Vector3(r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32());
        }

        /// <summary>Smallest-three quaternion packing: 2 + 3×10 bits.</summary>
        public static void WriteQuat(BitWriter w, Quaternion q)
        {
            float[] c = { q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w }; int big = 0; for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++) if (Mathf.Abs(c[i]) > Mathf.Abs(c[big])) big = i;
            float sign = c[big] < 0 ? -1f : 1f; w.WriteBits((ulong)big, 2);
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (i != big) w.WriteQuantized(c[i] * sign, -0.7071068f, 0.7071068f, 0.0014f);
        }

        public static Quaternion ReadQuat(BitReader r)
        {
            int big = (int)r.ReadBits(2); float[] c = new float[4]; float sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (i != big) { c[i] = r.ReadQuantized(-0.7071068f, 0.7071068f, 0.0014f); sum += c[i] * c[i]; }
            c[big] = Mathf.Sqrt(Mathf.Max(0, 1 - sum));
            return new Quaternion(c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]);
        }
    }

    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    public class NetworkTransform : NetworkBehaviour
    {
        [Tooltip("Who drives the transform: the owner (true) or the server (false).")] public bool ownerAuth = true;
        public SyncMode syncPosition = SyncMode.World, syncRotation = SyncMode.World;
        public bool syncScale;
        [Tooltip("Adaptive sync: skip sends while receivers can reconstruct the motion (Off = send every change).")] public AdaptiveSyncLevel adaptiveSync = AdaptiveSyncLevel.Off;
        [Tooltip("Replicate the parent NetworkIdentity: remotes re-parent and the pose is sent in the parent's local space while attached.")] public bool syncParent;
        /// <summary>Controller: the networked parent this object is attached to (null = none / a non-networked parent).</summary>
        public NetworkIdentity parentIdentity { get; private set; }
        [Tooltip("Sends per second from the controller (0 = every network tick).")] public float sendRate;
        [Tooltip("Remote copies render this many ticks behind the newest sample.")] public float interpolationTicks = 2f;
        [Tooltip("Snap instead of interpolating when the remote jumped farther than this.")] public float teleportDistance = 5f;
        public float positionResolution = 0.001f, positionRange = 8192f;

        public TransformSync sync;
        float _render; uint _newest;

        /// <summary>Latest replicated pose (remote copies) or the last sampled one (controller).</summary>
        public Vector3 latestPosition => sync.current.pos;
        public Quaternion latestRotation => sync.current.rot;

        protected virtual void Awake() => EnsureSync();
        protected override void OnBeforeBind() => EnsureSync();

        void EnsureSync()
        {
            if (sync != null) return;
            sync = new TransformSync(ownerAuth, sendRate > 0 ? 1f / sendRate : 0f) { syncPosition = syncPosition != SyncMode.No, syncRotation = syncRotation != SyncMode.No, syncScale = syncScale, syncParent = syncParent, strategy = TransformSyncStrategy.For(adaptiveSync), positionResolution = positionResolution, positionRange = positionRange };
            Sample();
            sync.onSample += s => { if (!isController && sync.buffer.Count > 1 && Vector3.Distance(sync.buffer[sync.buffer.Count - 2].pos, s.pos) > teleportDistance) { sync.buffer.RemoveRange(0, sync.buffer.Count - 1); _render = s.tick; } _newest = s.tick; };
        }

        protected override void OnSpawned(bool asServer)
        {
            if (isController) Sample(); else { Apply(sync.current.pos, sync.current.rot, sync.current.scale); _render = _newest = sync.current.tick; }
        }

        public override void OnTick(uint tick)
        {
            if (!isController) return;
            sync.current.tick = tick; if (networkManager != null) sync.tickRate = networkManager.tickRate; Sample();
        }

        /// <summary>Inject a custom adaptive sync strategy (null = the one for <see cref="adaptiveSync"/>).</summary>
        public void SetSyncStrategy(TransformSyncStrategy strategy) { EnsureSync(); sync.strategy = strategy ?? TransformSyncStrategy.For(adaptiveSync); }

        protected virtual void Update() => RenderUpdate(Time.unscaledDeltaTime);

        /// <summary>Per-frame work (called from Update): controller samples the transform, remotes interpolate.</summary>
        public void RenderUpdate(float dt)
        {
            if (!isSpawned) return;
            if (isController) { Sample(); return; }
            Interpolate(dt);
        }

        /// <summary>Controller: attach to another networked object (or detach with null); replicated when syncParent is on.</summary>
        public void SetParent(NetworkIdentity parent, bool worldPositionStays = true)
        {
            parentIdentity = parent;
            transform.SetParent(parent != null ? parent.transform : null, worldPositionStays);
            Sample();
        }

        bool attached => syncParent && parentIdentity != null;

        void Sample()
        {
            var t = transform;
            bool local = attached;
            sync.Set(syncPosition == SyncMode.Local || local ? t.localPosition : t.position, syncRotation == SyncMode.Local || local ? t.localRotation : t.rotation, t.localScale, attached ? parentIdentity.objectId : 0);
        }

        uint _appliedParent;

        protected virtual void Apply(Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot, Vector3 scale)
        {
            var t = transform;
            if (syncParent && sync.current.parent != _appliedParent)
            {
                _appliedParent = sync.current.parent;
                NetworkIdentity p = null;
                if (_appliedParent != 0 && networkManager != null && !networkManager.TryGetIdentity(_appliedParent, out p)) p = null;
                parentIdentity = p;
                t.SetParent(p != null ? p.transform : null, false);
            }
            bool local = syncParent && _appliedParent != 0;
            if (syncPosition == SyncMode.World && !local) t.position = pos; else if (syncPosition != SyncMode.No) t.localPosition = pos;
            if (syncRotation == SyncMode.World && !local) t.rotation = rot; else if (syncRotation != SyncMode.No) t.localRotation = rot;
            if (syncScale) t.localScale = scale;
        }

        void Interpolate(float dt)
        {
            var buf = sync.buffer; if (buf.Count == 0) return;
            float target = _newest - interpolationTicks;
            float hz = networkManager != null ? networkManager.tickRate : 30;
            _render += dt * hz;
            float maxAhead = sync.strategy != null ? Math.Max(1f, sync.strategy.maxSendInterval * hz) : 1f;   // adaptive sync: may run past the newest sample and extrapolate
            if (_render > target + maxAhead) _render = target + maxAhead; else if (_render < target - 4) _render = target - 4; // keep near the target, never run far ahead
            TransformSync.Sample a = buf[0], b = buf[buf.Count - 1];
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < buf.Count; i++) if (buf[i].tick <= _render && buf[i + 1].tick >= _render) { a = buf[i]; b = buf[i + 1]; break; }
            float t = b.tick > a.tick ? Mathf.Clamp01((_render - a.tick) / (b.tick - a.tick)) : 1f;
            if (_render >= b.tick) t = 1f;
            if (_render > b.tick && sync.strategy != null && buf.Count >= 2 && (_render - b.tick) / hz <= sync.strategy.maxSendInterval && sync.strategy.TryReconstruct(buf[buf.Count - 2], b, _render, out var ex))
            { Apply(ex.pos, ex.rot, ex.scale); return; }
            Apply(Vector3.Lerp(a.pos, b.pos, t), Quaternion.Slerp(a.rot, b.rot, t), Vector3.Lerp(a.scale, b.scale, t));
        }

        /// <summary>Controller: move instantly on every peer (no interpolation across the jump).</summary>
        public void Teleport(Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)
        {
            transform.position = pos; transform.rotation = rot; Sample();
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/Components/PlayerSpawner.cs`:

```cs
// Server-side helper: spawns one `playerPrefab` per player when they join (owner = that player) at
// the next spawn point, and, through NetworkIdentity.despawnOnOwnerDisconnect, lets it go when
// they leave. Put it next to the NetworkManager.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Transports;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public class PlayerSpawner : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public NetworkManager manager;
        [Tooltip("Prefab (from NetworkManager.networkPrefabs) or its index when prefabId >= 0.")]
        public GameObject playerPrefab;
        public int prefabId = -1;
        [Tooltip("Spawn points used round-robin; empty = origin.")]
        public List<Transform> spawnPoints = new List<Transform>();
        [Tooltip("Also spawn an object for the host's own player.")]
        public bool spawnForHost = true;

        readonly Dictionary<PlayerID, NetworkIdentity> _spawned = new Dictionary<PlayerID, NetworkIdentity>();
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<PlayerID, NetworkIdentity> spawned => _spawned;
        int _next;

        void Awake() { if (manager == null) manager = GetComponent<NetworkManager>() ?? NetworkManager.main; }
        void OnEnable() => Attach(manager);
        void OnDisable() => Detach();

        public void Attach(NetworkManager m)
        {
            Detach(); manager = m; if (m == null) return;
            m.onServerState += OnServerState; m.onPlayerJoined += OnJoined; m.onPlayerLeft += OnLeft;
        }

        public void Detach()
        {
            if (manager == null) return;
            manager.onServerState -= OnServerState; manager.onPlayerJoined -= OnJoined; manager.onPlayerLeft -= OnLeft;
        }

        void OnServerState(BridgeState s)
        {
            if (s == BridgeState.Started && manager.isHost && spawnForHost && manager.localPlayer.HasValue) OnJoined(manager.localPlayer.Value);
            if (s == BridgeState.Stopped) _spawned.Clear();
        }

        void OnJoined(PlayerID p)
        {
            if (!manager.isServer || _spawned.ContainsKey(p)) return;
            int pid = prefabId >= 0 ? prefabId : manager.networkPrefabs.IndexOf(playerPrefab);
            if (pid < 0) { Debug.LogWarning("[AurixNet] PlayerSpawner: no player prefab"); return; }
            var id = manager.Spawn(pid, p);
            if (spawnPoints.Count > 0) { var sp = spawnPoints[_next++ % spawnPoints.Count]; id.transform.position = sp.position; id.transform.rotation = sp.rotation; foreach (var b in id.behaviours) if (b is NetworkTransform nt) nt.Teleport(sp.position, sp.rotation); }
            _spawned[p] = id;
        }

        void OnLeft(PlayerID p) => _spawned.Remove(p);
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/Components/StateMachine.cs`:

```cs
// Aurix Net Unity SDK — replicated state machine (PurrNet-style StateMachine / StateNode).
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    /// <summary>A state of a <see cref="StateMachine"/>. Add instances to <c>StateMachine.states</c>; order must match on every peer.</summary>
    public abstract class StateNode : NetworkBehaviour
    {
        public StateMachine machine { get; internal set; }
        public bool isCurrentState => machine != null && machine.currentStateNode == this;

        public virtual void Enter() { }
        public virtual void Enter(bool asServer) { }
        public virtual void StateUpdate() { }
        public virtual void StateUpdate(bool asServer) { }
        public virtual void Exit() { }
        public virtual void Exit(bool asServer) { }
        public virtual bool CanEnter() => true;
        public virtual bool CanExit() => true;

        internal virtual void EnterWithData(BitReader data, bool asServer) { Enter(); Enter(asServer); }
        internal virtual Type dataType => null;
    }

    /// <summary>A state that is entered with a payload of type <typeparamref name="T"/> (replicated to every peer and to late joiners).</summary>
    public abstract class StateNode<T> : StateNode
    {
        public T lastData { get; private set; }
        public virtual void Enter(T data) { }
        public virtual void Enter(T data, bool asServer) { }
        public virtual bool CanEnter(T data) => true;

        internal override Type dataType => typeof(T);
        internal override void EnterWithData(BitReader data, bool asServer)
        {
            lastData = data != null ? NetSerializer.Read<T>(data) : default;
            Enter(); Enter(asServer); Enter(lastData); Enter(lastData, asServer);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Replicated state machine: the controller (server, or owner when <c>ownerAuth</c>) switches states, every peer
    /// runs Enter/Exit on the matching node with the same payload, late joiners enter the current state.
    /// </summary>
    public class StateMachine : NetworkBehaviour
    {
        [Tooltip("Owner may switch states (otherwise only the server).")] public bool ownerAuth;
        public List<StateNode> states = new List<StateNode>();

        public event Action<StateNode, StateNode> onStateChanged;
        public int currentStateId => _sync == null ? -1 : _sync.value.id;
        public int previousStateId { get; private set; } = -1;
        public StateNode currentStateNode => currentStateId >= 0 && currentStateId < states.Count ? states[currentStateId] : null;
        public StateNode previousStateNode => previousStateId >= 0 && previousStateId < states.Count ? states[previousStateId] : null;

        public struct State : INetSerializable, IEquatable<State>
        {
            public int id; public uint seq; public byte[] data;
            public void Write(BitWriter w) { w.WriteBits((ulong)(id + 1), 16); w.WriteBits(seq, 32); w.WriteUInt((ulong)(data?.Length ?? 0), 16); if (data != null) w.WriteBytes(data); }
            public void Read(BitReader r) { id = (int)r.ReadBits(16) - 1; seq = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(16); data = n > 0 ? r.ReadBytes(n) : null; }
            public bool Equals(State o) => id == o.id && seq == o.seq;
        }

        SyncVar<State> _sync;
        int _applied = -1; uint _appliedSeq;

        protected override void OnBeforeBind()
        {
            _sync = new SyncVar<State>(new State { id = -1 }, 0f, ownerAuth);
            foreach (var s in states) if (s != null) s.machine = this;
            _sync.onChanged += _ => ApplyIncoming();
        }

        protected override void OnSpawned(bool asServer) { ApplyIncoming(); }

        public T GetState<T>() where T : StateNode { foreach (var s in states) if (s is T t) return t; return null; }
        public bool IsCurrentState<T>() where T : StateNode => currentStateNode is T;
        public bool IsCurrentState(StateNode s) => currentStateNode == s;

        /// <summary>Controller: switch to a state without payload.</summary>
        public bool SetState(StateNode state, bool force = false) => Switch(states.IndexOf(state), null, force);
        /// <summary>Controller: switch to a state with a payload.</summary>
        public bool SetState<T>(StateNode<T> state, T data, bool force = false)
        {
            if (!force && !state.CanEnter(data)) return false;
            var w = new BitWriter(); NetSerializer.Write(w, data, typeof(T));
            return Switch(states.IndexOf(state), w.Finish(), force);
        }
        /// <summary>Controller: go to the next state in the list (wraps around).</summary>
        public bool Next(bool force = false) => states.Count == 0 ? false : Switch((currentStateId + 1) % states.Count, null, force);
        public bool Next<T>(T data, bool force = false)
        {
            if (states.Count == 0) return false;
            int n = (currentStateId + 1) % states.Count;
            if (!(states[n] is StateNode<T> typed)) return false;
            return SetState(typed, data, force);
        }
        /// <summary>Controller: leave the current state (no state active).</summary>
        public bool Stop(bool force = false) => Switch(-1, null, force);

        bool Switch(int id, byte[] data, bool force)
        {
            if (!isSpawned || !isController) return false;
            if (id >= states.Count) return false;
            var cur = currentStateNode;
            if (!force && cur != null && !cur.CanExit()) return false;
            if (!force && id >= 0 && !states[id].CanEnter()) return false;
            _sync.value = new State { id = id, seq = _sync.value.seq + 1, data = data };
            ApplyIncoming();
            return true;
        }

        void ApplyIncoming()
        {
            if (_sync == null) return;
            var st = _sync.value;
            if (st.id == _applied && st.seq == _appliedSeq) return;
            bool asServer = isServer;
            var prev = _applied >= 0 && _applied < states.Count ? states[_applied] : null;
            if (prev != null) { prev.Exit(); prev.Exit(asServer); }
            previousStateId = _applied; _applied = st.id; _appliedSeq = st.seq;
            var next = currentStateNode;
            if (next != null) next.EnterWithData(st.data != null ? new BitReader(st.data) : null, asServer);
            onStateChanged?.Invoke(prev, next);
        }

        public override void OnTick(uint tick)
        {
            var cur = currentStateNode;
            if (cur != null) { cur.StateUpdate(); cur.StateUpdate(isServer); }
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/NetSerializer.cs`:

```cs
// Bit-level serializer for the gameplay framework: primitives, Unity math types, strings, byte
// arrays, enums, arrays/lists of those, PlayerID, NetworkIdentity references and INetSerializable.
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    /// <summary>A player in the room: the Aurix actor id.</summary>
    public readonly struct PlayerID : IEquatable<PlayerID>
    {
        public readonly ushort id;
        public PlayerID(ushort id) { this.id = id; }
        public bool Equals(PlayerID o) => id == o.id;
        public override bool Equals(object o) => o is PlayerID p && p.id == id;
        public override int GetHashCode() => id;
        public override string ToString() => "P" + id;
        public static bool operator ==(PlayerID a, PlayerID b) => a.id == b.id;
        public static bool operator !=(PlayerID a, PlayerID b) => a.id != b.id;
        public static implicit operator ushort(PlayerID p) => p.id;
    }

    /// <summary>Implement on your own structs/classes to send them through SyncVars and RPCs.</summary>
    public interface INetSerializable
    {
        void Write(BitWriter w);
        void Read(BitReader r);
    }

    public static class NetSerializer
    {
        public const int MaxString = 65535, MaxBytes = 1 << 20, MaxCount = 1 << 16;

        /// <summary>Resolver for NetworkIdentity references; set by the NetworkManager.</summary>
        public static Func<uint, NetworkIdentity> ResolveIdentity;

        public static void Write(BitWriter w, object v, Type t)
        {
            if (t.IsEnum) t = Enum.GetUnderlyingType(t);
            switch (Type.GetTypeCode(t))
            {
                case TypeCode.Boolean: w.WriteBool((bool)v); return;
                case TypeCode.Byte: w.WriteBits((byte)v, 8); return;
                case TypeCode.SByte: w.WriteBits((byte)(sbyte)v, 8); return;
                case TypeCode.Int16: w.WriteBits((ushort)(short)v, 16); return;
                case TypeCode.UInt16: w.WriteBits((ushort)v, 16); return;
                case TypeCode.Int32: w.WriteBits((uint)(int)v, 32); return;
                case TypeCode.UInt32: w.WriteBits((uint)v, 32); return;
                case TypeCode.Int64: w.WriteBits((ulong)(long)v, 64); return;
                case TypeCode.UInt64: w.WriteBits((ulong)v, 64); return;
                case TypeCode.Single: w.WriteF32((float)v); return;
                case TypeCode.Double: w.WriteBits((ulong)BitConverter.DoubleToInt64Bits((double)v), 64); return;
                case TypeCode.Char: w.WriteBits((char)v, 16); return;
                case TypeCode.String: WriteString(w, (string)v); return;
            }
            if (t == typeof(Vector2)) { var x = (Vector2)v; w.WriteF32(x.x); w.WriteF32(x.y); return; }
            if (t == typeof(Vector3)) { var x = (Vector3)v; w.WriteF32(x.x); w.WriteF32(x.y); w.WriteF32(x.z); return; }
            if (t == typeof(Quaternion)) { var q = (Quaternion)v; w.WriteF32(q.x); w.WriteF32(q.y); w.WriteF32(q.z); w.WriteF32(q.w); return; }
            if (t == typeof(Color)) { var c = (Color)v; w.WriteF32(c.r); w.WriteF32(c.g); w.WriteF32(c.b); w.WriteF32(c.a); return; }
            if (t == typeof(PlayerID)) { w.WriteBits(((PlayerID)v).id, 16); return; }
            if (t == typeof(byte[])) { var b = (byte[])v ?? Array.Empty<byte>(); w.WriteUInt((ulong)b.Length, 20); w.WriteBytes(b); return; }
            if (typeof(NetworkIdentity).IsAssignableFrom(t)) { var id = (NetworkIdentity)v; w.WriteBits(id != null && id.isSpawned ? id.objectId : 0u, 32); return; }
            if (typeof(INetSerializable).IsAssignableFrom(t))
            {
                bool has = v != null || t.IsValueType; w.WriteBool(has);
                if (has) ((INetSerializable)v).Write(w);
                return;
            }
            if (t.IsArray)
            {
                var a = (Array)v; var et = t.GetElementType();
                w.WriteUInt((ulong)(a?.Length ?? 0), 16);
                if (a != null) foreach (var e in a) Write(w, e, et);
                return;
            }
            if (t.IsGenericType && t.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(List<>))
            {
                var l = (IList)v; var et = t.GetGenericArguments()[0];
                w.WriteUInt((ulong)(l?.Count ?? 0), 16);
                if (l != null) foreach (var e in l) Write(w, e, et);
                return;
            }
            if (t.IsGenericType && t.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
            {
                bool has = v != null; w.WriteBool(has);
                if (has) Write(w, v, Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(t));
                return;
            }
            throw new NetException("cannot serialize " + t.FullName + " (implement INetSerializable)");
        }

        public static object Read(BitReader r, Type t)
        {
            var orig = t;
            if (t.IsEnum) t = Enum.GetUnderlyingType(t);
            object o = null;
            switch (Type.GetTypeCode(t))
            {
                case TypeCode.Boolean: o = r.ReadBool(); break;
                case TypeCode.Byte: o = (byte)r.ReadBits(8); break;
                case TypeCode.SByte: o = (sbyte)(byte)r.ReadBits(8); break;
                case TypeCode.Int16: o = (short)(ushort)r.ReadBits(16); break;
                case TypeCode.UInt16: o = (ushort)r.ReadBits(16); break;
                case TypeCode.Int32: o = (int)(uint)r.ReadBits(32); break;
                case TypeCode.UInt32: o = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); break;
                case TypeCode.Int64: o = (long)r.ReadBits(64); break;
                case TypeCode.UInt64: o = r.ReadBits(64); break;
                case TypeCode.Single: o = r.ReadF32(); break;
                case TypeCode.Double: o = BitConverter.Int64BitsToDouble((long)r.ReadBits(64)); break;
                case TypeCode.Char: o = (char)r.ReadBits(16); break;
                case TypeCode.String: o = ReadString(r); break;
            }
            if (o != null) return orig.IsEnum ? Enum.ToObject(orig, o) : o;
            if (t == typeof(Vector2)) return new Vector2(r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32());
            if (t == typeof(Vector3)) return new Vector3(r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32());
            if (t == typeof(Quaternion)) return new Quaternion(r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32());
            if (t == typeof(Color)) return new Color(r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32());
            if (t == typeof(PlayerID)) return new PlayerID((ushort)r.ReadBits(16));
            if (t == typeof(byte[])) { int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(20); if (n > MaxBytes) throw new NetException("byte[] too long"); return r.ReadBytes(n); }
            if (typeof(NetworkIdentity).IsAssignableFrom(t)) { uint id = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); return id == 0 ? null : ResolveIdentity?.Invoke(id); }
            if (typeof(INetSerializable).IsAssignableFrom(t))
            {
                if (!r.ReadBool()) return null;
                var s = (INetSerializable)Activator.CreateInstance(t); s.Read(r); return s;
            }
            if (t.IsArray)
            {
                int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(16); var et = t.GetElementType(); var a = Array.CreateInstance(et, n);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a.SetValue(Read(r, et), i);
                return a;
            }
            if (t.IsGenericType && t.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(List<>))
            {
                int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(16); var et = t.GetGenericArguments()[0]; var l = (IList)Activator.CreateInstance(t);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) l.Add(Read(r, et));
                return l;
            }
            if (t.IsGenericType && t.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
                return r.ReadBool() ? Read(r, Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(t)) : null;
            throw new NetException("cannot deserialize " + t.FullName + " (implement INetSerializable)");
        }

        public static void Write<T>(BitWriter w, T v) => Write(w, v, typeof(T));
        public static T Read<T>(BitReader r) => (T)Read(r, typeof(T));

        public static void WriteString(BitWriter w, string s)
        {
            var b = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s ?? "");
            if (b.Length > MaxString) throw new NetException("string too long");
            w.WriteUInt((ulong)b.Length, 16); w.WriteBytes(b);
        }

        public static string ReadString(BitReader r)
        {
            int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(16);
            return System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(r.ReadBytes(n));
        }

        public static bool AreEqual<T>(T a, T b) => EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(a, b);
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/NetworkBehaviour.cs`:

```cs
// Game logic on a networked object. Declare state as SyncVar<T>/SyncList<T>/SyncDictionary<K,V>
// fields and remote calls as methods marked [ServerRpc], [ObserversRpc] or [TargetRpc], invoked
// through Rpc(nameof(Method), args...) / RpcTo(player, nameof(Method), args...). Modules and RPC
// methods are bound by reflection in a deterministic order, so both peers must run the same build.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public enum RpcKind : byte { Server, Observers, Target }

    public abstract class RpcAttribute : Attribute
    {
        public abstract RpcKind kind { get; }
        public bool runLocally;
        public bool reliable = true;
        /// <summary>Deflate the argument payload when it pays off (see <see cref="RpcCodec"/>).</summary>
        public RpcCompression compression;
        /// <summary>Send only the difference from the previous call of this RPC to the same peer.</summary>
        public bool deltaPack;
    }

    /// <summary>Client → server. By default only the owner may call it.</summary>
    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method)]
    public sealed class ServerRpcAttribute : RpcAttribute
    {
        public override RpcKind kind => RpcKind.Server;
        public bool requireOwnership = true;
        public ServerRpcAttribute(bool requireOwnership = true, bool runLocally = false, bool reliable = true, RpcCompression compression = RpcCompression.None, bool deltaPack = false) { this.compression = compression; this.deltaPack = deltaPack; this.requireOwnership = requireOwnership; this.runLocally = runLocally; this.reliable = reliable; }
    }

    /// <summary>Server → every observer (late joiners get the last call when bufferLast is set).</summary>
    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method)]
    public sealed class ObserversRpcAttribute : RpcAttribute
    {
        public override RpcKind kind => RpcKind.Observers;
        public bool bufferLast, excludeOwner, excludeSender;
        public ObserversRpcAttribute(bool runLocally = true, bool bufferLast = false, bool excludeOwner = false, bool reliable = true, RpcCompression compression = RpcCompression.None, bool deltaPack = false) { this.compression = compression; this.deltaPack = deltaPack; this.runLocally = runLocally; this.bufferLast = bufferLast; this.excludeOwner = excludeOwner; this.reliable = reliable; }
    }

    /// <summary>Server → one player (RpcTo).</summary>
    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method)]
    public sealed class TargetRpcAttribute : RpcAttribute
    {
        public override RpcKind kind => RpcKind.Target;
        public bool bufferLast;
        public TargetRpcAttribute(bool runLocally = true, bool bufferLast = false, bool reliable = true, RpcCompression compression = RpcCompression.None, bool deltaPack = false) { this.compression = compression; this.deltaPack = deltaPack; this.runLocally = runLocally; this.bufferLast = bufferLast; this.reliable = reliable; }
    }

    /// <summary>Optional last parameter of an RPC method: who sent it.</summary>
    public readonly struct RpcInfo
    {
        public readonly PlayerID sender; public readonly bool asServer;
        public RpcInfo(PlayerID sender, bool asServer) { this.sender = sender; this.asServer = asServer; }
    }

    public sealed class RpcMethod
    {
        public MethodInfo method; public RpcAttribute attr; public Type[] paramTypes; public bool wantsInfo; public byte index;
        /// <summary>Woven assemblies: the original body, renamed to Method__Impl; invoked instead of <see cref="method"/> on receive.</summary>
        public MethodInfo impl;
    }

    public abstract class NetworkBehaviour : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public NetworkIdentity identity { get; private set; }
        public int componentIndex { get; private set; }
        public NetworkManager networkManager => identity?.networkManager;
        public bool isSpawned => identity != null && identity.isSpawned;
        public bool isServer => identity != null && identity.isServer;
        public bool isClient => identity != null && identity.isClient;
        public bool isHost => identity != null && identity.isHost;
        public bool isOwner => identity != null && identity.isOwner;
        public bool isController => identity != null && identity.isController;
        public PlayerID? owner => identity?.owner;
        public PlayerID? localPlayer => identity?.localPlayer;
        public uint objectId => identity?.objectId ?? 0;

        internal NetworkModule[] modules = Array.Empty<NetworkModule>();
        internal RpcMethod[] rpcs = Array.Empty<RpcMethod>();
        Dictionary<string, RpcMethod> _rpcByName;

        static readonly Dictionary<Type, (FieldInfo[] fields, RpcMethod[] rpcs)> _cache = new Dictionary<Type, (FieldInfo[], RpcMethod[])>();

        internal void Bind(NetworkIdentity id, int index)
        {
            identity = id; componentIndex = index;
            OnBeforeBind();
            var (fields, rpcList) = Reflect(GetType());
            modules = new NetworkModule[fields.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < fields.Length; i++)
            {
                var m = (NetworkModule)fields[i].GetValue(this);
                if (m == null) { m = (NetworkModule)Activator.CreateInstance(fields[i].FieldType); fields[i].SetValue(this, m); }
                m.Bind(this, i); modules[i] = m;
            }
            rpcs = rpcList; _rpcByName = rpcs.ToDictionary(r => r.method.Name);
        }

        static (FieldInfo[], RpcMethod[]) Reflect(Type t)
        {
            if (_cache.TryGetValue(t, out var c)) return c;
            var fields = new List<FieldInfo>();
            var methods = new List<RpcMethod>();
            for (var cur = t; cur != null && cur != typeof(NetworkBehaviour); cur = cur.BaseType)
            {
                const BindingFlags F = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
                fields.InsertRange(0, cur.GetFields(F).Where(f => typeof(NetworkModule).IsAssignableFrom(f.FieldType)).OrderBy(f => f.MetadataToken));
                foreach (var m in cur.GetMethods(F))
                {
                    var a = m.GetCustomAttribute<RpcAttribute>(); if (a == null) continue;
                    var ps = m.GetParameters();
                    bool info = ps.Length > 0 && ps[ps.Length - 1].ParameterType == typeof(RpcInfo);
                    var impl = cur.GetMethod(m.Name + ImplSuffix, F, null, ps.Select(p => p.ParameterType).ToArray(), null);
                    methods.Add(new RpcMethod { method = m, impl = impl, attr = a, wantsInfo = info, paramTypes = ps.Take(info ? ps.Length - 1 : ps.Length).Select(p => p.ParameterType).ToArray() });
                }
            }
            var ordered = methods.OrderBy(r => r.method.DeclaringType.FullName).ThenBy(r => r.method.Name).ThenBy(r => r.paramTypes.Length).ToArray();
            if (ordered.Length > 255) throw new NetException(t.Name + ": more than 255 RPC methods");
            for (int i = 0; i < ordered.Length; i++) ordered[i].index = (byte)i;
            var res = (fields.ToArray(), ordered);
            _cache[t] = res; return res;
        }

        internal void InternalSpawned(bool asServer) { foreach (var m in modules) m.OnSpawned(asServer); OnSpawned(asServer); }
        internal void InternalDespawned() { foreach (var m in modules) m.OnDespawned(); OnDespawned(); }
        internal void InternalOwnerChanged(PlayerID? o, PlayerID? n) { foreach (var m in modules) m.OnOwnerChanged(o, n); OnOwnerChanged(o, n); }

        /// <summary>Called right before modules are bound: create module instances that depend on inspector fields here.</summary>
        protected virtual void OnBeforeBind() { }
        /// <summary>Called once the object is live on this peer (state applied, owner known).</summary>
        protected virtual void OnSpawned(bool asServer) { }
        protected virtual void OnDespawned() { }
        protected virtual void OnOwnerChanged(PlayerID? oldOwner, PlayerID? newOwner) { }
        /// <summary>Called every network tick on the server and on clients.</summary>
        public virtual void OnTick(uint tick) { }

        /// <summary>Suffix the IL weaver gives the original body of an RPC method.</summary>
        public const string ImplSuffix = "__Impl";

        /// <summary>Call a [ServerRpc] or [ObserversRpc] method by name (reflection mode; woven assemblies call the method directly).</summary>
        protected void Rpc(string method, params object[] args) { var r = Find(method); if (networkManager != null && !networkManager.SendRpc(this, r, TargetOf(r, args), args)) InvokeRpcLocal(r, args, LocalInfo()); }
        /// <summary>Call a [TargetRpc] method on one player by name.</summary>
        protected void RpcTo(PlayerID target, string method, params object[] args) { var r = Find(method); if (networkManager != null && !networkManager.SendRpc(this, r, target, args)) InvokeRpcLocal(r, args, LocalInfo()); }

        /// <summary>Woven RPC prologue: routes the call; returns true when the body must not run here.</summary>
        protected bool __RpcSend(int index, object[] args)
        {
            if (index >= rpcs.Length || networkManager == null) return false;
            var r = rpcs[index];
            return networkManager.SendRpc(this, r, TargetOf(r, args), args);
        }

        /// <summary>Woven RPC prologue: the RpcInfo for a locally executed call.</summary>
        protected RpcInfo __LocalInfo() => LocalInfo();
        /// <summary>Woven prologue of generic RPCs: keeps the RpcInfo delivered by the network, otherwise the local caller's info.</summary>
        protected RpcInfo __LocalInfoOr(RpcInfo received) => _receivingRpc ? received : LocalInfo();

        [NonSerialized] bool _receivingRpc;
        /// <summary>Woven prologue of generic RPC methods: routes the call with its type arguments; false when the body should run (local / receiving).</summary>
        protected bool __RpcSendGeneric(int index, Type[] typeArgs, object[] args)
        {
            if (_receivingRpc || index >= rpcs.Length || networkManager == null) return false;
            var r = rpcs[index];
            return networkManager.SendRpc(this, r, TargetOf(r, args), args, typeArgs);
        }

        static string TypeName(Type t) => t.FullName + ", " + t.Assembly.GetName().Name;
        static Type ResolveType(string name) => Type.GetType(name, false) ?? throw new NetException("generic RPC: unknown type " + name);

        RpcInfo LocalInfo() => new RpcInfo(localPlayer ?? default, isServer);

        /// <summary>[TargetRpc] methods take the target player as their first parameter.</summary>
        static PlayerID? TargetOf(RpcMethod r, object[] args) => r.attr.kind == RpcKind.Target && args.Length > 0 && args[0] is PlayerID p ? p : (PlayerID?)null;

        RpcMethod Find(string name)
        {
            if (_rpcByName != null && _rpcByName.TryGetValue(name, out var r)) return r;
            throw new NetException($"{GetType().Name}: no RPC method '{name}' (mark it [ServerRpc]/[ObserversRpc]/[TargetRpc])");
        }

        internal void WriteArgs(BitWriter w, RpcMethod r, object[] args, Type[] typeArgs = null)
        {
            if (args.Length != r.paramTypes.Length) throw new NetException($"{GetType().Name}.{r.method.Name}: expected {r.paramTypes.Length} args, got {args.Length}");
            var types = r.paramTypes;
            if (r.method.IsGenericMethodDefinition)
            {
                if (typeArgs == null || typeArgs.Length != r.method.GetGenericArguments().Length) throw new NetException($"{GetType().Name}.{r.method.Name}: generic RPC needs its type arguments (is the assembly woven?)");
                w.WriteUInt((ulong)typeArgs.Length, 8); foreach (var t in typeArgs) NetSerializer.WriteString(w, TypeName(t));
                types = ClosedParamTypes(r.method.MakeGenericMethod(typeArgs), r.wantsInfo);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++) NetSerializer.Write(w, args[i], types[i]);
        }

        static Type[] ClosedParamTypes(MethodInfo closed, bool wantsInfo) { var ps = closed.GetParameters(); var n = wantsInfo ? ps.Length - 1 : ps.Length; var t = new Type[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) t[i] = ps[i].ParameterType; return t; }

        internal void InvokeRpc(RpcMethod r, BitReader reader, RpcInfo info)
        {
            var target = r.impl ?? r.method; var types = r.paramTypes;
            if (r.method.IsGenericMethodDefinition)
            {
                int n = (int)reader.ReadUInt(8); var targs = new Type[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) targs[i] = ResolveType(NetSerializer.ReadString(reader));
                target = target.MakeGenericMethod(targs); types = ClosedParamTypes(target, r.wantsInfo);
            }
            var args = new object[types.Length + (r.wantsInfo ? 1 : 0)];
            for (int i = 0; i < types.Length; i++) args[i] = NetSerializer.Read(reader, types[i]);
            if (r.wantsInfo) args[args.Length - 1] = info;
            bool guard = r.method.IsGenericMethodDefinition && r.impl == null;
            if (guard) _receivingRpc = true;
            try { target.Invoke(this, args); } finally { if (guard) _receivingRpc = false; }
        }

        internal void InvokeRpcLocal(RpcMethod r, object[] args, RpcInfo info)
        {
            var target = r.impl ?? r.method;
            if (!r.wantsInfo) { target.Invoke(this, args); return; }
            var a = new object[args.Length + 1]; Array.Copy(args, a, args.Length); a[args.Length] = info;
            target.Invoke(this, a);
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/NetworkIdentity.cs`:

```cs
// A networked object: one NetworkIdentity on the prefab root, any number of NetworkBehaviours
// below it. Spawned and despawned by the server (room host); ownership gives one player control
// of ownerAuth modules and the right to call ServerRpcs that require it.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    public class NetworkIdentity : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Tooltip("Behaviours replicated with this object, in the same order on every peer. Filled from children when empty.")]
        public List<NetworkBehaviour> behaviours = new List<NetworkBehaviour>();
        [Tooltip("Despawn this object when its owner leaves (otherwise ownership is just removed).")]
        public bool despawnOnOwnerDisconnect = true;

        [Tooltip("Non-zero for objects placed in the scene: the same id on host and clients binds them (set by the editor; see NetworkManager.RegisterSceneObject).")]
        public uint sceneId;

        public NetworkManager networkManager { get; private set; }
        public uint objectId { get; private set; }
        public int prefabId { get; private set; } = -1;
        public PlayerID? owner { get; private set; }
        public bool isSpawned { get; private set; }

        public bool isServer => isSpawned && networkManager.isServer;
        public bool isClient => isSpawned && networkManager.isClient;
        public bool isHost => isSpawned && networkManager.isHost;
        public bool hasOwner => owner.HasValue;
        public bool isOwner => isSpawned && networkManager.localPlayer.HasValue && owner == networkManager.localPlayer;
        /// <summary>The peer that drives this object: its owner when it has one, else the server.</summary>
        public bool isController => isSpawned && (hasOwner ? isOwner : isServer);
        public bool IsController(bool ownerHasAuthority) => ownerHasAuthority ? isController : isServer;
        public PlayerID? localPlayer => networkManager?.localPlayer;

        readonly HashSet<PlayerID> _observers = new HashSet<PlayerID>();
        /// <summary>Server: players holding a copy of this object (clients: empty).</summary>
        public IReadOnlyCollection<PlayerID> observers => _observers;
        /// <summary>Set when a <see cref="NetworkLOD"/> behaviour is attached; gates per-player delta sends.</summary>
        public NetworkLOD lod { get; internal set; }
        public bool IsObserver(PlayerID p) => _observers.Contains(p);
        internal bool AddObserver(PlayerID p) { if (!_observers.Add(p)) return false; onObserverAdded?.Invoke(p); return true; }
        internal bool RemoveObserver(PlayerID p) { if (!_observers.Remove(p)) return false; onObserverRemoved?.Invoke(p); return true; }
        internal void ClearObservers() => _observers.Clear();
        [Tooltip("Visibility rules on this object only (null = the manager's rules).")]
        public INetworkVisibilityRule visibilityRule;

        public event Action<PlayerID> onObserverAdded, onObserverRemoved;
        public event Action<PlayerID?, PlayerID?> onOwnerChanged;
        public event Action onSpawned, onDespawned;

        protected virtual void Awake() { if (behaviours.Count == 0) GetComponentsInChildren(true, behaviours); }

        internal void Setup(NetworkManager m, uint id, int prefab, PlayerID? own)
        {
            networkManager = m; objectId = id; prefabId = prefab; owner = own;
            if (behaviours.Count == 0) GetComponentsInChildren(true, behaviours);
            for (int i = 0; i < behaviours.Count; i++) behaviours[i].Bind(this, i);
        }

        internal void MarkSpawned(bool asServer)
        {
            isSpawned = true;
            foreach (var b in behaviours) b.InternalSpawned(asServer);
            onSpawned?.Invoke();
        }

        internal void MarkDespawned()
        {
            if (!isSpawned) return;
            isSpawned = false;
            foreach (var b in behaviours) b.InternalDespawned();
            onDespawned?.Invoke();
        }

        internal void SetOwner(PlayerID? o)
        {
            if (owner == o) return;
            var old = owner; owner = o;
            foreach (var b in behaviours) b.InternalOwnerChanged(old, o);
            onOwnerChanged?.Invoke(old, o);
        }

        /// <summary>Server only: hand the object to a player (null = server-controlled).</summary>
        public void GiveOwnership(PlayerID? player) => networkManager?.SetOwnership(this, player);
        public void RemoveOwnership() => GiveOwnership(null);
        /// <summary>Server only: remove the object everywhere.</summary>
        public void Despawn() => networkManager?.Despawn(this);

        public override string ToString() => $"{name}#{objectId}{(hasOwner ? " owner " + owner : "")}";
    }
}
```
