`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/NetworkManager.cs`:

```cs
// Host-authoritative gameplay framework over an Aurix relay room: the server (room master) spawns
// and despawns NetworkIdentities, owns the tick, replicates SyncVar/SyncList/SyncDictionary deltas
// and routes RPCs; clients hold mirrors. Peers are RelayBridge peers (PlayerID = actor id).
// One manager per scene; StartHost() (server + local player), StartServer() (headless) or StartClient().
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using Aurix.Net.Transports;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public interface INetworkObjectFactory
    {
        NetworkIdentity Instantiate(NetworkManager manager, int prefabId);
        void Destroy(NetworkIdentity identity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Factory whose prefabs may need loading first (Addressables, asset bundles). The manager keeps the spawn and every
    /// message for that object pending until <c>ready</c> is called, then applies them in order.
    /// </summary>
    public interface IAsyncNetworkObjectFactory : INetworkObjectFactory
    {
        /// <summary>Instantiate when the prefab is available; call <paramref name="ready"/> on the main thread (may be synchronous).</summary>
        void InstantiateAsync(NetworkManager manager, int prefabId, Action<NetworkIdentity> ready);
    }

    /// <summary>Default factory: Object.Instantiate of <see cref="NetworkManager.networkPrefabs"/>[prefabId].</summary>
    public sealed class PrefabFactory : INetworkObjectFactory
    {
        public NetworkIdentity Instantiate(NetworkManager m, int prefabId)
        {
            if (prefabId < 0 || prefabId >= m.networkPrefabs.Count || m.networkPrefabs[prefabId] == null) throw new NetException("unknown prefab id " + prefabId);
            var go = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(m.networkPrefabs[prefabId]);
            var id = go.GetComponent<NetworkIdentity>();
            if (id == null) throw new NetException(m.networkPrefabs[prefabId].name + " has no NetworkIdentity");
            return id;
        }
        public void Destroy(NetworkIdentity id) { if (id != null) UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(id.gameObject); }
    }

    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-100)]
    public sealed class NetworkManager : MonoBehaviour
    {
        enum Msg : byte { Hello = 1, Welcome, PlayerJoined, PlayerLeft, Spawn, Despawn, Owner, Sync, Rpc, ViewTick, ServerTick, StaticRpc, Ping, Pong }
        const byte Version = 1;

        [Header("Aurix Net")]
        public string httpUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:8090";
        public string grant = "";
        public string roomName = "game";
        public int maxPlayers = 16;
        public byte eventCode = 201;
        [Tooltip("Network ticks per second: state deltas are collected and sent at this rate.")]
        public int tickRate = 30;
        [Tooltip("Prefabs that can be spawned; prefabId is the index.")]
        public List<GameObject> networkPrefabs = new List<GameObject>();

        /// <summary>Async grant source; wins over the inspector field.</summary>
        public Func<Task<string>> GrantProvider;
        public enum AutoStart { None, Host, Server, Client, HeadlessServerElseClient }
        [Tooltip("Start a role in Start(): Host, Server (headless), Client, or Server when the build runs without graphics and Client otherwise.")]
        public AutoStart autoStart = AutoStart.None;

        [Tooltip("When the host leaves, the room's new master takes over as server with the world it holds; clients re-attach.")]
        public bool allowHostMigration = true;
        public event Action onPromotedToHost, onHostChanged;
        [Tooltip("StartAuto: room props to match exactly (JSON object), SQL-like lobby expression, and the props a hosted room is created with.")]
        public string matchFilterJson, matchExpr, roomPropsJson;
        [Tooltip("Remote objects are rendered this many ticks behind the newest server state; reported to the server for lag compensation (match NetworkTransform.interpolationTicks).")]
        public float viewDelayTicks = 2f;
        readonly Dictionary<PlayerID, uint> _viewTicks = new Dictionary<PlayerID, uint>();
        /// <summary>Server: the server tick this player is currently looking at (its latest known server tick minus its view delay).</summary>
        public uint ViewTickOf(PlayerID p) => _viewTicks.TryGetValue(p, out var t) ? t : serverTick;

        /// <summary>Server: rewinds every ColliderRollback to the tick <paramref name="shooter"/> was looking at, runs <paramref name="body"/>, restores.</summary>
        public void Rollback(PlayerID shooter, Action body) => Rollback(ViewTickOf(shooter), body);

        public void Rollback(uint tick, Action body)
        {
            if (!isServer) { body(); return; }
            var list = new List<ColliderRollback>();
            foreach (var id in _ids.Values) if (id.isSpawned) foreach (var b in id.behaviours) if (b is ColliderRollback cr) { cr.Rollback(tick); list.Add(cr); }
            try { body(); } finally { foreach (var cr in list) cr.Restore(); }
        }

        public INetworkObjectFactory factory = new PrefabFactory();
        /// <summary>Server: who sees what. Empty = everyone sees everything. All rules must agree (AND).</summary>
        public readonly List<INetworkVisibilityRule> visibilityRules = new List<INetworkVisibilityRule>();
        [Tooltip("Server: re-evaluate visibility rules every N network ticks (0 = only on spawn/join).")]
        public int visibilityIntervalTicks = 5;

        public static NetworkManager main { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>Static RPCs route through <see cref="main"/> (the first manager created, or the one set here).</summary>
        public static void SetMain(NetworkManager m) => main = m;

        public bool isServer { get; private set; }
        public bool isClient { get; private set; }
        public bool isHost => isServer && isClient;
        public bool isOffline => !isServer && !isClient;
        public PlayerID? localPlayer { get; private set; }
        public PlayerID? serverPlayer { get; private set; }
        public uint tick { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>Newest server tick seen (clients); equals <see cref="tick"/> on the server.</summary>
        public uint serverTick { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>Ping/jitter/throughput of this manager's connection (per-player ping on the server).</summary>
        public readonly NetworkStatistics statistics = new NetworkStatistics();
        readonly System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch _clock = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
        public BridgeState serverState => _server?.State ?? BridgeState.Stopped;
        public BridgeState clientState => _client?.State ?? BridgeState.Stopped;
        public string lastError => _server?.LastError ?? _client?.LastError;

        readonly List<PlayerID> _players = new List<PlayerID>();
        public IReadOnlyList<PlayerID> players => _players;
        readonly Dictionary<uint, NetworkIdentity> _ids = new Dictionary<uint, NetworkIdentity>();
        public IEnumerable<NetworkIdentity> identities => _ids.Values;
        public bool TryGetIdentity(uint id, out NetworkIdentity ni) => _ids.TryGetValue(id, out ni);

        public event Action<BridgeState> onServerState, onClientState;
        public event Action<PlayerID> onPlayerJoined, onPlayerLeft;
        public event Action<NetworkIdentity> onSpawned, onDespawned;
        public event Action<string> onError;

        readonly Dictionary<uint, NetworkIdentity> _sceneObjects = new Dictionary<uint, NetworkIdentity>();
        /// <summary>Scene-placed identities by sceneId: spawned by the host on start, bound (not instantiated) on clients.</summary>
        public void RegisterSceneObject(NetworkIdentity id) { if (id != null && id.sceneId != 0) _sceneObjects[id.sceneId] = id; }

        RelayBridge _server, _client;
        uint _nextId = 1;
        float _accum;
        readonly List<byte> _toServer = new List<byte>();
        readonly Dictionary<int, List<byte>> _toClient = new Dictionary<int, List<byte>>();
        sealed class Buffered { public uint obj; public byte comp, method; public PlayerID? target; public bool excludeOwner; public byte[] body; }
        readonly List<Buffered> _buffered = new List<Buffered>();
        readonly RpcCodec _codec = new RpcCodec();
        readonly Dictionary<uint, List<(Msg kind, byte[] body)>> _pendingSpawns = new Dictionary<uint, List<(Msg, byte[])>>();
        public int pendingSpawnCount => _pendingSpawns.Count;
        static ulong RpcKey(NetworkIdentity id, NetworkBehaviour b, RpcMethod r) => ((ulong)id.objectId << 16) | ((ulong)b.componentIndex << 8) | r.index;
        static ulong RpcKey(uint obj, byte comp, byte method) => ((ulong)obj << 16) | ((ulong)comp << 8) | method;

        void Awake()
        {
            if (main == null) main = this;
#if UNITY_5_3_OR_NEWER
            foreach (var id in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<NetworkIdentity>(true)) RegisterSceneObject(id);
#endif
        }
        void Start()
        {
            switch (autoStart)
            {
                case AutoStart.Host: StartHost(); break;
                case AutoStart.Server: StartServer(); break;
                case AutoStart.Client: StartClient(); break;
                case AutoStart.HeadlessServerElseClient:
#if UNITY_SERVER
                    StartServer();
#else
                    if (SystemInfo.graphicsDeviceType == UnityEngine.Rendering.GraphicsDeviceType.Null) StartServer(); else StartClient();
#endif
                    break;
            }
        }

        void OnDestroy() { Stop(); if (main == this) main = null; }
        void Update() => NetworkUpdate(Time.unscaledDeltaTime);

        RelayBridge NewBridge() => new RelayBridge(new RelayBridgeSettings
        {
            HttpUrl = httpUrl, Grant = grant, GrantProvider = GrantProvider, RoomName = roomName, MaxPlayers = maxPlayers, EventCode = eventCode, AllowHostMigration = allowHostMigration, MatchFilterJson = matchFilterJson, MatchExpr = matchExpr, PropsJson = roomPropsJson
        });

        // ---- lifecycle ----
        public void StartHost() => StartServerInternal(true);
        public void StartServer() => StartServerInternal(false);

        void StartServerInternal(bool withLocalPlayer)
        {
            if (_server != null || _client != null) return;
            NetSerializer.ResolveIdentity = Resolve;
            var b = _server = NewBridge();
            b.OnState += s => { if (s == BridgeState.Started) ServerStarted(b, withLocalPlayer); onServerState?.Invoke(s); };
            WireServer(b);
            b.OnDisconnected += why => { if (why != BridgeLeave.Local) onError?.Invoke(b.LastError); Teardown(); };
            b.StartHost();
        }

        /// <summary>Quick match: joins a random open room (matchFilterJson / matchExpr) as a client, or hosts a fresh one with roomPropsJson when none exists.</summary>
        public void StartAuto()
        {
            if (_server != null || _client != null) return;
            NetSerializer.ResolveIdentity = Resolve;
            var b = NewBridge(); bool wired = false;
            b.OnState += s =>
            {
                if (s == BridgeState.Started && !wired)
                {
                    wired = true;
                    if (b.IsHost) { _server = b; WireServer(b); ServerStarted(b, true); }
                    else { _client = b; WireClient(b); ClientStarted(b); }
                }
                if (b.IsHost) onServerState?.Invoke(s); else onClientState?.Invoke(s);
            };
            b.OnDisconnected += why => { if (why != BridgeLeave.Local) onError?.Invoke(b.LastError); Teardown(); };
            b.StartAuto();
        }

        void ServerStarted(RelayBridge b, bool withLocalPlayer)
        {
            if (main == null || main == this || (!main.isServer && !main.isClient)) main = this;
            isServer = true; isClient = withLocalPlayer; localPlayer = serverPlayer = new PlayerID((ushort)b.LocalActor); if (withLocalPlayer) _players.Add(localPlayer.Value);
            foreach (var a in b.Peers) { var p = new PlayerID((ushort)a); if (!_players.Contains(p)) _players.Add(p); }
            foreach (var so in _sceneObjects.Values) SpawnExisting(so, -1, null);
        }

        void WireServer(RelayBridge b)
        {
            b.OnPeerJoined += a => { var p = new PlayerID((ushort)a); _players.Add(p); Broadcast(Msg.PlayerJoined, w => w.WriteBits(p.id, 16), except: a); onPlayerJoined?.Invoke(p); };
            b.OnPeerLeft += (a, why) => { var p = new PlayerID((ushort)a); _players.Remove(p); HandlePlayerLeft(p); Broadcast(Msg.PlayerLeft, w => w.WriteBits(p.id, 16)); onPlayerLeft?.Invoke(p); };
            b.OnData += (from, d, _) => HandleFrame(d, new PlayerID((ushort)from), true);
        }

        void ClientStarted(RelayBridge b)
        {
            if (main == null || main == this || (!main.isServer && !main.isClient)) main = this;
            isClient = true; localPlayer = new PlayerID((ushort)b.LocalActor); serverPlayer = new PlayerID((ushort)b.MasterActor);
            Send(-1, Msg.Hello, w => w.WriteBits(Version, 8));   // our data path is up: ask for the world
        }

        public void StartClient()
        {
            if (_server != null || _client != null) return;
            NetSerializer.ResolveIdentity = Resolve;
            var b = _client = NewBridge();
            b.OnState += s => { if (s == BridgeState.Started) ClientStarted(b); onClientState?.Invoke(s); };
            WireClient(b);
            b.OnDisconnected += why => { if (why != BridgeLeave.Local) onError?.Invoke(b.LastError); Teardown(); };
            b.StartClient();
        }

        void WireClient(RelayBridge b)
        {
            b.OnData += (from, d, _) => HandleFrame(d, new PlayerID((ushort)from), isServer);
            b.OnHostChanged += m => { serverPlayer = new PlayerID((ushort)m); Send(-1, Msg.Hello, w => w.WriteBits(Version, 8)); onHostChanged?.Invoke(); };
            b.OnPromoted += () =>
            {
                // we hold the objects we could see; they become the authoritative world
                _server = b; _client = null; isServer = true; serverPlayer = localPlayer;
                b.OnPeerJoined += a => { var p = new PlayerID((ushort)a); if (!_players.Contains(p)) _players.Add(p); Broadcast(Msg.PlayerJoined, w => w.WriteBits(p.id, 16), except: a); onPlayerJoined?.Invoke(p); };
                b.OnPeerLeft += (a, why) => { var p = new PlayerID((ushort)a); _players.Remove(p); HandlePlayerLeft(p); Broadcast(Msg.PlayerLeft, w => w.WriteBits(p.id, 16)); onPlayerLeft?.Invoke(p); };
                _players.Clear(); _players.Add(localPlayer.Value); foreach (var a in b.Peers) _players.Add(new PlayerID((ushort)a));
                uint max = 0; foreach (var id in _ids.Values) { id.ClearObservers(); if (id.objectId > max) max = id.objectId; }
                _nextId = max + 1; serverTick = tick;
                foreach (var id in _ids.Values) foreach (var bh in id.behaviours) foreach (var m in bh.modules) m.ClearDirty();
                onPromotedToHost?.Invoke();
            };
        }

        public void Stop()
        {
            var s = _server; var c = _client; _server = null; _client = null;
            s?.Stop(); c?.Stop();
            Teardown();
        }

        void Teardown()
        {
            foreach (var id in _ids.Values.ToArray()) { id.ClearObservers(); id.MarkDespawned(); onDespawned?.Invoke(id); if (id.sceneId == 0) factory.Destroy(id); }
            _ids.Clear(); _players.Clear(); _buffered.Clear(); _codec.Clear(); _pendingSpawns.Clear(); _toServer.Clear(); _toClient.Clear();
            isServer = false; isClient = false; localPlayer = null; serverPlayer = null; tick = 0; _nextId = 1;
            _server = null; _client = null;
        }

        NetworkIdentity Resolve(uint id) => _ids.TryGetValue(id, out var ni) ? ni : null;

        // ---- spawning (server) ----
        public NetworkIdentity Spawn(GameObject prefab, PlayerID? owner = null)
        {
            int pid = networkPrefabs.IndexOf(prefab);
            if (pid < 0) throw new NetException(prefab.name + " is not in networkPrefabs");
            return Spawn(pid, owner);
        }

        public NetworkIdentity Spawn(int prefabId, PlayerID? owner = null)
        {
            if (!isServer) throw new NetException("only the server spawns");
            return SpawnExisting(factory.Instantiate(this, prefabId), prefabId, owner);
        }

        /// <summary>Server: put an already instantiated identity (a prefab instance or a scene object) on the network.</summary>
        public NetworkIdentity SpawnExisting(NetworkIdentity id, int prefabId, PlayerID? owner)
        {
            if (!isServer) throw new NetException("only the server spawns");
            if (id.isSpawned) return id;
            id.Setup(this, _nextId++, prefabId, owner);
            _ids[id.objectId] = id;
            foreach (var b in id.behaviours) foreach (var m in b.modules) m.ClearDirty();
            id.MarkSpawned(true);
            foreach (var p in _players) if (p != localPlayer && CanSee(p, id)) { id.AddObserver(p); Send(p.id, Msg.Spawn, w => WriteSpawn(w, id)); }
            onSpawned?.Invoke(id);
            return id;
        }

        public void Despawn(NetworkIdentity id)
        {
            if (!isServer) { Debug.LogWarning("only the server despawns"); return; }
            if (id == null || !_ids.Remove(id.objectId)) return;
            foreach (var p in id.observers) Send(p.id, Msg.Despawn, w => w.WriteBits(id.objectId, 32));
            id.ClearObservers();
            _buffered.RemoveAll(x => x.obj == id.objectId);
            id.MarkDespawned(); onDespawned?.Invoke(id); if (id.sceneId == 0) factory.Destroy(id);
        }

        public void SetOwnership(NetworkIdentity id, PlayerID? player)
        {
            if (!isServer) { Debug.LogWarning("only the server changes ownership"); return; }
            if (id == null || !id.isSpawned || id.owner == player) return;
            if (player.HasValue && !_players.Contains(player.Value)) { Debug.LogWarning($"player {player} is not in the room"); return; }
            id.SetOwner(player);
            if (player.HasValue && player != localPlayer && !id.IsObserver(player.Value)) { id.AddObserver(player.Value); Send(player.Value.id, Msg.Spawn, w => WriteSpawn(w, id)); SendBuffered(player.Value, id); }
            else foreach (var p in id.observers) Send(p.id, Msg.Owner, w => { w.WriteBits(id.objectId, 32); WriteOwner(w, player); });
        }

        void HandlePlayerLeft(PlayerID p)
        {
            _viewTicks.Remove(p);
            _codec.ForgetPeer(p.id); statistics.RemovePlayer(p);
            foreach (var id in _ids.Values) id.RemoveObserver(p);
            foreach (var id in _ids.Values.Where(i => i.owner == p).ToArray())
            {
                if (id.despawnOnOwnerDisconnect) Despawn(id); else SetOwnership(id, null);
            }
        }

        void WriteSpawn(BitWriter w, NetworkIdentity id)
        {
            w.WriteBits(id.objectId, 32); w.WriteBits(id.sceneId, 32); w.WriteUInt((ulong)(id.prefabId < 0 ? 0xffff : id.prefabId), 16); WriteOwner(w, id.owner);
            w.WriteUInt((ulong)id.behaviours.Count, 8);
            foreach (var b in id.behaviours) { w.WriteUInt((ulong)b.modules.Length, 8); foreach (var m in b.modules) m.WriteFull(w); }
        }

        static void WriteOwner(BitWriter w, PlayerID? o) { w.WriteBool(o.HasValue); if (o.HasValue) w.WriteBits(o.Value.id, 16); }
        static PlayerID? ReadOwner(BitReader r) => r.ReadBool() ? new PlayerID((ushort)r.ReadBits(16)) : (PlayerID?)null;

        void SendWelcome(PlayerID p)
        {
            Send(p.id, Msg.Welcome, w =>
            {
                w.WriteBits(Version, 8); w.WriteBits(tick, 32); w.WriteBits(serverPlayer.Value.id, 16);
                w.WriteUInt((ulong)_players.Count, 16); foreach (var x in _players) w.WriteBits(x.id, 16);
            });
            foreach (var id in _ids.Values) if (CanSee(p, id)) { id.AddObserver(p); Send(p.id, Msg.Spawn, w => WriteSpawn(w, id)); SendBuffered(p, id); }
            foreach (var kv in _staticBuffered) { var sr = StaticRpcs.Find(kv.Key); if (sr != null) Send(p.id, Msg.StaticRpc, w => WriteStaticRpc(w, sr, kv.Value)); }
        }

        void SendBuffered(PlayerID p, NetworkIdentity id)
        {
            foreach (var b in _buffered)
            {
                if (b.obj != id.objectId) continue;
                if (b.target.HasValue && b.target.Value != p) continue;
                if (b.excludeOwner && id.owner == p) continue;
                var battr = b.comp < id.behaviours.Count && b.method < id.behaviours[b.comp].rpcs.Length ? id.behaviours[b.comp].rpcs[b.method].attr : null;
                var benc = battr != null ? _codec.Encode(RpcKey(b.obj, b.comp, b.method), p.id, battr, b.body) : b.body;
                Send(p.id, Msg.Rpc, w => { w.WriteBits(b.obj, 32); w.WriteBits(b.comp, 8); w.WriteBits(b.method, 8); w.WriteBits(serverPlayer.Value.id, 16); w.WriteUInt((ulong)benc.Length, 16); w.WriteBytes(benc); });
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Server: may this player hold a copy? Owner and the host's own player always may.</summary>
        public bool CanSee(PlayerID p, NetworkIdentity id)
        {
            if (p == localPlayer || id.owner == p) return true;
            if (id.visibilityRule != null) return id.visibilityRule.CanSee(p, id);
            foreach (var r in visibilityRules) if (!r.CanSee(p, id)) return false;
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>Server: re-run the rules now; spawns on players that gained sight, despawns on those that lost it.</summary>
        public void EvaluateVisibility()
        {
            if (!isServer) return;
            foreach (var id in _ids.Values.ToArray())
                foreach (var p in _players)
                {
                    if (p == localPlayer) continue;
                    bool see = CanSee(p, id), has = id.IsObserver(p);
                    if (see && !has) { id.AddObserver(p); Send(p.id, Msg.Spawn, w => WriteSpawn(w, id)); SendBuffered(p, id); }
                    else if (!see && has) { id.RemoveObserver(p); Send(p.id, Msg.Despawn, w => w.WriteBits(id.objectId, 32)); }
                }
        }

        // ---- tick ----
        /// <summary>Drives the network: pumps the link, runs ticks and flushes outgoing frames. Called from Update.</summary>
        public void NetworkUpdate(float dt)
        {
            bool connected = (isClient && _client != null && _client.State == BridgeState.Started) || (isServer && _server != null);
            statistics.SetConnected(connected);
            if (statistics.Update(dt) && isClient && !isServer && _client != null && _client.State == BridgeState.Started)
                Send(-1, Msg.Ping, w => { w.WriteBits((uint)_clock.ElapsedMilliseconds, 32); w.WriteBits((ulong)Math.Min(65535, Math.Max(0, statistics.ping)), 16); });
            _server?.Pump(); _client?.Pump();
            if (isOffline) { _server?.Flush(); _client?.Flush(); return; }
            _accum += dt; float step = 1f / Math.Max(1, tickRate);
            int n = 0;
            while (_accum >= step && n++ < 8) { _accum -= step; Tick(); }
            FlushFrames();
            _server?.Flush(); _client?.Flush();
        }

        void Tick()
        {
            tick++; if (isServer) serverTick = tick;
            if (isServer && _players.Count > (isClient ? 1 : 0)) Broadcast(Msg.ServerTick, w => w.WriteBits(tick, 32));   // clients learn the server clock even when nothing else changed
            if (isClient && !isServer && serverTick > 0 && _client != null && _client.State == BridgeState.Started)
            {
                uint vt = serverTick - (uint)Math.Min(serverTick, (uint)Math.Round(viewDelayTicks));
                Send(-1, Msg.ViewTick, w => w.WriteBits(vt, 32));
            }
            if (isServer && visibilityIntervalTicks > 0 && tick % (uint)visibilityIntervalTicks == 0 && (visibilityRules.Count > 0 || _ids.Values.Any(i => i.visibilityRule != null))) EvaluateVisibility();
            float now = tick * (1f / Math.Max(1, tickRate));
            foreach (var id in _ids.Values.ToArray())
            {
                if (!id.isSpawned) continue;
                foreach (var b in id.behaviours)
                {
                    for (int mi = 0; mi < b.modules.Length; mi++)
                    {
                        var m = b.modules[mi];
                        if (m.isController) m.OnBeforeSend();
                        if (!m.isDirty || !m.isController || now < m.nextSendTime) continue;
                        m.nextSendTime = now + m.sendIntervalInSeconds;
                        var body = new BitWriter(); m.WriteDelta(body); m.ClearDirty();
                        var bytes = body.Finish();
                        void Write(BitWriter w) { w.WriteBits(id.objectId, 32); w.WriteBits((ulong)b.componentIndex, 8); w.WriteBits((ulong)mi, 8); w.WriteBits(tick, 32); w.WriteUInt((ulong)bytes.Length, 16); w.WriteBytes(bytes); }
                        if (isServer && m.serverOnly) { m.ClearDirty(); continue; }
                        if (isServer) { if (m.ownerOnly && id.owner.HasValue) { if (id.owner != localPlayer) Send(id.owner.Value.id, Msg.Sync, Write); } else foreach (var p in id.observers) { if (id.lod != null && p != localPlayer && !id.lod.ShouldSendToPlayer(p, tick)) continue; Send(p.id, Msg.Sync, Write); } }
                        else Send(-1, Msg.Sync, Write);
                    }
                    b.OnTick(tick);
                }
            }
        }

        // ---- RPC ----
        /// <summary>Routes an RPC call. Returns true when the call was handled here (sent, buffered or refused)
        /// and the body must NOT run locally; false when the caller should execute the body.</summary>
        internal bool SendRpc(NetworkBehaviour b, RpcMethod r, PlayerID? target, object[] args, Type[] typeArgs = null)
        {
            if (!b.isSpawned) { Debug.LogWarning($"{b.GetType().Name}.{r.method.Name}: object not spawned"); return true; }
            var id = b.identity;
            switch (r.attr.kind)
            {
                case RpcKind.Server:
                {
                    var a = (ServerRpcAttribute)r.attr;
                    if (isServer) return false;
                    if (a.requireOwnership && !id.isOwner) { Debug.LogWarning($"{b.GetType().Name}.{r.method.Name}: ServerRpc requires ownership"); return true; }
                    var bytes = _codec.Encode(RpcKey(id, b, r), -1, a, Pack(b, r, args, typeArgs));
                    Send(-1, Msg.Rpc, w => WriteRpc(w, id, b, r, bytes));
                    return !a.runLocally;
                }
                case RpcKind.Observers:
                {
                    var a = (ObserversRpcAttribute)r.attr;
                    if (!isServer) { Debug.LogWarning($"{b.GetType().Name}.{r.method.Name}: ObserversRpc may only be called on the server"); return true; }
                    var bytes = Pack(b, r, args, typeArgs); var key = RpcKey(id, b, r);
                    foreach (var p in id.observers) { if (p == localPlayer || (a.excludeOwner && id.owner == p)) continue; var enc = _codec.Encode(key, p.id, a, bytes); Send(p.id, Msg.Rpc, w => WriteRpc(w, id, b, r, enc)); }
                    if (a.bufferLast) Buffer(id, b, r, null, a.excludeOwner, bytes);
                    return !(isClient && a.runLocally && !(a.excludeOwner && id.isOwner));
                }
                case RpcKind.Target:
                {
                    var a = (TargetRpcAttribute)r.attr;
                    if (!isServer) { Debug.LogWarning($"{b.GetType().Name}.{r.method.Name}: TargetRpc may only be called on the server"); return true; }
                    if (!target.HasValue) { Debug.LogWarning($"{b.GetType().Name}.{r.method.Name}: TargetRpc needs a target (first parameter PlayerID, or RpcTo)"); return true; }
                    var bytes = Pack(b, r, args, typeArgs);
                    if (a.bufferLast) Buffer(id, b, r, target, false, bytes);
                    if (target == localPlayer) return !(isClient && a.runLocally);
                    if (!id.IsObserver(target.Value)) { Debug.LogWarning($"{b.GetType().Name}.{r.method.Name}: {target} does not see this object"); return true; }
                    { var enc = _codec.Encode(RpcKey(id, b, r), target.Value.id, a, bytes); Send(target.Value.id, Msg.Rpc, w => WriteRpc(w, id, b, r, enc)); };
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        // ---- static RPCs (woven prologue calls these) ----
        /// <summary>Routes a static RPC through NetworkManager.main. Returns true when the body must NOT run locally.</summary>
        public static bool __StaticRpcSend(uint hash, object[] args)
        {
            var m = main; if (m == null || (!m.isServer && !m.isClient)) return false;
            var r = StaticRpcs.Find(hash); if (r == null) return false;
            return m.SendStaticRpc(r, args);
        }

        public static RpcInfo __StaticLocalInfo() => main == null ? default : new RpcInfo(main.localPlayer ?? default, main.isServer);

        bool SendStaticRpc(StaticRpcMethod r, object[] args)
        {
            string name = r.method.DeclaringType.Name + "." + r.method.Name;
            switch (r.attr.kind)
            {
                case RpcKind.Server:
                {
                    var a = (ServerRpcAttribute)r.attr;
                    if (isServer) return false;
                    var bytes = PackStatic(r, args);
                    Send(-1, Msg.StaticRpc, w => WriteStaticRpc(w, r, bytes));
                    return !a.runLocally;
                }
                case RpcKind.Observers:
                {
                    var a = (ObserversRpcAttribute)r.attr;
                    if (!isServer) { Debug.LogWarning($"{name}: ObserversRpc may only be called on the server"); return true; }
                    var bytes = PackStatic(r, args);
                    foreach (var p in _players) if (p != localPlayer) Send(p.id, Msg.StaticRpc, w => WriteStaticRpc(w, r, bytes));
                    if (a.bufferLast) _staticBuffered[r.hash] = bytes;
                    return !(isClient && a.runLocally);
                }
                case RpcKind.Target:
                {
                    var a = (TargetRpcAttribute)r.attr;
                    if (!isServer) { Debug.LogWarning($"{name}: TargetRpc may only be called on the server"); return true; }
                    if (!(args.Length > 0 && args[0] is PlayerID target)) { Debug.LogWarning($"{name}: TargetRpc needs a PlayerID first parameter"); return true; }
                    if (target == localPlayer) return !(isClient && a.runLocally);
                    if (!_players.Contains(target)) { Debug.LogWarning($"{name}: {target} is not in the room"); return true; }
                    var bytes = PackStatic(r, args);
                    Send(target.id, Msg.StaticRpc, w => WriteStaticRpc(w, r, bytes));
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        readonly Dictionary<uint, byte[]> _staticBuffered = new Dictionary<uint, byte[]>();
        static byte[] PackStatic(StaticRpcMethod r, object[] args) { var body = new BitWriter(); StaticRpcs.WriteArgs(body, r, args); return body.Finish(); }
        void WriteStaticRpc(BitWriter w, StaticRpcMethod r, byte[] bytes) { w.WriteBits(r.hash, 32); w.WriteBits(localPlayer?.id ?? 0, 16); w.WriteUInt((ulong)bytes.Length, 16); w.WriteBytes(bytes); }

        static byte[] Pack(NetworkBehaviour b, RpcMethod r, object[] args, Type[] typeArgs = null) { var body = new BitWriter(); b.WriteArgs(body, r, args, typeArgs); return body.Finish(); }
        void WriteRpc(BitWriter w, NetworkIdentity id, NetworkBehaviour b, RpcMethod r, byte[] bytes) { w.WriteBits(id.objectId, 32); w.WriteBits((ulong)b.componentIndex, 8); w.WriteBits(r.index, 8); w.WriteBits(localPlayer.Value.id, 16); w.WriteUInt((ulong)bytes.Length, 16); w.WriteBytes(bytes); }

        void Buffer(NetworkIdentity id, NetworkBehaviour b, RpcMethod r, PlayerID? target, bool excludeOwner, byte[] body)
        {
            _buffered.RemoveAll(x => x.obj == id.objectId && x.comp == b.componentIndex && x.method == r.index && x.target.Equals(target));
            _buffered.Add(new Buffered { obj = id.objectId, comp = (byte)b.componentIndex, method = r.index, target = target, excludeOwner = excludeOwner, body = body });
        }

        // ---- framing ----
        void Send(int actor, Msg kind, Action<BitWriter> write)
        {
            var w = new BitWriter(); write(w); var body = w.Finish();
            var buf = actor < 0 ? _toServer : (_toClient.TryGetValue(actor, out var l) ? l : (_toClient[actor] = new List<byte>()));
            buf.Add((byte)kind); buf.Add((byte)(body.Length >> 8)); buf.Add((byte)body.Length); buf.AddRange(body);
            statistics.CountOut(body.Length + 3);
        }

        void Broadcast(Msg kind, Action<BitWriter> write, int except = -1)
        {
            if (_server == null) return;
            foreach (var a in _server.Peers) if (a != except) Send(a, kind, write);
        }

        void FlushFrames()
        {
            if (_server != null)
            {
                foreach (var kv in _toClient) FlushBuffer(kv.Value, bytes => _server.SendTo(kv.Key, bytes, true));
            }
            if (_client != null) FlushBuffer(_toServer, bytes => _client.SendToHost(bytes, true));
        }

        static void FlushBuffer(List<byte> buf, Action<ArraySegment<byte>> send)
        {
            int mtu = RelayBridge.Mtu(true);
            int pos = 0;
            while (pos < buf.Count)
            {
                int end = pos;
                while (end < buf.Count)
                {
                    int len = 3 + ((buf[end + 1] << 8) | buf[end + 2]);
                    if (end + len - pos > mtu && end > pos) break;
                    end += len;
                }
                send(new ArraySegment<byte>(buf.GetRange(pos, end - pos).ToArray()));
                pos = end;
            }
            buf.Clear();
        }

        void HandleFrame(ArraySegment<byte> d, PlayerID from, bool asServer)
        {
            statistics.CountIn(d.Count);
            int pos = d.Offset, end = d.Offset + d.Count; var a = d.Array;
            while (pos + 3 <= end)
            {
                var kind = (Msg)a[pos]; int len = (a[pos + 1] << 8) | a[pos + 2]; pos += 3;
                if (pos + len > end) { Debug.LogWarning("[AurixNet] truncated frame"); return; }
                var body = new byte[len]; Array.Copy(a, pos, body, 0, len); pos += len;
                try
                {
                    if (!asServer && _pendingSpawns.Count > 0 && (kind == Msg.Owner || kind == Msg.Sync || kind == Msg.Rpc || kind == Msg.Despawn) && len >= 4 && _pendingSpawns.TryGetValue((uint)new BitReader(body).ReadBits(32), out var q)) { q.Add((kind, body)); continue; }
                    Handle(kind, new BitReader(body), from, asServer);
                }
                catch (Exception e) { Debug.LogWarning($"[AurixNet] {kind} from {from}: {e.Message}"); }
            }
        }

        void Handle(Msg kind, BitReader r, PlayerID from, bool asServer)
        {
            if (asServer)
            {
                switch (kind)
                {
                    case Msg.StaticRpc:
                    {
                        uint h = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); r.ReadBits(16); var bytes = r.ReadBytes((int)r.ReadUInt(16));
                        var sr = StaticRpcs.Find(h); if (sr == null || sr.attr.kind != RpcKind.Server) return;
                        StaticRpcs.Invoke(sr, new BitReader(bytes), new RpcInfo(from, true));
                        return;
                    }
                    case Msg.Ping: { uint t = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); int reported = (int)r.ReadBits(16); statistics.SetPlayerPing(from, reported); Send(from.id, Msg.Pong, w => w.WriteBits(t, 32)); return; }
                    case Msg.ViewTick: { uint vt = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); if (vt <= serverTick) _viewTicks[from] = vt; return; }
                    case Msg.Hello: if (r.ReadBits(8) == Version && _players.Contains(from)) SendWelcome(from); else Debug.LogWarning($"[AurixNet] hello from {from} with another protocol version"); return;
                    case Msg.Sync: { var (id, b, m) = ReadModuleRef(r); r.ReadBits(32); var bytes = r.ReadBytes((int)r.ReadUInt(16)); if (id == null || !m.ownerAuth || id.owner != from) return; m.lastReceivedTick = tick; bool accepted = m.ReadDeltaFromOwner(new BitReader(bytes)); m.ClearDirty();
                        if (!accepted) { var cw = new BitWriter(); m.WriteDelta(cw); var cb = cw.Finish(); Send(from.id, Msg.Sync, w => { w.WriteBits(id.objectId, 32); w.WriteBits((ulong)b.componentIndex, 8); w.WriteBits((ulong)m.index, 8); w.WriteBits(tick, 32); w.WriteUInt((ulong)cb.Length, 16); w.WriteBytes(cb); }); return; }
                        void Write(BitWriter w) { w.WriteBits(id.objectId, 32); w.WriteBits((ulong)b.componentIndex, 8); w.WriteBits((ulong)m.index, 8); w.WriteBits(tick, 32); w.WriteUInt((ulong)bytes.Length, 16); w.WriteBytes(bytes); }
                        if (!m.ownerOnly && !m.serverOnly) foreach (var p in id.observers) if (p != from) Send(p.id, Msg.Sync, Write); return; }
                    case Msg.Rpc:
                    {
                        var (id, b, _) = ReadModuleRef(r, module: false); byte mi = (byte)r.ReadBits(8); r.ReadBits(16); var bytes = r.ReadBytes((int)r.ReadUInt(16));
                        if (id == null || mi >= b.rpcs.Length) return;
                        var rm = b.rpcs[mi]; if (rm.attr.kind != RpcKind.Server) return;
                        bytes = _codec.Decode(RpcKey(id, b, rm), from.id, rm.attr, bytes);
                        if (((ServerRpcAttribute)rm.attr).requireOwnership && id.owner != from) { Debug.LogWarning($"[AurixNet] {b.GetType().Name}.{rm.method.Name} from non-owner {from}"); return; }
                        b.InvokeRpc(rm, new BitReader(bytes), new RpcInfo(from, true));
                        return;
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
            if (from != serverPlayer) return;
            switch (kind)
            {
                case Msg.Welcome:
                {
                    if (r.ReadBits(8) != Version) { onError?.Invoke("protocol version mismatch"); Stop(); return; }
                    tick = serverTick = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); r.ReadBits(16);
                    _players.Clear(); int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(16); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) _players.Add(new PlayerID((ushort)r.ReadBits(16)));
                    return;
                }
                case Msg.StaticRpc:
                {
                    uint h = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); var sender = new PlayerID((ushort)r.ReadBits(16)); var bytes = r.ReadBytes((int)r.ReadUInt(16));
                    var sr = StaticRpcs.Find(h); if (sr == null || sr.attr.kind == RpcKind.Server) return;
                    StaticRpcs.Invoke(sr, new BitReader(bytes), new RpcInfo(sender, false));
                    return;
                }
                case Msg.Pong: { uint t = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); statistics.RecordRtt((uint)_clock.ElapsedMilliseconds - t); return; }
                case Msg.ServerTick: { uint st = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); if (st > serverTick) serverTick = st; return; }
                case Msg.PlayerJoined: { var p = new PlayerID((ushort)r.ReadBits(16)); if (!_players.Contains(p)) _players.Add(p); onPlayerJoined?.Invoke(p); return; }
                case Msg.PlayerLeft: { var p = new PlayerID((ushort)r.ReadBits(16)); _players.Remove(p); onPlayerLeft?.Invoke(p); return; }
                case Msg.Spawn:
                {
                    uint oid = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); uint sid = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); int pid = (int)r.ReadUInt(16); if (pid == 0xffff) pid = -1; var owner = ReadOwner(r);
                    if (_ids.ContainsKey(oid)) return;
                    NetworkIdentity id;
                    void Finish(NetworkIdentity ni)
                    {
                        ni.Setup(this, oid, pid, owner); _ids[oid] = ni;
                        int nb = (int)r.ReadUInt(8);
                        for (int i = 0; i < nb; i++) { int nm = (int)r.ReadUInt(8); for (int j = 0; j < nm; j++) if (i < ni.behaviours.Count && j < ni.behaviours[i].modules.Length) { var mod = ni.behaviours[i].modules[j]; mod.lastReceivedTick = serverTick; mod.ReadFull(r); } }
                        foreach (var b in ni.behaviours) foreach (var m in b.modules) m.ClearDirty();
                        ni.MarkSpawned(false); onSpawned?.Invoke(ni);
                    }
                    if (sid != 0) { if (!_sceneObjects.TryGetValue(sid, out id)) { Debug.LogWarning($"[AurixNet] unknown scene object {sid}"); return; } Finish(id); return; }
                    if (factory is IAsyncNetworkObjectFactory af)
                    {
                        var queue = new List<(Msg, byte[])>(); _pendingSpawns[oid] = queue;
                        af.InstantiateAsync(this, pid, ni =>
                        {
                            if (!_pendingSpawns.Remove(oid)) { if (ni != null) factory.Destroy(ni); return; }   // stopped meanwhile
                            if (ni == null) { Debug.LogWarning($"[AurixNet] prefab {pid} failed to load; object {oid} dropped"); return; }
                            Finish(ni);
                            foreach (var (k, b) in queue) { try { Handle(k, new BitReader(b), from, false); } catch (Exception e) { Debug.LogWarning($"[AurixNet] deferred {k}: {e.Message}"); } }
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    id = factory.Instantiate(this, pid); Finish(id);
                    return;
                }
                case Msg.Despawn:
                {
                    uint oid = (uint)r.ReadBits(32);
                    if (_ids.TryGetValue(oid, out var id)) { _ids.Remove(oid); id.MarkDespawned(); onDespawned?.Invoke(id); if (id.sceneId == 0) factory.Destroy(id); }
                    return;
                }
                case Msg.Owner: { uint oid = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); var o = ReadOwner(r); if (_ids.TryGetValue(oid, out var id)) id.SetOwner(o); return; }
                case Msg.Sync: { var (id, _, m) = ReadModuleRef(r); uint st = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); var bytes = r.ReadBytes((int)r.ReadUInt(16)); if (st > serverTick) serverTick = st; if (id != null) { m.lastReceivedTick = st; m.ReadDelta(new BitReader(bytes)); m.ClearDirty(); } return; }
                case Msg.Rpc:
                {
                    var (id, b, _) = ReadModuleRef(r, module: false); byte mi = (byte)r.ReadBits(8); var sender = new PlayerID((ushort)r.ReadBits(16)); var bytes = r.ReadBytes((int)r.ReadUInt(16));
                    if (id == null || mi >= b.rpcs.Length) return;
                    var rm = b.rpcs[mi]; if (rm.attr.kind == RpcKind.Server) return;
                    bytes = _codec.Decode(RpcKey(id, b, rm), -1, rm.attr, bytes);
                    b.InvokeRpc(rm, new BitReader(bytes), new RpcInfo(sender, false));
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        (NetworkIdentity, NetworkBehaviour, NetworkModule) ReadModuleRef(BitReader r, bool module = true)
        {
            uint oid = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); int bi = (int)r.ReadBits(8); int mi = module ? (int)r.ReadBits(8) : -1;
            if (!_ids.TryGetValue(oid, out var id) || bi >= id.behaviours.Count) return (null, null, null);
            var b = id.behaviours[bi];
            if (module && mi >= b.modules.Length) return (null, null, null);
            return (id, b, module ? b.modules[mi] : null);
        }
    }
}

```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/NetworkModule.cs`:

```cs
// Synchronised state containers for NetworkBehaviours: SyncVar<T>, SyncList<T>, SyncDictionary<K,V>.
// The server (room host) is authoritative; a module with ownerAuth = true is written by the owner
// instead. Changes are collected once per network tick and sent as deltas; a spawn (or late join)
// carries the full state.
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public abstract class NetworkModule
    {
        public NetworkBehaviour behaviour { get; private set; }
        public NetworkIdentity identity => behaviour?.identity;
        public int index { get; private set; }
        public bool ownerAuth { get; protected set; }
        internal void SetAuthority(bool ownerAuth) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; }
        /// <summary>Owner-auth modules only: send to the owner and the server, not to other observers.</summary>
        public bool ownerOnly { get; protected set; }
        /// <summary>Owner-auth modules only: the server consumes the data and does not relay it to observers (inputs).</summary>
        public bool serverOnly { get; protected set; }
        public float sendIntervalInSeconds { get; set; }
        internal float nextSendTime;
        public bool isDirty { get; protected set; }
        /// <summary>Server tick of the delta being applied (set before ReadDelta/ReadFull).</summary>
        public uint lastReceivedTick { get; internal set; }

        /// <summary>True when the local side may write this module (server, or the owner for ownerAuth modules).</summary>
        public bool isController
        {
            get
            {
                var id = identity;
                if (id == null || !id.isSpawned) return true; // unspawned: local edits are the initial state
                return ownerAuth ? id.IsController(true) : id.isServer;
            }
        }

        internal void Bind(NetworkBehaviour b, int idx) { behaviour = b; index = idx; }
        internal void ClearDirty() { isDirty = false; }
        /// <summary>Server side: an owner-authoritative delta arrived. Return false to reject it; the server then sends its own state back to the owner and nothing to observers.</summary>
        public virtual bool ReadDeltaFromOwner(BitReader r) { ReadDelta(r); return true; }
        /// <summary>Called by the manager each tick before the dirty check (controller side).</summary>
        public virtual void OnBeforeSend() { }

        public void SetDirty()
        {
            if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !isController) { Debug.LogWarning($"{behaviour.GetType().Name}.{GetType().Name}: only the {(ownerAuth ? "owner" : "server")} may write it"); return; }
            isDirty = true;
        }

        public abstract void WriteFull(BitWriter w);
        public abstract void ReadFull(BitReader r);
        public abstract void WriteDelta(BitWriter w);
        public abstract void ReadDelta(BitReader r);
        public virtual void OnOwnerChanged(PlayerID? oldOwner, PlayerID? newOwner) { }
        public virtual void OnSpawned(bool asServer) { }
        public virtual void OnDespawned() { }
    }

    public sealed class SyncVar<T> : NetworkModule
    {
        T _value;
        public event Action<T> onChanged;
        public delegate void ActionWithOld(T oldValue, T newValue);
        public event ActionWithOld onChangedWithOld;

        public SyncVar(T initialValue = default, float sendIntervalInSeconds = 0f, bool ownerAuth = false, bool ownerOnly = false)
        {
            _value = initialValue; this.sendIntervalInSeconds = sendIntervalInSeconds; this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; this.ownerOnly = ownerOnly;
        }

        public T value
        {
            get => _value;
            set
            {
                if (NetSerializer.AreEqual(_value, value)) return;
                if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !isController) { Debug.LogWarning($"{behaviour.GetType().Name}.SyncVar<{typeof(T).Name}>: only the {(ownerAuth ? "owner" : "server")} may write it"); return; }
                var old = _value; _value = value; isDirty = true;
                onChanged?.Invoke(value); onChangedWithOld?.Invoke(old, value);
            }
        }

        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) => NetSerializer.Write(w, _value, typeof(T));
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) => Apply((T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)));
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) => WriteFull(w);
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r) => ReadFull(r);

        void Apply(T v)
        {
            if (NetSerializer.AreEqual(_value, v)) return;
            var old = _value; _value = v;
            onChanged?.Invoke(v); onChangedWithOld?.Invoke(old, v);
        }

        public static implicit operator T(SyncVar<T> s) => s._value;
        public override string ToString() => _value?.ToString() ?? "null";
    }

    public enum SyncListOperation : byte { Added, Removed, Inserted, Set, Cleared }

    public readonly struct SyncListChange<T>
    {
        public readonly SyncListOperation operation; public readonly T value; public readonly T oldValue; public readonly int index;
        public SyncListChange(SyncListOperation op, T value, T oldValue, int index) { operation = op; this.value = value; this.oldValue = oldValue; this.index = index; }
        public override string ToString() => $"{operation} [{index}] {value}";
    }

    public sealed class SyncList<T> : NetworkModule, IList<T>, IReadOnlyList<T>
    {
        readonly List<T> _list = new List<T>();
        readonly List<SyncListChange<T>> _pending = new List<SyncListChange<T>>();
        public event Action<SyncListChange<T>> onChanged;

        public SyncList(bool ownerAuth = false, bool ownerOnly = false) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; this.ownerOnly = ownerOnly; }

        public int Count => _list.Count;
        public bool IsReadOnly => false;
        public List<T> ToList() => new List<T>(_list);

        public T this[int i]
        {
            get => _list[i];
            set { if (!Allowed()) return; var old = _list[i]; _list[i] = value; Record(new SyncListChange<T>(SyncListOperation.Set, value, old, i)); }
        }

        public void Add(T item) { if (!Allowed()) return; _list.Add(item); Record(new SyncListChange<T>(SyncListOperation.Added, item, default, _list.Count - 1)); }
        public void Insert(int i, T item) { if (!Allowed()) return; _list.Insert(i, item); Record(new SyncListChange<T>(SyncListOperation.Inserted, item, default, i)); }
        public bool Remove(T item) { int i = _list.IndexOf(item); if (i < 0) return false; RemoveAt(i); return true; }
        public void RemoveAt(int i) { if (!Allowed()) return; var old = _list[i]; _list.RemoveAt(i); Record(new SyncListChange<T>(SyncListOperation.Removed, default, old, i)); }
        public void Clear() { if (!Allowed()) return; _list.Clear(); Record(new SyncListChange<T>(SyncListOperation.Cleared, default, default, 0)); }
        public bool Contains(T item) => _list.Contains(item);
        public int IndexOf(T item) => _list.IndexOf(item);
        public void CopyTo(T[] a, int i) => _list.CopyTo(a, i);
        public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator() => _list.GetEnumerator();
        IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator() => _list.GetEnumerator();

        bool Allowed()
        {
            if (identity == null || !identity.isSpawned || isController) return true;
            Debug.LogWarning($"{behaviour.GetType().Name}.SyncList<{typeof(T).Name}>: only the {(ownerAuth ? "owner" : "server")} may write it");
            return false;
        }

        void Record(SyncListChange<T> c)
        {
            if (c.operation == SyncListOperation.Cleared) _pending.Clear();
            if (_pending.Count >= 255) { _pending.Clear(); _pending.Add(new SyncListChange<T>(SyncListOperation.Cleared, default, default, -1)); }
            _pending.Add(c); isDirty = true; onChanged?.Invoke(c);
        }

        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w)
        {
            w.WriteUInt((ulong)_list.Count, 16);
            foreach (var x in _list) NetSerializer.Write(w, x, typeof(T));
        }

        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r)
        {
            _list.Clear(); _pending.Clear();
            int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(16);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) _list.Add((T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)));
            onChanged?.Invoke(new SyncListChange<T>(SyncListOperation.Cleared, default, default, -1));
        }

        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w)
        {
            // index -1 Cleared = "resend everything" marker after an overflow
            if (_pending.Count > 0 && _pending[0].operation == SyncListOperation.Cleared && _pending[0].index == -1)
            { w.WriteBits(0, 8); WriteFull(w); _pending.Clear(); return; }
            w.WriteBits((ulong)_pending.Count, 8);
            foreach (var c in _pending)
            {
                w.WriteBits((byte)c.operation, 3); w.WriteUInt((ulong)Math.Max(0, c.index), 16);
                if (c.operation == SyncListOperation.Added || c.operation == SyncListOperation.Inserted || c.operation == SyncListOperation.Set) NetSerializer.Write(w, c.value, typeof(T));
            }
            _pending.Clear();
        }

        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r)
        {
            int n = (int)r.ReadBits(8);
            if (n == 0) { ReadFull(r); return; }
            for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
            {
                var op = (SyncListOperation)r.ReadBits(3); int i = (int)r.ReadUInt(16);
                switch (op)
                {
                    case SyncListOperation.Added: { var v = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)); _list.Add(v); onChanged?.Invoke(new SyncListChange<T>(op, v, default, _list.Count - 1)); break; }
                    case SyncListOperation.Inserted: { var v = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)); i = Math.Min(i, _list.Count); _list.Insert(i, v); onChanged?.Invoke(new SyncListChange<T>(op, v, default, i)); break; }
                    case SyncListOperation.Set: { var v = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)); if (i < _list.Count) { var old = _list[i]; _list[i] = v; onChanged?.Invoke(new SyncListChange<T>(op, v, old, i)); } break; }
                    case SyncListOperation.Removed: { if (i < _list.Count) { var old = _list[i]; _list.RemoveAt(i); onChanged?.Invoke(new SyncListChange<T>(op, default, old, i)); } break; }
                    case SyncListOperation.Cleared: _list.Clear(); onChanged?.Invoke(new SyncListChange<T>(op, default, default, 0)); break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public enum SyncDictionaryOperation : byte { Set, Removed, Cleared }

    public readonly struct SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>
    {
        public readonly SyncDictionaryOperation operation; public readonly K key; public readonly V value;
        public SyncDictionaryChange(SyncDictionaryOperation op, K key, V value) { operation = op; this.key = key; this.value = value; }
    }

    public sealed class SyncDictionary<K, V> : NetworkModule, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<K, V>>
    {
        readonly Dictionary<K, V> _dict = new Dictionary<K, V>();
        readonly List<SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>> _pending = new List<SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>>();
        public event Action<SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>> onChanged;

        public SyncDictionary(bool ownerAuth = false, bool ownerOnly = false) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; this.ownerOnly = ownerOnly; }

        public int Count => _dict.Count;
        public IEnumerable<K> Keys => _dict.Keys;
        public IEnumerable<V> Values => _dict.Values;
        public bool ContainsKey(K k) => _dict.ContainsKey(k);
        public bool TryGetValue(K k, out V v) => _dict.TryGetValue(k, out v);
        public V this[K k] { get => _dict[k]; set => Set(k, value); }
        public void Add(K k, V v) => Set(k, v);

        public void Set(K k, V v)
        {
            if (!Allowed()) return;
            _dict[k] = v; Record(new SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>(SyncDictionaryOperation.Set, k, v));
        }

        public bool Remove(K k)
        {
            if (!Allowed() || !_dict.Remove(k)) return false;
            Record(new SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>(SyncDictionaryOperation.Removed, k, default)); return true;
        }

        public void Clear() { if (!Allowed()) return; _dict.Clear(); _pending.Clear(); Record(new SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>(SyncDictionaryOperation.Cleared, default, default)); }
        public IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<K, V>> GetEnumerator() => _dict.GetEnumerator();
        IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator() => _dict.GetEnumerator();

        bool Allowed()
        {
            if (identity == null || !identity.isSpawned || isController) return true;
            Debug.LogWarning($"{behaviour.GetType().Name}.SyncDictionary: only the {(ownerAuth ? "owner" : "server")} may write it");
            return false;
        }

        void Record(SyncDictionaryChange<K, V> c) { if (_pending.Count >= 255) { _pending.Clear(); _pending.Add(new SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>(SyncDictionaryOperation.Cleared, default, default)); foreach (var kv in _dict) _pending.Add(new SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>(SyncDictionaryOperation.Set, kv.Key, kv.Value)); } else _pending.Add(c); isDirty = true; onChanged?.Invoke(c); }

        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w)
        {
            w.WriteUInt((ulong)_dict.Count, 16);
            foreach (var kv in _dict) { NetSerializer.Write(w, kv.Key, typeof(K)); NetSerializer.Write(w, kv.Value, typeof(V)); }
        }

        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r)
        {
            _dict.Clear(); _pending.Clear();
            int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(16);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { var k = (K)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(K)); _dict[k] = (V)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(V)); }
            onChanged?.Invoke(new SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>(SyncDictionaryOperation.Cleared, default, default));
        }

        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w)
        {
            w.WriteBits((ulong)_pending.Count, 9);
            foreach (var c in _pending)
            {
                w.WriteBits((byte)c.operation, 2);
                if (c.operation != SyncDictionaryOperation.Cleared) NetSerializer.Write(w, c.key, typeof(K));
                if (c.operation == SyncDictionaryOperation.Set) NetSerializer.Write(w, c.value, typeof(V));
            }
            _pending.Clear();
        }

        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r)
        {
            int n = (int)r.ReadBits(9);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                var op = (SyncDictionaryOperation)r.ReadBits(2);
                switch (op)
                {
                    case SyncDictionaryOperation.Set: { var k = (K)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(K)); var v = (V)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(V)); _dict[k] = v; onChanged?.Invoke(new SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>(op, k, v)); break; }
                    case SyncDictionaryOperation.Removed: { var k = (K)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(K)); _dict.Remove(k); onChanged?.Invoke(new SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>(op, k, default)); break; }
                    case SyncDictionaryOperation.Cleared: _dict.Clear(); onChanged?.Invoke(new SyncDictionaryChange<K, V>(op, default, default)); break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/NetworkStatistics.cs`:

```cs
// Aurix Net Unity SDK — connection statistics (ping, jitter, throughput, stall detection).
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Per-manager network statistics, fed by <see cref="NetworkManager"/>: round-trip ping and jitter to the server
    /// (client side), per-player ping (server side), upload/download in bytes per second and messages per second,
    /// plus threshold events for high ping / jitter and a stalled connection.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class NetworkStatistics
    {
        public float pingIntervalSeconds = 0.33f;
        public int highPingMs = 150, highJitterMs = 50;
        public float stallSeconds = 2f;

        /// <summary>Smoothed round trip to the server in ms (client side; 0 on a pure server).</summary>
        public int ping { get; private set; }
        public int lastPing { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>Smoothed |rtt − mean| in ms.</summary>
        public int jitter { get; private set; }
        public bool hasPingEstimate { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>Bytes per second over the last completed one-second window.</summary>
        public float upload { get; private set; }
        public float download { get; private set; }
        public int messagesOutPerSecond { get; private set; }
        public int messagesInPerSecond { get; private set; }
        public long totalBytesOut { get; private set; }
        public long totalBytesIn { get; private set; }
        public bool isHighPing { get; private set; }
        public bool isHighJitter { get; private set; }
        public bool isConnectionStalled { get; private set; }
        public float secondsSinceLastReceived => _connected ? _sinceReceived : 0f;

        public event Action<bool, int> onHighPingChanged;
        public event Action<bool, int> onHighJitterChanged;
        public event Action<bool, float> onConnectionStalledChanged;
        public event Action<int> onPingUpdated;

        readonly Dictionary<PlayerID, int> _playerPing = new Dictionary<PlayerID, int>();
        /// <summary>Server side: the last ping a client reported.</summary>
        public int PingOf(PlayerID p) => _playerPing.TryGetValue(p, out var v) ? v : -1;
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<PlayerID, int> playerPings => _playerPing;

        float _window, _sinceReceived, _sincePing; long _winOut, _winIn; int _winMsgOut, _winMsgIn; float _meanRtt; bool _connected;

        internal void Reset() { _playerPing.Clear(); ping = jitter = lastPing = 0; hasPingEstimate = false; _meanRtt = 0; _sinceReceived = 0; isConnectionStalled = false; _connected = false; }
        internal void SetConnected(bool c) { _connected = c; if (!c) { isConnectionStalled = false; _sinceReceived = 0; } }
        internal void CountOut(int bytes) { _winOut += bytes; _winMsgOut++; totalBytesOut += bytes; }
        internal void CountIn(int bytes) { _winIn += bytes; _winMsgIn++; totalBytesIn += bytes; _sinceReceived = 0; if (isConnectionStalled) { isConnectionStalled = false; onConnectionStalledChanged?.Invoke(false, 0f); } }
        internal void SetPlayerPing(PlayerID p, int ms) => _playerPing[p] = ms;
        internal void RemovePlayer(PlayerID p) => _playerPing.Remove(p);

        /// <summary>Returns true when a ping should be sent now.</summary>
        internal bool Update(float dt)
        {
            _window += dt; _sinceReceived += dt; _sincePing += dt;
            if (_window >= 1f)
            {
                upload = _winOut / _window; download = _winIn / _window; messagesOutPerSecond = (int)(_winMsgOut / _window); messagesInPerSecond = (int)(_winMsgIn / _window);
                _window = 0; _winOut = _winIn = 0; _winMsgOut = _winMsgIn = 0;
            }
            if (_connected && !isConnectionStalled && _sinceReceived > stallSeconds) { isConnectionStalled = true; onConnectionStalledChanged?.Invoke(true, _sinceReceived); }
            if (_sincePing >= pingIntervalSeconds) { _sincePing = 0; return true; }
            return false;
        }

        internal void RecordRtt(float rttMs)
        {
            lastPing = (int)Math.Round(rttMs);
            if (!hasPingEstimate) { _meanRtt = rttMs; ping = lastPing; jitter = 0; hasPingEstimate = true; }
            else
            {
                float dev = Math.Abs(rttMs - _meanRtt);
                _meanRtt += (rttMs - _meanRtt) * 0.2f; ping = (int)Math.Round(_meanRtt);
                jitter = (int)Math.Round(jitter + (dev - jitter) * 0.2f);
            }
            onPingUpdated?.Invoke(ping);
            bool hp = ping > highPingMs; if (hp != isHighPing) { isHighPing = hp; onHighPingChanged?.Invoke(hp, ping); }
            bool hj = jitter > highJitterMs; if (hj != isHighJitter) { isHighJitter = hj; onHighJitterChanged?.Invoke(hj, jitter); }
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/NetworkVisibility.cs`:

```cs
// Interest management: on the server every spawned object has a set of observers (players that
// hold a copy). Rules decide who sees what; the manager re-evaluates them every
// visibilityIntervalTicks and spawns/despawns on the clients accordingly. Owners always see their
// own objects; the host's local player sees everything.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public interface INetworkVisibilityRule
    {
        bool CanSee(PlayerID player, NetworkIdentity target);
    }

    public sealed class AlwaysVisibleRule : INetworkVisibilityRule { public bool CanSee(PlayerID p, NetworkIdentity t) => true; }
    public sealed class NoVisibilityRule : INetworkVisibilityRule { public bool CanSee(PlayerID p, NetworkIdentity t) => false; }
    /// <summary>Only the owner (and the server) see the object.</summary>
    public sealed class OwnerOnlyRule : INetworkVisibilityRule { public bool CanSee(PlayerID p, NetworkIdentity t) => t.owner == p; }

    /// <summary>Visible when within <see cref="distance"/> of any object the player owns (its avatar).</summary>
    public sealed class DistanceRule : INetworkVisibilityRule
    {
        public float distance = 50f;
        readonly NetworkManager _m;
        public DistanceRule(NetworkManager m, float distance = 50f) { _m = m; this.distance = distance; }

        public bool CanSee(PlayerID p, NetworkIdentity t)
        {
            var tp = Position(t); float best = float.MaxValue;
            foreach (var id in _m.identities) if (id.owner == p) { float d = Vector3.Distance(Position(id), tp); if (d < best) best = d; }
            return best <= distance;
        }

        static Vector3 Position(NetworkIdentity id)
        {
            foreach (var b in id.behaviours) if (b is NetworkTransform nt && nt.sync != null) return nt.sync.current.pos;
            return id.transform.position;
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/Prediction/PredictedBehaviour.cs`:

```cs
// Client-side prediction with server reconciliation (PurrDiction-style API). Subclass with an INPUT
// and a STATE struct, implement Simulate(input, ref state, dt) deterministically from those alone:
//   owner    : samples input every tick (GetInput), simulates at once, keeps a history, sends inputs
//              to the server (redundantly), and on each verified state compares it with its own for
//              that tick — on a mismatch it rewinds and re-simulates the inputs after it;
//   server   : simulates the owner's input for each tick (repeats the last one when it is late),
//              sends the verified state to observers every stateSendInterval ticks;
//   observers: interpolate between verified states (UpdateView).
// Host-owned objects simulate on the server directly (no prediction needed).
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    /// <summary>Owner → server: a window of recent inputs, newest last (redundancy against loss).</summary>
    public sealed class InputStream<INPUT> : NetworkModule
    {
        public readonly List<(uint tick, INPUT input)> pending = new List<(uint, INPUT)>();
        public readonly Queue<(uint tick, INPUT input)> received = new Queue<(uint, INPUT)>();
        public int redundancy = 3;
        public InputStream() { ownerAuth = true; serverOnly = true; }
        public void Push(uint tick, INPUT input) { pending.Add((tick, input)); while (pending.Count > redundancy) pending.RemoveAt(0); isDirty = true; }
        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) => w.WriteBits(0, 4);
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) => r.ReadBits(4);
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w)
        {
            w.WriteBits((ulong)pending.Count, 4);
            foreach (var (t, i) in pending) { w.WriteBits(t, 32); NetSerializer.Write(w, i, typeof(INPUT)); }
        }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r)
        {
            int n = (int)r.ReadBits(4);
            for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) { uint t = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); var i = (INPUT)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(INPUT)); received.Enqueue((t, i)); }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Server → observers: the verified state at a tick.</summary>
    public sealed class VerifiedState<STATE> : NetworkModule
    {
        public uint tick; public STATE state; public bool has;
        public event Action<uint, STATE> onReceived;
        public void Set(uint t, STATE s) { tick = t; state = s; has = true; isDirty = true; }
        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) { w.WriteBool(has); if (has) { w.WriteBits(tick, 32); NetSerializer.Write(w, state, typeof(STATE)); } }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) { if (!r.ReadBool()) return; tick = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); state = (STATE)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(STATE)); has = true; onReceived?.Invoke(tick, state); }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) => WriteFull(w);
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r) => ReadFull(r);
    }

    public abstract class PredictedBehaviour<INPUT, STATE> : NetworkBehaviour where INPUT : struct where STATE : struct
    {
        [Tooltip("How many ticks ahead of the newest server tick the owner simulates (covers the round trip).")] public int inputLeadTicks = 3;
        [Tooltip("Server sends the verified state every N ticks.")] public int stateSendInterval = 1;
        [Tooltip("History kept on the owner for reconciliation.")] public int historyTicks = 128;

        public InputStream<INPUT> inputs;
        public VerifiedState<STATE> verified;

        /// <summary>Current simulated state: predicted on the owner, authoritative on the server, latest verified on observers.</summary>
        public STATE state;
        public uint currentTick { get; private set; }
        public int reconciliations { get; private set; }
        public int missedInputs { get; private set; }
        public uint lastVerifiedTick => verified != null && verified.has ? verified.tick : 0;

        readonly SortedDictionary<uint, (INPUT input, STATE after)> _history = new SortedDictionary<uint, (INPUT, STATE)>();
        INPUT _lastServerInput; bool _hasServerInput;
        readonly SortedDictionary<uint, INPUT> _serverInputs = new SortedDictionary<uint, INPUT>();
        STATE _viewFrom, _viewTo; uint _viewFromTick, _viewToTick; float _viewT; bool _viewInit;

        protected override void OnBeforeBind()
        {
            inputs ??= new InputStream<INPUT>();
            verified ??= new VerifiedState<STATE>();
            verified.onReceived += OnVerified;
        }

        protected override void OnSpawned(bool asServer)
        {
            if (isServer) { state = GetInitialState(); currentTick = networkManager.tick; verified.Set(currentTick, state); }
            else if (verified.has) { state = verified.state; currentTick = verified.tick; _viewFrom = _viewTo = state; _viewFromTick = _viewToTick = verified.tick; _viewInit = true; }
            else state = GetInitialState();
            SetUnityState(state);
        }

        // ---- to implement ----
        /// <summary>Owner: fill this tick's input (keys, aim…).</summary>
        protected virtual void GetInput(ref INPUT input) { }
        protected virtual INPUT GetDefaultInput() => default;
        /// <summary>Deterministic step: must depend only on input and state.</summary>
        protected abstract void Simulate(INPUT input, ref STATE state, float delta);
        protected virtual STATE GetInitialState() => default;
        /// <summary>Server: hook to apply authoritative changes (hits, knockback) before the step.</summary>
        protected virtual void ServerModifyState(ref STATE state) { }
        /// <summary>Push the state into the scene (transform, animator). Called for the owner after each step and for observers each frame.</summary>
        protected virtual void SetUnityState(STATE state) { }
        /// <summary>Observers: blend between verified states (default: step to the newer one).</summary>
        protected virtual STATE Interpolate(STATE from, STATE to, float t) => t < 1f ? from : to;
        protected virtual void UpdateView(STATE viewState, STATE? verifiedState) => SetUnityState(viewState);
        protected virtual bool StatesEqual(in STATE a, in STATE b) => EqualityComparer<STATE>.Default.Equals(a, b);
        protected virtual void OnReconciled(uint tick, in STATE predicted, in STATE verifiedState) { }

        // ---- tick ----
        public override void OnTick(uint tick)
        {
            if (!isSpawned) return;
            float dt = 1f / Math.Max(1, networkManager.tickRate);
            if (isServer) ServerTick(tick, dt);
            else if (isOwner) OwnerTick(dt);
        }

        void ServerTick(uint tick, float dt)
        {
            while (inputs.received.Count > 0) { var (t, i) = inputs.received.Dequeue(); if (t >= currentTick) _serverInputs[t] = i; }
            INPUT input;
            if (identity.hasOwner && !identity.isOwner)
            {
                if (_serverInputs.TryGetValue(tick, out var got)) { input = got; _lastServerInput = got; _hasServerInput = true; }
                else { input = _hasServerInput ? _lastServerInput : GetDefaultInput(); missedInputs++; }
                foreach (var k in new List<uint>(_serverInputs.Keys)) if (k <= tick) _serverInputs.Remove(k);
            }
            else { input = GetDefaultInput(); GetInput(ref input); }
            ServerModifyState(ref state);
            Simulate(input, ref state, dt);
            currentTick = tick;
            if (stateSendInterval <= 1 || tick % (uint)stateSendInterval == 0) verified.Set(tick, state);
            SetUnityState(state);
        }

        void OwnerTick(float dt)
        {
            uint target = networkManager.serverTick + (uint)Math.Max(0, inputLeadTicks);
            if (currentTick == 0 || target < currentTick) currentTick = target == 0 ? 1 : target;
            // advance at least one tick per local tick; catch up when the server moved further than expected
            uint until = Math.Max(currentTick + 1, target);
            int steps = 0;
            while (currentTick < until && steps++ < 8)
            {
                currentTick++;
                var input = GetDefaultInput(); GetInput(ref input);
                Simulate(input, ref state, dt);
                _history[currentTick] = (input, state);
                inputs.Push(currentTick, input);
            }
            while (_history.Count > historyTicks) _history.Remove(First(_history));
            SetUnityState(state);
        }

        static uint First(SortedDictionary<uint, (INPUT, STATE)> d) { foreach (var k in d.Keys) return k; return 0; }

        void OnVerified(uint tick, STATE server)
        {
            if (!isSpawned || isServer) return;
            if (!isOwner)
            {
                if (!_viewInit) { _viewFrom = _viewTo = server; _viewFromTick = _viewToTick = tick; _viewInit = true; }
                else { _viewFrom = Interpolate(_viewFrom, _viewTo, _viewT); _viewFromTick = _viewToTick; _viewTo = server; _viewToTick = tick; _viewT = 0f; }
                state = server; currentTick = tick;
                return;
            }
            if (!_history.TryGetValue(tick, out var h)) { if (tick > currentTick) { state = server; currentTick = tick; _history.Clear(); } return; }
            if (StatesEqual(h.after, server)) { foreach (var k in new List<uint>(_history.Keys)) if (k < tick) _history.Remove(k); return; }
            // mismatch: rewind to the server's state and replay the inputs after that tick
            reconciliations++;
            var predicted = h.after;
            state = server;
            float dt = 1f / Math.Max(1, networkManager.tickRate);
            foreach (var k in new List<uint>(_history.Keys))
            {
                if (k <= tick) { _history.Remove(k); continue; }
                var e = _history[k]; Simulate(e.input, ref state, dt); _history[k] = (e.input, state);
            }
            OnReconciled(tick, predicted, server);
            SetUnityState(state);
        }

        /// <summary>Observers: call every frame (Update) to advance the view between verified states.</summary>
        public void RenderUpdate(float dt)
        {
            if (!isSpawned || isServer || isOwner || !_viewInit) return;
            float span = Math.Max(1, (float)(_viewToTick - _viewFromTick)) / Math.Max(1, networkManager.tickRate);
            _viewT = Math.Min(1f, _viewT + dt / span);
            UpdateView(Interpolate(_viewFrom, _viewTo, _viewT), verified.has ? verified.state : (STATE?)null);
        }

        protected virtual void Update() => RenderUpdate(Time.unscaledDeltaTime);
    }
}
```
