`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/RpcCodec.cs`:

```cs
// Aurix Net Unity SDK — optional RPC payload packing: delta against the last call per peer, Deflate compression.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.IO.Compression;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public enum RpcCompression : byte { None, Fast, Balanced, Best }

    /// <summary>
    /// Packs RPC argument payloads when the attribute asks for it. Delta packing XORs the payload with the previous
    /// call of the same RPC to the same peer and run-length encodes the zeros (great for state-like RPCs that change a
    /// little each call); compression runs Deflate when it pays off. Both sides keep per-(RPC, peer) history; the first
    /// call to a peer is always sent whole so a receiver never lacks a base.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class RpcCodec
    {
        const byte FlagCompressed = 1, FlagDelta = 2;
        const int MinCompressBytes = 48;
        readonly Dictionary<(ulong key, int peer), byte[]> _sent = new Dictionary<(ulong, int), byte[]>(), _recv = new Dictionary<(ulong, int), byte[]>();

        public static bool Wants(RpcAttribute a) => a.compression != RpcCompression.None || a.deltaPack;
        public void Clear() { _sent.Clear(); _recv.Clear(); }
        public void ForgetPeer(int peer)
        {
            var ks = new List<(ulong, int)>(); foreach (var k in _sent.Keys) if (k.peer == peer) ks.Add(k); foreach (var k in ks) _sent.Remove(k);
            ks.Clear(); foreach (var k in _recv.Keys) if (k.peer == peer) ks.Add(k); foreach (var k in ks) _recv.Remove(k);
        }

        public byte[] Encode(ulong key, int peer, RpcAttribute a, byte[] raw)
        {
            if (!Wants(a)) return raw;
            byte flags = 0; var body = raw;
            if (a.deltaPack)
            {
                if (_sent.TryGetValue((key, peer), out var prev) && prev.Length == raw.Length) { body = RleZeros(Xor(raw, prev)); flags |= FlagDelta; }
                _sent[(key, peer)] = raw;
            }
            if (a.compression != RpcCompression.None && body.Length >= MinCompressBytes)
            {
                var c = Deflate(body, a.compression);
                if (c.Length < body.Length) { body = c; flags |= FlagCompressed; }
            }
            var o = new byte[body.Length + 1]; o[0] = flags; Buffer.BlockCopy(body, 0, o, 1, body.Length); return o;
        }

        public byte[] Decode(ulong key, int peer, RpcAttribute a, byte[] wire)
        {
            if (!Wants(a)) return wire;
            if (wire.Length == 0) return wire;
            byte flags = wire[0]; var body = new byte[wire.Length - 1]; Buffer.BlockCopy(wire, 1, body, 0, body.Length);
            if ((flags & FlagCompressed) != 0) body = Inflate(body);
            if ((flags & FlagDelta) != 0)
            {
                if (!_recv.TryGetValue((key, peer), out var prev)) throw new NetException("RpcCodec: delta-packed RPC without a base payload");
                body = Xor(UnRleZeros(body, prev.Length), prev);
            }
            if (a.deltaPack) _recv[(key, peer)] = body;
            return body;
        }

        static byte[] Xor(byte[] a, byte[] b) { var o = new byte[a.Length]; for (int i = 0; i < a.Length; i++) o[i] = (byte)(a[i] ^ b[i]); return o; }

        // runs: [zeroRun:1][litLen:1][lit...]... ; runs longer than 255 split.
        static byte[] RleZeros(byte[] d)
        {
            var o = new List<byte>(d.Length / 2 + 4); int i = 0;
            while (i < d.Length)
            {
                int z = 0; while (i < d.Length && d[i] == 0 && z < 255) { z++; i++; }
                int start = i; while (i < d.Length && d[i] != 0 && i - start < 255) i++;
                o.Add((byte)z); o.Add((byte)(i - start)); for (int k = start; k < i; k++) o.Add(d[k]);
            }
            return o.ToArray();
        }
        static byte[] UnRleZeros(byte[] e, int length)
        {
            var o = new byte[length]; int i = 0, p = 0;
            while (i + 1 < e.Length && p < length)
            {
                int z = e[i++], l = e[i++]; p += z;
                for (int k = 0; k < l && p < length; k++) o[p++] = e[i++];
            }
            return o;
        }

        static byte[] Deflate(byte[] d, RpcCompression level)
        {
            var lv = level == RpcCompression.Fast ? CompressionLevel.Fastest : CompressionLevel.Optimal;
            using (var ms = new MemoryStream()) { using (var z = new DeflateStream(ms, lv, true)) z.Write(d, 0, d.Length); return ms.ToArray(); }
        }
        static byte[] Inflate(byte[] d)
        {
            using (var src = new MemoryStream(d)) using (var z = new DeflateStream(src, CompressionMode.Decompress)) using (var ms = new MemoryStream()) { z.CopyTo(ms); return ms.ToArray(); }
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Framework/StaticRpc.cs`:

```cs
// Static RPCs: [ServerRpc] / [ObserversRpc] / [TargetRpc] on static methods of any class, no NetworkIdentity
// involved. Identified on the wire by a 32-bit FNV-1a of "Type.FullName::Method/argCount" so the weaver
// (one assembly at a time) and the runtime (all loaded assemblies) agree without a shared index.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public sealed class StaticRpcMethod
    {
        public MethodInfo method, impl; public RpcAttribute attr; public Type[] paramTypes; public bool wantsInfo; public uint hash;
    }

    public static class StaticRpcs
    {
        static Dictionary<uint, StaticRpcMethod> _byHash;
        static readonly object _lock = new object();

        public static uint Hash(string typeFullName, string method, int argCount) => Fnv(typeFullName + "::" + method + "/" + argCount);

        public static uint Fnv(string s)
        {
            uint h = 2166136261;
            foreach (char c in s) { h ^= c; h *= 16777619; }
            return h;
        }

        public static StaticRpcMethod Find(uint hash) { EnsureScanned(); return _byHash.TryGetValue(hash, out var m) ? m : null; }
        public static IEnumerable<StaticRpcMethod> All { get { EnsureScanned(); return _byHash.Values; } }

        /// <summary>Scans every loaded non-system assembly once; call RescanAssemblies after loading plugins.</summary>
        public static void RescanAssemblies() { lock (_lock) _byHash = null; EnsureScanned(); }

        static void EnsureScanned()
        {
            if (_byHash != null) return;
            lock (_lock)
            {
                if (_byHash != null) return;
                var map = new Dictionary<uint, StaticRpcMethod>();
                foreach (var asm in AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies())
                {
                    var n = asm.GetName().Name;
                    if (asm.IsDynamic || n.StartsWith("System") || n.StartsWith("Microsoft") || n == "mscorlib" || n == "netstandard" || n.StartsWith("UnityEngine") || n.StartsWith("UnityEditor") || n.StartsWith("Unity.") || n.StartsWith("Mono.")) continue;
                    Type[] types; try { types = asm.GetTypes(); } catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException e) { types = e.Types.Where(t => t != null).ToArray(); }
                    foreach (var t in types)
                    {
                        const BindingFlags F = BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
                        foreach (var m in t.GetMethods(F))
                        {
                            var a = m.GetCustomAttribute<RpcAttribute>(); if (a == null) continue;
                            var ps = m.GetParameters();
                            bool info = ps.Length > 0 && ps[ps.Length - 1].ParameterType == typeof(RpcInfo);
                            int argc = info ? ps.Length - 1 : ps.Length;
                            var impl = t.GetMethod(m.Name + NetworkBehaviour.ImplSuffix, F, null, ps.Select(p => p.ParameterType).ToArray(), null);
                            var e = new StaticRpcMethod { method = m, impl = impl, attr = a, wantsInfo = info, paramTypes = ps.Take(argc).Select(p => p.ParameterType).ToArray(), hash = Hash(t.FullName, m.Name, argc) };
                            if (map.TryGetValue(e.hash, out var other) && other.method != m) throw new NetException($"static RPC hash collision: {t.FullName}.{m.Name} vs {other.method.DeclaringType.FullName}.{other.method.Name}");
                            map[e.hash] = e;
                        }
                    }
                }
                _byHash = map;
            }
        }

        internal static void WriteArgs(BitWriter w, StaticRpcMethod r, object[] args)
        {
            if (args.Length != r.paramTypes.Length) throw new NetException($"{r.method.DeclaringType.Name}.{r.method.Name}: expected {r.paramTypes.Length} args, got {args.Length}");
            for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++) NetSerializer.Write(w, args[i], r.paramTypes[i]);
        }

        internal static void Invoke(StaticRpcMethod r, BitReader reader, RpcInfo info)
        {
            var args = new object[r.paramTypes.Length + (r.wantsInfo ? 1 : 0)];
            for (int i = 0; i < r.paramTypes.Length; i++) args[i] = NetSerializer.Read(reader, r.paramTypes[i]);
            if (r.wantsInfo) args[args.Length - 1] = info;
            (r.impl ?? r.method).Invoke(null, args);
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
// Aurix Net Unity SDK — ValidatedSyncVar (owner proposes, server validates) and SyncBigData (chunked large payloads).
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Owner-authoritative sync var whose writes are checked on the server: <see cref="validate"/>(current, proposed)
    /// returns false to reject, in which case the server sends its value back to the owner (which reverts) and
    /// observers never see the proposal. Without a validator it behaves like an owner-auth <see cref="SyncVar{T}"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ValidatedSyncVar<T> : NetworkModule
    {
        T _value;
        public event Action<T> onChanged;
        /// <summary>Owner side: the server rejected a value (argument: the value it was reverted to).</summary>
        public event Action<T> onRejected;
        /// <summary>Server side: (current, proposed) → accept?</summary>
        public Func<T, T, bool> validate;
        /// <summary>Server side: fired when a proposal was rejected (owner, proposed).</summary>
        public event Action<PlayerID?, T> onServerRejected;
        bool _awaitingServer;

        public ValidatedSyncVar(T initialValue = default, float sendIntervalInSeconds = 0f, Func<T, T, bool> validate = null)
        {
            _value = initialValue; this.sendIntervalInSeconds = sendIntervalInSeconds; this.validate = validate; ownerAuth = true;
        }

        public T value
        {
            get => _value;
            set
            {
                if (NetSerializer.AreEqual(_value, value)) return;
                if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !isController) { Debug.LogWarning($"ValidatedSyncVar<{typeof(T).Name}>: only the owner may write it"); return; }
                _value = value; isDirty = true; _awaitingServer = identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !identity.isServer;
                onChanged?.Invoke(value);
            }
        }

        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) => NetSerializer.Write(w, _value, typeof(T));
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) => Apply((T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)), false);
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) => WriteFull(w);
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r)
        {
            var v = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T));
            bool correction = isController && _awaitingServer;   // owner receiving the server's answer
            _awaitingServer = false;
            Apply(v, correction);
        }

        public override bool ReadDeltaFromOwner(BitReader r)
        {
            var proposed = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T));
            if (validate != null && !validate(_value, proposed)) { onServerRejected?.Invoke(identity?.owner, proposed); return false; }
            Apply(proposed, false); return true;
        }

        void Apply(T v, bool correction)
        {
            if (NetSerializer.AreEqual(_value, v)) return;
            _value = v; onChanged?.Invoke(v);
            if (correction) onRejected?.Invoke(v);
        }

        public static implicit operator T(ValidatedSyncVar<T> s) => s._value;
        public override string ToString() => _value?.ToString() ?? "null";
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Owner → server input value (not replicated to other observers). The owner writes <see cref="value"/> whenever the
    /// input changes; the server gets <see cref="onChanged"/>. Use it for non-predicted input (menus, abilities, chat
    /// typing state); predicted movement uses <c>PredictedBehaviour</c>.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class SyncInput<T> : NetworkModule
    {
        T _value;
        public event Action<T> onChanged;
        /// <summary>Server tick at which the latest input was received.</summary>
        public uint lastInputTick { get; private set; }

        public SyncInput(T defaultValue = default, float sendIntervalInSeconds = 0f) { _value = defaultValue; sendIntervalInSeconds = Math.Max(0, sendIntervalInSeconds); this.sendIntervalInSeconds = sendIntervalInSeconds; ownerAuth = true; serverOnly = true; }

        public T value
        {
            get => _value;
            set
            {
                if (NetSerializer.AreEqual(_value, value)) return;
                if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !identity.isOwner) { Debug.LogWarning($"SyncInput<{typeof(T).Name}>: only the owner may write it"); return; }
                _value = value; isDirty = true; onChanged?.Invoke(value);
            }
        }

        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) => NetSerializer.Write(w, _value, typeof(T));
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) { _value = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)); }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) => WriteFull(w);
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r)
        {
            var v = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)); lastInputTick = lastReceivedTick;
            if (NetSerializer.AreEqual(_value, v)) return;
            _value = v; onChanged?.Invoke(v);
        }
        public static implicit operator T(SyncInput<T> s) => s._value;
    }

    /// <summary>Replicates a Texture2D (PNG-encoded) through <see cref="SyncBigData"/>; remotes get a decoded texture in <see cref="onChanged"/>.</summary>
    public sealed class SyncTexture : NetworkModule
    {
        readonly SyncBigData _data;
        public Texture2D texture { get; private set; }
        public event Action<Texture2D> onChanged;
        public float progress => _data.progress;
        public bool isTransferring => _data.isTransferring;

        public SyncTexture(bool ownerAuth = false, int chunkSize = 8 * 1024)
        {
            this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; _data = new SyncBigData(ownerAuth, chunkSize);
            _data.onCompleted += bytes => { if (bytes.Length == 0) { texture = null; onChanged?.Invoke(null); return; } var t = new Texture2D(2, 2); if (t.LoadImage(bytes)) { texture = t; onChanged?.Invoke(t); } };
        }

        /// <summary>Controller: replace the texture (encoded to PNG and streamed).</summary>
        public void Set(Texture2D tex) { if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !isController) { Debug.LogWarning("SyncTexture: only the controller may set it"); return; } texture = tex; _data.Set(tex != null ? tex.EncodeToPNG() : Array.Empty<byte>()); isDirty = true; }

        public override void OnBeforeSend() { _data.OnBeforeSend(); if (_data.isDirty) isDirty = true; }
        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) => _data.WriteFull(w);
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) => _data.ReadFull(r);
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) { _data.WriteDelta(w); _data.ClearDirty(); }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r) => _data.ReadDelta(r);
    }

    /// <summary>Replicates a named file (name + bytes) through <see cref="SyncBigData"/>.</summary>
    public sealed class SyncFile : NetworkModule
    {
        readonly SyncBigData _data;
        public string fileName { get; private set; } = "";
        public byte[] bytes => _data.data;
        public event Action<string, byte[]> onChanged;
        public float progress => _data.progress;
        public bool isTransferring => _data.isTransferring;
        string _incomingName;

        public SyncFile(bool ownerAuth = false, int chunkSize = 8 * 1024)
        {
            this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; _data = new SyncBigData(ownerAuth, chunkSize);
            _data.onCompleted += b => { fileName = _incomingName ?? fileName; onChanged?.Invoke(fileName, b); };
        }

        public void Set(string name, byte[] content) { if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !isController) { Debug.LogWarning("SyncFile: only the controller may set it"); return; } fileName = name ?? ""; _data.Set(content); isDirty = true; }

        public override void OnBeforeSend() { _data.OnBeforeSend(); if (_data.isDirty) isDirty = true; }
        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) { NetSerializer.WriteString(w, fileName); _data.WriteFull(w); }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) { _incomingName = NetSerializer.ReadString(r); _data.ReadFull(r); }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) { NetSerializer.WriteString(w, fileName); _data.WriteDelta(w); _data.ClearDirty(); }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r) { _incomingName = NetSerializer.ReadString(r); _data.ReadDelta(r); }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Replicates a large byte payload (texture, save file, level blob) in chunks over the reliable sync path.
    /// Controller calls <see cref="Set"/>; receivers get <see cref="progress"/> updates and <see cref="onCompleted"/>.
    /// Late joiners receive the whole payload with the spawn state.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class SyncBigData : NetworkModule
    {
        public int chunkSize = 8 * 1024;
        [Tooltip("Chunks sent per tick.")] public int chunksPerTick = 2;
        byte[] _data = Array.Empty<byte>(); uint _version;
        byte[] _incoming; uint _incomingVersion; int _received, _nextChunk, _totalChunks;
        public event Action<byte[]> onCompleted;
        public event Action<float> onProgress;

        public SyncBigData(bool ownerAuth = false, int chunkSize = 8 * 1024) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; this.chunkSize = Math.Max(64, chunkSize); }

        /// <summary>Latest complete payload on this peer (empty until the first transfer finishes).</summary>
        public byte[] data => _data;
        public uint version => _version;
        public bool isTransferring => _incoming != null;
        public float progress => _incoming == null ? 1f : _totalChunks == 0 ? 1f : (float)_received / _totalChunks;

        /// <summary>Controller: replace the payload; it streams to every observer in chunks.</summary>
        public void Set(byte[] bytes)
        {
            if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !isController) { Debug.LogWarning("SyncBigData: only the controller may set it"); return; }
            _data = bytes ?? Array.Empty<byte>(); _version++;
            _nextChunk = 0; _totalChunks = (_data.Length + chunkSize - 1) / chunkSize; isDirty = true;
        }

        public override void OnBeforeSend() { if (_nextChunk < _totalChunks) isDirty = true; }

        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) { w.WriteBits(_version, 32); w.WriteUInt((ulong)_data.Length, 32); w.WriteBytes(_data); }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r)
        {
            _version = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(32); _data = n > 0 ? r.ReadBytes(n) : Array.Empty<byte>();
            _incoming = null; onProgress?.Invoke(1f); onCompleted?.Invoke(_data);
        }

        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w)
        {
            int count = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(chunksPerTick, _totalChunks - _nextChunk));
            w.WriteBits(_version, 32); w.WriteUInt((ulong)_data.Length, 32); w.WriteUInt((ulong)_totalChunks, 16); w.WriteUInt((ulong)_nextChunk, 16); w.WriteUInt((ulong)count, 8);
            for (int c = 0; c < count; c++, _nextChunk++)
            {
                int off = _nextChunk * chunkSize, len = Math.Min(chunkSize, _data.Length - off);
                w.WriteUInt((ulong)len, 16); for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) w.WriteBits(_data[off + i], 8);
            }
        }

        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r)
        {
            uint ver = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); int total = (int)r.ReadUInt(32), chunks = (int)r.ReadUInt(16), first = (int)r.ReadUInt(16), count = (int)r.ReadUInt(8);
            if (_incoming == null || _incomingVersion != ver) { _incoming = new byte[total]; _incomingVersion = ver; _received = 0; _totalChunks = chunks; }
            for (int c = 0; c < count; c++)
            {
                int len = (int)r.ReadUInt(16), off = (first + c) * chunkSize;
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) { byte b = (byte)r.ReadBits(8); if (off + i < _incoming.Length) _incoming[off + i] = b; }
                _received++;
            }
            onProgress?.Invoke(progress);
            if (_received >= _totalChunks || total == 0) { _data = _incoming; _version = ver; _incoming = null; onCompleted?.Invoke(_data); }
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
// More sync modules in the SyncList family: SyncHashSet, SyncQueue, SyncArray, SyncEvent, SyncTimer.
// Same rules: server- or owner-authoritative, full state on spawn/late join, per-tick deltas, onChanged.
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity.Framework
{
    public enum SyncSetOperation : byte { Added, Removed, Cleared }

    public sealed class SyncHashSet<T> : NetworkModule, IReadOnlyCollection<T>
    {
        readonly HashSet<T> _set = new HashSet<T>();
        readonly List<(SyncSetOperation op, T item)> _pending = new List<(SyncSetOperation, T)>();
        public event Action<SyncSetOperation, T> onChanged;
        public SyncHashSet(bool ownerAuth = false, bool ownerOnly = false) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; this.ownerOnly = ownerOnly; }
        public int Count => _set.Count;
        public bool Contains(T x) => _set.Contains(x);
        public bool Add(T x) { if (!Allowed() || !_set.Add(x)) return false; Record(SyncSetOperation.Added, x); return true; }
        public bool Remove(T x) { if (!Allowed() || !_set.Remove(x)) return false; Record(SyncSetOperation.Removed, x); return true; }
        public void Clear() { if (!Allowed()) return; _set.Clear(); _pending.Clear(); Record(SyncSetOperation.Cleared, default); }
        public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator() => _set.GetEnumerator();
        IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator() => _set.GetEnumerator();
        bool Allowed() { if (identity == null || !identity.isSpawned || isController) return true; Debug.LogWarning($"{behaviour.GetType().Name}.SyncHashSet<{typeof(T).Name}>: only the {(ownerAuth ? "owner" : "server")} may write it"); return false; }
        void Record(SyncSetOperation op, T x) { if (_pending.Count >= 255) { _pending.Clear(); _pending.Add((SyncSetOperation.Cleared, default)); foreach (var e in _set) _pending.Add((SyncSetOperation.Added, e)); } else _pending.Add((op, x)); isDirty = true; onChanged?.Invoke(op, x); }
        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) { w.WriteUInt((ulong)_set.Count, 16); foreach (var x in _set) NetSerializer.Write(w, x, typeof(T)); }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) { _set.Clear(); _pending.Clear(); int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(16); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) _set.Add((T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T))); onChanged?.Invoke(SyncSetOperation.Cleared, default); }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) { w.WriteBits((ulong)_pending.Count, 8); foreach (var (op, x) in _pending) { w.WriteBits((ulong)op, 2); if (op != SyncSetOperation.Cleared) NetSerializer.Write(w, x, typeof(T)); } _pending.Clear(); }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r)
        {
            int n = (int)r.ReadBits(8);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                var op = (SyncSetOperation)r.ReadBits(2); T x = default;
                if (op != SyncSetOperation.Cleared) x = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T));
                if (op == SyncSetOperation.Added) _set.Add(x); else if (op == SyncSetOperation.Removed) _set.Remove(x); else _set.Clear();
                onChanged?.Invoke(op, x);
            }
        }
    }

    public enum SyncQueueOperation : byte { Enqueued, Dequeued, Cleared }

    public sealed class SyncQueue<T> : NetworkModule, IReadOnlyCollection<T>
    {
        readonly Queue<T> _q = new Queue<T>();
        readonly List<(SyncQueueOperation op, T item)> _pending = new List<(SyncQueueOperation, T)>();
        public event Action<SyncQueueOperation, T> onChanged;
        public SyncQueue(bool ownerAuth = false, bool ownerOnly = false) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; this.ownerOnly = ownerOnly; }
        public int Count => _q.Count;
        public T Peek() => _q.Peek();
        public bool TryPeek(out T x) { if (_q.Count == 0) { x = default; return false; } x = _q.Peek(); return true; }
        public void Enqueue(T x) { if (!Allowed()) return; _q.Enqueue(x); Record(SyncQueueOperation.Enqueued, x); }
        public T Dequeue() { if (!Allowed()) throw new InvalidOperationException("not the controller"); var x = _q.Dequeue(); Record(SyncQueueOperation.Dequeued, x); return x; }
        public bool TryDequeue(out T x) { if (_q.Count == 0 || !Allowed()) { x = default; return false; } x = Dequeue(); return true; }
        public void Clear() { if (!Allowed()) return; _q.Clear(); _pending.Clear(); Record(SyncQueueOperation.Cleared, default); }
        public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator() => _q.GetEnumerator();
        IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator() => _q.GetEnumerator();
        bool Allowed() { if (identity == null || !identity.isSpawned || isController) return true; Debug.LogWarning($"{behaviour.GetType().Name}.SyncQueue<{typeof(T).Name}>: only the {(ownerAuth ? "owner" : "server")} may write it"); return false; }
        void Record(SyncQueueOperation op, T x) { if (_pending.Count >= 255) { _pending.Clear(); _pending.Add((SyncQueueOperation.Cleared, default)); foreach (var e in _q) _pending.Add((SyncQueueOperation.Enqueued, e)); } else _pending.Add((op, x)); isDirty = true; onChanged?.Invoke(op, x); }
        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) { w.WriteUInt((ulong)_q.Count, 16); foreach (var x in _q) NetSerializer.Write(w, x, typeof(T)); }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) { _q.Clear(); _pending.Clear(); int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(16); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) _q.Enqueue((T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T))); onChanged?.Invoke(SyncQueueOperation.Cleared, default); }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) { w.WriteBits((ulong)_pending.Count, 8); foreach (var (op, x) in _pending) { w.WriteBits((ulong)op, 2); if (op == SyncQueueOperation.Enqueued) NetSerializer.Write(w, x, typeof(T)); } _pending.Clear(); }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r)
        {
            int n = (int)r.ReadBits(8);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                var op = (SyncQueueOperation)r.ReadBits(2); T x = default;
                if (op == SyncQueueOperation.Enqueued) { x = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)); _q.Enqueue(x); }
                else if (op == SyncQueueOperation.Dequeued) { if (_q.Count > 0) x = _q.Dequeue(); }
                else _q.Clear();
                onChanged?.Invoke(op, x);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Fixed-length array; only changed slots travel.</summary>
    public sealed class SyncArray<T> : NetworkModule, IReadOnlyList<T>
    {
        readonly T[] _a; readonly HashSet<int> _dirtySlots = new HashSet<int>();
        public event Action<int, T> onChanged;
        public SyncArray(int length, bool ownerAuth = false, bool ownerOnly = false) { _a = new T[length]; this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; this.ownerOnly = ownerOnly; }
        public int Count => _a.Length;
        public int Length => _a.Length;
        public T this[int i]
        {
            get => _a[i];
            set { if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !isController) { Debug.LogWarning($"{behaviour.GetType().Name}.SyncArray<{typeof(T).Name}>: only the {(ownerAuth ? "owner" : "server")} may write it"); return; } _a[i] = value; _dirtySlots.Add(i); isDirty = true; onChanged?.Invoke(i, value); }
        }
        public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator() => ((IEnumerable<T>)_a).GetEnumerator();
        IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator() => _a.GetEnumerator();
        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) { foreach (var x in _a) NetSerializer.Write(w, x, typeof(T)); }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) { for (int i = 0; i < _a.Length; i++) { _a[i] = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)); onChanged?.Invoke(i, _a[i]); } }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) { w.WriteBits((ulong)_dirtySlots.Count, 16); foreach (var i in _dirtySlots) { w.WriteBits((ulong)i, 16); NetSerializer.Write(w, _a[i], typeof(T)); } _dirtySlots.Clear(); }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r) { int n = (int)r.ReadBits(16); for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) { int i = (int)r.ReadBits(16); _a[i] = (T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T)); onChanged?.Invoke(i, _a[i]); } }
    }

    /// <summary>Fire-and-forget event with a payload; late joiners do not receive past events (unlike bufferLast RPCs).</summary>
    public sealed class SyncEvent<T> : NetworkModule
    {
        readonly List<T> _pending = new List<T>();
        public event Action<T> onInvoked;
        public SyncEvent(bool ownerAuth = false) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; }
        public void Invoke(T arg)
        {
            if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !isController) { Debug.LogWarning($"{behaviour.GetType().Name}.SyncEvent<{typeof(T).Name}>: only the {(ownerAuth ? "owner" : "server")} may invoke it"); return; }
            _pending.Add(arg); isDirty = true; onInvoked?.Invoke(arg);
        }
        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) { }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) { }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) { w.WriteBits((ulong)_pending.Count, 8); foreach (var x in _pending) NetSerializer.Write(w, x, typeof(T)); _pending.Clear(); }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r) { int n = (int)r.ReadBits(8); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) onInvoked?.Invoke((T)NetSerializer.Read(r, typeof(T))); }
    }

    /// <summary>Server-driven countdown replicated by tick: clients compute the remaining time locally from the server tick.</summary>
    public sealed class SyncTimer : NetworkModule
    {
        uint _endTick; bool _running; bool _changed;
        public event Action onFinished, onStarted, onStopped;
        bool _finishedFired;
        public SyncTimer(bool ownerAuth = false) { this.ownerAuth = ownerAuth; }
        public bool isRunning => _running && !finished;
        public uint endTick => _endTick;
        public bool finished => _running && Tick() >= _endTick;
        public float remaining => !_running ? 0f : Math.Max(0, (int)(_endTick - Tick())) / (float)Math.Max(1, behaviour?.networkManager?.tickRate ?? 60);
        uint Tick() => behaviour?.networkManager?.serverTick ?? 0;
        public void Start(float seconds)
        {
            if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !isController) { Debug.LogWarning($"{behaviour.GetType().Name}.SyncTimer: only the {(ownerAuth ? "owner" : "server")} may start it"); return; }
            _endTick = Tick() + (uint)Math.Max(1, Math.Round(seconds * Math.Max(1, behaviour?.networkManager?.tickRate ?? 60))); _running = true; _finishedFired = false; _changed = true; isDirty = true; onStarted?.Invoke();
        }
        public void Stop()
        {
            if (identity != null && identity.isSpawned && !isController) return;
            _running = false; _changed = true; isDirty = true; onStopped?.Invoke();
        }
        /// <summary>Call from Update/OnTick to fire onFinished once.</summary>
        public void Poll() { if (_running && !_finishedFired && Tick() >= _endTick) { _finishedFired = true; onFinished?.Invoke(); } }
        public override void WriteFull(BitWriter w) { w.WriteBool(_running); w.WriteBits(_endTick, 32); }
        public override void ReadFull(BitReader r) { bool was = _running; _running = r.ReadBool(); _endTick = (uint)r.ReadBits(32); _finishedFired = false; if (_running && !was) onStarted?.Invoke(); if (!_running && was) onStopped?.Invoke(); }
        public override void WriteDelta(BitWriter w) { WriteFull(w); _changed = false; }
        public override void ReadDelta(BitReader r) => ReadFull(r);
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/Bits.cs`:

```cs
// MSB-first bit packing, mirrors net-wire::bits.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    public sealed class BitWriter
    {
        readonly List<byte> _buf = new List<byte>(); ulong _scratch; int _n; public int BitLen { get; private set; }
        public void WriteBits(ulong v, int nbits)
        {
            if (nbits == 0) return;
            if (nbits < 64) v &= (1UL << nbits) - 1;
            BitLen += nbits;
            while (nbits > 0)
            {
                int take = Math.Min(nbits, 64 - _n);
                // append the top `take` bits of v's remaining nbits
                ulong part = nbits == 64 && take == 64 ? v : (v >> (nbits - take)) & (take == 64 ? ulong.MaxValue : (1UL << take) - 1);
                if (take == 64) { _scratch = part; _n = 64; }
                else { _scratch = (_scratch << take) | part; _n += take; }
                nbits -= take;
                while (_n >= 8) { _buf.Add((byte)(_scratch >> (_n - 8))); _n -= 8; }
            }
        }
        public void WriteBool(bool b) => WriteBits(b ? 1UL : 0UL, 1);
        public void WriteUInt(ulong v, int nbits) { ulong max = nbits >= 64 ? ulong.MaxValue : (1UL << nbits) - 1; WriteBits(Math.Min(v, max), nbits); }
        public void WriteInt(long v, int nbits) => WriteUInt((ulong)((v << 1) ^ (v >> 63)), nbits);
        public void WriteQuantized(float v, float min, float max, float res) { Bits.QuantBits(min, max, res, out int nb, out _); ulong q = (ulong)(((Math.Min(Math.Max(v, min), max) - min) / res) + 0.5f); WriteUInt(q, nb); }
        public void WriteF32(float v) => WriteBits(BitConverter.ToUInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(v), 0), 32);
        public void WriteBytes(byte[] b) { foreach (var x in b) WriteBits(x, 8); }
        public byte[] Finish() { var o = new List<byte>(_buf); if (_n > 0) o.Add((byte)(_scratch << (8 - _n))); return o.ToArray(); }
    }

    public sealed class BitReader
    {
        readonly byte[] _b; readonly int _off; readonly int _bits; int _pos;
        public BitReader(byte[] b, int offset = 0) { _b = b; _off = offset; _bits = (b.Length - offset) * 8; }
        public int BitsLeft => _bits - _pos;
        public ulong ReadBits(int nbits)
        {
            if (nbits > BitsLeft) throw new NetException("delta truncated");
            ulong v = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < nbits; i++) { int p = _pos + i; v = (v << 1) | (uint)((_b[_off + (p >> 3)] >> (7 - (p & 7))) & 1); }
            _pos += nbits; return v;
        }
        public bool ReadBool() => ReadBits(1) == 1;
        public ulong ReadUInt(int nbits) => ReadBits(nbits);
        public long ReadInt(int nbits) { ulong zz = ReadBits(nbits); return (long)(zz >> 1) ^ -(long)(zz & 1); }
        public float ReadQuantized(float min, float max, float res) { Bits.QuantBits(min, max, res, out int nb, out _); return min + ReadUInt(nb) * res; }
        public float ReadF32() => BitConverter.ToSingle(BitConverter.GetBytes((uint)ReadBits(32)), 0);
        public byte[] ReadBytes(int n) { var o = new byte[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) o[i] = (byte)ReadBits(8); return o; }
    }

    public static class Bits
    {
        public static void QuantBits(float min, float max, float res, out int bits, out ulong steps)
        {
            steps = Math.Max(1UL, (ulong)Math.Ceiling((max - min) / res));
            bits = 64 - LeadingZeros(steps); if (bits < 1) bits = 1;
        }
        public static int LeadingZeros(ulong v) { int n = 0; for (int i = 63; i >= 0; i--) { if (((v >> i) & 1) != 0) break; n++; } return n; }
        public static int LenBits(uint max) => Math.Max(1, 64 - LeadingZeros(max));
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/Bots.cs`:

```cs
// Deterministic bot kit — port of `net-sim-bots`: behavior trees, hierarchical state machines and
// an integer blackboard. Trees/machines load from the same JSON the Rust crate emits (serde's
// externally tagged enums); tick hashes match Rust bit for bit.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Aurix.Net.Sim.Bots
{
    public enum Status { Running, Success, Failure }

    public sealed class Blackboard
    {
        public readonly SortedDictionary<uint, long> Values = new SortedDictionary<uint, long>();
        public long Get(uint k) => Values.TryGetValue(k, out var v) ? v : 0;
        public void Set(uint k, long v) => Values[k] = v;
        public bool Has(uint k) => Values.ContainsKey(k);
        public void Clear(uint k) => Values.Remove(k);
    }

    public interface IBrain
    {
        bool Condition(uint id, Blackboard bb);
        Status Action(uint id, Blackboard bb);
        void Abort(uint id, Blackboard bb);
    }

    /// Tree node in serde's externally tagged JSON shape.
    public sealed class BtNode
    {
        public string Kind;
        public List<BtNode> Children = new List<BtNode>();
        public uint Id;        // Condition/Action id, Wait ticks, Parallel need, Repeat times, Cooldown/Timeout ticks
        public uint Key; public byte Op; public long Value; // Compare/Set

        public static BtNode Parse(string json) => Parse(JsonDocument.Parse(json).RootElement);
        public static BtNode Parse(JsonElement e)
        {
            var prop = e.EnumerateObject().First();
            var n = new BtNode { Kind = prop.Name };
            var v = prop.Value;
            switch (n.Kind)
            {
                case "Sequence": case "Selector": foreach (var c in v.EnumerateArray()) n.Children.Add(Parse(c)); break;
                case "Parallel": n.Id = v.GetProperty("need").GetUInt32(); foreach (var c in v.GetProperty("children").EnumerateArray()) n.Children.Add(Parse(c)); break;
                case "Condition": case "Action": case "Wait": n.Id = v.GetUInt32(); break;
                case "Inverter": case "Succeeder": n.Children.Add(Parse(v)); break;
                case "Repeat": n.Id = v.GetProperty("times").GetUInt32(); n.Children.Add(Parse(v.GetProperty("child"))); break;
                case "Cooldown": case "Timeout": n.Id = v.GetProperty("ticks").GetUInt32(); n.Children.Add(Parse(v.GetProperty("child"))); break;
                case "Compare": n.Key = v.GetProperty("key").GetUInt32(); n.Op = v.GetProperty("op").GetByte(); n.Value = v.GetProperty("value").GetInt64(); break;
                case "Set": n.Key = v.GetProperty("key").GetUInt32(); n.Value = v.GetProperty("value").GetInt64(); break;
                default: throw new ArgumentException("unknown node " + n.Kind);
            }
            return n;
        }
        public int Count() => 1 + Children.Sum(c => c.Count());
    }

    public sealed class BehaviorTree
    {
        struct NodeState { public uint Counter, Cooldown; public bool Running; }
        public readonly BtNode Root;
        readonly NodeState[] _states;
        public uint Tick { get; private set; }

        public BehaviorTree(BtNode root) { Root = root; _states = new NodeState[root.Count()]; }
        public static BehaviorTree FromJson(string json) => new BehaviorTree(BtNode.Parse(json));

        public Status Step(IBrain brain, Blackboard bb)
        {
            var st = Run(Root, 0, brain, bb);
            for (int i = 0; i < _states.Length; i++) if (_states[i].Cooldown > 0) _states[i].Cooldown--;
            Tick++;
            return st;
        }
        public void Reset(IBrain brain, Blackboard bb) { Abort(Root, 0, brain, bb); Array.Clear(_states, 0, _states.Length); }

        public ulong Hash()
        {
            ulong h = 0xcbf29ce484222325UL;
            void Mix(ulong v) { for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { h ^= v & 0xff; h *= 0x100000001b3UL; v >>= 8; } }
            Mix(Tick);
            foreach (var s in _states) Mix((ulong)s.Counter | ((ulong)s.Cooldown << 32) | (s.Running ? 1UL << 63 : 0));
            return h;
        }

        Status Run(BtNode node, int idx, IBrain brain, Blackboard bb)
        {
            ref var s = ref _states[idx];
            switch (node.Kind)
            {
                case "Condition": return brain.Condition(node.Id, bb) ? Status.Success : Status.Failure;
                case "Action": { var st = brain.Action(node.Id, bb); s.Running = st == Status.Running; return st; }
                case "Compare":
                {
                    long v = bb.Get(node.Key), x = node.Value;
                    bool ok = node.Op switch { 0 => v == x, 1 => v != x, 2 => v < x, 3 => v <= x, 4 => v > x, _ => v >= x };
                    return ok ? Status.Success : Status.Failure;
                }
                case "Set": bb.Set(node.Key, node.Value); return Status.Success;
                case "Wait":
                    s.Counter++;
                    if (s.Counter >= node.Id) { s.Counter = 0; s.Running = false; return Status.Success; }
                    s.Running = true; return Status.Running;
                case "Sequence": case "Selector":
                {
                    bool isSeq = node.Kind == "Sequence";
                    uint start = s.Counter;
                    int childIdx = idx + 1;
                    var result = isSeq ? Status.Success : Status.Failure;
                    for (int i = 0; i < node.Children.Count; i++)
                    {
                        var c = node.Children[i];
                        if (i < start)
                        {
                            if (c.Kind == "Condition" || c.Kind == "Compare")
                            {
                                var g = Run(c, childIdx, brain, bb);
                                if ((isSeq && g == Status.Failure) || (!isSeq && g == Status.Success))
                                {
                                    int rest = childIdx + c.Count();
                                    for (int j = i + 1; j < node.Children.Count; j++) { Abort(node.Children[j], rest, brain, bb); rest += node.Children[j].Count(); }
                                    _states[idx].Counter = 0; _states[idx].Running = false;
                                    return g;
                                }
                            }
                            childIdx += c.Count();
                            continue;
                        }
                        var st = Run(c, childIdx, brain, bb);
                        childIdx += c.Count();
                        if (st == Status.Running)
                        {
                            _states[idx].Counter = (uint)i; _states[idx].Running = true;
                            int rest = childIdx;
                            for (int j = i + 1; j < node.Children.Count; j++) { Abort(node.Children[j], rest, brain, bb); rest += node.Children[j].Count(); }
                            return Status.Running;
                        }
                        if (!isSeq && st == Status.Success) { result = Status.Success; break; }
                        if (isSeq && st == Status.Failure) { result = Status.Failure; break; }
                    }
                    _states[idx].Counter = 0; _states[idx].Running = false;
                    return result;
                }
                case "Parallel":
                {
                    int childIdx = idx + 1; uint ok = 0, failed = 0;
                    foreach (var c in node.Children)
                    {
                        var st = Run(c, childIdx, brain, bb); childIdx += c.Count();
                        if (st == Status.Success) ok++; else if (st == Status.Failure) failed++;
                    }
                    if (ok >= node.Id) { AbortChildren(node, idx, brain, bb); return Status.Success; }
                    if ((uint)node.Children.Count - failed < node.Id) { AbortChildren(node, idx, brain, bb); return Status.Failure; }
                    return Status.Running;
                }
                case "Inverter": { var st = Run(node.Children[0], idx + 1, brain, bb); return st == Status.Success ? Status.Failure : st == Status.Failure ? Status.Success : Status.Running; }
                case "Succeeder": { var st = Run(node.Children[0], idx + 1, brain, bb); return st == Status.Running ? Status.Running : Status.Success; }
                case "Repeat":
                {
                    var st = Run(node.Children[0], idx + 1, brain, bb);
                    if (st == Status.Running) return Status.Running;
                    if (st == Status.Failure) { _states[idx].Counter = 0; return Status.Failure; }
                    _states[idx].Counter++;
                    if (node.Id > 0 && _states[idx].Counter >= node.Id) { _states[idx].Counter = 0; return Status.Success; }
                    return Status.Running;
                }
                case "Cooldown":
                {
                    if (s.Cooldown > 0 && !s.Running) return Status.Failure;
                    var st = Run(node.Children[0], idx + 1, brain, bb);
                    _states[idx].Running = st == Status.Running;
                    if (st != Status.Running) _states[idx].Cooldown = node.Id + 1;
                    return st;
                }
                case "Timeout":
                {
                    var st = Run(node.Children[0], idx + 1, brain, bb);
                    if (st == Status.Running)
                    {
                        _states[idx].Counter++;
                        if (_states[idx].Counter >= node.Id) { _states[idx].Counter = 0; Abort(node.Children[0], idx + 1, brain, bb); return Status.Failure; }
                        return Status.Running;
                    }
                    _states[idx].Counter = 0; return st;
                }
            }
            throw new InvalidOperationException("unknown node " + node.Kind);
        }

        void AbortChildren(BtNode node, int idx, IBrain brain, Blackboard bb)
        {
            int childIdx = idx + 1;
            foreach (var c in node.Children) { Abort(c, childIdx, brain, bb); childIdx += c.Count(); }
        }
        void Abort(BtNode node, int idx, IBrain brain, Blackboard bb)
        {
            if (node.Kind == "Action") { if (_states[idx].Running) brain.Abort(node.Id, bb); }
            else AbortChildren(node, idx, brain, bb);
            _states[idx].Counter = 0; _states[idx].Running = false;
        }
    }

    public sealed class Transition { public uint? Condition; public uint To; }
    public sealed class State
    {
        public uint Id; public uint? Parent, Initial, OnEnter, OnExit, Action;
        public List<Transition> Transitions = new List<Transition>();
    }

    public sealed class StateMachine
    {
        public readonly SortedDictionary<uint, State> States = new SortedDictionary<uint, State>();
        public uint Current; public uint TicksInState; public uint Tick;
        Status _lastAction = Status.Running;

        public StateMachine(IEnumerable<State> states, uint initial) { foreach (var s in states) States[s.Id] = s; Current = initial; }
        /// Accepts the Rust `StateMachine` JSON (`states` object keyed by id).
        public static StateMachine FromJson(string json)
        {
            var d = JsonDocument.Parse(json).RootElement;
            static uint? Opt(JsonElement e, string k) => e.TryGetProperty(k, out var v) && v.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number ? v.GetUInt32() : (uint?)null;
            var states = new List<State>();
            foreach (var p in d.GetProperty("states").EnumerateObject())
            {
                var e = p.Value;
                var s = new State { Id = e.GetProperty("id").GetUInt32(), Parent = Opt(e, "parent"), Initial = Opt(e, "initial"), OnEnter = Opt(e, "on_enter"), OnExit = Opt(e, "on_exit"), Action = Opt(e, "action") };
                foreach (var t in e.GetProperty("transitions").EnumerateArray()) s.Transitions.Add(new Transition { Condition = Opt(t, "condition"), To = t.GetProperty("to").GetUInt32() });
                states.Add(s);
            }
            var m = new StateMachine(states, d.GetProperty("current").GetUInt32());
            m.TicksInState = Opt(d, "ticks_in_state") ?? 0; m.Tick = Opt(d, "tick") ?? 0;
            if (d.TryGetProperty("last_action", out var la)) m._lastAction = Enum.Parse<Status>(la.GetString());
            return m;
        }
        public List<uint> Ancestors(uint id)
        {
            var o = new List<uint> { id };
            var p = States.TryGetValue(id, out var s) ? s.Parent : null;
            while (p.HasValue) { o.Add(p.Value); p = States.TryGetValue(p.Value, out var ps) ? ps.Parent : null; }
            return o;
        }
        public bool IsIn(uint id) => Ancestors(Current).Contains(id);
        public void Start(IBrain brain, Blackboard bb)
        {
            uint cur = Current;
            var chain = Ancestors(cur); chain.Reverse();
            foreach (var s in chain) { var a = States[s].OnEnter; if (a.HasValue) brain.Action(a.Value, bb); }
            while (States.TryGetValue(cur, out var st) && st.Initial.HasValue) { var a = States[st.Initial.Value].OnEnter; if (a.HasValue) brain.Action(a.Value, bb); cur = st.Initial.Value; }
            Current = cur; TicksInState = 0;
        }
        public void Step(IBrain brain, Blackboard bb)
        {
            uint? target = null;
            foreach (var s in Ancestors(Current))
            {
                foreach (var t in States[s].Transitions)
                {
                    bool fire = t.Condition.HasValue ? brain.Condition(t.Condition.Value, bb) : _lastAction != Status.Running && s == Current;
                    if (fire) { target = t.To; break; }
                }
                if (target.HasValue) break;
            }
            if (target.HasValue) DoTransition(target.Value, brain, bb);
            var act = States.TryGetValue(Current, out var cs) ? cs.Action : null;
            _lastAction = act.HasValue ? brain.Action(act.Value, bb) : Status.Success;
            TicksInState++; Tick++;
        }
        public void DoTransition(uint to, IBrain brain, Blackboard bb)
        {
            var from = Ancestors(Current); var toChain = Ancestors(to);
            foreach (var s in from) { if (toChain.Contains(s)) break; var a = States[s].OnExit; if (a.HasValue) brain.Action(a.Value, bb); }
            var enter = new List<uint>(toChain); enter.Reverse();
            foreach (var s in enter) { if (from.Contains(s)) continue; var a = States[s].OnEnter; if (a.HasValue) brain.Action(a.Value, bb); }
            uint cur = to;
            while (States.TryGetValue(cur, out var st) && st.Initial.HasValue) { var a = States[st.Initial.Value].OnEnter; if (a.HasValue) brain.Action(a.Value, bb); cur = st.Initial.Value; }
            Current = cur; TicksInState = 0; _lastAction = Status.Running;
        }
        public ulong Hash() => (ulong)Current ^ ((ulong)TicksInState << 32) ^ unchecked((ulong)Tick * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15UL);
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/Link.cs`:

```cs
// Pure C# port of net-transport::Link (and sdk/web link.ts): unreliable-sequenced batches,
// reliable-ordered, reliable-unordered, fragmentation up to 64 KiB. Not thread-safe: drive it
// from one thread (the Unity main thread) and feed datagrams through Receive().
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    public struct Received { public Channel Channel; public ushort Tick; public byte[] Payload; }

    public sealed class Link
    {
        const int Window = 32, MaxRetries = 10; const double MinRto = 50, MaxRto = 2000;
        const int FragHdr = 5, FragPayload = Packet.MaxUnfragmented - FragHdr, MaxMessage = 64 * 1024;

        sealed class InFlight { public ushort Seq; public byte[] Payload; public double SentAt; public int Retries; }
        sealed class Stream
        {
            public byte Kind; public bool Ordered;
            public ushort TxSeq; public List<InFlight> InFlight = new List<InFlight>(); public Queue<byte[]> Pending = new Queue<byte[]>();
            public double Rtt = 100, RttVar = 50;
            public bool HasAck; public ushort RxAck; public uint RxAckBits; public ushort Next; public Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> Buffer = new Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>();
            public double Rto() => Math.Min(MaxRto, Math.Max(MinRto, Rtt + 4 * RttVar));
            public void OnAck(ushort ack, uint bits, double now)
            {
                InFlight.RemoveAll(p =>
                {
                    bool acked = p.Seq == ack;
                    if (!acked && Packet.SeqNewer(ack, p.Seq)) { int d = (ushort)(ack - p.Seq); acked = d <= 32 && ((bits >> (d - 1)) & 1) == 1; }
                    if (acked && p.Retries == 0) { double s = now - p.SentAt; RttVar = 0.75 * RttVar + 0.25 * Math.Abs(s - Rtt); Rtt = 0.875 * Rtt + 0.125 * s; }
                    return acked;
                });
            }
            /// <summary>Records a received seq for acks; false when already seen or too old.</summary>
            public bool Mark(ushort seq)
            {
                if (!HasAck) { HasAck = true; RxAck = seq; RxAckBits = 0; return true; }
                if (seq == RxAck) return false;
                if (Packet.SeqNewer(seq, RxAck)) { int sh = (ushort)(seq - RxAck); RxAckBits = sh >= 32 ? 0 : (RxAckBits << sh) | (1u << (sh - 1)); RxAck = seq; return true; }
                int d = (ushort)(RxAck - seq); if (d > 32) return false;
                uint bit = 1u << (d - 1); if ((RxAckBits & bit) != 0) return false; RxAckBits |= bit; return true;
            }
        }
        sealed class Partial { public Channel Channel; public byte[][] Parts; public int Got; public double Started; }

        ushort _seqTx; bool _hasSeqRx; ushort _seqRx;
        readonly List<byte[]> _batch = new List<byte[]>(); int _batchLen;
        readonly Dictionary<byte, Stream> _streams = new Dictionary<byte, Stream>();
        ushort _fragId; readonly Dictionary<ushort, Partial> _partial = new Dictionary<ushort, Partial>();
        readonly Queue<byte[]> _out = new Queue<byte[]>();
        public ushort Tick;
        public long Sent, Recv, Retransmits, Dropped;

        public Link()
        {
            _streams[1] = new Stream { Kind = 1, Ordered = true };
            _streams[2] = new Stream { Kind = 2, Ordered = false };
            _streams[Packet.KindFragment] = new Stream { Kind = Packet.KindFragment, Ordered = false };
        }

        static double Now() => System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp() * 1000.0 / System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.Frequency;

        Packet.Header Header(byte kind, ushort seq, bool ackOnly = false, bool batch = false)
        {
            _streams.TryGetValue(kind, out var s); bool hasAck = s != null && s.HasAck;
            return new Packet.Header { Kind = kind, AckOnly = ackOnly, HasAck = hasAck, Batch = batch, Seq = seq, Ack = hasAck ? s.RxAck : (ushort)0, AckBits = hasAck ? s.RxAckBits : 0, Tick = Tick };
        }
        void Push(in Packet.Header h, ReadOnlySpan<byte> payload) { _out.Enqueue(Packet.Encode(h, payload)); Sent++; }

        public void Send(Channel channel, byte[] msg)
        {
            if (msg.Length > MaxMessage) throw new ArgumentException("message too large (max 64 KiB)");
            if (msg.Length > Packet.MaxUnfragmented)
            {
                int count = (msg.Length + FragPayload - 1) / FragPayload; if (count > 255) throw new ArgumentException("message too large");
                ushort id = _fragId++;
                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                {
                    int off = i * FragPayload, len = Math.Min(msg.Length - off, FragPayload);
                    var p = new byte[FragHdr + len]; p[0] = (byte)(id >> 8); p[1] = (byte)id; p[2] = (byte)channel; p[3] = (byte)i; p[4] = (byte)count;
                    Array.Copy(msg, off, p, FragHdr, len);
                    _streams[Packet.KindFragment].Pending.Enqueue(p);
                }
                Pump(Now()); return;
            }
            if (channel == Channel.Unreliable)
            {
                if (_batchLen + 2 + msg.Length > Packet.MaxUnfragmented) FlushBatch();
                _batch.Add(msg); _batchLen += 2 + msg.Length; return;
            }
            _streams[(byte)channel].Pending.Enqueue(msg); Pump(Now());
        }

        public void FlushBatch()
        {
            if (_batch.Count == 0) return;
            var p = new byte[_batchLen]; int o = 0;
            foreach (var m in _batch) { p[o++] = (byte)(m.Length >> 8); p[o++] = (byte)m.Length; Array.Copy(m, 0, p, o, m.Length); o += m.Length; }
            _batch.Clear(); _batchLen = 0;
            Push(Header((byte)Channel.Unreliable, _seqTx++, false, true), p);
        }

        void Pump(double now)
        {
            foreach (var s in _streams.Values)
                while (s.Pending.Count > 0 && s.InFlight.Count < Window)
                {
                    var payload = s.Pending.Dequeue(); ushort seq = s.TxSeq++;
                    s.InFlight.Add(new InFlight { Seq = seq, Payload = payload, SentAt = now, Retries = 0 });
                    Push(Header(s.Kind, seq), payload);
                }
        }

        /// <summary>Timer (call every few ms): retransmits and flushes the batch. False when the link is dead.</summary>
        public bool Poll()
        {
            double now = Now();
            FlushBatch();
            foreach (var s in _streams.Values)
            {
                double rto = s.Rto();
                foreach (var p in s.InFlight)
                    if (now - p.SentAt >= rto)
                    {
                        if (p.Retries >= MaxRetries) return false;
                        p.Retries++; p.SentAt = now; Retransmits++;
                        Push(Header(s.Kind, p.Seq), p.Payload);
                    }
            }
            if (_partial.Count > 0)
            {
                var stale = new List<ushort>();
                foreach (var kv in _partial) if (now - kv.Value.Started > 10000) stale.Add(kv.Key);
                foreach (var k in stale) _partial.Remove(k);
            }
            Pump(now);
            return true;
        }

        public bool TryDequeueOutgoing(out byte[] d) { if (_out.Count > 0) { d = _out.Dequeue(); return true; } d = null; return false; }

        bool Reassemble(ArraySegment<byte> frag, double now, ushort tick, out Received r)
        {
            r = default;
            if (frag.Count < FragHdr) return false;
            var b = frag.Array; int o = frag.Offset;
            ushort id = (ushort)((b[o] << 8) | b[o + 1]); var channel = (Channel)b[o + 2]; int index = b[o + 3], count = b[o + 4];
            if (count == 0 || index >= count) return false;
            if (!_partial.TryGetValue(id, out var p)) { if (_partial.Count >= 64) return false; p = new Partial { Channel = channel, Parts = new byte[count][], Started = now }; _partial[id] = p; }
            if (p.Parts.Length != count || p.Channel != channel) { _partial.Remove(id); return false; }
            if (p.Parts[index] == null) { var chunk = new byte[frag.Count - FragHdr]; Array.Copy(b, o + FragHdr, chunk, 0, chunk.Length); p.Parts[index] = chunk; p.Got++; }
            if (p.Got < count) return false;
            _partial.Remove(id);
            int total = 0; foreach (var x in p.Parts) total += x.Length;
            var msg = new byte[total]; int w = 0; foreach (var x in p.Parts) { Array.Copy(x, 0, msg, w, x.Length); w += x.Length; }
            r = new Received { Channel = channel, Tick = tick, Payload = msg }; return true;
        }

        public List<Received> Receive(byte[] d)
        {
            var outp = new List<Received>();
            if (!Packet.Decode(d, out var h, out var payload)) return outp;
            double now = Now(); Recv++;
            if (h.Kind == (byte)Channel.Unreliable)
            {
                if (!_hasSeqRx || Packet.SeqNewer(h.Seq, _seqRx))
                {
                    _hasSeqRx = true; _seqRx = h.Seq;
                    if (h.Batch)
                    {
                        int o = payload.Offset, end = payload.Offset + payload.Count; var b = payload.Array;
                        while (o + 2 <= end) { int n = (b[o] << 8) | b[o + 1]; o += 2; if (o + n > end) break; var m = new byte[n]; Array.Copy(b, o, m, 0, n); o += n; outp.Add(new Received { Channel = Channel.Unreliable, Tick = h.Tick, Payload = m }); }
                    }
                    else { var m = new byte[payload.Count]; Array.Copy(payload.Array, payload.Offset, m, 0, m.Length); outp.Add(new Received { Channel = Channel.Unreliable, Tick = h.Tick, Payload = m }); }
                }
                else Dropped++;
                return outp;
            }
            if (!_streams.TryGetValue(h.Kind, out var s)) return outp;
            if (h.HasAck) { s.OnAck(h.Ack, h.AckBits, now); Pump(now); }
            if (!h.AckOnly)
            {
                if (s.Mark(h.Seq))
                {
                    var copy = new byte[payload.Count]; Array.Copy(payload.Array, payload.Offset, copy, 0, copy.Length);
                    if (s.Ordered)
                    {
                        s.Buffer[h.Seq] = copy;
                        while (s.Buffer.TryGetValue(s.Next, out var m)) { Deliver(s, m, h.Tick, now, outp); s.Buffer.Remove(s.Next); s.Next++; }
                    }
                    else Deliver(s, copy, h.Tick, now, outp);
                }
                Push(Header(s.Kind, s.TxSeq, true), ReadOnlySpan<byte>.Empty);
            }
            return outp;
        }

        void Deliver(Stream s, byte[] p, ushort tick, double now, List<Received> outp)
        {
            if (s.Kind == Packet.KindFragment) { if (Reassemble(new ArraySegment<byte>(p), now, tick, out var r)) outp.Add(r); }
            else outp.Add(new Received { Channel = (Channel)s.Kind, Tick = tick, Payload = p });
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/LockstepClient.cs`:

```cs
// Client side of lockstep rooms: confirmed input bundles in tick order, late-join catch-up
// (checkpoint + journal tail), hash reports, checkpoint uploads when the node asks the master.
// The game owns the deterministic simulation: step it in OnTick, hash it, restore it in OnRestore.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    public sealed class LockstepClient
    {
        public const byte KindInput = 0x10, KindBundle = 0x20, KindHash = 0x21, KindCheckpoint = 0x22, KindCheckpointReq = 0x23, KindCatchup = 0x24, KindInputStats = 0x25, KindDumpReq = 0x26, KindDump = 0x27;

        /// <summary>Confirmed inputs for one tick, in tick order, every tick exactly once (empty dictionary = nobody sent).</summary>
        public event Action<uint, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>> OnTick;
        /// <summary>Catch-up start: restore the game state from this checkpoint (state empty at tick 0 = fresh start).</summary>
        public event Action<uint, ulong, byte[]> OnRestore;
        /// <summary>The node asked us (the master) for the confirmed state at a tick ≤ this one: answer with SendCheckpoint.</summary>
        public event Action<uint> OnCheckpointRequested;
        /// <summary>The node flagged a desync and wants our state at this tick (from your rollback history): answer with SendDump, or ignore.</summary>
        public event Action<uint> OnDumpRequested;

        readonly Action<Channel, byte[]> _send;
        readonly SortedDictionary<uint, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>> _pending = new SortedDictionary<uint, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>>();
        readonly List<byte[]> _recentInputs = new List<byte[]>();
        bool _started; uint _next; uint _lastInput;
        /// <summary>Next tick to be delivered to OnTick.</summary>
        public uint ConfirmedTick => _next;
        /// <summary>Newest tick the node has bundled (+1).</summary>
        public uint ServerTick { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>How many ticks ahead of the server clock inputs are stamped (≥1). Tuned automatically between
        /// InputDelayMin and InputDelayMax from the node's input-margin reports when AdaptiveDelay is on.</summary>
        public uint InputDelay = 2;
        public uint InputDelayMin = 1, InputDelayMax = 8;
        public bool AdaptiveDelay = true;
        /// <summary>Inputs repeated per datagram (1..8): higher survives more loss at the cost of bytes.</summary>
        public int InputRedundancy = 3;
        /// <summary>Last reported margin (ticks of slack; negative = inputs arrived late) and late inputs so far.</summary>
        public sbyte LastMargin; public long LateInputs;
        int _slackStreak;
        public long Delivered, Catchups, Dropped;

        public LockstepClient(Action<Channel, byte[]> send) { _send = send; }

        /// <summary>Feed every data-path payload from a lockstep room. Returns false when it was not a lockstep frame.</summary>
        public bool Receive(byte[] p)
        {
            if (p.Length == 0) return false;
            switch (p[0])
            {
                case KindCatchup:
                    {
                        if (p.Length < 17) return true;
                        uint tick = U32(p, 1); ulong hash = U64(p, 5); int len = (int)U32(p, 13);
                        var state = new byte[Math.Min(len, p.Length - 17)]; Array.Copy(p, 17, state, 0, state.Length);
                        _pending.Clear(); _next = tick; _started = true; Catchups++;
                        OnRestore?.Invoke(tick, hash, state);
                        return true;
                    }
                case KindBundle:
                    {
                        if (p.Length < 2) return true;
                        int n = p[1], o = 2;
                        for (int i = 0; i < n && o + 2 <= p.Length; i++)
                        {
                            int len = (p[o] << 8) | p[o + 1]; o += 2; if (o + len > p.Length) break;
                            DecodeBundle(p, o, len); o += len;
                        }
                        Drain();
                        return true;
                    }
                case KindCheckpointReq:
                    if (p.Length >= 5) OnCheckpointRequested?.Invoke(U32(p, 1));
                    return true;
                case KindDumpReq:
                    if (p.Length >= 5) OnDumpRequested?.Invoke(U32(p, 1));
                    return true;
                case KindInputStats:
                    if (p.Length >= 7) OnInputStats((sbyte)p[5], p[6]);
                    return true;
                case KindCheckpoint: case KindHash: case KindInput:
                    return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>Raises the input delay as soon as inputs arrive late, lowers it one tick at a time after three
        /// consecutive reports with two or more ticks of slack.</summary>
        internal void OnInputStats(sbyte margin, byte late)
        {
            LastMargin = margin; LateInputs += late;
            if (!AdaptiveDelay) return;
            if (margin < 0) { InputDelay = Math.Min(InputDelayMax, InputDelay + (uint)Math.Min(4, -margin)); _slackStreak = 0; }
            else if (margin >= 2) { if (++_slackStreak >= 3) { _slackStreak = 0; if (InputDelay > InputDelayMin) InputDelay--; } }
            else _slackStreak = 0;
        }

        void DecodeBundle(byte[] b, int o, int len)
        {
            int end = o + len; if (len < 6 || b[o] != KindBundle) return;
            uint t = U32(b, o + 1); int k = b[o + 5]; o += 6;
            if (t + 1 > ServerTick) ServerTick = t + 1;
            if (!_started) { _started = true; _next = t; }
            if (t < _next || _pending.ContainsKey(t)) return;
            var inputs = new Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>(k);
            for (int i = 0; i < k && o + 3 <= end; i++)
            {
                ushort a = (ushort)((b[o] << 8) | b[o + 1]); int l = b[o + 2]; o += 3; if (o + l > end) break;
                var d = new byte[l]; Array.Copy(b, o, d, 0, l); o += l; inputs[a] = d;
            }
            _pending[t] = inputs;
        }

        void Drain()
        {
            while (_pending.TryGetValue(_next, out var inputs))
            {
                _pending.Remove(_next); var t = _next; _next++; Delivered++;
                OnTick?.Invoke(t, inputs);
            }
            // Ticks older than the redundancy window that never arrived are lost for good only if the
            // node skipped them; the node re-sends 3 ticks per datagram and the journal tail is reliable.
            while (_pending.Count > 0)
            {
                var e = _pending.GetEnumerator(); e.MoveNext(); var oldest = e.Current.Key;
                if (oldest <= _next + 600) break;
                _pending.Remove(oldest); Dropped++;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Queues this tick's local input (sent with the previous two for redundancy).</summary>
        public void SendInput(byte[] input)
        {
            uint tick = Math.Max(ServerTick + InputDelay, _lastInput + 1); _lastInput = tick;
            _recentInputs.Add(input); int keep = Math.Max(1, Math.Min(8, InputRedundancy)); while (_recentInputs.Count > keep) _recentInputs.RemoveAt(0);
            _send(Channel.Unreliable, SyncWorld.EncodeInput(tick - (uint)(_recentInputs.Count - 1), _recentInputs));
        }

        public void ReportHash(uint tick, ulong hash)
        {
            var b = new byte[13]; b[0] = KindHash; W32(b, 1, tick); W64(b, 5, hash); _send(Channel.Unreliable, b);
        }

        /// <summary>Master only, in answer to OnCheckpointRequested: confirmed state at `tick` (≤ requested).</summary>
        public void SendCheckpoint(uint tick, ulong hash, byte[] state)
        {
            var b = new byte[13 + state.Length]; b[0] = KindCheckpoint; W32(b, 1, tick); W64(b, 5, hash); Array.Copy(state, 0, b, 13, state.Length);
            _send(Channel.Reliable, b);
        }

        /// <summary>Answer to OnDumpRequested: your state at `tick` (≤ 60 KiB) — stored by the node for 24 h next to
        /// the master's, so the two can be diffed offline.</summary>
        public void SendDump(uint tick, ulong hash, byte[] state)
        {
            var b = new byte[13 + state.Length]; b[0] = KindDump; W32(b, 1, tick); W64(b, 5, hash); Array.Copy(state, 0, b, 13, state.Length);
            _send(Channel.Reliable, b);
        }

        /// <summary>FNV-1a 64 over bytes: a simple, portable state hash.</summary>
        public static ulong Fnv1a(byte[] data) { ulong h = 14695981039346656037UL; foreach (var x in data) { h ^= x; h *= 1099511628211UL; } return h; }

        static uint U32(byte[] b, int o) => ((uint)b[o] << 24) | ((uint)b[o + 1] << 16) | ((uint)b[o + 2] << 8) | b[o + 3];
        static ulong U64(byte[] b, int o) => ((ulong)U32(b, o) << 32) | U32(b, o + 4);
        static void W32(byte[] b, int o, uint v) { b[o] = (byte)(v >> 24); b[o + 1] = (byte)(v >> 16); b[o + 2] = (byte)(v >> 8); b[o + 3] = (byte)v; }
        static void W64(byte[] b, int o, ulong v) { W32(b, o, (uint)(v >> 32)); W32(b, o + 4, (uint)v); }
    }
}
```
