`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/LockstepRollback.cs`:

```cs
// Predict/rollback on top of LockstepClient (same core as the Rust/Web SDKs): the game runs ahead of
// the confirmed tick with predicted remote inputs (each actor's last confirmed input, repeated) and
// its own inputs as sent, keeps a snapshot per predicted tick, and when a confirmed tick differs from
// the prediction restores the snapshot, re-steps it and re-predicts the ticks after it.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    /// <summary>The game's deterministic simulation: step one tick, snapshot, restore.</summary>
    public interface ISimulation<TSnapshot>
    {
        void Step(uint tick, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> inputs);
        TSnapshot Snapshot();
        void Restore(TSnapshot s);
    }

    public sealed class LockstepRollback<TSnapshot>
    {
        readonly ISimulation<TSnapshot> _sim; readonly ushort _localActor;
        readonly Dictionary<uint, TSnapshot> _history = new Dictionary<uint, TSnapshot>();
        readonly Dictionary<uint, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>> _predicted = new Dictionary<uint, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>>();
        readonly Dictionary<uint, byte[]> _localInputs = new Dictionary<uint, byte[]>();
        readonly Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> _lastKnown = new Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>();
        byte[] _lastLocal;

        /// <summary>Ticks the simulation may run ahead of the confirmed tick.</summary>
        public uint MaxPrediction;
        /// <summary>First tick not yet confirmed by the node.</summary>
        public uint ConfirmedTick { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>Next tick the simulation will run; HeadTick - ConfirmedTick ticks are predicted.</summary>
        public uint HeadTick { get; private set; }
        public long Rollbacks, ResimulatedTicks, PredictedTicks;
        /// <summary>State after the last confirmed tick: hash <em>this</em> for ReportHash, never the predicted head.</summary>
        public TSnapshot ConfirmedSnapshot => _history[ConfirmedTick];

        /// <param name="sim">Must be at tick <paramref name="start"/> (fresh game, or restored from a catch-up checkpoint).</param>
        public LockstepRollback(ISimulation<TSnapshot> sim, ushort localActor, uint start = 0, uint maxPrediction = 8)
        {
            _sim = sim; _localActor = localActor; MaxPrediction = Math.Max(1u, maxPrediction);
            ConfirmedTick = HeadTick = start; _history[start] = sim.Snapshot();
        }

        /// <summary>After the game restored a catch-up checkpoint at <paramref name="tick"/>: forget every prediction.</summary>
        public void Reset(uint tick)
        {
            _history.Clear(); _history[tick] = _sim.Snapshot(); _predicted.Clear(); _localInputs.Clear();
            ConfirmedTick = HeadTick = tick;
        }

        /// <summary>Remember the input sent stamped with <paramref name="tick"/> (what LockstepClient.SendInput stamped) so our own prediction uses exactly it.</summary>
        public void LocalInput(uint tick, byte[] input) { _lastLocal = input; _localInputs[tick] = input; }

        /// <summary>Runs the simulation ahead to <paramref name="target"/> (exclusive), bounded by MaxPrediction.</summary>
        public void Predict(uint target)
        {
            target = Math.Min(target, ConfirmedTick + Math.Max(1u, MaxPrediction));
            while (HeadTick < target)
            {
                uint t = HeadTick; var inputs = Guess(t);
                _sim.Step(t, inputs); _predicted[t] = inputs; HeadTick = t + 1; _history[HeadTick] = _sim.Snapshot(); PredictedTicks++;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Feeds a confirmed tick (LockstepClient.OnTick). True when a rollback happened.</summary>
        public bool Confirm(uint tick, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> inputs)
        {
            if (tick != ConfirmedTick) return false;
            foreach (var kv in inputs) _lastKnown[kv.Key] = kv.Value;
            _localInputs.Remove(tick);
            bool rolled = false;
            if (tick >= HeadTick) { _sim.Step(tick, inputs); HeadTick = tick + 1; _history[HeadTick] = _sim.Snapshot(); }
            else if (!_predicted.TryGetValue(tick, out var guess) || !SameInputs(guess, inputs))
            {
                rolled = true; Rollbacks++;
                _sim.Restore(_history[tick]); _sim.Step(tick, inputs); _history[tick + 1] = _sim.Snapshot();
                uint oldHead = HeadTick; HeadTick = tick + 1;
                foreach (var t in _predicted.Keys.Where(k => k > tick).ToList()) _predicted.Remove(t);
                ResimulatedTicks += oldHead - HeadTick;
                Predict(oldHead);
            }
            ConfirmedTick = tick + 1; _predicted.Remove(tick); _history.Remove(tick);
            return rolled;
        }

        Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> Guess(uint tick)
        {
            var g = new Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>(_lastKnown);
            var mine = _localInputs.TryGetValue(tick, out var exact) ? exact : _lastLocal;
            if (mine != null) g[_localActor] = mine; else g.Remove(_localActor);
            return g;
        }

        static bool SameInputs(Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> a, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> b)
        {
            if (a.Count != b.Count) return false;
            foreach (var kv in a) { if (!b.TryGetValue(kv.Key, out var w) || !w.SequenceEqual(kv.Value)) return false; }
            return true;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>What <see cref="ReplayRing{TSnapshot}.Window"/> hands back: restore Snapshot, then step Inputs from Start.</summary>
    public struct ReplayWindow<TSnapshot> { public uint Start; public TSnapshot Snapshot; public List<Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>> Inputs; }

    /// <summary>Instant replay (kill cam) buffer: the last <c>keep</c> confirmed ticks' inputs plus a snapshot of the confirmed state every <c>every</c> ticks. Feed it from the confirmed path (after Confirm, with ConfirmedSnapshot).</summary>
    public sealed class ReplayRing<TSnapshot>
    {
        readonly int _keep; readonly uint _every; uint _first;
        readonly List<Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>> _inputs = new List<Dictionary<ushort, byte[]>>();
        readonly SortedDictionary<uint, TSnapshot> _snaps = new SortedDictionary<uint, TSnapshot>();
        public ReplayRing(int keepTicks = 300, uint snapshotEvery = 10) { _keep = Math.Max(1, keepTicks); _every = Math.Max(1u, snapshotEvery); }

        /// <summary>Records confirmed <paramref name="tick"/> with its inputs and the confirmed state <em>before</em> it (taken lazily on snapshot boundaries). A gap resets the ring.</summary>
        public void Record(uint tick, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> inputs, Func<TSnapshot> stateBefore)
        {
            if (_inputs.Count == 0 || _first + (uint)_inputs.Count != tick) { _inputs.Clear(); _snaps.Clear(); _first = tick; }
            if (_snaps.Count == 0 || tick % _every == 0) _snaps[tick] = stateBefore();
            _inputs.Add(inputs);
            if (_inputs.Count > _keep) { int drop = _inputs.Count - _keep; _inputs.RemoveRange(0, drop); _first += (uint)drop; }
            uint anchor = 0; bool found = false;
            foreach (var k in _snaps.Keys) { if (k <= _first) { anchor = k; found = true; } else break; }
            if (found) foreach (var k in _snaps.Keys.Where(k => k < anchor).ToList()) _snaps.Remove(k);
        }
        /// <summary>Oldest tick that can still be replayed, or null.</summary>
        public uint? Oldest => _inputs.Count == 0 ? (uint?)null : _snaps.Keys.First();
        /// <summary>Everything needed to re-simulate from the newest snapshot at or before <paramref name="from"/> (clamped to what is kept) through the last recorded tick.</summary>
        public ReplayWindow<TSnapshot>? Window(uint from)
        {
            if (_inputs.Count == 0) return null;
            uint start = _snaps.Keys.First();
            foreach (var k in _snaps.Keys) { if (k <= from) start = k; else break; }
            int skip = (int)Math.Max(0, (long)start - _first);
            return new ReplayWindow<TSnapshot> { Start = start, Snapshot = _snaps[start], Inputs = _inputs.Skip(skip).ToList() };
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/ManagedClient.cs`:

```cs
// Pure C# Aurix Net client: no native library, works on every Unity platform including WebGL
// (via the WebSocket tunnel). Control channel = WebSocket JSON, data = WebSocket binary tunnel
// using the same packet format as QUIC. Call Poll() once per frame from the main thread.
using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.WebSockets;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    public enum CacheOp : byte { None = 0, Add = 1, Remove = 2 }

    public sealed class ManagedClient : IDisposable
    {
        ClientWebSocket _ws;
        readonly Link _link = new Link();
        readonly ConcurrentQueue<object> _inbox = new ConcurrentQueue<object>();
        readonly SemaphoreSlim _sendLock = new SemaphoreSlim(1, 1);
        CancellationTokenSource _cts;
        bool _dataReady;

        public int Actor { get; private set; } = -1;
        /// <summary>URL given to ConnectAsync, the grant and the last join message: what RejoinAsync needs.</summary>
        public string EntryUrl { get; private set; }
        public string Grant { get; private set; }
        public string LastJoinJson { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>The node shut down and handed the room to another node: call RejoinAsync (NetRunner does).</summary>
        public event Action OnRehost;
        /// <summary>System notice from the operator or game backend: (text, level = "info" | "warn").</summary>
        public event Action<string, string> OnNotice;
        public string JoinedJson { get; private set; }
        public string RoomMode { get; private set; }

        /// <summary>Raw control message (JSON text).</summary>
        public event Action<string> OnControl;
        /// <summary>Data-path message (channel, server tick, payload).</summary>
        public event Action<Channel, ushort, byte[]> OnData;
        /// <summary>Relay event decoded from the data path.</summary>
        public event Action<EventFrame> OnEvent;
        public event Action OnDataReady;
        public event Action<string> OnClosed;

        sealed class Closed { public string Reason; }
        sealed class Text { public string Json; }
        sealed class Bin { public byte[] Data; }

        /// <summary>Opens the control channel and authenticates with a grant.</summary>
        public static async Task<ManagedClient> ConnectAsync(string httpUrl, string grant, int timeoutMs = 10000)
        {
            var c = new ManagedClient { _ws = new ClientWebSocket(), _cts = new CancellationTokenSource(), EntryUrl = httpUrl, Grant = grant };
            var url = (httpUrl.StartsWith("https") ? "wss" : "ws") + httpUrl.Substring(httpUrl.IndexOf(':')) + "/ws";
            using (var t = new CancellationTokenSource(timeoutMs)) await c._ws.ConnectAsync(new Uri(url), t.Token);
            _ = c.ReadLoop();
            await c.SendControlAsync("{\"t\":\"auth\",\"grant\":" + Json.Str(grant) + "}");
            await c.WaitForAsync("authed", timeoutMs);
            return c;
        }

        /// <summary>connect + join, following one `room_elsewhere:&lt;url&gt;` redirect.</summary>
        public static async Task<ManagedClient> ConnectAndJoinAsync(string httpUrl, string grant, string joinJson, int timeoutMs = 10000)
        {
            var c = await ConnectAsync(httpUrl, grant, timeoutMs);
            try { await c.JoinRawAsync(joinJson, timeoutMs); return c; }
            catch (NetException e) when (e.Message.Contains("room_elsewhere:"))
            {
                c.Dispose();
                var url = e.Message.Substring(e.Message.IndexOf("room_elsewhere:") + 15).Trim();
                var c2 = await ConnectAsync(url, grant, timeoutMs);
                await c2.JoinRawAsync(joinJson, timeoutMs);
                return c2;
            }
        }

        public Task<int> JoinOrCreateAsync(string name, string mode = "relay", int maxPlayers = 8, string propsJson = null, string[] reserved = null)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("{\"t\":\"join_or_create\",\"name\":").Append(Json.Str(name))
                .Append(",\"mode\":\"").Append(mode).Append("\",\"max_players\":").Append(maxPlayers);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propsJson)) sb.Append(",\"props\":").Append(propsJson);
            if (reserved != null && reserved.Length > 0)
            {
                sb.Append(",\"reserved\":[");
                for (int i = 0; i < reserved.Length; i++) { if (i > 0) sb.Append(','); sb.Append(Json.Str(reserved[i])); }
                sb.Append(']');
            }
            return JoinRawAsync(sb.Append('}').ToString());
        }

        /// <summary>Joins a random open room. <paramref name="filterJson"/> must equal room props exactly,
        /// <paramref name="expr"/> is a SQL-like condition on lobby props ("map = 'dust' AND skill <= 1500"),
        /// <paramref name="matchType"/> is "fill" (default), "serial" or "random".</summary>
        public Task<int> JoinRandomAsync(string filterJson = null, string expr = null, string matchType = null)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("{\"t\":\"join_random\"");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filterJson)) sb.Append(",\"filter\":").Append(filterJson);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(expr)) sb.Append(",\"expr\":").Append(Json.Str(expr));
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(matchType)) sb.Append(",\"match_type\":").Append(Json.Str(matchType));
            return JoinRawAsync(sb.Append('}').ToString());
        }

        public Task<int> JoinAsync(string name, string schemaHash = null, bool spectator = false)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("{\"t\":\"join\",\"name\":").Append(Json.Str(name));
            if (schemaHash != null) sb.Append(",\"schema_hash\":").Append(Json.Str(schemaHash));
            if (spectator) sb.Append(",\"spectator\":true");
            return JoinRawAsync(sb.Append('}').ToString());
        }

        /// <summary>Any join-like control message; opens the data path (ticket first) and waits for the server's ack.</summary>
        /// <summary>After a rehost: a fresh client in the same room with the same grant (entry URL, then fallbacks).</summary>
        public async Task<ManagedClient> RejoinAsync(params string[] fallbackUrls)
        {
            if (LastJoinJson == null) throw new NetException("rejoin: never joined");
            var msg = LastJoinJson.Replace("\"t\":\"join_or_create\"", "\"t\":\"join\"");
            Dispose();
            Exception last = null;
            foreach (var url in new[] { EntryUrl }.Concat(fallbackUrls))
            {
                try { return await ConnectAndJoinAsync(url, Grant, msg); } catch (Exception e) { last = e; }
            }
            throw last;
        }

        public async Task<int> JoinRawAsync(string json, int timeoutMs = 10000)
        {
            LastJoinJson = json;
            await SendControlAsync(json);
            var joined = await WaitForAsync("joined", timeoutMs);
            JoinedJson = joined;
            Actor = (int)Json.Num(joined, "actor");
            RoomMode = Json.Str(joined, "mode");
            var data = Json.Obj(joined, "data");
            if (Json.Bool(data, "ws_tunnel") == false) throw new NetException("node has the WebSocket tunnel disabled");
            var ticket = Convert.FromBase64String(Json.Str(data, "ticket"));
            await SendBinaryAsync(ticket);
            var deadline = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(timeoutMs);
            while (!_dataReady) { if (DateTime.UtcNow > deadline) throw new NetException("data path timeout"); await Task.Delay(5); Poll(); }
            return Actor;
        }

        public Task SendControlAsync(string json) => SendAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json), WebSocketMessageType.Text);
        Task SendBinaryAsync(byte[] b) => SendAsync(b, WebSocketMessageType.Binary);
        async Task SendAsync(byte[] b, WebSocketMessageType kind)
        {
            await _sendLock.WaitAsync();
            try { if (_ws.State == WebSocketState.Open) await _ws.SendAsync(new ArraySegment<byte>(b), kind, true, _cts.Token); }
            finally { _sendLock.Release(); }
        }

        public void SendData(Channel channel, byte[] payload) { _link.Send(channel, payload); if (channel != Channel.Unreliable) FlushLink(); }
        /// <param name="cache">Add keeps the event for late joiners (current cache slice, see CacheSliceAsync); Remove drops your earlier cached events with the same code.</param>
        public void SendEvent(byte code, byte[] payload, Target target = Target.Others, bool reliable = false, ushort[] actors = null, ushort? group = null, CacheOp cache = CacheOp.None)
            => SendData(reliable || cache != CacheOp.None ? Channel.Reliable : Channel.Unreliable, Event.Encode(code, payload, target, actors, group, cache));
        /// <summary>Relay event-cache slices: "increase" opens the next slice, "set" picks one, "purge" drops one slice, "purge_up_to" every slice up to index.</summary>
        public Task CacheSliceAsync(string op, ushort? index = null) =>
            SendControlAsync("{\"t\":\"cache_slice\",\"op\":\"" + op + "\"" + (index.HasValue ? ",\"index\":" + index.Value : "") + "}");

        /// <summary>Pushes queued unreliable messages; call at the end of the frame.</summary>
        public void Flush() { _link.FlushBatch(); FlushLink(); }

        void FlushLink() { while (_link.TryDequeueOutgoing(out var d)) _ = SendBinaryAsync(d); }

        /// <summary>Dispatches pending messages on the calling thread. Call every frame.</summary>
        public int Poll(int max = 256)
        {
            int n = 0;
            if (!_link.Poll()) { _inbox.Enqueue(new Closed { Reason = "link dead" }); }
            FlushLink();
            while (n < max && _inbox.TryDequeue(out var m))
            {
                n++;
                switch (m)
                {
                    case Text t:
                        OnControl?.Invoke(t.Json);
                        if (Json.Str(t.Json, "t") == "left" && Json.Str(t.Json, "reason") == "rehost") OnRehost?.Invoke();
                        if (Json.Str(t.Json, "t") == "notice") OnNotice?.Invoke(Json.Str(t.Json, "text"), Json.Str(t.Json, "level"));
                        break;
                    case Bin b:
                        foreach (var r in _link.Receive(b.Data))
                        {
                            if (r.Payload.Length == 0) { if (!_dataReady) { _dataReady = true; OnDataReady?.Invoke(); } continue; }
                            OnData?.Invoke(r.Channel, r.Tick, r.Payload);
                            byte k = (byte)(r.Payload[0] & 0xf0);
                            if (RoomMode == "relay" || (k != 0x10 && k != 0x20))
                                if (Event.TryDecode(r.Payload, out var f)) OnEvent?.Invoke(f);
                        }
                        FlushLink();
                        break;
                    case Closed c: OnClosed?.Invoke(c.Reason); break;
                }
            }
            return n;
        }

        public Task LeaveAsync() => SendControlAsync("{\"t\":\"leave\"}");
        /// <summary>Sync rooms: steer area-of-interest — extra viewpoints (camera, scope target) and entities forced into view (team mates, objectives). Entity ids as in deltas.</summary>
        /// <summary>Project-wide live rooms/players grouped by the room prop "lobby" (JSON: {rooms, players, lobbies:[{lobby, rooms, players}]}); one per second.</summary>
        public async Task<string> StatsAsync(int timeoutMs = 10000)
        {
            await SendControlAsync("{\"t\":\"stats\"}");
            return await WaitForAsync("stats", timeoutMs);
        }

        /// <summary>Presence of up to 64 players across the fleet (JSON: {friends:[{player, online, room?:{id,name,mode,node}}]}); one per second.</summary>
        public async Task<string> FindFriendsAsync(string[] players, int timeoutMs = 10000)
        {
            var ids = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            foreach (var p in players ?? Array.Empty<string>()) { if (ids.Length > 0) ids.Append(','); ids.Append(Json.Str(p)); }
            await SendControlAsync("{\"t\":\"find_friends\",\"players\":[" + ids + "]}");
            return await WaitForAsync("friends", timeoutMs);
        }

        /// <summary>One-shot room list (JSON {rooms:[{id,name,mode,players,max_players,open,props}]}), optionally filtered by a SQL-like expr on lobby props; one per second.</summary>
        public async Task<string> RoomsAsync(string expr = null, int limit = 100, int timeoutMs = 10000)
        {
            await SendControlAsync("{\"t\":\"get_rooms\",\"expr\":" + (expr == null ? "null" : Json.Str(expr)) + ",\"limit\":" + limit + "}");
            return await WaitForAsync("rooms", timeoutMs);
        }

        int _rpcSeq;
        /// <summary>Call your backend through the node (WebRPC): the project's webhook subscribed to "rpc" is POSTed {name, player_id, actor?, room?, body}; returns the raw rpc_result JSON {id, ok, status?, body, error?}. bodyJson is a JSON literal (≤ 8 KiB); 5 calls/s.</summary>
        public async Task<string> RpcAsync(string name, string bodyJson = "null", int timeoutMs = 10000)
        {
            var id = (uint)System.Threading.Interlocked.Increment(ref _rpcSeq);
            await SendControlAsync("{\"t\":\"rpc\",\"id\":" + id + ",\"name\":" + Json.Str(name) + ",\"body\":" + (string.IsNullOrEmpty(bodyJson) ? "null" : bodyJson) + "}");
            return await WaitForAsync("rpc_result", timeoutMs);
        }

        public Task SetViewAsync(ulong[] viewpoints = null, ulong[] interest = null) =>
            SendControlAsync("{\"t\":\"set_view\",\"viewpoints\":[" + string.Join(",", viewpoints ?? Array.Empty<ulong>()) + "],\"interest\":[" + string.Join(",", interest ?? Array.Empty<ulong>()) + "]}");

        async Task ReadLoop()
        {
            var buf = new byte[64 * 1024]; var acc = new List<byte>();
            try
            {
                while (_ws.State == WebSocketState.Open)
                {
                    var r = await _ws.ReceiveAsync(new ArraySegment<byte>(buf), _cts.Token);
                    if (r.MessageType == WebSocketMessageType.Close) break;
                    for (int i = 0; i < r.Count; i++) acc.Add(buf[i]);
                    if (!r.EndOfMessage) continue;
                    var msg = acc.ToArray(); acc.Clear();
                    if (r.MessageType == WebSocketMessageType.Text) _inbox.Enqueue(new Text { Json = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(msg) });
                    else _inbox.Enqueue(new Bin { Data = msg });
                }
                _inbox.Enqueue(new Closed { Reason = "control channel closed" });
            }
            catch (Exception e) { if (!_cts.IsCancellationRequested) _inbox.Enqueue(new Closed { Reason = e.Message }); }
        }

        /// <summary>Waits for a control message of type `t`, polling the inbox (other messages are dispatched normally).</summary>
        async Task<string> WaitForAsync(string t, int timeoutMs)
        {
            var deadline = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(timeoutMs);
            string got = null, err = null;
            Action<string> h = j => { var ty = Json.Str(j, "t"); if (ty == t) got = j; else if (ty == "error") err = Json.Str(j, "code") + ": " + Json.Str(j, "message"); };
            OnControl += h;
            try
            {
                while (got == null && err == null) { if (DateTime.UtcNow > deadline) throw new NetException("timeout waiting for " + t); Poll(); await Task.Delay(2); }
            }
            finally { OnControl -= h; }
            if (err != null) throw new NetException(err);
            return got;
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            try { _cts?.Cancel(); _ws?.Dispose(); } catch { }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Relay event frame codec (u8 code, u8 flags, u16 from, [u16 group], [u16 n, n*u16], payload).</summary>
    public static class Event
    {
        public static byte[] Encode(byte code, byte[] payload, Target target, ushort[] actors = null, ushort? group = null, CacheOp cache = CacheOp.None)
        {
            int n = target == Target.Actors ? (actors?.Length ?? 0) : 0;
            var b = new byte[4 + (group.HasValue ? 2 : 0) + (target == Target.Actors ? 2 + n * 2 : 0) + (payload?.Length ?? 0)];
            int o = 0; b[o++] = code; b[o++] = (byte)((int)target | (group.HasValue ? 0x10 : 0) | (cache == CacheOp.Add ? 0x04 : cache == CacheOp.Remove ? 0x08 : 0)); b[o++] = 0; b[o++] = 0;
            if (group.HasValue) { b[o++] = (byte)(group.Value >> 8); b[o++] = (byte)group.Value; }
            if (target == Target.Actors) { b[o++] = (byte)(n >> 8); b[o++] = (byte)n; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { b[o++] = (byte)(actors[i] >> 8); b[o++] = (byte)actors[i]; } }
            if (payload != null) Array.Copy(payload, 0, b, o, payload.Length);
            return b;
        }
        public static bool TryDecode(byte[] buf, out EventFrame f) => EventFrame.TryDecode(buf, out f);
    }

    /// <summary>Minimal JSON field access for the handful of control fields the client needs.</summary>
    internal static class Json
    {
        public static string Str(string s)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("\"");
            foreach (var c in s) { if (c == '"' || c == '\\') sb.Append('\\').Append(c); else if (c < 0x20) sb.Append("\\u").Append(((int)c).ToString("x4")); else sb.Append(c); }
            return sb.Append('"').ToString();
        }
        static int Find(string json, string key)
        {
            if (json == null) return -1;
            int i = json.IndexOf("\"" + key + "\"", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (i < 0) return -1;
            i = json.IndexOf(':', i + key.Length + 2); return i < 0 ? -1 : i + 1;
        }
        public static string Str(string json, string key)
        {
            int i = Find(json, key); if (i < 0) return null;
            while (i < json.Length && json[i] == ' ') i++;
            if (i >= json.Length || json[i] != '"') return null;
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (i++; i < json.Length; i++)
            {
                char c = json[i];
                if (c == '"') break;
                if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < json.Length) { c = json[++i]; if (c == 'u' && i + 4 < json.Length) { sb.Append((char)Convert.ToInt32(json.Substring(i + 1, 4), 16)); i += 4; continue; } if (c == 'n') c = '\n'; }
                sb.Append(c);
            }
            return sb.ToString();
        }
        public static double Num(string json, string key)
        {
            int i = Find(json, key); if (i < 0) return double.NaN;
            int j = i; while (j < json.Length && (char.IsDigit(json[j]) || json[j] == '-' || json[j] == '.' || json[j] == ' ')) j++;
            return double.TryParse(json.Substring(i, j - i).Trim(), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var v) ? v : double.NaN;
        }
        public static bool? Bool(string json, string key)
        {
            int i = Find(json, key); if (i < 0) return null;
            var rest = json.Substring(i).TrimStart();
            return rest.StartsWith("true") ? true : rest.StartsWith("false") ? false : (bool?)null;
        }
        /// <summary>Substring of the object value for `key` (brace matched).</summary>
        public static string Obj(string json, string key)
        {
            int i = Find(json, key); if (i < 0) return null;
            while (i < json.Length && json[i] != '{') i++;
            int depth = 0; bool inStr = false;
            for (int j = i; j < json.Length; j++)
            {
                char c = json[j];
                if (inStr) { if (c == '\\') j++; else if (c == '"') inStr = false; continue; }
                if (c == '"') inStr = true; else if (c == '{') depth++; else if (c == '}' && --depth == 0) return json.Substring(i, j - i + 1);
            }
            return null;
        }
    }
}

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    /// <summary>Small JSON helpers exposed for samples/tests (field access on control messages).</summary>
    public static class ManagedClientTestHooks
    {
        public static string Str(string json, string key) => Json.Str(json, key);
        public static double Num(string json, string key) => Json.Num(json, key);
    }
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/Packet.cs`:

```cs
// Aurix Net wire format, pure C# (mirrors net-transport::packet / sdk/web/src/packet.ts).
// 12-byte big-endian header: u8 version, u8 kind|flags, u16 seq, u16 ack, u32 ack_bits, u16 tick.
using System;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    public static class Packet
    {
        public const byte ProtocolVersion = 1;
        public const int HeaderLen = 12;
        public const int MaxDatagram = 1100;
        public const int MaxUnfragmented = MaxDatagram - HeaderLen;
        public const byte FlagAckOnly = 0x80, FlagHasAck = 0x40, FlagBatch = 0x20;
        public const byte KindFragment = 3;

        public struct Header
        {
            public byte Kind; public bool AckOnly, HasAck, Batch;
            public ushort Seq, Ack; public uint AckBits; public ushort Tick;
        }

        public static byte[] Encode(in Header h, ReadOnlySpan<byte> payload)
        {
            var o = new byte[HeaderLen + payload.Length];
            o[0] = ProtocolVersion;
            o[1] = (byte)((h.Kind & 0x1f) | (h.AckOnly ? FlagAckOnly : 0) | (h.HasAck ? FlagHasAck : 0) | (h.Batch ? FlagBatch : 0));
            o[2] = (byte)(h.Seq >> 8); o[3] = (byte)h.Seq; o[4] = (byte)(h.Ack >> 8); o[5] = (byte)h.Ack;
            o[6] = (byte)(h.AckBits >> 24); o[7] = (byte)(h.AckBits >> 16); o[8] = (byte)(h.AckBits >> 8); o[9] = (byte)h.AckBits;
            o[10] = (byte)(h.Tick >> 8); o[11] = (byte)h.Tick;
            payload.CopyTo(o.AsSpan(HeaderLen));
            return o;
        }

        public static bool Decode(byte[] d, out Header h, out ArraySegment<byte> payload)
        {
            h = default; payload = default;
            if (d.Length < HeaderLen || d[0] != ProtocolVersion) return false;
            byte k = d[1];
            h.Kind = (byte)(k & 0x1f); h.AckOnly = (k & FlagAckOnly) != 0; h.HasAck = (k & FlagHasAck) != 0; h.Batch = (k & FlagBatch) != 0;
            h.Seq = (ushort)((d[2] << 8) | d[3]); h.Ack = (ushort)((d[4] << 8) | d[5]);
            h.AckBits = ((uint)d[6] << 24) | ((uint)d[7] << 16) | ((uint)d[8] << 8) | d[9];
            h.Tick = (ushort)((d[10] << 8) | d[11]);
            payload = new ArraySegment<byte>(d, HeaderLen, d.Length - HeaderLen);
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>true when a is a newer 16-bit sequence than b.</summary>
        public static bool SeqNewer(ushort a, ushort b) => a != b && (ushort)(a - b) < 0x8000;
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/Predictor.cs`:

```cs
// Client-side prediction for server-authoritative entities (sync rooms with a WASM `logic` module).
// The local player applies its own input immediately with the same step function the server runs,
// keeps the inputs it has not seen confirmed yet, and when the server's state for tick T arrives it
// re-simulates every later input on top of it — so a mismatch (hit a wall the client did not know
// about, got pushed) is corrected without waiting a round trip, and a correct guess costs nothing.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    public sealed class Predictor<TState>
    {
        struct Frame { public uint Tick; public byte[] Input; public TState After; }

        readonly Func<TState, byte[], TState> _step;
        readonly Func<TState, TState, bool> _diverged;
        readonly List<Frame> _pending = new List<Frame>();
        readonly int _capacity;
        TState _confirmed;

        /// <summary>State after the newest local input (what to render for the local player).</summary>
        public TState Predicted { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>Last server tick that was reconciled.</summary>
        public uint ConfirmedTick { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>How many inputs are in flight (sent, not yet confirmed by a server state).</summary>
        public int Pending => _pending.Count;
        /// <summary>Corrections applied so far (server state differed from the prediction).</summary>
        public long Mispredictions { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>Fires after a correction with the state the client had predicted for that tick and the
        /// authoritative one; use it to smooth the visual snap (error offset decayed over a few frames).</summary>
        public event Action<TState, TState> OnCorrected;

        /// <param name="step">Deterministic simulation step: state + one tick of input → next state. Must be
        /// the same rule the server logic applies for this entity.</param>
        /// <param name="diverged">Returns true when the authoritative state differs from the prediction
        /// enough to replay (null = always replay; cheap for small states).</param>
        /// <param name="capacity">Max inputs kept in flight; older ones are dropped (the server is that far
        /// behind, prediction is meaningless anyway).</param>
        public Predictor(TState initial, Func<TState, byte[], TState> step, Func<TState, TState, bool> diverged = null, int capacity = 128)
        {
            Predicted = initial; _confirmed = initial; _step = step ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(step)); _diverged = diverged; _capacity = Math.Max(1, capacity);
        }

        /// <summary>Applies a local input for <paramref name="tick"/> (the tick you sent it with) and remembers it.</summary>
        public TState Record(uint tick, byte[] input)
        {
            Predicted = _step(Predicted, input);
            _pending.Add(new Frame { Tick = tick, Input = input, After = Predicted });
            while (_pending.Count > _capacity) _pending.RemoveAt(0);
            return Predicted;
        }

        /// <summary>Feeds the authoritative state the server produced after consuming inputs up to
        /// <paramref name="tick"/>. Returns true when the prediction for that tick was wrong and the
        /// pending inputs were replayed on top of the server state.</summary>
        public bool Reconcile(uint tick, TState authoritative)
        {
            if (tick < ConfirmedTick) return false; // stale (reordered) state
            ConfirmedTick = tick;
            int confirmed = 0;
            while (confirmed < _pending.Count && _pending[confirmed].Tick <= tick) confirmed++;
            TState predictedThen = confirmed > 0 ? _pending[confirmed - 1].After : _confirmed;
            _pending.RemoveRange(0, confirmed);
            _confirmed = authoritative;
            bool wrong = _diverged != null ? _diverged(authoritative, predictedThen) : !Equals(authoritative, predictedThen);
            if (!wrong) return false;
            var s = authoritative;
            for (int i = 0; i < _pending.Count; i++) { s = _step(s, _pending[i].Input); var f = _pending[i]; f.After = s; _pending[i] = f; }
            Predicted = s;
            Mispredictions++;
            OnCorrected?.Invoke(predictedThen, authoritative);
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>Forget everything (teleport, respawn, rehost).</summary>
        public void Reset(TState state) { _pending.Clear(); Predicted = state; _confirmed = state; }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/Schema.cs`:

```cs
// IDL parser, same grammar as net-wire::schema (one statement per line, // comments).
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    public enum FieldKind { Bool, UInt, Int, F32, Quant, Vec2, Vec3, Quat, String, Bytes }
    public sealed class FieldType { public FieldKind Kind; public int Bits; public float Min, Max, Res; public uint Max_; }
    public sealed class Field { public string Name; public FieldType Type; }
    public sealed class ComponentDef { public ushort Id; public string Name; public bool OwnerOnly, Global; public List<Field> Fields = new List<Field>(); public int IndexOf(string f) { for (int i = 0; i < Fields.Count; i++) if (Fields[i].Name == f) return i; return -1; } }

    public sealed class Schema
    {
        public List<ComponentDef> Components = new List<ComponentDef>();
        public ComponentDef ById(int id) => id >= 0 && id < Components.Count ? Components[id] : null;
        public ComponentDef ByName(string n) { foreach (var c in Components) if (c.Name == n) return c; return null; }
        public int ComponentIdBits => Math.Max(1, 64 - Bits.LeadingZeros((ulong)Math.Max(2, Components.Count) - 1));

        public static Schema Parse(string text)
        {
            var s = new Schema(); ComponentDef cur = null; int line = 0;
            foreach (var raw in text.Split('\n'))
            {
                line++;
                var l = raw; int c = l.IndexOf("//", StringComparison.Ordinal); if (c >= 0) l = l.Substring(0, c); l = l.Trim();
                if (l.Length == 0) continue;
                if (l.StartsWith("component "))
                {
                    if (cur != null) throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: nested component");
                    var rest = l.Substring(10).Trim();
                    if (!rest.EndsWith("{")) throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: expected '{{'");
                    var parts = rest.Substring(0, rest.Length - 1).Trim().Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                    cur = new ComponentDef { Id = (ushort)s.Components.Count, Name = parts[0] };
                    for (int i = 1; i < parts.Length; i++) { if (parts[i] == "@owner_only") cur.OwnerOnly = true; else if (parts[i] == "@global") cur.Global = true; else throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: unknown flag {parts[i]}"); }
                    continue;
                }
                if (l == "}") { if (cur == null) throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: stray '}}'"); s.Components.Add(cur); cur = null; continue; }
                if (cur == null) throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: field outside component");
                int colon = l.IndexOf(':'); if (colon < 0) throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: expected name: type");
                var name = l.Substring(0, colon).Trim(); var ty = l.Substring(colon + 1).Trim();
                string attr = null; int at = ty.IndexOf('@'); if (at >= 0) { attr = ty.Substring(at + 1).Trim(); ty = ty.Substring(0, at).Trim(); }
                cur.Fields.Add(new Field { Name = name, Type = ParseType(ty, attr, line) });
            }
            if (cur != null) throw new NetException("schema: unterminated component");
            return s;
        }

        static FieldType ParseType(string b, string attr, int line)
        {
            FieldType Range(FieldKind k)
            {
                if (attr == null || !attr.StartsWith("range(") || !attr.EndsWith(")")) throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: {b} needs @range(min, max, res)");
                var p = attr.Substring(6, attr.Length - 7).Split(',');
                if (p.Length != 3) throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: bad range");
                return new FieldType { Kind = k, Min = F(p[0]), Max = F(p[1]), Res = F(p[2]) };
            }
            float F(string x) => float.Parse(x.Trim(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            uint? Paren(string n) { if (!b.StartsWith(n)) return null; var r = b.Substring(n.Length); if (r.Length == 0) return 0; if (r.StartsWith("(") && r.EndsWith(")") && uint.TryParse(r.Substring(1, r.Length - 2).Trim(), out var v)) return v; throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: bad {n} size"); }
            switch (b)
            {
                case "bool": return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.Bool };
                case "u8": return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.UInt, Bits = 8 };
                case "u16": return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.UInt, Bits = 16 };
                case "u32": return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.UInt, Bits = 32 };
                case "u64": return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.UInt, Bits = 64 };
                case "i8": return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.Int, Bits = 8 };
                case "i16": return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.Int, Bits = 16 };
                case "i32": return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.Int, Bits = 32 };
                case "i64": return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.Int, Bits = 64 };
                case "f32": return attr == null ? new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.F32 } : Range(FieldKind.Quant);
                case "vec3": return Range(FieldKind.Vec3);
                case "vec2": return Range(FieldKind.Vec2);
                case "quat": return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.Quat };
            }
            var bits = Paren("bits"); if (bits.HasValue) { if (bits == 0 || bits > 64) throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: bits(n) needs 1..=64"); return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.UInt, Bits = (int)bits.Value }; }
            var str = Paren("string"); if (str.HasValue) return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.String, Max_ = Math.Min(Math.Max(str.Value, 1), 65535) };
            var by = Paren("bytes"); if (by.HasValue) return new FieldType { Kind = FieldKind.Bytes, Max_ = Math.Min(Math.Max(by.Value, 1), 65535) };
            throw new NetException($"schema line {line}: unknown type {b}");
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace Aurix.Net.Sim
{
    public struct Vec3 { public double X, Y, Z; public Vec3(double x, double y, double z) { X = x; Y = y; Z = z; } }
    public struct Quat
    {
        public double X, Y, Z, W;
        public Quat(double x, double y, double z, double w) { X = x; Y = y; Z = z; W = w; }
        /// Axis-angle helper (axis must be unit length).
        public static Quat AxisAngle(Vec3 axis, double angle)
        {
            double s = Math.Sin(angle / 2);
            return new Quat(axis.X * s, axis.Y * s, axis.Z * s, Math.Cos(angle / 2));
        }
    }
    public struct Body3State { public Vec3 Position, Velocity, AngularVelocity; public Quat Rotation; }

    /// Deterministic fixed-point 3D world (spheres, boxes, capsules) over the native/wasm module.
    public sealed class Sim3World : IDisposable
    {
        public uint Handle { get; private set; }
        public Sim3World(double gx = 0, double gy = -10, double gz = 0, uint tickHz = 60)
        {
            Handle = Sim3Native.sim3_world_new(Fx.From(gx), Fx.From(gy), Fx.From(gz), tickHz);
        }
        public void Dispose() { if (Handle != uint.MaxValue) { Sim3Native.sim3_world_free(Handle); Handle = uint.MaxValue; } }
        /// 3D reference scenario hash; equals 0x0a9c7e6fc4fa43bf on every platform.
        public static ulong GoldenHash() => Sim3Native.sim3_golden_hash();
        /// 3D joints/character reference scenario hash; equals 0x5db56af63cceee85 on every platform.
        public static ulong JointGoldenHash() => Sim3Native.sim3_joint_golden_hash();
        /// 3D convex hull reference scenario hash; equals 0xd656fc8f55999cf8 on every platform.
        public static ulong HullGoldenHash() => Sim3Native.sim3_hull_golden_hash();

        public void Step() => Sim3Native.sim3_step(Handle);
        public ulong Tick => Sim3Native.sim3_tick(Handle);
        public ulong Hash() => Sim3Native.sim3_hash(Handle);
        public byte[] Snapshot()
        {
            uint n = Sim3Native.sim3_snapshot(Handle);
            var b = new byte[n];
            for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++) b[i] = (byte)Sim3Native.sim3_snapshot_byte(Handle, i);
            return b;
        }
        public bool Restore(byte[] bytes)
        {
            Sim3Native.sim3_snapshot_set_len(Handle, (uint)bytes.Length);
            for (uint i = 0; i < bytes.Length; i++) Sim3Native.sim3_snapshot_set_byte(Handle, i, bytes[i]);
            return Sim3Native.sim3_restore(Handle) == 1;
        }
        public uint AddSphere(BodyKind kind, Vec3 p, double radius, double density = 1)
            => Sim3Native.sim3_add_sphere(Handle, (uint)kind, Fx.From(p.X), Fx.From(p.Y), Fx.From(p.Z), Fx.From(radius), Fx.From(density));
        public uint AddBox(BodyKind kind, Vec3 p, Vec3 half, double density = 1)
            => Sim3Native.sim3_add_box(Handle, (uint)kind, Fx.From(p.X), Fx.From(p.Y), Fx.From(p.Z), Fx.From(half.X), Fx.From(half.Y), Fx.From(half.Z), Fx.From(density));
        /// Capsule along the body y axis.
        public uint AddCapsule(BodyKind kind, Vec3 p, double halfLen, double radius, double density = 1)
            => Sim3Native.sim3_add_capsule(Handle, (uint)kind, Fx.From(p.X), Fx.From(p.Y), Fx.From(p.Z), Fx.From(halfLen), Fx.From(radius), Fx.From(density));
        public bool Remove(uint id) => Sim3Native.sim3_remove_body(Handle, id) == 1;
        public void SetMaterial(uint id, double friction, double restitution, bool sensor = false)
            => Sim3Native.sim3_set_material(Handle, id, Fx.From(friction), Fx.From(restitution), sensor ? 1u : 0u);
        public void SetLayers(uint id, uint layer, uint mask) => Sim3Native.sim3_set_layers(Handle, id, layer, mask);
        public void SetVelocity(uint id, Vec3 v, Vec3 w = default)
            => Sim3Native.sim3_set_velocity(Handle, id, Fx.From(v.X), Fx.From(v.Y), Fx.From(v.Z), Fx.From(w.X), Fx.From(w.Y), Fx.From(w.Z));
        public void SetPosition(uint id, Vec3 p) => Sim3Native.sim3_set_position(Handle, id, Fx.From(p.X), Fx.From(p.Y), Fx.From(p.Z));
        public void SetRotation(uint id, Quat q) => Sim3Native.sim3_set_rotation(Handle, id, Fx.From(q.X), Fx.From(q.Y), Fx.From(q.Z), Fx.From(q.W));
        public void ApplyImpulse(uint id, Vec3 impulse, Vec3? at = null)
            => Sim3Native.sim3_apply_impulse(Handle, id, Fx.From(impulse.X), Fx.From(impulse.Y), Fx.From(impulse.Z), at.HasValue ? 1u : 0u,
                Fx.From(at?.X ?? 0), Fx.From(at?.Y ?? 0), Fx.From(at?.Z ?? 0));
        public Body3State Body(uint id)
        {
            double G(uint f) => Fx.To(Sim3Native.sim3_body_get(Handle, id, f));
            return new Body3State
            {
                Position = new Vec3(G(0), G(1), G(2)),
                Rotation = new Quat(G(3), G(4), G(5), G(6)),
                Velocity = new Vec3(G(7), G(8), G(9)),
                AngularVelocity = new Vec3(G(10), G(11), G(12)),
            };
        }
        public bool Raycast(Vec3 from, Vec3 dir, out Ray3Hit hit, uint mask = uint.MaxValue)
        {
            uint r = Sim3Native.sim3_raycast(Handle, Fx.From(from.X), Fx.From(from.Y), Fx.From(from.Z), Fx.From(dir.X), Fx.From(dir.Y), Fx.From(dir.Z), mask);
            hit = default;
            if (r == 0) return false;
            double G(uint f) => Fx.To(Sim3Native.sim3_ray_get(f));
            hit.Body = r - 1; hit.Fraction = G(0);
            hit.Point = new Vec3(G(1), G(2), G(3)); hit.Normal = new Vec3(G(4), G(5), G(6));
            return true;
        }
        public ContactEvent[] Events()
        {
            uint n = Sim3Native.sim3_events_len(Handle);
            var ev = new ContactEvent[n];
            for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++)
                ev[i] = new ContactEvent { A = Sim3Native.sim3_event_get(Handle, i, 0), B = Sim3Native.sim3_event_get(Handle, i, 1), Begin = Sim3Native.sim3_event_get(Handle, i, 2) == 1 };
            return ev;
        }

        // ---- joints and character controller ----
        public uint JointBall(uint a, uint b, Vec3 anchorA, Vec3 anchorB)
            => Sim3Native.sim3_joint_ball(Handle, a, b, Fx.From(anchorA.X), Fx.From(anchorA.Y), Fx.From(anchorA.Z), Fx.From(anchorB.X), Fx.From(anchorB.Y), Fx.From(anchorB.Z));
        /// Hinge around local axes; pass lower/upper for angle limits (radians), maxTorque > 0 enables the motor.
        public uint JointHinge(uint a, uint b, Vec3 anchorA, Vec3 anchorB, Vec3 axisA, Vec3 axisB, double? lower = null, double? upper = null, double motorSpeed = 0, double maxTorque = 0)
        {
            bool limits = lower.HasValue && upper.HasValue;
            return Sim3Native.sim3_joint_hinge(Handle, a, b, Fx.From(anchorA.X), Fx.From(anchorA.Y), Fx.From(anchorA.Z), Fx.From(anchorB.X), Fx.From(anchorB.Y), Fx.From(anchorB.Z),
                Fx.From(axisA.X), Fx.From(axisA.Y), Fx.From(axisA.Z), Fx.From(axisB.X), Fx.From(axisB.Y), Fx.From(axisB.Z),
                limits ? 1u : 0u, Fx.From(lower ?? 0), Fx.From(upper ?? 0), Fx.From(motorSpeed), Fx.From(maxTorque));
        }
        /// Distance joint; minLength < length allows slack (rope).
        public uint JointDistance(uint a, uint b, Vec3 anchorA, Vec3 anchorB, double length, double? minLength = null)
            => Sim3Native.sim3_joint_distance(Handle, a, b, Fx.From(anchorA.X), Fx.From(anchorA.Y), Fx.From(anchorA.Z), Fx.From(anchorB.X), Fx.From(anchorB.Y), Fx.From(anchorB.Z), Fx.From(length), Fx.From(minLength ?? length));
        public bool RemoveJoint(uint id) => Sim3Native.sim3_joint_remove(Handle, id) == 1;
        public void SetMotor(uint joint, double speed, double maxTorque) => Sim3Native.sim3_joint_motor(Handle, joint, Fx.From(speed), Fx.From(maxTorque));
        public double HingeAngle(uint joint) => Fx.To(Sim3Native.sim3_hinge_angle(Handle, joint));
        /// Capsule character controller over a kinematic capsule body; returns a controller index.
        public uint Character(uint body, double stepHeight = 0.5, double minGroundNormalY = 0.7, double snapDistance = 0.25)
            => Sim3Native.sim3_kcc_new(Handle, body, Fx.From(stepHeight), Fx.From(minGroundNormalY), Fx.From(snapDistance));
        /// Move the controller this tick (call before Step()); returns whether it stands on ground.
        public bool MoveCharacter(uint k, Vec3 delta) => Sim3Native.sim3_kcc_move(Handle, k, Fx.From(delta.X), Fx.From(delta.Y), Fx.From(delta.Z)) == 1;
        public Character3State CharacterState(uint k)
        {
            double G(uint f) => Fx.To(Sim3Native.sim3_kcc_get(Handle, k, f));
            return new Character3State
            {
                GroundNormal = new Vec3(G(0), G(1), G(2)),
                Velocity = new Vec3(G(3), G(4), G(5)),
                Grounded = Sim3Native.sim3_kcc_get(Handle, k, 6) == 1,
                GroundBody = (uint)Sim3Native.sim3_kcc_get(Handle, k, 7),
            };
        }

        // ---- convex hulls and sweeps ----
        /// Convex polyhedron from body-space vertices (<= 32) and faces as index loops (any winding);
        /// author vertices around the centre of mass. Throws on an invalid hull.
        public uint AddConvex(BodyKind kind, Vec3 pos, Vec3[] verts, uint[][] faces, double density = 1)
        {
            Sim3Native.sim3_convex_reset(Handle);
            foreach (var v in verts) Sim3Native.sim3_convex_vert(Handle, Fx.From(v.X), Fx.From(v.Y), Fx.From(v.Z));
            foreach (var f in faces) { foreach (var i in f) Sim3Native.sim3_convex_index(Handle, i); Sim3Native.sim3_convex_face_end(Handle); }
            uint id = Sim3Native.sim3_add_convex(Handle, (uint)kind, Fx.From(pos.X), Fx.From(pos.Y), Fx.From(pos.Z), Fx.From(density));
            if (id == uint.MaxValue) throw new ArgumentException("sim3: invalid convex hull (need >= 4 vertices and >= 4 faces)");
            return id;
        }
        /// Sweep a sphere along dir; Fraction is where the centre stops, Point/Normal lie on the hit surface.
        public bool SphereCast(Vec3 from, Vec3 dir, double radius, out Ray3Hit hit, uint mask = uint.MaxValue)
        {
            uint id = Sim3Native.sim3_spherecast(Handle, Fx.From(from.X), Fx.From(from.Y), Fx.From(from.Z), Fx.From(dir.X), Fx.From(dir.Y), Fx.From(dir.Z), Fx.From(radius), mask);
            hit = default;
            if (id == 0) return false;
            double G(uint i) => Fx.To(Sim3Native.sim3_ray_get(i));
            hit = new Ray3Hit { Body = id - 1, Fraction = G(0), Point = new Vec3(G(1), G(2), G(3)), Normal = new Vec3(G(4), G(5), G(6)) };
            return true;
        }
        /// Sweep a capsule (segment along its local Y, rotated by rot) along dir; same result as SphereCast.
        public bool CapsuleCast(Vec3 from, Quat rot, double halfLen, double radius, Vec3 dir, out Ray3Hit hit, uint mask = uint.MaxValue)
        {
            uint id = Sim3Native.sim3_capsulecast(Handle, Fx.From(from.X), Fx.From(from.Y), Fx.From(from.Z), Fx.From(rot.X), Fx.From(rot.Y), Fx.From(rot.Z), Fx.From(rot.W), Fx.From(halfLen), Fx.From(radius), Fx.From(dir.X), Fx.From(dir.Y), Fx.From(dir.Z), mask);
            return RayResult(id, out hit);
        }
        /// Sweep a box (half extents, rotated by rot) along dir; same result as SphereCast.
        public bool BoxCast(Vec3 from, Quat rot, Vec3 half, Vec3 dir, out Ray3Hit hit, uint mask = uint.MaxValue)
        {
            uint id = Sim3Native.sim3_boxcast(Handle, Fx.From(from.X), Fx.From(from.Y), Fx.From(from.Z), Fx.From(rot.X), Fx.From(rot.Y), Fx.From(rot.Z), Fx.From(rot.W), Fx.From(half.X), Fx.From(half.Y), Fx.From(half.Z), Fx.From(dir.X), Fx.From(dir.Y), Fx.From(dir.Z), mask);
            return RayResult(id, out hit);
        }
        static bool RayResult(uint id, out Ray3Hit hit)
        {
            hit = default;
            if (id == 0) return false;
            double G(uint i) => Fx.To(Sim3Native.sim3_ray_get(i));
            hit = new Ray3Hit { Body = id - 1, Fraction = G(0), Point = new Vec3(G(1), G(2), G(3)), Normal = new Vec3(G(4), G(5), G(6)) };
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
// Aurix Sim: deterministic fixed-point 2D physics over the shared net_sim_wasm native library
// (libnet_sim_wasm.so / .dll / .dylib; in WebGL the same module is linked as a static lib).
// Values crossing the boundary are Q32.32 raw longs; `Fx.From`/`Fx.To` convert.
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace Aurix.Net.Sim
{
    public static class Fx
    {
        public const long One = 1L << 32;
        public static long From(double v) => (long)Math.Round(v * 4294967296.0);
        public static double To(long raw) => raw / 4294967296.0;
    }

    public enum BodyKind : uint { Static = 0, Kinematic = 1, Dynamic = 2 }

    public struct BodyState { public double X, Y, Angle, Vx, Vy, AngularVelocity; }
    public struct RayHit { public uint Body; public double Fraction, X, Y, Nx, Ny; }
    public struct ContactEvent { public uint A, B; public bool Begin; }
    public struct AgentState { public double X, Y, Vx, Vy; public bool Arrived; public uint Poly; }

    internal static class SimNative
    {
        const string Lib = "net_sim_wasm";
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_world_new(long gx, long gy, uint hz);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_world_free(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_step(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_tick(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern ulong sim_hash(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_snapshot(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_snapshot_byte(uint h, uint i);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_snapshot_set_len(uint h, uint len);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_snapshot_set_byte(uint h, uint i, uint v);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_restore(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_add_circle(uint h, uint k, long x, long y, long r, long d);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_add_box(uint h, uint k, long x, long y, long hw, long hh, long d);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_add_capsule(uint h, uint k, long x, long y, long hl, long r, long d);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_remove_body(uint h, uint id);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_set_material(uint h, uint id, long f, long r);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_set_layers(uint h, uint id, uint layer, uint mask, uint sensor);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_set_velocity(uint h, uint id, long vx, long vy, long w);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_set_position(uint h, uint id, long x, long y, long a);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_apply_impulse(uint h, uint id, long ix, long iy);

        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_kcc_move(uint h, uint k, long dx, long dy);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern ulong sim_golden_hash();
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_nav_grid(uint h, long ox, long oy, long cell, uint cols, uint rows);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_nav_load(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern ulong sim_nav_hash(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_nav_locate(uint h, long x, long y);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_nav_path(uint h, long x0, long y0, long x1, long y1, uint mask);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern long sim_nav_point(uint h, uint i);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_nav_raycast(uint h, long x0, long y0, long x1, long y1);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_nav_field(uint h, long x, long y, uint mask);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_agent_add(uint h, long x, long y, long r, long speed);

        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_agent_follow(uint h, uint id, uint field);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_agent_stop(uint h, uint id);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern long sim_agent_get(uint h, uint id, uint field);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_crowd_step(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern ulong sim_crowd_hash(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_crowd_snapshot(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_crowd_restore(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern ulong sim_nav_golden_hash();
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_joint_distance(uint h, uint a, uint b, long ax, long ay, long bx, long by, long len, long minLen);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_joint_revolute(uint h, uint a, uint b, long ax, long ay, long bx, long by, uint hasLimits, long lower, long upper, long motorSpeed, long maxTorque);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_joint_weld(uint h, uint a, uint b, long ax, long ay, long bx, long by, long relAngle);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_joint_remove(uint h, uint id);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern void sim_joint_motor(uint h, uint id, long speed, long maxTorque);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_events_len(uint h);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_event_get(uint h, uint i, uint field);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern uint sim_circlecast(uint h, long x, long y, long dx, long dy, long r, uint mask);
        [DllImport(Lib)] public static extern ulong sim_joint_golden_hash();
    }

    public sealed class SimWorld : IDisposable
    {
        public readonly uint Handle;
        bool _freed;

        public SimWorld(double gravityX = 0, double gravityY = -10, uint tickHz = 60)
        {
            Handle = SimNative.sim_world_new(Fx.From(gravityX), Fx.From(gravityY), tickHz);
        }

        /// Reference scenario hash; equals the Rust/wasm value 0x58d9870ba45952b5 on every platform.
        public static ulong GoldenHash() => SimNative.sim_golden_hash();
        /// Navigation reference scenario hash; equals 0x746c5a608abe2f26 on every platform.
        public static ulong NavGoldenHash() => SimNative.sim_nav_golden_hash();
        /// Joint reference scenario hash; equals 0x4bcc781a484ceeed on every platform.
        public static ulong JointGoldenHash() => SimNative.sim_joint_golden_hash();

        public void Dispose() { if (!_freed) { _freed = true; SimNative.sim_world_free(Handle); } }
        public void Step() => SimNative.sim_step(Handle);
        public uint Tick => SimNative.sim_tick(Handle);
        public ulong Hash() => SimNative.sim_hash(Handle);

        public byte[] Snapshot()
        {
            uint n = SimNative.sim_snapshot(Handle);
            var b = new byte[n];
            for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++) b[i] = (byte)SimNative.sim_snapshot_byte(Handle, i);
            return b;
        }
        public bool Restore(byte[] bytes)
        {
            SimNative.sim_snapshot_set_len(Handle, (uint)bytes.Length);
            for (uint i = 0; i < bytes.Length; i++) SimNative.sim_snapshot_set_byte(Handle, i, bytes[i]);
            return SimNative.sim_restore(Handle) == 1;
        }

        public uint AddCircle(BodyKind kind, double x, double y, double radius, double density = 1)
            => SimNative.sim_add_circle(Handle, (uint)kind, Fx.From(x), Fx.From(y), Fx.From(radius), Fx.From(density));
        public uint AddBox(BodyKind kind, double x, double y, double halfW, double halfH, double density = 1)
            => SimNative.sim_add_box(Handle, (uint)kind, Fx.From(x), Fx.From(y), Fx.From(halfW), Fx.From(halfH), Fx.From(density));
        public uint AddCapsule(BodyKind kind, double x, double y, double halfLen, double radius, double density = 1)
            => SimNative.sim_add_capsule(Handle, (uint)kind, Fx.From(x), Fx.From(y), Fx.From(halfLen), Fx.From(radius), Fx.From(density));
        public void Remove(uint id) => SimNative.sim_remove_body(Handle, id);
        public void SetMaterial(uint id, double friction, double restitution) => SimNative.sim_set_material(Handle, id, Fx.From(friction), Fx.From(restitution));
        public void SetLayers(uint id, uint layer, uint mask, bool sensor = false) => SimNative.sim_set_layers(Handle, id, layer, mask, sensor ? 1u : 0u);
        public void SetVelocity(uint id, double vx, double vy, double angular = 0) => SimNative.sim_set_velocity(Handle, id, Fx.From(vx), Fx.From(vy), Fx.From(angular));
        public void SetPosition(uint id, double x, double y, double angle = 0) => SimNative.sim_set_position(Handle, id, Fx.From(x), Fx.From(y), Fx.From(angle));
        public void ApplyImpulse(uint id, double ix, double iy) => SimNative.sim_apply_impulse(Handle, id, Fx.From(ix), Fx.From(iy));

        public BodyState Body(uint id) => new BodyState
        {
            X = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_body_get(Handle, id, 0)),
            Y = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_body_get(Handle, id, 1)),
            Angle = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_body_get(Handle, id, 2)),
            Vx = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_body_get(Handle, id, 3)),
            Vy = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_body_get(Handle, id, 4)),
            AngularVelocity = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_body_get(Handle, id, 5)),
        };
        /// Raw Q32.32 field (0..5 = x, y, angle, vx, vy, angular velocity) for hashing/networking.
        public long BodyRaw(uint id, uint field) => SimNative.sim_body_get(Handle, id, field);

        public bool Raycast(double x, double y, double dx, double dy, out RayHit hit, uint mask = uint.MaxValue)
        {
            uint body = SimNative.sim_raycast(Handle, Fx.From(x), Fx.From(y), Fx.From(dx), Fx.From(dy), mask);
            hit = default;
            if (body == 0) return false;
            hit.Body = body;
            hit.Fraction = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(0));
            hit.X = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(1));
            hit.Y = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(2));
            hit.Nx = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(3));
            hit.Ny = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(4));
            return true;
        }

        /// Character controller over a kinematic body; returns its index for MoveCharacter.
        public uint Character(uint body, double stepHeight = 0.5, double minGroundNormalY = 0.7)
            => SimNative.sim_kcc_new(Handle, body, Fx.From(stepHeight), Fx.From(minGroundNormalY));
        /// Moves the controller; true when grounded afterwards.
        public bool MoveCharacter(uint kcc, double dx, double dy) => SimNative.sim_kcc_move(Handle, kcc, Fx.From(dx), Fx.From(dy)) == 1;

        // ---- navigation: navmesh, paths, flow fields, crowd agents ----
        void FillBuffer(byte[] bytes)
        {
            SimNative.sim_snapshot_set_len(Handle, (uint)bytes.Length);
            for (uint i = 0; i < bytes.Length; i++) SimNative.sim_snapshot_set_byte(Handle, i, bytes[i]);
        }
        /// Grid navmesh of cols×rows cells; blocked = (col, row) cells to remove.
        public void NavGrid(double originX, double originY, double cell, uint cols, uint rows, (uint col, uint row)[] blocked = null)
        {
            blocked = blocked ?? Array.Empty<(uint, uint)>();
            var buf = new byte[blocked.Length * 8];
            for (int i = 0; i < blocked.Length; i++)
            {
                BitConverter.GetBytes(blocked[i].col).CopyTo(buf, i * 8);
                BitConverter.GetBytes(blocked[i].row).CopyTo(buf, i * 8 + 4);
            }
            FillBuffer(buf);
            SimNative.sim_nav_grid(Handle, Fx.From(originX), Fx.From(originY), Fx.From(cell), cols, rows);
        }
        /// Load a navmesh exported by NavMesh::to_bytes (JSON).
        public bool NavLoad(byte[] json) { FillBuffer(json); return SimNative.sim_nav_load(Handle) == 1; }
        public ulong NavHash() => SimNative.sim_nav_hash(Handle);
        public bool NavLocate(double x, double y, out uint poly) { poly = SimNative.sim_nav_locate(Handle, Fx.From(x), Fx.From(y)); return poly != uint.MaxValue; }
        public (double x, double y)[] NavPath(double x0, double y0, double x1, double y1, uint mask = uint.MaxValue)
        {
            uint n = SimNative.sim_nav_path(Handle, Fx.From(x0), Fx.From(y0), Fx.From(x1), Fx.From(y1), mask);
            if (n == 0) return null;
            var pts = new (double, double)[n];
            for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++) pts[i] = (Fx.To(SimNative.sim_nav_point(Handle, 2 * i)), Fx.To(SimNative.sim_nav_point(Handle, 2 * i + 1)));
            return pts;
        }
        /// Line of sight on the mesh; false when clear, else the boundary point hit.
        public bool NavRaycast(double x0, double y0, double x1, double y1, out double hx, out double hy)
        {
            bool hit = SimNative.sim_nav_raycast(Handle, Fx.From(x0), Fx.From(y0), Fx.From(x1), Fx.From(y1)) == 1;
            hx = hit ? Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(1)) : 0; hy = hit ? Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(2)) : 0;
            return hit;
        }
        /// Flow field towards a goal, shared by any number of agents; uint.MaxValue when unreachable.
        public uint NavField(double x, double y, uint mask = uint.MaxValue) => SimNative.sim_nav_field(Handle, Fx.From(x), Fx.From(y), mask);
        public uint AddAgent(double x, double y, double radius, double maxSpeed) => SimNative.sim_agent_add(Handle, Fx.From(x), Fx.From(y), Fx.From(radius), Fx.From(maxSpeed));
        public void RemoveAgent(uint id) => SimNative.sim_agent_remove(Handle, id);
        public void AgentTarget(uint id, double x, double y) => SimNative.sim_agent_target(Handle, id, Fx.From(x), Fx.From(y));
        public void AgentFollow(uint id, uint field) => SimNative.sim_agent_follow(Handle, id, field);
        public void AgentStop(uint id) => SimNative.sim_agent_stop(Handle, id);
        public AgentState Agent(uint id) => new AgentState
        {
            X = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_agent_get(Handle, id, 0)),
            Y = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_agent_get(Handle, id, 1)),
            Vx = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_agent_get(Handle, id, 2)),
            Vy = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_agent_get(Handle, id, 3)),
            Arrived = SimNative.sim_agent_get(Handle, id, 4) == 1,
            Poly = (uint)SimNative.sim_agent_get(Handle, id, 5),
        };
        /// Advance all agents one tick (call next to Step()).
        public void CrowdStep() => SimNative.sim_crowd_step(Handle);
        public ulong CrowdHash() => SimNative.sim_crowd_hash(Handle);
        public byte[] CrowdSnapshot()
        {
            uint n = SimNative.sim_crowd_snapshot(Handle);
            var b = new byte[n];
            for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++) b[i] = (byte)SimNative.sim_snapshot_byte(Handle, i);
            return b;
        }
        public bool CrowdRestore(byte[] bytes) { FillBuffer(bytes); return SimNative.sim_crowd_restore(Handle) == 1; }

        // ---- joints, contact events, shape casts ----
        /// Distance joint between local anchors; minLength < length allows slack (rope).
        public uint JointDistance(uint a, uint b, double ax, double ay, double bx, double by, double length, double? minLength = null)
            => SimNative.sim_joint_distance(Handle, a, b, Fx.From(ax), Fx.From(ay), Fx.From(bx), Fx.From(by), Fx.From(length), Fx.From(minLength ?? length));
        /// Pin joint; pass lower/upper for angle limits, maxTorque > 0 enables the motor.
        public uint JointRevolute(uint a, uint b, double ax, double ay, double bx, double by, double? lower = null, double? upper = null, double motorSpeed = 0, double maxTorque = 0)
        {
            bool limits = lower.HasValue && upper.HasValue;
            return SimNative.sim_joint_revolute(Handle, a, b, Fx.From(ax), Fx.From(ay), Fx.From(bx), Fx.From(by), limits ? 1u : 0u, Fx.From(lower ?? 0), Fx.From(upper ?? 0), Fx.From(motorSpeed), Fx.From(maxTorque));
        }
        public uint JointWeld(uint a, uint b, double ax, double ay, double bx, double by, double relAngle = 0)
            => SimNative.sim_joint_weld(Handle, a, b, Fx.From(ax), Fx.From(ay), Fx.From(bx), Fx.From(by), Fx.From(relAngle));
        public bool RemoveJoint(uint id) => SimNative.sim_joint_remove(Handle, id) == 1;
        public void SetMotor(uint joint, double speed, double maxTorque) => SimNative.sim_joint_motor(Handle, joint, Fx.From(speed), Fx.From(maxTorque));
        /// Contact begin/end events from the last Step().
        public ContactEvent[] Events()
        {
            uint n = SimNative.sim_events_len(Handle);
            var ev = new ContactEvent[n];
            for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++)
                ev[i] = new ContactEvent { A = SimNative.sim_event_get(Handle, i, 0), B = SimNative.sim_event_get(Handle, i, 1), Begin = SimNative.sim_event_get(Handle, i, 2) == 1 };
            return ev;
        }
        /// Sweep a circle along (dx, dy); same result as Raycast.
        public bool CircleCast(double x, double y, double dx, double dy, double radius, out RayHit hit, uint mask = uint.MaxValue)
        {
            uint r = SimNative.sim_circlecast(Handle, Fx.From(x), Fx.From(y), Fx.From(dx), Fx.From(dy), Fx.From(radius), mask);
            hit = default;
            if (r == 0) return false;
            hit.Body = r - 1;
            hit.Fraction = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(0)); hit.X = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(1)); hit.Y = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(2));
            hit.Nx = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(3)); hit.Ny = Fx.To(SimNative.sim_ray_get(4));
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/SyncWorld.cs`:

```cs
// Client-side replicated world for sync rooms: decodes server deltas (0x11), keeps entities,
// acks (0x13), and encodes owner inputs (0x10 with full component writes). Engine-agnostic.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    public sealed class NetEntity
    {
        public ulong Id; public ushort? Owner; public uint LastTick;
        public Dictionary<ushort, ComponentValue> Components = new Dictionary<ushort, ComponentValue>();
        public ComponentValue Get(ComponentDef c) => c != null && Components.TryGetValue(c.Id, out var v) ? v : null;
    }

    /// <summary>One owner-authoritative op for <see cref="SyncWorld.EncodeOps"/>.</summary>
    public struct SyncOp
    {
        public const byte Write = 0, Spawn = 1, Despawn = 2, Transfer = 3;
        public byte Op; public ulong Entity; public ushort To; public IList<(ComponentDef, ComponentValue)> Writes;
        public static SyncOp WriteEntity(ulong entity, IList<(ComponentDef, ComponentValue)> writes) => new SyncOp { Op = Write, Entity = entity, Writes = writes };
        public static SyncOp SpawnEntity(IList<(ComponentDef, ComponentValue)> writes = null) => new SyncOp { Op = Spawn, Writes = writes };
        public static SyncOp DespawnEntity(ulong entity) => new SyncOp { Op = Despawn, Entity = entity };
        /// <summary>Hands an entity you own to another actor in the room.</summary>
        public static SyncOp TransferEntity(ulong entity, ushort to) => new SyncOp { Op = Transfer, Entity = entity, To = to };
    }

    public sealed class SyncWorld
    {
        public const byte KindInput = 0x10, KindDelta = 0x11, KindResync = 0x12, KindAck = 0x13;
        public readonly Schema Schema;
        public readonly Dictionary<ulong, NetEntity> Entities = new Dictionary<ulong, NetEntity>();
        public uint ServerTick { get; private set; }
        public long Gaps { get; private set; }
        uint _lastDelta; uint _history; bool _any;
        /// <summary>Entity first seen / changed in this delta / removed.</summary>
        public event Action<NetEntity> OnSpawn, OnChange, OnDespawn;

        public SyncWorld(Schema schema) { Schema = schema; }

        /// <summary>Feeds any sync datagram payload; returns the ack to send back (null when not a delta).</summary>
        public byte[] Receive(byte[] p)
        {
            if (p.Length < 11 || p[0] != KindDelta) return null;
            var r = new BitReader(p, 1);
            uint tick = (uint)r.ReadBits(32), baseline = (uint)r.ReadBits(32);
            ServerTick = tick;
            if (!_any) { _any = true; _lastDelta = tick; _history = 0; }
            else if (tick > _lastDelta)
            {
                uint sh = tick - _lastDelta;
                if (baseline != 0 && baseline - 1 != _lastDelta && !Acked(baseline - 1)) Gaps++;
                _history = sh >= 32 ? 0 : (_history << (int)sh) | (1u << (int)(sh - 1)); _lastDelta = tick;
            }
            else if (tick < _lastDelta) { uint d = _lastDelta - tick; if (d <= 32) _history |= 1u << (int)(d - 1); }
            int nd = (int)r.ReadBits(16);
            for (int i = 0; i < nd; i++) { ulong id = r.ReadBits(48); if (Entities.TryGetValue(id, out var e)) { Entities.Remove(id); OnDespawn?.Invoke(e); } }
            int n = (int)r.ReadBits(16); int cidBits = Schema.ComponentIdBits;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                ulong id = r.ReadBits(48); bool fresh = !Entities.TryGetValue(id, out var e);
                if (fresh) { e = new NetEntity { Id = id }; Entities[id] = e; }
                e.Owner = r.ReadBool() ? (ushort?)r.ReadBits(16) : null; e.LastTick = tick;
                int nc = (int)r.ReadBits(8);
                for (int k = 0; k < nc; k++)
                {
                    ushort cid = (ushort)r.ReadBits(cidBits); var c = Schema.ById(cid) ?? throw new NetException("delta: unknown component " + cid);
                    if (r.ReadBool()) { e.Components.Remove(cid); continue; }
                    bool full = r.ReadBool();
                    if (full) e.Components[cid] = ComponentValue.DecodeFull(c, r);
                    else e.Components[cid] = ComponentValue.DecodeDelta(e.Components.TryGetValue(cid, out var b) ? b : ComponentValue.Zero(c), c, r);
                }
                if (fresh) OnSpawn?.Invoke(e); else OnChange?.Invoke(e);
            }
            return EncodeAck(_lastDelta, _history);
        }
        bool Acked(uint t) { if (t == _lastDelta) return true; if (t > _lastDelta) return false; uint d = _lastDelta - t; return d <= 32 && (_history & (1u << (int)(d - 1))) != 0; }

        public static byte[] EncodeAck(uint last, uint bits) => new byte[] { KindAck, (byte)(last >> 24), (byte)(last >> 16), (byte)(last >> 8), (byte)last, (byte)(bits >> 24), (byte)(bits >> 16), (byte)(bits >> 8), (byte)bits };

        /// <summary>Input packet: the last inputs ending at `firstTick + inputs.Count - 1` (send 2-3 for redundancy).</summary>
        public static byte[] EncodeInput(uint firstTick, IList<byte[]> inputs)
        {
            int len = 6; foreach (var i in inputs) len += 1 + Math.Min(255, i.Length);
            var b = new byte[len]; int o = 0; b[o++] = KindInput; b[o++] = (byte)(firstTick >> 24); b[o++] = (byte)(firstTick >> 16); b[o++] = (byte)(firstTick >> 8); b[o++] = (byte)firstTick; b[o++] = (byte)Math.Min(255, inputs.Count);
            foreach (var i in inputs) { int n = Math.Min(255, i.Length); b[o++] = (byte)n; Array.Copy(i, 0, b, o, n); o += n; }
            return b;
        }

        /// <summary>Owner-authoritative input body: full writes of the given components (applied to the actor's avatar).</summary>
        public byte[] EncodeWrites(IList<(ComponentDef, ComponentValue)> writes)
        {
            var w = new BitWriter(); w.WriteBits((ulong)writes.Count, 8); int cb = Schema.ComponentIdBits;
            foreach (var (c, v) in writes) { w.WriteBits(c.Id, cb); v.EncodeFull(c, w); }
            return w.Finish();
        }

        /// <summary>Owner-authoritative ops: write/spawn/despawn/transfer entities you own (at most 32 spawned per actor).</summary>
        public byte[] EncodeOps(IList<SyncOp> ops)
        {
            var w = new BitWriter(); w.WriteBits(0xff, 8); w.WriteBits((ulong)ops.Count, 8); int cb = Schema.ComponentIdBits;
            foreach (var op in ops)
            {
                w.WriteBits(op.Op, 8);
                if (op.Op != SyncOp.Spawn) w.WriteBits(op.Entity, 48);
                if (op.Op == SyncOp.Transfer) { w.WriteBits(op.To, 16); continue; }
                if (op.Op == SyncOp.Despawn) continue;
                var ws = op.Writes ?? Array.Empty<(ComponentDef, ComponentValue)>();
                w.WriteBits((ulong)ws.Count, 8);
                foreach (var (c, v) in ws) { w.WriteBits(c.Id, cb); v.EncodeFull(c, w); }
            }
            return w.Finish();
        }
    }
}
```
