`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/TickTimer.cs`:

```cs
// Tick-based timer (Fusion's TickTimer): created against the current server tick, compared against it
// later, so every peer agrees on when it expires. Pure C#, serializable as two ticks.
using System;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    [Serializable]
    public struct TickTimer : IEquatable<TickTimer>
    {
        public uint Start, End;

        public static readonly TickTimer None = default;
        public static TickTimer CreateFromTicks(uint now, uint ticks) => new TickTimer { Start = now, End = now + Math.Max(1u, ticks) };
        public static TickTimer CreateFromSeconds(uint now, float seconds, int tickHz) => CreateFromTicks(now, (uint)Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(0f, seconds) * Math.Max(1, tickHz)));

        /// <summary>False for <see cref="None"/>; true until reset (also after it expired).</summary>
        public bool IsRunning => End != 0;
        public bool Expired(uint now) => IsRunning && now >= End;
        /// <summary>Running and not yet expired.</summary>
        public bool IsActive(uint now) => IsRunning && now < End;
        public uint RemainingTicks(uint now) => IsActive(now) ? End - now : 0;
        public float RemainingSeconds(uint now, int tickHz) => RemainingTicks(now) / (float)Math.Max(1, tickHz);
        /// <summary>0..1 progress since creation.</summary>
        public float Normalized(uint now) => !IsRunning || End <= Start ? 1f : Math.Min(1f, Math.Max(0f, (now - (float)Start) / (End - Start)));

        public bool Equals(TickTimer o) => Start == o.Start && End == o.End;
        public override bool Equals(object obj) => obj is TickTimer t && Equals(t);
        public override int GetHashCode() => (int)(Start * 31 + End);
        public override string ToString() => IsRunning ? $"TickTimer({Start}->{End})" : "TickTimer.None";
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Managed/Values.cs`:

```cs
// Component values and their bit codec (full and delta), mirrors net-wire::value.
using System;
using System.Text;

namespace Aurix.Net.Managed
{
    /// <summary>One field value; which member is used depends on the field type.</summary>
    public struct Value
    {
        public bool B; public ulong U; public long I; public float F; public float X, Y, Z, W; public string S; public byte[] Bytes;
        public override bool Equals(object o) => o is Value v && B == v.B && U == v.U && I == v.I && F == v.F && X == v.X && Y == v.Y && Z == v.Z && W == v.W && S == v.S && SameBytes(Bytes, v.Bytes);
        public override int GetHashCode() => (int)U ^ I.GetHashCode() ^ F.GetHashCode() ^ X.GetHashCode();
        static bool SameBytes(byte[] a, byte[] b) { if (a == null || b == null) return (a?.Length ?? 0) == (b?.Length ?? 0); if (a.Length != b.Length) return false; for (int i = 0; i < a.Length; i++) if (a[i] != b[i]) return false; return true; }
        public static Value Zero(FieldType t) => t.Kind == FieldKind.Quat ? new Value { W = 1 } : t.Kind == FieldKind.String ? new Value { S = "" } : t.Kind == FieldKind.Bytes ? new Value { Bytes = Array.Empty<byte>() } : default;
    }

    public sealed class ComponentValue
    {
        public Value[] Fields;
        public static ComponentValue Zero(ComponentDef c) { var v = new ComponentValue { Fields = new Value[c.Fields.Count] }; for (int i = 0; i < c.Fields.Count; i++) v.Fields[i] = Value.Zero(c.Fields[i].Type); return v; }
        public ComponentValue Clone() => new ComponentValue { Fields = (Value[])Fields.Clone() };

        public static void WriteField(BitWriter w, FieldType t, in Value v)
        {
            const float lim = 0.70710677f;
            switch (t.Kind)
            {
                case FieldKind.Bool: w.WriteBool(v.B); break;
                case FieldKind.UInt: w.WriteUInt(v.U, t.Bits); break;
                case FieldKind.Int: w.WriteInt(v.I, t.Bits); break;
                case FieldKind.F32: w.WriteF32(v.F); break;
                case FieldKind.Quant: w.WriteQuantized(v.F, t.Min, t.Max, t.Res); break;
                case FieldKind.Vec2: w.WriteQuantized(v.X, t.Min, t.Max, t.Res); w.WriteQuantized(v.Y, t.Min, t.Max, t.Res); break;
                case FieldKind.Vec3: w.WriteQuantized(v.X, t.Min, t.Max, t.Res); w.WriteQuantized(v.Y, t.Min, t.Max, t.Res); w.WriteQuantized(v.Z, t.Min, t.Max, t.Res); break;
                case FieldKind.Quat:
                    {
                        float x = v.X, y = v.Y, z = v.Z, ww = v.W; float len = (float)Math.Sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z + ww * ww);
                        float[] q = len > 0 ? new[] { x / len, y / len, z / len, ww / len } : new[] { 0f, 0f, 0f, 1f };
                        int largest = 0; for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++) if (Math.Abs(q[i]) > Math.Abs(q[largest])) largest = i;
                        float sign = q[largest] < 0 ? -1 : 1; w.WriteUInt((ulong)largest, 2);
                        float res = 2 * lim / ((1 << 10) - 1);
                        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (i != largest) w.WriteQuantized(q[i] * sign, -lim, lim, res);
                        break;
                    }
                case FieldKind.String: { var b = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(v.S ?? ""); if (b.Length > t.Max_) b = TruncateUtf8(b, (int)t.Max_); w.WriteUInt((ulong)b.Length, Bits.LenBits(t.Max_)); w.WriteBytes(b); break; }
                case FieldKind.Bytes: { var b = v.Bytes ?? Array.Empty<byte>(); if (b.Length > t.Max_) Array.Resize(ref b, (int)t.Max_); w.WriteUInt((ulong)b.Length, Bits.LenBits(t.Max_)); w.WriteBytes(b); break; }
            }
        }
        static byte[] TruncateUtf8(byte[] b, int max) { int n = max; while (n > 0 && (b[n] & 0xC0) == 0x80) n--; Array.Resize(ref b, n); return b; }

        public static Value ReadField(BitReader r, FieldType t)
        {
            const float lim = 0.70710677f;
            switch (t.Kind)
            {
                case FieldKind.Bool: return new Value { B = r.ReadBool() };
                case FieldKind.UInt: return new Value { U = r.ReadUInt(t.Bits) };
                case FieldKind.Int: return new Value { I = r.ReadInt(t.Bits) };
                case FieldKind.F32: return new Value { F = r.ReadF32() };
                case FieldKind.Quant: return new Value { F = r.ReadQuantized(t.Min, t.Max, t.Res) };
                case FieldKind.Vec2: return new Value { X = r.ReadQuantized(t.Min, t.Max, t.Res), Y = r.ReadQuantized(t.Min, t.Max, t.Res) };
                case FieldKind.Vec3: return new Value { X = r.ReadQuantized(t.Min, t.Max, t.Res), Y = r.ReadQuantized(t.Min, t.Max, t.Res), Z = r.ReadQuantized(t.Min, t.Max, t.Res) };
                case FieldKind.Quat:
                    {
                        int largest = (int)r.ReadUInt(2); float res = 2 * lim / ((1 << 10) - 1); var q = new float[4]; float sum = 0;
                        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (i != largest) { q[i] = r.ReadQuantized(-lim, lim, res); sum += q[i] * q[i]; }
                        q[largest] = (float)Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(0, 1 - sum));
                        return new Value { X = q[0], Y = q[1], Z = q[2], W = q[3] };
                    }
                case FieldKind.String: { int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(Bits.LenBits(t.Max_)); return new Value { S = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(r.ReadBytes(n)) }; }
                case FieldKind.Bytes: { int n = (int)r.ReadUInt(Bits.LenBits(t.Max_)); return new Value { Bytes = r.ReadBytes(n) }; }
            }
            throw new NetException("bad field type");
        }

        public void EncodeFull(ComponentDef c, BitWriter w) { for (int i = 0; i < c.Fields.Count; i++) WriteField(w, c.Fields[i].Type, Fields[i]); }
        public static ComponentValue DecodeFull(ComponentDef c, BitReader r) { var v = new ComponentValue { Fields = new Value[c.Fields.Count] }; for (int i = 0; i < c.Fields.Count; i++) v.Fields[i] = ReadField(r, c.Fields[i].Type); return v; }
        public static ComponentValue DecodeDelta(ComponentValue b, ComponentDef c, BitReader r)
        {
            var changed = new bool[c.Fields.Count]; for (int i = 0; i < changed.Length; i++) changed[i] = r.ReadBool();
            var o = b.Clone(); for (int i = 0; i < changed.Length; i++) if (changed[i]) o.Fields[i] = ReadField(r, c.Fields[i].Type);
            return o;
        }
    }
}

// Mirror transport over an Aurix Net relay room (see Transports/RelayBridge.cs for the topology).
// Compiled only when Mirror is in the project (Mirror defines MIRROR).
#if MIRROR
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Aurix.Net.Transports;
using Mirror;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.MirrorTransport
{
    public sealed class AurixNetMirrorTransport : Transport
    {
        [Header("Aurix Net")]
        [Tooltip("Node control-plane URL, e.g. https://node.example.com")]
        public string httpUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:8090";
        [Tooltip("Grant issued by your backend (POST /v1/grants). Leave empty and set GrantProvider from code.")]
        public string grant = "";
        [Tooltip("Relay room name shared by host and clients. ClientConnect(address) overrides it when address is non-empty.")]
        public string roomName = "mirror";
        public int maxPlayers = 16;
        [Tooltip("Relay event code reserved for Mirror frames.")]
        public byte eventCode = 200;

        /// <summary>Async grant source; wins over the inspector field.</summary>
        public Func<Task<string>> GrantProvider;

        RelayBridge _server, _client;

        RelayBridge NewBridge(string room) => new RelayBridge(new RelayBridgeSettings
        {
            HttpUrl = httpUrl, Grant = grant, GrantProvider = GrantProvider, RoomName = room, MaxPlayers = maxPlayers, EventCode = eventCode
        });

        public override bool Available() => true;

        // ---- client ----
        public override bool ClientConnected() => _client != null && _client.State == BridgeState.Started;

        public override void ClientConnect(string address)
        {
            if (_client != null) return;
            var b = _client = NewBridge(string.IsNullOrEmpty(address) ? roomName : address);
            b.OnState += s => { if (s == BridgeState.Started) OnClientConnected?.Invoke(); };
            b.OnData += (from, d, _) => OnClientDataReceived?.Invoke(d, Channels.Reliable);
            b.OnDisconnected += why =>
            {
                if (_client == b) _client = null;
                if (why == BridgeLeave.Failed) OnClientError?.Invoke(TransportError.Refused, b.LastError);
                else if (why == BridgeLeave.HostGone || why == BridgeLeave.Lost) OnClientError?.Invoke(TransportError.ConnectionClosed, b.LastError);
                OnClientDisconnected?.Invoke();
            };
            b.StartClient();
        }

        public override void ClientSend(ArraySegment<byte> segment, int channelId = Channels.Reliable)
        {
            if (_client == null) return;
            _client.SendToHost(segment, channelId == Channels.Reliable);
            OnClientDataSent?.Invoke(segment, channelId);
        }

        public override void ClientDisconnect() { var b = _client; _client = null; b?.Stop(); }

        // ---- server ----
        public override Uri ServerUri() => new UriBuilder { Scheme = "aurix", Host = roomName }.Uri;
        public override bool ServerActive() => _server != null && _server.State == BridgeState.Started;

        public override void ServerStart()
        {
            if (_server != null) return;
            var b = _server = NewBridge(roomName);
            b.OnPeerJoined += a => { OnServerConnected?.Invoke(a); OnServerConnectedWithAddress?.Invoke(a, "actor:" + a); };
            b.OnPeerLeft += (a, why) => OnServerDisconnected?.Invoke(a);
            b.OnData += (from, d, _) => OnServerDataReceived?.Invoke(from, d, Channels.Reliable);
            b.OnDisconnected += why => { if (_server == b) _server = null; if (why != BridgeLeave.Local) Debug.LogWarning("[AurixNet] server stopped: " + b.LastError); };
            b.StartHost();
        }

        public override void ServerSend(int connectionId, ArraySegment<byte> segment, int channelId = Channels.Reliable)
        {
            if (_server == null) return;
            _server.SendTo(connectionId, segment, channelId == Channels.Reliable);
            OnServerDataSent?.Invoke(connectionId, segment, channelId);
        }

        public override void ServerDisconnect(int connectionId) => _server?.Kick(connectionId);
        public override string ServerGetClientAddress(int connectionId) => "actor:" + connectionId;
        public override void ServerStop() { var b = _server; _server = null; b?.Stop(); }

        // ---- common ----
        public override int GetMaxPacketSize(int channelId = Channels.Reliable) => RelayBridge.Mtu(channelId == Channels.Reliable);
        public override int GetBatchThreshold(int channelId = Channels.Reliable) => RelayBridge.Mtu(false);

        public override void ClientEarlyUpdate() => _client?.Pump();
        public override void ServerEarlyUpdate() => _server?.Pump();
        public override void ClientLateUpdate() => _client?.Flush();
        public override void ServerLateUpdate() => _server?.Flush();

        public override void Shutdown() { ClientDisconnect(); ServerStop(); }
    }
}
#endif

// P/Invoke bindings for libaurix_net (crates/net-ffi/include/aurix_net.h).
using System;

namespace Aurix.Net
{
    internal static class Native
    {
#if UNITY_IOS && !UNITY_EDITOR

        const string Lib = "aurix_net";

        public struct Event
        {
            public int kind;
            public byte channel;
            public ushort tick;
            public IntPtr data;
            public UIntPtr dataLen;
            public IntPtr json;
        }

`sdk/unity/Runtime/PurrNet/AurixNetTransport.cs`:

```cs
// PurrNet transport over an Aurix Net relay room (see Transports/RelayBridge.cs for the topology).
// Compiled only when the PurrNet package is present (AURIX_PURRNET is set by the asmdef version define).
#if AURIX_PURRNET
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Aurix.Net.Transports;
using PurrNet.Transports;
using UnityEngine;
using PChannel = PurrNet.Transports.Channel;

namespace Aurix.Net.PurrNet
{
    public sealed class AurixNetTransport : GenericTransport, ITransport
    {
        [Header("Aurix Net")]
        [Tooltip("Node control-plane URL, e.g. https://node.example.com")]
        public string httpUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:8090";
        [Tooltip("Grant issued by your backend (POST /v1/grants). Leave empty and set GrantProvider from code.")]
        public string grant = "";
        [Tooltip("Relay room name shared by host and clients.")]
        public string roomName = "purrnet";
        public int maxPlayers = 16;
        [Tooltip("Relay event code reserved for PurrNet frames.")]
        public byte eventCode = 200;

        /// <summary>Async grant source; wins over the inspector field.</summary>
        public Func<Task<string>> GrantProvider;

        public override bool isSupported => true;
        public override ITransport transport => this;

        public event OnConnected onConnected;
        public event OnDisconnected onDisconnected;
        public event OnDataReceived onDataReceived;
        public event OnDataSent onDataSent;
        public event OnConnectionState onConnectionState;

        readonly List<Connection> _connections = new List<Connection>();
        public IReadOnlyList<Connection> connections => _connections;

        public ConnectionState listenerState { get; private set; } = ConnectionState.Disconnected;
        public ConnectionState clientState { get; private set; } = ConnectionState.Disconnected;

        RelayBridge _host, _client;
        static readonly Connection ServerConn = new Connection(0);

        RelayBridge NewBridge() => new RelayBridge(new RelayBridgeSettings
        {
            HttpUrl = httpUrl, Grant = grant, GrantProvider = GrantProvider, RoomName = roomName, MaxPlayers = maxPlayers, EventCode = eventCode
        });

        protected override void StartClientInternal() => Connect(null, 0);
        protected override void StartServerInternal() => Listen(0);

        // ---- IListener (PurrNet server = room master) ----
        public void Listen(ushort port)
        {
            if (_host != null) return;
            var b = _host = NewBridge();
            b.OnState += s => { listenerState = Map(s); onConnectionState?.Invoke(listenerState, true); };
            b.OnPeerJoined += a => { var c = new Connection(a); _connections.Add(c); onConnected?.Invoke(c, true); };
            b.OnPeerLeft += (a, why) => { var c = new Connection(a); if (_connections.Remove(c)) onDisconnected?.Invoke(c, Map(why, true), true); };
            b.OnData += (from, d, _) => onDataReceived?.Invoke(new Connection(from), new ByteData(d.Array, d.Offset, d.Count), true);
            b.OnDisconnected += why => { if (why != BridgeLeave.Local) Debug.LogWarning("[AurixNet] host stopped: " + b.LastError); if (_host == b) _host = null; };
            b.StartHost();
        }

        public void StopListening() { var b = _host; _host = null; b?.Stop(); }

        // ---- IConnectable (PurrNet client) ----
        public void Connect(string ip, ushort port)
        {
            if (_client != null) return;
            var b = _client = NewBridge();
            b.OnState += s =>
            {
                clientState = Map(s); onConnectionState?.Invoke(clientState, false);
                if (s == BridgeState.Started) onConnected?.Invoke(ServerConn, false);
            };
            b.OnData += (from, d, _) => onDataReceived?.Invoke(ServerConn, new ByteData(d.Array, d.Offset, d.Count), false);
            b.OnDisconnected += why =>
            {
                if (why == BridgeLeave.Failed) Debug.LogError("[AurixNet] connect failed: " + b.LastError);
                if (_client == b) _client = null;
                onDisconnected?.Invoke(ServerConn, Map(why, false), false);
            };
            b.StartClient();
        }

        public void Disconnect() { var b = _client; _client = null; b?.Stop(); }

        // ---- data ----
        public void SendToClient(Connection target, ByteData data, PChannel method = PChannel.ReliableOrdered)
        {
            if (_host == null || !target.isValid) return;
            _host.SendTo(target.connectionId, data.segment, Reliable(method));
            onDataSent?.Invoke(target, data, true);
        }

        public void SendToServer(ByteData data, PChannel method = PChannel.ReliableOrdered)
        {
            if (_client == null) return;
            _client.SendToHost(data.segment, Reliable(method));
            onDataSent?.Invoke(ServerConn, data, false);
        }

        public void CloseConnection(Connection conn) => _host?.Kick(conn.connectionId);

        public void RaiseDataReceived(Connection conn, ByteData data, bool asServer) => onDataReceived?.Invoke(conn, data, asServer);
        public void RaiseDataSent(Connection conn, ByteData data, bool asServer) => onDataSent?.Invoke(conn, data, asServer);

        public void ReceiveMessages(float delta) { _host?.Pump(); _client?.Pump(); }
        public void SendMessages(float delta) { _host?.Flush(); _client?.Flush(); }

        public int GetMTU(Connection target, PChannel channel, bool asServer) => RelayBridge.Mtu(Reliable(channel));

        static bool Reliable(PChannel c) => c == PChannel.ReliableOrdered || c == PChannel.ReliableUnordered;

        static ConnectionState Map(BridgeState s) => s switch
        {
            BridgeState.Starting => ConnectionState.Connecting,
            BridgeState.Started => ConnectionState.Connected,
            BridgeState.Stopping => ConnectionState.Disconnecting,
            _ => ConnectionState.Disconnected
        };

        static DisconnectReason Map(BridgeLeave why, bool asServer) => why switch
        {
            BridgeLeave.Kicked => DisconnectReason.ServerRequest,
            BridgeLeave.Local => asServer ? DisconnectReason.ServerRequest : DisconnectReason.ClientRequest,
            BridgeLeave.Failed => DisconnectReason.ConnectionFailed,
            _ => DisconnectReason.Timeout
        };
    }
}
#endif

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Transports/RelayBridge.cs`:

```cs
// Shared core for the third-party netcode transports (PurrNet, Mirror, FishNet): one Aurix relay room
// carries a host (the room master) and its clients. Host→client frames are events targeted at one
// actor, client→host frames are events to the master, PurrNet/Mirror/FishNet connection ids are the
// Aurix actor ids. Plain C#, no engine dependency; the adapters are thin MonoBehaviour wrappers.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Aurix.Net;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;

namespace Aurix.Net.Transports
{
    public enum BridgeState { Stopped, Starting, Started, Stopping }

    /// <summary>Why a peer or the local side went away; adapters map it onto their own enums.</summary>
    public enum BridgeLeave { Local, Kicked, HostGone, Lost, Failed }

    public sealed class RelayBridgeSettings
    {
        public string HttpUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:8090";
        public string Grant = "";
        /// <summary>Async grant source; wins over <see cref="Grant"/>.</summary>
        public Func<Task<string>> GrantProvider;
        public string RoomName = "game";
        public int MaxPlayers = 16;
        /// <summary>Relay event code reserved for transport frames; keep other events off it.</summary>
        public byte EventCode = 200;
        public int TimeoutMs = 10000;
        /// <summary>Keep the link when the master changes: raise OnPromoted / OnHostChanged instead of dropping.</summary>
        public bool AllowHostMigration;
        /// <summary>StartAuto: join_random filter (room props that must match exactly, JSON object) and SQL-like lobby expression.</summary>
        public string MatchFilterJson, MatchExpr;
        /// <summary>Props the room is created with when hosting (JSON object); StartAuto matches them against MatchFilterJson.</summary>
        public string PropsJson;
    }

    public sealed class RelayBridge : IDisposable
    {
        public const string KickReason = "kicked";

        public readonly RelayBridgeSettings Settings;
        public bool IsHost { get; private set; }
        public BridgeState State { get; private set; } = BridgeState.Stopped;
        public int LocalActor => _client?.Actor ?? -1;
        public int MasterActor { get; private set; } = -1;
        public string LastError { get; private set; }

        /// <summary>Host side: a client actor joined / left the room.</summary>
        public event Action<int> OnPeerJoined;
        public event Action<int, BridgeLeave> OnPeerLeft;
        /// <summary>Frame from actor <c>from</c> (host side: a client; client side: always the master).</summary>
        public event Action<int, ArraySegment<byte>, bool> OnData;
        public event Action<BridgeState> OnState;
        /// <summary>Client side: the link to the host ended (after <see cref="State"/> went Stopped).</summary>
        public event Action<BridgeLeave> OnDisconnected;
        /// <summary>Host migration: this peer became the room master (now the host).</summary>
        public event Action OnPromoted;
        /// <summary>Host migration: another peer became the master (clients keep their link).</summary>
        public event Action<int> OnHostChanged;

        readonly List<int> _peers = new List<int>();
        readonly List<int> _known = new List<int>();
        public IReadOnlyList<int> Peers => _peers;
        public bool HasPeer(int actor) => _peers.Contains(actor);

        ManagedClient _client;

        public RelayBridge(RelayBridgeSettings settings) { Settings = settings; }

        public void StartHost() => Start(true);
        public void StartClient() => Start(false);
        /// <summary>Quick match: join a random open room matching MatchFilterJson/MatchExpr as a client, or host a fresh one (random name, PropsJson) when none exists. Check IsHost once Started.</summary>
        public void StartAuto() => Start(false, true);

        async void Start(bool host, bool auto = false)
        {
            if (State != BridgeState.Stopped) return;
            IsHost = host; LastError = null;
            Set(BridgeState.Starting);
            try
            {
                var grant = Settings.GrantProvider != null ? await Settings.GrantProvider() : Settings.Grant;
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(grant)) throw new NetException("no grant: set Grant or GrantProvider");
                var c = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync(Settings.HttpUrl, grant, Settings.TimeoutMs);
                // Frames and control messages can arrive while the join handshake is still awaiting the
                // data path (the host answers player_joined at once); queue them until Started.
                var early = new List<object>(); bool started = false;
                c.OnControl += j => { if (started) OnControl(j); else early.Add(j); };
                c.OnEvent += f =>
                {
                    if (f.Code != Settings.EventCode) return;
                    if (!started) { early.Add(f); return; }
                    Dispatch(f, host);
                };
                if (auto)
                {
                    try { await c.JoinRandomAsync(Settings.MatchFilterJson, Settings.MatchExpr); }
                    catch (NetException e) when (e.Message.Contains("no matching room"))
                    {
                        Settings.RoomName = "m-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 10);
                        host = IsHost = true;
                        await c.JoinOrCreateAsync(Settings.RoomName, "relay", Settings.MaxPlayers, Settings.PropsJson);
                    }
                }
                else if (host) await c.JoinOrCreateAsync(Settings.RoomName, "relay", Settings.MaxPlayers, Settings.PropsJson);
                else await c.JoinAsync(Settings.RoomName);
                MasterActor = (int)Json.Num(c.JoinedJson, "master");
                if (host && MasterActor != c.Actor) { c.Dispose(); throw new NetException("room already has a host (master actor " + MasterActor + ")"); }
                if (!host && MasterActor == c.Actor) { c.Dispose(); throw new NetException("no host in room " + Settings.RoomName); }
                _client = c;
                c.OnClosed += r => Fail(BridgeLeave.Lost, r);
                foreach (var a in Actors(c.JoinedJson)) { if (a != c.Actor && !_known.Contains(a)) _known.Add(a); if (host && a != c.Actor) AddPeer(a); }
                Set(BridgeState.Started);
                started = true;
                foreach (var e in early) { if (e is string j) OnControl(j); else if (e is EventFrame f) Dispatch(f, host); }
                early.Clear();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                LastError = e.Message;
                Set(BridgeState.Stopped);
                OnDisconnected?.Invoke(BridgeLeave.Failed);
            }
        }

        void Dispatch(EventFrame f, bool host)
        {
            if (host) { if (_peers.Contains(f.From)) OnData?.Invoke(f.From, f.Payload, true); }
            else if (f.From == MasterActor) OnData?.Invoke(f.From, f.Payload, false);
        }

        public void Stop() => Stop(BridgeLeave.Local);

        void Stop(BridgeLeave why)
        {
            if (_client == null) { if (State == BridgeState.Starting) Set(BridgeState.Stopped); return; }
            Set(BridgeState.Stopping);
            if (IsHost) foreach (var a in _peers.ToArray()) { _peers.Remove(a); OnPeerLeft?.Invoke(a, BridgeLeave.Local); }
            try { _client.Dispose(); } catch { }
            _client = null;
            Set(BridgeState.Stopped);
            OnDisconnected?.Invoke(why);
        }

        void Fail(BridgeLeave why, string reason)
        {
            if (State == BridgeState.Stopped || State == BridgeState.Stopping) return;
            LastError = reason;
            Stop(why);
        }

        /// <summary>Host → one client.</summary>
        public void SendTo(int actor, ArraySegment<byte> data, bool reliable)
        {
            if (_client == null || !IsHost) return;
            _client.SendEvent(Settings.EventCode, Copy(data), Target.Actors, reliable, new[] { (ushort)actor });
        }

        /// <summary>Client → host.</summary>
        public void SendToHost(ArraySegment<byte> data, bool reliable)
        {
            if (_client == null || IsHost) return;
            _client.SendEvent(Settings.EventCode, Copy(data), Target.Master, reliable);
        }

        /// <summary>Host: remove a client from the room; it sees <see cref="BridgeLeave.Kicked"/>.</summary>
        public void Kick(int actor)
        {
            if (_client == null || !IsHost) return;
            _ = _client.SendControlAsync("{\"t\":\"kick\",\"actor\":" + actor + ",\"reason\":\"" + KickReason + "\"}");
            RemovePeer(actor, BridgeLeave.Kicked);
        }

        /// <summary>Dispatch pending messages on the calling thread (every frame).</summary>
        public void Pump() => _client?.Poll();
        public void Flush() => _client?.Flush();

        /// <summary>Largest payload for one frame on the given channel.</summary>
        public static int Mtu(bool reliable) => reliable ? 8192 : Packet.MaxUnfragmented - 8;

        public void Dispose() => Stop();

        void OnControl(string j)
        {
            switch (Json.Str(j, "t"))
            {
                case "player_joined": { var p = Json.Obj(j, "player"); int a = (int)Json.Num(p, "actor"); if (IsHost) AddPeer(a); else if (!_known.Contains(a)) _known.Add(a); break; }
                case "player_left": { int a = (int)Json.Num(j, "actor"); _known.Remove(a); if (IsHost) RemovePeer(a, Json.Str(j, "reason") == KickReason ? BridgeLeave.Kicked : BridgeLeave.Lost); break; }
                case "master_changed":
                {
                    int m = (int)Json.Num(j, "actor");
                    if (!Settings.AllowHostMigration) { if (!IsHost || m != LocalActor) Fail(BridgeLeave.HostGone, IsHost ? "lost mastership" : "host left the room"); break; }
                    MasterActor = m;
                    if (m == LocalActor && !IsHost) { IsHost = true; _peers.Clear(); foreach (var a in _known) if (a != LocalActor) _peers.Add(a); OnPromoted?.Invoke(); }
                    else if (m != LocalActor) { if (IsHost) { IsHost = false; _peers.Clear(); } OnHostChanged?.Invoke(m); }
                    break;
                }
                case "left":
                    Fail(Json.Str(j, "reason") == KickReason ? BridgeLeave.Kicked : BridgeLeave.Lost, Json.Str(j, "reason"));
                    break;
            }
        }

        void AddPeer(int actor) { if (!_known.Contains(actor)) _known.Add(actor); if (_peers.Contains(actor)) return; _peers.Add(actor); OnPeerJoined?.Invoke(actor); }
        void RemovePeer(int actor, BridgeLeave why) { if (_peers.Remove(actor)) OnPeerLeft?.Invoke(actor, why); }
        void Set(BridgeState s) { State = s; OnState?.Invoke(s); }

        static byte[] Copy(ArraySegment<byte> d) { var b = new byte[d.Count]; Array.Copy(d.Array, d.Offset, b, 0, d.Count); return b; }

        /// <summary>Actor ids from joined.players (array of {actor,...}).</summary>
        static IEnumerable<int> Actors(string joined)
        {
            int i = joined.IndexOf("\"players\"", StringComparison.Ordinal); if (i < 0) yield break;
            int end = joined.IndexOf(']', i); if (end < 0) end = joined.Length;
            for (int k = joined.IndexOf("\"actor\"", i, StringComparison.Ordinal); k >= 0 && k < end; k = joined.IndexOf("\"actor\"", k + 7, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                int s = joined.IndexOf(':', k) + 1; var sb = new StringBuilder();
                while (s < joined.Length && (char.IsDigit(joined[s]) || joined[s] == ' ')) { if (joined[s] != ' ') sb.Append(joined[s]); s++; }
                if (sb.Length > 0) yield return int.Parse(sb.ToString());
            }
        }
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Unity/NetAnimator.cs`:

```cs
// Replicates Animator parameters through a schema component (default "Animator"): every field of the
// component maps to the Animator parameter of the same name — f32/quantized → float, int/uint →
// integer, bool → bool. Triggers are not state: fire them with a [Rpc] on the owner.
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity
{
    [SyncComponent("Animator")]
    [RequireComponent(typeof(Animator))]
    public sealed class NetAnimator : SyncBehaviour
    {
        [Tooltip("Remote copies blend float parameters towards the replicated value with this rate (0 = snap).")] public float FloatDamping = 0f;
        Animator _anim;

        protected override void OnBound() { _anim = GetComponent<Animator>(); }

        protected override bool CollectCustom(ComponentValue v)
        {
            if (_anim == null || NetComponent == null) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < NetComponent.Fields.Count; i++)
            {
                var f = NetComponent.Fields[i];
                switch (f.Type.Kind)
                {
                    case FieldKind.Bool: v.Fields[i] = new Value { B = _anim.GetBool(f.Name) }; break;
                    case FieldKind.UInt: v.Fields[i] = new Value { U = (ulong)Mathf.Max(0, _anim.GetInteger(f.Name)) }; break;
                    case FieldKind.Int: v.Fields[i] = new Value { I = _anim.GetInteger(f.Name) }; break;
                    case FieldKind.F32: case FieldKind.Quant: v.Fields[i] = new Value { F = _anim.GetFloat(f.Name) }; break;
                    default: break;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        protected override bool ApplyCustom(ComponentValue v)
        {
            if (_anim == null || NetComponent == null) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < NetComponent.Fields.Count; i++)
            {
                var f = NetComponent.Fields[i];
                switch (f.Type.Kind)
                {
                    case FieldKind.Bool: _anim.SetBool(f.Name, v.Fields[i].B); break;
                    case FieldKind.UInt: _anim.SetInteger(f.Name, (int)v.Fields[i].U); break;
                    case FieldKind.Int: _anim.SetInteger(f.Name, (int)v.Fields[i].I); break;
                    case FieldKind.F32: case FieldKind.Quant:
                        if (FloatDamping > 0f) _anim.SetFloat(f.Name, v.Fields[i].F, FloatDamping, Time.unscaledDeltaTime); else _anim.SetFloat(f.Name, v.Fields[i].F);
                        break;
                    default: break;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Unity/NetRigidbody.cs`:

```cs
// Replicates a Rigidbody through a schema component (default "Rigidbody": pos vec3, rot quat, vel vec3,
// ang vec3). Owner: simulates and sends every tick. Remote: kinematic, interpolated like NetTransform
// with velocity-based extrapolation when the next sample has not arrived yet.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity
{
    [SyncComponent("Rigidbody")]
    [RequireComponent(typeof(Rigidbody))]
    public sealed class NetRigidbody : SyncBehaviour
    {
        [Sync("pos")] public Vector3 Position;
        [Sync("rot")] public Quaternion Rotation = Quaternion.identity;
        [Sync("vel")] public Vector3 Velocity;
        [Sync("ang")] public Vector3 AngularVelocity;
        [Tooltip("Snap instead of interpolating when the remote jumped farther than this.")] public float TeleportDistance = 5f;
        [Tooltip("Remote copies extrapolate with the last velocity for at most this many ticks.")] public float MaxExtrapolationTicks = 3f;

        struct Sample { public uint Tick; public Vector3 Pos; public Quaternion Rot; public Vector3 Vel; }
        readonly List<Sample> _buf = new List<Sample>(8);
        Rigidbody _rb;

        protected override void OnBound()
        {
            _rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
            if (IsMine) { Position = _rb.position; Rotation = _rb.rotation; Velocity = _rb.velocity; AngularVelocity = _rb.angularVelocity; }
            else { _rb.isKinematic = true; _rb.position = Position; _rb.rotation = Rotation; _buf.Clear(); _buf.Add(new Sample { Tick = View.Runner.ServerTick, Pos = Position, Rot = Rotation, Vel = Velocity }); }
        }

        protected override void OnBeforeSend()
        {
            if (_rb == null) return;
            Position = _rb.position; Rotation = _rb.rotation; Velocity = _rb.velocity; AngularVelocity = _rb.angularVelocity;
        }

        protected override void OnSynced(uint tick)
        {
            if (_buf.Count > 0 && Vector3.Distance(_buf[_buf.Count - 1].Pos, Position) > TeleportDistance) _buf.Clear();
            _buf.Add(new Sample { Tick = tick, Pos = Position, Rot = Rotation, Vel = Velocity });
            while (_buf.Count > 8) _buf.RemoveAt(0);
        }

        void Update()
        {
            if (View == null || IsMine || _rb == null || _buf.Count == 0) return;
            float render = View.Runner.RenderTick; float hz = Mathf.Max(1, View.Runner.Settings.TickHz);
            Sample a = _buf[0], b = _buf[_buf.Count - 1];
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < _buf.Count; i++) if (_buf[i].Tick <= render && _buf[i + 1].Tick >= render) { a = _buf[i]; b = _buf[i + 1]; break; }
            Vector3 pos; Quaternion rot;
            if (render > b.Tick)
            {
                float ahead = Mathf.Min(render - b.Tick, MaxExtrapolationTicks);
                pos = b.Pos + b.Vel * (ahead / hz); rot = b.Rot;
            }
            else
            {
                float t = b.Tick > a.Tick ? Mathf.Clamp01((render - a.Tick) / (b.Tick - a.Tick)) : 1f;
                pos = Vector3.Lerp(a.Pos, b.Pos, t); rot = Quaternion.Slerp(a.Rot, b.Rot, t);
            }
            _rb.MovePosition(pos); _rb.MoveRotation(rot);
        }
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Unity/NetRunner.cs`:

```cs
// The one component a scene needs: connects, joins, spawns prefabs for replicated entities,
// sends the local player's [Sync] writes as inputs every tick, dispatches events and RPCs.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity
{
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-100)]
    public sealed class NetRunner : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public static NetRunner Instance { get; private set; }
        public NetSettings Settings;
        [Tooltip("Join this room on Start (empty = call JoinOrCreate yourself).")] public string AutoJoinRoom = "";
        [Tooltip("Player id for dev grants (DevApiKey); production grants come from your backend.")] public string DevPlayerId = "";

        public ManagedClient Client { get; private set; }
        public Schema Schema { get; private set; }
        public SyncWorld World { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>Lockstep rooms: confirmed inputs per tick, catch-up, hashes (see LockstepClient).</summary>
        public LockstepClient Lockstep { get; private set; }
        public int Actor => Client?.Actor ?? -1;
        public RoomMode Mode { get; private set; }
        public bool IsJoined { get; private set; }
        public uint ServerTick => World?.ServerTick ?? 0;
        /// <summary>Server tick remote entities are rendered at (ServerTick - InterpolationTicks, advanced between deltas).</summary>
        public float RenderTick { get; private set; }
        public readonly Dictionary<ulong, NetView> Views = new Dictionary<ulong, NetView>();

        public event Action OnJoined;
        public event Action<string> OnClosed;
        public event Action<EventFrame> OnEvent;
        public event Action<string> OnControl;
        public event Action<NetView> OnSpawned, OnDespawned;
        /// <summary>Server state for an entity you own arrived (tick = server tick). Feed it to a
        /// <see cref="Predictor{TState}"/> to reconcile when your WASM logic drives the entity.</summary>
        public event Action<NetView, NetEntity, uint> OnOwnEntityUpdated;
        /// <summary>Tick stamped on the last input sent (what to pass to <c>Predictor.Record</c>).</summary>
        public uint LastInputTick => _lastInputTick;

        const byte RpcEventCode = 0xF0;
        readonly List<(ComponentDef, ComponentValue)> _writes = new List<(ComponentDef, ComponentValue)>();
        readonly List<byte[]> _recentInputs = new List<byte[]>();
        uint _lastInputTick; float _tickTimer; float _lastDeltaTime;

        void Awake() { Instance = this; }

        async void Start()
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(AutoJoinRoom))
            {
                try { await ConnectWithDevGrantAsync(); await JoinOrCreateAsync(AutoJoinRoom); }
                catch (Exception e) { Debug.LogError("Aurix Net: " + e.Message); }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Dev only: issues a grant with Settings.DevApiKey and connects.</summary>
        public async Task ConnectWithDevGrantAsync()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Settings.DevApiKey)) throw new NetException("NetSettings.DevApiKey is empty; pass a grant from your backend to ConnectAsync instead");
            var pid = string.IsNullOrEmpty(DevPlayerId) ? "dev-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8) : DevPlayerId;
            await ConnectAsync(await DevGrant.IssueAsync(Settings.ServerUrl, Settings.DevApiKey, pid, pid));
        }

        /// <summary>Connects with a grant your backend issued (POST /v1/grants).</summary>
        public async Task ConnectAsync(string grant)
        {
            Client = await ManagedClient.ConnectAsync(Settings.ServerUrl, grant);
            Client.OnControl += j => OnControl?.Invoke(j);
            Client.OnEvent += HandleEvent;
            Client.OnData += HandleData;
            Client.OnClosed += r => { IsJoined = false; OnClosed?.Invoke(r); };
            Client.OnRehost += () => _ = RejoinAsync();
        }

        [Tooltip("Other nodes/region URLs to try when the entry node is gone during a rehost.")] public string[] FallbackUrls = new string[0];

        /// <summary>Rehost (node shut down, room handed to another node): drop the views, rejoin the same room.</summary>
        public async Task RejoinAsync()
        {
            IsJoined = false;
            foreach (var v in Views.Values) Destroy(v.gameObject);
            Views.Clear(); World = null; Lockstep = null;
            try
            {
                var old = Client; Client = null;
                var c = await old.RejoinAsync(FallbackUrls);
                Client = c;
                c.OnControl += j => OnControl?.Invoke(j);
                c.OnEvent += HandleEvent; c.OnData += HandleData;
                c.OnClosed += r => { IsJoined = false; OnClosed?.Invoke(r); };
                c.OnRehost += () => _ = RejoinAsync();
                Mode = Enum.TryParse<RoomMode>(c.RoomMode, true, out var m) ? m : Mode;
                AfterJoin();
            }
            catch (Exception e) { Debug.LogError("Aurix Net rehost failed: " + e.Message); OnClosed?.Invoke("rehost failed: " + e.Message); }
        }

        public Task JoinOrCreateAsync(string room) => JoinOrCreateAsync(room, Settings.DefaultMode);
        public async Task JoinOrCreateAsync(string room, RoomMode mode, int maxPlayers = 0)
        {
            Mode = mode;
            var props = new StringBuilder("{\"tick_hz\":").Append(Settings.TickHz);
            if (mode == RoomMode.Sync && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Settings.Schema)) props.Append(",\"schema\":").Append(JsonStr(Settings.Schema));
            props.Append('}');
            await Client.JoinOrCreateAsync(room, mode.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(), maxPlayers > 0 ? maxPlayers : Settings.MaxPlayers, props.ToString());
            AfterJoin();
        }
        public async Task JoinAsync(string room, bool spectator = false)
        {
            await Client.JoinAsync(room, null, spectator);
            Mode = Enum.TryParse<RoomMode>(Client.RoomMode, true, out var m) ? m : RoomMode.Relay;
            AfterJoin();
        }
        void AfterJoin()
        {
            if (Mode == RoomMode.Sync)
            {
                Schema = Schema.Parse(string.IsNullOrEmpty(Settings.Schema) ? ArenaSchema : Settings.Schema);
                World = new SyncWorld(Schema);
                World.OnSpawn += Spawn; World.OnChange += Change; World.OnDespawn += Despawn;
            }
            if (Mode == RoomMode.Lockstep) Lockstep = new LockstepClient((ch, b) => Client.SendData(ch, b));
            IsJoined = true; OnJoined?.Invoke();
        }

        public const string ArenaSchema = "component Transform {\n  pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)\n  rot: quat\n}\n";

        void HandleData(Channel ch, ushort tick, byte[] p)
        {
            if (Lockstep != null) { Lockstep.Receive(p); return; }
            if (World == null) return;
            var ack = World.Receive(p);
            if (ack != null) { Client.SendData(Channel.Unreliable, ack); RenderTick = Mathf.Max(RenderTick, World.ServerTick - Settings.InterpolationTicks); _lastDeltaTime = Time.unscaledTime; }
        }

        void Spawn(NetEntity e)
        {
            var prefab = PickPrefab(e); if (prefab == null) return;
            var view = Instantiate(prefab); view.name = prefab.name + "#" + e.Id;
            Views[e.Id] = view; view.Bind(this, e);
            _spawned.Clear(); view.GetComponentsInChildren(true, _spawned); foreach (var s in _spawned) s.Spawned(view);
            OnSpawned?.Invoke(view);
        }
        readonly List<ISpawned> _spawned = new List<ISpawned>(); readonly List<IDespawned> _despawned = new List<IDespawned>();

        /// <summary>Timer expiring <paramref name="seconds"/> of server ticks from now (same on every peer).</summary>
        public TickTimer TimerFromSeconds(float seconds) => TickTimer.CreateFromSeconds(ServerTick, seconds, Settings.TickHz);
        public TickTimer TimerFromTicks(uint ticks) => TickTimer.CreateFromTicks(ServerTick, ticks);
        public bool Expired(TickTimer t) => t.Expired(ServerTick);
        public float RemainingSeconds(TickTimer t) => t.RemainingSeconds(ServerTick, Settings.TickHz);
        void Change(NetEntity e)
        {
            if (!Views.TryGetValue(e.Id, out var v)) { Spawn(e); return; }
            v.Owner = e.Owner;
            if (v.IsMine) { OnOwnEntityUpdated?.Invoke(v, e, World.ServerTick); return; }
            foreach (var b in v.Behaviours) b.ApplyFromEntity(e, World.ServerTick);
        }
        void Despawn(NetEntity e)
        {
            if (!Views.TryGetValue(e.Id, out var v)) return;
            Views.Remove(e.Id);
            _despawned.Clear(); v.GetComponentsInChildren(true, _despawned); foreach (var d in _despawned) d.Despawned(v);
            OnDespawned?.Invoke(v); Destroy(v.gameObject);
        }
        NetView PickPrefab(NetEntity e)
        {
            if (Settings.Prefabs == null || Settings.Prefabs.Length == 0) return null;
            var pc = Schema.ByName("Prefab"); var pv = pc != null ? e.Get(pc) : null;
            if (pv != null && pc.IndexOf("name") >= 0) { var n = pv.Fields[pc.IndexOf("name")].S; foreach (var p in Settings.Prefabs) if (p != null && p.name == n) return p; }
            return Settings.Prefabs[0];
        }

        void Update()
        {
            Client?.Poll();
            if (World != null && Settings.TickHz > 0) RenderTick += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * Settings.TickHz; // advance between deltas
        }

        void LateUpdate()
        {
            if (Client == null || !IsJoined) return;
            if (World != null && Settings.TickHz > 0)
            {
                _tickTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime; float dt = 1f / Settings.TickHz;
                if (_tickTimer >= dt) { _tickTimer -= dt; if (_tickTimer > dt) _tickTimer = 0; SendOwnerInputs(); }
            }
            Client.Flush();
        }

        void SendOwnerInputs()
        {
            _writes.Clear();
            foreach (var v in Views.Values) if (v.IsMine) foreach (var b in v.Behaviours) { var w = b.CollectWrite(false); if (w.HasValue) _writes.Add(w.Value); }
            uint tick = Math.Max(World.ServerTick + 2, _lastInputTick + 1); _lastInputTick = tick;
            var body = _writes.Count > 0 ? World.EncodeWrites(_writes) : Array.Empty<byte>();
            _recentInputs.Add(body); while (_recentInputs.Count > 3) _recentInputs.RemoveAt(0);
            if (_writes.Count == 0 && _recentInputs.TrueForAll(b => b.Length == 0)) return;
            Client.SendData(Channel.Unreliable, SyncWorld.EncodeInput(tick - (uint)(_recentInputs.Count - 1), _recentInputs));
        }

        /// <summary>Sends a raw input frame for the current tick to the server logic (`props.logic`); returns the
        /// tick it was stamped with. Resent with the next two inputs for loss tolerance.</summary>
        public uint SendInput(byte[] body)
        {
            if (World == null || Client == null) return 0;
            uint tick = Math.Max(World.ServerTick + 2, _lastInputTick + 1); _lastInputTick = tick;
            _recentInputs.Add(body ?? Array.Empty<byte>()); while (_recentInputs.Count > 3) _recentInputs.RemoveAt(0);
            Client.SendData(Channel.Unreliable, SyncWorld.EncodeInput(tick - (uint)(_recentInputs.Count - 1), _recentInputs));
            return tick;
        }

        // ---- events / RPC (relay channel) ----
        public void SendEvent(byte code, byte[] payload, Target target = Target.Others, bool reliable = false) => Client.SendEvent(code, payload, target, reliable);

        internal void SendRpc(NetView view, string method, object[] args)
        {
            var w = new BitWriter(); w.WriteBits(view.EntityId, 48);
            var mb = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(method); w.WriteBits((ulong)mb.Length, 8); w.WriteBytes(mb);
            w.WriteBits((ulong)args.Length, 8);
            foreach (var a in args) RpcArgs.Write(w, a);
            Client.SendEvent(RpcEventCode, w.Finish(), Target.Others, reliable: true);
        }
        void HandleEvent(EventFrame f)
        {
            if (f.Code != RpcEventCode) { OnEvent?.Invoke(f); return; }
            var buf = new byte[f.Payload.Count]; Array.Copy(f.Payload.Array, f.Payload.Offset, buf, 0, buf.Length);
            var r = new BitReader(buf); ulong id = r.ReadBits(48);
            var method = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(r.ReadBytes((int)r.ReadBits(8))); int n = (int)r.ReadBits(8);
            if (!Views.TryGetValue(id, out var v)) return;
            foreach (var b in v.Behaviours)
            {
                var m = b.RpcMethod(method); if (m == null) continue;
                var ps = m.GetParameters(); var args = new object[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) args[i] = RpcArgs.Read(r, i < ps.Length ? ps[i].ParameterType : typeof(object));
                b.InvokeRpc(method, args); return;
            }
        }

        static string JsonStr(string s)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder("\"");
            foreach (var c in s) { if (c == '"' || c == '\\') sb.Append('\\').Append(c); else if (c == '\n') sb.Append("\\n"); else if (c < 0x20) sb.Append("\\u").Append(((int)c).ToString("x4")); else sb.Append(c); }
            return sb.Append('"').ToString();
        }

        void OnDestroy() { Client?.Dispose(); if (Instance == this) Instance = null; }
    }

    /// <summary>Tagged RPC argument codec: bool, int, long, float, string, byte[], Vector3, Quaternion.</summary>
    static class RpcArgs
    {
        public static void Write(BitWriter w, object a)
        {
            switch (a)
            {
                case bool b: w.WriteBits(1, 4); w.WriteBool(b); break;
                case int i: w.WriteBits(2, 4); w.WriteInt(i, 32); break;
                case long l: w.WriteBits(3, 4); w.WriteInt(l, 64); break;
                case float f: w.WriteBits(4, 4); w.WriteF32(f); break;
                case string s: { w.WriteBits(5, 4); var b = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s); w.WriteBits((ulong)b.Length, 16); w.WriteBytes(b); break; }
                case byte[] bs: w.WriteBits(6, 4); w.WriteBits((ulong)bs.Length, 16); w.WriteBytes(bs); break;
                case Vector3 v: w.WriteBits(7, 4); w.WriteF32(v.x); w.WriteF32(v.y); w.WriteF32(v.z); break;
                case Quaternion q: w.WriteBits(8, 4); w.WriteF32(q.x); w.WriteF32(q.y); w.WriteF32(q.z); w.WriteF32(q.w); break;
                default: throw new NetException("unsupported RPC argument type " + a?.GetType().Name);
            }
        }
        public static object Read(BitReader r, Type want)
        {
            switch ((int)r.ReadBits(4))
            {
                case 1: return r.ReadBool();
                case 2: return Convert.ChangeType((int)r.ReadInt(32), want == typeof(object) ? typeof(int) : want);
                case 3: return r.ReadInt(64);
                case 4: return Convert.ChangeType(r.ReadF32(), want == typeof(object) ? typeof(float) : want);
                case 5: return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(r.ReadBytes((int)r.ReadBits(16)));
                case 6: return r.ReadBytes((int)r.ReadBits(16));
                case 7: return new Vector3(r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32());
                case 8: return new Quaternion(r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32(), r.ReadF32());
            }
            throw new NetException("bad RPC argument");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Dev-time grant issuance from the client. Production: your backend calls POST /v1/grants.</summary>
    public static class DevGrant
    {
        public static async Task<string> IssueAsync(string http, string apiKey, string playerId, string name)
        {
            using (var c = new System.Net.Http.HttpClient())
            {
                var req = new System.Net.Http.HttpRequestMessage(System.Net.Http.HttpMethod.Post, http.TrimEnd('/') + "/v1/grants");
                req.Headers.Authorization = new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", apiKey);
                req.Content = new System.Net.Http.StringContent("{\"player_id\":" + Q(playerId) + ",\"name\":" + Q(name) + "}", Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                var r = await c.SendAsync(req); var body = await r.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                if (!r.IsSuccessStatusCode) throw new NetException("grant: " + body);
                return ManagedClientTestHooks.Str(body, "grant");
            }
        }
        static string Q(string s) => "\"" + s.Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\"";
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Unity/NetSettings.cs`:

```cs
// Project-wide Aurix Net settings: create via Assets > Create > Aurix Net > Settings.
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity
{
    [CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "Aurix Net/Settings", fileName = "AurixNetSettings")]
    public sealed class NetSettings : ScriptableObject
    {
        [Tooltip("Node or cloud URL, e.g. https://eu.net.aurix.dev")] public string ServerUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:8090";
        [Tooltip("Dev only: issues grants from the client with an API key. Never ship a key; in production your backend calls POST /v1/grants.")]
        public string DevApiKey = "";
        public RoomMode DefaultMode = RoomMode.Sync;
        public int TickHz = 60;
        public int MaxPlayers = 8;
        [Tooltip("IDL schema for sync rooms (components and fields). Empty = built-in arena schema.")]
        [TextArea(6, 30)] public string Schema = "component Transform {\n  pos: vec3 @range(-1024, 1024, 0.01)\n  rot: quat\n}\ncomponent Prefab {\n  name: string(32)\n}\n";
        [Tooltip("Remote entities are rendered this many ticks behind the server for smooth interpolation.")]
        public int InterpolationTicks = 2;
        [Tooltip("Prefabs that can be spawned for replicated entities; matched by the Prefab.name component, the first one is the default.")]
        public NetView[] Prefabs = new NetView[0];
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Unity/NetTransform.cs`:

```cs
// Replicates position/rotation through the schema's Transform component (pos: vec3, rot: quat).
// Owner: writes the transform every tick. Remote: interpolates between the last two server states.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity
{
    [SyncComponent("Transform")]
    public sealed class NetTransform : SyncBehaviour
    {
        [Sync("pos")] public Vector3 Position;
        [Sync("rot")] public Quaternion Rotation = Quaternion.identity;
        [Tooltip("Snap instead of interpolating when the remote jumped farther than this.")] public float TeleportDistance = 5f;

        struct Sample { public uint Tick; public Vector3 Pos; public Quaternion Rot; }
        readonly List<Sample> _buf = new List<Sample>(8);

        protected override void OnBound()
        {
            if (IsMine) { Position = transform.position; Rotation = transform.rotation; }
            else { transform.position = Position; transform.rotation = Rotation; _buf.Clear(); _buf.Add(new Sample { Tick = View.Runner.ServerTick, Pos = Position, Rot = Rotation }); }
        }

        protected override void OnSynced(uint tick)
        {
            if (_buf.Count > 0 && Vector3.Distance(_buf[_buf.Count - 1].Pos, Position) > TeleportDistance) _buf.Clear();
            _buf.Add(new Sample { Tick = tick, Pos = Position, Rot = Rotation });
            while (_buf.Count > 8) _buf.RemoveAt(0);
        }

        void Update()
        {
            if (View == null) return;
            if (IsMine) { Position = transform.position; Rotation = transform.rotation; return; }
            if (_buf.Count == 0) return;
            float render = View.Runner.RenderTick;
            Sample a = _buf[0], b = _buf[_buf.Count - 1];
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < _buf.Count; i++) if (_buf[i].Tick <= render && _buf[i + 1].Tick >= render) { a = _buf[i]; b = _buf[i + 1]; break; }
            float t = b.Tick > a.Tick ? Mathf.Clamp01((render - a.Tick) / (b.Tick - a.Tick)) : 1f;
            if (render > b.Tick) t = 1f;
            transform.position = Vector3.Lerp(a.Pos, b.Pos, t);
            transform.rotation = Quaternion.Slerp(a.Rot, b.Rot, t);
        }
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Unity/NetView.cs`:

```cs
// Identity of a replicated entity on a GameObject (like a network object id + owner).
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity
{
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    public sealed class NetView : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public ulong EntityId { get; internal set; }
        public ushort? Owner { get; internal set; }
        public NetEntity Entity { get; internal set; }
        public NetRunner Runner { get; internal set; }
        /// <summary>True when the local player owns this entity (its inputs drive it).</summary>
        public bool IsMine => Runner != null && Owner.HasValue && Owner.Value == Runner.Actor;
        internal readonly List<SyncBehaviour> Behaviours = new List<SyncBehaviour>();

        internal void Bind(NetRunner runner, NetEntity e)
        {
            Runner = runner; Entity = e; EntityId = e.Id; Owner = e.Owner;
            Behaviours.Clear(); GetComponentsInChildren(true, Behaviours);
            foreach (var b in Behaviours) b.Bind(this);
        }

        /// <summary>Invokes a [Rpc] method on every peer's copy of this view (reliable relay event).</summary>
        public void Rpc(string method, params object[] args) => Runner.SendRpc(this, method, args);
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Runtime/Unity/SyncBehaviour.cs`:

```cs
// Base class for replicated behaviours: fields marked [Sync] map onto a schema component's
// fields by name (component = [SyncComponent("Name")] or the class name). The owner sends
// changed values every tick as its input; everyone else receives them from server deltas.
// [Rpc] methods can be called through NetView.Rpc("Method", args...).
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Aurix.Net.Unity
{
    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Field)] public sealed class SyncAttribute : Attribute { public string Name; public SyncAttribute(string name = null) { Name = name; } }
    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class)] public sealed class SyncComponentAttribute : Attribute { public string Name; public SyncComponentAttribute(string name) { Name = name; } }
    [AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method)] public sealed class RpcAttribute : Attribute { }

    public abstract class SyncBehaviour : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public NetView View { get; private set; }
        public bool IsMine => View != null && View.IsMine;
        protected ComponentDef NetComponent { get; private set; }
        FieldInfo[] _fields; int[] _slots; ComponentValue _lastSent;
        readonly Dictionary<string, MethodInfo> _rpcs = new Dictionary<string, MethodInfo>();

        internal void Bind(NetView view)
        {
            View = view;
            var t = GetType();
            var cname = t.GetCustomAttribute<SyncComponentAttribute>()?.Name ?? t.Name;
            NetComponent = view.Runner.Schema?.ByName(cname);
            var fs = new List<FieldInfo>(); var slots = new List<int>();
            foreach (var f in t.GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic))
            {
                var a = f.GetCustomAttribute<SyncAttribute>(); if (a == null) continue;
                int idx = NetComponent?.IndexOf(a.Name ?? f.Name) ?? -1;
                if (idx < 0) { Debug.LogWarning($"{t.Name}.{f.Name}: no field '{a.Name ?? f.Name}' in component '{cname}' of the schema"); continue; }
                fs.Add(f); slots.Add(idx);
            }
            _fields = fs.ToArray(); _slots = slots.ToArray();
            foreach (var m in t.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic)) if (m.GetCustomAttribute<RpcAttribute>() != null) _rpcs[m.Name] = m;
            if (!IsMine) ApplyFromEntity(view.Entity, view.Runner.ServerTick);
            OnBound();
        }

        /// <summary>Called once the view is bound (entity known, IsMine valid).</summary>
        protected virtual void OnBound() { }
        /// <summary>Called on remote copies after [Sync] fields were updated from a delta.</summary>
        protected virtual void OnSynced(uint tick) { }

        /// <summary>Owner side, before [Sync] fields are collected: copy engine state into them.</summary>
        protected virtual void OnBeforeSend() { }
        /// <summary>Schema-driven behaviours: fill <paramref name="v"/> yourself and return true to skip [Sync] fields.</summary>
        protected virtual bool CollectCustom(ComponentValue v) => false;
        /// <summary>Schema-driven behaviours: read <paramref name="v"/> yourself and return true to skip [Sync] fields.</summary>
        protected virtual bool ApplyCustom(ComponentValue v) => false;

        internal void ApplyFromEntity(NetEntity e, uint tick)
        {
            if (NetComponent == null) return;
            var v = e.Get(NetComponent); if (v == null) return;
            if (!ApplyCustom(v) && _fields != null)
                for (int i = 0; i < _fields.Length; i++) _fields[i].SetValue(this, FromValue(v.Fields[_slots[i]], NetComponent.Fields[_slots[i]].Type, _fields[i].FieldType));
            OnSynced(tick);
        }

        /// <summary>Owner side: the component value to send this tick, or null when nothing changed.</summary>
        internal (ComponentDef, ComponentValue)? CollectWrite(bool force)
        {
            if (NetComponent == null) return null;
            OnBeforeSend();
            var v = _lastSent?.Clone() ?? ComponentValue.Zero(NetComponent);
            if (!CollectCustom(v))
            {
                if (_fields == null || _fields.Length == 0) return null;
                for (int i = 0; i < _fields.Length; i++) v.Fields[_slots[i]] = ToValue(_fields[i].GetValue(this), NetComponent.Fields[_slots[i]].Type);
            }
            bool changed = force || _lastSent == null; if (!changed) for (int i = 0; i < v.Fields.Length && !changed; i++) changed = !v.Fields[i].Equals(_lastSent.Fields[i]);
            if (!changed) return null;
            _lastSent = v; return (NetComponent, v);
        }

        internal bool InvokeRpc(string name, object[] args) { if (!_rpcs.TryGetValue(name, out var m)) return false; m.Invoke(this, args); return true; }
        internal MethodInfo RpcMethod(string name) => _rpcs.TryGetValue(name, out var m) ? m : null;

        static Value ToValue(object o, FieldType t)
        {
            switch (t.Kind)
            {
                case FieldKind.Bool: return new Value { B = (bool)o };
                case FieldKind.UInt: return new Value { U = Convert.ToUInt64(o) };
                case FieldKind.Int: return new Value { I = Convert.ToInt64(o) };
                case FieldKind.F32: case FieldKind.Quant: return new Value { F = Convert.ToSingle(o) };
                case FieldKind.Vec2: { var v = (Vector2)o; return new Value { X = v.x, Y = v.y }; }
                case FieldKind.Vec3: { var v = (Vector3)o; return new Value { X = v.x, Y = v.y, Z = v.z }; }
                case FieldKind.Quat: { var q = (Quaternion)o; return new Value { X = q.x, Y = q.y, Z = q.z, W = q.w }; }
                case FieldKind.String: return new Value { S = (string)o ?? "" };
                case FieldKind.Bytes: return new Value { Bytes = (byte[])o ?? Array.Empty<byte>() };
            }
            return default;
        }
        static object FromValue(in Value v, FieldType t, Type target)
        {
            switch (t.Kind)
            {
                case FieldKind.Bool: return v.B;
                case FieldKind.UInt: return Convert.ChangeType(v.U, target);
                case FieldKind.Int: return Convert.ChangeType(v.I, target);
                case FieldKind.F32: case FieldKind.Quant: return Convert.ChangeType(v.F, target);
                case FieldKind.Vec2: return new Vector2(v.X, v.Y);
                case FieldKind.Vec3: return new Vector3(v.X, v.Y, v.Z);
                case FieldKind.Quat: return new Quaternion(v.X, v.Y, v.Z, v.W);
                case FieldKind.String: return v.S;
                case FieldKind.Bytes: return v.Bytes;
            }
            return null;
        }
    }
}

```

`sdk/unity/Samples~/LockstepDuel/DuelSim.cs`:

```cs
// Lockstep duel sample: a deterministic integer simulation stepped only from confirmed inputs.
// Every client runs the same code over the same inputs; the node (or your WASM logic with
// props.logic) checks the hashes. Scene: NetRunner (DefaultMode = Lockstep) + this component.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Aurix.Net.Managed;
using Aurix.Net.Unity;
using UnityEngine;

public sealed class DuelSim : MonoBehaviour
{
    public NetRunner Runner; public GameObject FighterPrefab;
    // state: per actor x,y in millimetres and hp; all integer, so every platform agrees
    readonly SortedDictionary<ushort, int[]> _fighters = new SortedDictionary<ushort, int[]>();
    readonly Dictionary<ushort, GameObject> _gos = new Dictionary<ushort, GameObject>();
    uint _tick; byte _dir;

    void Start()
    {
        Runner.OnJoined += () =>
        {
            Runner.Lockstep.OnRestore += Restore;
            Runner.Lockstep.OnTick += Step;
            Runner.Lockstep.OnCheckpointRequested += t => Runner.Lockstep.SendCheckpoint(_tick, Hash(), Serialize());
        };
    }

    void Update()
    {
        if (Runner.Lockstep == null) return;
        _dir = (byte)((Input.GetKey(KeyCode.W) ? 1 : 0) | (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.S) ? 2 : 0) | (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.A) ? 4 : 0) | (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.D) ? 8 : 0) | (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Space) ? 16 : 0));
        foreach (var kv in _fighters) { if (!_gos.TryGetValue(kv.Key, out var go)) { go = Instantiate(FighterPrefab); _gos[kv.Key] = go; } go.transform.position = new Vector3(kv.Value[0] / 1000f, 0, kv.Value[1] / 1000f); }
    }

    void FixedUpdate() { Runner.Lockstep?.SendInput(new[] { _dir }); }

    void Step(uint tick, Dictionary<ushort, byte[]> inputs)
    {
        foreach (var a in inputs.Keys) if (!_fighters.ContainsKey(a)) _fighters[a] = new[] { (int)a * 2000, 0, 100 };
        foreach (var kv in inputs)
        {
            var f = _fighters[kv.Key]; byte d = kv.Value.Length > 0 ? kv.Value[0] : (byte)0;
            if ((d & 1) != 0) f[1] += 50; if ((d & 2) != 0) f[1] -= 50; if ((d & 4) != 0) f[0] -= 50; if ((d & 8) != 0) f[0] += 50;
            if ((d & 16) != 0) foreach (var o in _fighters) if (o.Key != kv.Key && Mathf.Abs(o.Value[0] - f[0]) + Mathf.Abs(o.Value[1] - f[1]) < 1500) o.Value[2] = Mathf.Max(0, o.Value[2] - 1);
        }
        _tick = tick + 1;
        if (_tick % 10 == 0) Runner.Lockstep.ReportHash(_tick, Hash());
    }

    void Restore(uint tick, ulong hash, byte[] state)
    {
        _fighters.Clear(); _tick = tick;
        for (int o = 0; o + 14 <= state.Length; o += 14) _fighters[(ushort)((state[o] << 8) | state[o + 1])] = new[] { System.BitConverter.ToInt32(state, o + 2), System.BitConverter.ToInt32(state, o + 6), System.BitConverter.ToInt32(state, o + 10) };
    }
    byte[] Serialize()
    {
        var b = new byte[_fighters.Count * 14]; int o = 0;
        foreach (var kv in _fighters) { b[o] = (byte)(kv.Key >> 8); b[o + 1] = (byte)kv.Key; for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) System.BitConverter.GetBytes(kv.Value[i]).CopyTo(b, o + 2 + i * 4); o += 14; }
        return b;
    }
    ulong Hash() => LockstepClient.Fnv1a(Serialize());
}

// Relay chat sample: a relay room, text as reliable events (code 1), player join/leave from control messages.
using System.Text;
using Aurix.Net;
using Aurix.Net.Unity;
using UnityEngine;

public sealed class ChatSample : MonoBehaviour
{
    public NetRunner Runner; public string Room = "chat-1";
    string _input = ""; readonly StringBuilder _log = new StringBuilder();

    async void Start()
    {
        Runner.OnEvent += f => { if (f.Code == 1) _log.AppendLine($"[{f.From}] {Encoding.UTF8.GetString(f.Payload.Array, f.Payload.Offset, f.Payload.Count)}"); };
        Runner.OnControl += j => { if (j.Contains("player_joined") || j.Contains("player_left")) _log.AppendLine(j); };
        await Runner.ConnectWithDevGrantAsync();
        await Runner.JoinOrCreateAsync(Room, RoomMode.Relay, 16);
        _log.AppendLine("joined as actor " + Runner.Actor);
    }

        GUILayout.TextArea(_log.ToString(), GUILayout.Height(340));
        GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();

        {
            Runner.SendEvent(1, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_input), Target.All, reliable: true); _input = "";
        }
        GUILayout.EndHorizontal(); GUILayout.EndArea();
    }
}

`sdk/unity/Weaver/Aurix.Net.Weaver.Cli/Program.cs`:

```cs
// aurix-weave <assembly.dll> [--ref <dir>]... : weaves RPC methods in place (plain .NET builds, tests, CI).
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using Aurix.Net.Weaver;
using Mono.Cecil;

static class Program
{
    static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        if (args.Length == 0) { Console.Error.WriteLine("usage: aurix-weave <assembly.dll> [--ref <dir>]..."); return 2; }
        if (args[0] == "--dump" && args.Length >= 3)
        {
            var a = AssemblyDefinition.ReadAssembly(Path.GetFullPath(args[1]));
            foreach (var t in a.MainModule.GetTypes()) foreach (var m in t.Methods) if ((t.Name + "::" + m.Name).EndsWith(args[2]) && m.HasBody)
            { Console.WriteLine($"--- {t.FullName}::{m.Name}({string.Join(", ", System.Linq.Enumerable.Select(m.Parameters, x => x.ParameterType.Name))}) attrs={m.Attributes} customAttrs={m.CustomAttributes.Count}"); foreach (var i in m.Body.Instructions) Console.WriteLine("    " + i); }
            return 0;
        }
        var path = Path.GetFullPath(args[0]);
        var resolver = new DefaultAssemblyResolver();
        resolver.AddSearchDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path));
        for (int i = 1; i + 1 < args.Length; i++) if (args[i] == "--ref") resolver.AddSearchDirectory(args[++i]);
        var pdb = Path.ChangeExtension(path, ".pdb"); bool symbols = File.Exists(pdb);
        var rp = new ReaderParameters { AssemblyResolver = resolver, ReadWrite = true, ReadSymbols = symbols, InMemory = true };
        using var asm = AssemblyDefinition.ReadAssembly(path, rp);
        var res = RpcWeaver.Process(asm.MainModule);
        foreach (var d in res.Diagnostics) Console.Error.WriteLine("weaver: " + d);
        if (!res.Changed) { Console.WriteLine($"aurix-weave: nothing to do in {Path.GetFileName(path)}"); return 0; }
        asm.Write(path, new WriterParameters { WriteSymbols = symbols });
        Console.WriteLine($"aurix-weave: {res.Methods} RPC method(s) woven in {Path.GetFileName(path)}");
        return 0;
    }
}

`sdk/web/README.md`:

```md
# @aurix/net

```ts
import { Client } from "@aurix/net";
const client = await Client.connect("https://<node>", grantFromYourBackend);
client.on("event", (f) => console.log(f.code, f.from, f.payload));
await client.joinOrCreate("lobby-1", "relay", 8);
client.sendEvent(1, new TextEncoder().encode("hi"));   // unreliable
client.flush();                                        // once per frame
```

Control over WebSocket, data over the WebSocket tunnel with the same channels/acks as the native
transport (WebTransport datagrams are the next step). `sendData(Channel.Unreliable, bytes)` for
sync inputs / lockstep frames; raw frames arrive on `"data"`. Build: `npm i && npm run build`,
test against a local node: `NET_API_KEY=an_... npm test` (the `sim wasm` tests need
`cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p net-sim-wasm` first and are skipped without it).

## Sync rooms

`SyncSession` turns a joined sync-room client into a replicated world (same wire format as the Unity
managed core, checked against shared golden vectors): schema IDL parsing, delta decoding with acks,
owner-authoritative writes or raw inputs for server logic, and an interpolation buffer for remotes.

```ts
import { Client, SyncSession, ComponentValue, InterpolationBuffer, lerpVec, distVec } from "@aurix/net";
const schema = "component Transform {\n  pos: vec3 @range(-4096, 4096, 0.01)\n  rot: quat\n}\n";
const c = await Client.connect(url, grant);
const joined = await c.joinOrCreate("arena-1", "sync", 16, { schema });
const s = new SyncSession(c, schema, 60 /* tick Hz */, 2 /* interpolation ticks */);
const tr = s.world.schema.byName("Transform")!;
const remote = new Map<number, InterpolationBuffer<number[]>>();
s.world.onChange = (e) => { if (e.owner !== joined.actor) (remote.get(e.id) ?? remote.set(e.id, new InterpolationBuffer(lerpVec, distVec, 5)).get(e.id)!).push(e.lastTick, s.world.get(e, tr)!.fields[0] as number[]); };
setInterval(() => s.sendWrites([[tr, new ComponentValue([[x, y, z], [0, 0, 0, 1]])]]), 1000 / 60); // my avatar
function frame(dt: number) { const t = s.advance(dt); for (const [, b] of remote) draw(b.sample(t)); }
```

With a WASM `logic` module driving entities, send raw inputs (`s.sendInput(bytes)` returns the tick) and
reconcile your own entity when its server state arrives (`onChange` where `e.owner === joined.actor`).

## Data path

In browsers the client opens a WebTransport session to `joined.data.webtransport_url`
(HTTP/3 datagrams, certificate pinned via `serverCertificateHashes`, so the dev server's
self-signed certificate works without installing anything) and falls back to the WebSocket
binary tunnel when WebTransport is unavailable or fails. Node (tests) uses the tunnel.
`client.dataPath` tells you which one is active; set `client.forceTunnel = true` to skip
WebTransport.

`Client.connectAndJoin(httpUrl, grant, msg)` connects and joins in one call and follows a
`room_elsewhere:<url>` redirect to the node hosting the room (rooms are pinned to one node).

## Lockstep rooms

`LockstepClient` (same frames as the managed core): feed data-path payloads to `receive`, get confirmed
inputs tick by tick in `onTick`, restore from `onRestore` on late join, `sendInput` each tick, `reportHash`
every N ticks; `inputDelay` adapts to the node's margin reports between `inputDelayMin`/`inputDelayMax`,
`inputRedundancy` sets the per-datagram repeat; answer `onDumpRequested` with `sendDump` so a desync leaves
two comparable state blobs on the node.
