`sdk/web/src/bots.ts`:

```ts
// Deterministic bot kit — port of `net-sim-bots`: data-driven behavior trees, hierarchical state
// machines and an integer blackboard. Node JSON is serde's externally tagged form, so trees
// authored for Rust/WASM run unchanged here; hashes match the Rust crate bit for bit.

export type Status = "Running" | "Success" | "Failure";

export type BtNode =
  | { Sequence: BtNode[] }
  | { Selector: BtNode[] }
  | { Parallel: { need: number; children: BtNode[] } }
  | { Condition: number }
  | { Action: number }
  | { Inverter: BtNode }
  | { Succeeder: BtNode }
  | { Repeat: { times: number; child: BtNode } }
  | { Cooldown: { ticks: number; child: BtNode } }
  | { Timeout: { ticks: number; child: BtNode } }
  | { Wait: number }
  | { Compare: { key: number; op: number; value: number | bigint } }
  | { Set: { key: number; value: number | bigint } };

export class Blackboard {
  readonly values = new Map<number, bigint>();
  get(k: number): bigint {
    return this.values.get(k) ?? 0n;
  }
  set(k: number, v: bigint | number) {
    this.values.set(k, BigInt(v));
  }
  has(k: number): boolean {
    return this.values.has(k);
  }
  clear(k: number) {
    this.values.delete(k);
  }
  /** Sorted snapshot (same order as the Rust BTreeMap). */
  entries(): [number, bigint][] {
    return [...this.values.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
  }
}

export interface Brain {
  condition(id: number, bb: Blackboard): boolean;
  action(id: number, bb: Blackboard): Status;
  abort?(id: number, bb: Blackboard): void;
}

interface NodeState {
  counter: number;
  cooldown: number;
  running: boolean;
}

function kind(n: BtNode): string {
  return Object.keys(n)[0];
}
function children(n: BtNode): BtNode[] {
  const k = kind(n);
  if (k === "Sequence" || k === "Selector") return (n as any)[k];
  if (k === "Parallel") return (n as any).Parallel.children;
  if (k === "Inverter" || k === "Succeeder") return [(n as any)[k]];
  if (k === "Repeat" || k === "Cooldown" || k === "Timeout") return [(n as any)[k].child];
  return [];
}
function count(n: BtNode): number {
  return 1 + children(n).reduce((s, c) => s + count(c), 0);
}

const FNV_OFFSET = 0xcbf29ce484222325n;
const FNV_PRIME = 0x100000001b3n;
const MASK64 = (1n << 64n) - 1n;
function fnvMix(h: bigint, v: bigint): bigint {
  let x = BigInt.asUintN(64, v);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    h ^= x & 0xffn;
    h = (h * FNV_PRIME) & MASK64;
    x >>= 8n;
  }
  return h;
}

export class BehaviorTree {
  private states: NodeState[];
  tick_ = 0;
  constructor(readonly root: BtNode) {
    this.states = Array.from({ length: count(root) }, () => ({ counter: 0, cooldown: 0, running: false }));
  }
  static fromJSON(text: string | BtNode): BehaviorTree {
    return new BehaviorTree(typeof text === "string" ? (JSON.parse(text) as BtNode) : text);
  }
  get tick(): number {
    return this.tick_;
  }
  reset(brain: Brain, bb: Blackboard) {
    this.abort(this.root, 0, brain, bb);
    for (const s of this.states) {
      s.counter = 0;
      s.cooldown = 0;
      s.running = false;
    }
  }
  step(brain: Brain, bb: Blackboard): Status {
    const st = this.run(this.root, 0, brain, bb);
    for (const s of this.states) if (s.cooldown > 0) s.cooldown--;
    this.tick_ = (this.tick_ + 1) >>> 0;
    return st;
  }
  hash(): bigint {
    let h = fnvMix(FNV_OFFSET, BigInt(this.tick_));
    for (const s of this.states) {
      const v = BigInt(s.counter) | (BigInt(s.cooldown) << 32n) | (s.running ? 1n << 63n : 0n);
      h = fnvMix(h, v);
    }
    return h;
  }

  private run(node: BtNode, idx: number, brain: Brain, bb: Blackboard): Status {
    const k = kind(node);
    const s = this.states[idx];
    switch (k) {
      case "Condition":
        return brain.condition((node as any).Condition, bb) ? "Success" : "Failure";
      case "Action": {
        const st = brain.action((node as any).Action, bb);
        s.running = st === "Running";
        return st;
      }
      case "Compare": {
        const { key, op, value } = (node as any).Compare;
        const v = bb.get(key);
        const x = BigInt(value);
        const ok = op === 0 ? v === x : op === 1 ? v !== x : op === 2 ? v < x : op === 3 ? v <= x : op === 4 ? v > x : v >= x;
        return ok ? "Success" : "Failure";
      }
      case "Set": {
        const { key, value } = (node as any).Set;
        bb.set(key, BigInt(value));
        return "Success";
      }
      case "Wait": {
        s.counter++;
        if (s.counter >= (node as any).Wait) {
          s.counter = 0;
          s.running = false;
          return "Success";
        }
        s.running = true;
        return "Running";
      }
      case "Sequence":
      case "Selector": {
        const isSeq = k === "Sequence";
        const kids = children(node);
        const start = s.counter;
        let childIdx = idx + 1;
        let result: Status = isSeq ? "Success" : "Failure";
        for (let i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) {
          const c = kids[i];
          if (i < start) {
            const ck = kind(c);
            if (ck === "Condition" || ck === "Compare") {
              const st = this.run(c, childIdx, brain, bb);
              if ((isSeq && st === "Failure") || (!isSeq && st === "Success")) {
                let rest = childIdx + count(c);
                for (const later of kids.slice(i + 1)) {
                  this.abort(later, rest, brain, bb);
                  rest += count(later);
                }
                s.counter = 0;
                s.running = false;
                return st;
              }
            }
            childIdx += count(c);
            continue;
          }
          const st = this.run(c, childIdx, brain, bb);
          childIdx += count(c);
          if (st === "Running") {
            s.counter = i;
            s.running = true;
            let rest = childIdx;
            for (const later of kids.slice(i + 1)) {
              this.abort(later, rest, brain, bb);
              rest += count(later);
            }
            return "Running";
          }
          if (!isSeq && st === "Success") {
            result = "Success";
            break;
          }
          if (isSeq && st === "Failure") {
            result = "Failure";
            break;
          }
        }
        s.counter = 0;
        s.running = false;
        return result;
      }
      case "Parallel": {
        const { need } = (node as any).Parallel;
        const kids = children(node);
        let childIdx = idx + 1;
        let ok = 0;
        let failed = 0;
        for (const c of kids) {
          const st = this.run(c, childIdx, brain, bb);
          childIdx += count(c);
          if (st === "Success") ok++;
          else if (st === "Failure") failed++;
        }
        if (ok >= need) {
          this.abortChildren(node, idx, brain, bb);
          return "Success";
        }
        if (kids.length - failed < need) {
          this.abortChildren(node, idx, brain, bb);
          return "Failure";
        }
        return "Running";
      }
      case "Inverter": {
        const st = this.run((node as any).Inverter, idx + 1, brain, bb);
        return st === "Success" ? "Failure" : st === "Failure" ? "Success" : "Running";
      }
      case "Succeeder": {
        const st = this.run((node as any).Succeeder, idx + 1, brain, bb);
        return st === "Running" ? "Running" : "Success";
      }
      case "Repeat": {
        const { times, child } = (node as any).Repeat;
        const st = this.run(child, idx + 1, brain, bb);
        if (st === "Running") return "Running";
        if (st === "Failure") {
          s.counter = 0;
          return "Failure";
        }
        s.counter++;
        if (times > 0 && s.counter >= times) {
          s.counter = 0;
          return "Success";
        }
        return "Running";
      }
      case "Cooldown": {
        const { ticks, child } = (node as any).Cooldown;
        if (s.cooldown > 0 && !s.running) return "Failure";
        const st = this.run(child, idx + 1, brain, bb);
        s.running = st === "Running";
        if (st !== "Running") s.cooldown = ticks + 1;
        return st;
      }
      case "Timeout": {
        const { ticks, child } = (node as any).Timeout;
        const st = this.run(child, idx + 1, brain, bb);
        if (st === "Running") {
          s.counter++;
          if (s.counter >= ticks) {
            s.counter = 0;
            this.abort(child, idx + 1, brain, bb);
            return "Failure";
          }
          return "Running";
        }
        s.counter = 0;
        return st;
      }
    }
    throw new Error(`unknown node ${k}`);
  }

  private abortChildren(node: BtNode, idx: number, brain: Brain, bb: Blackboard) {
    let childIdx = idx + 1;
    for (const c of children(node)) {
      this.abort(c, childIdx, brain, bb);
      childIdx += count(c);
    }
  }

  private abort(node: BtNode, idx: number, brain: Brain, bb: Blackboard) {
    const k = kind(node);
    if (k === "Action") {
      if (this.states[idx].running) brain.abort?.((node as any).Action, bb);
    } else {
      let childIdx = idx + 1;
      for (const c of children(node)) {
        this.abort(c, childIdx, brain, bb);
        childIdx += count(c);
      }
    }
    const s = this.states[idx];
    s.counter = 0;
    s.running = false;
  }
}

export interface Transition {
  condition: number | null;
  to: number;
}
export interface State {
  id: number;
  parent: number | null;
  initial: number | null;
  on_enter: number | null;
  on_exit: number | null;
  action: number | null;
  transitions: Transition[];
}

export class StateMachine {
  readonly states = new Map<number, State>();
  current: number;
  ticksInState = 0;
  tick = 0;
  private lastAction: Status = "Running";
  constructor(states: State[], initial: number) {
    for (const s of states) this.states.set(s.id, s);
    this.current = initial;
  }
  /** Accepts the Rust `StateMachine` JSON (`states` object keyed by id). */
  static fromJSON(text: string | any): StateMachine {
    const d = typeof text === "string" ? JSON.parse(text) : text;
    const m = new StateMachine(Object.values(d.states) as State[], d.current);
    m.ticksInState = d.ticks_in_state ?? 0;
    m.tick = d.tick ?? 0;
    m.lastAction = d.last_action ?? "Running";
    return m;
  }
  start(brain: Brain, bb: Blackboard) {
    let cur = this.current;
    for (const s of this.ancestors(cur).reverse()) {
      const a = this.states.get(s)?.on_enter;
      if (a != null) brain.action(a, bb);
    }
    for (;;) {
      const init = this.states.get(cur)?.initial;
      if (init == null) break;
      const a = this.states.get(init)?.on_enter;
      if (a != null) brain.action(a, bb);
      cur = init;
    }
    this.current = cur;
    this.ticksInState = 0;
  }
  ancestors(id: number): number[] {
    const out = [id];
    let p = this.states.get(id)?.parent;
    while (p != null) {
      out.push(p);
      p = this.states.get(p)?.parent;
    }
    return out;
  }
  isIn(id: number): boolean {
    return this.ancestors(this.current).includes(id);
  }
  step(brain: Brain, bb: Blackboard) {
    const chain = this.ancestors(this.current);
    let target: number | null = null;
    outer: for (const s of chain) {
      for (const t of this.states.get(s)!.transitions) {
        const fire = t.condition != null ? brain.condition(t.condition, bb) : this.lastAction !== "Running" && s === this.current;
        if (fire) {
          target = t.to;
          break outer;
        }
      }
    }
    if (target != null) this.transition(target, brain, bb);
    const a = this.states.get(this.current)?.action;
    this.lastAction = a != null ? brain.action(a, bb) : "Success";
    this.ticksInState = (this.ticksInState + 1) >>> 0;
    this.tick = (this.tick + 1) >>> 0;
  }
  transition(to: number, brain: Brain, bb: Blackboard) {
    const from = this.ancestors(this.current);
    const toChain = this.ancestors(to);
    for (const s of from) {
      if (toChain.includes(s)) break;
      const a = this.states.get(s)?.on_exit;
      if (a != null) brain.action(a, bb);
    }
    for (const s of [...toChain].reverse()) {
      if (from.includes(s)) continue;
      const a = this.states.get(s)?.on_enter;
      if (a != null) brain.action(a, bb);
    }
    let cur = to;
    for (;;) {
      const init = this.states.get(cur)?.initial;
      if (init == null) break;
      const a = this.states.get(init)?.on_enter;
      if (a != null) brain.action(a, bb);
      cur = init;
    }
    this.current = cur;
    this.ticksInState = 0;
    this.lastAction = "Running";
  }
  /** Same formula as Rust: current ^ ticks_in_state << 32 ^ tick * golden. */
  hash(): bigint {
    const golden = 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15n;
    return BigInt.asUintN(64, BigInt(this.current) ^ (BigInt(this.ticksInState) << 32n) ^ ((BigInt(this.tick) * golden) & MASK64));
  }
}
```

`sdk/web/src/event.ts`:

```ts
// Relay event frame: u8 code, u8 flags (bit0..1 target, bit2 cache-add, bit3 cache-remove, bit4 has-group), u16 from, [u16 group], [u16 n, n*u16 actors], payload.
export type Target = "all" | "others" | "master" | number[];
export interface EventFrame { code: number; from: number; target: Target; group?: number; payload: Uint8Array; }

/** Event cache flag: `add` keeps the event for late joiners (current cache slice), `remove` drops your earlier cached events with the same code. */
export type CacheOp = "add" | "remove";

export function encodeEvent(code: number, payload: Uint8Array, target: Target = "others", group?: number, cache?: CacheOp): Uint8Array {
  const kind = target === "all" ? 0 : target === "others" ? 1 : target === "master" ? 2 : 3;
  const actors = Array.isArray(target) ? target : [];
  const len = 4 + (group !== undefined ? 2 : 0) + (kind === 3 ? 2 + actors.length * 2 : 0) + payload.length;
  const b = new Uint8Array(len); const dv = new DataView(b.buffer); let o = 0;
  b[o++] = code; b[o++] = kind | (group !== undefined ? 0x10 : 0) | (cache === "add" ? 0x04 : cache === "remove" ? 0x08 : 0); dv.setUint16(o, 0); o += 2;
  if (group !== undefined) { dv.setUint16(o, group); o += 2; }
  if (kind === 3) { dv.setUint16(o, actors.length); o += 2; for (const a of actors) { dv.setUint16(o, a); o += 2; } }
  b.set(payload, o);
  return b;
}

export function decodeEvent(b: Uint8Array): EventFrame | null {
  if (b.length < 4) return null;
  const dv = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength); let o = 0;
  const code = b[o++], flags = b[o++]; const from = dv.getUint16(o); o += 2;
  let group: number | undefined; if (flags & 0x10) { group = dv.getUint16(o); o += 2; }
  let target: Target = (["all", "others", "master"] as const)[flags & 3] ?? "all";
  if ((flags & 3) === 3) { const n = dv.getUint16(o); o += 2; const a: number[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { a.push(dv.getUint16(o)); o += 2; } target = a; }
  return { code, from, target, group, payload: b.subarray(o) };
}
```

`sdk/web/src/index.ts`:

```ts
import { Channel } from "./packet.js";
import { Link, Received } from "./link.js";
import { encodeEvent, decodeEvent, Target, CacheOp } from "./event.js";
export { Channel } from "./packet.js";
export { Link } from "./link.js";
export { encodeEvent, decodeEvent } from "./event.js";
export type { Target, EventFrame } from "./event.js";
export * from "./sync.js";
export * from "./lockstep.js";

export type RoomMode = "relay" | "sync" | "lockstep";
/** `stats` answer: live rooms/players of the project, grouped by the room prop `lobby` ("" = default lobby). */
export interface Stats { rooms: number; players: number; lobbies: { lobby: string; rooms: number; players: number }[] }
/** `get_rooms` / lobby entry. */
export interface RoomSummary { id: string; name: string; mode: string; players: number; max_players: number; open: boolean; props: Record<string, unknown> }
/** `rpc` answer: `ok` = your endpoint answered 2xx; `body` is its JSON (null when empty); `error` explains a failed call. */
export interface RpcResult { ok: boolean; status?: number; body: unknown; error?: string }
/** `find_friends` answer: online = authenticated somewhere in the fleet or holding a room slot. */
export interface Friend { player: string; online: boolean; room?: { id: string; name: string; mode: RoomMode; node: string } }
export interface Joined { room: string; name: string; mode: RoomMode; actor: number; master: number; tick_hz?: number; schema_hash?: string; data: { host: string; port: number; cert_sha256: string; ticket: string; ws_tunnel: boolean; webtransport_url?: string } }

/** Data path: WebTransport datagrams when the browser and the node support it, else the WS tunnel. */
interface DataPath { send(d: Uint8Array): void; close(): void; kind: "webtransport" | "ws-tunnel" }


type Listener = (...a: any[]) => void;

/** Browser/Node client. Control over WebSocket; data over WebTransport datagrams (browsers)
 *  or the WebSocket tunnel (fallback / Node). Set `forceTunnel` to skip WebTransport. */
export class Client {
  private ws!: WebSocket; private link = new Link(); private timer?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
  private path?: DataPath; forceTunnel = false;
  /** Which data path is in use after join(). */
  get dataPath() { return this.path?.kind; }
  private listeners = new Map<string, Listener[]>(); private waiters: ((m: any) => boolean)[] = []; private rpcSeq = 0;
  joined?: Joined; actor = -1;

  on(ev: "control" | "data" | "event" | "ready" | "closed" | "rehost", fn: Listener) { (this.listeners.get(ev) ?? this.listeners.set(ev, []).get(ev)!).push(fn); return this; }
  private emit(ev: string, ...a: any[]) { for (const f of this.listeners.get(ev) ?? []) f(...a); }

  /** URL given to connect(), the grant and the last join message: what rejoin() needs. */
  entryUrl = ""; grant = ""; lastJoin: object | null = null; private opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {};
  static async connect(httpUrl: string, grant: string, opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<Client> {
    const c = new Client(); c.entryUrl = httpUrl; c.grant = grant; c.opts = opts;
    const url = httpUrl.replace(/^http/, "ws") + "/ws";
    await new Promise<void>((res, rej) => {
      const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error("timeout")), opts.timeoutMs ?? 10000);
      c.ws = new WebSocket(url); c.ws.binaryType = "arraybuffer";
      c.ws.onopen = () => { clearTimeout(t); res(); };
      c.ws.onerror = (e) => { clearTimeout(t); rej(new Error("websocket error")); };
    });
    c.ws.onmessage = (m) => c.onMessage(m.data);
    c.ws.onclose = () => { c.stop(); c.emit("closed", "control channel closed"); };
    c.send({ t: "auth", grant });
    await c.waitFor((m) => m.t === "authed", (m) => m.t === "error");
    return c;
  }

  private onMessage(data: any) {
    if (typeof data === "string") {
      const m = JSON.parse(data);
      this.emit("control", m);
      if (m.t === "left" && m.reason === "rehost") this.emit("rehost");
      if (m.t === "notice") this.emit("notice", String(m.text ?? ""), String(m.level ?? "info"));
      this.waiters = this.waiters.filter((w) => !w(m));
    } else {
      this.onDatagram(new Uint8Array(data as ArrayBuffer));
    }
  }
  private waitFor(ok: (m: any) => boolean, fail?: (m: any) => boolean, timeoutMs = 10000): Promise<any> {
    return new Promise((res, rej) => {
      const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error("timeout")), timeoutMs);
      this.waiters.push((m) => {
        if (ok(m)) { clearTimeout(t); res(m); return true; }
        if (fail?.(m)) { clearTimeout(t); rej(Object.assign(new Error(String(m.message ?? m.code)), { code: m.code })); return true; }
        return false;
      });
    });
  }

  /** Any control message, e.g. {t:"set_room_props", props:{...}}. */
  send(msg: object) { this.ws.send(JSON.stringify(msg)); }

  /** connect + join, following one `room_elsewhere:<url>` redirect to the node hosting the room. */
  static async connectAndJoin(httpUrl: string, grant: string, msg: object, opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<{ client: Client; joined: Joined }> {
    const c = await Client.connect(httpUrl, grant, opts);
    try { return { client: c, joined: await c.join(msg) }; }
    catch (e) {
      const m = String((e as Error).message ?? e);
      const i = m.indexOf("room_elsewhere:");
      if (i < 0) throw e;
      c.close();
      const url = m.slice(i + "room_elsewhere:".length).trim();
      const c2 = await Client.connect(url, grant, opts);
      return { client: c2, joined: await c2.join(msg) };
    }
  }
  /** `reserved`: player ids whose seats are held for 60 s when this call creates the room (a party
   *  arriving together — pass the `players` list from a matchmaking ticket). */
  async joinOrCreate(name: string, mode: RoomMode = "relay", maxPlayers = 8, props: Record<string, unknown> = {}, reserved: string[] = []): Promise<Joined> {
    return this.join({ t: "join_or_create", name, mode, max_players: maxPlayers, props, reserved });
  }
  /** Joins a random open room: `filter` must equal room props exactly, `expr` is a SQL-like condition
   *  on the room's lobby props (`map = 'dust' AND skill <= 1500`), `matchType` picks among candidates
   *  (`fill` fullest first, `serial` emptiest first, `random`). Follows a redirect to the hosting node. */
  async joinRandom(filter: Record<string, unknown> = {}, expr?: string, matchType: "fill" | "serial" | "random" = "fill"): Promise<Joined> {
    return this.join({ t: "join_random", filter, expr, match_type: matchType });
  }
  /** After `left{reason:"rehost"}` (the node shut down and handed the room to another node): a fresh
   *  client in the same room with the same grant. Tries the entry URL, then `fallbackUrls`. */
  async rejoin(fallbackUrls: string[] = []): Promise<{ client: Client; joined: Joined }> {
    if (!this.lastJoin) throw new Error("rejoin: never joined");
    const msg = { ...(this.lastJoin as Record<string, unknown>) };
    if (msg.t === "join_or_create") msg.t = "join";
    this.close();
    let err: unknown = null;
    for (const url of [this.entryUrl, ...fallbackUrls]) {
      try { return await Client.connectAndJoin(url, this.grant, msg, this.opts); } catch (e) { err = e; }
    }
    throw err;
  }
  async join(msg: object): Promise<Joined> {
    this.lastJoin = msg;
    this.send(msg);
    const j = (await this.waitFor((m) => m.t === "joined", (m) => m.t === "error")) as Joined;
    this.joined = j; this.actor = j.actor;
    // open the data path: ticket as the first datagram/frame, wait for the server's empty ack
    const ticket = Uint8Array.from(atob(j.data.ticket), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
    const ready = new Promise<void>((res, rej) => { const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error("data path timeout")), 10000); this.on("ready", () => { clearTimeout(t); res(); }); });
    this.path = await this.openPath(j.data);
    this.path.send(ticket);
    this.timer = setInterval(() => { if (!this.link.poll()) { this.stop(); this.emit("closed", "link dead"); } this.flushLink(); }, 5);
    await ready;
    return j;
  }

  private onDatagram(bytes: Uint8Array) {
    const recv: Received[] = this.link.receive(bytes);
    this.flushLink();
    for (const r of recv) {
      if (r.payload.length === 0) { this.emit("ready"); continue; }
      this.emit("data", r.channel, r.tick, r.payload);
      if (this.joined?.mode === "relay" || (r.payload[0] & 0xf0) !== 0x10 && (r.payload[0] & 0xf0) !== 0x20) {
        const f = decodeEvent(r.payload); if (f) this.emit("event", f);
      }
    }
  }

  private async openPath(d: Joined["data"]): Promise<DataPath> {
    const WT: any = (globalThis as any).WebTransport;
    if (WT && d.webtransport_url && !this.forceTunnel) {
      try {
        const hash = Uint8Array.from(d.cert_sha256.match(/../g)!.map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));
        const wt = new WT(d.webtransport_url, { serverCertificateHashes: [{ algorithm: "sha-256", value: hash }] });
        await wt.ready;
        const writer = wt.datagrams.writable.getWriter();
        const reader = wt.datagrams.readable.getReader();
        (async () => { try { for (;;) { const { value, done } = await reader.read(); if (done) break; this.onDatagram(value); } } catch { /* closed */ } })();
        wt.closed.then(() => { this.stop(); this.emit("closed", "webtransport closed"); }, () => { this.stop(); this.emit("closed", "webtransport error"); });
        return { kind: "webtransport", send: (b) => { writer.write(b).catch(() => {}); }, close: () => wt.close() };
      } catch (e) {
        // fall through to the tunnel
      }
    }
    if (!d.ws_tunnel) throw new Error("no usable data path (webtransport failed, tunnel disabled)");
    return { kind: "ws-tunnel", send: (b) => this.ws.send(b), close: () => {} };
  }
  private flushLink() { for (const d of this.link.drain()) this.path?.send(d); }

  /** Queue a data message; unreliable ones leave on flush()/timer. */
  sendData(channel: Channel, payload: Uint8Array) { this.link.send(channel, payload); if (channel === Channel.Reliable) this.flushLink(); }
  /** Relay event; `opts.cache` keeps it for late joiners (see `cacheSlice`), `opts.group` sends to one interest group. */
  sendEvent(code: number, payload: Uint8Array, target: Target = "others", reliable = false, opts: { group?: number; cache?: CacheOp } = {}) {
    this.sendData(reliable || opts.cache ? Channel.Reliable : Channel.Unreliable, encodeEvent(code, payload, target, opts.group, opts.cache));
  }
  /** Relay event-cache slices: `increase` opens the next slice, `set` picks one, `purge` drops one slice, `purge_up_to` every slice up to `index`. */
  cacheSlice(op: "increase" | "set" | "purge" | "purge_up_to", index?: number) { this.send({ t: "cache_slice", op, index }); }
  /** Push queued unreliable messages now (call at end of frame). */
  flush() { this.link.flushBatch(); this.flushLink(); }
  get stats() { return this.link.stats; }

  leave() { this.send({ t: "leave" }); }
  /** Sync rooms: steer area-of-interest — extra viewpoints (camera, scope target) and entities forced into view (team mates, objectives). Entity ids as in deltas. */
  /** Project-wide room/player counts per lobby (lobby statistics); at most one per second. */
  async lobbyStats(): Promise<Stats> {
    this.send({ t: "stats" });
    const m = await this.waitFor((m) => m.t === "stats", (m) => m.t === "error");
    return { rooms: m.rooms, players: m.players, lobbies: m.lobbies };
  }
  /** Presence of up to 64 players (find friends): online and the room they are in, fleet-wide. */
  async findFriends(players: string[]): Promise<Friend[]> {
    this.send({ t: "find_friends", players });
    const m = await this.waitFor((m) => m.t === "friends", (m) => m.t === "error");
    return m.friends;
  }
  /** One-shot room list (SQL-lobby style): open, visible rooms with a free slot, optionally filtered by a SQL-like `expr` on lobby props (`map = 'dust' AND rank_min <= 1400`); one per second. */
  async rooms(expr?: string, limit?: number): Promise<RoomSummary[]> {
    this.send({ t: "get_rooms", expr, limit });
    const m = await this.waitFor((m) => m.t === "rooms", (m) => m.t === "error");
    return m.rooms;
  }
  /** Call your backend through the node (WebRPC): the project's webhook subscribed to `rpc` is POSTed `{name, player_id, actor?, room?, body}` and its JSON answer comes back. Body ≤ 8 KiB, 5 calls/s. */
  async rpc(name: string, body: unknown = null): Promise<RpcResult> {
    const id = (this.rpcSeq = (this.rpcSeq + 1) >>> 0);
    this.send({ t: "rpc", id, name, body });
    const m = await this.waitFor((m) => m.t === "rpc_result" && m.id === id, (m) => m.t === "error");
    return { ok: m.ok, status: m.status, body: m.body, error: m.error };
  }
  setView(viewpoints: (number | bigint)[] = [], interest: (number | bigint)[] = []) {
    this.send({ t: "set_view", viewpoints: viewpoints.map(Number), interest: interest.map(Number) });
  }
  close() { this.stop(); this.path?.close(); this.ws.close(); }
  private stop() { if (this.timer) { clearInterval(this.timer); this.timer = undefined; } }
}

export * from "./sim.js";
export * from "./bots.js";
```

`sdk/web/src/link.ts`:

```ts
import { Channel, Header, MAX_UNFRAGMENTED, decodeHeader, encodeHeader, seqNewer } from "./packet.js";

export interface Received { channel: Channel; tick: number; payload: Uint8Array; }
const WINDOW = 32, MAX_RETRIES = 10, MIN_RTO = 50, MAX_RTO = 2000;
/** Packet kind of fragment packets (their own reliable stream); channels use their own value. */
export const KIND_FRAGMENT = 3;
const FRAG_HDR = 5, FRAG_PAYLOAD = MAX_UNFRAGMENTED - FRAG_HDR, MAX_MESSAGE = 64 * 1024;

class ReliableTx {
  seq = 0; inFlight: { seq: number; payload: Uint8Array; sentAt: number; retries: number }[] = []; pending: Uint8Array[] = [];
  rtt = 100; rttVar = 50;
  rto() { return Math.min(MAX_RTO, Math.max(MIN_RTO, this.rtt + 4 * this.rttVar)); }
  onAck(ack: number, bits: number, now: number) {
    this.inFlight = this.inFlight.filter(p => {
      let acked = p.seq === ack;
      if (!acked && seqNewer(ack, p.seq)) { const d = (ack - p.seq) & 0xffff; acked = d <= 32 && ((bits >>> (d - 1)) & 1) === 1; }
      if (acked && p.retries === 0) { const s = now - p.sentAt; this.rttVar = 0.75 * this.rttVar + 0.25 * Math.abs(s - this.rtt); this.rtt = 0.875 * this.rtt + 0.125 * s; }
      return !acked;
    });
  }
}
class ReliableRx {
  ack: number | null = null; ackBits = 0; next = 0; buffer = new Map<number, Uint8Array>();
  /** Records a received seq for acks; false when already seen or too old. */
  mark(seq: number): boolean {
    if (this.ack === null) { this.ack = seq; this.ackBits = 0; return true; }
    if (seq === this.ack) return false;
    if (seqNewer(seq, this.ack)) { const sh = (seq - this.ack) & 0xffff; this.ackBits = sh >= 32 ? 0 : ((this.ackBits << sh) | (1 << (sh - 1))) >>> 0; this.ack = seq; return true; }
    const d = (this.ack - seq) & 0xffff; if (d > 32) return false;
    const bit = 1 << (d - 1); if (this.ackBits & bit) return false; this.ackBits = (this.ackBits | bit) >>> 0; return true;
  }
}
/** One reliable packet stream (ordered delivery optional). Kinds: 1 ordered, 2 unordered, 3 fragments. */
class Stream { tx = new ReliableTx(); rx = new ReliableRx(); constructor(public kind: number, public ordered: boolean) {} }

/** Mirrors net-transport::Link: unreliable-sequenced batches, reliable-ordered, reliable-unordered,
 *  and fragmentation of messages up to 64 KiB over a dedicated reliable fragment stream. */
export class Link {
  private seqTx = 0; private seqRx: number | null = null; private batch: Uint8Array[] = []; private batchLen = 0;
  private streams = new Map<number, Stream>([[1, new Stream(1, true)], [2, new Stream(2, false)], [KIND_FRAGMENT, new Stream(KIND_FRAGMENT, false)]]);
  private fragId = 0; private partial = new Map<number, { channel: Channel; parts: (Uint8Array | undefined)[]; got: number; started: number }>();
  private out: Uint8Array[] = []; tick = 0;
  stats = { sent: 0, recv: 0, retransmits: 0, dropped: 0 };

  private header(kind: number, seq: number, ackOnly = false, batch = false): Header {
    const s = this.streams.get(kind); const hasAck = !!s && s.rx.ack !== null;
    return { kind, ackOnly, hasAck, batch, seq, ack: hasAck ? s!.rx.ack! : 0, ackBits: hasAck ? s!.rx.ackBits : 0, tick: this.tick };
  }
  private push(h: Header, payload: Uint8Array) { this.out.push(encodeHeader(h, payload)); this.stats.sent++; }

  send(channel: Channel, msg: Uint8Array) {
    if (msg.length > MAX_MESSAGE) throw new Error("message too large (max 64 KiB)");
    if (msg.length > MAX_UNFRAGMENTED) {
      const count = Math.ceil(msg.length / FRAG_PAYLOAD); if (count > 255) throw new Error("message too large");
      const id = this.fragId; this.fragId = (this.fragId + 1) & 0xffff;
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const chunk = msg.subarray(i * FRAG_PAYLOAD, Math.min(msg.length, (i + 1) * FRAG_PAYLOAD));
        const p = new Uint8Array(FRAG_HDR + chunk.length); p[0] = id >> 8; p[1] = id & 0xff; p[2] = channel; p[3] = i; p[4] = count; p.set(chunk, FRAG_HDR);
        this.streams.get(KIND_FRAGMENT)!.tx.pending.push(p);
      }
      this.pump(performance.now()); return;
    }
    if (channel === Channel.Unreliable) {
      if (this.batchLen + 2 + msg.length > MAX_UNFRAGMENTED) this.flushBatch();
      this.batch.push(msg); this.batchLen += 2 + msg.length; return;
    }
    this.streams.get(channel)!.tx.pending.push(msg); this.pump(performance.now());
  }
  flushBatch() {
    if (this.batch.length === 0) return;
    const p = new Uint8Array(this.batchLen); let o = 0;
    for (const m of this.batch) { p[o++] = m.length >> 8; p[o++] = m.length & 0xff; p.set(m, o); o += m.length; }
    this.batch = []; this.batchLen = 0;
    const seq = this.seqTx; this.seqTx = (this.seqTx + 1) & 0xffff;
    this.push(this.header(Channel.Unreliable, seq, false, true), p);
  }
  private pump(now: number) {
    for (const s of this.streams.values()) {
      while (s.tx.pending.length && s.tx.inFlight.length < WINDOW) {
        const payload = s.tx.pending.shift()!; const seq = s.tx.seq; s.tx.seq = (s.tx.seq + 1) & 0xffff;
        s.tx.inFlight.push({ seq, payload, sentAt: now, retries: 0 });
        this.push(this.header(s.kind, seq), payload);
      }
    }
  }
  /** Timer: retransmits and flushes the batch. Returns false when the link is dead. */
  poll(now = performance.now()): boolean {
    this.flushBatch();
    for (const s of this.streams.values()) {
      const rto = s.tx.rto();
      for (const p of s.tx.inFlight) {
        if (now - p.sentAt >= rto) {
          if (p.retries >= MAX_RETRIES) return false;
          p.retries++; p.sentAt = now; this.stats.retransmits++;
          this.push(this.header(s.kind, p.seq), p.payload);
        }
      }
    }
    for (const [id, p] of this.partial) if (now - p.started > 10000) this.partial.delete(id);
    this.pump(now);
    return true;
  }
  nextOutgoing(): Uint8Array | undefined { return this.out.shift(); }
  drain(): Uint8Array[] { const o = this.out; this.out = []; return o; }

  private reassemble(frag: Uint8Array, now: number): Received | undefined {
    if (frag.length < FRAG_HDR) return;
    const id = (frag[0] << 8) | frag[1], channel = frag[2] as Channel, index = frag[3], count = frag[4];
    if (count === 0 || index >= count) return;
    let p = this.partial.get(id);
    if (!p) { if (this.partial.size >= 64) return; p = { channel, parts: new Array(count), got: 0, started: now }; this.partial.set(id, p); }
    if (p.parts.length !== count || p.channel !== channel) { this.partial.delete(id); return; }
    if (!p.parts[index]) { p.parts[index] = frag.slice(FRAG_HDR); p.got++; }
    if (p.got < count) return;
    this.partial.delete(id);
    const total = p.parts.reduce((n, x) => n + x!.length, 0); const msg = new Uint8Array(total); let o = 0;
    for (const x of p.parts) { msg.set(x!, o); o += x!.length; }
    return { channel, tick: this.tick, payload: msg };
  }

  receive(d: Uint8Array, now = performance.now()): Received[] {
    const dec = decodeHeader(d); if (!dec) return [];
    const { h, payload } = dec; this.stats.recv++;
    const out: Received[] = [];
    if (h.kind === Channel.Unreliable) {
      if (this.seqRx === null || seqNewer(h.seq, this.seqRx)) {
        this.seqRx = h.seq;
        if (h.batch) { let o = 0; while (o + 2 <= payload.length) { const n = (payload[o] << 8) | payload[o + 1]; o += 2; if (o + n > payload.length) break; out.push({ channel: Channel.Unreliable, tick: h.tick, payload: payload.subarray(o, o + n) }); o += n; } }
        else out.push({ channel: Channel.Unreliable, tick: h.tick, payload });
      } else this.stats.dropped++;
      return out;
    }
    const s = this.streams.get(h.kind); if (!s) return out;
    if (h.hasAck) { s.tx.onAck(h.ack, h.ackBits, now); this.pump(now); }
    if (!h.ackOnly) {
      if (s.rx.mark(h.seq)) {
        const deliver = (p: Uint8Array, tick: number) => {
          if (s.kind === KIND_FRAGMENT) { const r = this.reassemble(p, now); if (r) { r.tick = tick; out.push(r); } }
          else out.push({ channel: s.kind as Channel, tick, payload: p });
        };
        if (s.ordered) {
          s.rx.buffer.set(h.seq, payload.slice());
          while (s.rx.buffer.has(s.rx.next)) { deliver(s.rx.buffer.get(s.rx.next)!, h.tick); s.rx.buffer.delete(s.rx.next); s.rx.next = (s.rx.next + 1) & 0xffff; }
        } else deliver(payload.slice(), h.tick);
      }
      this.push(this.header(s.kind, s.tx.seq, true), new Uint8Array(0));
    }
    return out;
  }
}
```

`sdk/web/src/lockstep.ts`:

```ts
// Client side of lockstep rooms (port of the managed core): confirmed input bundles in tick order,
// late-join catch-up (checkpoint + journal tail), hash reports, checkpoint uploads when the node asks
// the master, adaptive input delay from the node's margin reports, and state dumps after a desync.
// The game owns the deterministic simulation: step it in onTick, hash it, restore it in onRestore.
import { Channel } from "./packet.js";
import { SyncWorld } from "./sync.js";

export const LS_INPUT = 0x10, LS_BUNDLE = 0x20, LS_HASH = 0x21, LS_CHECKPOINT = 0x22, LS_CHECKPOINT_REQ = 0x23, LS_CATCHUP = 0x24, LS_INPUT_STATS = 0x25, LS_DUMP_REQ = 0x26, LS_DUMP = 0x27;

export type TickInputs = Map<number, Uint8Array>;

export class LockstepClient {
  /** Confirmed inputs for one tick, in tick order, every tick exactly once (empty map = nobody sent). */
  onTick?: (tick: number, inputs: TickInputs) => void;
  /** Catch-up start: restore the game state from this checkpoint (empty state at tick 0 = fresh start). */
  onRestore?: (tick: number, hash: bigint, state: Uint8Array) => void;
  /** The node asked us (the master) for the confirmed state at a tick <= this one: answer with sendCheckpoint. */
  onCheckpointRequested?: (tick: number) => void;
  /** The node flagged a desync and wants our state at this tick (from your rollback history): answer with sendDump, or ignore. */
  onDumpRequested?: (tick: number) => void;

  private pending = new Map<number, TickInputs>();
  private recentInputs: Uint8Array[] = [];
  private started = false; private next = 0; private lastInput = 0; private slackStreak = 0;
  /** Next tick to be delivered to onTick. */
  get confirmedTick(): number { return this.next; }
  /** Newest tick the node has bundled (+1). */
  serverTick = 0;
  /** Ticks ahead of the server clock inputs are stamped; tuned between min/max from margin reports when adaptive. */
  inputDelay = 2; inputDelayMin = 1; inputDelayMax = 8; adaptiveDelay = true;
  /** Inputs repeated per datagram (1..8). */
  inputRedundancy = 3;
  lastMargin = 0; lateInputs = 0; delivered = 0; catchups = 0; dropped = 0;

  constructor(private readonly send: (channel: Channel, payload: Uint8Array) => void) {}

  /** Feed every data-path payload from a lockstep room. Returns false when it was not a lockstep frame. */
  receive(p: Uint8Array): boolean {
    if (p.length === 0) return false;
    switch (p[0]) {
      case LS_CATCHUP: {
        if (p.length < 17) return true;
        const tick = u32(p, 1), hash = u64(p, 5), len = u32(p, 13);
        const state = p.slice(17, 17 + Math.min(len, p.length - 17));
        this.pending.clear(); this.next = tick; this.started = true; this.catchups++;
        this.onRestore?.(tick, hash, state);
        return true;
      }
      case LS_BUNDLE: {
        if (p.length < 2) return true;
        const n = p[1]; let o = 2;
        for (let i = 0; i < n && o + 2 <= p.length; i++) { const len = (p[o] << 8) | p[o + 1]; o += 2; if (o + len > p.length) break; this.decodeBundle(p, o, len); o += len; }
        this.drain();
        return true;
      }
      case LS_CHECKPOINT_REQ: if (p.length >= 5) this.onCheckpointRequested?.(u32(p, 1)); return true;
      case LS_DUMP_REQ: if (p.length >= 5) this.onDumpRequested?.(u32(p, 1)); return true;
      case LS_INPUT_STATS: if (p.length >= 7) this.onInputStats((p[5] << 24) >> 24, p[6]); return true;
      case LS_CHECKPOINT: case LS_HASH: case LS_INPUT: return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /** Raises the delay as soon as inputs arrive late; lowers it one tick after three consecutive reports with >= 2 ticks of slack. */
  onInputStats(margin: number, late: number): void {
    this.lastMargin = margin; this.lateInputs += late;
    if (!this.adaptiveDelay) return;
    if (margin < 0) { this.inputDelay = Math.min(this.inputDelayMax, this.inputDelay + Math.min(4, -margin)); this.slackStreak = 0; }
    else if (margin >= 2) { if (++this.slackStreak >= 3) { this.slackStreak = 0; if (this.inputDelay > this.inputDelayMin) this.inputDelay--; } }
    else this.slackStreak = 0;
  }

  private decodeBundle(b: Uint8Array, o: number, len: number): void {
    const end = o + len; if (len < 6 || b[o] !== LS_BUNDLE) return;
    const t = u32(b, o + 1); const k = b[o + 5]; o += 6;
    if (t + 1 > this.serverTick) this.serverTick = t + 1;
    if (!this.started) { this.started = true; this.next = t; }
    if (t < this.next || this.pending.has(t)) return;
    const inputs: TickInputs = new Map();
    for (let i = 0; i < k && o + 3 <= end; i++) { const a = (b[o] << 8) | b[o + 1]; const l = b[o + 2]; o += 3; if (o + l > end) break; inputs.set(a, b.slice(o, o + l)); o += l; }
    this.pending.set(t, inputs);
  }

  private drain(): void {
    for (;;) { const inputs = this.pending.get(this.next); if (!inputs) break; this.pending.delete(this.next); const t = this.next++; this.delivered++; this.onTick?.(t, inputs); }
    for (const t of [...this.pending.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b)) { if (t <= this.next + 600) break; this.pending.delete(t); this.dropped++; }
  }

  /** Queues this tick's local input (sent with the previous ones for redundancy); returns the tick it was stamped with. */
  sendInput(input: Uint8Array): number {
    const tick = Math.max(this.serverTick + this.inputDelay, this.lastInput + 1); this.lastInput = tick;
    this.recentInputs.push(input); const keep = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, this.inputRedundancy)); while (this.recentInputs.length > keep) this.recentInputs.shift();
    this.send(Channel.Unreliable, SyncWorld.encodeInput(tick - (this.recentInputs.length - 1), this.recentInputs));
    return tick;
  }

  reportHash(tick: number, hash: bigint): void { const b = new Uint8Array(13); b[0] = LS_HASH; w32(b, 1, tick); w64(b, 5, hash); this.send(Channel.Unreliable, b); }

  /** Master only, in answer to onCheckpointRequested: confirmed state at `tick` (<= requested). */
  sendCheckpoint(tick: number, hash: bigint, state: Uint8Array): void { this.send(Channel.Reliable, frame(LS_CHECKPOINT, tick, hash, state)); }
  /** Answer to onDumpRequested: your state at `tick` (<= 60 KiB), stored by the node for 24 h next to the master's. */
  sendDump(tick: number, hash: bigint, state: Uint8Array): void { this.send(Channel.Reliable, frame(LS_DUMP, tick, hash, state)); }

  /** FNV-1a 64 over bytes: a simple, portable state hash (same as the managed core). */
  static fnv1a(data: Uint8Array): bigint { let h = 14695981039346656037n; for (const x of data) { h ^= BigInt(x); h = (h * 1099511628211n) & 0xffffffffffffffffn; } return h; }
}

function frame(kind: number, tick: number, hash: bigint, state: Uint8Array): Uint8Array { const b = new Uint8Array(13 + state.length); b[0] = kind; w32(b, 1, tick); w64(b, 5, hash); b.set(state, 13); return b; }
function u32(b: Uint8Array, o: number): number { return ((b[o] << 24) | (b[o + 1] << 16) | (b[o + 2] << 8) | b[o + 3]) >>> 0; }
function u64(b: Uint8Array, o: number): bigint { return (BigInt(u32(b, o)) << 32n) | BigInt(u32(b, o + 4)); }
function w32(b: Uint8Array, o: number, v: number): void { b[o] = v >>> 24; b[o + 1] = (v >>> 16) & 255; b[o + 2] = (v >>> 8) & 255; b[o + 3] = v & 255; }
function w64(b: Uint8Array, o: number, v: bigint): void { w32(b, o, Number(v >> 32n)); w32(b, o + 4, Number(v & 0xffffffffn)); }

/** The game's deterministic simulation for LockstepRollback: step one tick, snapshot, restore. */
export interface Simulation<S = unknown> {
  step(tick: number, inputs: TickInputs): void;
  snapshot(): S;
  restore(s: S): void;
}

/**
 * Predict/rollback on top of LockstepClient (same core as the Rust/C# SDKs): the game runs ahead of
 * the confirmed tick with predicted remote inputs (each actor's last confirmed input, repeated) and
 * its own inputs as sent, keeps a snapshot per predicted tick, and when a confirmed tick differs from
 * the prediction restores the snapshot, re-steps it and re-predicts the ticks after it.
 */
export class LockstepRollback<S = unknown> {
  private confirmed: number; private head: number;
  private history = new Map<number, S>();
  private predicted = new Map<number, TickInputs>();
  private localInputs = new Map<number, Uint8Array>();
  private lastLocal?: Uint8Array;
  private lastKnown: TickInputs = new Map();
  rollbacks = 0; resimulatedTicks = 0; predictedTicks = 0;

  /** `sim` must be at tick `start` (fresh game, or restored from a catch-up checkpoint). */
  constructor(private readonly sim: Simulation<S>, private readonly localActor: number, start = 0, public maxPrediction = 8) {
    this.confirmed = this.head = start; this.history.set(start, sim.snapshot());
  }
  /** First tick not yet confirmed by the node. */
  get confirmedTick(): number { return this.confirmed; }
  /** Next tick the simulation will run; head - confirmedTick ticks are predicted. */
  get headTick(): number { return this.head; }
  /** State after the last confirmed tick: hash *this* for reportHash, never the predicted head. */
  confirmedSnapshot(): S { return this.history.get(this.confirmed) as S; }

  /** After the game restored a catch-up checkpoint at `tick`: forget every prediction. */
  reset(tick: number): void {
    this.history.clear(); this.history.set(tick, this.sim.snapshot()); this.predicted.clear(); this.localInputs.clear();
    this.confirmed = this.head = tick;
  }
  /** Remember the input sent stamped with `tick` (what LockstepClient.sendInput returned) so our own prediction uses exactly it. */
  localInput(tick: number, input: Uint8Array): void { this.lastLocal = input; this.localInputs.set(tick, input); }

  /** Runs the simulation ahead to `target` (exclusive), bounded by maxPrediction. */
  predict(target: number): void {
    target = Math.min(target, this.confirmed + Math.max(1, this.maxPrediction));
    while (this.head < target) {
      const t = this.head, inputs = this.guess(t);
      this.sim.step(t, inputs); this.predicted.set(t, inputs); this.head = t + 1; this.history.set(this.head, this.sim.snapshot()); this.predictedTicks++;
    }
  }
  /** Feeds a confirmed tick (LockstepClient.onTick). Returns true when a rollback happened. */
  confirm(tick: number, inputs: TickInputs): boolean {
    if (tick !== this.confirmed) return false;
    for (const [a, i] of inputs) this.lastKnown.set(a, i);
    this.localInputs.delete(tick);
    let rolled = false;
    if (tick >= this.head) { this.sim.step(tick, inputs); this.head = tick + 1; this.history.set(this.head, this.sim.snapshot()); }
    else if (!sameInputs(this.predicted.get(tick), inputs)) {
      rolled = true; this.rollbacks++;
      this.sim.restore(this.history.get(tick) as S); this.sim.step(tick, inputs); this.history.set(tick + 1, this.sim.snapshot());
      const oldHead = this.head; this.head = tick + 1;
      for (const t of [...this.predicted.keys()]) if (t > tick) this.predicted.delete(t);
      this.resimulatedTicks += oldHead - this.head;
      this.predict(oldHead);
    }
    this.confirmed = tick + 1; this.predicted.delete(tick); this.history.delete(tick);
    return rolled;
  }

  private guess(tick: number): TickInputs {
    const g: TickInputs = new Map(this.lastKnown);
    const mine = this.localInputs.get(tick) ?? this.lastLocal;
    if (mine) g.set(this.localActor, mine); else g.delete(this.localActor);
    return g;
  }
}

function sameInputs(a: TickInputs | undefined, b: TickInputs): boolean {
  if (!a || a.size !== b.size) return false;
  for (const [k, v] of a) { const w = b.get(k); if (!w || w.length !== v.length) return false; for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) if (v[i] !== w[i]) return false; }
  return true;
}

/** What ReplayRing.window hands back: restore `snapshot`, then step `inputs` from `start`. */
export interface ReplayWindow<S> { start: number; snapshot: S; inputs: TickInputs[] }

/**
 * Instant replay (kill cam) buffer: the last `keep` confirmed ticks' inputs plus a snapshot of the
 * confirmed state every `every` ticks, so any recent moment can be re-simulated locally. Feed it from
 * the confirmed path (after LockstepRollback.confirm, with confirmedSnapshot()).
 */
export class ReplayRing<S = unknown> {
  private first = 0; private inputs: TickInputs[] = []; private snaps = new Map<number, S>();
  constructor(private readonly keep = 300, private readonly every = 10) { this.keep = Math.max(1, keep); this.every = Math.max(1, every); }

  /** Records confirmed `tick` with its inputs and the confirmed state *before* it (taken lazily on snapshot boundaries). A gap resets the ring. */
  record(tick: number, inputs: TickInputs, stateBefore: () => S): void {
    if (this.inputs.length === 0 || this.first + this.inputs.length !== tick) { this.inputs = []; this.snaps.clear(); this.first = tick; }
    if (this.snaps.size === 0 || tick % this.every === 0) this.snaps.set(tick, stateBefore());
    this.inputs.push(inputs);
    while (this.inputs.length > this.keep) { this.inputs.shift(); this.first++; }
    let anchor = -1; for (const k of this.snaps.keys()) if (k <= this.first && k > anchor) anchor = k;
    if (anchor >= 0) for (const k of [...this.snaps.keys()]) if (k < anchor) this.snaps.delete(k);
  }
  /** Oldest tick that can still be replayed. */
  get oldest(): number | undefined { if (this.inputs.length === 0) return undefined; let m: number | undefined; for (const k of this.snaps.keys()) if (m === undefined || k < m) m = k; return m; }
  /** Everything needed to re-simulate from the newest snapshot at or before `from` (clamped to what is kept) through the last recorded tick. */
  window(from: number): ReplayWindow<S> | undefined {
    let start = -1; for (const k of this.snaps.keys()) if (k <= from && k > start) start = k;
    if (start < 0) { const o = this.oldest; if (o === undefined) return undefined; start = o; }
    return { start, snapshot: this.snaps.get(start) as S, inputs: this.inputs.slice(Math.max(0, start - this.first)) };
  }
}
```

`sdk/web/src/packet.ts`:

```ts
// 12-byte datagram header, big-endian: u8 version, u8 kind, u16 seq, u16 ack, u32 ack_bits, u16 tick.
export const PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1;
export const HEADER_LEN = 12;
export const MAX_DATAGRAM = 1100;
export const MAX_UNFRAGMENTED = MAX_DATAGRAM - HEADER_LEN;
export const FLAG_ACK_ONLY = 0x80, FLAG_HAS_ACK = 0x40, FLAG_BATCH = 0x20;
export enum Channel { Unreliable = 0, Reliable = 1, ReliableUnordered = 2 }
export const KIND_FRAGMENT = 3;

export interface Header { kind: number; ackOnly: boolean; hasAck: boolean; batch: boolean; seq: number; ack: number; ackBits: number; tick: number; }

export function encodeHeader(h: Header, payload: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const out = new Uint8Array(HEADER_LEN + payload.length);
  const dv = new DataView(out.buffer);
  out[0] = PROTOCOL_VERSION;
  out[1] = (h.kind & 0x1f) | (h.ackOnly ? FLAG_ACK_ONLY : 0) | (h.hasAck ? FLAG_HAS_ACK : 0) | (h.batch ? FLAG_BATCH : 0);
  dv.setUint16(2, h.seq); dv.setUint16(4, h.ack); dv.setUint32(6, h.ackBits); dv.setUint16(10, h.tick);
  out.set(payload, HEADER_LEN);
  return out;
}

export function decodeHeader(d: Uint8Array): { h: Header; payload: Uint8Array } | null {
  if (d.length < HEADER_LEN || d[0] !== PROTOCOL_VERSION) return null;
  const dv = new DataView(d.buffer, d.byteOffset, d.byteLength);
  const k = d[1];
  return {
    h: { kind: k & 0x1f, ackOnly: !!(k & FLAG_ACK_ONLY), hasAck: !!(k & FLAG_HAS_ACK), batch: !!(k & FLAG_BATCH), seq: dv.getUint16(2), ack: dv.getUint16(4), ackBits: dv.getUint32(6), tick: dv.getUint16(10) },
    payload: d.subarray(HEADER_LEN),
  };
}

/** true when a is a newer 16-bit sequence than b */
export function seqNewer(a: number, b: number): boolean { return ((a - b) & 0xffff) < 0x8000 && a !== b; }
```

```ts
export interface BodyState {
  x: number;
  y: number;

  vx: number;
  vy: number;

/** Loads the sim module once; pass the wasm bytes or a compiled module. */
export class Sim {
  private constructor(private readonly e: SimExports) {}

  static async load(source: BufferSource | WebAssembly.Module | Response | Promise<Response>): Promise<Sim> {
    let module: WebAssembly.Module;
    if (source instanceof WebAssembly.Module) module = source;
    else if (source instanceof Response || source instanceof Promise) {
      module = (await WebAssembly.compileStreaming(source as Response)) as WebAssembly.Module;
    } else module = await WebAssembly.compile(source);
    const inst = await WebAssembly.instantiate(module, {});
    return new Sim(inst.exports as unknown as SimExports);
  }

  /** Reference scenario hash; must equal the native Rust value (`0x58d9870ba45952b5`). */
  goldenHash(): bigint {
    return BigInt.asUintN(64, this.e.sim_golden_hash());
  }
  /** Navigation reference scenario hash; must equal the native value (`0x746c5a608abe2f26`). */
  navGoldenHash(): bigint {
    return BigInt.asUintN(64, this.e.sim_nav_golden_hash());
  }
  /** Joint reference scenario hash; must equal the native value (`0x4bcc781a484ceeed`). */
  jointGoldenHash(): bigint {
    return BigInt.asUintN(64, this.e.sim_joint_golden_hash());
  }
  /** 3D reference scenario hash; must equal the native value (`0x0a9c7e6fc4fa43bf`). */
  golden3Hash(): bigint {
    return BigInt.asUintN(64, this.e.sim3_golden_hash());
  }
  /** 3D joints/character reference scenario hash (`0x5db56af63cceee85`). */
  joint3GoldenHash(): bigint {
    return BigInt.asUintN(64, this.e.sim3_joint_golden_hash());
  }
  /** 3D convex hull reference scenario hash (`0xd656fc8f55999cf8`). */
  hull3GoldenHash(): bigint {
    return BigInt.asUintN(64, this.e.sim3_hull_golden_hash());
  }
  /** Create a 3D world (gravity in m/s², tick rate). */
  world3(gravity: { x: number; y: number; z: number } = { x: 0, y: -10, z: 0 }, tickHz = 60): Sim3World {
    return new Sim3World(this.e, this.e.sim3_world_new(fx(gravity.x), fx(gravity.y), fx(gravity.z), tickHz));
  }

  world(gravity = { x: 0, y: -10 }, tickHz = 60): SimWorld {
    return new SimWorld(this.e, this.e.sim_world_new(fx(gravity.x), fx(gravity.y), tickHz));
  }
}

export class SimWorld {
  constructor(private readonly e: SimExports, readonly handle: number) {}

  free() {
    this.e.sim_world_free(this.handle);
  }
  step() {
    this.e.sim_step(this.handle);
  }
  get tick(): number {
    return this.e.sim_tick(this.handle);
  }
  hash(): bigint {
    return this.e.sim_hash(this.handle);
  }
  snapshot(): Uint8Array {
    const n = this.e.sim_snapshot(this.handle);
    const out = new Uint8Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = this.e.sim_snapshot_byte(this.handle, i);
    return out;
  }
  restore(bytes: Uint8Array): boolean {
    this.e.sim_snapshot_set_len(this.handle, bytes.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) this.e.sim_snapshot_set_byte(this.handle, i, bytes[i]);
    return this.e.sim_restore(this.handle) === 1;
  }

  addCircle(kind: BodyKind, x: number, y: number, radius: number, density = 1): number {
    return this.e.sim_add_circle(this.handle, kind, fx(x), fx(y), fx(radius), fx(density));
  }
  addBox(kind: BodyKind, x: number, y: number, halfW: number, halfH: number, density = 1): number {
    return this.e.sim_add_box(this.handle, kind, fx(x), fx(y), fx(halfW), fx(halfH), fx(density));
  }
  addCapsule(kind: BodyKind, x: number, y: number, halfLen: number, radius: number, density = 1): number {
    return this.e.sim_add_capsule(this.handle, kind, fx(x), fx(y), fx(halfLen), fx(radius), fx(density));
  }
  remove(id: number) {
    this.e.sim_remove_body(this.handle, id);
  }
  setMaterial(id: number, friction: number, restitution: number) {
    this.e.sim_set_material(this.handle, id, fx(friction), fx(restitution));
  }
  setLayers(id: number, layer: number, mask: number, sensor = false) {
    this.e.sim_set_layers(this.handle, id, layer >>> 0, mask >>> 0, sensor ? 1 : 0);
  }
  setVelocity(id: number, vx: number, vy: number, angular = 0) {
    this.e.sim_set_velocity(this.handle, id, fx(vx), fx(vy), fx(angular));
  }
  setPosition(id: number, x: number, y: number, angle = 0) {
    this.e.sim_set_position(this.handle, id, fx(x), fx(y), fx(angle));
  }
  applyImpulse(id: number, ix: number, iy: number) {
    this.e.sim_apply_impulse(this.handle, id, fx(ix), fx(iy));
  }
  body(id: number): BodyState {
    const g = (f: number) => num(this.e.sim_body_get(this.handle, id, f));
    return { x: g(0), y: g(1), angle: g(2), vx: g(3), vy: g(4), angularVelocity: g(5) };
  }
  /** Raw Q32.32 position, for hashing/networking without float round-trips. */
  bodyRaw(id: number, field: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5): Fx {
    return this.e.sim_body_get(this.handle, id, field);
  }
  raycast(x: number, y: number, dx: number, dy: number, mask = 0xffffffff): RayHit | null {
    const body = this.e.sim_raycast(this.handle, fx(x), fx(y), fx(dx), fx(dy), mask >>> 0);
    if (!body) return null;
    const r = (f: number) => num(this.e.sim_ray_get(f));
    return { body, fraction: r(0), point: { x: r(1), y: r(2) }, normal: { x: r(3), y: r(4) } };
  }
  /** Character controller over a kinematic body; returns its index for `moveCharacter`. */
  character(body: number, stepHeight = 0.5, minGroundNormalY = 0.7): number {
    return this.e.sim_kcc_new(this.handle, body, fx(stepHeight), fx(minGroundNormalY));
  }
  /** Moves the controller; returns true when grounded afterwards. */
  moveCharacter(kcc: number, dx: number, dy: number): boolean {
    return this.e.sim_kcc_move(this.handle, kcc, fx(dx), fx(dy)) === 1;
  }

  // ---- navigation (navmesh, paths, flow fields, crowd agents) ----
  private fillBuffer(bytes: Uint8Array) {
    this.e.sim_snapshot_set_len(this.handle, bytes.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) this.e.sim_snapshot_set_byte(this.handle, i, bytes[i]);
  }
  /** Grid navmesh of cols×rows cells; `blocked` lists [col, row] cells to remove. */
  navGrid(origin: { x: number; y: number }, cell: number, cols: number, rows: number, blocked: [number, number][] = []) {
    const buf = new Uint8Array(blocked.length * 8);
    const dv = new DataView(buf.buffer);
    blocked.forEach(([c, r], i) => {
      dv.setUint32(i * 8, c, true);
      dv.setUint32(i * 8 + 4, r, true);
    });
    this.fillBuffer(buf);
    this.e.sim_nav_grid(this.handle, fx(origin.x), fx(origin.y), fx(cell), cols, rows);
  }
  /** Load a navmesh exported by `NavMesh::to_bytes` (JSON). */
  navLoad(bytes: Uint8Array): boolean {
    this.fillBuffer(bytes);
    return this.e.sim_nav_load(this.handle) === 1;
  }
  navHash(): bigint {
    return this.e.sim_nav_hash(this.handle);
  }
  navLocate(x: number, y: number): number | null {
    const p = this.e.sim_nav_locate(this.handle, fx(x), fx(y));
    return p === 0xffffffff ? null : p;
  }
  navPath(from: { x: number; y: number }, to: { x: number; y: number }, mask = 0xffffffff): { x: number; y: number }[] | null {
    const n = this.e.sim_nav_path(this.handle, fx(from.x), fx(from.y), fx(to.x), fx(to.y), mask >>> 0);
    if (!n) return null;
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push({ x: num(this.e.sim_nav_point(this.handle, 2 * i)), y: num(this.e.sim_nav_point(this.handle, 2 * i + 1)) });
    return out;
  }
  /** Line of sight on the mesh: null when clear, else the boundary point hit. */
  navRaycast(from: { x: number; y: number }, to: { x: number; y: number }): { x: number; y: number } | null {
    if (this.e.sim_nav_raycast(this.handle, fx(from.x), fx(from.y), fx(to.x), fx(to.y)) !== 1) return null;
    return { x: num(this.e.sim_ray_get(1)), y: num(this.e.sim_ray_get(2)) };
  }
  /** Flow field towards a goal shared by any number of agents; null when unreachable. */
  navField(goal: { x: number; y: number }, mask = 0xffffffff): number | null {
    const f = this.e.sim_nav_field(this.handle, fx(goal.x), fx(goal.y), mask >>> 0);
    return f === 0xffffffff ? null : f;
  }
  addAgent(x: number, y: number, radius: number, maxSpeed: number): number {
    return this.e.sim_agent_add(this.handle, fx(x), fx(y), fx(radius), fx(maxSpeed));
  }
  removeAgent(id: number) {
    this.e.sim_agent_remove(this.handle, id);
  }
  agentTarget(id: number, x: number, y: number) {
    this.e.sim_agent_target(this.handle, id, fx(x), fx(y));
  }
  agentFollow(id: number, field: number) {
    this.e.sim_agent_follow(this.handle, id, field);
  }
  agentStop(id: number) {
    this.e.sim_agent_stop(this.handle, id);
  }
  agent(id: number): { x: number; y: number; vx: number; vy: number; arrived: boolean; poly: number } {
    const g = (f: number) => this.e.sim_agent_get(this.handle, id, f);
    return { x: num(g(0)), y: num(g(1)), vx: num(g(2)), vy: num(g(3)), arrived: g(4) === 1n, poly: Number(g(5)) };
  }
  /** Advance all agents one tick (call next to `step()`). */
  crowdStep() {
    this.e.sim_crowd_step(this.handle);
  }
  crowdHash(): bigint {
    return this.e.sim_crowd_hash(this.handle);
  }
  crowdSnapshot(): Uint8Array {
    const n = this.e.sim_crowd_snapshot(this.handle);
    const out = new Uint8Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = this.e.sim_snapshot_byte(this.handle, i);
    return out;
  }
  crowdRestore(bytes: Uint8Array): boolean {
    this.fillBuffer(bytes);
    return this.e.sim_crowd_restore(this.handle) === 1;
  }

  // ---- joints, contact events, shape casts ----
  /** Distance joint between local anchors; `minLength < length` allows slack (rope). */
  jointDistance(a: number, b: number, anchorA: { x: number; y: number }, anchorB: { x: number; y: number }, length: number, minLength = length): number {
    return this.e.sim_joint_distance(this.handle, a, b, fx(anchorA.x), fx(anchorA.y), fx(anchorB.x), fx(anchorB.y), fx(length), fx(minLength));
  }
  /** Pin joint; optional angle limits and motor (`maxTorque > 0` enables it). */
  jointRevolute(
    a: number,
    b: number,
    anchorA: { x: number; y: number },
    anchorB: { x: number; y: number },
    opts: { lower?: number; upper?: number; motorSpeed?: number; maxTorque?: number } = {},
  ): number {
    const limits = opts.lower !== undefined && opts.upper !== undefined;
    return this.e.sim_joint_revolute(
      this.handle, a, b, fx(anchorA.x), fx(anchorA.y), fx(anchorB.x), fx(anchorB.y),
      limits ? 1 : 0, fx(opts.lower ?? 0), fx(opts.upper ?? 0), fx(opts.motorSpeed ?? 0), fx(opts.maxTorque ?? 0),
    );
  }
  jointWeld(a: number, b: number, anchorA: { x: number; y: number }, anchorB: { x: number; y: number }, relAngle = 0): number {
    return this.e.sim_joint_weld(this.handle, a, b, fx(anchorA.x), fx(anchorA.y), fx(anchorB.x), fx(anchorB.y), fx(relAngle));
  }
  removeJoint(id: number): boolean {
    return this.e.sim_joint_remove(this.handle, id) === 1;
  }
  setMotor(joint: number, speed: number, maxTorque: number) {
    this.e.sim_joint_motor(this.handle, joint, fx(speed), fx(maxTorque));
  }
  /** Contact begin/end events from the last `step()`. */
  events(): { a: number; b: number; begin: boolean }[] {
    const n = this.e.sim_events_len(this.handle);
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push({ a: this.e.sim_event_get(this.handle, i, 0), b: this.e.sim_event_get(this.handle, i, 1), begin: this.e.sim_event_get(this.handle, i, 2) === 1 });
    return out;
  }
  /** Sweep a circle along `dir`; same result shape as `raycast()`. */
  circleCast(from: { x: number; y: number }, dir: { x: number; y: number }, radius: number, mask = 0xffffffff) {
    const r = this.e.sim_circlecast(this.handle, fx(from.x), fx(from.y), fx(dir.x), fx(dir.y), fx(radius), mask >>> 0);
    if (!r) return null;
    const g = (i: number) => num(this.e.sim_ray_get(i));
    return { body: r - 1, fraction: g(0), point: { x: g(1), y: g(2) }, normal: { x: g(3), y: g(4) } };
  }
}

export type Vec3 = { x: number; y: number; z: number };
export type Quat = { x: number; y: number; z: number; w: number };
export type Body3State = { position: Vec3; rotation: Quat; velocity: Vec3; angularVelocity: Vec3 };
export type Ray3Hit = { body: number; fraction: number; point: Vec3; normal: Vec3 };

/** Deterministic 3D world (spheres, boxes, capsules) over the same wasm module. */
export class Sim3World {
  constructor(private readonly e: SimExports, readonly handle: number) {}
  free() {
    this.e.sim3_world_free(this.handle);
  }
  step() {
    this.e.sim3_step(this.handle);
  }
  tick(): number {
    return Number(this.e.sim3_tick(this.handle));
  }
  hash(): bigint {
    return this.e.sim3_hash(this.handle);
  }
  snapshot(): Uint8Array {
    const n = this.e.sim3_snapshot(this.handle);
    const out = new Uint8Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = this.e.sim3_snapshot_byte(this.handle, i);
    return out;
  }
  restore(bytes: Uint8Array): boolean {
    this.e.sim3_snapshot_set_len(this.handle, bytes.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) this.e.sim3_snapshot_set_byte(this.handle, i, bytes[i]);
    return this.e.sim3_restore(this.handle) === 1;
  }
  addSphere(kind: BodyKind, p: Vec3, radius: number, density = 1): number {
    return this.e.sim3_add_sphere(this.handle, kind, fx(p.x), fx(p.y), fx(p.z), fx(radius), fx(density));
  }
  addBox(kind: BodyKind, p: Vec3, half: Vec3, density = 1): number {
    return this.e.sim3_add_box(this.handle, kind, fx(p.x), fx(p.y), fx(p.z), fx(half.x), fx(half.y), fx(half.z), fx(density));
  }
  /** Capsule along the body y axis. */
  addCapsule(kind: BodyKind, p: Vec3, halfLen: number, radius: number, density = 1): number {
    return this.e.sim3_add_capsule(this.handle, kind, fx(p.x), fx(p.y), fx(p.z), fx(halfLen), fx(radius), fx(density));
  }
  remove(id: number): boolean {
    return this.e.sim3_remove_body(this.handle, id) === 1;
  }
  setMaterial(id: number, friction: number, restitution: number, sensor = false) {
    this.e.sim3_set_material(this.handle, id, fx(friction), fx(restitution), sensor ? 1 : 0);
  }
  setLayers(id: number, layer: number, mask: number) {
    this.e.sim3_set_layers(this.handle, id, layer >>> 0, mask >>> 0);
  }
  setVelocity(id: number, v: Vec3, w: Vec3 = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }) {
    this.e.sim3_set_velocity(this.handle, id, fx(v.x), fx(v.y), fx(v.z), fx(w.x), fx(w.y), fx(w.z));
  }
  setPosition(id: number, p: Vec3) {
    this.e.sim3_set_position(this.handle, id, fx(p.x), fx(p.y), fx(p.z));
  }
  setRotation(id: number, q: Quat) {
    this.e.sim3_set_rotation(this.handle, id, fx(q.x), fx(q.y), fx(q.z), fx(q.w));
  }
  /** Axis-angle helper for `setRotation` (axis must be unit length). */
  static axisAngle(axis: Vec3, angle: number): Quat {
    const s = Math.sin(angle / 2);
    return { x: axis.x * s, y: axis.y * s, z: axis.z * s, w: Math.cos(angle / 2) };
  }
  applyImpulse(id: number, impulse: Vec3, at?: Vec3) {
    this.e.sim3_apply_impulse(this.handle, id, fx(impulse.x), fx(impulse.y), fx(impulse.z), at ? 1 : 0, fx(at?.x ?? 0), fx(at?.y ?? 0), fx(at?.z ?? 0));
  }
  body(id: number): Body3State {
    const g = (f: number) => num(this.e.sim3_body_get(this.handle, id, f));
    return {
      position: { x: g(0), y: g(1), z: g(2) },
      rotation: { x: g(3), y: g(4), z: g(5), w: g(6) },
      velocity: { x: g(7), y: g(8), z: g(9) },
      angularVelocity: { x: g(10), y: g(11), z: g(12) },
    };
  }
  raycast(from: Vec3, dir: Vec3, mask = 0xffffffff): Ray3Hit | null {
    const r = this.e.sim3_raycast(this.handle, fx(from.x), fx(from.y), fx(from.z), fx(dir.x), fx(dir.y), fx(dir.z), mask >>> 0);
    if (!r) return null;
    const g = (i: number) => num(this.e.sim3_ray_get(i));
    return { body: r - 1, fraction: g(0), point: { x: g(1), y: g(2), z: g(3) }, normal: { x: g(4), y: g(5), z: g(6) } };
  }
  events(): { a: number; b: number; begin: boolean }[] {
    const n = this.e.sim3_events_len(this.handle);
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push({ a: this.e.sim3_event_get(this.handle, i, 0), b: this.e.sim3_event_get(this.handle, i, 1), begin: this.e.sim3_event_get(this.handle, i, 2) === 1 });
    return out;
  }

  // ---- joints and character controller ----
  jointBall(a: number, b: number, anchorA: Vec3, anchorB: Vec3): number {
    return this.e.sim3_joint_ball(this.handle, a, b, fx(anchorA.x), fx(anchorA.y), fx(anchorA.z), fx(anchorB.x), fx(anchorB.y), fx(anchorB.z));
  }
  /** Hinge around local axes; optional angle limits (radians) and motor (`maxTorque > 0`). */
  jointHinge(a: number, b: number, anchorA: Vec3, anchorB: Vec3, axisA: Vec3, axisB: Vec3, opts: { lower?: number; upper?: number; motorSpeed?: number; maxTorque?: number } = {}): number {
    const limits = opts.lower !== undefined && opts.upper !== undefined;
    return this.e.sim3_joint_hinge(
      this.handle, a, b, fx(anchorA.x), fx(anchorA.y), fx(anchorA.z), fx(anchorB.x), fx(anchorB.y), fx(anchorB.z),
      fx(axisA.x), fx(axisA.y), fx(axisA.z), fx(axisB.x), fx(axisB.y), fx(axisB.z),
      limits ? 1 : 0, fx(opts.lower ?? 0), fx(opts.upper ?? 0), fx(opts.motorSpeed ?? 0), fx(opts.maxTorque ?? 0),
    );
  }
  /** Distance joint; `minLength < length` allows slack (rope). */
  jointDistance(a: number, b: number, anchorA: Vec3, anchorB: Vec3, length: number, minLength = length): number {
    return this.e.sim3_joint_distance(this.handle, a, b, fx(anchorA.x), fx(anchorA.y), fx(anchorA.z), fx(anchorB.x), fx(anchorB.y), fx(anchorB.z), fx(length), fx(minLength));
  }
  removeJoint(id: number): boolean {
    return this.e.sim3_joint_remove(this.handle, id) === 1;
  }
  setMotor(joint: number, speed: number, maxTorque: number) {
    this.e.sim3_joint_motor(this.handle, joint, fx(speed), fx(maxTorque));
  }
  hingeAngle(joint: number): number {
    return num(this.e.sim3_hinge_angle(this.handle, joint));
  }
  /** Capsule character controller over a kinematic capsule body; returns a controller index. */
  character(body: number, stepHeight = 0.5, minGroundNormalY = 0.7, snapDistance = 0.25): number {
    return this.e.sim3_kcc_new(this.handle, body, fx(stepHeight), fx(minGroundNormalY), fx(snapDistance));
  }
  /** Move the controller this tick (call before `step()`); returns whether it stands on ground. */
  moveCharacter(k: number, delta: Vec3): boolean {
    return this.e.sim3_kcc_move(this.handle, k, fx(delta.x), fx(delta.y), fx(delta.z)) === 1;
  }
  characterState(k: number): { groundNormal: Vec3; velocity: Vec3; grounded: boolean; groundBody: number | null } {
    const g = (f: number) => this.e.sim3_kcc_get(this.handle, k, f);
    const gb = Number(g(7));
    return { groundNormal: { x: num(g(0)), y: num(g(1)), z: num(g(2)) }, velocity: { x: num(g(3)), y: num(g(4)), z: num(g(5)) }, grounded: g(6) === 1n, groundBody: gb ? gb - 1 : null };
  }

  // ---- convex hulls and sweeps ----
  /** Convex polyhedron from body-space vertices (<= 32) and faces as index loops (any winding);
   *  author vertices around the centre of mass. Returns the body id (throws on an invalid hull). */
  addConvex(kind: BodyKind, pos: Vec3, verts: Vec3[], faces: number[][], density = 1): number {
    this.e.sim3_convex_reset(this.handle);
    for (const v of verts) this.e.sim3_convex_vert(this.handle, fx(v.x), fx(v.y), fx(v.z));
    for (const f of faces) {
      for (const i of f) this.e.sim3_convex_index(this.handle, i);
      this.e.sim3_convex_face_end(this.handle);
    }
    const id = this.e.sim3_add_convex(this.handle, kind, fx(pos.x), fx(pos.y), fx(pos.z), fx(density));
    if ((id >>> 0) === 0xffffffff) throw new Error("sim3: invalid convex hull (need >= 4 vertices and >= 4 faces)");
    return id;
  }
  /** Sweep a sphere along `dir`; `fraction` is where the centre stops, `point`/`normal` lie on the hit surface. */
  sphereCast(from: Vec3, dir: Vec3, radius: number, mask = 0xffffffff): Ray3Hit | null {
    const id = this.e.sim3_spherecast(this.handle, fx(from.x), fx(from.y), fx(from.z), fx(dir.x), fx(dir.y), fx(dir.z), fx(radius), mask);
    if (id === 0) return null;
    const g = (i: number) => num(this.e.sim3_ray_get(i));
    return { body: id - 1, fraction: g(0), point: { x: g(1), y: g(2), z: g(3) }, normal: { x: g(4), y: g(5), z: g(6) } };
  }
  /** Sweep a capsule (segment along its local y, rotated by `rot`) along `dir`; same result shape as `sphereCast`. */
  capsuleCast(from: Vec3, rot: Quat, halfLen: number, radius: number, dir: Vec3, mask = 0xffffffff): Ray3Hit | null {
    const id = this.e.sim3_capsulecast(this.handle, fx(from.x), fx(from.y), fx(from.z), fx(rot.x), fx(rot.y), fx(rot.z), fx(rot.w), fx(halfLen), fx(radius), fx(dir.x), fx(dir.y), fx(dir.z), mask);
    return this.rayResult(id);
  }
  /** Sweep a box (`half` extents, rotated by `rot`) along `dir`; same result shape as `sphereCast`. */
  boxCast(from: Vec3, rot: Quat, half: Vec3, dir: Vec3, mask = 0xffffffff): Ray3Hit | null {
    const id = this.e.sim3_boxcast(this.handle, fx(from.x), fx(from.y), fx(from.z), fx(rot.x), fx(rot.y), fx(rot.z), fx(rot.w), fx(half.x), fx(half.y), fx(half.z), fx(dir.x), fx(dir.y), fx(dir.z), mask);
    return this.rayResult(id);
  }
  private rayResult(id: number): Ray3Hit | null {
    if (id === 0) return null;
    const g = (i: number) => num(this.e.sim3_ray_get(i));
    return { body: id - 1, fraction: g(0), point: { x: g(1), y: g(2), z: g(3) }, normal: { x: g(4), y: g(5), z: g(6) } };
  }
}
```
